text.body:
<1> oṃ śrī gaṇeśāyanamaḥ oṃ śrī gurubhyonamaḥ śāṃti kamalakaro pūrva pīṭhikāyaṃ anyatra uddhṛta sarvaśānti karmopayogi svasti vācanādi viṣayāḥ | tatrādau śrīguru prārthanādikam guruḥ brahmā gururviṣṇuḥ gururdevo maheśvaraḥ gurussākṣātpara brahma tasmai śrī guravenamaḥ || tatradau devatā prārdhanādikam‌ vāgīśādyā ssumanasaḥ sarvārdhānā mupakrame | yaṃ natvā kṛta kṛtyā syuḥtaṃ namāmi gajānanam‌ || caṃdramā ivarājaṃtaṃ dvijarājaṃ kalānidhim | vaṃde vāṃchita lābhāya subrahmaṇyaṃ mahāgurum || tatvajñānaphale grahi rjhamatara vyāmoha muṣṭiṃdhayaḥ | niśśeṣa vyasanodaraṃbhari raphu prāgbhāra kūlaṃkaṣaḥ | luṃṭāko mada matsarādi vitate stāpatrayā ruṃtudaḥ | pāda ssyā damitaṃpacaḥ karuṇayā bhadraṃkara śśāṃkaraḥ || acaturvadano brahmā dvibāhu raparo hariḥ | aphāla locana śśaṃbhu rbhagavān bādarāyaṇaḥ || kaśyapo trirbharadvājo vaśvamitro tha gautamaḥ | jamadagni rvasiṣṭhaśca saptaite tu mahārṣayaḥ || manvādyāḥ smṛtikartaraḥ karma brahma prabodhakāḥ | āpa staṃbādi munayaḥ sarve dharmaika tatparāḥ || vaṃdanīyā dvijātīnāṃ kṛtajñā pūrvakaṃ sadā | śreyase bhūyane smābhiḥ pāthiritāhi dayālavaḥ || eta tvārthiva dehaḥ prādūra bhūdyena bhagavatā guruṇā | saṃtu namāṃsi sahasraṃ tasmai sarvajña mūrtaye pitre || tanu rida mabhivṛddhiṃsamavāpyā sai sarva devatā śaktyā | devyā yayā vikalayā mātre tasyai namostu bhagavatyai || etanmudraṇa kārye paidika sadvipra bṛṃda toṣārtham | teṣā māśīryādai ssaphalo stu kṛta prayatno yam || guṇadoṣā bādho gṛhṇa nniṃdukṣvelā viveśvaraḥ | śirasā ślāghate pūrvaṃ paraṃ kaṃṭhe niyacchati || vijñapyaṃte hi vidvāṃsaḥ paṃḍitā guṇa maṃḍitāḥ | saṃgrahe smi ngraṃthajāte dayāṃ kurvaṃtu sādaram || śrī gurubhyonamaḥ śāṃti kamalākara pūrva pīṭhikāyaṃ svastivācana prayogaḥ hariḥ oṃ śuklāṃbaradharaṃ viṣṇuṃ śaśivarṇaṃ caturbhujam | prasannavadanaṃ dhyāye tsarva vighnopa śāṃtaye || tadeva lagnaṃ sudinaṃ tadeva tārābalaṃ caṃdrabalaṃ tadeva | vidyābalaṃ daivabalaṃ tadeva lakṣmīpate te'ghriṃ yugaṃ smarāmi || sumuhūrtamastu, supratiṣṭhitamastu | devīṃ vāca majanayaṃta devā stāṃ viśvarūpāḥ paśavo vadaṃti | sānomandreṣa mūrjaṃ duhānā dhenurvā gasyā nupa suṣṭu taitu || sumuhūrtamastu | supratiṣṭhitamastu | kalyāṇādbhuta gātrāya kāmitārtha pradāyineḥ | śrīmadveṃkaṭa nāthāya śrīnivāsāya maṃgalam || yatra yogīśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo yatra pārtho dhanurdharaḥ | tatra śrī rvijayo bhūti rthruvānīti rmati rmama || smṛte sakala kalyāṇa bhājanaṃ yatra jāyate | puruṣasta majaṃ nityaṃ vrajāmi śaraṇaṃ hapim || sarvadā sarvakīryeṣu nāsti teṣā mamaṃralam | yeṣāṃ hṛdistho bhagavān maṃgalāyatanaṃ hariḥ || lābha ste ṣāṃ jaya steṣāṃ kuta steṣāṃ parābhavaḥ | yeṣā mindīvara śyāmo hṛtayastho janārdanaḥ || āpadā mapahartāraṃ dātāraṃ sarva saṃpadām | lokābhirāmaṃ śrīrāmaṃ bhūyo bhūyo namāmyaham || sarvamaṃgala māṃgalye śive sarvārtha sādhike | śaraṇye tryabake devi nārāyaṇi namo stute || śrī lakṣmī nārāyaṇābhyāṃ namaḥ śrī aruṃdhatī vasiṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ śrī umā maheśvarābhyāṃ namaḥ śrī sītā rāmābhyāṃ namaḥ śrī vāṇī hiraṇya garbhābhyāṃ namaḥ śrī mātā pitṛbhyāṃ namaḥ śrī śacī puraṃdarābhyaṃ namaḥ śrī ācāryebhyo namaḥ śrī gurubhyo namaḥ sarvebhyo brāhmaṇebhyo mahājanebhyonamaḥ | bhū to ccā ṭa na m uttiṣṭhaṃtu bhūta piśācāḥ ete bhūmibhārakāḥ | eteṣā mavirodhena brahmakarma samārabhe || prāṇānāyamya || oṃ bhūḥ oṃ bhuvaḥ og suvaḥ oṃ mahaḥ oṃ janaḥ oṃ tapaḥ og satyaṃ oṃ tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhiyo yonaḥ pracadayāt omapojyotī raso amṛtaṃ brahma bhūrbhuvassuvaroṃ|| mama upātta samasta duridakṣayadvātarā śrī parameśvara muddiśya śrī parameśvara prītyardhaṃ | śubhe śobhane muhūrte adyabrahmaṇaḥ dvitīya parārthe śvetavarāhakalpe vaivasvata masvantare kaliyuge prathamapāde jaṃbūdvīpe bharatavarṣe bharatakhaṃḍe meroḥ dakṣiṇadigbhāge, kṛṣṇā godāvaryoḥ madhyapradeśe śobhanagṛhe samasta devatā brāhmaṇa harihara sannidhau asmin vartamāne vyāhārīka cāṃdramānena ......... saṃvatsare ......... ayane ......... ṛtā ......... māse ......... pakṣe ......... tithau ......... vānare śubha nakṣatra śubhayoga śubhakaraṇa evaṃ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭhāyāṃ śubhatithau, śrīmān ......... gotraḥ ......... nāmadheyaḥ ......... śrīmataḥ ......... gotrasya ......... nāmadheyasya ......... mama upātta samasta durita kṣaya dvārā śrī rapameśvara muddiśya śrīparameśvara prītyarthaṃ, prārīpsitasya karmaṇaḥ aṃgatvena śudhyarthaṃ vṛddhyardhaṃ, śāṃtyardhaṃ, abhyudayārthaṃca mahājanai ssaha ādau svasti puṇyāhavācanaṃ kariṣye, tadādau nirvighnena parisamāptyarthaṃ | oṃ gaṇānāṃ tvā gaṇapatig havāmahe kaviṃ kavīnā vupama śrśastamam | jyeṣṭharājaṃ brahmaṇāṃ bragmaṇaspata āna śṛṇava nnū tibhissīda sādanam || śānti kamalākaramu sāṃgaṃ sāyudhaṃ savāhanaṃ saśaktikaṃ patnīputra parivāra sametaṃ sumukhaṃ śrī mahāgaṇapati mānāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | oṃ anu nīte punarasmāsu cakṣuḥ punaḥ prāṇamihano dhehibhogam | jyokpaśyema sūrya muccaraṃta mamakule mṛḍayāna ssvasti || oṃ amṛtaṃ vai prāṇā amṛta māpaḥ prāṇāneva yathā sthānamupa hvayate || sthirobhava, varadobhava, suprasannobhava, sthirāsanaṃ kuru | śuklāṃbaradharaṃ viṣṇuṃ śaśivarṇaṃ catupbhujam | prasanna vadanaṃ dhyāye tsarva vighnopa śāmataye || śrī mahāgaṇādhipataye namaḥ thyāyāmītyādikaṃ yathāvibhavam, yathāvi staraṃ yathāvakāśaṃ ṣoḍaśopacāra pūjāṃ kṛtvā | sumukhaścaikadaṃtaśca kapilo gajakarṇakaḥ | laṃbodaraśca vikaṭo vighnarājo gaṇādhipaḥ || dhūmaketu rgaṇādhyakṣaḥ phālacaṃdro gajānaḥ | vakratuṃḍa śśūrpakarṇo heraṃya sskaṃda pūryajaḥ || ṣeḍaśai tāni nāmāni yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādapi | vidyāraṃbhe vivāheca praveśe nīrdametathā || saṃgrāme sarvakāryeṣu vighna stasya na jāyate | | śrī mahāgaṇaidhipatayo namaḥ suvarṇaḥ divya maṃtra puṣpaṃ samarpa yāmi, ātma pradakṣiṇa namaskārām samarpayāmi | vakratuṃḍa mahākāya koṭisūrya samaprabha | avighnaṃ kuru me deva sarvakāryeṣu sarvadā || maṃtrahīnaṃ kriyārahīnaṃ bhaktaṃhīnaṃ gaṇādhipa | yatpūjitaṃ mayādeva paripūrṇaṃ tadastute || anayā dhyānāvāhanādi ṣoḍaśopacara pūjayā bhagavan sarvātmakaḥ śrī mahāgaṇādhipatiḥ suprataḥ suprasannoḥ varadobhavatu | uttare śūbhakarmaṇya vighnamastu | śrī mahāgaṇapati prasādaṃ śirasā gṛhṇāmi | samāptā śrī vighveśvara pūjā oṃ tatsat | oṃ imaṃme varuṇaśṛdhīhava madyāca mṛḍaya tvāmavasyuḥ rācake tatvāyāmi brahmaṇāvaṃdamāna stadāśāsth yajamāno havirphiḥ aheḍamāno varuṇaha bhodhyuraśag samāna āyuḥ pramoṣīḥ || oṃ bhūḥ varuṇa māvāhayāmi oṃ bhuvaḥ varuṇa māvāhayāmi ogaṃ suvaḥ varuṇa māvāhayāmi oṃ bhūrbhuvassuvaḥ varuṇa mānāhayāmi varuṇāyamanaḥ dhyānā vāhanādi ṣoḍaśopacārapūjāṃ namarpayāmi anayā varuṇa pūjayā varuṇaḥ prīyatām || sarveṣu kāleṣu samastadeśe ṣvaśeṣa kāryaṣu tatheśvareśaavaraḥ | sarvasvarūpī bhagavā nanādi rmamāstu māṃgalya vivṛddhaye hariḥ || pavitrapāṇiḥ prāṇānāyayya, evaṃ ......... tithau | asmākaṃ sakuṭu mbānāṃ aiśvaryābhivṛddhyarthaṃ, samasta magalā vāptyardhaṃ, śāntikarma kariṣyamāṇaḥ | tasmin śāṃti karmaṇi ādityādīnāṃ navānāṃ grahāṇāṃ yeye grahāḥ śubha sthāneṣu sthitāḥ teṣāṃgrahāṇāṃ atyaṃtāti śaya śubha phala pradātṛtva siddhyardhaṃ | ādityādi navagraha devatā uddhiśya ādityādi navagraha devatā prītyardhaṃ navagraha makhākhyaṃ karma kariṣya māmaḥ tadādau śuddyardhaṃ vṛddhyardhaṃ abhyudayārdhaṃca mahājanai ssahasvasti puṇyahavācanaṃ karuṣye | oṃ puṇyāhaṃ dīrgha māyurastu, śivā āpaḥ saṃtu | saumanasya vastu | akṣataṃ cāriṣṭaṃ cāstu | oṃ arcata prārcata priya medhāso arcata | arcaṃtu putrakā uta puraṃ na dhṛṣṇvarcata || oṃ gaṃdhadvarāṃ dhurādharṣāṃ nitya puṣṭāṃ karīṣiṇīm | īśvarīg sarvabhūtānāṃ tāmihopahvaye śriyam || gaṃdhāḥ pāṃtu | saumaṃgalyaṃ cāstu | oṃ ayanete parāyaṇe dūrvārohaṃtu puṣpiṇīḥ | hradāśca puṃḍarīkāṇi samudrasya gṛhā ime || akṣatāḥ pāṃtu | āyuṣyamastu | puṣpāṇi pāṃtu | saumaṃgya cāstu | tāṃbūlāni pāṃtu, aiśvaryamastu | dakṣiṇāḥ pāṃtu, bahudeyaṃ cāstu | svaśreyasa mastu | prajāpatiḥ priyatām| śāṃtirastu | yaṃ kṛtvā sarvavedayajña kriyā karaṇa karmaraṃbhā śsubhā śyobhanāḥ pravartante tamahā moṃkāra mādiṃ kṛtya bhavadbhiranujñātaḥ puṇyaṃ puṇyāhaṃ vācayiṣye | vācyatām oṃ bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devāḥ bhadraṃ paśyemākṣabhurya jatrāḥ | sthirai raṃgai stuṣṭu vāgṃ sastanūbhiḥ | vyaśema deva hita yadāyuḥ || oṃ draviṇodā draviṇasasturasya draviṇodā ssanarasya priyaṃsat dravanaṇodā vīravatī viṣaṃno draviṇodā rāsate dīrgha māyaḥ || savitā paścātātsavitā purastā tpapitottārāt savitā dharāttāt | savitāna ssuvatu sarvatātiṃ navetāno rāsatāṃ dīrghamāyuḥ || navo navobhavati jāyamānohnāṃ ketu ruṣa sāmetyagre | bhāgaṃ devebhyo vidādhā tyāya srpacandramai stirati dīrdha māyuḥ || āpa uṃdaṃtu jīvane dīrghāyutvāya varcase || oṃ yastvā hṛdā kīriṇā manyamāno - martyaṃ martyo johavīmi | jātavodo yaśo asmāsu dhehi prajābhiragne amṛtatvamaśyām || yasmaitvagṃ sukṛte jātaveda uloka magne kṛṇava ssyonam | aśvinagṃ saputriṇaṃ vīravaṃtaṃ gomaṃtag rayiṃnaśatesvasti || saṃtvā siṃcāmi yajuṣā prajāmāyurdhanaṃca || dakṣiṇa kalaśamādāya | prākkalaśe kiṃci tkiṃci dudakaṃ nivayati | dīrghamāyurastu | ma nassamādhīyatāṃ | samāhita masasaḥ smaḥ | prasīdaṃtubhavaṃtaḥ prasannāḥ smaḥ | śāntirastu | puṣṭi pastu | āyuṣyamastu | ārogya mastu | svasti śivaṃ karmāstu | karma samṛddhirastu | putra samṛddhirastu | veda samṛddhirastu | śāstra samṛddhirastu | dhana dhānya samṛddhirastu | iṣṭa naṃpadastu | īśānyāṃ bahir‌deśe, ariṣṭa nirasanamastu | iti kalaśayo rīśānyadeśe udakaṃ siṃcet | yatpāpaṃ tatrpatihatamastu | yacchreya sta dastu | śukrāṃgāraka budha bṛhaspati śanaiścara rāhuketu soma sahita āditya purogāḥ sarve grahāḥ prīyantām | tithi karaṇa muhūrta janma nakṣatra digdevatāḥ prīyantām | nairṛtyāṃ diśi śāmyaṃtu ghorāṇi | śāmyaṃtu pāpāni | śāmyaṃtu ītayaḥ | iti udakaṃ śiṃcet | pradhama kalaśe śubhānivardaṃtāṃ | śivā ṛtava ssaṃtu | śivā oṣadhaya ssaṃtu | śivā vanaspataya ssaṃtu | ahorātre śive syātām | uttare śubha karmaṇya vighnamastu | uttarottara mahārahābhivṛddhi rastu | uttarottarā śśubhāḥ kriyā ssaṃpadyantām | agni purogāḥ viśvodevāḥ priyantām | maheśvarī purogāḥ mātaraḥ priyaṃtām | aiṃdra purogāḥ marudgaṇāḥ priyantam | vasiṣṭha purogāḥ ṛṣigaṇāḥ priyaṃtām, śrī viṣṇu purogā ssarvedevāḥ priyaṃtām | āditya purogā ssarve grahāḥ priyaṃtām | ṛṣaya śchaḍāgsyācāryāḥ vedāḥ yajñāḥ dakṣiṇāśca priyaṃtām | brahmaca brāhmaṇāśca priyaṃtām | brahma viṣṇu maheśvarāśca priyaṃtām | śraddhā medhe priyetām | priyatāṃ bhagavānnāgāyaṇaḥ | priyatāṃ bhagavān parjanyaḥ | priyatāṃ bhagavān svāmī mahāsenaḥ | priyatāṃ bhagavān pitāmahāḥ | satyā etā āśiṣaḥ saṃtu | puṇyāha kālā vācyaṃtām | itisiṃcet | oṃ udgāteva śakune sāmagāyasi brahmaputra iva savaneṣu śaṃsani | vṛṣeva vājī śisumatī rapītyā sarvato naśśakune bhadramāvada viśvato naśśakune puṇyamāvada || āvadaṃ stvaṃ śakune bhadramāvada tūṣṇīmāsīna ssumatiṃ cikiddhinaḥ | yadutpatanvadasi karkari ryadhā bṛhadvademani dadhe suvīrāḥ || yājyayā yajati prattirtvayājyā puṇyaivalakṣmīḥ puṇyāmeva tallakṣmīṃ saṃbhāvayati puṇyāṃ lakṣmīṃ saṃskurute oṃ yatpuṇyaṃ nakṣatram | tadbaṭkurvīto pavyuṣam | yadāvai sūrya udeti | atha nakṣatraṃ naiti | yāvati tatra sūryogaccet | yatra jaghanyaṃ paśyet | tāvati kuryīta yatkārī syāt | puṇyāha eva kurute || oṃ yatpuṇyaṃ nakṣatram | tadbaṭkurvīto vavyuṣam | yadāvai sūrya udeti | atha nakṣatraṃ naiti | yāvati tatra sūryogacchet | yatra jaghanyaṃ paśyet | tāvati kurvīta yatkārī syāt | puṇyāha eva kurute || oṃ tāni vāetāni yama nakṣatrāṇi | yānyeva deva nakṣatrāṇi | toṣu kurvīta yatkārī syāt | puṇyāha eva kurute || iti namasturyāt | tataḥ oṃ puṇyāhaṃ bhavaṃto bruvaṃtu oṃ puṇyāhaṃ | ityevaṃ triḥ vadet | oṃ svastaye vāyumupa brahamahai somaṃsvasti bhuvanasyayanpatiḥ || bṛhaspatiṃ sarvagaṇaṃ svasteye svastaya ādityāso bhavaṃtunaḥ || āditya udayavīya ssvastyā priyaṃte pathyaṃ svasti mabhyu dyaṃti svastyai vedaḥ priyaṃte svastyudyaṃti svastyidyaṃti || oṃ svastayanaṃ tārkṣya mariṣṭanevamiṃ mahādbhūtaṃ vā yasaṃ tevatānāṃ | asuraghna muṃdra sakhaṃ samatsu bṛhadyaśo nāva mivāpu hema || aṃho muca māṃgira saṃgayaṃca svastyātreyaṃ manasāca tārkṣyam | prayatapāṇi śśaraṇaṃ prapadye svasti saṃbādheṣvabhayaṃ no astu || svastina iṃdro vṛddha śravāḥ svastinaḥ pūṣā viśvavedāḥ | svastinastārkṣyo ariṣṭa nemuḥ svastino bṛhaspatirdadhātu || oṃ aṣṭau devā vasava ssomyāsaḥ | catasro devīrajarā śraviṣṭhāḥ | te yajñaṃ pāṃtu rajanaḥ parastāt | saṃvatsarīṇa mamṛtaggṃ svasti ityabhyudayaṃ prārdhayamānaḥ, mahyaṃ saha kuṭuṃbāya ayuṣmate svasti bhavaṃto bṛvaṃtu, āyuṣmate svasti, evaṃ triḥ; oṃ svasti bhavaṃto bṛvaṃtu | oṃ svasti | evaṃ triḥ | oṃ ṛddhyāma stomaṃ sanu yāma vāya mānomaṃtraṃ sarate hopayātam | yaśonu pakvaṃ madhu goṣvaṃtarā bhūtāṃśo aśvinoḥ kāmamaprāḥ || sarvāmṛddhi mṛdhnuyāmiti taṃ vai teyasaiva purastā tparyabhava cchaṃdobhi rmadhyakṣarai purariṣṭā dgāyatrā ssarvato dvādaśāhu paribhūya sarvāmṛddhi mṛdhno tsarvāmṛddhi mṛthnotiya evaṃ veda || oṃ ṛddhyāsma havyai rnamasepa sadya | mitraṃ devaṃ mitradheyaṃ no astu | anūrādhān haviṣā varthayaṃtaḥ śataṃ jīvema śarada ssavīrāḥ || oṃ trīṇaṃ trīṇivai devānā mṛddhāsi | trīṇi chaṃdāgṃsisi | trīṇi savanāni | traya ime lokāḥ | ṛddhyāmeva tadvīrya eṣu lokeṣu prati tiṣṭhati || vāma dakṣiṇa hastābhyāṃ dakṣiṇottara kalaśauyugapadgṛhītvā, prākkalaśe - svasti puṇyāha samṛddhistu, varṣa śata saṃpūrṇamastu ......... gotrābhi vṛddhirastu, śāntiḥ puṣṭiḥ tuṣṭiścāstu | punarasi go brāhmaṇebhya śśubhaṃ bhavatu | sarvasaṃpadastu, bhagavān māstoṣpatiḥ prīyatā miti bhavaṃto bṛvaṃtu | bhagavan vāstoṣpatiḥ prīyatām iti saṃcet | oṃ śucīve havyā maruta śmucīnā | śucigṃ hino myadhyaragṃ śucibhyaḥ | ṛtena satyamṛta sāpa āyan ścuci janmāna śśucayaḥ pāvakāḥ || agni śmuci vrata aśvatdhaṃ bṛhaspataye, audumbaraṃ śukrāya, śamīṃ śanaiścarāya, rāhave dūrvāḥ ketave kuśāḥ, sūryasya - ravi grahamu ākṛṣṇe netyasya maṃtrasya, hiraṇya stūpaṛṣiḥ, savitā devatā triṣṭup chaṃdaḥ, sūryagraha devatā muddhiśya ......... prītyarthaṃ, sūrya graha prasāda siddhyardhe adhidevatā pratyadhi devatā sahita sūryagrahārādhane viniyogaḥ | karasyāsaḥ - hṛdayādisyāsaḥ ; - akṛṣṇena aṃgaṣṭhābhyaṃ namaḥ hṛdayāya sanamaḥ rajasā tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ śirase svāhā niveśayan madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ śikhāyai vauṣaṭ amṛtaṃ martaṃca amānikābhyāṃ namaḥ kavacāya huṃ hiraṇyayena savitārathena kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ netratrayāyavauṣaṭ ādevoyāti bhūvamāni paśyan karatala karapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ astrāya phaṭ evaṃ karanyāsaḥ hṛdayādinyāsaḥ, bhūrbhuvassuvaromiti digbaṃdhaṛ | dhyānam - vedī madhye lalita kamale karṇikāyāṃ rathastha ssaptāśvorkosruṇa rucivapuḥ saptarajjurvvibāhuḥ | gotre ramye bahuvidhaguṇe kāśyapākhye pramātaḥ kāligākhye viṣayajanitaḥ prāṅmukhaḥ padmahastaḥ | padmāsanaḥ padmakarodvibāhuḥ padmadyutiḥ saptaturaṃgavāhaḥ | divākaro loka gupuḥ kirīṭī mayi prasādaṃ vidadhātu devaḥ || maṃtra - ākṛṣṇena rajasā vartamāno niveśaya nnamṛtaṃ martaṃca | hiraṇyayena savitā rathenā devoyāti bhuvanāni paśyan || oṃ bhūrbhuvassuvaḥ | sūrya grahehā gaccha | sūrya grahaṃ rakta varṇaṃ, rakta mālyāṃbaradharaṃ, rakta chatra dhvaja ratha patākādi śobhitaṃ, divyarathasamārūdaṃ, meruṃ pradakṣiṇī kurvāṇaṃ, prāṅmukhaṃ, padmāsavasthaṃ, dvibhujaṃ, saptāśvaṃ, saptarajjuṃ, kaliṃga deśādhipatiṃ, kāśyapasagotraṃ, prabhava saṃvatsara māgha śuddha saptamyāṃ viśākhānakṣatre jātaṃ, siṃharāśyadhipatiṃ, bhānuvāsara prayuktaṃ, kirīṭinaṃ, sākhāsīnaṃ, patnīputra parivāra sametaṃ, grahamaṃḍale godhūma dhānyasyopari sūryagraha māvāhāyāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi || adhidevata - agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe hotāraṃ viśvavedasam | asyayajñesya sukratum || sūrya grahādhi devatā magnaṃ sāṃgaṃ sāyudhaṃ savāhanaṃ śakti patnī putra parivārasametaṃ sūrya grahasya dakṣiṇataḥ agnimāhayāmi || pratyadhivata - kadrudrāya pracetase mīḍhuṣṭamāya tavyase vocema śaṃtamagṃ hṛde || sūryagraha pratyadhidevatāṃ, rudraṃ sāṃgaṃ sāyudhaṃ savāhanaṃ śakti patnī putra parivārasametaṃ sūryagrahasya uttarataḥ rudra māvāyāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi || caṃdrasya - caṃdra grahamu āpyāya svetyasya maṃtrasya | gautamaṛṣiḥ | somodevatā | gāyatrīcchaṃdaḥ | adhidevatā sahita caṃdragraha prasāda siddhyarthe caṃdra grahārādhane viniyogaḥ | karanyālaḥ - hṛdayādinyāsaḥ - oṃ āpyāyasva aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ hṛdayāya namaḥ sametute tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ śirase svāhā viśvataḥ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ śikhāyai vauṣaṭ somavṛṣṇiyam anāmukābhyāṃ namaḥ kavacāya huṃ bhavāvājasya kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ netratrayāyavauṣaṭ saṃgathe karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ astrāya ṣaṭ evaṃ karanyāsaḥ, hṛdayādinyāsaḥ, bhūrbhuvassuvaromiti digbaṃdhaḥ | dhyānam - agneya bhāge praradho daśāśvaścātreyajo yāmuna deśa jaśca | pratyaṅmukhasthaḥ caturaśra pīṭhe gadādharāṃgo himavatsvabhāvaḥ || śvetāṃbaraḥ śvetavapuḥ kirīṭī śvetadyuti rdaṃḍadharo dvibāhuḥ | caṃdromṛtātma vapadaḥ kirīṭī śreyāṃsi mahyaṃ vidadhātu devaḥ || maṃtraḥ - āpyāyasva sametute viśvataḥ soma vṛṣṭiyam | bhavā vājanya saṃgadhe || oṃ bhūrbhuvassuvaḥ | caṃdragrahehāgaccha | caṃdra grahaṃ, śveta varṇaṃ, śveta gaṃdhaṃ, śveta puṣpaṃ, śveta mālyāṃbaradharaṃ, śvetacchatra dhvaja ratha patākādi śobhitaṃ, divyaratha samārūḍhaṃ, moruṃ pradakṣīṇī kuryāṇaṃ, daśāśvaratha vāhānaṃ, pratyaṅmakhaṃ, dvibhūjaṃ, daṃḍadharaṃ, yāmuna deśādhipatiṃ, ātreyasa gotraṃ, naṃdana saṃvatsara kārtika śuddha caturdaśyāṃ kṛttikā nakṣatre jātaṃ, karkaṭaka rāśyadhipatiṃ, iṃdumāsara prayuktaṃ kirīṭinaṃ, sukhāsīnaṃ, patnī putra parivāra sametaṃ grahamaṃḍale praviṣṭa masminnadhikaraṇe sūryagraha syāgneya digbhāge samacaturaśramaṃḍale taṃḍulādhānyasyopari bhagavaṃtaṃ caṃdragraha māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmu pūjayāmi | adhidevatā - apsume somo abra vī daṃta viśvāvi bheṣajā | agniṃca viśva śaṃbhuva māpaśca viśva bheṣajīḥ || caṃdra grahādhidevatāḥ apassāṃgāḥ sāyudhāḥ savāhanāḥ śakti pati putra parivāra sametāḥ caṃdragrahasya dakṣiṇataḥ apaḥ āvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi || pratyadhidevatā - gaurī mimāya salilāni takṣatyekapadī dvipadī sācatuṣpadī | aṣṭāpadī namapadī babhūvuṣī sahāsrākṣarā paramevyoman || caṃdragraha pratyadhidevatāṃ gaurīṃ sāṃgāṃ sāyadhāṃ savāhanāṃ śakti putra pati parivāra sametāṃ caṃdragraha syottarataḥ gaurī māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi || aṃgārakasya - kujagrahamu agniryūrdhe tyasya maṃtrasya | virūpa ṛṣiḥ | aṃgāraka grahadevatā | gāyatrīcchaṃdaḥ | adhidevatā pratyadhidevatā sahita aṃgāraka graha prasāda siddhyarthaṃ aṃgāraka grahārādhane viniyogaḥ || karanyānaḥ - hṛdayādinyāsaḥ - agnirmūrthā aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ hṛdayāya namaḥ divaḥ kakut tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ śikhāyai vauṣaṭ ayaṃ anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ kavacāya huṃ apāgṃ retāgṃsi kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ netratrayāyavauṣaṭ jinvati karatala karapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ astrāya ṣaṭ evaṃ karanyāsaḥ, hṛdayādinyāsaḥ, bhūrbhuvassuvaromiti digbaṃdhaḥ | dhyānam - yāmyegadā śakti dharastri śūlī varaprado yāmyamukho'tiraktiḥ | kuba stvavaṃtī viṣaya strakoṇa stasmin bharadvāja kule prasūtaḥ || raktāṃjaro raktavapuḥ kirīṭī caturbhujo meṣagamo gadānṛtī | dharāsuta śmaktidharastraśūlī sadā mama syādvaradaḥ praśāntaḥ || maṃtraḥ - oṃ agnirūrdhā divaḥ kakutpatiḥ pṛthivyā ayam | apāgṃ retāgṃsi jinvati || oṃ bhūrbhuvassuvaḥ | aṃgāraka grahehāgaccha | aṃgāraka grahehāgaccha | aṃgāraka gha grahaṃ, rakta varṇaṃ, rakta puṣpaṃ, rakta mālyāṃbaradharaṃ, raktachatra dhvaja ratha patākādi śobhitaṃ, divyaratha samārūḍhaṃ, meruṃ pradakṣiṇa kuryāṇaṃ, meṣa vāhanaṃ, dakṣiṇābhi mukhaṃ, caturbhujaṃ, gadā śūla śaktidharaṃ, avaṃtī deśādhipatiṃ, bhāradvājasa gotraṃ, akṣaya saṃvatsara bhādrapada śukla dvitīyāyāṃ pūrva phalgunī nakṣatra jātaṃ, meṣa vṛścika rāśyadhipatiṃ, bhaumanāsara prayuktaṃ, kirīṭinaṃ, kirīṭinaṃ, sukhāsīnaṃ, patnī patra parivāra sametaṃ, grahamaṃḍale praviṣṭamasminnadhikaraṇe sūrya grahasya dakṣiṇa digbhāge trikoṇākāra maṃḍale āḍhaka dhānyasyopari aṃgāraka grahamāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi || adhidevata - oṃ syonā pṛthivi bhavā nṛkṣarā niveśanī | yacchānaḥ śarma saprathāḥ || aṃkāraka grahādhidevatāṃ pṛthivīṃ, sāṃgāṃ sāyudhāṃ savāhanāṃ pati śakti putra parivāra sametāṃ aṃgāraka grahasya dakṣiṇaḥ pṛthivī māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi || pratyadhidevatā - oṃ kṣetrasya patināvayugṃ hiteneva jayāmasi | gāmaśvaṃ poṣayitvā savo mṛḍātī dṛśe || aṃgāraka pratyadhidevatāṃ kṣetrapālakaṃ sāṃgaṃ sāyadhaṃ savāhanaṃ śakta patnī putra sametāṃ aṃgāraka grahasyottarataḥ kṣetrapālaka māvāhayāmu sthāpayāmu pūjayāmi || budhasya - budha grahamu udbudhyasvetyasya maṃtrasya | madhuścaṃdaṛṣiḥ budhagraho devatā | triṣṭup chaṃdaḥ | yajamānasyādhi devatā pratyadhi devatā sahita budhagraha siddhyarthe budhagrahārādhane viniyogaḥ || maṃtraḥ - kapanyāsaḥ - hṛdayādinyāsaḥ - udbudhya svāgne aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ hṛdayāya namaḥ prati jāgṛhyenaṃ tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ śirase syāhā iṣṭāpū rtesagṃ sṛjethām madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ śikhāyai vauṣaṭ ayaṃca anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ śakavacāya huṃ punaḥ kṛṇvagt‌sgāpitaraṃ yuvānaṃ kaniṣṭhakābhyāṃ namaḥ netratrayāyavauṣaṭ‌ anyātāgmasī tvayitaṃtumetaṃ karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃnamaḥ astrāya phaṭ evaṃ karanyāsaḥ, hṛdayādinyānaḥ, bhūrbhuvassuvaromiti digbaṃdhaḥ | dhyānaṃ - udaṅmukho māgadhajo haristha ścātreya gotra śara maṃḍalasthaḥ | sakhaḍga carmoru gadādharoṅñastvāśānabhāge varada ssupītaḥ || pītāṃbaraḥ pītavapuḥ kirīṭī caturbhujo daṃḍadharaśca saumyaḥ | carmāsi dhṛksomasuta ssumoru ssiṃhādhirūḍho varado budhaśca || oṃ udbudhya svāgne pratijāgṛhyena miṣṭāpū rte sagṃ sṛjethā mayaṃca | punaḥ kṛṇvagg‌svā pitaraṃ yuvāna ma nvātāgṃsīttayi taṃtu metam || oṃ bhūrbhuvassuvaḥ | budhagrahehāgaccha || budhagrahaṃ pītavarṇaṃ, pīta gaṃdhaṃ, pīta puṣpaṃ, pīta mālyāṃ baradharaṃ, pītacchatradhvaja ratha patādikādi śobhitaṃ, divya ratha samārūḍhaṃ, meruṃ pradakṣiṇī kūrvāṇaṃ, siṃha vāhanaṃ udaṅnukhaṃ, magadha deśādhi patiṃ, caturbhujaṃ, khaḍga carmāṃharadharaṃ, ātreyasa gotraṃ, saumyasaṃvatsara vaiśākha śukla ekādaśyāṃ uttara phalgaṇī nakṣatrajātaṃ, kanyāmidhuna rāśyadhipatiṃ, saumyavāsara prayuktaṃ, kirīṭinaṃ, sukhasīnaṃ, patvī putra parivāra sametaṃ grahamaṃḍale praviṣṭa masminathikaraṇe sūryagrahasyeśāsya digbhage bāṇākāra maṃḍale mudgadhānyasyopari budhagraha māvāhayāmi sdhāpayāmi pūjayāmi | adhidevata - oṃ idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame tredhā nidadhe padam | samuḍha masyapāgṃ sure || budhagrahādhidevatāṃ viṣṇuṃ sāṃgaṃ sāyudhaṃ savāhanaṃ śakti patni putra parivāra sametaṃ viṣṇu māvāhayāmi sdhāpayāmi pūjayāmi | pratyadhidevata - oṃ sahasra śīrṣā puruṣaḥ | sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt | sabhūmiṃ viśvato vṛtvā | atyatiṣṭha ddaśāṃgulam || budhagraha pratyadhidevatāṃ nārāyaṇaṃ sāṃgāṃ sāyudhaṃ savāhanaṃ, śakti patnī putra parivāra sameta budhagraha syadakṣiṇata budhagrahasya viṣṇumāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjāyāmi || pratyadhidevatā - oṃ sahasra śīrṣā puruṣaḥ | sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt | sabhūmiṃ viśvato vṛtvā | atyatiṣṭha ddhaśāṃgulam || budhagraha patyadhidavatāṃ nārāyaṇaṃ sāgaṃ sāyudhaṃ savāhanaṃ, śakti patnī putra parivāra sametaṃ budhagrahasya uttaracaḥ nārāyaṇa māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | bṛhaspateḥ - guru grahamu bṛhaspate ati yadarya ityasya maṃtrasya | gṛtsna madaṛṣi | bṛhaspati grahodevatā | jagatīcchaṃdaḥ | adhidevatā pratyadhidevatā sahita bṛhaspati grahodevatā | jagatīccaṃdaḥ | adhidevatā pratyadhidevatā sahita bṛhaspati graha prasāda siddhyarthe bṛhaspati grahārādhane viniyogaḥ || kapanyāsaḥ - hṛdayādinyāsaḥ - bbhahaspate atiyadaryo arhāt aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ hṛdayāya namaḥ dyuma dvibhādi tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ śirase svāhā kratumajjaneṣu madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ śikhāyai vauṣaṭ yaddīdayacchavasā anāvikābhyāṃ namaḥ kavacāya huṃ ṛcaprajāta tadasmāsu kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ netratrayāyavauṣaṭ draviṇaṃ dhehi citraṃ karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ astrāya phaṭ evaṃ karanyāsaḥ, hṛdayādinyāsaḥ, bhūrbhuvassuvaromiti digbhaṃdhaḥ | dhyānam - saumye sudīrghe caturaśra pīṭherathe'ṅgirāḥ pūrvamukha svabhāvaḥ | daṃḍākṣamālā jalapātradhārī siṃdhvākhyadeśe varada ssureśaḥ || kanakāṃbaraḥ kanakavapuḥ kirīṭī caturbhujo devaguruḥ praśāṃtaḥ | tadhāpi daṃḍhaṃca kamaṃḍuluṃca tathākṣasūtro varado'stu mahyam || oṃ bṛhaspate atiyadaryo arhadyumadvibhāti kramatu majjaneṣu | yaddīdaya cchavasarta prajāta tadasmāsu draviṇaṃ dhehi citram || oṃ bhūrbhuvassuvaḥ | bṛhaspati grahehaigaccha | bṛhaspati grahaṃ, kanakavarṇaṃ | kanaka puṣpaṃ, kanaka ccatra dhvajaratha patākādi śobhitaṃ, divya ratha samārūḍhaṃ, meruṃ pradakṣiṇīṃ kuryāṇaṃ, pūryābhi mukhaṃ, padmāsanasthaṃ | caturbhujaṃ, daṃḍākṣamālādhāriṇaṃ, siṃdhudvīpa deśādhipatiṃ, āṃgīrasa gotraṃ, saumya saṃvatsara dvādaśyāṃ, dhaniṣṭhā nakṣatra jātaṃ, dhanurmīna rāśyadhipatiṃ, guruvāsara prayaktaṃ, kirīṭinaṃ, sukhānīnaṃ, patnī putra parivāra sametaṃ grahamaṃḍale praviṣṭha masminvadhikaraṇe sūryagrahasyottara digbhāge dīrgha caturaśra maṃḍale caṇaka dhānyasyopari bṛhaspatigraha māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | adhidevata - oṃ brahmaṅñaunaṃ prathamaṃ purāstā dviṣī maraḥ surucovesa āvaḥ | sa ṛdhviyā upamā asya viṣṭhā nsataścayoni masataścavinaḥ || bṛhaspati grahaidhidevatāṃ brahmoṇaṃ sāṃgaṃ sāyudhaṃ, savāhanaṃ śakti patnī putra parivāra sametaṃ bṛhaspati grahasya dakṣiṇataḥ brahmāṇa māmahāyāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | pratyadhidevata - oṃ iṃdraṃvo viśvata spari havāmahe janebhyaḥ | asmāka mastu kevalaḥ || bṛhaspatigraha pratyadhidevatāṃ iṃdraṃ sāṃgaṃ sāyudhaṃ savāhanaṃ śakti patnī putra parivāra sametaṃ bṛhaspati grahasya uttarataḥ iṃpramāvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi || śukrasya - śukra grahamu śukraṃte anya dityasya maṃtrasya | bharadvāja ṛṣi | śukra graho devatā | triṣṭup caṃdaḥ | yajamāna syādhidevatā | pratyadhi devatā sahita śukragraha prasāda siddhyarthe śukra grahārādhane viniyogaḥ || kapanyāsaḥ - hṛdayādinyāsaḥ - śukraṃte anyat aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ hṛdayāya namaḥ yajataṃte anyat tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ śirale svāhā viṣurūpe ahanī madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ śikhāyai vauṣaṭ dyaurivāsi anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ kavacāya huṃ viśvāhimāyā avasi svadhāvaḥ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ netratrayāyavaiṣaṭ bhadrātepūṣanniharātirastu karatala karapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ astrāya phaṭ dhyānam - prācyāṃ bhṛgorbhojakaṭi pradeśa ssabhārgavaḥ pūrvamukha svabhāvaḥ | sapaṃca koṇeśa rathādhirūḍho daṃḍākṣamālā varaṃdo'bu pātraḥ || śvetāṃbaraḥ śvetavapuḥ kirīṭī caturbhujo daityaguruḥ praśāṃtaḥ | tadāṃsi daṃḍaṃca kamaṃḍuluṃca tathākṣasūtro varado'stu mahyam || maṃtraḥ - oṃ śukraṃte anyadyajataṃ te anya dviṣu rūpe ahanī dauryavāsi | viśvāhi māyā avasi svadhāvo bhadrāte pūṣanniha rātirastu || oṃ bhūrbhuvassuvaḥ | śukragrahehaigaccha || śukragrahaṃ śveta varṇaṃ, śveta gaṃdhaṃ, śveta puṣpaṃ, śveta mālyāṃbaradharaṃ, śveta cchatra dhvaja ratha patākādiśobhitaṃ | divya ratha samārūḍhaṃ, meruṃ pradakṣiṇī kūryāṇaṃ, pūrvabhimukhaṃ, padmāsanasthaṃ, caturbhujaṃ, dhaṃḍākṣamālā jaṭāvalkala dhāriṇaṃ, kāṃbhoja deśādhipatiṃ, bhārgavala gotraṃ mannaṃdha saṃvatsara dasamyāṃ puṣyamī nakṣatra jātaṃ, tulāvṛṣabha rāśyadhipatiṃ, bhṛguvāsara prayuktaṃ, patnī putra parivāra sametaṃ grahamaṃḍale praviṣṭaṃ asminnadhikaraṇe sūryagrahasya prāgbhāge paṃca koṇākāramaṃḍale rājamāṣa dhānyasyopari śukragraha māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | adhidevata - oṃ iṃdrāṇīmānu nāriṣu supatnī mahāmaśravam | nahyasyā aparaṃca najarasā marate patiḥ || śukragrahādi devatāṃ iṃdraṇīṃ sāṃgāṃ sāyudhāṃ savāhanāṃ pati śakti putra parivāra sametaṃ śukra grahasya dakṣiṇataḥ iṃdrāṇī māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi || pratyadhidevatā - oṃ iṃdra marutva iha pāhi somaṃ yathā śāryāte apibassu tanya | tavapraṇītī tavaśūra śarma nnāvināsaṃti kavaya ssuyajñaḥ || śukragraha pratyadhidevatāṃ iṃdra marutvaṃtaṃ sāṃgaṃ sāyadhaṃ savāhanaṃ śakti patnī putra parivāra sametaṃ śukra grahasya uttarataḥ iṃdra marutyaṃta māvāyāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | śanaiścarasya - śani grahamu śamagni ragnibirityasya maṃtrasya | śanaiścara grahodevatā | uṣṇike chaṃdaḥ | adhidevatā pratyadhi devatā sahita ścanaiścara graha vrasāda siddhyarthe śanaiścara grahairādhane viniyogaḥ | kapanyāsaḥ - hṛdayādinyāsaḥ - śamagniḥ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ hṛdayāya namaḥ agnibhisskarat tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ śirase svāhā śaṃsa stavatu sūryaḥ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ śikhāyai vauṣaṭ śaṃvātaḥ anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ netratrayāyavauṣaṭ apaśśrithaḥ karatala karapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ astrāya phaṭ evaṃ karanyāsaḥ, hṛdayādinyāsaḥ, bhūrbhuvassuvaromiti digbaṃdhaḥ | dhyānaṃ - cāpāsano gṛdhraratha ssunīlaṛ pratyaṅmukhaḥ kāśyapajaḥ pradīcyāṃ | saśūla cāpeṣu varapradaśca saurāṣṭradeśe prabhavaśca saurī || nīladyuti rnilavapuḥ kirīṭī gṛdhrasthitaḥ cāpadharo dhanuṣmān | caturbhuja ssūrya sutaḥ praśāṃtaḥ sacāstu mahyaṃ varamaṃdagāmī || maṃtraḥ - oṃ śamagni ragnibhisskaraccaṃ nastapatu sūryaḥ | śaṃ vāto vātvarapā apa sridhaḥ || oṃ bhurbhuvassuvaṃ | śanaiścara grahehāccha || śanai ścara grahaṃ, nīlavarṇaṃ, nīlapuṣpaṃ, nīla mālyāṃbara dharaṃ, nīla cchatra dhvajaratha patākādi śobhitaṃ, divyaratha samārūḍhaṃ, meruṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ, cāpāsanasthaṃ, pratyaṅmukhaṃ, gṛdhra rathaṃ | caturbhujaṃ, śūlāyudha dharaṃ, saurāṣṭra deśādhipatiṃ, kāśyapasa gotraṃ, vikāri saṃvatsara navamyāṃ rohiṇī nakṣatrajātaṃ, makara kuṃbha rāśyadhi patiṃ, maṃdavāsara prayuktaṃ, kirīṭinaṃ, sukhāsīnaṃ, patni putra parivāra sametaṃ, grahamaṃḍale praviṣṭa masminnadhikaraṇe sūryagrahasya paścima digbhāge dhanurākāra maṃḍale tila dhānyasyopari, śanai ścara graha māvāhayāmi, sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi || adhidevata - oṃ yamāya somagṃ sunuta yamāya ṅuhutāhaviḥ | yamagāṃhayajño gacchatyagni dūto araṃkṛtaḥ || śanaiścara grahādidevatāṃ yamaṃ sāṃgaṃ sāyudhaṃ savāhanaṃ śakti patnī putra parivāra sametaṃ yama māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | pratyadhidevata - oṃ prajāpate natvadetānyanyo viśvajātāni paritā babhūva | yatkāmāsai juhumastanno āstuvaggṃsyāma patayo rayīṇām || śanai ścara gahādhidevatāṃ prajāpatiṃ sāṃgaṃ vāyudhaṃ savāhanaṃ śakti patnī putra sametaṃ śanaiścara grahanya uttarataḥ prajāpati māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi || rāhoḥ - rāhu grahamu kayāna ścitretyanya maṃtrasya | vāmadeva ṛṣiḥ | rāhugraho devatā | gāyatrī cchaṃdaḥ | adhidevatā pratyadhidevatā sahita rāhugraha prasāda siddhyarthe rāhugrahadhane viniyogaḥ || kapanyāsaḥ - hṛdayādinyāsaḥ - kayānaḥ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ hṛdayāya namaḥ citra ābhūvat tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ śirase svāhā ūtī madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ śikhāyai vauṣaṭ sakhā anāvikābhyāṃ namaḥ kavacāya huṃ kayāśaciṣṭhayā kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ netratrayāyavauṣaṭā vṛtā karatala karapṛṣṭhāṃ namaḥ astrāya phaṭ evaṃ karanyāsaḥ, hṛdayādinyāsaḥ bhūrbhuvassuvaromiti digbhaṃdhaḥ | dhyānam - paiṭhīnapo barbara deśajāta śśūrpāsana ssiṃha gata ssadāyaḥ | yāmyāsano nairṛtī dakkarāśo varaprada śśūla sa carma khaḍgaḥ || nīlāṃbaro nīlavapuḥ kirīṭī karāla karāla vaktraḥ karavāla śūlī | caturbhuja ścharmadharaśca rāhu ssiṃhādhirāḍho varado'stumahyam || maṃtraḥ - oṃ kayāna ścitra ābhuva dūtī sadāvṛdha ssakhā | kayā śaciṣṭhayā vṛtā || oṃ bhūrbhuvassuvaḥ | rāhu grahehāgaccha || rahū grahaṃ, nīla varṇaṃ, nīla gaṃdhaṃ, nīla mālyāṃbaradharaṃ, nīla cchatra dhvaja ratha patākādi śobhitaṃ, divya ratha samārūḍhaṃ, merumapradakṣiṇī kurmāṇaṃ, siṃhāsanaṃ, nairṛti mukhaṃ, śūrpāsanasthaṃ, caturbhujaṃ, karāla vaktraṃ, khaḍga carma varakaraṃ, paiṭhīnasa gotraṃ, barbara deśādhipatiṃ, kirīṭinaṃ, sukhāsīnaṃ, patnī putra parivāra sametaṃ, grahamaṃḍale praviṣṭa masminnadhikaraṇe sūryagrahasya nairṛti digbhāge śūrpākāra maṃḍale māṣadhānyasyopari rāhugraha māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | adhidevata - oṃ āyaṃ gauḥ pṛśṅnirakramī dasa sanmātaraṃ punaḥ | pitaraṃ ca prayan tsuvaḥ || rāhu grahādhidevatāṃ gāṃ sāṃgāṃ sāyudhāṃ savāhanāṃ pati śakti putra parivāra sametāṃ rāhṛgrahasya dakṣiṇataḥ gā māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | pratyadhitadevatā - oṃ namo astu sarpebhvo yeke ca pṛthivī manu | ye aṃtarikṣī ye divitebhya ssarpebhyo namaḥ || rāhugraha pratyadhidevatāṃ sarpaṃ sāṃgāṃ sāyudhaṃ savāhanaṃ śakti patnī putra parivāra sametaṃ rāhugrahasyottarataḥ | māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | ketoḥ - ketu grahamu ketu kṛṇvannityasya maṃtrasya | madhuścaṃda ṛṣiḥ | ketu gaṇo devatā | gāyatrī chaṃdaḥ | adhidevatā pratyadhi devatā sahita ketugama prasāda siddhyarthe ketugaṇārādhane viniyogaḥ || kapanyāsaḥ - hṛdayādinyāsaḥ - ketuṃ kṛṇvan aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ hṛdayāya namaḥ aketave tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ śirase svāhā peśomaryāḥ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ śikhāyai vauṣaṭ apeśane anāvikābhyāṃ namaḥ kavacāya huṃ samuṣadbhiḥ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ netratrayāyavauṣaṭā ajāyathāḥ karatala karapṛṣṭhāṃ namaḥ astrāya phaṭ evaṃ karanyāsaḥ hṛdayādinyāsaḥ, bhūrbhuvassuvaromiti digbaṃdhaḥ | dhyānam - dhvajāsano jaivami ni gotrajo'ṃtarvedeṣu deśeṣu vicitra varṇaḥ | yāmyāsano vāyudiśi prakhaḍga carmāsibhiścāṣṭa sutaśca ketuḥ || dhūmro dvibāhu rvarado gadā bhṛdgṛsanastho vikṛtānanaśsa | kirīṭa keyūra vibhūṣitāṃga ssadāstume ketu gaṇaḥ praśāṃtaḥ || maṃtraḥ - oṃ ketuṃ kṛṇvanna ketave peśo maryā apeśane | samu ṣadbhi rajāyathāḥ || oṃ bhūrbhuvassuvaḥ | ketu grahehāgaccha || ketu gaṇaṃ, citra varṇaṃ, citra gaṃdhaṃ, citra puṣpaṃ, citra mālyāṃbaradharaṃ, citra chatra dhvaja ratha patākādi śobhitaṃ, divya ratha samārūḍhaṃ, meru mapradakṣiṇī kurvāṇaṃ, dhvajāsanasdhaṃ, dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ, caturbhujaṃ, aṃtarvedi deśādipatiṃ, siṃhāsanāsīnaṃ, grahamaṃḍale praviṣṭa masminnadhikaraṇe sūryagrahasya vāyavya digbhāge dhvajākāramaṃḍale kuluttha dhāvyasyopari ketugaṇa māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | adhidevata - oṃ sacitra citraṃ citayaṃ tamasmaicitra kṣatra citratamaṃ vayodhām | caṃdraṃ rayiṃ puruvīraṃ bṛhaṃtaṃ caṃdra caṃdrābhirgṛṇate yudunasva || ketu gaṇādhidevatāṃ citraguptaṃ sāṃgaṃ sāyudhaṃ savāhanaṃ śakti patni putra parivāra sametaṃ ketugaṇasya dakṣiṇataḥ citragupta māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | pratyadhidevata - oṃ brahmādevānāṃ padavīḥ kavīnā mṛṣirviprāṇāṃ mahiṣo mṛgāṇām | śyeno gṛdhrāṇāgṃ svadhitirvanānāgṃ somaḥ pavitra matyetirobhan || ketugaṇa pratyadhidevatāṃ brahmāṇaṃ sāṃgaṃ sāyudhaṃ navāhanaṃ śakti patnī putra parivāra sametaṃ ketugaṇasyottarataḥ brahmāṇa māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | jātavedase sunavāma somamarātiyato nidahātivedaḥ | sanaḥ paruṣadati durgaṇi viśvānā vevasiṃdhuṃ durutātyagniḥ || durga māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | oṃ gaṇānāṃ dva gaṇapatigṃ havāmahe kaviṃ kavīnā vupama śrśastamam | jyeṣṭharājaṃ brahmaṇāṃ bragmaṇaspata āna śṛṇava nnū tibhissīda sādanam || kṣetrasyapatinā vayagṃhitenevajayāmasi | gāmaśvaṃ poṣayitvāsano mṛḍātidṛśe || kṣetrapālaka māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | svastidā viśaspati rvatrahāvimṛdheovaśī | vṛṣeṃdraḥ puraetunassvastidā abhayaṃkaraḥ || abhayaṃkara māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | iṃdraṃvo viśvatasparihavā mahejanebhyaḥ | asmākamastu kevalaḥ || iṃdraṃ lokapāla māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe hotāraṃ viśvavedasaṃ | asyayajñasya sukratuṃ || agniṃ lokapāla māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | yamāyasomagṃ sunutayamājuhutāhaviḥ | yamagṃ hayajñogacchatyagnidūto araṃkṛtaḥ || yamaṃ lokapālaka māvahayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | mūṣuṇaḥ parāvarānir‌r‌tir‌ dṛhaṇāvadhīt | patīṣṭatṛṣṇayāsaha || nirar‌tiṃ lokapāla māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | imaṃ movaru - cake || varuṇaṃ lokapāla māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | tavavāyuvanaspat tvaṣṭurjamāta radbhuta || avāṃsyā vṛṇīmahe || vāyuṃ lokapāla māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | somodhenugesomo arvaṃtamāsuṃgṃsomo vīraṃkarmaṇyaṃdadātu || sādanyaṃ vitathyagṃ sakheyaṃ | pituśravaṇaṃ yodadāśadasyai || kuberaṃ lokapāla māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | tamīśānaṃ jagata stasthuṣaspatiṃdhiyaṃ jinvamavasehūmahevayaṃ | pūṣānoyathā vedhasāmasadvṛdhe rakṣikāpāyuradabdhasvastaye || īśānaṃ lokapāla māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | ūrdhvaūṣaṇaūtayetiṣṭhā devonapavitā | ūrdhvovājasya savitāya daṃjibhirvāghadbhirvihvayāmahe || ūrdhvapuruṣa māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | syonā pṛthivi bhavānṛkṣarānikeśanī | yacchānaśśarma saprathāḥ || pṛthivī māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | vāstoṣpate prati jānī hyasmān tsvaveśo anamīvobhavānaṃ | yatve mahe prati tanno juṣasvaśaṃ catuṣpad || vāstupuruṣa māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | brahma devānāṃ padavīḥ kavīnā mṛṣirviprāṇāṃ mahiṣo mṛgāṇāṃ | śyeno gṛḍhraṇāṃ svadi tirva nānāgṃ somaḥ pavitra matyetirebhan || brahmāṇa mānāhayāmi sdhāpayāmi pūjayāmi | praṇodevī sarasvatī nājebhirvājinīvatī | dhīnāmavitryavatu || sarasvatī māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | idaṃ viṣṇu rvicakrame tridhānidadhe padaṃ | samūḍhamasya pāgṃ sure || viṣṇu māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | saktumuvatitaunāpunantoyatradhīrāmavasāvācamakrata | atrasakhāya ssakhyāni jānate bhadraiṣāṃ lakṣmīrnihitādhivāci || lakṣmi māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | kadrudrā vapracetase mīḍhuṣṭamā yatavyane | vocema śaṃtamagṃ hṛde || rudra māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | gaurī mimāya salilāli takṣatyeka padī dvipadī sācatuṣpadī | aṣṭāpadī navapadī babhūvuṣī sahasrākṣarā paramevyoman || gaurī māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | krānā śiśumrahīnām hinvannṛtasyadīdhitiṃ | viśvā paripriyā bhuvadadhadvitā | āditpratnasyareta sojyotiṃ paśyaṃti vāsaraṃ | paroyadidhyatedinā || eṣo uṣā apūrvāpyucchati priyādhivaḥ | ssuṣovāyaśvi bṛham | aśvanīdevatā māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | yata iṃdra bhayāma hetatono abhayaṃkṛdhi | maghavaṃcchagdhita vatanna ūtayeni dviṣovimṛdhojahi || abhayaṃkara māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | ityauttarīya pāṭhaḥ | suparṇosi garutmān trivṛtte śirogāyatraṃ cakṣustoma ātmāsāmateta sūrvā sudevyaṃ bṛhadrathaṃtarepakṣa yajñāyajñiyaṃ pucchaṃ chaṃdāg‌syaṃ gānidhiṣṇiyāśsaphā || yajūgeṃṣināma | suparṇosi garutmān divaṃgaccha suvaḥtata || garuḍa māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | dhanvanāgā dhanvanājijayema dhanvanā tīvrānsamadojayeku | dhanuśśatrorapa kāmaṃ kṛṇoti dhanvati sarvāḥ pradiśojayemi || dhanvaṃtari māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | muṃcāvitvāhaviṣā jīvanāyaka majñātayakṣmā dutarājayakṣmāt | grāhirjagrāhi yaduvaitadenaṃtasyā iṃdrāgnī pravamumu ktamenaṃ || iṃdrāgnī āvāgahayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāma | | saṃsṛṣṭaṃdhanamabhayaṃsamākṛta masmaṃbhyaṃ dhattāvaruṇaśśamanyuḥ | bhiyaṃdathānā hṛdayeṣu śatravaḥ parājitāso apanilayaṃtāṃ || śatraphala māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | dūramasmacchatravo yaṃtubhītāḥ | tadiṃ drāgnīkṛtāṃta dviśākhe | tannodevā ānuma daṃtuyajñaṃ | paścātpurastādabhayaṃnno astu || nakṣatrāṇāmathipatnī viśākhe | śreṣṭhāviṃdrāgnī bhuvanasyagopau | viśākhānakṣatra māvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi | maṃṭapasthā'dityādi navagraha devatābhyo namaḥ | iṃdrādyaṣṭa dikpālaka devatābhyo namaḥ | durgāgaṇapatikṣetrapālakābhayaṃkara vāstupuruṣādi devatābhyo namaḥ | dhyānā vāhanādi ṣoḍaśoracāra pūjā ssavarpayāmi | namassūryāya somāya maṃgalāya budhāyaca | guru śukra śanibhyaśca rāhave ketave namaḥ || prārthanāṃ samarpayāmi | anayā pūjayā maṃṭapastha devatā ssuprītā ssuprasannā varadābhavaṃtu | iti navagrahārādhana samaptaḥ | athamṛtyuṃjayaṃ asyaśrī tryaṃbakastotra mahāmaṃtrasya | maitrā varuṇa putro vaniṣṭhaṛṣiḥ | anuṣṭupchaṃdaḥ | śrī mṛtuṃjaya tryaṃbakarudro devatā | devadevyau praṇavau bījaśaktiḥ | atra mūlaṃ maṃtreṇa karaśuddhiṃ kṛtvā | praṇavaṃ karatala yorvinyasya | vyāhṛtyādi maṃtra pāda catuṣṭayaṃ karayo raṃguṣṭādi kaniṣṭhāṃta maṃgulīṣu vinyasya tatassarveṇavyāpaka nyāsaṃkṛtvā dehāṃganyāsa mārabhet || oṃ bhūrbhuvassuvaḥ - aguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ triyaṃbakaṃ yajāmahe - tarjanībhyāṃnnamaḥ sugaṃdhiṃ puṣṭivardhanaṃ - madhyamābhyānnamaḥ uryāruka mivabaṃdhanāt - anāmikābhyāṃnnamaḥ mṛtyormukṣīyamāmṛtāt - kaniṣaṭhibhyānnamaḥ oṃ bhūrbhuvassuvaḥ triyaṃbakaṃ mṛtyormukṣīyamāmṛtāt - karatala kara pṛṣṭhābhmā namaḥ triyaṃbakaṃ iti - śirase namaḥ sugaṃdhimiti - lalāṭe namaḥ puṣṭivardhanamiti - mukhe namaḥ urvāruka miti - hṛdaye namaḥ iveti - naubhau namaḥ baṃdhanāditi kaṭyāṃ mṛtyorityūrudvaye | mikṣiyetijānudvaye | metijaṃghādvaye | amṛtāditipādadvaye | evaṃ dehāṃganyāsaṃ kṛtvā ṣaḍaṃganyāsa mārabhet || oṃ namo bhagavate triyaṃbakāya śūlapāṇayesvāhā - hṛdaye oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāyamitamū rtayemāṃ jīvayaśira sesvāhā - śipasi oṃ namo bhagavate nīlakaṃṭhāya caṃdrajaṭine svāhā - śikhā oṃ namo bhagavate tripūrāṃtakāya hrāṃ hrīṃ - kavacā oṃ namo bhagavate trilocanāya ṛgyajissāmādharvaṇamūrtaye - netra oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāyāgnitrayāya jvalajjvalamāṃ rakṣarakṣa aghorāstraya phaṭ bhūrbhuvassuvaromiti digbhaṃdhaḥ || dhānyaṃ - tataścaṃdramaṃḍaloparibaddha padmāsanaṃ caṃdravarṇaṃ sravadamṛta pūrṇa caṃdrakalādharaṃ | yoga mudrākṣamālā baddhādhara hastadvayaṃ dhutāmṛtapūrṇa kanakakalaśo ttara karadvayaṃ | soma sūryāgni trilocanaṃ baddhapiṃga jaṭājūṭaṃ nāgayajñovavītinaṃ | nāgābharaṇa bhūṣitaṃ vyāghra carmāṃbaradharaṃ bhaktanukaṃpinaṃ bhasmānulepanaṃ śrīrudraṃ dhyātvāsnehapūrṇenamanasā pūrvokta mārgeṇākṛyitvā śaraṇaṃ prajet || tryaṃbaka mahādeva trāhimāṃśataṇāgataṃ | janmamṛtyu jarārogaiḥ pīḍitaṃ karmabaṃdhanaiḥ trāvaka stvadgataprāṇa stvacchiṣyohaṃ sadā mṛḍa | iti vijñāpyadeveśaṃ japenmaṃtraṃ triyaṃbakaṃ || iti prārthanāṃ kṛtvā lamityādi paṃcapūjāṃ kṛtvā japet || oṃ bhūrbhuvassuvaromiti digbhaṃdhaḥ | triyaṃbakaṃ yajāmahema | gaṃdhiṃ puṣṭirdhanaṃ urvaruka minabaṃdhanāt | mṛtyormikṣīya māmṛtāt || apamṛtyu mapakṣudhaṃ | apetaśśapathaṃ jahi || athāno agnaāvaha | rāyaspoṣagṃ sahapriṇaṃ || ete sahasra - mṛtyavesvāhā || mamasarvāpa mṛtyurnaśyatu āyarvardhatāṃ || acyutaḥ kalpavṛkṣaśca anaṃtaḥ kāmadhevanavaḥ | ciṃtāmaṇintu goviṃdo nāmatrayamudāhṛtaṃ || acyutāya namaḥ || anaṃtāya namaḥ || goviṃdāya namaḥ || oṃ bhūrbhuvassuvaromiti dagbaṃdhaḥ | aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ ityārabhya dignimokaṃ kṛtvā paṃcapūjāṃtaṃ kuryat || iti vṛtyuṃjaya vidhānaṃ | athanavagraha prayogavidhiḥ yājñavalkyaḥ - śrī kāmaśśāṃti kāmovā grahayajñaṃ samācaret | vṛṣṭyāyuḥ puṣṭikāmovā tathai vābhicarannapi || sūrya ssomo mahīputra ssomaputro bṛhaspatiḥ | śukra śśanai ścaro rāhuḥ ketuśceti grahāssmṛtāḥ || tāmrakātsphāṭikādrakta caṃdanātsvarṇa kādubhau | rājatādāyasātsī sātkaṃsyātkāryāgrahāḥ kramāt || svavarṇairvāpaṭelekhyā gaṃdhairmaṃḍalakeṣuvā | yathāvarṇaṃ pradeyāni vāsāṃsi kasumānica || gaṃdhāśca balayaścaiva dhūpodeyaśca gugguraluḥ | kartavyo maṃtravaṃtaśca caravaḥ pratidaivataṃ || asatyena imaṃdevā agnirmūrdhā divaḥkakut | udbudyasnetica bucoyathā saṃkhyāṃ prakīrtitāḥ || bṛhaspate'ti yadaryasta thaivānnātparisrutaḥ | śanno devī stadhā kāṃḍātketuṃ kṛṇvannimāstathā || arkaḥ palāśaḥ khadira apāmārgotha pippalaḥ | uduṃbaraśśamī dūrvāḥ kuśāśca samidhaḥ kramāt || ekasyai tattvaṣṭa śatamaṣṭā viṃśati revavā | hotavyāmadhusarpibhyāṃdadhnā kṣīreṇa vāyutāḥ || dadhyodanaṃha viḥpūrṇaṃmāṃsaṃcitrānna mevaca || dadyādanaṃha viḥpūrṇaṃmāṃsaṃcitrannamevaca || dadyādgṛhī kramādevaṃ viprebhyo bhojanaṃ budhaḥ | śaktito vāyathālābhaṃ satkṛtya vidhipūrvakaṃ || dhenuśśaṃkha stathā naḍvān hemavāsohayaḥ kramāt | kṛṣṇā gaurāya saśchāga etāvai dakṣiṇā smsatāḥ || yaścayasya yadādṛṣṭa ssataṃ yatnena pūjayet | brahmaṇaiṣāṃ varodattaṛ pūjitāḥ pūjayiṣyatha || vijñāneśvare - ete sūryādayo navagrahāḥ pūjyāityuktaṃ kiṃtvityatrāha | tāmrakāditi | sūryādīnāṃmūrtayastāmrādibhiryathā kāmaṃ kāryastalābhe svavarṇavaiḥ paṭalekhyāḥ | maṃḍaleṣuvā daṃdaiḥ rakta caṃdanādibhiryathāvaṇaṃ lekhyā ityasvayaḥ | dvibhujatvādi viśeṣastu matsyapurāṇoktodraṣṭavyaḥ | tadyathā | padmāsanaḥ padmakaraḥ padmagarbha samadyutiḥ | saptāśvaratha saṃsthoridvibhūjassyātsadā taviḥ || śvetaḥ śvetāṃbaradharo daśāśvaśśveta bhūṣaṇaḥ | gadāpāṇirdvi bāhuśca kartavyo varadaśśaśī || raktamālyāṃbaradharaḥśśakti śūla gadādharaḥ | caturbhujo meṣagamo varadassyāddharāsutaḥ || pītamālyāṃbaradharaḥ karṇikāramadyutiḥ | khaḍgacarma gatāpāṇi ssiṃhastho varado budhaḥ || deva daitya gurūtadva tpītaśśvetau caturbhujau | daṃḍinau varadau kāryau sākṣasūtra kamaṃḍalū || iṃdranīladyitiśśūlī varado gṛdhravāhanaḥ | bāṇabāṇāsanadharaḥ kartavyorkasuta ssadā || karālavadanaḥkhaḍga carmaśūlī varapradaḥ | nīla spiṃhāsanasthaśca rāhuratra praśasyate || dhumrādvibāhavassarve gadinovikṛtānanāḥ | gṛdhrāsanagatānityaṃ ketavassurvara pradāḥ || sarvekirī ṭinaḥkāryāḥ grahāloka hitāvahāḥ | svāṃgu lenocchritā ssarve śatamaṣṭottaraṃ sadeti || eteṣāṃ sthāpanadeśaśca tatraivoktaḥ | madhyetubhāskaraṃ vidyāllohitaṃ dakṣiṇenati || uttareṇa guruṃ viṃdyātbhudhaṃ pūrvottareṇatu || pūrveṇabhārgavaṃ viṃdyātsomaṃ dakṣiṇapūrvataḥ | vaścimenaśaśaniṃ vidyādrāhuṃ dakṣiṇapaścime || paścimo ttarataḥ ketun‌ sthāpaye cchukla taṃḍulairiti || iti navagraha prayoga vidhiḥ | athāgnimukhaṃ - hariḥ oṃ - athakarmāṇyācārādīni gṛhyaṃte athagārhyāṇi kamrāṇi | prāṅmukhodarbheṣvā sīnodarbhā ndūrvānvādhāraya māṇaḥ | pavitrapāṇiḥ patnyāsaha prāṇānāyamyadeśa kālau | saṃkīrtyāmukaṃkarmaṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpya | upalipyaśucaudeśeśveta taṃḍula cūrṇena | prādeśamātraṃ sdhiṃḍilaṃ caturaśra maṃḍalaṃvā | kalpayitvā dvābhyāṃdarbhābhyā mullikhya | prācīḥ pūrva mudaksaṃsdhaṃ dakṣiṇāraṃbha mālikhet | athodīchīḥ pūrassaṃsdhaṃ paścimāraṃbha mālikhet | avākkarobhyukṣyu nithāya vahni mutsicyatevo kṣaṇatoya śeṣuṃ | prāktoyamanyanni dadhātyudagvā yathābahissyācca paristarāṇāṃ | bhūrbhuvassuvaro mityagniṃ pratiṣṭhāpyā vokṣama śeṣatoyaṃ | prāgudagvotsicya anyadudakamānīya yathāpari staraṇādbahiḥ | prāgudagvānidadhyādagnyānayavapātrayorakṣatodakaṃninīyāgni midhvā | oṃ catvāri śṛṃgātrayo asya pādādveśīrṣe na ptahastāpoasya| tridhābaddho vṛṣabhororavītimahodevo martyāgṃ āviveśa | agniṃdhyāyāmi saptaha staścatu śśṛṃga ssaptajihvodviśīrṣakaḥ | tripātprasannavadana ssukhāsīnaśśucismitaḥ || ṣvāhāṃtudakṣiṇepārśve devīṃ vāme svadhāṃ tathā | bibhraddakṣiṇa hastaiśca śaktimannaṃ srucaṃ sravaṃ | tomaraṃ vyajanaṃ vāmairghṛta rātraṃtu dhārayan | meṣārūḍhaṃ jaṭābaddhaṃ goravarṇaṃ mahejanaṃ | dhumadhvajaṃ lohitākṣaṃ saptārci ssarvakāmadaṃ | ātmābhi mukhamāsīnaṃ evaṃ dhyāye ddhutāśanaṃ || eṣahidevaḥ pradiśonusarvāḥ pūrvohijātassaugarbhe aṃtaḥ | savijāyamāna ssajaniṣyamāṇaḥ pratyaṅmukhā stiṣṭhati viśvatomukhaḥ || prāṅmukhāgne mamākhimukhobhava | sumukhobhava | suprasannobhava | varadobhava || oṃ bhūrbhuvassuvaḥ tatsa viturvareṇyāṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yonaḥ pracodayāt || sodakena pāṇinā pradakṣiṇa magniṃ parisamūhya alaṃkṛtya || agnaye namaḥ, hutavahānāya namaḥ, hutāśine namaḥ, kṛṣṇa vartmane namaḥ, devamukhāya namaḥ, saptajihvāya namaḥ, vaiśvanarāya namaḥ, jātavedaye namaḥ | prāgudaggrairdarbhairagniṃ pari stṛṇāti | dakṣiṇānu ttarān karoti uttaranadharān uttareṇāgniṃ prāgagrān darbhān‌tsag stīrya | dviṃdvaṃ syaṃci pātrāṇi prayunakti | darvīmājyasthā līṃprokṣaṇī mitaradarvīṃ | apracchinnāgrā vanaṃtargarbhaudarbhau prādeśamātre vavitre kurute | kṛṇaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ vāṃtardhā yachina ttinanakhena | apa upasanpṛśya | adbhiranumṛjya || prokṣaṇīmādāya - tasyāmapa ānīya - hastayo raṃguṣṭhopa kaniṣṭhikābhyāmudagagre gṛhītvā prācīstrirutpūyābhimaṃtrya uttanāni pātrāṇikṛtvā vanrasyedhmaṃtriḥ prokṣya śeṣamutsicya tatvātraṃ dakṣiṇatonidhāya tepavitre pūrṇapātrenidhāya pūrṇapātramādāya pūrvavaktṛtvā - samaṃprāṇairhṛtavā uttareṇāgniṃdarbheṣu sādayitvā darbhaiḥ pracchādya brahmārth dakṣiṇato gnerbhrahmaṇaṃdarśeṣu niṣādya tadabhāve brahmāyatane || asmin homakarmaṇitvaṃ brahmabhava brahmanbrahmāsinamante brahmanbrahmaṇe iti brahmasanaṃdatvā tepavitre ājyapātr nidhāya ājyaṃ vilāpya āpareṇāgniṃ pavitrāṃrta hitāyā mājyaṃ nirūpya udīcoṃgārānnirūhya teṣvadhiśritya jvalatātṛṇenātho gāminyādīptyājyo pratiphalīkṛtya dvedarbhāge pracchidya prakṣālya pratyasyāpa upaspṛśya caruṇāsahatriḥ paryagni kṛtvā udagudvāsya aṃgārānpratyūhya udagagrābhyāṃ pavitrābhyāṃ punarāhā ramājyaṃ trirutrūya pavitragraṃdhiṃ visrasya prakṣālya prāgagramagnau vipatre anu praharati darbhaissasruvaṃ dakṣiṇena hastenādāya vāmena juhūṃ yugapatpratitapya vāma kaniṣṭhikānāmikā saṃdhau juhuṃ gṛhītvā tasyoparisruva maṃtaratobhyākāragṃ sarvatobila mabhisamāhāraṃmūlairdaṃḍamiti vyutkramaṇaṃ dhārayitvā juhū magrairaṃtaratobhyākāraṃ prācīṃ madhyairbāhyataḥ pratīcīmūlairdaṃjamiti krameṇa sruvastha darbhai revasaṃmṛjya nasaṃmṛṣṭa masaṃmṛṣṭaṃsag sparśayati punaḥ idhmamādāya paridhīnparidathāti sthaviṣṭho madhyamaḥ aṇīyān drāghīryān dakṣiṇārthyaḥ aṇiṣṭhohrasiṣṭha uttarārdhyaḥ udagagraṃ madhyamaṃ prāgagrāvitarau madhyamaṃ paridhimupaspṛśya purastādūrdhvedve āghūrasamidhāvādadhāti agniṃ pariṣiṃcati adite sumanyasveti dakṣiṇataḥ prācīnamanuma tenu manyasveti paścādudīcīnagṃ sarasvatenu manya svetyu ttarataḥ prācīnaṃdeva savitaḥ prasuveti samaṃtaṃ idhma malaṃkṛtya svayamalaṃkṛtya brahmāṇamalaṃkṛtya idhyaṃdvirabhigharya mūlamadhyamayormadhya gaṃkṛtvā asmin homakarmaṇi brahman idhyamādhāsye adhatsvetyanujñātaḥ upaviśya hastābhyāṃ tūṣṇīmidmamādadhātī prajāpataya idaṃ idhmaprakṣepaṇa muhūrta ssumuhurtostu āghūrāvāmāpayati darśapūrṇa mānavattūṣṇīṃ itara dharvīmādāya uttaraparidhi saṃdhi manvavahṛtya prajāpatiṃ manasādhyāyan dhakṣiṇataḥ prāṃcamṛjugṃ saṃtata māghārayati vāyavyādāgneyāṃtaṃ prajāpataya idaṃ | pradhāna darvīmādāya dvitīyamaiṃdramitara paridhi mūrdhvāyāṃ diśiyajña saṃvatsaro yajñapatirmā jayaṃtāṃ || samudraṃvaḥ prahiṇomisvāṃ yonimapi gaccata | ācchidraḥ prajayā bhūyāsaṃmā parāseci matpayaḥ | aṃjalau pūrṇapātra mānayati - retaevāsyāṃ prajāṃdadāti prajayāhi manuṣyaḥ pūrṇaḥ | mukhaṃ visṛṣṭe | āvabṛdasyaivarūpaṃ kṛtvottiṣṭhati - akṣatāṃ śirasidhārayot || śāṃtirastu - puṣṭirastu - dhanadhānya samṛddhirastu - karma samṛddhirastu - bhagavān vāstoṣpatiḥ priyatāṃ || prāgādi paristaraṇa muttare visṛjet || brahmaṇe varaṃ dadāmi || agnestṛṇānyapacinomi || tejasvīyaśasvī brahmavarcasī bhavati || homāṃte śrīyajña puruṣaya namaḥ - dhyānādi ṣoḍaśopacāra pūjātsamarpayāmi || svasti śraddhāṃ medhāṃ yaśaḥ prajñāṃ vidyāṃ buddhiṃ śriyaṃ balaṃ | āyuṣyaṃteja ārogyaṃdehime havyavāhana || yasyasmṛtyāca nāmektya tapohoma kriyādaṣu | syūnaṃ saṃpūrṇatāṃyāti sadyovaṃde hūtāśanaṃ - yaddhutaṃtu mayādeva paripūrṇaṃ tadastute || aneva navagahahomena bhagavan sarvātmakaḥ sarvaṃ śśrī yajñeśvaraḥ priyatāṃ || maṃṭapasthādityādi navagraha devatābhyo namaḥ || iṃdrādyaṣṭa dikpālaka devatābhyo namaḥ || punaḥ pūjāṃ kariṣye || chaṃtraṃ dhārayāmi - cāmare vījayāmi - nṛtyaṃ darśayāmi - gītaṃśrāvayāmi - vādyaṃ ghoṣayāmi - āṃdolikā nārohayāmi - āśvānārohayāmi - gajānārohayāmi - samasta rājopacāra - devopacāra bhaktyupacāra pūjāṃ tsamarpayāmi || anayā pūjayā ādityādi navagrahaḥ iṃdrādyaṣṭa dikpālakā ssuprītā ssuprasannā varadā bhavaṃtu || yajñena yajña mayajaṃtadevā stāni dharmaṇī pradhamānyāsan | tehanākaṃ mahimāna ssacaṃte yatrapūrvesādhyā ssaṃtidevāḥ || maṃṭapastha devatāḥ yadhāsthānaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayāmi || oṃ bṛhatsāma kṣatrabhṛdvṛdbhavṛṣṇiyaṃ - triṣṇubhauja śśubhita mugravīraṃ - iṃdrastomena paṃcadaśena madhyamidaṃ vātena sagareṇa rakṣa || sumaṃgalīriyaṃ vadhūrimāgṃ sameta paśyatā saubhāgya manyaidatvā yādhāstaṃ viparetana || oṃ agnena yasupadhārāye yasupadhārāye asmānviśvāni deva vayumāni vidvān - yuyodhyasmajjuhurāṇa meno bhūyiṣṭhāṃte nama uktiṃ vidhema | pravaśśukrāya bhānave bharadhvāṃ havyaṃ matiṃcāgnaye supūtaṃ - yodaivyāni mānuṣā janug‌ṣyaṃta rviśvāni vidmanājigāti - acchāgiro matayodeva yaṃtī ragniyaṃtrī draviṇaṃ bikṣamāṇāḥ - susaṃdṛśagṃ supratīkag svaṃcagṃ havyavā hamaratiṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ - agnetva masmadyuyodhya mīnā anagnitrā abhyamaṃta kṛṣṭīḥ - punarasmabhyag‌ suvitā yadevā kṣāṃ viśvebhi rajirebhiryajatra - agnetvaṃ pārayānavyo asmān svastibhirati durgāṇi viśvā - pūśca pṛthivī bahulāna urvī bhavāto kāyatanayā yaśaṃyoḥ || prakāravo mananāvacya mānādeva dhrīcīṃ nayadhadeva yaṃtaḥ dakṣiṇāvāḍvājinī prācyeti - havirbharaṃ tyagnaye ghṛtācī || namaste gārha patyāya namaste dakṣiṇāgnaye - nama āhava nāyāya mahāvedyainamenamaḥ | kāṃḍadvayopa pādyāyakarma brahmasvarūpiṇe - mahāvedyai namonamaḥ | kāṃḍadvayopa pādyāyakarma brahmasvarūpiṇe - svargāpa vargarūpāya yajñeśāya namonamaḥ - yajñe śācyuta goviṃda mādhavānaṃta keśava | kṛṣṇa viṣṇo hbhaṣīkeśa vāsudeva namostute - sakṛtai agnenamaḥ - dvinainamaḥ - trisainamaḥ - catusainamaḥ - paṃcakṛtvaśīsainamaḥ - daśakṛtvasainamaḥ - śatakṛtvāsai namaḥ - sahasra kṛtvasainamaḥ - namaste astumā māhigṃsīḥ - ahaṃ parastā dahamavastā dahaṃ jyotiṣāvi tamovavāra - yadaṃtarikṣaṃ tadumepitā bhūdahagṃ sūryamabhayato dadarśāhaṃ bhūyāsamuttama ssamānānāṃ || oṃ anṛṇā masminnanṛṇāḥ parasmigg stṛtīyeloke anṛṇāssyāma yedevayānā utapitṛyāṇā ssarvānpatho anṛṇā ākṣīyema || pramādātkurvatāṃ karma pracyavetādhvareyadi - smaraṇādeva tadviṣṇoḥ saṃpūrṇaṃ syāditi smṛtiḥ || viṣṇu smaraṇaṃ kuryāt || iti jayādayaḥ | atha mukhāvalo kanam - prāṇānāyasya || evaṃ - prītyarthaṃ uttarānakṣatra pradhamacaraṇe jātasya kumārasya tithi vāra nakṣatra varjyādi sakalāriṣṭa nivṛtti dvārā parameśvara prītyarthaṃ mukhāvalokana pūrvakaṃ graha makhākhyaṃ karma kariṣyamāṇa stadaṃgatvena tadādau - śuddhyarthaṃ - vṛddhyarthaṃ - śāṃtyarthaṃ abhyudayārthaṃ ca mahājanaiḥ baṃdhu bissaha svasti pūṇyāhavācanaṃ kariṣye || teṣāṃ pradhamataḥ gaṇādhipati pūjāṃ kṛtvā - puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā - mukhāvalokana pūrvakaṃ graha makhaṃ kuryāt || oṃ rūpagṃ rūpaṃ pratirūpo babhūva - tadasya rūpaṃ prati cakṣaṇāya - indro māyābhiḥ pururūpa īyate - yuktāhyasya haraya śśatādaśa || mukhāvalokana muhūrta ssumuhūrto astu || evaṃ mukhāvalokasaṃ kṛtvā - pūrvokta vidhinā grahapūjāṃ samāpya tattaddhoma dānādikaṃ yadhāvidhiṃ kuryatā || kevala mukhāvalokana pakṣe mukhāvalokanaṃ kṛtvā gaṇādhipati pūjāṃ pūṇyāhavācanaṃ ca samācaret - iti mukhāvalokanam || nirīkṣitājya dānaṃ kariṣye || iti saṃkalvya || prati grahītāraṃ brahmaṇaṃ saṃpūjya - niparīkṣitājyaṃ sadakṣiṇā tāṃbūlaṃ dadvāt || yā'lakṣmiryāca medausthyaṃ sarvāgeṣu vyapasthitaṃ - tatsarvaṃ śamayājyatvaṃ śriyaṃ puṣṭiṃca vardhaya - iti dadyāt || iti mukhāvalokanam | bodhāyana pravarakhaṃḍa prāraṃbhaḥ - bodhayanaḥ || ekaeva ṛṣiryāva tpravareṣvanuvartate | tāvatsamānagotratva manya trāṃgiraso bhṛgoḥ || mādhavīye smṛtyaṃtare || paṃcānāṃtriṣu sāmānyāda vivāha striṣudvāyoḥ | bhṛṃgvaṃgiro gaṇeṣvevaṃ śeṣeṣvekopivārayet || nirṇayasiṃdhau tasyārdhaḥ - śeṣa gotreṣu ekopisamānaḥ pravaro vivāhaṃ vārayedityarthaḥ || bodhāyanopi - bhṛṃgvaṃgirasāvadhi kṛtya - dvyārṣe sannipāte tryārṣeyāṇāma vivāhaḥ tryārṣeya sannipāte paṃcārṣeyāṇāma vivāhaḥ - bhṛgvāṃgiro gaṇeṣvasi jamadagni gautama bharadvājeṣu ekapravarasāmye anyeṣā masāmyevāsa pūjāṃte parayā bhaktyā tasyaivaṃ dhana saṃcayaḥ | vittakāmo yadāso'thasvādā liṃgasya vanaspatīn | japedudrān śivaṃ dhyāyeddhruvaṃte homatāṃ yayuḥ | napuṣpavātaruṃ bāhyaṃ bilvaṃvā liṃgyatān japet | āvartayan bahūnvārān savṛkṣohematāṃ vrajet | tīrtheka sakhale gatvā japtvā rudran bahunpunaḥ | japenmadhya japekṛṣṇa pāṣāṇa hematāmiyuḥ | māhārvāta māśritya avaṣṭabhya dinedine | japedekā daśāhānainidhiṃ prāpsoti puṣkalaṃ | masidhovaita sīścaitat trimadhvaktā juhotiyaḥ | taḍaṃte jāyatetasya draviṇaṃ puṣkalaṃ bahu | madhubilyādayo vṛkṣā āliṃgyaikā daśīdine jāyaṃte hematāṃ yāṃti tatthyaṃ tatrana saṃśayaḥ | adhavā liṃgamāśritya svayaṃbhvapara diṅmukhaṃ | saṃchādyaikādaśāhāni jape detatsupekajaiḥ | paśūnvākutsitāṃścaiva napaśyenna ca saṃspṛśet | yaṃpaśyedvyapayātetu hemasyāddvādaśehāni || athānyaḥ | "kṛṣṇāṣṭamīṃ samārabhya yāvatkṛṣṇa caturthaśī | sthaṃḍilaṃcopavipyārkaprastarevā japetsuthīḥ |" ' namoastu nīlagrīvāya ' ityanena sahasrābhi maṃtritaṃ ghṛtavāyasa mīśvarāya nivedayot | kārṣāpaṇānāṃ sahasra mutpadyate || athānyaḥ || 'pramuṃcadhanvana' ityanena yathāsiddhānnāṃ sahānase'gnāvaṣṭa sahasraṃ juhuyāt | dravyamavicchinna makṣayaṃ bhavati || athānyaḥ || 'namevaḥ kirikebhya' iti tilāhutī nāmayutaṃ juhuyāt | kārṣāpaṇānāṃ sahasravutpadyate" iti kālikāpurāṇe | athānnā kāmasya śaunakaḥ | 'asauyastāmra' ityanenobhayena āharaharudayā stamayoḥ āditya mupatiṣṭheta | akṣayamanna mupatiṣṭhate | atha bodhāyanaḥ | utumbara samidbhidhvakṣatairvā rudramahā rudrati rudrāti rudrāṇā manyatamaṃ japtvātatrokta saṃkhyayā jurahayādanna mutpadyate" | atha vṛṣṭi kamasya śaunakaḥ | 'asauyastāmra' | ityanenodaka śākaya vāharo vaitasa samidhānāmayutaṃ juhuyāt | guḍa kṣīrāktānāṃ vāyutaṃ juhuyāt | bhagavānādityo vṛṣṭiṃ muṃcati | athā yuṣkāmasyasa evāha | "āyuṣtāmaḥ pūrvoktavithinā devamārādhya sarvadikṣu raktapīta kṛṣṇabalī datvā pudraikādaśinī mekādaśa kṛtvo japtvā 'ārā ttegoghna' iti ṣoḍaśopacārān kṛtvā tameva maṃtraṃ sahasraṃ japet | vyādhi taścedraverdine brāhmaṇāya dakṣiṇāṃ datvā sahasraṃ jāpayet | vyādhibhyaḥ pramucyate | śatāyurbhavati | atha putrakāmasya śaunakaḥ | 'pariṇorudrasya ' iti vaṭa samudhānāmayutaṃ juhuyām | putra āyuṣmānutpadyate | atha go kāmasyasa eva | 'namovaḥ kirikebhya' iti maṃtreṇa vaikaṃkatoduṃbara samidhāṃ dadhyaktānāma yutaṃ jūhuyāt | ananta go svāmi bhavati | nacagāvaḥ phrakṣīyaṃte | athavā nenaiva maṃtreṇa arkaparṇa śataṃ gopayasai kādaśā hutīrjuruyāt | ekādaśa gāva utpadyante | athavāktāmasyasaevāha | mahācatuṣpade valmiki mṛdāliṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya paṃcagavyena snāpayet | 'samovaḥ kirikebhya' iti maṃtreṇa cābhi maṃtrya mānasoka iti ghṛtapāyaṃsaṃ dina dvayaṃ bilva mupaharet | dakṣiṇāmūrtau vacāphalasamartha phalaṃ susūkṣmaṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā tāmra bhājanenyaset | kapisaghṛtenāloḍhya pradeśinyāni mutābhi maṃtritaṃ kṛtvā pibeda pratihata vākyo bhavati | punaspayeva drāpe aṃdhanaspata ityādinā śata sahasraṃ juhuyāt | vāsāṃsya kṣarāṇi bhavanti | atha vaśyakāmasya bodhāyanaḥ | pudraikādaśinī rudra mahā rudrāti rudreṣvasya tamaṃ japtvā | juhuyāt śveta puṣpāṇi saviśvaṃ kurute vaśaṃ | atha kṛtsnaṃ jagatkaścidvaśī kartuṃ samīhate | nābhimātra jalasthaśca jape dudrāsanbahūṃ stathā | kṛtvā caivārcanaṃ śaṃbho rādāyaniyamaṃ tataḥ || ādityābimukho bhūtvā rudraṇāvartaye tsadā | tasyāvarta yatorudrān jitākṣasyaca dhīmataḥ | vṛṣaketu samāyāti varado bhaktavatsalaḥ || adhārogya kāmasya śaunakaḥ | 'mano mahaṃtaṃ' iti maṃtreṇa tilāhutī nāmayutaṃ juruyāt | bālānāṃ parijananya cārogyaṃ bhavati | atha pratyupasthite sarvabhaye balīṃśca datvā | 'mīḍhuṣṭama' iti punaḥ ṣoḍasopacāraṃ kṛtvā rudraikādaśinī mekādaśa kṛtvo japtvā jāpayitvāvā rudravedinaṃ sarvebyo bhayebyaḥ pramucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | 'imāg rudrā' iti maṃtreṇa dadhi madhu pāyasāhutīnāṃ pratyekamayutaṃ juruyāt | sarva bhayānyupaśāmyānti | athaśānti kāmaḥ pūrvokat vithinā maṃtra devanyāsādikaṃ kṛtvā devamārādhya rudravedinaṃ brāhmaṇa mācāryaṃ kṛtvā svayaṃbhu liṃgamabhigamya tatrāpyanenaiva vidhi nārādhanaṃ kṛtvā paṃcāmṛtaissnārayitvā prathamānuvāke nājyāhomaṃ kṛtvā devaṃ saṃpūjya 'namaste rudra manyava' ityekādaśānuvākānāṃ japaṃ kūryāt | dhārānūsrāvavayaṃ stathā japāṃte 'agnāviṣṇo sajoṣasa - ityekādaśānuvākānā mekamekaṃ japet | punaḥ paṃcāmṛtaiḥ snāvapo ttato devaṃ samabhyarcya bhakṣyukhojyayutaṃ naivedyaṃ datvā caturaḥ pūrṇa kalaśān paṃcamṛttikā paṃcavallava paṃcaratna yutān akṣata gaṃdha dhūpādi bhirarca yitvā sitavastra veṣṇitān kṛtvā 'śaṃnovātaḥ pavatāṃ' iti śāṃtiṃ dhyayān japtvābhi ṣekaṃ kārayot | śāṃtipbhavati | tataḥ svasdhobhavati | ācāryāya sitavastrayugalaṃ dhenuṃ kāṃcanaṃ dadyāt - brāmmaṇāṃśca bhojayeccāṃtirbhavati, punaḥ śaunakaḥ | 'mānomahāṃtaṃ' iti maṃtreṇāśavatdha manudhāmayutaṃ juhuyāt | prati saṃvatsaraṃ yātrā yāmayutaṃ juhuyāt | evaṃkṛte ātmīyasya bālastri vṛddhajātanya śāṃtiḥ | namobhavāya , "namojyeṣṭhāya " ityetābhyāṃ kumāra grahādi grastānāṃ bhasmābhi maṃtrya rakṣāṃ kārayet | rātrau śikhāṃca badhniyāt kumārādi grahabhayaṃ nabhavati | 'mīḍhuṣṭama śivatama' iti mahābhaye corabhaye'gnibhaye prāṇātyayevā manasā japet kṣemeṇāgacchati | imāgṃ rudrāya , ityanena suvarṇa dūrvāṃkuraiḥ śata sahasraṃ juhuyāt | mahājvaropaghāte gatāyurapi dirghāyurbhavati | namaste rudramanyava , iti caturbhiḥ pratyṛcaṃ yava godhūmagavīdhukajartilānāṃ dadhi madhu ghṛtāktānāma yutaṃ juhuyāt | ekādaśa dvādaśa rātreṇavā vāyumupaśamayati | 'adyavoca dadhivakta' iti sarvarakṣā kartavya | āturebhyaḥ narṣapān saptābhi maṃtritān kṛtvā caturdiśaṃ prakṣipeddaśadikṣu rakṣā kṛtābhavati | padhigacchato' sacchāṃti mupagacchati | sarṣapeṇa brahmarāśrasa bhūta piśācādibhyo mokṣayatā | 'yatārudra śivātanū ' iti ṛgyāṃti mātayā pratisaraṃ sahasrābhi maṃtritaṃ kṛtvā ekādaśa graṃthīn‌dattvā bālānāṃ gurviṇīnāṃ ca haste badhnīyāt | bāvāgurviṇyaśca sukhenavardhaṃte | yakṣa rākṣasā dyutsādanaṃ ca | sa'sahasrāṇi ' iti raktavāsa sāraktoṣṇīṣaraktamālyānu lepanairdevaṃ samarcayet | smaśāne ekavṛkṣe nadīpuline catuṣpathevanevā kārpāsa taṃḍulaṃ paripeṣṭhatāṃ mahātaivāktāṃ smaśānāgnau pradīptena yavapiṣṭh naikādaśautri maṃtrite sayakṣa pākṣasādeḥ śatrorapi pratikṛtiṃ kṛtvo rasikaṭu tailena pratimāṃ kṛtvā sthāpya dakṣiṇabhūtibhāge ekai kenaśareṭaikācaśa prāṇā yataneṣu vitodayet | sahasāgataṃ sakalalokagataṃvā śatramutsādayati | 'namorudrebhya' iti mathyāhne rukmakaṃṭakai rjuhuyātsarṣapaiścā haraharvā pratyapa ttīrāṣṭre devayonamaḥ sapiśācāśca bhraṃśaṃti khecarīṇāṃ strīṇāṃ yātudhānānāṃvā bhasmībhavati | adhemāḥ śāṃtayaḥ | 'imāgṃ rudrāya' iti maṃtreṇa gavāmupaghātegoṣṭha madhye'gnimupa samādhāya vaikaṃkata samidhāmayutaṃ juhuyāt | paśvādīnāṃ śāṃti dviguṇena mahāśāṃtiriti | adha
