gavāmupaghāte goṣṭhamadhye'gnimupa samādhāya vaikaṃkata samidhāyayutaṃ juhuyāt | paśvādīnāṃ śāṃti dviguṇena mahāśāṃtiriti | adha śatṛmārama kāmaḥ pūrvoktavidhinā maṃtranyāsādi kṛtvā dikpālebhyo raktaudana barlīdatvā, stuhiśṛtaṃ, ityanena ṣoḍaśopacārān kṛtvā rudraikādaśinī mekādaśa kṛtvā japito punaḥ 'stuhiśṛtaṃ ' iti sahaśraṃ japetpratyahaṃ saptarātreṇa śatṛvināśo bhavati | atha kṛtyā mutpādayatu kāmaḥ raktavāsa sāraktoṣṇīṣa raktamālyānu lepanairdeva marcayet | śmaśānāṃgaṇe lohita śalākāḥ prādeśamātrā mahātailākta lakṣaṃ juhuyāt | "uttiṣṭha raktāṃgi raktanetre raktakeśi " kanyāṃ tāṃkṣi prameva rudhikarakubena pūrṇamāṃ samātreṇa tarpayet | anyathā kartārameva hiṃset sātvāritāyaṃtritā vadati | "kaṃdharṣayāmi vadavā jñāyateyadamattralokya sthitata abhyutsāda muṣvāmi" iti | tathācai kaikasya śarīrasya grāmonagare gṛheca prayegaḥ | śākaṃ yaśasya mupayokṣya mupoṣya dvādaśa rātrāṇi vaghubhyoṃgāni mahaṃtīti annahīnāni tulā puruṣa cāṃdrāyaṇānāṃ madhyama epavikalpya grahaṇetvācamya nityābhi mādmāvalaṃ binānyathā peṭhet iti | "pramuṃcadhanvana" iti ṣaḍbhirāyudha mabhimaṃtrya saṃgrāmopa nītāḥ śatravaḥ phalāyaṃte | abhimukhānāvatiṣṭhaṃte | darbhakaṃṭakānāma yutaṃ juhuyāt | prabhūtaḥ śatrūyate kṣatriyādiḥ | kṣatriyodivapa tribhāgena vaiśyaḥ ṣaḍbhāgena caturbhāgena śūdraḥ tathā cāvyāhataṃ karmetmā cakṣate | 'vigirida vilohitaḥ' iti yadhāśatṛ bhiraneka paryāya muptaśatṛmukhe juhuyāt | sarvevibhagna manaso vimukhāśśatravaśca palāyaṃte | 'namohiraṇyabāhana' ityanuvaikaiḥ kaṭutai vāktānāṃ rājābhi śaṃkitānāṃ sarṣapān jubuyāt | cakramutpādayati | phaṭ kāreṇa devasyoparimālāmadho śirāmavalaṃbya saśirasāvastreṇa rudhira māslavya trikaṭuke nābhyajyadeva karāṃgulunārekhā mutlādya śatro rnāmānu smaran‌ japet | sabala samudāyaṃ śatṛmucchāṭayati | evaṃ kṛtsnaṃ grāmamucchāṭayati ekāhma | rājānamahorātreṇa saṃpūrṇa magdha divasena kṣatriyaṃ kṣapayita | divasa tribhāgena vaiśyaṃca turbhāgena śūdraṃ | tathā cāvyāhataṃ karmetyā cakṣatre | etatsarvaṃ śaunakoktaṃ hemādrau | atha meru taṃtroktaṃ | raudrīṃ dhārāṃtataḥ kuryātpyocyate tadvidhānākaṃ | 'namaste' rudhrāgnā viṣṇū ityadhyāya dvāyenaca | āvartanamiti proktaṃ gaṃgāsnāsa phalapradaṃ | āvartanābhiṣekaṃtu yaḥ kuryā tpratyahaṃ naraḥ - tasyaivadivajaṃ pāpaṃ daivajaṃnāśa māpnuyāt | saṃdhyāvaṃdanataḥ kṣīṇaṃ taccetvrāgjanmajaṃ bhavet | ekaḥ pāṭho samaste'syahyanuvākaḥ parasyaca | evaṃ bhavāya namaste'sya, agnā viṣṇū tadhaikakaṃ | iyaṃ rudrī samākhyātā raudra pāpa nikṛṃtanī | anayā pratyahaṃyastu kuryālliṃgābhiṣecanaṃ | janmajanma kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ varṣamadhye praṇaśyati | rudrībhirekādaśa bhirlaghurudraḥ prakīrtitaḥ | anena siktaṃ yairlīṃgaṃtena paśyaṃti bhāskariṃ | ekādaśabhi retaistu mahārudraḥ prakīrtitaḥ | nirdhanodhanamāpnoti mahāpātaka nāśanaḥ | anena vihito homaḥ somayāga phalapradaḥ | anādhikārīdī kṣāyaṃ karepakṣa stvayaṃ mataḥ |ekādaśa mahārudrai ratirudraḥ prakīrtitaḥ | atipāpa haroyasmā ddṛṣṭanyānaiva niṣkṛtiḥ || iti merutaṃtroktaṃ vidhānaṃ namāptamāsīt || namakaṃ - athatattanmaṃta prayoga vidhānasahita mahārudrādhyāyaḥ - prārabhyate - oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya | oṃ namaste rudramanyava utotaiṣave namaḥ namaste astu dhanvane bāhubhyāmutate namaḥ || athāsya maṃtrasya puraścaraṇādikaṃ bhrūmaḥ | kṛrcchaṃ dvādaśa rātraṃ caritvā ekādaśa sahasra mabhihita dināni nirantaraṃ japan kṛta puraścaraṇobhavati | tatonena pradakṣiṇaṃ namaskāraṃ ca kuryāt | tato dakṣiṇāmurti sannidhāvekādaśa sahasra japādaśeṣaṃ pāpaṃ naśyati | tato lakṣa japāt saptajanma kṛtaṃpāpaṃ naśyati | nasminneva datriṇāmūrti sannidhāvagniṃ nidhāya ghṛtapāyasaṃ śravayitvā svāgnau juhuyāt | sākṣāddevaṃpaśyati | tasminneva sarvato'ratnamātra magnikuṃḍaṃ kṛtvā svāgnau kāpilena ghṛtena śatasahasraṃ śratasahasraṃ juhuyāt | gāṇapatyaṃ labhate | adhaitayārcā rājñovakṣyate rājā puraścaraṇa siddhena brāhmaṇena liṃge pūjāṃ kārayet | tatprakārovakṣyet | liṃgasya dakṣiṇato āgnikuṃḍaṃ vidhāya madhitāgniṃ nidhāya nityavadājyena dūrvābiḥ śuddhena taṃḍulena śamīsamidbhiḥ pratyeka maṣṭa sahasraṃ juhuyāt | devasya sannidhau japedaṣṭa sahasraṃ | devavayā mabhimataḥ pradakṣiṇa maṣṭa sahasraṃ | tāṃḍavaṃ deva sannidhau | praṇāma namaskārāpyaṣṭa sahasrau | etaiḥ karmabhirbhagavānati suprasanno bhavati || dhyānaṃ - ākarṇa kṛṣṇe dhanuṣijvalaṃtīṃ devīmiṣuṃbhāsvati saṃdadhānaṃ | thyāyenmaheśīṃ mahānīyaveṣaṃ devyāyutaṃ yodhatanuṃ yuvānam || || oṃ yāta iṣuśśivatamāśivaṃ babhūvate dhanuḥ | śivāśaravyāyā tavatayāno rudra mṛjaya || etanmaṃtraṃ dvādaśa dināni carubhojījapitvā kṛta puraścaraṇo viniyoktaṃ yogyo bhavati | annārdhītatastila taṃḍula yāvakāmalaka kalkamekādaśa sahasraṃ juhuyādannavānabhi jāyate | etena rājā durbikṣa nivāṇārthaṃ tilaguḍa miśrita caruṇā svāgnau śata sahasra māhutīḥ kārayet | tataḥ subhikṣa mabhijāyate rājye || dhyānaṃ - dhyāyeddevaṃ susmikaṃ syandanasthaṃ devyāsārdhaṃ tejasādīpyamānaṃ | iṣviṣvā sālaṃkṛtābhyāṃ karābhyāṃ śūrākāraṃ stūyamānaṃ surādyaiḥ || || oṃ yāte rudra śivātanū raghorā pāpakāśinī | tayānastanuvāśa ntamayāgiri śantābhicākaśīhi || adāsya maṃtrasya puraścaraṇam || haviṣyāśī trirātraṃ japankṛta puraścaraṇobhavati | adhaitayāgo śāstiṃ kuryāt | goṣṭhamadhye sarvato hastamātra magnikuṃḍaṃ vidhāya madhite agnauvaikaṃkatāpāmārga samidhāṃ dadhimadhu ghṛtāktānāmayutaṃ juhuyāt athāne naivāparāṃgo śāntiṃ vakṣyāmaḥ | brāhmaṇairghaṭa jalamabhi mantritaṃ sarvaganthādivāsitaṃ kṛtvā śata sahasraṃ japitvāgāḥ prokṣet | gavāṃśāntirbhavati || dhyānaṃ - smerānanaṃ caṃdraralāvataṃsaṃ gaṃgādharaṃ śailasutā sahāyaṃ | trilocanaṃ bhasmabhujaṃga bhuṣaṇaṃdhyāye tpaśūnāṃpatimīśitāraṃ || || oṃ yāmiṣuṃgirisa ntahaste bibharṣyastave | śivāṃgiritratāṃkuru māhigṃsīḥ puruṣaṃ jagat || || śive navacasātvāgiri śāccāvadāyasi | yathāna ssarva mijñagada yakṣmagṃ sumanā asat || || etayoḥ puraścarama mekaviṃśati dināni | niraṃtaraṃ japaḥ | tataḥ kṛta puraścarama etābhyā makāla maraṇa pratighātaṃ kuryāt | siddhena brāhmaṇena rājā kārayedakālamaraṇaṃ nabhavati rāṣṭre | abhyāṃ tila vrīhi godhūmā yavānāṃ dadhi madhu ghṛtāktānāṃ lakṣaṃ juhuyadeka viṃśati dināni | tasmin rāṣṭre akāla maraṇa bhayaṃ nabhavati | navabhirdinairipadravā naśyaṃti | aṣṭādaśa bhirdinaikhilaṃ jagadakālamaraṇa mupaśamayati || dhyānaṃ - sāṃgrāmikeṇa vapuṣā pravirājamānaṃ dṛpyatpura traya tṛṇāśani maṃdahānaṃ | daityān didhikṣu macaleśvara cāpabāṇiṃ dhyāyetpurāri mamarau gharathāthiruḍhaṃ || || oṃ adyavoca dadhivaktā pradhamodaivyobhiṣak | ahīguścasarvān jaṃbhaya nsarvāṃścayātu dhānyaḥ || || āthāsya maṃtrasya puraścaraṇaṃ | ārdhakṛrcchaṃcaritvā tataḥ paraṃ paṃca dināni śaikamūla yavacarubhoji divā''vaśyakāvirodhenatiṣṭhanniraṃtaraṃ japankṛta puraścaraṇobhavati | tatotesa rājā rakṣāṃ kāpayet | sarvārakṣārthaṃ śveta siddhārtha taṃḍula dūrvāya vaiścasamairājya siktaitātmanognau mathiteva nityavadaṣṭasahasrahomaḥ | viśeṣeṇārtrayāṃ daśa sahasra homaḥ | tasminneva tilaguḍa yavapayo miśritacaraṇā'ṣṭa sahasrahomaḥ | rājā dīrghāyurbhavati | sarvatrakāleca dakṣiṇāṃdadyāt | dakṣiṇāca trividhā | uttama madhyamādha mabedhena | suvarṇa niṣṭaṃ daśa sahasraṃ dakṣiṇottamā | paṃca sahrasaṃ madhyamā | trisahasra madhamā | adhavā | triśatamuttamā | dviśataṃ madhyamā | niṣkaśata madhamā | yasminkarmaṇi karmāṃgaṃ dakṣiṇātu vidhīyate | pradamaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt | paścāt karmāṃga dakṣiṇāṃ | evaṃ sarvatra kāle dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt | yadvā | uttamā catuṣṣaṣṭiḥ | madhyamādvā triśat | caturviṃśatiradhamā | bahukartṛkeṣu prati puruṣaṃ uttamā dātavyā ekakartṛke ekasyaiva | athāpyudāhārante | "atyalpa dakṣiṇo yajño yajamānaṃ śamayate " iti | rājñāṃ tatsadṛśānāṃ cottamā dakṣiṇādātavyā | anyoṣāṃ madhyamādikā | "vibhave satiyo mohanna kuryādvidhi vistaraṃ | naivatatpala māpnoti pralobhākrāntamānasaḥ" iti | daśa puruṣakartṛke triśatam | ācāryasya dviguṇam | ācāryo bhagavāneveti mantavyaḥ | sarvatraivaṃ vidhādakṣiṇādeyā | tatrāgnau maṃtra kalaśaṃ nidadhyāt | agneḥ puromaṃtra kalaśasthāranaṃ | sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃvā kalaśaṃ sthāpayet | tatrāgnau devamāvāhya tatsanidhau homaḥ kāryaḥ | homāṃte kalaśodakena rājānaṃ prokṣayet | gurorevanityaṃ viśeṣakārī rājākṛta rakṣobhavati | anenaivā paramapi valmīka pathaṃgacchan kārpāsa bījalavaṇa siddhārdhānekādaśa kṛtvo'bhi maṃtryayāṃdiśaṃ gacchettāṃdiśaṃ varjayitvā'nyā sudikṣu pratripet | tataśoddho japan gacchet | vyāghra taskara brahmarākṣasa yakṣa bhūtādibhyo muccate | ānenaivāparaṃ roganāśanaṃ pravakṣyate | āturaḥ sarṣapān saptābhi maṃtri tān‌kṛtvā śikhāyāṃbadhvā sthāpaye dārogyaṃsyāt | śveta sarṣapai revaṃkṛtaiḥ kumāra grahādibhyo mucyate | nāgaraṃ phalamātra mabhimaṃtrya payasikṣaptyā kvādhayitvā''tmāgnāvaṣṭa sahasraṃ vā'ṣṭa śataṃhutvā śeṣaṃpibet | garbharogānaśyanti || dhyānaṃ - caṃcrārda mauliṃ kālāriṃvyāla yajñopavītinaṃ | jvalatpāvaka saṃkāśaṃ dhyāyerdevaṃ trilocanam || || oṃ āsauyastāmro aruṇauta babhrussumaṃgalaḥ | yecemāg‌ rudrā abhitodikṣu | śritā vsahasra śovaiṣāg‌ heḍa īmahe || || āsauyova sarsati nīlagrīvo vilohitaḥ | utainaṃgopā adṛśanna dṛśannu dahāryaḥ | utainaṃ viśvābhūtāni sadṛṣṭo mṛḍayātinaḥ || || adaitayoḥ puraścaraṇārdhaṃca kṛccramekaṃ caritvā ṣoḍaśadinā niraṃtaraṃ japet | etābhyā manāvṛṣṭyaṃ satyāṃ vṛṣṭardhaṃ kāryaṃ | ārdrāṃtaṃ ārdrādinā | brāhmaṇān paṃcasiddhānā huyataiḥ kāryaṃ | teṣā muṣṇīṣa vasana karṇaveṣṭana kaṇṭhābharaṇa karavaṇḍanādi dadyāt | siddhaṃ homadravyaṃ tila taṇḍula yavānāṃdadhi madhu ghṛtāktānāṃ śata sahasraṃ juhuyāt | vetna samidhāṃ kṣīrāktānāṃ tadvatteṣāṃ paṃcānāmeko japeccatvāro juhuyulekādaśa dināni dīkṣitvā'ntya dineraktatamarasairaṣṭa sahasraiḥ pratyekamārādhayet | sakṛjñapitvā karmakālenavyāvyatyopa spṛśaṃścavīkṣyā sītā'nyadhā prāyaścittibha vedā samāpteragni rakṣākartavyā |avasānadine bhagavānādityo mahāvṛṣṭiṃ pramuṃcati | vetasa puṣpāṇāmayutaṃ juhuyāt | savitāvaraṃ dadāti | udyantamastaṃ yantamādityametābhyā mupatiṣṭheta kaṇṭhadaghnojalesthitvā etābhyā mubhayakara pūrṇajala mādityaṃ abhijapan prakṣīpet | pratidina maṣṭa sahasaāṃ kṛtvā navadināni | tatassavitā manaḥkāmamā saṃvatsaraṃdadāti japā puṣpāṇāṃ madvaktānā mekaviṃśati sahasra juhuyāt | savituḥ prasādājjāti smaratvaṃ labhate | caturvedi kulejaniḥ || dhyānaṃ - maṃḍalāṃtargataṃ hiraṇmayaṃ bhrājamānavapuṣaṃ śucismitaṃ | caṇḍadīdhiti makhaṃḍa vigrahaṃ ciṃtayenmuni sahasra svitam || || oṃ namo astu nīlagrīvāya sahasrākṣāya mīḍhuṣe | athoye anya satvāno haṃtebhyo'karaṃ namaḥ || || athāsya maṃtrasya puraścaraṇam | paṃca daśa dināni haviṣyāśī nirantaraṃ japet | śiva samīpe paścima dvārālaye kuṇḍamaratni mātraṃ sarvato vidhāya mathitāgnauvarkapuṣpaiḥ amāvāsyāyā mārabhya daśadināvadhi pratyahaṃ sahasraṃ hutvāghṛta pāyanaṃ devāya nivedayet | paṃcadināni dīkṣītvā sambhogālaye nadītire goṣṭhevā gṛhṇīyāt | devālayece ddevasyopari anyatrakumbhe āvāhyatanya paścimabhāgegniṃ saṃsthāpya śamī samīdhāṃ śamī patrāṇāṃ dadhi madhu ghṛtektānāṃ patryaha mekādaśa sahasraṃ tadartha maṣṭaśataṃvā | tāmarasa puṣpāṇyu parivisyaset | tadabhāve patraṃvā evaṃkṛtvā'ntya dine āṣṭa sahasraṃ tadartha maṣṭaśataṃvā brāhmaṇān bhojayet | dravya tyāgaṃ viśeṣeṇakuryāt | ekādaśa rudra rūponbojayitvāteṣāṃ kiṃci dvastu pradāya dakṣiṇato devasannidhau ācayarya madhikaṃ bhojayitvā dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt | dakṣiṇāpyupta bījābhūmiḥ || mānamapyucyate | narāratniṃ daṃḍenāṣṭaśataṃ | kuṇḍalāya suvarṇamapi pratidinaṃ pādaniṣkaṃ | tenakuṃḍalaṃ nirvāya dātavyaṃ | kāṃsyapātramekāgne pevamevahi | evaṃ putrakāmīkṛtvā śambhuprabhāvātputravān bhavati | yāvaddakṣiṇā bhūmistāvada viccinnāsa ntatirbhavati | asaṃvatsarātsiddhirbhavati | etatphalaṃ saptajanmānāṃ saṃbadhyate | tasmādaluptaṃ kuryāt || dhyānaṃ - śaraścaṃdra prakāśena vapuṣāśītala dyuti | dhyāye tsiṃhāsanāsīnamumayā sahitaṃ śivam || || oṃ pramuñca dhapvana stvamubhayo rārtniyorjyām | yāścate hasta iṣavaḥ parātābhagavonapa || || avatatya dhanustvage sahasrākṣa śateṣude | niśīryaśalyānāṃ mukhāśivona ssumanābhava || || vijyaṃdhamaḥ kapardano viśalyo bāmavāgā ita | anesanna syeṣava ābhurasya niṣaṅgathiḥ || ' || āsāṃti sṛṇāmṛcāṃ puraścaraṇam | kṛccraṃcaritvā''naṃ saṃśodya navadināni japet siddhobhavati || etābhiryuddhakāle bhūpaterayu dhānyābhi maṃtrya kuśakaṃṭakānāṃ sahasraṃ juhuyāt | yuddhopanītāḥ śatravo hīyante || dhyānaṃ - udyadbhāskarakoṭi prakāśamādī dahamūrdānaṃ | bhīṣaṇa bhujaṅga bhūṣaṃdhyāye dvividhāyudhaṃ pudramiti | dvitīyasya dhyānaṃ| rudraṃ suraniyantāraṃ śūla khaṭvāṃgabhāgariṇaṃ | jvālā mālāvṛtaṃ dhyāye dbhaktānā mabhayapradamiti || || oṃ yāte hetirmīḍhuṣṭamahāste babhūvate dhanuḥ | tayo'smānviśvata stvamayakṣmayā paribbhuja || || namaste astvāyu'dhāyānā tatāyadhṛṣṇave | ubābhyāmutate samo bāhabhyāṃ tavadhanvane || || parite dhanvanoheti rasmān‌ mṛṇaktu viśvataḥ | adhoya iṣudi stavā're asminnidhehitam || || iti prathamonuvākaḥ || || ādhaitā sāmṛcāṃ puraścaraṇam | pūrnoktānāṃti sṛṇāmiva kuryāt | etābhirapi saṃgrāmakāle tailamekādaśa pradīpa sahasrārhaṃ droṇyāṃ prakṣipya tatradeva māvāhya lokapālai ssaharādhya spṛṣṭhvātailaṃ saptadināni pratidina maṣṭasahasraṃ jaset | tenasidda tailena pradīpā nekādaśa sahasramāropya śatrurājye pratyasanne rājānaṃ vināsenānīḥ purogaccet | dṛṣṭvā dīpajvālāṃ śatṛsenā nāvatiṣṭhate | etatrpabhāvā devaśatravo vinaśyanti | anyadapi etābhirevā rātinagare siddhaveṣadhāraṇo brāhmaṇāḥ śaktāḥ mantrasiddhāḥ śatrorabhicāraṃ kuryuḥ | rājāyadupayu ṅkaivastuta detābhiḥ spṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvāca sparśana darśanā yogyaṃ tanmukhācchṛtvā ābicāro'stviti japeyuḥ | maṃtrāṃteranya tarasminnapi nagarāṃgabhūte sahasrābhi maṃtritaṃkhaneyuḥ | tannagaraṃ śaṃbhukopātsaṃvatsaratrayānnaśyati vyādhinā | evaṃ kārayitu rācāryasya rājyasamaṃdeyamiti | sarvatra maṃtraprabhāvātsidhyati | pramāṇabuthyā kāryamati || dhyānaṃ - praṇamadamarapoka mauśimālā kusumarajoruṇapaidapadmayugmam | ānavarata manusmaredbhavānyā mahājagatāṃ pitaraṃ pinākapāṇiṃ || || oṃ namohiraṇyabāhave senānyediśāṃca pataye namonamo | vṛkṣebhyohari keśebhyaḥ paśūnāṃ pataye namo nama | ssaspi - jarāya tviṣīmatepathīnāṃ pataye namonamo | babhluśāya vivyādhine'nnānāṃ pataye namo namo | harikeśāyopavītine puṣṭhānāṃ pataye namo namo | bhavasyahetyai jagatāṃ pataye namo namo | rudrāyā''tatāvine kṣetrāṇāṃ patayai namo namo | ssūtāyā''haṃtyāya vanānāṃ pataye namo namo | rohitātāyastha pataye vṛkṣāṇāṃ pataye namo namo | maṃtriṇenāṇijāya kakṣāṇāṃ pataye namo namo | bhupantayo vārivaskṛtā yauṣadīnāṃ pataye namo namo | uccairghoṣāyā'krandayate pattīnāṃ pataye namo namaḥ | kṛtsnanītāyadhānavate satvanāṃ pataye namaḥ || || iti dvitīyonuvākaḥ || ' || ādhaitasyānuvākasya puraścaraṇaṃ - ārthakṛcchraṃcaritvā aṣṭa sahasraṃ carubhojīvapet | tavaccaṃborālaya mekādaśa pradakṣiṇāḥ pratisaṃdhyaṃ kuryāt | japasamāptau devamārādhya tatsannithau brāhmaṇā nekādaśa bojayitvā kṛtapuraścaraṇobhavati | tenapūrvaṃ rājñāṃvakṣyate | śatrūṇāṃ māraṇa kāmorakta sarṣapāṃ sailā ktānayutaṃ juhuyā kṛtāvṛtautena karmaṇā śatravonaśyati | sarṣapāṃ sailāktānayutaṃ devamanulipya śatṛnāma grahaṇa pūrvakaṃjape daṣṭa sahasraṃ | ekādaśa ratreṇa śatṛṇāṃ rājñāṃ mahājvarojāyate tenaivate naśyanti || yudthe pratyāsanne devasyoparimāṃjiṣṭaṃ paṭasūropya svayaṃśuddhobhūtvā dakṣiṇahastāṃ guṣṭhena etadgaccha tyanuvākāṃte vadannaṣṭa sahasraṃ paṃcaḍināni japet | śatṛṇāṃ rājāsthā nādgacchati || āthavaśīkartu kāmaḥ pālāśāśvatthavai kaṃkatā pāmārgāṇāṃ madhughṛtāktānāmayutaṃ juhuyāt | kramaśovarṇa cutaṣṭayaṃ vaśamānayati | rājyakāmo rājākumuda saugaṃdhikotpalānāṃ madhuyuta mayutaṃ juhuyāt rājyaśriya mupatiṣṭhate | śrīkāmaśce tpaṃkajānāmayutaṃ juhuyāt śrīmānbhavati | medhākāmaḥ palāśapuṣpaṃ kapilājyenāktamayutaṃ juhuyāt | medhāvī bhavati | śatrūn‌jetu kāmojapa mekādaśa sahasraṃ kuryāt | śatravo vijitā bhavanti | pratidina maṣṭottara śatamaṣṭāviṃśatiṃvā pradakṣiṇa namaskārāṃśca yāvajjīvaṃ kuryāt | ihaloke sukhībhūtvā'ntekailāsa māpnoti || dhyānaṃ - muktālaṃkṛta sarvāṃga miṃdu gaṃgādharaṃ haraṃ | dhyāye tkalpatarormūle samāsīnaṃ sahomayā || || oṃ namassahamānāya nivyādhina avyādhinīnāṃ pataye namo namaḥ || kakubhāya niṣaṃgiṇe stenānāṃ pataye name namo | niṣaṃgiṇa iṣudhiyate taskarāṇāṃ pataye name namo | vaṃcate parivaṃcatestāyūnāṃ pataye namo namo | nicerave parivarāyāraṇyānāṃ pataye name namo | simadbhyonaktaṃ caradbhyaḥ prakṛṃtānāṃ pataye name namo | uṣṇīṣiṇe giricarāya kuluṃcānāṃ pataye name namo | iṣumadbhyo dhanvāvibhyaścano namo nama | ātanvānebyaḥ pratidadānebhyaścano namo namaḥ | āyacchadbhyo visṛjadbhyaścano namo namo | asyadbhyo vidyadbhyaścano namo namaḥ | āsīnebhyaśśayā nebhyaścano namo namaḥ | nvapadbhyo jāgradbhyaścano namo nama | stiṣṭhabhbyo dhāvadbhyaścano namo nama | ssabhābhya ssabhāpatibhyaścano namo nama | aśvebhyo'śvapitabhyaścano namo namaḥ || || iti tṛtīyonuvākaḥ || || adhaitasyānuvākasya puraścaraṇaṃ | kṛccraṃcaritvā paṃcasahasra japātkṛta puraccaraṇobhavati | janapadavyādhiṣu satyurājā śāṃtiṃ kārayet | siddairbhrāhmaṇai rekādasabhirīśvarālaye japaḥ kāryaḥ | paṃca bhirjapaḥ | paṃcabhirhomaḥ | eko brāhmaṇaḥ tilaudanaṃ prati namaskāraṃ kuryāt | śatasahasraṃ japaḥ | evaṃkṛtejanapada vyādirnaśyati | vāhanānāṃroge tilapiṣṭa miśrāpūpai rāhutimātrairekādaśa sahasrahomādvāhanānāṃ sāmānya vyādirnaśyati | anyavyādau vāhanāvāne āpāmārgā taṃḍulai rājyamiśrai raṣṭanahasraṃ juhuyāt | teṣāṃ vyādhirnaśyati | pradhānavyādhau śudda taṃḍu lai rājyasiktaiḥ śaṃbhorālaye śatasahasraṃ juhuyāt | amātyānāṃ roge'pidūrvā pāmārgaiḥ pratyeka maṣṭasahasraṃ juhuyāt | teṣāṃ vyādhirnaśyati | rājavyāthāmucyate | siddairbrāhmaṇai rekaviṃśatyākaṃ | teṣāmekobrahma | rāja pramāṇaṃ sarvato'gni kuṃḍaṃ kṛtvā | tatramathitāgni mādhāyadvāṃdvāṃ bhūtvā juhuyuḥ | taḍula tilaśyāmākanīvārā pāmārga dūrvākamala kiṃjalkaśuddhau danājyāni homadravyāṇi sarvaṃcagavyājya miśraṃca bhavati | tāsmādagnikuṃḍā dakṣaṇapaścamataḥ kalaśaṃ jalaśaṃ jalapūrṇaṃ spṛṣṭvā brahmajapet | āhutirapi saptanāḍi kāntāniraṃtaraṃ | evamamāvāsyā prabhyatya māvāsyāṃtaṃ homaḥ | atharājaroga udīrṇaśce dudayātprabhṛtya stamayāddomaḥ | nāḍikāhomasya dakṣiṇā pratidinaṃ prati puruṣamardhaniṣkaḥ | divāhome taddviguṇaṃ | ācāryasya taddviguṇaṃ | kalajalenaprokṣaṇaṃ rājopabhogya dravyeṣu kartavyaṃ | evaṃkṛte rājarogo vinaśyati | anyadapyucyate rājaroga vināśārdhaṃ nityavadanenānu vākenaśuklataṃḍulai rājyatilamiśritairaṣṭasahasramāhutayo hotavyāḥ | anenarājā nityaṃ nirogobhavati dīrghamāyuścabhavati | anyeṣāmapi rogesati anenāmavākena prati namaskāraṃ tilavrīhiyavai rājyākte rmadhusikai raṣṭasahasraṃ juhuyāt teṣāṃvyādhirnaśyati | anenānu vākenābhicārā ucyaṃte | rājācānyatarasya rāṣṭrasya rogahulya micchan nāmnaiva vārāhadhibhirmāmasaiḥ lakṣamahomaḥ kāryaḥ | ripurāṣṭraṃ samuddiśyābhicāraṃ karomiphaṭ‌ svāheti | evaṃmāṃsa homena ripu rāṣṭraṃ prajāśca śuṣyanti | athavaikaṃkatasamidbīraktamūtrapeṣṭitābhiḥ śatasahasrahomaḥ | anena śatroḥ mahājvarobhavati | vararāṣṭrajanai rupabhogyaṃ jalādikaṃ vastuspṛṣṭpā vīkṣyavā śatasahasraṃ japaṃkuryāt | yastadvāstūsaṃyuktena saṃvatsarānnaśyati | smaśānāgnā varkasamadbhiḥ śatasahasraṃ juhuyāt | tena śatṛrājanagaraṃvyādhinā naśyati | arkāraṇyaṃ bhavati anenaiva cāmuṃḍālaye dakṣiṇābhimukho bhūtvā māṣatilai staivaktaiḥ ekādaśa sahasraṃ juhuyāt | pararāṣṭra prajācamasūrikābirbādhyate anenaivā paramucyate | paścimadvāre śaṃbhorālaye devasya smṛtvā maṃtrāṃte prajvalajvālāpa smārannitivadet | etena rājaśatru rapasmāribhavati | anenaiva sarvaṃpadagaṃ rājānaṃ smṛtvā śuddha taṃḍula kṛta piṣṭai rāhutimātraiḥ śata sahasra homena rājayakṣmotpadyate | tenaivanaśyatiḥ || athadhyānaṃ - rūpayavvana saṃpannā mūrtaiva vanadevatā | puṣṭatā śoka punnāga sahakāra śiśūpamaḥ | paṃcavaṃśati nakṣatro māyūrakṛta śekharaḥ | ākalaṃka śaracaṃdra pūrṇabiṃba samānanaḥ | prāṃtebadḍha kapardaṃto vasānaścarma komalaṃ | savyāpasavya vidhṛta kṛtamālā vibhūṣitaḥ | dhārākadaṃba puṃjena nābhideśa vralaṃbinā | ājaṃghuprekṣaṇīyena prekṣaṇīyo'pi śatṛbhiḥ | bhāryāsyacāru sarvāṃgī vanyālaṃkāra bhūṣitā | ādarśamūrti śobhānāṃ vanyānāmiva nirmalā | tasyāhaste dhanurdhatvā śaramekaṃca nirmalaṃ | dvidīya maṃbyaśiṣṭaṃ vāmena bāhunā | sugaṃdipuṣpastabaka māghrū yāghrāya pāṇinā | vījyamānomandamaṃdaṃ navapallavaśākhayā | samāvṛto bālakaiśyaśvabhiścāpi manoharaiḥ | gacchadbhiragratodṛptairthyātavyo jagatāṃgupuḥ | evaṃbhūto mahātejāḥ kirātava purīśvaraḥ || || oṃ nama āvyādhinobhyo vividhyaṃtībhyaścavo namonama | ugaṇābhya stṛg‌hatībhyaścavo namo namo | gṛtsebhyogṛtsa patibhyaścavo namo namo | vrātebhyovrāta patibhyaścavo namo namo | gaṇebhyo gaṇapatibhyaścavo namo namo | virūpebhyo viśvarūpebhyaśyavo namo namo | mahādbhyaḥ kṣullakebhyaśyavo namo namo | radhibhyoradhebhyaśyavo namo namo radhebhyaḥ | radhapatibhyaśyavo namo nama | ssenābya ssenānibhyaśyavo namo namaḥ | kṣatṛbhya ssaṃgrahītṛbhyaśyavo namo namo | stakṣadbhyo radhakārebhyaścavo namenamaḥ | kulālebhyaḥ karmārebhyaśyavo namo namaḥ | puṃjiṣṭebyo niṣādhebhyaśyavo namo nama | iṣukṛdbhyo dhanvakṛdbhyaśyavo namo namo | mṛgayubhyaśśva nibhyaśyavo namo nama | śśvabhyaśśva patibhyaśyavo namaḥ || || anuvākaḥ || || adhasyānuvākaśca puraścaraṇaṃ | kṛcchraṃ dvādaśarātraṃ tadardaṃca kṛtvā nava sahasraṃ japet | tataḥ śivālaye'ṣṭa sahasraṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryādyā vatpradakṣiṇasamāptistāvanniraṃtaraṃ japet | tadhākṛta puraścaraṇobhavati | atradinādayona prekṣitavyāḥ | yadārucistadākartavyaṃ | rājayakṣmāvṛttomartyaḥ siddhaṃdvijaṃ vṛtvāśāṃtiṃ kuryāt | tatovṛto vipraḥ kārayituragnau tadṛhaikadeśe kuṃḍaṃ bāhumātraṃ vidhāya tasyapurovediṃ kṛtvā tatranavaghaṭaṃjalapūrṇaṃ taṃtuveṣṭitaṃ nidāya devamanenānuvākena nāvāhya gaṃdhādibhirabhyarcya gaṃdhaṃ kurpūraṃ puṣpaṃ tāmarasaṃ dhūpaṃ uśīrādidaśāṃgaṃ dīpaṃsarpiṣāsamarpya ekamārādyātmānamapi tatvamārādyaikādaśadināni dīkṣatvā kuryāt | prāraṃbhadine maṃtrapuṣpaṃtaṃ kṛtvā anuvāke nākādaśa kṛtvaḥ prati namaskāramājyena hutvā tatsannidāvekaviṃśati sahasraṃ japet | tadā tatprabhṛti yāvadaṃtamagniḥ saṃrakṣyaḥ tato'piparaśvaraḥ | nityakāryaṃ kṛtvā tilalāja dūrvāvrīhi yavailāja madhusikterekādaśa kṛtvo'nuvākena homaḥ | evaṃtrīṇi dinādi pratidinaṃ madhusarpiṣā juhuyāt | tatodvedine saptamāṣṭame aśvaththāphāmārgahomaḥ pūrvavat | tata ekadina mudayātprabhṛti astamayamāvaśyaka nityāvirodhena niraṃtara manuvākaṃ japet | tato navame madhasarpiṣāhomaḥ | daśame udayā stamayaṃ japet | tataḥ samāptidine anekanānuvāke nāṣṭasahasra kamala puṣpaiḥ prati namaskāraṃ devamārādhayet | tato gaurīmārādhya brāhmaṇaivryadhi nirmocana mastvitivācyaṃ | dānakālesṣṭa sahasraṃ tadardhaṃ paṃcaviṃśati niṣkaṃvā | evamokasya pṛthagdānaṃ | karmadakṣiṇādātavyā | pratidinamekaniṣkaṃ | tatospi sarvadakṣiṇeti dhenurdeyā | evaṃ samāpya devaṃ visarjayet | devālayadikarturepaṃ | tato ghaṭajalenataṃ snāpayet prokṣayodvā | etena rājayakṣmānaśyati | śaṃbhu prasādādevadīrghāyurbhavati | anenaivānuvākena mehaśāṃti rucyate | mhavān svāgnau madhusarpitahā prati namaskāraṃ nava sahasra māhutīrjurahayāt | mohonaśyati | anyeṣāmapi kuṣṭhādīnāṃ śata sahasra manuvākaṃ japet | vyādhayonaśyaṃti | jvarādi sannipāte śaktyo brāhmaṇonābhi mātre jale srotasi sthitvāraktakamala maṣṭasahasraṃ prati namaskāraṃ kṣipet | śeṣeṇa bhṛṃgiriṭi pūjākartavyā | evaṃ kṛte mahājvaro naśyati | pūrvamanena rājayakṣmaṇo nirharaṇa muktaṃ |goratvādbrāhṇaṇo vidvāneva gururbhave danyathā kalaha kriyābhavati| tasmādalopaḥ kāryaḥ || tato dhyānaṃ - bhasmodbhāsita sarvāṃgaṃ jaṭāmaṃḍala maṃḍitaṃ | dhyāye ttryakṣaṃ vṛṣārūḍhaṃ gaṇeśvarayutaṃ haraṃ || || iti caturdhānuvākaḥ | maṃ|| oṃ namo bhavāyaca rudrāyaca namaśśarvāyaca | paśupatayeca namo nīlagrīvāyaca śiti kaṃṭhāyaca śata dhanvaneca | kapardinecavyupta keśāyaca nama ssahasrākṣayaca śata dhanvaneca | namo giriśāyaca śipiviṣṭayaca namo mīḍhuṣṭamāyaceṣumateca | namo hrasvāyaca vāmanāyaca namo bṛhateca | varṣīyaseca namo vṛddhāyaca saṃvṛdhdhaneca || || namo agriyāyaca pathramāyaca nama | āśavecā jirāyaca namaśśīghriyāyaca śībhyāyaca nama | ūrmyāyacā vasvayacanamaḥ srotasyāyaca dvīpyāyaca || ' || || namo jyeṣṭhāyaca kaniṣṭhāyaca namaḥ | purvājāyacā parajāyaca namo dadhyamāyacā pagalbhāyaca | namo jaghanyāyaca buddhniyāyaca namasyobhyāyaca | prati saryāyaca namo yāmyāyaca kṣemyāyaca | nama urvaryāyaca khalyāyaca namaḥ ślokyāyacā vasānyāyaca | namo vanyāyaca kakṣyāyaca nama śranāyaca pratiśravāyaca || || nama aśuṣeṇāyacā suradhāyaca | nama śśūrāyacā vabhindateca namo varmiṇeca varūdhineca | namo bilmineca kavacineca namaśśrutāyaca śrutasenāyaca || || || etayoranuvākayoḥ puraścaraṇaṃ | trirātraṃcarubhojīsyājjapedatha niraṃtaram | ekādaśa dināni kṛta puraścaraṇobhavati | tataḥ karmocyate | etābhyāśveta kamalaiḥ prati namaskāraṃ māsaṃ liṃgasyoparikṣipe dekādaśa kṛtvaḥ | rājyaśrīrvardhate | brāhmaṇā nekādaśa bhojayoddevasya dakṣiṇāmūrteḥ sakaile | rājño janmadine rājāgnau mathitegnauvā asvaddha samudhāṃ ghṛtāktānā mekavi śati sahasraṃ juhuyāt | dūrvāṇā mekādaśa sahasraṃ | evaṃ kṛterājño jayāyuṣī varthete | etau vijayūrthaṃ mālimāli śata sahasraṃ jaset | etābhyāṃ saṃgrāme pratyāsanne rājño mahānasa pakvānnena sopadaṃśena bhaktena dadhi madhu ghṛtā ktena prati namaskāra mekādaśa kṛtvo hutvāśeṣaṃ baliṃbhūmau nidhāyādāya jalamuśraṃ pratisenā mabhi prakṣipet | sānenā'cirānnaṣṭābhavati | etābhyāmeva śuddha taṃḍulai rājyasiktai ragnau hutvāśeṣaṃ śatru mabhiprakṣipet | sanaṣṭobhavati | etābhyāmeva rājñaḥ sarvāyadhāni spṛṣṭvā sahasra mabhi maṃtrayet | teṣāṃ tejo vardhate | etābhyāmeva paramenāṃ prakṣipet | sāsenā ciraṃ naṣṭābhavati | etābhyāmeva parasenāstaṃbha ucyate | arka samidbhirādityaṃ prati namaskāraṃ śata sahasraṃ juhuyāt | "parasenā staṃbhaṃ karomisvāhā" | evaṃ kṛte śatṛsenā staṃbhitā bhavati | etābhyamevarājña sarvāṇi bhojya vastunyabhi maṃtrayet | tānyamṛtāni bhavanti | etābhyameva parasenā śoṣaṇa micchan vakṣyamāṇaṃ kuryāt | hariṇa varahaśaśakapaṃjala kalavaṃkamṛgāṇāṃ māṃsairnadyaṃ tarāleśūdrā nītāgnau pratidravyaṃ śata sahasraṃ juhuyāt | apūpairapi āhuti mātraṃ lakṣaṃ juhuyāt | prati namaskāraṃ "pararāṣṭra prajāśoṣaṇaṃ karomi svāheti" | evaṃkṛte paramarāṣṭhra prajāḥ śuṣyanti | teṣāṃ dakṣiṇāḥ suvarṇa rajata go bhūmi vastrādaya iti rājñāmeva muktaṃ | anyoṣāmucyate | vandyānāmana patyānā metābhyāṃ svāgnau prati namaskāraṃ uduṃbara samudhāṃ dadhi madhu ghṛtāktānāmekaviṃśati sahasraṃ juhuyāt | namaskāra mabhiṣekaḥ | japedaṣṭa sahasra metābhyāmeva mahādeva mabhiṣiṃcet | saptanāḍikā mātrabhati | strī puṃsoparaṣṭatriṃśa daṣṭa catvāriṃśa dūrvāmapi prayuṃjānayoḥ putrojāyate | yastusvanaṃśa karobhavati | śivabhaktojāyate | tasyahastayoḥ śūlāṃkobhavati | etābhyāṃ ghṛtapāyasaṃ śrapayitvāsṣṭa sahasraṃ juhuyāt | tadānya janmani brāhmaṇojāyate | etābhyāṃ sūtra mabhimaṃtrya garbhiṇīhaste badhniyāt | tathā garbhanāśonasyāt | etābhyāṃ kumāra grahadi grastānaṃ bhasmadūpa rakṣāṃkārayet | rātrauca śikhāṃ badhniyāt | kamāra graha bhayaṃ nabhavati || dhyānaṃ - gaurīkarāṃbudanyasta svarṇaśaila śarānanaṃ | iṣu hastaṃ radhārūḍhaṃ naranārītanuṃ smaret || || iti paṃca ṣaṣṭhānuvākaḥ || || || maṃ|| oṃ namo duṃdubhyāyacāhananyāyaca | namo dhṛṣṇaveca pramṛśāyaca namo dūtāyaca | prahitāyaca namo niṣaṃgiṇeceṣu dhimateca | namastīkṣṇeti vecāyudhineca namaḥ svāyudhāyaca | sudhanvaneca namassṛtyāyaca pathyāyaca | namḥ kāṭyāyaca nīpyāyaca nama ssūdyāyaca | sarasyāyaca namo nādyāyaca vaiśaṃtāyaca || || namaḥ kupyāyacā vaṭyāyaca namo varṣyāyacā varṣyāyaca | namo meghyāyaca vidyutyāyaca nama īdhriyāyacātapyāyaca | namo vātyāyaca reṣmiyāyaca | namo vāstavyāyaca vastupāyaca || || || asyānuvākaśca puraścaraṇaṃ || ekopavānaṃ kṛtvāsṣṭa śataṃ japet | kṛta puraścaraṇo bhavati |anena cāturvarṇa vaśyakāmaḥ aśvāddo daṃbara vaṭaplakṣa samudhodadhi madhughṛtāktān huhuyāt | medhāvījāyate | puṣṭikāmospūpaiḥ nava sahasraṃ juhuyāt | ārogya kāmaḥ khādirāṇāṃ samidhāṃ dadhi madhu ghṛtāktānāṃ paṃca sahasraṃ juhuyāt | pūpakāmoyutaṃ cūtapallavān dadhi madhu ghṛtāktān‌ juhuyāt | rūpakāmoyutaṃ cūtapallavān dadhi madhu ghṛtāktān juhuyāt | śrakāmaḥ kāntāre svākāra pramāṇa magnikuṃḍaṃ khanitvā tatra mathitāgnau śvetakamalānāṃ dadhyādyaktānāṃ paṃca sahasraṃ juhuyāt | sākṣācchrīrupatiṣṭate | tasyāḥ prasādena tadanvayo yāvadbhūstā vadvarthate | kārpāsapaṭakāmastu kārpāsabījairmadvaktaiḥ ayutaṃ juhuyāt | ānenakārpāsapaṭā upalabhyante | dhenu kāmogavāṃ vrajehyetamanuvākaṃ japanpradakṣiṇamayutaṃ kuryāt | dhenumāpnoti | putrakāmaḥ palāśa samuthāṃ dadhi madhu ghṛtāktānāma yutaṃ juhuyāt | vaṃśakaraṃ putraṃ labhate | āyuṣkāmo dūrvāṇāṃ ghṛtāktānāṃ prativarṣamayutaṃ juhuyāt | śatāyurbhavati | vidyākāmośvata samithā mājyāktānāṃ śata sahasraṃ juhuyātsarva vidyāpārago bhavati | rājyakāmaḥ saugaṃdhikānāṃ madhvaktānāṃ paṃcalakṣaṃ juhuyāt | samrāḍabhijāyate | athamuktyupāya ucyate | tatrādau cāṃdrāyaṇaṃ caritvā eta manuvākameka viṃśati sahasraṃ japitvā tataḥ paraṃ paṃca sahasrāsta pradakṣiṇaṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ paścātsvāgnau śaṃbhu sannidhau palāśāśvattha samidhāṃ madhughṛtāktānāṃ lakṣatrayaṃ juhuyāt | tataḥ śaṃbhu prasādānmukto bhavati | anyecatatkulajātā yāvadiyaṃ pṛthivītāvadvarthate || dhyānaṃ - jaṭābhirlaṃbamānābhiḥ nṛtyantamabhaya pradaṃ | devaṃ śucismitaṃdhyāye dvyāghracarma pariṣtṛtaṃ || maṃ|| oṃ namassomāyaca rudrāyaca samastrāmrāyacā ruṇāyaca | namaśśajgāyaca paśapatayeca nama ugrāyaca bhūmāyaca namo agre madhāyaca dūrevadhāyaca | namo hantreca haniyyaseca | namo vṛkṣebhyohari keśebhyo namastārāya namaśśaṃbhaveca | mayobhaveca namaśśaṃkarāyaca mayaskarāyaca | namaśśivāyaca śivatarāyaca || || namastīrthyāyaca kulyāyaca namaḥ pāryāyacā vāryāyaca | namaḥ prataraṇāyacottaraṇāyaca | nama atāryāyacā lādyāyaca | namaśśaṣpyāyaca phnyāyaca | namassikatyāyaca pravāhyayaca || || nama iriṇyāyaca prapathyāyaca | namaḥ kigṃśilāyaca kṣayaṇāyaca | namaḥ kapartineca pula stayeca | namogoṣṭyāyaca gṛhyāyaca | namastalpyayaca gehyāyaca | namaḥ kāṭyāyaca gahvareṣṭhāyaca | namo pāgṃ savyāyaca pajasyāyaca | namaśśuṣkyāyaca harityāyaca | namo lopyāyaco lapyāyaca || || nama ūrvyāyaca sūrmyāyaca | namaḥ parṇyāyaca parṇa śadyāyacaḥ | namopa guramāṇāyacābighnateca | nama ākbhidateca prakbhidateca || adāsya mantrasya puraścaraṇādikaṃ bhrūmaḥ | kṛcchradvayaṃ caritvādau paṃcaśataṃ japetkṛtapuraścaraṇo bhavati | pūrvāṃ rājñāmucyate | rājāyadāsāmrājyamicchati tadāvakṣyamāṇaṃ kuryāt | kālovasaṃtaḥ deśogiraḥ śarvālayaḥ kāṃtāraṃvā tatrāvayevādevasya sannidhau brāhmaṇaiḥ kāryasiddhiṃ vācayitvātān saṃpūjya prāraṃbhaḥ | ārdrāyāmamāvāsyāyāṃvātayoranyatarasvāṃ prāraṃbhaḥ brāhmaṇān maṃtrasiddhān gṛhṇīyāt | yadvā ācāryaḥ sadyaḥ karmasiddhiṃ kuryāt | ācārya iti kalpavitsiddaucyate | sayadhāvadet tathā siddhirbhavati | tatra sadyasiddhirucyate | brāhmaṇāstasmādācāryātsaṃ śuddhāsmaṃtramādāya paṃcadaśadināni niraṃtaraṃ japeyuḥ | tataḥ karmayogyā bhavaṃti | evaṃ siddherhomaḥ kāryaḥ | pratinamaskāramāhuti pratrepaḥ | homadravyāṇi | tiṃvrīhiyavādayaḥ sājyāḥ | homakālā ucyaṃte | udayātprabhṛtyāstamaya manavarta mekādaśa dvijaistriṃ śaddinānikārayedevaṃ | homakartṛbhya uttarīyādayopātreṇa dātavyaḥ | acāryasyāpi kuṃḍalādayaḥ | homāgneruparisarpiḥ pātraṃ sadā srodobhavedaṇudhāramevaṃ karmayāvatsa māpyate tāvatdevasyāpi pratidina maṣṭa sahasraṃ bhojanaṃ kāryaṃ | brāhmaṇānapitāvataḥ | pratidinaṃbhojaye daṃtyadine nityāddviguṇam | ācāryo bhagavāneveti maṃcavyaṃ | ācāryasya sārabhūtā bāmirdātavyā | ṛtvijā śataṃ śataṃ niṣkāstadarthārthavā dakṣiṇādātavyā | taddviguṇa mācāryāyeti | tatra śivapūjāyāṃ gandhaḥ karpūramiśritaḥ | kamalāni puṣpāṇi | dhūpaḥ karpūra miśrito guggulaḥ | dīpogavyājya iti | naivedyaṃtūktaṃ | evaṃ rudrārādhanaṃ prati saṃvatsaraṃ kāryaṃ | evamārādhanādrājā samrāṭ bhavet | rājānoye sāgaramadhyasthāne rudrarūpairhanyamānā bhavaṃti | iha sarvāṃbhavaṃ bhūktojāyate | tasya karayoḥ pinākāṃko bhavati | tenāṃkena rudrārādhānakārītyavagaṃtavyaṃ | anyasyāpi yasya rājñohasta yoraṃkebhavati sopi rudrārādhana kārītyavagaṃtavyaḥ | eva mekādaśa brāhmaṇaiḥ prati saṃvatsaraṃ rudrārādhanaṃ kartavyaṃ | atraivā paramucyate | rājā śatṛnāśa kāmaḥ atiśa ktena brāhmaṇamena kāryate | śatruṃ rājānaṃ mahākhadirarūpiṇaṃ kṛtvā kasmiṃ ścidvini ktedeśe jalapūrṇakubhe devatāmāvāhya tatsannidhāvagnimādāya śamīsamidbhiḥ sakaṃṭakābhiḥ rudhirāktābhiḥ śata sahasraṃ juhuyāt | rudhiraṃ ca baiḍālaṃ praśastaṃ bhavati | tatastadrūpaṃ pratyaṃgaṃ lohaśaṃkhubhiḥ prati maskāraṃ khānayitvā | tadupari rājāsvapādaṃvinyaset | vinyāsakāle gururjapete | tatorājā brāhmaṇānāṃ śataṃ bhojaya ttatodevaṃ visarjayet | evaṃ kṛte pararājā saṃvatsara trayānnaṣṭo bhavati | anyaccata devarūpaṃ saśṛkhalaṃ kṛtvā pūrvavaddomaḥ | tato rājā cirāccṛṃkhalī rājayaśyatvaṃvrajet | anyadapivakṣyate | śatṛrājanagare kṛtrima veṣadhāriṇo rājapuruṣāḥ sabrāhmaṇāḥ siddhāḥ praviśya catuṣpadeṣu caityeṣu devāvayoṣu rājasabhāsurājadvāreca rohaśaṃkūnapitāṃ ścatasahasrābhimaṃtritānkṛtvā guptānyaneyuḥ | tato bhasmābhimaṃtritaṃ sarvato vikireyuḥ | javamapivikireyuḥ | evaṃ kṛte tatpuramāsaṃvatsara trayānnaṣṭaṃ bhavati | tatrakhadirabadaryādayo vanaspatayorohaṃti | tato vikṛtaveṣāḥ pararājapura jalāśayośu kaṃṭha pramāṇe jaletapaḥ kurvāṃtaḥ sūryābhimukhauḥ aṣṭaśatadināni pratidina maṣṭaśataguṇaṃ japeyuḥ | evaṃ kṛtetajjalapāyino vāhanādayo viṣadaṣṭā iva naśyaṃti | evaṃ kurvaṃto vidvāṃso guptamevakuryuḥ | pratyakṣeṇa rājabhayaṃ sadyojāyate | atieva guptamevakāryamiti | evaṃ kartrūṇāṃ rājyārthasamā dakṣiṇāsyāditi || tataḥ dhyānaṃ - pinākapāṇiṃ bhūteśamudya tsūryāyutadyutiṃ | bhūṣitaṃ bhūjagairdhyāyet kaṃṭhe kālaṃ kapardinaṃ || || oṃ namovaḥkarikebhyo devānāg‌ hudayobhyo namo vikṣiṇakebhyo namo vicinvatkebhyo nama āmīvatkebhyaḥ || ' || || athāsya maṃtrasya puraścaraṇaṃ | parākaṃ caritvā catvāriṃśa tsahasraṃ japet | kṛtapuraścaraṇo bhavati | maṃtrasodhanārdhaṃ gurusannidhau aṣṭanahasraṃ japet | tataḥ karmayogyo bhavati | anenamaṃtreṇa dussādhyaṃ kiṃcinnavidyate | mantraprabhāvātsarvāṃ saṃvadyate | anenakāmyaṃ karmocyate | mahābhyogyābhijāyate | manojavamicchan jāgaraṇaṃ kūryāt | puraścakaṇamapi viśeṣeṇa bhavati | sāṃvatsarikaṃkṛcchraṃcaritvātmānaṃ saṃsodhyatatosṣṭādaśadinānica rukāśamūla phalāharīmirantaraṃ japet | bhavati | yaṃyaṃdeśa mabhikāyamate taṃtaṃdeśaṃ guruṃcasmṛtvā maṃntra maṣṭaśatamāvartayet | taddeṣagāmī bhavati | evaṃ manojavaprakāra uktaḥ | tatosdṛśyaprakāra ucyate | atrāpi pūrvavatpuraṇaścharaṇa madṛśyā vaśyakāle lohitaṃ caṃdanaṃ kapilāpayāsā saṃklidya tatkṣodamaśvatthapatre nidhāya saṃspṛśyāṣṭa sahasraṃ japet | tata stenātmāna mupalipya devaṃ spṛṣṭvā smṛtvā prāṇāyāmaṃ dhārayet | tataḥ kenaci dadṛśyobhavati | rājavaśya kāmolohita caṃdanakṣodamayutābhi maṃtritaṃ kṛtvā taṃtuveṣcitāṃ gulikāṃ kṛtvā nityavadrājagṛhapraveśe svalalāṭedhārayutvā praviśet | rājā rājapuruṣāścavaśyā bhavaṃti | yaṃyaṃnāśa yitu micchettasya tasya nāmagrahamapūrvaka mayutamekapādo bhūtvā devasya sannidhau japet | saṃvatsarānnaśyati | devasya dakṣiṇāmūrte sannidhau nityamaṣṭaśataṃ japet | rājapuruṣebhyo bhayaṃ mābermāsromo eṣāṃ kiṃcanām mat || adhanya maṃtrasya puraścaraṇaṃ | ekāhamupavāsaṃ kṛtvāyutaṃ japet | kṛtapuraścaraṇobhavati | kapilājyenārdrāyāmayuta māhutīrjuhuyāt | kṛtadhanobhavati | jvare sannipāte tasya śirastodūrvāgrāṇāṃ paṃca sahasraṃ juhuyāt | tasmā jvarānmukto dīrghāyuśca bhavati | abhicāra mokṣakāmavaikaṃkatānāma yutaṃ juhuyāt | tasyābicārebhyo bhayaṃ navidhyate | uduṃbaratilānāmayutaṃ jihuyāt | tasyābicārebhyo bhayaṃ navidyate | grāmanagara madhyesgnimupa samudhāya tatraghṛtāktatila piṣṭānāmayutāni juhuyāt aśvaddadaleṣu balimupaharet | adāvapyaṣṭa sahasraṃ juhuyāt | tasyarudro bhairavarūpī bhūtai ssahasvayaṃ dṛśyobhavati dṛṣṭvāyadicale dunmādī bhavati | acalasya tasyamahā siddhirbhavati | āpadi tadrūpaṃ smare dāpadbhyaśca muktirbhavati || tato dhyānaṃ - agulphāsita kaṃcukeḍa marukāśliṣṭolasatkuṃtalī | śūlīkuṃjalita śravāḥ satilakomaṃdaṃ kvaṇannūpuraḥ | śrīmannirmala daṃtapaṃkti kiraṇaḥ śvetāyamānānano | devobhairavaveṣa bhūṣita vapurdhyeyo mṛḍānīpatiḥ || maṃ|| oṃ yāte rudra śivātanūśśivā viśvāhabheṣajī | śivā rudrasyabheṣajī tayāno mṛḍajīnāse || athātasya maṃtrasya puraścaraṇaṃ | aṣṭaśata prāṇāyāmān kṛtvā paṃca sahasraṃ japet | kṛta puraścaraṇobhavati | anena kevalaṃ gapbharatrā vighākatavyā | nānyat | vyaktegarbhe tṛtīyā māsirakṣāṃ kūryāt | rudramantra siddhena brāhmaṇe natadabhivṛddhau svavibhavānuguṇa malaṃkṛtvā śaṃbhūmiva taṃnamaskṛtyāt | sādugarbhe asādhavona prekṣitavyāḥ yadāpirucirbhavati tadaivakartavyaṃ | rājo gṛhāṃtarālevivikte ārvāk ārvāgvāmidvayaṃ svīkṛtya dvajādya lakārai ralaṃkṛtya maṃtradvayena prastha smaret || maṃ|| oṃ imāgṃ rudraya tavase kapardine kṣayadvīrāya prabharāmahematiṃ | yādhānaśśamasadvipade catuṣpade viśvaṃ puṣṭhaṃ grāme asmin‌ nnanāturaṃ || mṛḍāno rudro tanomaya skṛdhikṣaya dvīrāya namasāvidemate | yacchaṃcayośca manurāyajepitā tadaśyāma tavarudraḥ praṇītau || || adānayoḥ puraścaraṇaṃ | kṛcchraṃ caritvā nava sahasraṃ japet | kṛta puraścaraṇo bhavati | amāvāsyāyāṃ catuṣpadesgnimupasamādāya dadhisāra mayutāhutimātraṃ juhuyāt | dadhisāra mayutāhutimāṃ juhuyāt | gavādīnāṃśātirbhavati | etābhyameva rājavāhanānāṃ śāṃtaye jalaṃ spṛṣvā pratyārdra mayutaṃ japaṃ kṛtvā japa jalena vāhanaśālāṃ prokṣayet | vāhanānāṃ śāṃtirbhavati | vāhanānāṃ kiṃcidupa yojyatena jalena miśritaṃ kṛtvā upayojayet | tiraścāṃ śāṃtaye dūrvāṇāmayutaṃ juhuyāt | teṣāṃ śāṃtirbhavati || dhyānaṃ - divya siṃhāsanāsīmanaṃ stūyamānaṃ mahārṣibhiḥ | prasannavadanaṃ dhyāye tsomaṃ somartha dhāriṇaṃ || || maṃ|| oṃ manomahaṃta mutamāno arbhakaṃ māna ukṣaṃtamutamāna ukṣitaṃ | mānonadhīḥ pitaraṃ motamātaraṃ priyāmāna stanuvo rudrarīriṣaḥ || || adhānya maṃtrasya puraścaraṇaṃ | upavāsa trayaṃ kṛtvā paṃca sahasraṃ japet | kṛta puraścaraṇo bhavati | anena svajanarkṣākartavyā | yavatilvānā ajyaktānāmayutaṃ juhuyāt | aśvaddha samitāmayutaṃ juhuyāt dadhi madhvājyenāyutaṃ juhuyāt | prati saṃvatsara mārdrāyāmayutaṃ juhuyāt | evaṃkṛte ātmīya strī bāla vṛddha janasya śāṃtirbhavati | asminapi śāṃtikāraṇe japamayutaṃ kuryāt viśeṣeṇa rājā pratimāsaṃ maṃtreṇānena kāṃtyardha mārdrāyāṃ homaṃkārayet | tenarājñoṃtaḥ purādayopi vardhaṃte || dhyānaṃ - bāleṃdu makuṭaṃ devaṃ taruṇāditya vigrahaṃ | dhyāye naṃdīśvarākāraṃ gaṇeśvara samāvṛtaṃ || || maṃ|| oṃ mānastoketaye mānaāyuṣi mānogoṣumāno aśveṣurīriṣaḥ | vīrānmāno rudrabhāmito vidhīrhaniṣmaṃto namasāvidemate || || adhāsya maṃtrasya puraśṛraṇaṃ | kṛccraṃcaratvā uduṃbara prātreṇa kāpilaṃ sarvisahasrābi maṃtritaṃkṛtvā tenasvāgnau madhitenāṣṭa sahasraṃhutvā mahāvyāhṛtibhirbutvā śataṃ śeṣamaśitvā trirātra mupavanet tataścarubhojī paṃcāśatsahasraṃ japet | gupave paṃcaniṣkaṃdadyāt | nityavadrājāsvāgne madhitespivā kevala mājyapi ktaistilairayutaṃ juhuyāt | aṣṭabhirbrāhmaṇai raṣṭāsidikṣu rājānamabhito bhasmāṣṭaśatābhimaṃtrita mādāya rājarakṣāṃ kuryāt | etadapinityavat kāryaṃ| anenaivāparamucyate | śvetakamalai rdadhimadhughṛtāktairayutaṃ juhuyāt | ekādaśarudrarūpai brāhmaṇai maṃtrasiddhai sadyaliddhairvākāryaḥ | atha sadyasiddhirucyate | ācāryānmaṃtraṃlabdhā trirātramupoṣyati rātraṃ niraṃtaraṃ japet sadyassiddho bhavati | tattatkarmayogyataitāyutaṃ nityavadeva juhuyāt | rājā cirajīvī bhavati | anena kalaśānaṣṭa sahasramaṣṭaśataṃvā jalapūrṇān svarṇa rajita tāmramayān vābhimaṃtrya gaṃdhādibhirārādhyanavavastraveṣṭitān kṛtvā nyā nyapi maṃgalānikṛtvā ācāryo rājajanmadine rājānaṃsnāpayet yāvaṃtohikalaśāḥsyuḥ | evaṃ kṛterājā doṣaiḥ kāyiktaiḥ pātakādibhīrasyalipto bhavati | rājñovā vṛddhyardhamanena nityavadekena brāhmaṇe nāṣṭasahasraṃ japaṃ kārayet | vāhanāyudhaśālāsu ratnākaradiṣu ca māsimāsi saumye nakṣatre śātiṃ kuryāt | aśvadthāpāmārgasamudhāṃ dadhi madhu ghṛtāktānāmayutaṃ juhuyāt | gatāyuṣo apyāyurvardate | dyūte vyavahāreca maṃtrametaṃ japet naparājito bhavati | trirātramupoṣya niraṃtaraṃ japet | tataścaru bhojībirvaphalānāṃ madhvāktānāmayutaṃ juhuyāt | svarṇasahasraṃ labhate | kumudānāṃ dadhimadhughṛtāktānāmayutaṃ juhuyāt | kanyāṃ labhate | anenaiva saṃvatsaraṃ ca rubhojī kapilāghṛtenasyānmaṃtranityava daṣṭasahasramaṣṭaśataṃ vāhutīrjuhuyāt | sarvasmān mahāpātakān mucyate | enena malayajakṣodamabhimaṃtrya lalāṭedhārayet‌tsarve vaśyānisyuḥ | apāmārgasamidbhi raṣṭasahasraṃ pratijanmadine juhuyādapamṛtyuṃjayati | vṛṣṭikāmaḥ sūryaṃ japāpuṣpairayutairārādhayet | raktoṣṇīṣavasanānulepanobhūtvā ādityavāre | bhagavānādityo mahāvṛṣṭiṃ mucaṃti | dūramārgagāmī daśaśarkarāgṛhītvāṣṭasahasrābhi maṃtritāḥ dikṣudaśasuprakṣipya gacchet | satuyāvadgamanaṃkṣemī bhavati | karmaṇā mavighnakāmo maṃtramayutaṃ japītvā karmārabhet | anāyānenakarmaṇā maṃtaṃgacchet | putrakāmesnelakṣamājyena juhuyādvaṃśakaraṃ putraṃ labhate | api yaṃyaṃjetumicchettaṃtaṃ sikatākāraṃ vidhāyatasya śirasisthitvāyutaṃ japet | sarvatra vijayijāyate | anyadapisarvamanena saṃbhavati | maṃtraprabhāvāddevasya sākṣātsiddhānāmeva phalati | anyeṣāṃ vṛdhāprayāsa iti maṃtravyaṃ || dhyānaṃ - dadānamekādaśadhāvibhaktadehaṃ viśuddhasphaṭikaprakāśaṃ | tejonidhiṃ śūlinamuṃdumauliṃ viciṃtayettatra sadai varudraṃ || || maṃ|| oṃ arātaigoghnaruṣaghn kṣayadvīrāyasumnamasmete astu | rakṣācano adhica devabrūhyadhā ca naḥ śarmayaccadvijarhāḥ || || adhānya puraścaraṇaṃ | trirātramupoṣyati rātraṃ niraṃtaraṃjapet | kṛtapuraścaraṇo bhavati| anenāyuṣkāmānāmeva nānyeṣāmityāhuḥ | "śatāyuḥ puruṣa ucyate" itiśṛtau | evaṃ satiiti janmanijanmāṃtarevā āyuṣaḥkṣayakāraṇaiḥ karmabharbhālādayomriyaṃte teṣāmāyurvardhanāya | matreṇānenaprayoga ucyate | nityavadanenasvāgnau sarpiṣāṣṭa sahasramaṣṭaśataṃvā āhutīrjuhuyāt | dūrvāṇāmaṣṭasahasraṃ dadhi madhughutāktānāṃ juhuyāt | svajanmakṣatre nityamevāṣṭa sahasraṃ japet | ārdrayāṃ viśeṣeṇa | pratyārdhraṃ dūrvāpāmārgaśamī tilānāṃ dadhimadhughṛtāktānāṃ pratyekamayutamāhutī rjuhuyāt | rātrauyāvatpaṃcasahasraṃ japet | tāvatpradakṣiṇāḥ kuryāt | rājājanmadine durvāpādhumārgādi pratyekaṃyutaṃ juhuyāt | rājā dīrghāyurbhavati | aśaktānāṃ srotasihomaḥ | tatostyaṃtāśaktānāṃ japaeva | śuddhataṃḍulai rmadhvājyāktairayutaṃ juhuyāttasyāyurvardhate | maṃtreṇā nenadevasyopari arkasumanobhirayuta mārādhayet | tasya śrīrvardhate | paścimadvārāvayevācarubojī adhaśśāyī brahmacarmavā nakṣāravaṇāśī devamabhitaḥ sahasraṃjape deṃvakṛte śatāyuḥ saptajanmasubhavati | āśaktasyabhakṣāharaḥ praśasta iti || kurvāṇaṃsannidhaudevyā devamānaṃdatāṃjavaṃ | hutāśanadaraṃdhyāye ttaptakāṃcanasannibhaṃ || || maṃ|| oṃ - stuhi | śrutaṃgarta sadaṃyuvānaṃ mṛgaṃnabhīmamupahatnu mugraṃ | mṛḍājaritre rudrastavāno anyaṃte asminnivapaṃtu senāḥ || || adhāsya puraścaraṇaṃ | ekarātra mupoṣya trirātraṃ niraṃtaraṃ japet | kṛta puraścaraṇo bhavati | vaikaṃkata samīdāṃ viṣatai lāktānāṃ śmaśānāgnau lakṣaṃ juhuyāt | śatravonaśyati | śatrunāma grahaṇaṃ kṛtvā devasya sannidhau bhasma pāṇirayutaṃ japet | tasyaśakṣorma hajvarobhavati | śvetasiddhārdrayutaṃ juhuyāt | śatrormasūrikā jāyaṃte | tābhirevamriyate | śatrora, gṛhakṣetrādiṣu maṃtreṇānenāvaṭaṃkhānayutvā tatrakalpaṃ romāsthi śarkarādikaṃkhātayet | tasyaśīghraṃ nāśobhavati || dhyānaṃ - udyadbhāskara koṭiprakāśamādīpta dahana mūrdhānaṃ | aṃbara nilayaṃ bhīmaṃ dhyāyedabhayaṃ śavaṃ suraughanutaṃ || "śaṃbhākṛti rdevodyātavya" itikecit || maṃ|| oṃ pariṇo rudrasyaheti rvṛṇaktu paritveṣasya durmatiraghoyoḥ | avasthirā maghavadbhyastamanuṣva mīḍhvastokāya tanayāya mṛḍaya || || adhāsya maṃtrasya puraścaraṇaṃ | kṛccracaritvā navadināni pratidina maṣṭa sahasraṃ japet | kṛta puraścaraṇobhavati | ānena putra kāmānāmeva kartavyaṃ | etadapi guptaṃ kuryāt | dāvānalarūḍhanya phalāśakhadirādeḥ samidhāṃ dadhi madhu ghṛtāktānāḥ paścimadvāre śivālayetvāyutaṃ juhuyāt | śivasadṛśaṃ putraṃlabhate | devāvaye aśvaddhachāyā yāmātma gṛha goṣṭhayorvā ārdhrāyāmamāvāsyāyāvaṃvā kṛṣṇapakṣe aṣṭamyāṃvā prāraṃbhaḥ | pūrvedyuścaru bhojanā daṃpatī bhavataḥ | prati maṃtrākṣaraṃ kalaśāṃ staṃtuveṣṭitān jalapūrṇān pratiṣṭhāvyateṣāṃ madhye kuṃbhamuccaistaraṃ nidhāya tasmin devaṃ somamāvāhayet | āyātu bhagavān kailāsāt | iti āvāhya gaṃthādibhirabhyarcya tataḥ pūrvavanmadhya kalaśa mārabhya pratikalaśaṃ maṃtrādita ekameka makṣaraṃnyaset | tato nava sahasraṃ japet | tata uddeśakāgnau śyāmākalājānāṃ madhughṛtāktānāmaṣṭa sahasraṃ hutvā tanmātra mājyenaca hutvā tata ādi kalaśa mādāya tattadatrararūpiṇaṃ bhagavaṃtaṃ smaran srāpayet | ekāsanametau pratiṣṭhāpya kubhajalenaca snāpayitvā brāhmaṇānāmasṭa sahasra maṣṭaśataṃvā ekaśata maṃte bhojayet | tatra kasala vastravrīhyādīnācāryasya datvātaṃ bhojayitvā dakṣiṇākele paṃcaniṣkaṃ trayaṃvādadyādevaṃ rūpāyā dakṣaṇāyāḥ kiṃcidapinyūnaṃ nabhavedevaṃdatvā daṃpatī bhuṃjīyātāmevaṃ tayo putraḥ śivatamodīrghāyurutpadyate | athapūrvokta karmāśa ktava paramucyate | aśakto maṃtramimaṃ japet | paścimādvāre devālaye ahorātraṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt | udayā tprabhṛtyāstamāyāt astamāyā tprabhṛtyodayā ttatravavighnoyadi midyate aśaktāna saṃticet | śaktasanna śaktamātmānaṃ matvākurvan naśyati | tasmātpuraścaraṇayukto gururapramattaḥ kūryāditi | aśaktānāṃ prajākāmānā magatīnāmanugrahaṃ vakṣyāt | nityavadaśvatthasya pūrvottara mūlādārabhya aṣṭa sahasraṃ japet | aśvaddha caturdikṣu pratidina maṣṭa sahasraṃ japet | evaṃ samāpya yāvaccaktitāvadvā brahmaṇān dīkṣāyuktān bhojaye devaṃkṛte vaṃśakaraṃ putraṃ labhata iti | dhyānaṃ - gajacarmāvṛta tanuṃ sphuratpra haraṇojjvalaṃ | sarvapāpaharaṃ dhyāye ddevaṃ kuṃjarabhedinaṃ || iti || || maṃ|| oṃ mīḍhuṣṭama śiva tama śivonassumanābhava || paramevṛkṣa āyudhaṃ nidhāya kṛttiṃ vasāna ācarapinākaṃ | bibhradāgahi || || adhatasya puraścaraṇaṃ | ekarātraṃ paṃcadaśa sahasraṃ japet kṛpuraścaraṇo bhavati | ardhanāśa bhayeprāṇa saṃśaye ghorārtibhayevācorādibhaye kevalājyena paṃcasahasrāhutī rjuhuyāt | tebyomucyate || dhyānaṃ - maṃgalāyatanaṃ devaṃ yuvānamati suṃdaraṃ | dhyāyedvanacarākāra māgaccaṃtaṃ pinākinaṃ || || maṃ|| oṃ vikiridavilohita namaste astubhagavaḥ | yāste sahasrāgṃ hetayossya masmanniva paṃtutāḥ || || athāsya puraścaraṇaṃ | trirātraṃca rubhojī daśa sahasraṃ japet | tadaṃte daśa sahasraṃ pradakṣiṇāḥ kurvān japet | kṛta puraścaraṇo bhavati | anena mahājana vihodhe sakala saṃjāghātaṃ dadhi madhughṛtāktānāṃ samidhāmayutaṃ jāhuyāt | bhayaṃna bhapati | sarvān jetu kāmospāmārga samidhāṃ kapilājyapiktānāṃ śata sahasra māhutī rjuhuyāt | etenaiva varāhadayo vaśyā bhavaṃti | tiraścojetu kāmobilva samudhāṃ dadhi madhu ghṛtāktānaṃ śata sahasra māhutīrjuhuyāt | etenaiva varāhadayo vaśyā bhavaṃti | tiraścejatu kāmobilva samidhāṃ dadhi madhu ghṛtāktānāṃ śata sahasra hāhutī rjuhuyāt | apojetu kāmojalasya madhye ātmāgni mādhāya kāpilenapayasā śata sahasra māhitī rjuhuyāt | ādabhyobhayaṃ najāyate | eva manyadapi yadyajjetu kāmobhavati | tattannāma grahaṇaṃ kṛtvā kāpilājyena śata sahasraṃ juhuyāt | tattatsarvaṃjayati || tatodhyānaṃ - prasanna vadanaṃ saumyaṃ racitodvāhamaṃḍanaṃ | aṃjayā sahitaṃ dhyāye tsurasaṃghairabhiṣṭhutaṃ || || maṃ|| oṃ sahasrāṇi sahasradhā bāhuvo stavahetayaḥ | tāsāmīśāno bhagavaḥ parācīnā mukhākṛthi || ' || adāsya maṃtrasya puraścaraṇa mucyate | kṛccrārdhaṃcaritvā paṃcadaśa sahasraṃ japet | kṛta puraścaraṇo bhavati | anena maṃtreṇa puruṣāṇāṃ rājopadravaśāṃtiṃ kuryāt | śālmalī vaikaṃkata samidbhirvrīhi yavatilāni sarpiḥ siktānyayutaṃ juhuyāt | upadravāśyaṃti | bhagavato dakṣaṇāvūrtḥ sannidhau śata sahasraṃ japet | pradhāna puruṣa māraṇe vilmīka mṛttikā liṃgaṃ kṛtvānena maṃtreṇa yāvaccīrṇa mabhiṣiṃcet | tatastāṃ mṛdamādāya sadyāṃ prakṣipya tattīre svāgnau śuddha taṃḍulaiḥ ghṛtāktairayutaṃ juhuyāt tasya maraṇa mupaśama yati | mahākāṃtāragāmi bhasmāṣṭa sahasra mabhimaṃtrya sarvaṃtena śarīra mavalipyagaccet | tasyakimapi bhayaṃnabhavati | kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ rātrau śmaśāne bāḍālamāṃseni saudasela balimupaharet | "rākṣasebhyo balimupaharāmi" iti | tatastebhyo bhayaṃnavidyate | mahīśāstuḥ kopopahatānāṃ suvarṇa mahāśāstuḥ sannidau anenāṣṭa sahasra mājyena juhuyāt | kukkuṭa māṃsena balimupaharet | tatra navavasanāni muvarṇādikaṃcahomasya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt | niṣkatrayekaṃ vārāṣṭra śatabhāgo vādātavya iti | anyeṣā mapidaivopa hatānāmanena maṃtrma sarpiṣā aṣṭasahasraṃ juhuyāt | daivopadravānaśyaṃti || tatodhyānaṃ - sarvapāpa haraṃdevaṃ sarvābharaṇa bhūṣitaṃ | sarvāyudha dharaṃ dhyāye tsarvaloka maheśvaraṃ || ' || maṃ|| oṃ sahasrāṇi sahasraśoyerudrā adhibhūmyāṃ | teṣāgṃ sahasrayojaneSvadhanvāni tanmisi | asmin mahātyarṇaveSṃtarikṣe bhavā adhi | nīlagrīvāśśitikaṃṭhāḥ śvārvā adaḥ śramācarāḥ | nilagrīvāśśi kaṃṭhādi vagṃ rudrā upaśritāḥ || || eteṣāṃ caturṇāṃ maṃtrāṇāṃ puraścaraṇādikaṃ bhrūmaḥ | cāṃdrāyaṇaṃ caritvā kāyaśodhanārdhaṃ paṃca sahasraṃ japet | tataḥ kṛta pura ścaraṇobhavati abhicārikaṃ karma maṃtrairtaiḥ kuryāt | rājā brāhmaṇaisvadeśa jātairhomaṃ kuryāt | śālmalī sālavetra veṇu śarāṇā markatulāveṣṭitānāṃ śaśarudhirāktānāṃ śata sahasraṃ juhuyāt | atrapiṣṭena snigdhena mūkṣmeṇa śatruprati kṛtiṃ kṛtvā prāṇānsaṃsthāpya krameṇa chitvāSṣṭa sahasraṃ juhuyāt | etaiḥ phrayogai śśatravo naśśanti | etaireva maṃtrairabicāraṃ pratikurvāṇo dūrvāṇāṃ dadhi madhu ghṛtāktānāṃ paṃcasahasraṃ juhuyāt | rājñastvābhicāradoṣā naśyaṃti kārayitaḥ || tato dhyānaṃ - daṃṣṭra karālavadanaṃ jvalajvalanamūrdhajaṃ | bibhrāṇaṃ triśikhaṃ dīpaṃ dhyāye dbhujagabhūṣaṇaṃ || || maṃ|| oṃ yevṛkṣeṣu saspiṃjarā nīlagrīvā vilohitāḥ | yebhūtānā madhipatayo viśikhāsaḥ kapardhinā | yeanneṣu vividhyanti pātreṣu pibatojanān || || eteṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ pūrvavatpuraścaraṇādikaṃ sarvaṃ || || maṃ|| oṃ yepathāṃ pathirakṣaya ailabṛdāyavyudhaḥ || yotīrthāni | pracaraṃtisṛkāvaṃto niṣaṃgiṇaḥ || || anayoḥ puraścaraṇaṃ | kṛcchraṃcaritvā | paṃcasahasraṃ japet | kṛtapuraścaraṇo | bhavati | etābhya mṛtagamanadine svāgnau vaṣṭa sahasraṃ kāpilenapayasā sarpirvimiśreṇa juhuyāt | tataḥ ṛtugāmībhavet | tatra vidvān vaṃśakaraḥ putrojāyate | etābhyameva mahātīrthagamane svāgnau śuddhataṃḍulai rājyasiktairayutaṃ juhuyāt | tīrthamanāvapan gacchet | snātvāgatya svāgnimārādhyavācaṃ visṛjaṃstīrtha phalaṃ yadārthamaśnute || dhyānādikaṃ pūrvavat || || maṃ|| oṃ yaetāvaṃtaśca bhūyāgṃ saścadiśo rudrāvitasthare | teṣāgṃ sahasrayonajanena dhanvānitanmasi || || puraścaraṇādikaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvavaddraṣṭavyaṃ || || oṃ namo rudrebhyoyevṛthivyāṃ yestarikṣeye diviyeṣā mannaṃvāto varṣamiṣavastebhyo daśaprācīrdaśa dakṣiṇā daśapratīcīrdaśodīcīrdaśordhvāstebhyo nama stenomṛḍayaṃtu teyaṃ dviṣmoyaścanodveṣṭitaṃvojaṃbhedadhāmi || || adhāsya maṃtrasya puraścaraṇaṃ | ekaviṃśati dināni dīkṣitvā paṃca paṃcadināni nānyavastu bhuṃjīta āmameva sarvaṃ bhavet | prathamapaṃcakaṃ payaḥ | dvitīyaṃ phalaṃ | tṛtīyaṃ dadhi | caturthamapiphalaṃ | eka upavāsaḥ | evaṃ catvāri ekaviṃśati dināni haviṣyā śītiṣṭan sadā japettataḥ paṃcadinānigalapramāṇajalastho bhavet | ekadinamaghamardhaṇa vidhānena japet | ācāryasya daśaniṣkaṃ suvarṇaṃ dadyāt | tatsamāṃca śuśrūṇāṃ kṛtvā kṛtapuraścaraṇo bhavati | tato nityavatsvāgnau anenāṣṭa sahasra maṣṭaśataṃvā āhuti rājyena juhuyāt | yāvajjīva mananyamanājapet | tatosnena kartavyaṃ karmocyate | evaṃ siddhasyavakṣyamāṇa mamāvāsyā yāṃsvāgnau kapisājyenā,ṭasahasramāhutīrjuhuyāt | hutvākeśānāliṣyāṣṭaśataṃ juhuyāt | atharvaśiraḥ pratyuktavidhānena ārādhanaṃ | tataḥ kṛtyā raktāṃgī raktamūrdajā raktanayanotpadyate | pūrvamevājā rudhirapūritāṃścaturaḥ kumbhān‌sthāpa yitvātaistāṃ tarpaṇāt anyadhātmānaṃ nāśayet | tayāsarvānnāśaye ttayāsarvaṃchābhicāro sādhayet anenājyenāyutaṃ juhuyāt | kālajñānamutpadyate aṃtata pramāṇaṃ sarvamevotpadyate | kāpilenapayasājuhu yādayutaṃjāti smarojāyate || uvācaphalaṃ - śṛtaṃ rudraprasādena sarvameva yathātathaṃ | ekādaśaikādaśato dānavuktaṃtadānakha | paṃcagokarṇikaṃ dānaṃ śaṃbhudānaṃ tathaivacasārvābhaukaraṃbhūmeḥ | kalaśasthāpanaṃtathā śikhāsphuṭita saṃskārakhaṃḍa aṃbarīṣaḥ marṣaṇaḥ bṛhadukṣaḥ śiśiraḥ darbhapiṃgaḥ bhadraṇaḥ <2> ityaṃbikāṃ copatiṣṭhet‌ - bṛhatparāśaro maṃtrānta ramāha - saubhāgya maṃbikedehī - rūpabhāgyaṃ yaśopica - śriyaṃ putrāṃśca kāmāṃśca tadhā śauryaṃ ca - dehime - gaṇeśa mātaraṃ bāle yatkiṃcinmada bhīpsitaṃ ekānāmnaiva taddehi gauridehi varānmameti - arghyadāna mupasthānaṃ ca catuṣpathe balyaṃnaṃtaraṃ kāryamiti madanaratne - tataḥ ācāryaḥ śūrpekuśe nāstīrya kṛtā kṛtā dyupaharaṃ tatranidhāya catuṣpade bhūva mabhyukṣya kuśānāstirya tatra maṃtroktau devatāḥ saṃpūjya tatra - śūrpaṃ nidhāya baliṃ dadyāt - maṃtrāstu - baliṃ gṛhṇaṃtvi maṃdevā ādityā vasava stadhā - maruto dāśvinau rudrāḥ suvarṇāḥ pannagāgrahaḥ - asurā yātu dhānāśca piśācā mātaroragāḥ | śākinyo yakṣa bhetālau yoginyaḥ pūtanāḥ śivāḥ - jṛṃbhagāḥ siddha gaṃdharvā nānāvidyā dharānagāḥ - dikpālā lokapālāścayeca vighna vināyakāḥ - jagatāṃ śāṃti kartāro brahmadyāśca maharṣayaḥ - māvighnaṃ mācame pāpaṃ māsaṃtu paripaṃthinaḥ - saumyābhavaṃtu tṛptāśca bhūtapretāḥ sukhāvahāḥ - tato yajamāno gṛhamāgatya prakṣālyācamya - pūrṇāhutiṃ hutvā - ācāryaṃ saṃpūjya tasmai vastra yugmaṃ hemaṃca dakṣiṇāṃ datvā ṛtvigbhyo yadhā śaktyonyebhyaśca bhūyasīṃ dakṣiṇāṃdatvā - vināya kāṃbikayo ruttara pūjāṃkṛtvā visṛjyācāryā yadatvāgniṃ saṃpūjya vibhūtiṃ dhṛtvāgniṃ visṛjya brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā karmeśvarārpaṇaṃ kuryāt || iti nārāyaṇa bhabṭa, sūrinūnu rāmakṛṣaama bhaṭṭasūnukamalākara bhaṭṭa kṛte śāṃti ratne vināyaka śāṃtiḥ hemādrau bhaviṣye - caturthyāṃ vāraṇaṃ haimaṃ palādūrdhvatu śobhanaṃ - kārayitvā kuśayutaṃ tiladroṇo parinyanet || vastraiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayitvā naivedyaṃ vinivedyaca | tatastu brāhmaṇe dadyādgaṇeśaḥ priyatāmiti || kāryā raṃbheṣu sarveṣu tasya vighnaṃ najāyate | tayā vināyaka śāṃtyā vikalpaḥ - vāraṇāḥ sapta janmani bhavaṃti madavihvalāḥ - idaṃ caitre śrāvaṇe kārtike vākāryamiti hemādriḥ || a tha gra ha ya jña śāṃ tiḥ etha sarvaśāṃti prakṛtatvā dgṛhayajña ucyate - skāṃda yājñyevalkyau - śrīkāmaḥ śāṃti kāmonā tadaivābhi carannapi | sacatuthyā | kevalaḥ ayutahomo lakṣahomaḥ - koṭihomaśceti - adyo yājñavalkyā dyairuktaḥ - trayo mātsye uktāḥ || grahayajñastridhā proktaḥ pūrāṇaśruti voditaḥ | prathamoyuta homassyālsakṣa homa stataḥ paraṃ | tṛtīyaḥ koṭi homastu sarvākāma phalapradaḥ || tadvedhā - naimittikāḥ kāmyāśca - taddeśastatraiva || grahasyottara pūrveṇa maṃḍapaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ | rudrāyatana bhūmauvā caturaśramudaklpavaṃ | daśahasta madhāṣṭauvā hastānkuryādvi dhānataḥ - tasyadvārāṇiṃ catvāri kartavyāni vicakṣaṇaiḥ || maṃtra muktāvaśyāṃ || catura śrāścatudvārā aṣṭahastā daśāpivā | caturviṃśati hastāvā hīna madhyottamāḥ kramāt | yadvādvāśa hastāssyā dvihastā vṛddhitopinā | aṣṭāviṃśati paryaṃtāḥ kaiściduktā manīṣibhiḥ || agni purāṇepyevaṃ || ayaṃtu maṃṭapaḥ kāmye naimittikādau | nityaṃ naimuttikaṃhitvā sarvamasyatra maṃṭapa miti śāradā tilakāt || kuṃḍala maṃṭapa prakāronmatpitṛkṛta pramoda dīpikāyāṃ matkṛte dāna kamalākarecajñeyaḥ || skāṃde || navagrahamakhe kuṃḍaṃ hasta mātraṃ samaṃbhavate | caturaśramadho hastaṃ yomi vaktraṃ samekhalaṃ | caturaṃgula vistāro mekhalā tadvaducbhritā | māna hīnādikaṃ kaṃḍaṃ maneka bhayadaṃ smṛtaṃ || yonirmātsye || vita stimātrayoni ssyātṣaṭsaptāṃgulivistṛtā | kūrma pṛṣṭhonnatā madhye pārśva yoścāṃgulocchritā | mekhalopari sarvatra aśvaddha dalasannibhā || kuṃḍābhāve sthaṃḍilaṃvā || nitya naimittikaṃ homaṃ sthaṃḍi levā samācarediti śāradā tilakāt || kaṃḍa mevaṃ vidhaṃ tatsyāt sthaḍilaṃvā samāśramediti || skāṃde || tasyacottarapūrveṇa sthaṃḍilaṃvedi || tryaśraṃ caturaśraṃcavitastyucrāya saṃmitaṃ | dviraṃgulo cchritovavraḥ pradhamaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ | aṃgulochrāya saṃyuktaṃ vapradvaya maṃthovari | dvyaṃgulastatravistāraḥ sarveṣāṃ kathito budhaiḥ | navagraha makhekāryā ṛtvijaścaturaḥ śubhāḥ | athavācaika mabhyarca vidhinā brahmaṇā saha || madanaratne skāṃde || navagraha makhe viprāścatvāro vedavādinaḥ | āthanā ṛtvijauśāṃtau dvāvevaśruti coditau | kāryāvāyuta hometu naprasajjeta vistare || vedya saṃbhale sarvato bhadraṃ kāryaṃ || maṃḍalaṃ sarvato bhadrame tatsādhāraṇaṃ smṛtamiti śāradā tilakāt || mātsye || puṇyehni viprakathite kṛtvā brāhmaṇa vācanaṃ | agni praṇayanaṃ kṛtvā vedyā māvāhayetsurān || ādityābhi mukhāssarve sāthi pratyadhidevatāḥ || pratimā āha yājñavalkyaḥ || tāmrakātsphaṭikā drakta caṃdanā tsvarṇakādubau | rajitādayasaḥ sīsāt kāṃsyātkārvā grahaḥ kāmāt | svavarṇervā paṭelekhyā gaṃdhai rmaṃḍala keṣuvā || mātsye || padmāsanaḥ padmakaraḥ padmapatra samadyutiḥ | saptāśvaḥ saptarajjuśca dvibhaja syātsadā raviḥ || śvetaḥ śetāṃbaradharo daśāśvaḥ śvetabhūṣaṇaḥ | gadāpāṇi rdvibāhuścakartavyo varadaḥ śaśī || raktamālyāṃbaradharaḥ śakti śūla gadādharaḥ | caturbhujo meṣagamo varada ssyāddharā sutaḥ || pīta mālyāṃbaradharaḥ karṇikārasa madyutiḥ | khaḍga carmagadā pāṇi, saṃhastho varado budhaḥ || devadaitya gurūtadva tpītaśvetau caturbhujau | daṃḍinau varadau kāryau sākṣasūtra kamaṃḍalū || iṃdranīla dyutiḥ śūlī varado gṛdhra vāhanaḥ | bāṇa bāṇāsanadharaḥ kartavyorkassuta ssadā || karāla vadanaḥ khaḍga carma śūlī varadradaḥ | nīlasiṃhāsanasthaśca rāhuratra praśasyate || dhūmrā dvibāhuḥ sarve gadino vikṛtānanāḥ | gṛdhrāsana hitāvaḥ || skāṃde || janma bhūgotra magniśca varṇasthāna mukhānica | yosjñātvā kurute śāṃtiṃ grahastenāva mānitāḥ || utpanorkaḥ kaliṃgoṣu yamunāyāṃca caṃdramāḥ | aṃgārakastva vaṃtyāṃca magadhāyāṃ himāṃśujaḥ | siṃdudeśe gururjātaḥ śukro bhojakaṭetadhā | śanaiścarastu saurāṣṭre rāhu rvairāṭināpure | aṃtarvedyāṃ tathāketu rityetāgraha bhūmayaḥ | ādityaḥ kāśyapegotre ātreyaścaṃdramā bhavet | bhāradvājo bhavedbhauma stadhātreyastu somajaḥ | guruścaivāṃgiro gotre śukrovai bhārgavastadhā | śaniḥ kāśyapa evātha rāhu ; paiṭhīsa siptathā | ketuvo jaiminīyāśca grahāgni stadasaṃtaraṃ || ādityaḥ kapilonāma paṃgalaḥ somaucyate | dhūmraketu stadhākhaumo jāṭhakāgni rbudhaḥ smṛtaḥ | gurulcaiva śibhīnāmā śukro bhavati haṭakaḥ | śanaiścaro mahātejāḥ rāhoḥ keto rhutāśanaḥ || bhāskarāṃgārakau raktau śuklā śukra nirākarau | somaputro guruścai vatāvubh pitākau smṛtā | kṛṣṇaṃ śanaiścaraṃ vidyādrāhuṃ citrāśca ketavaḥ || gobhilenatu || brāhmaṇau bhārgavācāryaukṣatriyāvarka lohitau | vaiśyausoma budhaujñeyau śeṣān śūdrān vinirdiśediti varṇau uktāḥ - skāṃde || madhyetu bhāskaraṃ vidyā cchiśinaṃ pūrvadakṣiṇe || dakṣiṇe lohitaṃ vidyādbudhaṃ pūrvottareṇatu | uttaretu guruṃ vidāyatpūrveṇaivatubhārgavaṃ | paścimetu śaniṃ vidyā drāhu dakṣiṇa paścime | paścimottarataḥ ketūn sthāpyāvai śukla taṃḍulaiḥ | athavā varṇakaiḥ kāryāḥ kāryāḥ svarṇādidhātubhiḥ | śukrārkaun prāṅmubhaujñeyau guru saumyā mudaṅmukhau | pratyaṅmukhaśśani ssomaḥ śeṣādakṣiṇato mukhauḥ | prāṅmukhā vūrdhvadṛṣṭīca vāmadṛṣṭī udaṅmukhau | pratyaṅmukhā vadhodṛṣṭī ādityābhi mukhāḥpare || iti mātsyokteḥ || hemādrau vikalpa ityuktaṃ | varṇarūpa guṇairyuktān vyāhṛtvāssvāhayottutān || grahamaṃḍalāni skāṃde || bhānuṃtu maṃḍalākāraṃ somaṃtu caturaśrakaṃ | aṃgārakaṃ trikoṇaṃtu budhaṃ bāṇākṛtiṃ tadhā | caturaśraṃ guruṃ vidyāt paṃcāśraṃ bhārgavaṃ tadhā | dhanustulyaṃ śaniṃ vidyādrāhu śūrpākṛtiṃ tadhā | ketavastu dhvajākairā gaṇeśaṃ tatsvarūpiṇaṃ || tattadvarṇamaṃḍaleṣu tāmrādi pratimāsu taṃḍulesthāpayedityarthaḥ || maṃḍalamūrtyorvikalpa iti hemādriḥ | grahamaṃtrānāha yājñyavalkyaḥ || ākṛṣṇena imaṃdevā agnirmūrthādivaḥ kakut | udbhudhyasvetica ṛcoyadhā saṃkhyaṃ prakīrtitāḥ | bṛhaspate āti yadaryasta dhaivānnātpati srutaḥ | śanno devī stathākāṃḍā tketuṃ kṛṇvannimā stadhā || skāṃdetu || kayāna iti rāhuścetyuktaṃ || mātsyetvanye uktāḥ || agniṃdūtaṃ dineśāya somāya ssvagna ityapi | syonāpṛthiti khaumāya idaṃ biṣṇurbudhāyaca | iṃdra āsāṃsureśāya śukra jyotiḥ sitāyaca | prajārateti saurāya āyaṃgauriti rāhave | ketave brahmajijñānaṃ svaisvairmatraiḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ || anyārdhānānupi maṃtrāṇāṃ vacanaika deśādyadhārda maiṃdrīsyāditi nyāyena viniyogaḥ - homepyeta eva || adhidevatā sskāṃde || sūryasya cottare śaṃbhu mumāṃsomasya dakṣiṇe | skaṃda maṃgārakasyaiva dakṣiṇasyāṃ niveśayet | saumyātpaścimato viṣṇuṃ brahmāṇaṃ jīva pūrvataḥ | iṃdra mraiṃdyāṃtādviddhi maṃdasyāgneyato yamaṃ || rāhu pūrvottare kālaṃ sarvobhūta bhayāvahaṃ | ketornairbuti digbhāge citra guptaṃ nidhāpayet | īśvaraṃ tryaṃbakaṃceti śrīścatetica pārvatīṃyadakraṃdetica skaṃdaṃ viṣṇuṃ viṣṇorarāṭataḥ | ābrahmanniti brahmāṇaṃ sajoṣā iṃdravāsavaṃ | yamāyatveti ca yamaṃ kālaṃ kārṣirasītica | citrāvasosva maṃtreṇa citraguptaṃ nidhāpayet || agnarāpaḥ kṣitarvi ṣṇu riṃdra aiṃdrī prajāpatiḥ | sarpā brahmāca nirdiṣṭāḥ sthāpyāḥ pratyadhidevatāḥ | agnīṃdūta mitihyagne ravaruṇasya uduttamaṃ | syonāpṛthivi medhinyā idaṃ viṣṇustu viṣṇane | iṃdrāyeṃdo itīṃdrasyottānaparṇe śacīsmatrau | vrajāpate prajeśasya eṣabrahmetivā vidheḥ | maṃtro namo astu sarpebhya ssarpāṇāṃ sthāpane mataḥ || gobhila vasiṣṭhau || graha devatamormadhye adhidevānni veśayet | madanaratne saṃgrahetu || adhidevā dakṣiṇetuvāme pratyadhidevatāḥ | sthāpanīyāḥ prayatnenavyā bṛtībhiḥ pṛdhakpṛdhak || utpalaparimale || grahasya dakṣiṇepārśve sthāpayodadhidevatāḥ || grahasyottara pārśvetunyane tpratyadhidevatāḥ || launakaḥ || kṣetrasya patinākṣetrapālaṃ bhūjottaresyavet || bhūjobhaumaḥ || grahadevādi devānāṃ | naivedyaṃ kusumānica | grahavaccāsanaṃ dānaṃ sthāpanaṃ bhūnupūrvataḥ | ityaktaṃ - vāsiṣṭhetvanyadhoktaṃ || rudraṃtryayaṃbaka maṃtreṇa raveruttaratonyaset || somasyāgneya digbhāge śrīścate menakātmajāṃ | yadakraṃdeti bhaumasya skaṃdaṃyāmye prapūjayet | viṣṇuṃ viṣṇorarāṭetiyaje tpūrvebudhasyaca | guroruttaratasthsāpyo brahma bahmeti maṃtrataḥ | sajoṣeṃdreti maṃtreṇa prācyāṃ śakraṃ vidhāpayet | śaneḥ paścimataḥ sthāpoṃya māyatvetpṛcāyamaḥ | kārṣīrasīta maṃtreṇa rāhoḥ kālaṃ tathottare | citraguptaṃtu ketūnāṃ citrāvasviti naiṛrte | grahadevata yormadhye adhidevānniveśa yet || mātsye || vināyakaṃtathā durgāṃ vāyumākāśamevaca | āvāha yedvyāhṛtī bhistadaivāśvi kumārakau || madanaratne skāṃde || uttare śani sūryābhyāṃguroḥ ketośca dakṣiṇe | gaṇādhipaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya sarvadeva namaskṛtaṃ || tatraiva saṃgrahe || rāhu maṃdadineśānāṃ uttarasyaṃ yadhākramaṃ || gaṇeśa durgāvāyūṃśca rāhu ketoścha dakṣiṇe | ākāśa maśvinauceti paṃcai tāssthāpayodbudaḥ || vasiṣṭaḥ || vināyakaṃ gaṇānāṃtvā | durgaṃ bejācavedase || vāyo yotetathā vāyuṃ ghṛtaṃ ghṛteti cāṃharaṃ | yāvāṃdhiśetī saṃpūjya dvāvapyetau tatośvanau || gobhilīyo || dvātraṃṃśa ddevatā sthsāpyādiśāṃ pālāśca diggajāḥ || yājñavalkyaḥ || yadhāvarṇaṃ pradeyāni vāsāṃsi kunumānica | gaṃdhāśca balayaścaiva dhūpodevaśca guggulaḥ | guḍodanaṃ pāyasaṃca haviṣyaṃ kṣīraṣāpṭikaṃ | dadhyodanaṃ haviścūrṇaṃ māṃsaṃ citrānnamevaca | dadyādgraha kramādetaddvijebhyo bhojanaṃ budhaḥ || śaktitovā yadhālābhaṃ saṃskṛtya vidhi pūrvakaṃ || havirghṛtaudanaṃ || cūrṇaṃ tilacūrṇa miśraudanaṃ || skāṃde || divākara kujābhyāṃhidāpāye draktacaṃdanaṃ | caṃdanaṃ bhārgapecaiva sitavarṇaṃ pradāpayet | kuṃkumenatu saṃyuktaṃ caṃdanaṃ jīvasaumyayoḥ | agaruṃ caṃdanaṃ dadyā drāhuke tvarkajeṣuca | grahavarṇāni puṣpāṇi gāyatryā dhūpamācaret || raveḥ kuṃdurukaṃ dhūpaṃ śaśinastu ghṛtākṣataḥ | bhaume sarjarasaṃcaiva agaruṃ ca budhe smṛtaṃ | sihlakaṃ guraverdadyā tsomāya ghṛtapāyasaṃ | lohitāya haviṣyānnaṃ budhāya kṣiraṣāṣṭikaṃ | dadhyodhanaṃ gurordadyā cchukrāyaca ghṛtodanaṃ | miśritaṃ tilamāṣaiśca naivedyaṃtu śanaiścare | rāho rmāṣodanaṃ | dadyā tketościtrodanaṃ tathā || mātsyetu || masurāśca kuje dadyādityuktaṃ || niveda yitvāhutibhirhomaṃ kṛryādataṃdritaḥ || ātra viśeṣo matkṛtedāna kamalākarejñeyaḥ || mātsye || dhūpāmo dotra surabhirupariṣṭā dvitānakaṃ | adhidevānāṃtu uppala parimāle sarveṣāṃ lokāpālānāṃ caṃdanaṃca vilepanaṃ | śatapatrāṇi puṣpāṇi dadyā gugguludhūpakaṃ | dīpaṃ goghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ naivedyaṃ ca ghṛto danaṃ | mātsye - prāgu ttareṇa tasmāccha dadhyakṣata vibhūṣitaṃ | cūtapalli vanaṃyuktaṃ phala vastrayugānvitaṃ || paṃcaratna samāyuktaṃ paṃcapallava saṃyutaṃ | sthāpayeda praṇaṃ kuṃbhaṃ varuṇaṃ tatravinyaset || gaṃgādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāḥ samudrāśca sarāṃsica | gajāśavarathyāvalmīka saṃgamāhṛda gokulāt || mṛdamānīya vipreṃdra sarvauṣadhi saminvitaṃ snānārthaṃ vinyase tatra yajamānasya dharmavit || yūjñavalkyaḥ || kartavyā maṃtravadbhiśca caravaḥ pratidevataṃ | nānādevatābhya ssahaiveti gṛhyasūtra vacanā tsahapṛdhagvāśrapayet || mātsyetu || homaṃ samārabhetsarpiryava vrīhitilādinā || hemādraudevīpurāṇe || gaṇādhipataye devāyā prathamā caturāhutiḥ | anyadhā viphalaṃ vipra bhavatīha nasaṃśayaḥ || yajñavalkyaḥ || arkaḥ phalāśaḥ khadiścāpāmārgothapippalaḥ || auduṃbara ścamīdūrvā kuśāśca samudhakramāt || ekaikasya tvaṣṭaśatamaṣṭāviṃśati revavā | homavyā madhusarpibhyāṃ dadhnākṣīreṇavāyutāḥ || prādeśamātrā ssamidaḥ āśākhā aphalāśanīḥ | devānāmapisarveṣā mupāṃśu paramārdhavit | svenasvenaiva maṃtreṇa hotavyā ssamidhaḥ pṛthat | hotavyaṃ ghṛtādyatra carubhakṣyādikaṃ tataḥ || skāṃde || sthāpanamaṃtrā eva homa maṃtrā uktāḥ | adhidevādīnāṃcaivaṃ || vāsiṣṭhepi || śeṣāṇāṃ sthāpanaṃ maṃtrairhomovyāhṛbhi stilaiḥ | mātsyetvadhidevādīnāṃ maṃtrā uktāḥ || āvorājetirudrasya baliṃ homaṃ samācaret | apohiṣṭhetyumāyāśca syonetisvāmisastathā || viṣṇoridaṃviṣṇuriti tameśeti svayaṃbhuvaḥ || tathāyamasyacāyaṃ gauriti homaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | kālasya brahmajijñāna miti maṃtraḥ praśasyate || citraguptasyacājñāna miti vedavido viduḥ | agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīma prakīrtitaḥ || bhūmeḥ pṛthivyaṃtarikṣa mitiproktaṃ maharṣibhiḥ | sahasraśīrṣā puruṣa iti viṣṇorudāhṛta || iṃdrāyoṃdo marutvāta iti śakrasyate | uttānaparṇesubhage iti śacyāḥ praśasyate || prajāpateḥ punarhemaḥ prajāpata iti smṛtaḥ || namo astu sarpebhya iti sarpāṇāṃ maṃtra ucyate || eṣabrahmaya ṛtvīya iti brahmaṇyudāhṛtaḥ | vināyakasyacātuna iti maṃtro budhaismṛtaḥ ||
