namaḥ oṃ mṛgāya namaḥ oṃ pitṛbhyo namaḥ eṣapāyasa balirnamama oṃ dauvārikāya namaḥ eṣapāyasa balirnamama oṃ sugrīvāya namaḥ oṃ puṣpadaṃtāya namaḥ oṃ varuṇāya namaḥ oṃ asurāya namaḥ oṃ śoṣāya namaḥ oṃ pāpāya namaḥ oṃ rogāya namaḥ oṃ āhnayai namaḥ oṃ mukhyāya namaḥ oṃ bhallāṭāye namaḥ oṃ somāya namaḥ oṃ sarvebhyo namaḥ oṃ ādityai namaḥ oṃ dityai namaḥ eṣapāyasa balirnamama eṣa pāyasa balirnamama || tataścarakādibhyaḥ māṣabhakta baliṃ dadyāt || oṃ carakyai namaḥ māṣabhakta baliṃ tsamarpayāmi oṃ vidāryai namaḥ oṃ pūtanāyai namaḥ oṃ pāparākṣanyai namaḥ oṃ skaṃdāyai namaḥ oṃ āryamṇ namaḥ oṃ jṛṃbhakāya namaḥ oṃ pilipiṃchāya namaḥ māṣabhakta baliṃ tsamarpayāmi || tataḥ pāvamānena rākṣoghnenaca sūktena maṃṭapaṃ peṣṭayet || oṃ pāpamānyaḥ punaṃtumā | prājāpatyaṃ pavitraṃ śatodyā magṃ hiraṇyayaṃ | tena brahya vidovayaṃ pūtaṃ brahmapūnīmahe | iṃdramsu nīti sahamā punātu somasvastyā varuṇa ssamīcyā | yamorājāḥ pramṛṇābhiḥ punātu | jātavedā mūrjayaṃtyā punātu || oṃ rakṣohaṇo valagahano vaiṣṇavānbhanāmīdamahaṃtaṃ valaga mudvāsāmi | yannansamāno yama samāno nicakhā nedamena madharaṃkaromi | yonassamāno nicakhā nedamena madharaṃkaromi | yonassamāno yosamānosrātī yati gāya treṇa chanda sāsvabāḍho valagaṃki matra bhadraṃ tannau sahavirāḍasi sapatnaha saṃrāḍasi bhratṛvya hasva - rāḍasyabhi mātihaviśvārāḍasi viśvāsāṃ nāṣṭrāṇāgṃ hantā || athadvārapūjāṃ kuryāt || tatrapūrvadvāre || ūrdvaṃ - śriyainaṃ śriyāmāvāyāmi || adhaḥ dehalyai namaḥ dehalī mavāhayāmi || vāma dakṣiṇa staṃbhayoḥ gaṇeśāya namaḥ - gaṇeśa māvāhayāmi | staṃdāya namaḥ skaṃda māvāhayāmi || takṣakalaśa dvayaṃ saṃsthāpya | gaṃgāyai namaḥ - yamunāyainamaḥ - gaṃgā yamunā māvāhayāmi || jalamāpūrya || dakṣiṇadvāre || ūrdvaṃ - śriyainamaḥ - devālyai namaḥ - staṃbhayoḥ puṣpadaṃtāya namaḥ - staṃbhayoḥ puṣpadaṃtāya namaḥ - kapardhine namaḥ || puṣpataṃtakapardni māvāhayāmi - kalaśadvayaṃ saṃsthāpya - godāvaryai namaḥ - kṛṣṇāyai namaḥ - jalamāpūrya || dakṣiṇadvāre || ūrdvaṃ - śriyainamaḥ - dehalai namaḥ - staṃbhayoḥ puṣpadaṃtāya namaḥ - kapardhine namaḥ || puṣpataṃtakapardni māvāhayāmi - kalaśadvayaṃ saṃsthāpya - godāvaryai namaḥ - kṛṣṇāyai namaḥ - jalamāpūrya || paścimadvāre || ūrdhvaṃ - śriyai namaḥ - dehalyai namaḥ - staṃbhayoḥ naṃdine namaḥ - caṃḍāya namaḥ - kalaśadvāye - revāyai namaḥ - narmadāyai namaḥ - revānarmadā māvāhayāmi - jalamāpūrva || uttaradvāre || ūrdhvaṃ - śriyainamaḥ adhaḥ dehalyai namaḥ - saṃbhayoḥ mavākālāya namaḥ - bhṛṃgiṇe namaḥ - kalaśadvaye - vāruṇya namaḥ - kṛṣṇaveṇyai namaḥ || jalamāpūrya || tata storaṇādi pūjāṃ kariṣye iti saṃkalpya || tatra pūrvasyāṃ diśi - maṃṭapādbahirhastamātre aśvaddhaṃ vaṭaṃvā sudṛḍaṃ śobhananāmakaṃvā śaṃkhacinihnitaṃ toraṇaṃnyasya - oṃ agnimīle purohitaṃ - sudṛḍha toraṇāya namaḥ - sudṛḍha toraṇaṃ āvāhayāmi - sudṛḍha toraṇāya namaḥ - gaṃdha - puṣpa - dhūpa - dīpa - naivedya - tābūla - dakṣiṇāṃtopacāraiḥ pūjayet || tatra rāhave namaḥ - rūhu āvāhayāmi - bṛhaspataye bṛhaspatiṃ āvāhayāmi - rāhu bṛhaspatibhyāṃ gaṃdhā dyupacārān samarpayet - tatraikaḥ kalaśaḥ sthāpya - tatra kalaśasthāna maṃbhāḥ || mahīṃdyauriti bhūmiṃ spṛṣṭvā || oṃ mahīṃ dyauḥ pṛthivīca imaṃ yajña mimikṣātāṃ pivṛtānno bharīmabhiḥ || bhūmiṃspṛśya || oṣadhayassaṃ vadaṃta iti yavān nikṣipya || oṃ - oṣadha yassaṃ vadaṃte somena saha rājña yasmai karoti brāhmaṇa stagṃ rājan pārayāsi || akalaśeti kalaśaṃ saṃsthāpya || oṃ ākalaśeṣudhāvati pavitre pariṣicyate ukdairyagye vardhate || imaṃmme gaṃge iti jalenāpūrya | oṃ imaṃmme gaṃge yamune sarasvati śrutidristomagṃ sacatāpa ṛṣṇiyā āsikniyā marudvṛdhe vitantayārjīkiyeśṛṇūhyasuṣomayā ||gaṃdhadvārāmiti gaṃdhaṃ kṣiptyā || oṃ gaṃdhadvārāṃ durādharṣāṃ nityapuṣṭhāṃkarīṣiṇīṃ īśvarīgṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tāmihopahvayeśriyaṃ || oṣadhayaḥ samitiyavān || oṃ oṣadhaya ssaṃvadaṃtesomena saharājñā yasmai karoti brāhmaṇastagṃ rājan pārayāmasi || kāṃḍātkāṃḍāditi dūrvāḥ || oṃ kāṃḍātkāṃḍātprarohaṃti paruṣaḥ paruṣaḥ pari evānodūrve pratanu sahasreṇa śatenaca || aśvaddeva iti paṃca pallavān || oṃ aśvaddevo niṣadhanaṃ parṇevo vasatiḥ kṛtā gobhāya itkilā sadhayatsanavadha pūruṣaṃ || syonā pṛthinīrita phalaṃ || oṃ yāḥ phalinīryā aphalā apuṣpāyāśca puṣpiṇīḥ bṛgaspatiḥ prasūtāstāno muṃcaṃtvagṃ hanaḥ || sahiratnā nīti paṃcaratnāni || oṃ sahiratnāni dāsuṣesuvāti savitābhagaḥ | taṃ bhāgaṃ citramīmahe || hiraṇyarūpa iti hiraṇyaṃ || oṃ hiraṇyarūpa ssahiraṇya saṃdṛgannapātsetu hiraṇya varṇaḥ hiraṇya yātpariyonerniṣadyā hiraṇyadāda dadyannamasmai || yuvāsu vāsā ita vastreṇa sūtreṇa vāmukhe veṣṭhayet || oṃ yuvāsu vāsāḥ parivītāgāstsautsryan bhavati jāyamānaḥ taṃ dhīrāsaḥ kavaya unnayaṃti svādayā manasā deva yaṃtaḥ || pūrṇādarvītyu paridhānya pūrṇa pātraṃ nyaset || oṃ pūrṇā darvī parāpatasupūrṇā punarāpata | vaśriva vakrīṇāvaha iṣamūrjagṃ śatakrato || oṃ kalaśe dhṛvāya namaḥ - dṛvamāvāhayāmi - daṃdhādyupacārān tsamarpayāmi || tato gakṣiṇe gatvā || auduṃbaraṃ plakṣaṃvā subhadraṃ vikaṭa nāmakaṃvā cakra cihnitaṃ toraṇaṃnyasya - oṃ iṣetvorjetvā vāyavastho pāyavastha devovaḥ savitā prārpayatu śreṣṭhata māyakarmaṇe || subhadratoraṇāya namaḥ - āvāhanā dyupacārān - gaṃdhādi paṃṭopacārān tsamarpayāmi || tatra sūryāya namaḥ - āvāhayāmi || aṃgārakāya namaḥ - aṃgāraka māvāhayāmi || sūryāṃgārakābhyāṃ namaḥ - gaṃdhādyupacārān tsamarpayāmi || tatra ekaḥ kalaśyaṃ sthāpya tasminṃlaśe - dharāya namaḥ - darā māvāhayāmi gaṃdhādyupacārān tsamarpayāmi || tataḥ paścime gatvā - pūrvavatu kalaśāni plakṣa mauduṃbaraṃ vāsukarma sukhīma nāmakaṃ vāgadācihnitaṃ toraṇanyanya - oṃ agna āyāhivātaye gṛṇāno havyadātayeni hotātsatsibarhiṣi || sukarmatoraṇāya namaḥ - sukarma toraṇaṃ āvāhayāmi - gaṃdhādyupacārān tsamarpayāmi || tatra śukrāya śukraṃ - āvāhayāmi || budhāya budhaṃ āvāhayāmi - śukra budhvābyānnamaḥ - gaṃdhādi paṃcopacārān tsamarpayāmi || tataḥ uttare gatvā || vaṭa māśvataṃvā palāśaṃ vāsuhotraṃ suprabhaṃvā padma cihnitaṃ toraṇaṃ nyasya || oṃ śannodevi rabiṣṭhaya āpo bhavaṃtu pītayośaṃyo ribhisravaṃtunaḥ || suhotra toraṇāya namaḥ - suhotra toraṇaṃ āvāhayāmi - gaṃdhādyupacārān tsamarpayāmi || tatra somāya namaḥ - soma māvāhayāmi ketave namaḥ - ketu māvāhayāmi śanaiścarāya namaḥ - śanaiścara māvāhayāmi somaketuśanaiścarebhyonamaḥ - gaṃdhādyupacārān tsamarpayāmi tatraikaḥ kalaśaḥ sthāpyaḥ || tasmin kalaśe vighneśāya namaḥ gaṃdhādi paṃcopacārān tsamarpayāmi tataḥ pūrve gatvā vasmahīdyau ritrādinā prati dvāra śākhaṃ kalaśadvayaṃ saṃsthāpya pratikalaśaṃ maṃtrāvṛtiḥ || asmin kalaśadvāye airāvatākhya diggajāya namaḥ airāvatākhya diggajaṃ āvāhya - airāvatākhya diggajāya namaḥ - gaṃdhā dyupacārān tpamarpayāmi || tatra ṛgvedinā vṛtijā || ṛgvedaḥ padmapatrākṣo gāyatryaḥ soma devataḥ || atri gotrastaṃ vipreṃdra ṛtviktvaṃme makhe bhaveti pratyekaṃ vṛtvā || maṃ|| oṃ agni mīle purohitaṃ majñasyadevamṛtvijaṃ hotāraṃ ratnadhātamaṃ - gaṃdhā dyupacāraiḥ pūjayet || dhyānaṃ || tataḥ sahasrākṣa mairāvata saṃsthitaṃ pīta kirīṭinaṃ kuṃḍaladharaṃ dakṣiṇa vāmakarastha vajrotpala miṃdraṃ dhyātyā || ehyehi sarvāmara siddhasāddy rabhiṣṭato vajradarā mareśa | saṃvājya manosapsara sāṃgaṇena rakṣādhvaraṃno bhagannamaste || bho iṃdra ihagacca ihatiṣṭha iṃdraṃ sāṃgaṃ saparivāraṃ | sāyudhaṃ saśaktiṃ, dvāra kalaśe āvāhayāmi || maṃ || oṃ trātāra mindra mavitāra minrdagṃ havehave suhavagṃ śūramindraṃ | huvesu śukraṃ puruhuta mindragṃ svastino maṣu vādhātvindraḥ || iṃdrāya namaḥ dhvaja patākepari āvāhayāmi gaṃdhādyupacārān tsamarpayāmi || dhyānaṃ || iṃdraḥ surapati śreṣṭho vajrahasto mahabalaḥ | śata yajñādhipo deva stasmai nityaṃ namo namaḥ || iti namaskāraṃ kuryāt || iṃdrāya sāṃgāya saparivārāya sāyudāya savāhanāyamayā samarpita sadīpadhadiyakta māṣabiliṃ bhakṣvayajña samāpti paryaṃtaṃ yajamāna sahita ācāryādi ṛtvik brāhmaṇa arcaka pācakādīnāṃ rakṣa rakṣa iti satvāmet || tataḥ agneyāṃgatvā tatra pūrvavat kalaśaṃ saṃsthāpya tatra puṃḍarīkāya namaḥ āvāhayāmi - amṛtāya amṛta mavāhayāmi | puṃḍarīkaḥ amṛtābhyāṃ gaṃdhādyupacārān tsamarpayāmi || anaṃtaraṃ || dhyānaṃ || bhāgasthaṃ raktavarṇaṃ dakṣiṇa vāmakaradvaya dṛtaśakti maṃḍaluṃ yajñopavītinaṃ dhyātvā || ehyhi sarvāmarahavyavāha muni pravarai rabhitobhijuṣṭa | tojovatāloka gaṇeśasārthaṃ mamādhvāraṃ pāhinamo namaste || bhoagn ihagacca ihatiṣṭa agniṃ sāṃgaṃ sapari vāraṃ sāyudaṃ saśaktiṃ asmin kalaśe āvāha yāmi - gaṃdhādyupa cārān tsamarpayāmi || maṃ|| oṃ - agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmah hotāraṃ viśvavedasaṃ - asya yajñasya sukratuṃ || iti maṃtreṇa - raktapatākaṃ - raktadhvajaṃ cocchrayot || tataṃ - tvaṃnno agne varuṇasya vidvān devasyahḍova yāsisīṣṭhāḥ || yajiṣṭho vahni tamaśśośucāno viśvā dveṣāgṃsi pramumugdhyasmat || agnaye namaḥ - agnaye dhvaja patākopari āvāhayāmi | agnaye namaḥ gaṃgādyupacārān tsamarpayāmi || dhyānaṃ || agnyaḥ puruṣoraktaḥ sarvadevamayovyayaḥ | dhūmraketū rajodhyakṣa stastm nityaṃ namo namaḥ iti satvā || agneye sāṃgāya saparivārāya sāyudāyasa śaktikāya mayā samarpita sadī padadhīmāṣa bhakta baliṃ bhakṣa yajñarakṣa - yajamānasahita ācāryādi ṛtvik brāhmaṇa arcaka pācakādīnāṃ rakṣa rakṣa iti natvā ācāyet || tato dakṣiṇegatvā prati dvāraśākhaṃ kalaśadvayaṃ saṃsthāpya tatra kalaśadvaye, vāmanākhyadiggajāya namaḥ - vāmanākhyādiggaja māvāhayāmi || vāmanākhyadiggajāya namaḥ gaṃdhādyupacārān tsamarpayāmi - tatra yajurvedināvṛtvijā asmin dakṣiṇadvāre śāṃtisūkta japārdhetvā mahaṃvṛṇe || kātarākṣoyajurveda straiṣṭubho viṣṇudaivataḥ | kāśyapeyastu vipreṃdra ṛtviktaṃ memakhe bhavati | pratyekaṃ vṛtvā || maṃ|| oṃ ikṣetvorjetvā vāyavasthopāyastha devāva sosavitā prārpayatu śreṣṭhata māyakarmaṇa apyāya madhva magniyā devabhāgamūrjasvatīḥ payasvatī rasamīnā ayakṣmā māvastena śatamāghaśagṃso rudrasya hetiḥ parivovṛṇaktudhṛvā asmin gopatausyāta bahviryaja mānanya paśūn pāhi || iti pyatyekaṃ gaṃdhādibhirabhyarca || tato mahiṣārūḍhaṃ dhṛtadaṃḍapāśaṃ dakṣiṇa vāmakaradvayaṃ kṛṣṇāṃjanacayopamaṃ agni samalocanaṃ yamaṃ dhyātvā || dhyānaṃ || ehyehi vaivasvata dharmarāja sarvāmarai rarcita dharmamūrte | śubhānaṃda śucāmadhīśa śivāya namaḥ pāhi makhaṃ namaste || bhoyama iha gaccha iha tiṣṭha yamaṃ sāṃgaṃ - saparivāraṃ sāyudhaṃ saśaktiṃdvāra kalaśe āvāhayāmi | gaṃdhādyupacārān tsamarpayāmi || tatra maṃtraḥ || maṃ|| oṃ āyaṃ gauḥ pṛśni rakramī daśananmātaraṃ punaḥ pitaraṃ ca prayaṃtsuvaḥ || iti maṃtreṇa kṛṣṇāṃ patākāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dhvajaṃ cocchra yet || tato maṃ|| oṃ sugannaḥ paṃthā mabhayaṃkṛṇotu | yasminnakṣatreyami yajñesmin pūjaye pratigṛhyatāṃ || yamāya namaḥ mayā samarpita sadīpa dadhiyukta māṣabaliṃ bhakṣa yajamāna sahita ācārya - ṛtvik brāhmaṇa arcaka pācaka ācāryadīnāṃ rakṣa rakṣa || iti satvā || ācāyet || tato nai ṛtyāṃgatvā tatra pūrvavat kalaśaṃ saṃsthāpya tatra kumudāya namaḥ - durjayāyanamaḥ - durjayakumuda māvāhayāmi || kumuda durjayābhyāṃ gaṃdhādyupacārān tsamarpayāmi || dhyānaṃ || tataḥ narārūḍhaṃ mahākāyaṃ khaḍgahastaṃ mahābalaṃ rākṣapai rveṣṭitaṃ nīlaṃ pītābharaṇabhūṣitaṃ || iti nipṛtiṃdhyātvā || ehyehirakṣo gaṇanāyakatvāṃ viśāla bhetāla piṣāca saṃghaiḥ | mamādhvaraṃ pāhi piśācanādha lokeśvaratvaṃ bhagavannamaste || bho nirṛtaye ihagaccha iha tiṣṭha niṛrutiṃ asmin kalaśe āvāhayāmi | gaṃdhādyupacārān tsamarpayāmi || meṣaṇaḥ iti maṃtreṇa nīlāṃ patākāṃ dhva jaṃcocchrayet || maṃ || oṃ moṣamaḥ parāparā viṛrutir dhṛvaṇāvatīt patīkṣṇa tṛṣṇayā saha || nirurutaye dhvaja patākopari āvāhayāmi || maṃ || oṃ anunvaṃtama yajamāna muccanainasyetyāṃ taskarasyānveṣi anyamasmadicchasāta ityā namo devī nirurute tubhyamastu || nirurutaye namaḥ gaṃdhādyupacārān tsamarpayāmi || maṃ || oṃ meṣaṇaḥ parāparā niṛrutir dhṛpaṇāvatīt patīkṣṇa tṛṣṇayā anyamasmadicchasāta itayā namo devī nirurute tubhyamastu || nirurutaye namaḥ gaṃdhādyupacārān tsamarpayāmi || dhyānaṃ || nirurutiṃ khañgahastaṃca sarvalokaika pāvanaṃ | āvāhayāmi yajñesmin pūjeyaṃ pratigṛhyaṃtāṃ || iti natvā || nirṛtaye sāṃgāya saparivārāya savāhanāya saśaktikāya mayā samarpita sadīpa dadhiyukta māṣabaliṃ bhakṣa - yajamānasahita ācārya ṛtvik brāhmaṇa arcaka pācaka ācāryādīnāṃ rakṣa rakṣa - iti satvā ācāmet || tataḥ paścimegatvā kalaśadvayaṃ prati dvāraśākhaṃ pūrvavat saṃsthāpya asman kalaśadvāye - aṃjanākhya diggajāya namaḥ - kalaśe aṃjanākhya diggaja māvāhayāmi - aṃjanākhya diggajāya namaḥ - gaṃdhādyupacārān tsamarpayāmi | tatra sāmavedinā pṛtvijā | asmin paścimadvāre śāṃtisū ktajapārdaṃ tvāṃ vṛṇe || sāmavedastu piṃgākṣojāgrataḥ śakradaivataḥ bhāradvājastu vipreṃdra ṛtviktvaṃ memakhe bhaveti pratyekaṃ vṛtvā || maṃ || oṃ agnaāyāhivītaye gṛṇāno havyadātaye nihotā tsatsi barhiṣi | iti maṃtreṇa pratyakaṃ gaṃdhādyupacāraiḥ pūjayet || tato makarasthaṃ pāśahastaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ kirīṭadhāriṇaṃ dhyātvā || dhyānaṃ || yehyehiyādo gaṇavāradhīnāṃ gaṇeśa parjanyasahapsarobhiḥ | vidyādhareṃdrāmaragīyamāna pāhi tvamasān bhagavannamaste || bhovaruṇaṃ sāṃgaṃ sāyudhaṃ saśaktiṃ saparivāraṃ dvārakalaśe āvahayāmi || maṃ || oṃ imaṃmmevaruṇaśṛdhīha hamadyā ca mṛḍayātvā mavasyurācake || iti maṃtreṇa śvetaṃ patākāṃ śvetadhvajaṃ cocchrayet || maṃ || oṃ - tatvāyāmi brahmaṇāvaṃdamāna stadāśāsteyajamāne havirbhiḥ | āheḍamāno varuṇehabodhyuruśagṃ samāna āyuḥ pramoṣīḥ || varuṇāya namaḥ | dhvajapatākasyopari āvāhayāmi || gaṃdhādyupacārān tsamarpayāmi || dhyānaṃ || pāśahastaṃ ca varuṇamarṇasāṃ pati mīśvaraṃ āvāhayāmi yajñesmin pūjeyaṃ pratigṛhyatāṃ || iti dhyātvā || varuṇāya sāṃgāya saparivārāya savāhanāya saśaktikāya mayā samarpita sadīpa dadhiyu ktamāṣa bhaktalabaliṃ bhakṣa yajamāna sahita ācārya ṛtvik brāhmaṇa arcaka pācakādīnāṃ rakṣa rakṣa || iti natvā || ācāmet || vāyavyāṃ gatvā pūrvavatkalaśaṃ saṃsthāpya tatra puṣpadaṃtāya namaḥ siddhārdhāya namaḥ asmin kalaśe āvāhayāmi || puṣpadaṃta siddhārdhāya namaḥ - gaṃdhādyupacārān tsamarpayāmi | tato mṛgādhirūḍhaṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ citrāṃbaradharaṃ yuvānaṃ varadhvajadharaṃ dakṣiṇa vāmahasta dvayaṃ vāyuṃ dhyātvā || ehyehiyajñe mamarakṣaṇāya mṛgādirūḍhaḥ sahasiddhasaṃghaiḥ | prāṇādhipaḥ kālakaveḥ sahāya gṛhaṇa pūjāṃ bhagavannamaste | bhovāyave iha gaccha iha tuṣṭha vāyave namaḥ sāṃgāya saparivārāya sāyudāya saśaktikāya kasaśe āvāhayāmi gaṃdhādyupacārān tsamarpayāmi || vāyośataṃ harīṇāṃ yuvasyapoṣyāṇāṃ utavāte sahasriṇo radha āyātupājasā || iti maṃtreṇa dhūmrapatākāṃ dhūmradhvajaṃ cocchrayet || maṃ || oṃ tavavāya vṛttaspate tvaṣṭurūjā mātaradbutā āvāsyāṃ vṛṇīmahe || vāyave namaḥ dhvajapatākopari āvāhayāmi - gaṃdhādyupacārān tsamarpayāmi || vāyu mākāśagaṃcaiva pavavaṃ vegavadgatiṃ | āvāhayāmi yajñesnin pūjeyaṃ prati gṛhyatām | ānākāromahaujāśca yaścādṛṣṭagatirdani | tasmai pūjyāya jagato vāyavehaṃ samāvicet || iti satvā || vāyave namaḥ sāṃgāya saparivārāya savāhanāya saśaktikāya mayā samarpita sadīpa dadhiyu ktamāṣa baliṃ bhakṣa mama yajamāna sahita ācārya ṛtvik brāhmaṇa arcaka pācakā dīnāṃ rakṣa rakṣa || iti satvā || ācāyet || tataḥ uttaradvāraṃ gatvā - uttaradvāre kalaśadvayaṃ prati dvāraśākhaṃ saṃsthāpya tatra kalaśadvaye sārvabhauma diggaja māvāhayāmi - gaṃdhādyupacārān tsamarsayāmi || tatra adharvavedivāvṛtvijā || asmin uttaradvāre śāṃtisūkta japārdhaṃtvā mahaṃpṛṇe || bṛhannetrodharva vedonuṣṭu bho rudradaivataḥ | vaiśaṃpāyana vipreṃdra ṛtviktaṃme makhe bhaveti || pratyekaṃ vṛtvā || maṃ || oṃ śannodevi rabhiṣṭaya āpobhavaṃtu pītayeśśaṃyo rabhisravaṃtunaḥ || iti maṃtreṇa pratyekaṃ gaṃdhādyuvacāraiḥ pūjayet || tato narayuta vimānasthaṃ kuṃḍala hārakeyura ruciravara gadādhara dakṣiṇa vāmabhujadvayaṃ makuṭimaṃ mahodaraṃ mahākāyaṃ haritavarṇaṃ kuberaṃ dhyātvā || dhyānaṃ || ehyehi yajñeśvara yajñarakṣārthaṃ vidhaksva nakṣatra gaṇena sārdhaṃ | sarvauṣadhībhiḥ pitṛbhissahaiva gṛhama pūjāṃ bhagavannamaste || bhosoma iha gacca iha tiṣṭha mama pūjāṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇadvāra kalaśe āvāhayāmi ṣaṣa maṃ || oṃ āpyāyasva sametute viśvatassomavṛṣṭiyaṃ bhavāvājasya saṃgadhe | iti maṃtreṇa huritāṃ patākāṃ haritaṃ dhvajaṃ cocchruyot || maṃ || oṃ somodhenagṃ somo arvaṃta māśuṃ somo vīraṃ karmaṇyaṃ dadātu sādanyaṃ vidatyagṃ sapheyaṃ pituśravaṇaṃyo dadāsa tasmai || somāya namaḥ dhvajapatākopari āvāhayāmi | gaṃdhādyupacārān tsamarpayāmi || sarva nakṣatramadhyetu somerājā vyavasthitaḥ | tasmai somāya devāya nakṣatra pataye namaḥ | iti natvā | somāya sāṃgāya saparivārāya sahavānāya saśaktikāya mayā samarpita sadīpa dadhiyukta māṣa baliṃ samarpayāmi | bho somāya baliṃ bhakṣa yajñaṃ rakṣa yajamānāsahita ācārya ṛtvik brāhmaṇa arcaka pācakanāṃ rakṣa rakṣa - ācāmet || tataḥ īśānyāṃ gatvā tatra pūrva vatkalaśaṃ saṃsthāpya tatra supratīkāya namaḥ - supratīkaṃ āvāhayāmi - maṃgalāya maṃgala daivata māvāhayāmi | supratīka maṃgalābhyāṃ namaḥ - gaṃdhādyupacārān tsamarpayāmi || tato vaṣārūḍaṃ dakṣiṇavāmahantayorvara triśūladharaṃ trinetraṃ śuklavarṇaṃ īśānaṃ dhyātyā || dhyānaṃ || ehyehi viśveśvara satri śūlaka pāla khaṭvārigadhareṇa sārdhaṃ | lokena yajñeśvara yajñasiddy gṛhaṇa pūjāṃ bhagavannamaste || bho iśānahagacca iha tiṣṭha mama pūjāṃ gṛhma gṛhṇa kalaśe īśāna māvāhayāmi || maṃ || oṃ abitvā deva savitarīśānaṃ vāryāṇām sadāvanbhāga mīma he iti maṃtreṇa śveta patākāṃ śvetadvajaṃ cocchrayet stamīśānaṃ jagatasthasthu caṣpatiṃ dhiyaṃ jinvamavasehu mahevayaṃ | pūṣāṇoyadhā veda sāmasadvṛdhe rakṣitāpāya rarabdhasvastaye || īśānāya namaḥ dhva japa patākopari āvāhayāmi || gaṃdhā dyupacārān tsamarpayāmi || vṛṣaskaṃdha samārūḍaṃ śūlahastaṃ trilocanaṃ āvāhayāmi yajñesmin pūjeyaṃ pratigṛhyatāṃ | sarvādhipo mahādeva īśvaraḥ śūlapāṇi rvipūṣākṣa | stasmai nityaṃ namo namaḥ || itinatvā || bho īśānāya sāṃgāya saparivārāya sāyadhāya savāhanāya saśaktikāya mayā samarpita sadīpa dadhiyukta māṣa baliṃ samarpayāmi || bho īśānāya baliṃbhakṣa yajñarakṣa yajamāna sahita ācārya ṛtvik brāhmaṇa arcaka pācaka ācāryādīn rakṣa rakṣa itiha satvā || ācāyot || tataḥ īśāna pūrvayormadhye ādaḥ uddiśya || anaṃtaśayanā sīnaṃ phaṇāsaptaka maṃḍitaṃ | padma śaṃkhadarodvārdho dakṣiṇaṃ ca garadvāyaṃ | cakra gadādara dakṣiṇa vāma karadvayaṃ nīlavarṇa manaṃtaṃ dhyātvā | ehyehi pātāla dharāmareṃdra nāgāṃganā kinnara gīyamāna | yakṣokarageṃdrā suraloka saṃghai ranaṃta rakṣādhvāra masmadīyaṃ || bho anaṃta ihagaccha ihatiṣṭha anaṃtataṃ sāṃgaṃ sāyudhaṃ saparivāraṃ naśakti sahitaṃ anaṃta māvāhayāmi || maṃ || oṃ āyaṃgauḥ puśnirakramīda sananmātaraṃ punaḥ pitaraṃ ca prayaṃtsuvaḥ || iti maṃtreṇa śvetāṃ patākāṃ śvetaṃ dhvajaṃ coccrayet || oṃ namo astu sarvebhyo yekeca pṛthivī manuye aṃtarikṣeyedivitebhya sarvebhyo namaḥ - anaṃtāya namaḥ patāka dhvajasyopari āvāhayāmi | gaṃdhā dyupacārān tsamarnayāmi | yosā va saṃta rūpeṇa brahmāṃḍaṃ sacarācaraṃ | puṣpavaddārayan mūrdhani tasmai nityaṃ namo namaḥ | bho anaṃtāya sāṃgāya savāhanāya saparivārāya saśaktikāya mayā samarpita sadīpadidhiyukta māṣabaliṃ samarpayāmi | bho anaṃtāya baliṃ bhakṣa yajña rakṣa yajamāna sahita ācāryādi ṛtvik brāhmaṇa arcaka pācakādīnāṃ rakṣa rakṣa || itinatvā ācāyet || tato nairuti paścimayormadhye ūrdhva muddiśya || akṣasūtra kuśamuṣṭidharodhvān dhoḍakṣikaraṃ sruvaka maṃḍaludharordvādho vāmakaradvāyaṃ caturmukhaṃ śmaśṛjaṭilaṃ laṃbodharaṃ raktavarṇaṃ brahmaṇaṃdhyātvā || oṃ ehyehi sarvādhipate sureṃdra lokena sārdhaṃ pitṛdevātābhi || sarvasya dātāhyamita prabhāvo viśvādaraṃ naḥ satataṃ śivāya || bho brahmannihagacca ihatiṣṭha brahmaṇaṃ sāṃgaṃ saparivāraṃ sāyudhaṃ savāhasaṃ saśakti sametaṃ āvāhayāmi || maṃ || oṃ brahma jijñānaṃ pradamaṃ purastādvi śīmato suracovena avāha - saḍaudhniyā upamā asyaviśṭhā tsataścayo namisadaścavivaḥ || iti maṃtreṇa raktaṃ patākāṃ rakta dhvajaṃ coccrayet || maṃ || oṃ brahma devānāṃ padavīḥ kavīnā mṛṣirvi prāṇāṃ mahiṣo mṛgāṇāṃ syeno gṛdhrāṇā gusvaditirva nānāgṃ somaḥ savitra martyetirebhan ici rudrayāvile - caṃḍīkalpe || brahmaṇe namaḥ patāradvajo paribrahmaṇa māvāhayāmi | gaṃdhā dyupacārān tsamarpayāmi || dhyānaṃ || padmayoniścatu rmūrtir vedāvāsaḥ ritāmahaḥ yajñādyakṣa ścaturvāktrastasmai nityaka namo namaḥ || iti natvā || brahmaṇe sāṃgāya saparivārāya savāhanāya saśaktikāya mayāsamarpita sadīpa dadimāṣa bhakta baliṃ tsamarpayāmi || bho brahmaṇe namaḥ baliṃ bhakṣa yajñaṃ rakṣa yajamāna sameta ācārya ṛtvik brāhmaṇa arcaka pācaka ācāryadīnāṃ rakṣa rakṣa || iti natvā || mamaskāraṃ kuryāt || ācāmet || tato maṃṭapamadhye tyuccadaṃḍo daśahastadīrgho trihastavistṛto vicitravarṇaḥ || maṃ || oṃ iṃdrasya vṛṣṇo varuṇasya rājñā ādityānāṃ marutāgṃ śardhaugraṃ mahamanasāṃ bhuvanacyavānāṃ ghoṣo devānāṃ jayatāmugdhyanmat || iti maṃtreṇa sthāpya || oṃ brahma jijñānaṃvaḥ || brahmaṇenamaḥ gaṃdhyādupacārān tsamarpayāmi || tato maṃṭapaṣoḍaśa staṃbheṣu sarvebhyo devebhyo namaḥ || vaṃśeṣu kinnarobhyo namaḥ | pṛṣṭhe pannagebhyo namaḥ | iti pūjayet | tataḥ pūrvasyāṃ diśi maṃṭapādbahiḥ kiṃcidbhūmi mupalipya - tatropaviśya || trailokyeyāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi ca rāṇi ca | brahma viṣṇu śśivaissārthaṃ rakṣāṃ kurvāṃtu tānime | deva dānava saṃva gaṃdharvā yakṣa rākṣasa pannagāḥ | ṛṣayo munayogāvo devamātara rrudaśca kṣetrapālo gaṇessaha | rakṣaṃtu maṃṭapaṃ sarveghnaṃtu rakṣāṃsi sarvataḥ | trailokya sthaibhyaḥ sthāvarebhyo bhūtebhyo namaḥ | trailokyasthāni sthāvarāṇi bhūtānyāmavā || oṃ brahmaṇe namaḥ - brahmaṇaṃ āvāhayāmi namaḥ - gaṃdhādi paṃcopacārān tsamarpayāmi oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ - viṣṇuṃ āvāhayāmi namaḥ - gaṃdhādi paṃcopacārān tsamarpayāmi oṃ śivāya namaḥ - śivaṃ āvāhayāmi namaḥ - gaṃdhādi paṃcopacārān tsamarpayāmi oṃ devebhyo namaḥ - devān āvāhayāmi namaḥ - gaṃdhādi paṃcopacārān tsamarpayāmi oṃ dānavebhyo namaḥ - dānavān āvāhayāmi namaḥ - gaṃdhādi paṃcopacārān tsamarpayāmi oṃ gaṃdharvebhyo namaḥ - gaṃdharvān āvāhayāmi namaḥ - gaṃdhādi paṃcopacārān tsamarpayāmi oṃ yakṣebhyo namaḥ - yakṣān āvāhayāmi namaḥ - gaṃdhādi paṃcopacārān tsamarpayāmi oṃ rākṣasebhyo namaḥ - rākṣasān āvāhayāmi namaḥ - gaṃdhādi paṃcopacārān tsamarpayāmi oṃ pannagebhyo namaḥ - pannagān āvāhayāmi namaḥ - gaṃdhādi paṃcopacārān tsamarpayāmi oṃ gobhyonamaḥ - gāḥ āvāhayāmi namaḥ - gaṃdhādi paṃcopacārān tsamarpayāmi oṃ ṛṣibhyo namaḥ - ṛṣīn āvāhayāmi namaḥ - gaṃdhādi paṃcopacārān tsamarpayāmi oṃ manuṣyebhyo namaḥ - manuṣyān āvāhayāmi namaḥ - gaṃdhādi paṃcopacārān tsamarpayāmi oṃ devāmātṛbhyo namaḥ - devamātṛ ityāvāhya gaṃdhādi paṃcopacārān tsamaprayāmi || pratyekaṃ māṣa bhaktabalīn dadyāt || tato yajamānaḥ sācāryatvin kprakṣālita pāṇipāda ācāṃtaḥ | prāk‌dvāre maṃṭapaṃ praveśayet || yajamānognyāyatanā ddakṣiṇata upaviśet | ācāryastukuṃḍa paścimataḥ upaviśyācamya praṇāvāyamyā āmuka karmaṇyagnipratiṣṭhā kariṣye | iti saṃkalpya || guruṃ gaṇapatiṃ ca natvā || mūlena nirīkṣya phaḍiti sāmānyārghodakeva saṃprokṣya saṃprokṣya - kuśena tāḍayitvā - humityavakuṃṭya - sthaṃḍilopari madhyama dakṣiṇo ttareṣu krameṇa prāgagrāstisrorekhālikhitvā | tadupari madhyama paścimapūrveṣu udagagrā stisrorekhālikhitvā | tāsurekhāsu ullekhakrameṇa oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ aiṃ klīṃ sauḥ brahmaṇe namaḥ yamāya namaḥ - somāya namaḥ - rudrāyā namaḥ - viṣṇave namaḥ || iṃdrāya namaḥ - ityabhyarcayet | tataḥ svadehi ṣaḍaṃganyānaṃ kuryāt yadhā | asya śrī vaiśvānara mahāmaṃtrasya bhṛguṛṣiḥ - daivīgāyatrī chaṃdaḥ - śrī vaiśvānaro devatā - raṃ bījaṃ - svāhāśaktiḥ - jātaveda iti kīlakaṃ amukahome amukasiddhyardhe viniyogaḥ | oṃ rāṃ sahasrārciṣe hṛdayāya namaḥ oṃ rīṃ svastipūrṇāya śirase svāhā oṃ rūṃ uttiṣṭha puruṣāya śikhāyaivaṣaṭ oṃ raiṃ dhūmavyāpine kavacāya huṃ oṃ rauṃ saptajihvāya netratrayāya vauṣaṭ oṃ raḥ dhanurdharāya hastrāya phaṭ || adha jihvānyāsaḥ || oṃ sryuṃ hiraṇyāyai namaḥ guhye - oṃ ṣyūṃ gaganāyai namaḥ pāyau - oṃ śryuṃ raktāyai namaḥ śirasi - oṃ vryūṃ kṛṣṇāyai namaḥ vaktr - oṃ tryāṃ suprabhāyai namaḥ nāsikāyoḥ - oṃ rryuṃ ataraktāyai namaḥ netratrayoḥ - oṃ yryūṃ bahurūpāyai sarvāṃge || adhāṣṭamūrtinyāsaḥ || oṃ agnaye jānavedase namaḥ mūrthni | oṃ agnaye saptajihvāya namaḥ dakṣāṃse | oṃ agnaye havya vāhanāya namaḥ dakṣapārśve | oṃ agnaye aśvodarāya namaḥ dakṣakaṭyāṃ | oṃ agnaye vaiśvānarāya namaḥ guhye | oṃ agnaye kaumāratejase namaḥ vāmakaṭyāṃ | oṃ agnaye vaiśvānarāya namaḥ guhye | oṃ agnaye kaumāratejase namaḥ vāmakaṭyāṃ | oṃ agnaye viśvamukhāya namaḥ vāmapārśve | oṃ agnayo devamukhāya namaḥ vāmāṃse | oṃ agnaye agnyāsanāya namaḥ sarvāṃge || hṛdayāgne rmūrtiṃ vibhāvyā || ṣaḍaṃgena āgneśāsuravāyukoṇeṣu madhye dikṣuca sdhaṃḍilamabhyarca tatrāṣṭakoṇa ṣaṭkoṇa trikoṇātmaka magnicakraṃ praveśarītyā vilikhyaḥ || biṃdutrikoṇa saṃyuktaṃ ṣaṭkoṇāṃcāṣṭapatrakaṃ bhūpurema yutaṃ yaṃtraṃ vaiśvānaramitīritaṃ || iti vaiśvānara yaṃtraṃ agnimukhe vibhāvya - trikoṇe digaṣṭakaṃ vibhāvya | tatra svāgrādi prādakṣiṇyena dikṣumadhyeca kramāt || oṃ pītāyai namaḥ oṃ śvetāyainamaḥ | oṃ āruṇāyai namaḥ | oṃ kṛṣṇāyai namaḥ | oṃ dhūmrāyai namaḥ | oṃ jvālinyai namaḥ | oṃ raṃ sarvaśakti kamālāsanāya namaḥ | iti pīṭhaśaktiṃ samarcayet || tataḥ pīṭhamadhye oṃ taṃ tamase namaḥ | oṃ raṃ rajase namaḥ | oṃ saṃ satvāya namaḥ | oṃ āṃ ātmane namaḥ | oṃ paṃ paramātmane namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ jñānātmane namaḥ || tataḥ - trikoṇe oṃ hrīṃ vāgīśvarībhyā namaḥ | iti maṃtreṇa janiṣya māṇasya vahneḥ pitarau vāgīśvarī vāgīśvarau saṃbapūjya | tayormidunībhāvaṃ bhāvayitvā | araṇḥ sūryakāṃtadvā vahni mutpādya dvijagṛhadvā ānīya mṛtpātre tāmrapātevā agniṃ sthaṃḍivādbahiḥ agneyāṃ āśanyāṃ nai ṛtvāṃvā diśinidāya | tasmātkravyādaṃśa mekamagniṃ śalakaṃ phaṭ iti astramaṃtreṇa naiṛtvāṃ nipasya | agniṃ mūlena nirīkṣya | prokṣyaca astreṇa kuśaistāḍayitvā - kavacenā vakuṃṭhya | dhenuyeni mudrāṃ pradarśya | oṃ raṃ vaiśvanarajātaveda ihavahaṃ lohitākṣa sarvākarmāṇi nirgamayitaṃ vāgīśvarī bījanya vāgīśvarī yonyāṃ praveśa budhyā bāhyagnau saṃyojayet || tata - oṃ kavacāya huṃ iti maṃtreṇa iṃdhanai rācchādya | oṃ agniṃ prajvalitaṃ vaṃde jātavedaṃ hutāśanaṃ | suvarṇavarṇamamalaṃ saṃmiddhaṃ viśvato mukhaṃ || ityupasthāya | oṃ uttiṣṭha puruṣa harita paṃgala lohitākṣa sarva karmāṇi sādhayame dehi dāpaya svāhā | iti vahni mutthāpya | tataḥ oṃ hriṃ iti sdhaṃḍile sthāpayet || oṃ citpiṃgala hana hana daha daha paca paca sarvajñā jñapaya svāha - iti prajvālvā - jvālinīmudrāṃ pradarśya - vāgīśvarī garbhdhṛtaṃ dhyātvā | oṃ raṃ namaḥ asya homāgneḥ - garbhādāna karma - puṃnavana karma - sīmaṃtonnayana karma - jātakarma - homa devatāgniriti nāmnā nāmakaraṇa karma kalpayāmi namaḥ | oṃ raṃ namaḥ devātāgneḥ annaprāśana karma - caulakarma - upavayana karma - godāna karma - vivāha karma kalpayāmi namaḥ - iti tattatkarma bhāvanāyā akṣaratai rabhyarcayet || tataḥ sāmānyārghodakena - deva mūlamaṃtreṇa agniṃ pariṣicya agnimalaṃkṛtya || mānasovacāraiḥ saṃpūjya - agniryogapīṭhaṃ pūjayet || oṃ namo brahmadibyo brahmavidyā saṃpradāya kartṛbhyo vaṃśaṛṣibhyo namo gurubhyaḥ | oṃ gaṇānāṃtvā sādanaṃ || śrī mahāgaṇādhipataye namaḥ || oṃ atalādi saptalokebhyo namaḥ - oṃ maṃḍūkādi paratvāṃtapīṭha devatābhyonnamaḥ - kuṃḍamadhye agniryogapīṭhaṃ devatābhyonnamaḥ - kuṃḍamadhye agniryogapītaṃ saṃpūjya || adha svagṛhyasūtrokta magnimukhaṃ adhāṣṭakoṇesvāgrādi prādakṣiṇyena - oṃ jātavedase namaḥ - oma saptajihvāya namaḥ - oṃ havyavāhanāya namaḥ - oṃ kaumāratejase namaḥ - oṃ viśvamukhāya namaḥ - oṃ devamukhāya namaḥ | ityabhipūjyā || ṣaṭkoṇe ṣaḍaṃgaṃ yadhā || oṃ sahasrārciṣe hṛdayāya namaḥ | oṃ svastipūrṇāya śirase svāhā | oṃ utti,ṭha puruṣāya śikhāyaivaṣaṭ | oṃ dhūmavyāpine kavacāya huṃ | oṃ saptajihvāya netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | oṃ dhanurda rāya astrāya phaṭ - ityabhyarca || trikoṇe || oṃ vaiśvānarajātaveda iha vaha lohitākṣa sarvakarmāṇi sādhayasvāhā - iti maṃtreṇa agniṃ puṣpātyakṣatai rabhyarcayet | kuṃḍa saṃskāramekhalayoni pūjāṃ kuryāt || oṃ apasarpaṃtuye bhūtāḥ ye bhūtāḥ viṣnasaṃsthitāḥ | ye bhūtā vighnakartāra tenasyaṃtu śivāgniyāḥ | iti gaurasarṣapān vikīrya paṃcagavyena tattanmaṃtraiḥ kuṃḍaṃ saṃprokṣya || pūṇyāhavodakena ca saṃprokṣya || śucīvo punātu || hantai gaṃdha puṣpākṣata jalān gṛhītvā - oṃ āvāhayāmi tatkuṃḍaṃ viśvakarma vinirmitaṃ | śārīraṃ yaccate divyaṃ agnyidhiṣṭhāna madbhutaṃ | ityāvāhya | kuṃḍāya namaḥ iti paṃcopacārai saṃpūjya || yecakuṃḍe sthitādevāḥ kuṃḍāṃge yāśca devatāḥ buddhiṃ yaccaṃtute sarve yajña siddhiṃ mudānvitāḥ | yekuṃḍetava nirmāṇaṃ racitaṃ viśvakarmaṇo asmākaṃ vāṃchitaṃ siddhiṃ yajñasiddhaṃ dadātubho || iti saṃprārdhya || kuṃḍamadhye viśvakarmaṇa māvāhya || maṃ || oṃ viśvakarman haviṣā vardanena | trātāra miṃdra makṛṇo ravadhvaṃ | tasmai viśassa manamaṃta pūrvīra yamagrau vihvayo yadhāsat | upayāma gṛhīto sīṃdrāyatvā | viśvakarmaṇa eṣate yoniriṃdrā yatvā viśvakarmaṇe || oṃ viśvakarmaṇe namaḥ gaṃgādi paṃcopacārai | nāśayatvaṃ hitān sarvān viśvakarma namostute || iti saṃprārdhya || uparimekhalāyāṃ, śvetavarṇā laṃkṛtāyāṃ viṣṇu māvāhayet idaṃ - sure || viṣṇo yajña patedepa duṣṭadaitya niṣūdana | vibhoyajñasya rajñārdhaṃ kuṃḍe sannihito bhava || pradhama mekhalāyai viṣṇudaivatyai śvetavarṇā laṃkṛtāyai namaḥ || iti akṣataiḥ saṃpūjya || tato madhya mekhalāyāṃ, raktavarṇā laṃkṛtāyāṃ, brahmaṇa māvāhayt | oṃ brahmajijñānaṃ - vivaḥ || brahmaṇaṃ paṃcopacārai ssaṃpūjya || haṃsa puṣṭha samārūḍha devadeva gaṇāvṛta | rakṣārdhaṃ mama yajñasya kuḍaṃsmat sannidho bhava | iti madhya mamekhalāyai brahmadaivatvai rakta varṇā laṃkṛtāyai namaḥ | iti saṃpūjya tato adho mekhalāyāṃ, kṛṣṇavarṇā laṃkṛtāyāṃ rudra māvāhya | oṃ namaste rudra - mṛḍaya | gaṃgādhara mahādeva vṛṣārūḍha maheśvara | agaccha bhagavan rudra kuṃḍesmin tsannidobhava | iti tṛtīyamekhalāyai kṛṣṇavarṇā laṃkṛtāyai rudra daivatyai namaḥ | iṃti saṃpūjyaḥ || tato yoni pūjāṃ kuryāt || jaga dutpatti hetukāyai manobhavayutāyai yonyai namaḥ || maṃ || oṃ kṣatrasya yonirasi kṣatrasya nābhirasi mātvāhigṃ sī | māmāhigṃ sīḥ || yoniṃ gaṃdādibhiḥ saṃpūjya || dhyānaṃ || sevaṃte mahatīṃ yonīṃ devarṣi siddha mānavāḥ | caturāśīti lakṣāṇi pannagādyapsarī sṛpāḥ | paśavaḥ pakṣiṇāḥ sarve saṃ saraṃtiyato bhuvi | yonirityeva vikhyāta jaga dutpatti hetukā | manobhava yutādevī rati saukhya pradāyinī | mohayaṃti surān sarvān jagaddhātrī namo namaḥ | yonītvaṃ viśvarūpāṇi prakutirviśva dhāriṇī | kāmasthā kāmārūpāca viśvayonyai nayo namaḥ || iti yoni pūjāṃ kuryāt || tataḥ kaṃṭhapūjā || jīvanaṃ sarvaṃjaṃtūnāṃ sragādisthānamuttamaṃ uttamāṃgasya cādhāraṃ kaṃṭhamāvāhayāmyamaṃ || maṃ || oṃ nīlagrīvā śśitikaṃṭhādivagṃ rudrā upaśritāḥ teṣāgṃ sahasrayojayane vadanvānitanmasi || kaṃṭhaṃ maṃgalarūpeṇa svarakuṃḍe pratiṣṭhitaḥ | parito mekhalāstvatto racitāṃ viśvakarmaṇā || iti maṃtreṇa kaṃṭhaṃ saṃpūjya || tato nābhipūjā || maṃ || oṃ nābhirmcittaṃ vijñānaṃ pāyurmopacatirbavet | anaṃdanaṃdāvāṃḍaume bhagavatsaubhāgaṃ pasaḥ | jaṃghābhyāṃ padbhyāṃ dharmosi viśvarājāpratiṣṭhataḥ || nābhetvāṃ kuṃḍamadhyetu devaispahapratiṣṭhitā | ata staṃ pūjitādevī śubhadāvṛddhidābāva || iti maṃtreṇa nābhiṃ saṃpūjya || adha kuṃjamadhye vāstupūjāṃ kuryāt || āvāhayāmi deveśaṃ puruṣaṃ ca mahābalaṃ | devadeva gaṇādhyakṣaṃ pātālatalavāsinaṃ || maṃ || oṃ vāstoṣpate pratijānīhya smān‌svāveśo anamīvo bhavānaḥ | yatvemahepratitanno juṣasvaśannaedi dvipadeśaṃ catuṣpade || vāstupuruṣāya namaḥ | gaṃdhādibhiḥ saṃpūjya - vāsturuṣāya namaḥ - baliṃ dadāmi || nārikelodakena baliṃ dadyāt || asya dehasthitokṣoṇi brahmaṃjaṃ viśvamaṃḍalaṃ | vyāpinaṃ bhīmarūpaṃ ca surūpaṃ viśvarūpiṇaṃ | pitāmahe sutomukhya tubhyaṃ vāstupate namaḥ || taṃtu tanvanitimaṃtreṇa taṃtuvāveṣṭya || maṃ || oṃ taṃtuṃ tanvanrajapo bhānumanvahi jyotiṣmataḥ padhorakṣadhiyākṛtān | anulbaṇaṃ vayuta joguvāmapomanurbhava janayā daivyaṃ janam || raktavastrema yonimācchādya || ṣaṭpātra prayogaṃ kuryāt || catvāriśṛṃgā || grahavedyaṃ pūrvoktaprakāreṇa sarvatobhadra maṃḍalaṃ kṛtvā | tatra devatā āvāhayet || prāṇānāyamya deśakālau smṛtvā - sarvatobhadramaṃḍale devatā sthāpanamahaṃ kariṣye || iti saṃkalpya || brahmajijñānaṃ gautamo vāmadevo triṣṭuv | brahmavāhane viniyogaḥ || maṃ || oṃ brahmajijñānaṃ pradhamaṃ purastādviśīmata ssurucovena āvaha sabuddhiyā upamā asya viṣṭatsatasya yoni masadaścavivaḥ || madhye brahmaṇa māvāhayāmi || āpyāyasva gautamaḥ somo gāyatrī || maṃ || oṃ apyāyasva sametute viśvatassomavṛṣṇiyaṃ bhavāvājasyasaṃgadhe || uttare somāya namaḥ somaṃ āvāhayāmi || abhitvājīgatinḥ śunaḥ śepa īśāne gāyatrī || maṃ || oṃ abhitvā devasavita rīśānāṃ vāryāṇāṃ sadāvan bhāgavī mahe || īśānyāṃ īśānāya namaḥ āvāhayāmi || iṃdravo madhūmacchaṃdā iṃdro gāyatrī || maṃ || oṃ iṃdravo viśvatassariha vāmahejanebhyaḥ asmāka mastu kevalaḥ || pūrve iṃdrāya namaḥ iṃdraṃ āvāhayāmi || agniṃ dūtaṃ kaṇvomedhātidiragni rgāyatrī || maṃ || oṃ agniṃ dūtaṃ mṛṇīmahe hotāraṃ viśvavedanaṃ āsya yakṣasya sukratuṃ || āgneyāṃ agnaye namaḥ - agniṃ āvāhayāmi || yavāya somaṃ yamonuṣṭhan || maṃ || oṃ yamāya somagṃsunuta yamāya juhutāhaviḥ yamagṃha yajñogaccan tyagnidūto araṃkṛtaḥ || dakṣiṇe yamāya namaḥ - yamaṃ āvāhayāmi || moṣuṇosghoraḥ kaṇvo niḍharti rgāyatri || maṃ || oṃ moṣaṇaḥ parā parā nirurutir dhṛvaṇāvatīku patī kṣṇatṛṣṇayāsaha || naiṛtvāṃ - viṛrutaye namaḥ - viruruti māvāhayāmi || tatvāyāmirāśunaḥ śopho varuṇastriṣṭup ṣaṣa maṃ || oṃ tatvāyāmi brahmaṇā vaṃdamāsastadāśāste yajamāno havirbhiḥ ahḍamāno varuṇehabodhyuruṣagṃ samāsa āyuḥ prayeṣi || paścame varuṇāya namaḥ - varuṇa āvāhayāmi || tava vāyavyāśvāṃgirasovāyargāyātrī || maṃ || oṃ tava vāyuvṛttaspate tvaṣṭurujāmāta radbhutā āvāṃsyāvṛṇīmahe || he vāyavyāṃ vāyuve namaḥ - vāyaṃ āvāhayāmi || jyayā atrimaitrāvaruṇau vasavastriṣṭun || maṃ || oṃ jmayā atra vasavo raṃtidevā urāvaṃtarikṣe marjayaṃtaśubhrāḥ - arvāk‌padha urujrayaḥ kṛṇudhvaṃśrotrā dūtasya jagmuṣono asya || vāyu somamadhye aṣṭavasubhyo namaḥ - aṣṭanasūnā vāhayāmi || ārudrāsaḥ śyāvāśvā ekādaśarudrā jagatī || maṃ || oṃ ārudrāsa iṃdravataḥ sajoṣaso hiraṇyaradhā ssunitāyagaṃtana - iyaṃvo asmatpratiharyate mati stṛṣṇacena diva utsā udanyave || soma īśānayormadhye ekādaśarudrebhyo namaḥ - ekādaśarudran āvāhayāmi || tyānnusāmavedo matsyo dvādaśādityā gāyatrī || maṃ || oṃ tvānnukṣatriyāgṃ ādityānyā ciṣāmahe samṛlīkāyabhiṣṭaye | īśāneṃdrayormadhye dādaśātityebhyo namaḥ - dvādaśādityā nāvāhayāmi || aśvanāvarti rāhūgaṇośvināvuṣṇik || maṃ || oṃ aśvināparti rasmadāgomaddapā hiraṇyavat | ārvāgraṃthaṃ samānāniyacchat || iṃdrāgnimadhye aśvibhyāṃ namaḥ - aśvinau devatānāvāhayāmi || omāsaścarṣaṇīdhṛta iti gṛtsnamado viśvedevā gāyatrī || maṃ || oṃ māsaścarṣadhṛto viśvedevāsa āgatadāśvāgṃsodāśuṣassutam || āgniyamadhye viśvebhyo devebhyo namaḥ - viśvān devān āvāhayikṣye || abhitvaṃ vāmadeva ssaptayakṣā atyaṣṭhi || maṃ || oṃ abhityaṃ devagṃ savitārameṇyoḥ kavikratumarcāmi satyasavanagṃ ratnadhāmaṃ priyaṃ matimūrdhvāyasyāmatirbhā ādidyutatsavīmani hiraṇyapāṇiramimīḍa sukratuḥ kṛpāsyuḥ || yama viruruti madhye saptayakṣebhyo namaḥ - saptayakṣān āvāhayāmi || āyaṃgauḥ sārvarājīsarcā gāyatrī || maṃ || oṃ āyaṃgauḥ pṛśnirakramīdasanas mātaraṃ punaḥ pitaraṃ ca prayaṃtsuvaḥ || nirṛti varuṇamadhye bhūtanāgebhyaḥ - bhūtanāgān āvāhayāmi || tatraiva || apparasāmaitasarpaśṛṃgo gaṃdharvāpsarasonuṣṭup || maṃ || oṃ apsarasāṃ gaṃdharvāṇāṃ mṛgāṇāṃ caraṇe caran - keśike tasya vidyāsakhāsyā durmadiṃtamaḥ || gaṃdharvāpsarasebhyo namaḥ - gaṃdharvāpsarasān āvāhayāmi || kumāraṃ mātāskaṃdastriṣṭhun || maṃ || oṃ kumāraṃ mātādagnināpacya mānādabhiśūlaṃ nihatasyāvadhāvati | mātarbhūmyāmāśri ṣanmātṛṇeṣu devebyastaduśadbhyorātamastu || yadakraṃda aucādhyo dīrghatamā skaṃdastriṣṭhupu || maṃ || oṃ yadakraṃdaḥ pradamaṃ jāyamāna udyatsamudrā dutavāpurīṣāt | śvenasyapakṣau hiraṇyasya bāhū upastutyaṃ mahijātaṃte arvan || brahma somamadhyesaṃdāya namaḥ - skaṃdāvāhane viniyogaḥ || ṛṣabha mṛṣabovai rājonuṣṭhub || maṃ || oṃ ṛṣabhaṃ māsamānānāṃ sapatnīnāṃ vṛṣāsahiṃhaṃtāraṃ śatrūṇāṃ kṛthivirājaṃ gopatiṃgavāḥ || brahma somamadhye ṛṣabhāya namaḥ - vṛṣabheśvarāya namaḥ - vṛṣabheśvara māvāhayāmi || aditirlokyo bṛgaspatiḥ śūla mahakālonuṣṭhun || maṃ || oṃ aditirhajaniṣṭha dakṣayāduhitā tava | tāṃ devā anvajāyaṃta bhadrā amṛtabaṃdhavaḥ || brahma īśānyamadhye dakṣādi sapta gaṇān āvāhayāmi || jātaveda kaśyapo durgāstriṣṭhup || maṃ || oṃ jātavedase suna vāmasoma marātīyato nidahati vedaḥ | sanaḥ parṣadati durgāṇi viśvānāvevasindhuṃduritātyagniḥ || brahmeṃdramadhye durgāyai namaḥ - durgāmāvāhayāmi || idaṃ viṣṇur methātithir viṣṇur gāyatrī || maṃ || oṃ idaṃ viṣṇur vicakrametredhānidadepadaṃ | samūḍhamasyapāgṃ sure || brahmeṃdramadhye viṣṇave namaḥ - viṣṇu māvāhayāmi || udīratāṃ śaṃkhaḥ svadhātriṣṭup || maṃ || oṃ udīratāmavara utparāsa unmadhyamāḥ pitarassomyāsaḥ | asuṃya īyuravṛkā ṛtajñā stnovaṃtu pitarohaveṣu || brahmāgni mdhye - svadhāyai namaḥ - svadhāmāvāhayāmi || paraṃmṛtyo saṃkuśikomṛtyu rogāstriṣṭhup || maṃ || oṃ paraṃmṛtyo anuparehipaṃthāṃ yastvṣva itaro devayānāt | cakṣuṣmate śṛṇvate tebravīmīmānaḥ prajāgṃ rīriṣomota vīrān || brahmāgni yamamadhye ma tyurogebhyo namaḥ - mṛtyurogān āvāhayiṣye || gaṇānāṃ tvāgṛtsnamado gaṇapatirjagat || maṃ || oṃ gaṇānātvā gaṇadanaṃ || brahma nirurutimadhye gaṇapati māvāhayāmi || śannodevī rāṃbarīṣaḥ siṃdhudvīpa āpo gāyatrī || maṃ || oṃ śannodevī rabhiṣṭaya āpobhavaṃtu pītaye śannorabi sravaṃtunaḥ || brahma varuṇamadhyeādbhyo namaḥ - āpaḥ manāhayāmi || maruto yasvahārugaṇo maruto gāyatrī || maṃ || oṃ marutoyasyahikṣaye rādhadivo vimahasaḥ sasugo pātayejanaḥ || brahmavāyumadhye marudbhyo namaḥ - marutaḥ ānāhayāmi || syonā methātithi bhūmirgāyatrī || maṃ || oṃ syonāpṛthivī bhavānṛkṣarānive śanī yaccānnaśśarma sapradhāḥ || brahma pādayūle kari kādhaḥ - pṛthivyai - puthīvī māvāhayāmi || imaṃmegaṃge ityasya siṃdhu kṣitrsai yamedho yamunā sarasvatyau jagatī || maṃ || oṃ imaṃve gaṃge yamune sarasvati śṛtidristomagṃ sacatāpariṣṇiyā - asikniyā marudvṛdhe vitastayārjīkiye śṛṇuhya suṣomayā || gaṃgādi sarvanadībhyo namaḥ - gaṃgādi sarvanadī māvāhayāmi || tatraiva || dhāmno dhāmno gautamo vāmadevaḥ saptasāgarānuṣṭhup || maṃ || oṃ dhāmno dhāmno rājannito paruṇonumuṃca yadāpo āghniyā varuṇo numuṃca yadāpo āghniyā varuṇeti śaphāmahe tato varuṇonumuṃca || kṣārādi saptasāgarā māvāhayāmi || tadupari merave namaḥ || maṃ || oṃ asm rudrāmivānā parvatāso vṛtyahatyebarahutā sajoṣāṃ - yaśśaṃsatestu vatedāyi vajra iṃdrajyeṣṭhā asmā avaṃtu devāḥ | meruparvāta māvāhayāmi || bāhyaparidhau somādi samīpe krameṇāyudhāni aṣṭadikṣu || gadāṃ || gaṇānātvā sādanaṃ || somasamīpe gadā māvāhayāmi || śūlaṃ || maṃ || oṃ yataigātrā dagni nāvacyamānādabhi śūlaṃ nihatasvāvadhātavati - mātarbhūmyāmāśri ṣanmātṛṇeṣu devebhya staduśadbhyorātamastu || īśānyāṃ śūlaṃ āvāhayāmi || vajraṃ || maṃ || oṃ mahagṃ innro vajrabāhu ṣṣoḍaśī śarmayaccatu svastinomaghavākarotuhastu pāpmānaṃ yosmāndveṣṭi || iṃdrasamīpe vajraṃ āvāhayāmi || śaktiṃ || maṃ || oṃ vasucame vasatiścame karmacame śaktiścame || agnisamīpe śaktiṃ āvāhayāmi || daṃḍaṃ || maṃ || oṃ iḍaehi āditaehi sarasvatyehi || yamasamīpe daṃḍaṃ āvāhayāmi || khaḍgaṃ || maṃ || oṃ rurūraudraḥ kṛkalāsaśśakuniḥ pippakāteśaravyāyai hariṇo brahmaṇeśārgastarakṣuḥ kṛṣṇaśśvācatu rakṣo gardabhasta itira janānā mṛgayedūkṣṇā || nirurutisamīpe khaḍgaṃ āvāhayāmi || pāśaṃ || || maṃ || oṃ uduttamaṃ varuṇa pāśa masmadavādamam | vimadhyamaggṃ śraddhāya - atha vayamādatya vrate tavānāgaso āditayesyāma || varuṇasamīpe pāśaṃ āvāhayāmi || aṃkuśaṃ || maṃ || oṃ āgṃ śuścame raśmiśca mesdhābhyāścamedhi patiścame || vāyusamīpe aṃkuśaṃ āvāhayāmi || tat bāhye || uttarādikrameṇa || maṃ || oṃ abhitvā gomataḥ girijātavedo vicarṣaṇedyumnairabhi praṇonumaḥ || uttare ahalyāsahita || gautamaṛṣi āvāhayāmi || maṃ || oṃ ayaṃ dakṣiṇā viśvakarmā tasya manovaiśvakaraṇaṃ grīṣmo mānasastriṣṭhuggreṣmī triṣṭhubha aiḍamaiḍai daṃtaryāmosstarāmā tpañcadaśaḥ pañcadaśā dbhṛhadbhṛhato bharadvāja ṛṣiḥ prajāpati gṛhītayātvayā manaḥ gṛhmami prajābhyaḥ || īśānyāṃ suśīlāsahita bharadvāja māvāhayāmi || maṃ || oṃ yaṃpaścādviśvacāstasya cakṣurvaiśvavyacanaṃ varṣāṇicākṣuṣāṇi jagatīvārṣī jagatyā ṛkṣama mṛkṣamācchukra śśukrādsaptadaśa ssaptadaśādvairūpaṃ vairūpā dviśvāmitraṛṣiḥ prajāpati gṛhītayātvayā cakṣur‌ gṛhṇami prajābhyaḥ || pūrve kumudvatī sahita viśvāmitra māvāhayāmi || maṃ || oṃ yatteśilpaṃ kaśyaparācanāvat | indriyāvatpuṣkalaṃ citrabhānu | yasminthsūryā arpitā saptasākam | tasmi nrājāna madhimiśrayemaṃ || āgneyāṃ - aditisahita kaśyarapa māvāhayāmi || maṃ || oṃ idamu ttarātsuvastasya śrotrag‌ṃ śaracchautryinuṣṭhu pcāradyanuṣṭhubhassāragṃ svārānmanthī manthina ekavigṃśa ekavigṃśādvairāḍajaṃ vairājā jjamadagni ṛṣiḥ prajāti gṛhītayā - tvayā śrotraṃ gṛhṇami prajābhyaḥ || dakṣiṇe rveṇukāsahita jamadagni māvāhayāmi || maṃ || oṃ ayaṃ purobhuvastasya prāṇo bhauvāyanovasantaḥ prāṇāyano gāyatrī vāsantī gāyatriyai gāyatraṃ gāyatrā durāgṃ śurupāgṃ śostrivṛttrivṛto radhantaragṃ radhantarā dvasiṣṭha ṛṣiḥ prajāpati gṛhītayā tvayāprāṇaṃ gṛhṇami prajābhyaḥ || naururutyā ; aruṃdhatīsahita vasiṣṭha māvāhayāmi || maṃ || oṃ atriradadādaurvāya prajāṃ putrakāmāya sariricānosmanyata nirvīrya śśidhiloyātamāna etaṃ caturātrama paśyatta māsharataināyajatatatovai tasya catvāro vīrāasjāyanta suhotā sūdgātā svādhvaryususabheyoya evaṃ vidvāgṃ ścatū rātreṇayajata assya catvāro āvāhayāmi || maṃ || oṃ taṃ patnibhiranugacchema devāḥ putrairbhrātṛ bhirutavā hiraṇyaiḥ nākaṃ gṛhṇanā ssukṛtasya loke tṛtīye vṛṣṭhe adhirocane divaḥ || vāyavyāṃ aruṃdhatī māvāhayāmi || tat bahya pūrvādikrameṇa || maṃ || oṃ indrāṇīdevī subhagā suvatnī | udagṃśena pati vidye jigāye - trigṃ śadasyā jaghanayoya janāni | upastha indragṃ sthaviraṃ bibharti || pūrve aiṃdrī māvāhayāmi || maṃ || oṃ adhaitānarūpebhya alabhate | atihrasvamatidīrgham | atikṛśamatyagṃ salam | atiśukla matikṛṣṇam | atiślakhakṣṇa matilomaśamam | atikirīṭa matidanturam | atimirmiramatime viṣam | āśāyaijāmim | pratīkhākṣayai kūmārīṃ || agneye - kaumārī māvāhayāmi || maṃ || oṃ yujeradhajgaveṣaṇagṃ haribhyāṃ - upabrahmaṇi jujuṣāṇamastu | vibādhiṣṭhāsya rojasī mahitvā | indrovṛtrāṇya pratī jaghanvān || dakṣiṇe brāhmīṃ māvāhayāmi || maṃ || oṃ āyaṃgauḥ yaṃtsuvaḥ || naiṛtvāṃ vārāhī māvāhayāmi || maṃ || ambe ambālyambike namāyabhatikaścana sasastyaśvakaḥ || paścime cāmuṃḍā mānāhayāmi || maṃ || oṃ apyāyasva saṃgadhe || vāyuvyāṃ naiṣṇavī māvāhayāmi || maṃ || oṃ yāterudraśivā tanūraghorā pāpakāśinī - tayānastanu vāśaṃ tamayā giriśantābhicākaśīhī || uttare - māheśvarī māvāhayāmi || maṃ || oṃ namo gaṇebhyo gaṇapatibhyaścavo namaḥ || īśānyāṃvaināyakī mānāhayāmi || <3> tatra madhye sūryāya - sūryāṃ āvāhayāmi || bāhye pūrvādyaṣṭadikṣa - somāya - somāya - somaṃ āvāhayāmi || bhaumāya - bhaumaṃ āvāhayāmi || budhāya - budhaṃ āvāhayāmi || bṛhaspataye - bṛhaspati āvāhayāmi | śukrāya - śukraṃ āvāhayāmi || śanaiścarāya - śanaiścara māvāhayāmi || rāhave - rāhuṃ āvāhayāmi || ketave ketuṃ āvāhayāmi || etādevatāḥ pratiṣṭhāpya saṃpūjya pūrvoktaphrakāreṇāṣṭagaṃdhaiḥ kṣaumavastroparigrahā yaṃtraṃ vilikhya | tadupari yadhākrameṇa saṃsthāpya | tatra kuṃkumākṣataiḥ grahanyādhi pratyadhidevatān sthāpayet || tadyathā || maṃḍale ādityādi devatā sthāpanaṃ kariṣye || iti saṃkalpya || padmāsanaḥ padmakaro padmagarbha || ākṛṣṇena hiraṇyaḥ stūpaḥsavitā triṣṭhup | sūryāvāhane viniyogaḥ | oṃ bhūrbhuvasvaḥ kaliṃgadevaśodbhava kāśyavagotra sūrya ihagaccheti || āpyāyasva gautamaḥ somo gāyatrī - oṃ bhūrbhuvasvaḥ yamunā tīrodbhava ātreyasagotra soma ihagaccheti || agnirmūrdhāvirūpāṃ gārako gāyatrī - oṃ bhūrbhuvasvaḥ avaṃtī samudbava bhāradvājala gotra bauma ihagaccha || udbhudhya svabūdhaḥ saumyo budhastriṣṭu bh - oṃ bhūrbhuvasvaḥ magadhadeśodbhava ātreyasagotra budha ihakagaccha || bṛhaspate gṛtsamado bṛhaspati striṣḍup | oṃ bhūrbhuvasvaḥ siṃdhu deśodbhava āṃgīrasagotra bṛhaspate ihagaccha || śukra parāśaraḥ dvivadāvirāṭ - oṃ bhūrbhavasvaḥ - bhojakaṭakodbhava bhārgavasagotraśśukra ihagaccha || śamagniritiviṭaḥ śāśinaruṣṇik - oṃ bhūrbhuvasvaḥ - saurāṣṭradeśodbhava kāśyapanagotra śanaiścara ihagaccha || kayāno vāmadevo rāhurgayatrī | oṃ bhūrbhuvasvaḥ - siṃhaladeśodbhava paiṭhī nasagotra rāho ihagaccha || ketu madhucchaṃdāḥ keturgāyatrī | oṃ bhūrbhuvasvaḥ - aṃtarvedī samudbhava jaiminasagotra keto ihagaccha || adhāthidevātā || tryiṃbako vasiṣṭho rudronuṣṭhupe - gaurīmimādīrghatamā umā jagatī || yadakraṃdo dīrghatamāḥ skaṃdastriṣṭhup || viṣṇornukaṃ dīrghatapānāyaṇasthriṣṭhup || brahmajijñānaṃ vāsudevo brahmatriṣṭhup || iṃdraṃvo madhuccaṃdā iṃdro gāyatrī - yamāya somaṃ yamo yamonuṣṭhup || moṣūṇosghoraḥ kaṇvaḥ kālogāyatrī || uṣo rājaṃ praskaṇva citragupto bṛhatī || adhipratyadhidevatā || agniṃ kaṇvomedhātidhi ragnirgāyatrī | apsume medhātidhiponuṣṭhup | svonāmedhātadhirbhūmi rgāyatrī | idaṃ viṣṇurmedhātidhi rviṣṇurgayatrī | iṃdraśreṣṭhāni gṛtsamada iṃdrastriṣṭhup | iṃdrāṇīṃ vṛṣākapi riṃdrāṇī paṃktiḥ | prajāpate hiraṇyadarbhaḥ prajāpatistriṣṭhun | ayaṃ gauḥ sārpārājño sarpa gāyatrī - brahmajijñānaṃ gautamo vāmadevo brahmatriṣṭhup || tataḥ uttarataḥ || gaṇānāṃtvā gṛtsnamado gaṇapatirjagatī || jātavedase kaśyapo durgāstriṣṭhun || tavavāyu śvāṃgiraso vāyurgāyatrī ādityatsa ākāśogāyatrī - eṣo uṣaḥ praskaṇvośvinau gāyatrī | yadvārāho ruttare vināyakaṃ || śaneruttare || vāyuṃ - rāhordakṣiṇe ākāśaṃ - ketordakṣiṇeśvanau | uttare kṣetrasya patinā vāmadevaḥ kṣetradhipati ranuṣṭhup - vāstoṣpate vasiṣṭho vāstoṣpati striṣṭup || tataḥ lakṣakoṭi homayoḥ || sāmadhvani śarīra stvaṃvāhanaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ - viṣapāpaharo nitya mataḥ śāṃtiṃ prayaccame || iti maṃtreṇa iṃdraṃ mitraṃ varuṇamitivā garutmaṃta muttarataḥ āvāhya dikpālā naṣṭadikṣu tattanmaṃtrai rāvāhya || tataḥ raveḥ pūrve śeṣaṃ | somasyāgre vāsukiṃ || bhaumasyāgre takṣakaṃ || budho ttare karkoṭikaṃ || gurūttare padmaṃ || śukrottare mahapadmaṃ || śani paśśime śaṃkhapālaṃ || rāheḥ purataḥ kaṃbalaṃ || ketoḥ purataḥ kuliśaṃca sthāpayet || tataḥ pūrve aśvinyādi sapta nakṣatrāṇi || viṣkaṃ bādi saptayogān || bavabālava karaṇe || saptadvīpāni || ṛgvedaṃca || dakṣiṇe puṣyādi sapta nakṣatrāṇi || dhṛtyādi saptayogān || kaulavatte tilakaraṇe saptasāgarān || yajurvegān garaji vaṇikkaraṇe sapta pātālāni sāmavedaṃca || uttare abhijidādi sapta nakṣātrāṇi sādhyādiṣaḍyogān viṣṭikaraṇaṃ bhūrādīn saptalokān || adharva vedaṃca || vāyapyedhruvaṃ saptarṇīṃśca || tato yadhāvakāśaṃ gaṃgādi saptasaritaḥ saptakulācalān || aṣṭau vasūn dvādaśādityān ekādaśa rudrān ekona paṃcā śanmarutaḥ ṣoḍaśa mātṛḥ ṣaḍ‌rutūn dvādaśa māpān dve āyane paṃcadaśa kidhīḥ ṣaṣṭi saṃvatsarān saparṇan nnāgān yakṣān gaṃdharvān vidyāghapāpsarasaḥ rakṣāṃsi bhūtāni manuṣyān iti || koṭi hometu vedyāḥ pūrve brahma madhye janārdanaḥ || paścime rudraḥ uttare skaṃdaḥ tato dhyāyet || tatastu mitrā - gṛhavai ityāvāhya || puruṣasūktena ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya prārdhayet || ādatyāvasavo rudrā maruto lokapāntathā | brahma janārdanaścaiva śūlapāṇirbhagākṣaha || atra sannihitā ssarpe bhavaṃtu makha bhāginaḥ | pūjāṃ gṛhṇaṃtu sarvatra mayā bhaktyopapāditān || kurvaṃtu ca śubhaṃ sarve yajña kartuḥ samāhitāniti || tato vedīśānyāṃ kuṃbhaṃ saṃpūjya | devadānava saṃvāde iti saṃprārdhyā anvādhānaṃ kuryāt || cakṣuṣī ājyenāṃta muktvā || navagrahanaṣṭa śatāṣṇā viṃśatyaṣṭānyatama saṃkhyābhiḥ samiccarvājyāhutibhiḥ navagraha nayuta lakṣakoṭyānyatara saṃkhyābhiryavavrīhi ghṛtatilānyata rāhutibhiḥ śeṣeṇa sviṣṭa kṛtamityādi carvājyāhutirekaiva sarveṣāmiti pakṣe tadhollekhanādi || lakṣakoṭi homayorgarutmaṃta maṣṭaśatādi saṃkhyayā samidādibhiḥ koṭihome brahmādīnāṃ garuḍavatat || carvekāhutipakṣe || vatsānāṃ paṃcāvadāna dharmaśca | lakṣahomāde rbahudina sādhyatve carusviṣṭa kṛdādya dina evakāryaḥ || yāvaddhoma samāpti pratidinaṃ graha pūjā kāryā koṭihome prati sahasraṃ pūrṇāhuti rapi homa samāstā vagniṃ saṃpūjya sviṣṭakṛdādi prāyaścitta homāṃtaṃ kṛtvāgneḥ samaṃtānnavagrahebhyo vederu ttarato vināyakādi saptabhyo garutmateca tattanmaṃtraiḥ māṣabhakta balīn datvā kṣetrapāla baliṃ brāhmaṇena śūdreṇavā catuṣṭaye kṣepayet tataḥ prakṣāli tapādo dvādaśa gṛhī tena caturguhītena vājyena vastra nārikelādi yutena pūrṇāhutīṃ juhūyāt || tatra maṃtrāḥ || samadrā dūrmirityasya gauta movā modhevogni striṣṭup || maṃ || samudrāya vayanāya sinthūnāṃ pataye namaḥ | nadīnāgṃ sarvāsāṃ pitre juhutā viśvakarmaṇe viśvāhasmartyagṃ haviḥ || mūrdhānaṃdino bārhaspatyo bhāradvājo vaiśvānarastriṣṭhun || maṃ || oṃ mūrdhānaṃdivo ṛtiṃ pṛthivyā vaiśvānara mṛtāya jātamagnigṃ saṃmrāja maditiṃ janānā māsannā pātraṃ janayaṃtu devāḥ || punastvagnirvasu rudrādi tyāstriṣṭup || maṃ || oṃ punastvādityā rudrā vasavassa miṃdhatāṃ punarbahmaṇo vasūnīda yajñaiḥ ghute natvaṃ tanuvo vardhayasva satyānsaṃtu yajamānasya kāmāḥ || pūrṇādarvī viśve devāḥ śatakratu ranuṣṭup || maṃ || oṃ pūrṇā darvī parāpata supūrṇā punarāvata | vaśriva vakrīṇā vaha iṣamūrjagṃ śatakrato || saptate agne saptavategnaye || maṃ || oṃ saptate agne samidhassaptajihva saptaṛṣayaḥ ssaptadhāmapriyāṇi | saptahotrā saptadhātvāya jaṃtu saptayonī rāpṛṇasvaghṛtena || dhāmaṃte vāmadevo āpo jagatī || maṃ || oṃ dhāmno dhāmno rājannito varuṇonumuṃca yadāpo agniyā varuṇotiśaphāmahe tato varuṇonumuṃca || etairhutvā || idamagne vaiśvāsarāya vasurudrādityebhyaḥ śatakratave saptate agnayedbyaśca namameti tyāgaḥ || athavasoddhārāṃ pātayet || tatra maṃtrāḥ || agni mīle iti navānāṃ madhucchaṃdā agnirgāyatrī | viṣṇorṇuka iti ṣaṇṇāṃ dīrgha tapāviṣṇu striṣṭup || ātepitariti paṃcadaśānāṃ gṛtsnamado rudrastriṣṭup || svādhiṣceti daśānāṃ maduchaṃdāḥ pavamāna somogāyatrī || mahāvaiśvānarajyeṣṭha sāmanīca pūrṇapātra vimokādi karma śeṣaṃ samāpya | sattvak‌śreyaḥ saṃpādanaṃ kṛtvā kuṃḍeśānabhāge svastikoparibhadrāsane upaviṣṭaṃ yajamānaṃ graha kalaśodakena samudra jyeṣṭatyādibhiḥ surāstvetyādi biścābhiṣaṃcet || atra patnī vāme || tato yajamānaḥ sarvauṣadhī rabhiranulipyasnātvā || paurāṇaiśca || teca || surāstvāmabhiṣiṃcaṃtu brahma viṣṇu maheśvarāḥ vāsudevo jagannādhastathā saṃkarṣamovibhuḥ || pradyumnaścāniruddaśca bhavaṃtu vijayāyate || ākhaṃḍalognirbhagavān yamovai niṛrutistathā || varuṇaḥ pavanaścaiva dhanādhyakṣa stadāśivaḥ || brahmaṇā sahitāḥ sarve dikpālāḥ pātumāṃ sadā || kīrtilakṣmī dhṛtirmedhā puṣṭi śraddhā kriyāmatiḥ | buddhirlajñāvapuḥ śśāṃtiḥ kāṃtistuṣṭaśca mātaraḥ || etāstva mabhiṣiṃcaṃtu devapatnya ssamāgatāḥ | āditya ścaṃdramā bhaumo budha jīvasitārkajāḥ || gṛhastvā mabhiṣiṃcaṃtu rāhuḥ ketuścatarpitāḥ | deva dānava gaṃdharva yakṣa rākṣasa pannagāḥ || ṛṣayo musayogāvo devamātara evaca | devavatnyodrumānāgā daityāścāpsarasāṃgaṇāḥ || astrāṇi sarva śāstrāṇi rājāno vāhanānica | auṣadhāni ca ratnāni kālasyāvayavāścaye || saritaḥ sāgarāḥśailā stīrdhāni jaladāsadāḥ | etaitvā mabhiṣiṃcaṃtu sarvakāmārtha siddhaye || iti || tataḥ prājñmakhaḥ kartāgneḥ paścādācārya ṛtvijaḥ udaṅmakhān saṃpūjya || deśakālau saṃkīrtya mayākṛte āyuta homākhye grahayajña pratiṣṭāgabhūtāṃ imāṃ kapilāṃgāṃ rudradaivatyāmukha gotrebhyo gurvādi sarvaṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇāsahitā mahaṃsaṃpradade samametyuktvā || kapile sarvadhevānāṃ pūjanīyyāsi rohiṇi | tīrdhadevamayī yasmādadaḥ śāṃtiṃ prayacchame || iti paṭhet || emagre jñeyaṃ || puṇyastvaṃ śaṃkha puṇyaunāṃ maṃgalānāṃ ca maṃgalaṃ | viṣṇunāvidhṛtonitya madaḥ śāṃtiṃ prayacchame || iti somāya śaṃkhaṃ | dharmastvaṃ vṛṣarūpeṇa jagadānaṃdakāraka | aṣṭamūrte radhiṣṭhānaḥ tasmāśchāṃtiṃ prayacchame || bhaumāya vṛṣaṃ || hiraṇyagarbhagarbhasthaṃ hemabījaṃ vibhāvasoḥ | anaṃtapuṇyaphaladaḥ śāṃtiṃ pracchame || iti budhāyahemaḥ || pītavastrayugaṃ yasmādvāsudevasya vallabhaṃ | pradānāttasyame viṣṇuḥ priyatāṃ śāntidobhavet || iti gurave pītavastraṃ || viṣṇotvamaśvarūpeṇa yasmā damṛtasaṃbhavaḥ | caṃdrarka vāhanaṃ nityamadaḥ śāṃti prayacchame || iti śukrāyāśvaṃ || yasmātvaṃ pradhitākṛṣṇā dhenokeśābhasannibhā | sarvapāpaharā nitya madhaḥ śāṃtiṃ prayacchame || iti śaneḥ kṛṣṇāṃgāṃ || yasmādāyasakarmaṇi tvadadīnāni sarvadā | lāṃgalānyāyudhādīni tasmā cchāṃtiṃ prayacchame || iti ketave chāgaṃ | sarveṣāṃ vāgāvaḥ || gavāmaṃgeṣu tiṣṭhaṃti bhuvanānicaturdaśa | yasmāttasmācchivaṃ mesyādihaloke paratracetadeyā || sarvebhyassuvarṇaṃvā dadyāt || sarveṣāṃ prītayeśayyā ratnāni bhūmisadakṣiṇādeyā || tannaṃtrāstu || yasmādaśūnyaṃ śayasaṃ keśavasya śivasyaca | śayyāsśūnyāmeyaṃ syāddattajanmanijannani || yadhāratneṣu sarveṣu sarvedevāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ | mama śāṃtiṃ prayacchaṃtu ratnadānename surāḥ || yadhā bhūmipradānasya kalāṃnārhaṃtiṣoḍaśīṃ | dānānyanyānimeśāṃtirbhūmidanādbhavatviti || vastra kāṃcana ratnānyapi yathāśaktidadyāt || tato grahāṇāmuttara pūjāṃ kṛtvā || yāṃtu devagāṇā iti visṛjyāgniṃ saṃpūjya vibhūtira dhṛtvā gacchagaccha sura śreṣṭheti vusṛjyokta saṃkhyāyā viprān saṃbhojya || karmeśvarārpaṇamiti || iti kamalākara kṛtāvayuta homaḥ atha lakṣa homavidhiḥ mātsye || kadhitoyuta homoyaṃ latrahoma mataḥ śṛṇuḥ || sarva kāmaptaye yasmāllakṣahomaṃ vidurbuthāḥ || || asmāddaśaguṇaḥ proktalakṣa homaḥ svayaṃbhuvā | āhutībhiḥ prayatnena dakṣiṇābhistadhaivaca || || atha ṛtvijo bṛhatparāśareṇoktāḥ | yugmāstu ṛtvijaḥ kāryā brāhmaṇā yevi paścitaḥ | nityaṃ japa parāścaiva niyojyāstena tadvijāḥ || kaṃdamūla phalā harādadhikṣīrāśi nopivā mātsye || dvihasta vistṛtaṃ tadvaccaturhastāya taṃtadā || lakṣahome bhaletkuṃḍaṃ yoni vaktraṃ trimekhalaṃ | dviraṃgulo cchritākāryā pradhamā mekhalā judhaiḥ | dviraṃgulannatā tatra dvitāyā samudā hṛtā | uccrāya vistarābhyāṃ catṛtīyā caturaṃgulā || caturaṃgula vistāraḥ pūrva yorapiśasyate || tasyacottara pūrveṇa vitastitraya saṃvitāṃ | prāgudak pravaṇāṃta dvaccaturaśrāṃ samaṃ tataḥ || viṣkaṃbhārdhocchritaṃ proktaṃ sdhaṃḍilaṃ viśvakarmaṇā | saṃsthāpanāya devānāṃ vapradvaya samādṛtaṃ || dviraṃgulocchrito vapraḥ pradhamaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ | tryiṃgulocchrāyakaṃ proktaṃ vapradvaya mathopari || dvyaṃgula statra vistāraḥ sarveṣāṃ kathito budhaiḥ | daśāṃ gulocchritābhittiḥ sthaṃjilesyāttadhopari || tasmināvāhā yeddevān pūrvavacchukla taṃḍule | gurutmānadhika statra saṃsthāpya śśriyamiccatā || naca sarvavedyante pūrvabhāge sthāpyaḥ || aṃtetu bādarāyaṇa iti nyāyāt || tadā vāhāne maṃtrāḥ || sāmadhvani śarīratvaṃ vāhānaṃ parameṣṭinaḥ | viṣapāpahāro nitya madaḥ śāṃtiṃ prayacchame || viṣāpa harama itavā pāṭhaḥ || pūrvā vatkuṃbhamā maṃtrya tadvaddomaṃ samācaret || sahasrāṇāṃ śataṃhutvā samitsaṃkhyādikaṃ punaḥ | pūrvavatsa midājya carun hutvā suvarṇosigarutmāniti garuḍadaiva patākaṃ homaṃ hutvā vyāhṛtībharlakṣa homaṃ kuryādi tyardhaḥ || maṃ || oṃ suparṇosiga rutmān trivṛtte śirogāyatraṃ cakṣu stoma ātmā sāmate tanūrva devyāṃ bṛhadra daṃtare pakṣau yajñā yajñiyaṃ pṛcchaṃ caṃdāgṣyaṃgāni dhiṣṇiyā spaphāya jūgṃṣī nāmā suparṇopi garutmān divaṃgacca suvaḥ pataḥ || ghṛta kubhādvasoddhārāṃ pātaye danalopari | auduṃbarī mayī mārdrā mṛjvīṃ koṭara varjitāṃ || bāhu mātrāṃ sruvaṃ kṛtvā tatantaṃbhadvayorapi | ghṛtā dhārāṃ tataḥ samyagagneru paripātayet || śrāmaya ssūkta māgneyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ laudra maiṃdavaṃ | maha vaiśvānaraṃ sāmaca pāṭhayet | agnimīle navānāṃ madhucchaṃdorgnigāyatrī || viṣṇornukamiti ṣaṇṇāṃ dīrghatamā viṣṇu striṣṭhup || svādhiṣṭayāda śānāṃ madhu caṃdaḥ somo gāyatrī || mahavaiśvā narasāmnaḥ vaiśvānara ṛṣi rdevatā | jagatī bṛhatī cchaṃdaḥ || mūrdhā naṃdipa iti jyeṣṭhā sāmno bharadvājau vaiśvānara striṣṭup || snānaṃ ca yajamānasya pūrvavat svasti vācanaṃ | dātavyā yajamānena pūrva vaddakṣiṇāḥ kramāt || tadvaccha daśa cāṣṭauvā lakṣa homepi ṛtvijaḥ | kartavyāḥ śakti tastadvacchatvārovā vimatsarāḥ || navagraha makhā tsarvaṃ lakṣahome daśottare || datvā dadyāmmani śreṣṭha bhūṣaṇānyapi śaktitaḥ || atra dānaṃ yadhā śakyā dātavyaṃ bhūti micchatā | ekaika śatāhute ssahassrasyavaiko vipra ityardhaḥ || phalaṃtu || pūjyate śivalokeca vasvāditya marudgaṇaiḥ | tatra kalpa śatānyaṣṭāvatha maukṣa mavāpnuyāt || sakāmoyastvi maṃkuryāllakṣa homaṃyadhāvidhi | sarvānkāmānnavāpnoti padaṃcā naṃtya maśnute || putrārdī labhate putraṃ dhanārdhī labhate dhanaṃ || bhāryārdhī labhate bhāryāṃ kumārīca śubhaṃ patiṃ | bhraṣṭarājya stadhārājyāṃ śrīkāmaḥ śriyamāpnuyāt || yaṃ yaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ taṃ taṃ prāpnoti puṣkalaṃ | niṣkāmaḥ kurute yastu paraṃbrahmādi gacchati || iti lakṣahomaḥ || atha koṭihomaḥ mātsye || asmācchataguṇaḥ proktaḥ koṭihomaḥ svayaṃbhūvā | āhutībhiḥ prayatnena dakṣiṇābhiḥ phalenaca || pūrvā vadgṛha devānāṃ āvāhana visarjane || homa maṃtrāstu pūrvoktāḥ snāne dāne tadhaivaca | kuṃḍa maṃṭapavedīnāṃ niśeṣoyaṃ nibodhaye || koṭi home caturhastaṃ caturaśraṃca yatnataḥ | yoni vaktradvayopetaṃ tadapyāhustrimekhalaṃ || ekaṃ yoni vaktraṃ paścime aparaṃ dakṣiṇa iti || hemādrau madanaratne coktaṃ || vediśca koṭihome syādvita stīnāṃ catuṣṭayaṃ | caturaśrāḥ samaṃtācca tribhirvastrai ssamāvṛtā || vapra pramāṇaṃ pūrvoktaṃ vedikāyā stadhocchrayaḥ | tadhā ṣoḍaśa hastaḥ syānmaṃcapaśca caturmukhaḥ || pūrvadvāreca saṃsthāpya bahvāṛcaṃveda pāragaṃ | yāmya sthāpyo yajurvedī paścame sāmavedinaṃ || adharvedinaṃ tadva duttare sthāpayedbudhaḥ | aṣṭau homārtha mā maṃtryā veda vedāṃga vedinaḥ || āhatya dvādarśā viprān vastra mālyānu lepanaiḥ | pūrvā vatpūjaye dbhaktyā sarvābharaṇa bhūṣaṇaiḥ || rātri sūktaṃca raudraṃca pāvamānaṃ sumaṃgalaṃ | pūrvādvāre ṛcāṃ śāṃtiṃ paṭhannāsta udaṅmukhaḥ || śākraṃ saumyaṃ ca raudraṃca kūṣmāṃḍaṃ śāṃtimevaca || pāṭhayeddakṣiṇadvāri yajurvedina muttasuṃ || sauvarṇa madhamai rājannāgneyaṃ rudra saṃhitaṃ | jyeṣṭha sāma tathā śāṃti chaṃbogaḥ paścime paṭhet || śāṃti sūktaṃca sauraṃca tadhā śākunikaṃ śubhaṃ | pauṣṭikaṃca tathā rājannuttare dvara vecavit || aṣṭa bhibrāhmaṇai statra homa kāryaśca pūrvavat | snāne dāneca maṃtrāḥ syustaeva muni sattama || vasordārāvi dhānaṃca lakṣahoma vadiṣyate || anena vidināyastu koṭihomaṃ samācaret || sarvā nkāmānnavāpnoti tato viṣṇupadaṃ prajet || aśvameda sahasrāṇāṃ daśa cāṣṭauca darmavit || kṛtvā yatphala mavāpnoti koṭihomātta daśnute | brahma hatyā sahasrāṇi bhṛṇahatya rbudānica || naśyaṃti koṭi homena yathāvachciva bhāṣitaṃ || iti mātsye koṭihoma vidhiḥ atha nṛsiṃha homavidhiḥ nṛsiṃha homaḥ || nṛsiṃha pūraṇe nṛsiṃha homaviśeṣaḥ || dunvapnadarśane ghore grahapīḍā samudbhave | hanaṃtī pratimācaiva jvalaṃtī ca viśeṣataḥ || prasvedayuktaṃ pratamāṃ dṛṣṭvātu nṛpanaṃdana | tadhā mahājvaragrasto dhārādevasya mūrdhani || saṃtataṃ narasiṃhasya kuryā dvākārayedbudhaiḥ | āyane viṣuvecaiva caṃdra sūrya grahetathā || narasiṃhaṃ samārādhya lakṣahomaṃ ca kārayet | ānāvṛṣṭi mahāmārī jvare rogabhaye tadhā || narasihmaṃ samārādhya brāhmaṇai rvedapāgaiḥ | kāraye lakṣahomaṃtu grāmapaścānnarā dhipaḥ || dṛṣṭvopa sargaṃ maraṇaṃ prajānāmātmanaścahi | samyagārādhya yatnena narasiṃhmasya maṃdire || śaṃkarāyatinevāpi koṭihomaṃ samācaret | pramāṇaṃ bāhumātraṃtu sarvataḥ kuṃḍalakṣaṇaṃ || brahmacārī vratai ryukta strirātraṃtuviśeṣataḥ ahorātra mupoṣyādha gāyatrī mayutaṃ japet || nirāhārāśca śucayaste sarve saṃyateṃdriyāḥ | ārabheyu statoyajñaṃ tato homamaṃtaṃdrikāḥ || yavadhānyatilairmiśraiḥ gāyatryā pradhamaṃhutaṃ | juhuyādekacittena svāhākārānvitaṃ budhaḥ || tato vyāhṛtibhiḥ paścājjuhuyāttu tilādikaṃ | yāvatpra pūryate saṃkhyā lakṣaṃvā koṭirevavā || tāvaddinekuryā dacyutārcana pūrvakaṃ | tāvacchabhojanaṃ dadyāvaddomaṃ samācaret || samāste dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāttataḥ prokṣyodakena ca | evaṃ kṛtetu grāmasya rājño janapadasya ca || sarvabādhā praśamanī śāṃtirbhavati sarvadā || iti nṛsiṃha homavidhiḥ lakṣakoṭi homavidhiḥ ṣaḍaśraṃ lakṣaṇopetaṃ vaiḍuryaṃkārayecchivaṃ | hemapīṭhaṃ suśobhāḍhyaṃ caṃdrārkau tatra mātaraḥ || carcikādyāḥ praka rtavyāḥ pūrvādi parikalpitāḥ | tatra grahāṇāṃ pragvat pūjākāryā || lakṣahomaḥ prakartavyaḥ sarvapīḍā nivāraṇaḥ | gāyatryā grahamaṃtraiśca kūṣmāṃḍai rjātavedasaiḥ || aiṃdravāruṇa vāhneyai rvāyayāmyaissavaikṛtaiḥ | homaśśatasahasrastu hyatrotkruṣyo vidhīyate || ātra maṃtravibhāgastu hyatotkruṣṭo vidhīyate || sarvapīḍā vināśāya koṭihoma śśubhāvahaḥ | yavavrīhi ghṛta kṣira tilāḥ kaṃguprasārikāḥ || saṃkajośīra bilvāmradalā home prakīrtitāḥ | tatraiva brahmovāca - lakṣahomaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathoktaṃ tatra śaṃbhunā | bhūmikaṃpe diśāṃdāpe grahayuddhepyupasthite || ketu saṃdarśanecaiva ādityaśya ca kaṃpane | kṛṣṇavarṇe thavāsūrye tathā chidrasamanvite || raktavṛṣṭistathānaḍyo viparītā bhavaṃti ca | nirgataṃ gaganāddhūmaṃ vārimadhyegni saṃsthitiḥ || upasargā stathāloke nānotpāta samudbhave | yasyarāśau grahāḥpaṃca ṣaṭsaptaca surādhipa || grahaṇaṃ caṃdra ravyośca grahairvāṣṭa masaṃsthitaiḥ | sūryaścābhyarcanaṃ kāryaṃ śivasyāsśubhanāśanaṃ || lakṣahomo mahāmomaḥ koṭihomaḥ puroditaḥ | go bhū hīraṇya vastrāśva tiladānaṃ śubhāvahaṃ || pāyasaṃ dadhi kṣīrājyaṃ deyaṃ naivedya muttamaṃ | eka liṃge prakartavya matho vipragraheṣuca || vṛṣādi rahita meka liṃgaṃ || bāhumātre tataḥ kuṃḍe jaṃghāmātre thavā punaḥ | hotavyaṃ surarājaṃdra nānyeṣu vidhirīdṛśaḥ || ahaṃte kadhayiṣyāmi lakṣahomasyayo vidhiḥ | caturhastaṃ tathā kuṃḍaṃ vistāraṃ surasattama || ṣoḍaśāṃgulavistāra mucchrāye ṣoḍaśāṃgulaṃ | caturaṃgula maunnatyaṃ caturhastanya kīrtitaṃ || dvādaśāṃgulavistāro dairghyaṃ dviguṇamucyate | yoniḥ kuṃḍ prakartavyā nādhikāśasyate kvicit || yavavrīhi ghṛta kṣīra tilakaṃgudalāni ca | cūtasya sūrarājeṃdra pālāśa samidhastathā || dūrvāṃkuraṃ śamī śreṣṭhaṃ jāduṃbarya śśubhuvahāḥ | gāyatrī tryaṃbakaścāpi śaṃbhavāye ca kīrtitāḥ || jātaveda samaṃtreṇa maṃtreṇeṃdreṇacaivahi | sahasrasīrṇeṇa namo hiraṇyene tyadhāpivā || rudramaṃtrai stadhā sauraiḥ pāṃcarātrāgamoditaiḥ | hotavyaṃ śatamaṣṭautu sahasramadha saṃkhyayā || paṃkajotpala bilvādi homadravyaṃ śubhāvahaṃ | kaṃpanaṃ svedanaṃ gātre aśṛpātārtha jalpanaṃ || devatānāṃ surādhyakṣa utpātāḥ kṣayakārakāḥ | lakṣahomaṃ prakurvīta koṭihoma madhāpivā || godoha rudrabhavane mahāsnānaṃ śubhāvahaṃ | anyadhā mārakoghoro jāyate rājavibhramaḥ || ye devāste grahāssarveye grahāstetu jaṃgamāḥ | teṣāṃ saṃpūjanā nnityaṃ dīrghāyuḥ puruṣobhavet || "atra lakṣahome koṭihomeca bṛhatsarāśarokto viśeṣaḥ" yugmāścha ṛtvijaḥ kāryā brāhmaṇā sai vipaścitaḥ | niyamavrata saṃpannā ssahitāḥ pārdhivairnanu || nityaṃ japa parāśceva niyojyāsai sadā dvijāḥ | kaṃdamūla phalāhārā dadhikṣīrāśino pivā || agni somau ca sūryaṃ ca viṣṇuṃcaiva prajāpatiṃ | viśvedevā smaheṃdraṃ ca mitraṃ sviṣcakṛtaṃ tadhā || dadhi madhu ghṛtāktāśca samidhaścaiva yājñiyāḥ | homaye cchatasāhasraṃ maṃtraiścaiva yadhākramaṃ || caturvaṃśati gāyatryā mānastoketaṣaṭ tadhā | triṣaṭ grahādi maṃtraiśca catasro viṣṇudaivataiḥ || kūṣmaṃḍai rjuhuyatpaṃca kirikeyaiḥstu ṣoḍaśa | huneddaśasahasrāṇi jātavedasa ityṛcā || paṃcaivatapa sahasrāṇi juhuyādiṃ dradaivataiḥ | koṭime caturhastaṃ caturaśrāyataṃ punaḥ || yonivaktradvayopetaṃ tadapyāhustrimekhalaṃ | vedīca koṭihomeśyā ddhastānāṃhi catuṣṭhayaṃ || caturaśrā samātadya ttribirvipraiḥ samāvṛtā | aṣṭautu homakāḥ kāryā vedavedāṃgavedinaḥ || evaṃ dvādaśate pūjyāḥ vastramālyānulepanaiḥ | bhagavan mahadutpāta saṃbhave bhūprakaṃpane || nirghātapāṃsuvarṣe ca grahabhaṃge tathaivaca | janmanakṣatra pīḍāsu anāvṛṣṭibhayeṣuca || krūrāsu grahapīḍāsu durbhikṣe deśaviplave | vyādīnāṃ saṃbhave jāte śarīre cātipīḍite || prabrūhimdvijaśreṣṭha tathārogyapradaṃ nṛṇāṃ | nanatkumāra uvāca - śṛṇurāja spravakṣyāmi śāṃtikarma tatho ttamaṃ || koṭihomākhyamatulaṃ sarvakāma phalapradaṃ | brahmahatyādi pāpāni ena naśyaṃti tatkṣaṇāt || utpātāḥ praśamaṃyāṃti mahatsaṃpadyate sukhaṃ | vidhānaṃ tasya vakṣyami śṛṇuṣvaikamavābhava || devāgāre ca bhavane tīrdhevā śivasannidhau | parvatevā prakurvīta ya iccet kṣemamātmaḥ || śubhanakṣatra yogeca vāre sarvaguṇānvite | yajamānasyānukūle koṭihomaṃ samārabhet | pūjamitvā prayatnena brāhmaṇaṃ veda pāragaṃ | vastraiśca bhūṣaṇaiścaiva gaṃdha mālyānu lepanaiḥ || praṇamya vidhi vattasmai ātmānaṃ vini vedayet | tvaṃnogatiḥ pitāmātā tvaṃgatastvaṃ parāyaṇaṃ || tvatprasādena viprarṣe sarvamyesyā nmanogate | āpadvi mekṣaṇārdhamme kuruyajña manuttamaṃ || koṭi homākhya matulaṃ śāṃtyardhaṃ sarvakāmadaṃ | pūrohita stathā prājñaḥ śuklāṃbaradhara śśuciḥ || brāhmaṇai ssahitaḥ puṇyai ssaṃyutai ssasamāhitaiḥ | bhūmibhāge sameśuddhe prāguda kpravaṇe tathai || puṇyāhaṃ vācayetpuṇya kṛtoviprā nsupūjayet | tatastu sahito vipraissūtraye nmaṃṭapaṃ śubhaṃ || madhyetu maṃṭapasyāpi kuṃḍaṃ kuryādvi cakṣaṇaḥ | caturhasta pramāṇena āyāmena tadhaivaca || mekhalā tritayaṃ tasya dvādaśāṃgula vistṛtaṃ | tatpramāṇāṃ tadhā yoniṃ kurvīta susamāhitaiḥ || kuṃḍasya pūrvabhāgetu vediṃ kuryādvica kṣaṇaḥ || caturhastāṃ samāṃcaiva hasta mātrocchritāṃ nṛpa | sthāpanaṃ tatra devānāṃ kuryādyatnena buddhimān | upalipyatato bhūmiṃ maṃṭapasyasa maṃtataḥ || vinyanetkalaśāṃ statra jalapūrṇāṃ ścaturdiśaṃ | aśvattha plakṣa cūtādyaiḥ palli vairupa śobhitān || vitāna mupariṣṭāccha maṃṭapasya prakalpayet | sthāyoddikṣu sarvāsu toraṇāni vicakṣaṇaḥ || evaṃ saṃbhṛta saṃbhāraḥ purodhāssu samāhitaḥ | puṇyāha jayaghoṣeṇa homakarma samārabhet || sthāpayityā surānvedyāṃ vakṣyamāṇā naridama | brahmaṇaṃ pūrvābhāgetu madhye devaṃ janārdanaṃ || paścimeca tathā rudraṃ vasunuttara tastathā | vāyau saumyaṃ tadhaiśāne lokapālān krameṇatu || evaṃ saṃsthāpya vibudhān yadhāpthānaṃ nṛpottama | pūjaye dvidivadvastra gaṃdhamālyāma lepanaiḥ || vedokta maṃtrai stalligaiḥ purāṇoktaiḥ pṛdhak pṛdhak | āditya vasavorudrā maruto lokapā stathā || brahma janāpganaścaiva śulapāṇi rbhagoryamā | evaṃ sannihitān devān saṃpūjya yatnata ssudhīḥ || naivedyai rvividhai rbhakṣaiḥ phalai rdīpai stadhai vaca | tatastutai rdvijai ssārdhaṃ kujasya vidhipūrvakaṃ || kuryātsaṃskāra karaṇaṃ yadhoktaṃ veda ciṃtakaiḥ | tataḥ prajvālaye dvahniṃ nāmnākhyātaṃ ghanārciṣaṃ || niyojaye dvijāṃ statra śata saṃkhyā nṛṣo ttama | alābetu bahūnāṃ ca yathā lābhaṃ niyojayet || vidyā vṛddhāne vayo vṛddhān gṛhasthā ssaṃyateṃdriyā || mukhānityasya catvāri saptajihvāśca pārdhipa | evaṃ jirvā mathaikaṃtu tatsmṛtaṃ sārvakāmukaṃ || ṛgbhiḥ pūrvamukhe homo yajurbhiścottaremukhe | sāmabhiḥ paścimekāryosdharvabhi rdakṣiṇāvukhe || ṛgbhiḥ ṛgvedibhiḥ - homovyāhṛtibhiścaiva sarvastatra vidhīyate | praṇavādyaiścatalliṃgai svāhākārāṃtayojitaiḥ || juhuyātsarvadevānāṃ vedyāṃyecopakalpitāḥ | evaṃ pragaspayodyajñaṃ koṭihomākhya muttamaṃ || tilāḥ kṛṣṇā ghṛtābhyaktāḥ kiṃcidvrīhi samanvitāḥ | hotavyāḥ koṭihometu samidhastu palāśajāḥ || pūrṇehoma samasretu dadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ śubhāṃ | pūrṇahuti ssamākhyātā koṭihome sarādhipa || sahasrāṇi nṛpaśreṣṭha daśa śāstra viśāradaiḥ | dakṣiṇa ca sahasraṃ dhenavaḥ sahasraṃ śaṃkha ityādi sarveṣā madhavā gāvaḥ iti pakṣe navaśatagāvaḥ savaśataṃ suvarṇāni adha koṭihomasya śatamukhadaśamukha dvimukhai kamukha bhedā ucyaṃte saṃvaraṇa uvāca - bahutvātkarmaṇobrahman keṭihāmaḥ suduṣkaraḥ | niyamā brahmacaryādyā duṣkarā iti mematiḥ || nirodho brahmaṇānāṃca bhūśayyādiśca duṣkaraḥ | kārye gurulaghīyastvaṃ parvakālādyapekṣayā || keṭihomasya saṃkṣepaṃ vadam brahmasaṃbhanā | sanatkumāra uvāca - śatānano daśamukho dvimukhaika mukhāstathā || caturvidho mahārājā koṭihome vidhīyate | kāryasya garutāṃjñātvā naivedyā madha parvaṇaḥ || yadhā saṃjñepataḥ kāryaḥ koṭihomastadhāśṛṇu | kṛtvā kuṃḍaśataṃ divyaṃ yadhoktammanasammiṃtaṃ || ekai kasmin tadhā kuṃḍe daśaviprānniyojayet | sadyaḥ pakṣetu viprāṇāṃ sahasraṃ parikīrtitaṃ || yadhā kuṃḍa bahutvetu rāḍasūye ydhākratau | syādevāgni bahutvatu sacayajñe vibhijyate || tadhā kuṃja śatepyatra ghṛtārchiṣi niyojite | eka evabhavedyajñaḥ koṭihomo nasaṃśayaḥ || evaṃ yaḥkurute kṣipraṃ vyānakaiḥ kāryagauravāt | śatānana ssavijñeyaḥ keṭihomo nasaṃśayaḥ || atra kuṃḍānāṃ hasta mātratā śīghradāhi ghṛtādiparā tila yavādautu lakṣe śatāṃśe lakṣārdhetri karaṃ kuḍaṃ lakṣa homecatuḥ karaṃ | ayutetvatha hotavye kuṃḍaṃsyādthasta mātrakaṃ || dviguṇaṃ lakṣa homeca keṭihome caturgaṇam | iti maṃtrāṃtaroktaṃ jñeyaṃ || iti śata mukhaḥ - svalpaira hobhiḥ kāryassyā dvarṣākālādake yadā | tadā daśamukhaḥ kāryaḥ koṭihomo mahāyate || viprāṇaṃ dveśate tatra vibhajya viniyo jayet | maṃṭapastu paṃcā śatkaraḥ paṃca viṃśati karovā || iti daśamukhaḥ - yatrakuṃḍa dvayaṃ kṛtvā vibhajyaca vibāvasuṃ | homaṃ kuryurdvijā bhūyaḥ saṃskṛtya vidhi pūrvākaṃ || śataṃ tatra niyojyāca viprāṇāṃ pravibhajyavai | māse thavārdha māsevā kāryā kālehyupasthite || tadātu dvimukhaḥ kāryaḥ koṭihomo vicakṣaṇaiḥ | yadātu svecchayā yajñaṃ yajamāna ssamāpayet || kālena bahunā rājan stadācaika mukhobhavet | ekakuṃḍa sthitovahni rekacittai ssamāhitaiḥ || nasaṃkhyā niyamaścātra brāhmaṇānāṃ narottama | sakāla niyamaścaiva svecchayā yajña ucyate || āvṛtāya kartukāmasya cāturmāsyādi karmavat | sadā prasaktaḥ kartavyo yajñoyaṃ sārva kālikaḥ || yoya meka mukhorāja nkālena bahunā bhavet | yato vihitatamāyuśca vittaṃ caivā sthihaṃ sadā || āta ssaṃkṣepata kāryaḥ dharma kāryāṃ prasasyate | tata ssamāpte yajñetu kārayetsu samāhitaḥ || śaṃkhatūryā ninādena brahmaghoṣa raveṇaca | tatastu dāsayodviprā nṛtvija śśranāṃca śataṃ tadhā || niṣkaika kanakaiścai kuṃḍalai rvividhair nṛpa | go śataṃcaiva dātavyaṃ aśvānāṃca śataṃ tadhā || sahasraṃca suvarṇānāṃ sarveṣā mapi dāpayet | grāmairgaja rathai raśvaiḥ pūjayeccha purohitaṃ || tataścā vabṛthesnāyāttairghaṭaiḥ pūrva kalpitaiḥ | lakṣa homokta maṃtreṇa sadā vijaya kāraṇau || evaṃ samāpayodyastu koṭihoma makhaṃ śubhaṃ | tasyārogyaṃ priyāḥ putrā āyurvurdhi stadhaivaca || anāvṛṣṭi bhayaṃcaiva utpātabhayamevaca | durbhikaṃ grahapīḍā ca praśamaṃyāṃti bhūtale || etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ sarvakarma phalapradaṃ | sanakākhyena muninā pārdhivāya nivedite || sarvopasargaśamanaṃ bhavane bhavāya | yekārayaṃti manujā nṛpa koṭihomaṃ | bhogānavāsyā manasobhimatān prakāmāṃ | teyāṃti śakrasadanaṃ śici śuddhasatvāḥ || iti bhiviṣyottare koṭi homavidhi ssaṃpūrṇaṃ tatra bahuprasaveṣu tacchāṃteruktatvādgomukha prasava ucyate || gargaḥ - praṇipatya raviṃ vakṣye prāyaścitta manusmaran | sarvādiṣṭa vināśāya yaduktaṃ jyotirarṇave || pitrāriṣṭ sutāriṣṭ mātrariṣṭ tadhaivaca | yannakṣatrotpattau yadyariṣṭaṃ tatredaṃ kuryādityardhaḥ || prāyaścittaṃ tadhākuryā ttattaddoṣasya śāṃtaye || pūṣāśvinyo rgurau sārpa mukhācicitreṃdramūlabhe | eṣva ppṛkṣeṣu jātasya kuryādgo jananaṃ tathā || tathā śabdasyamuccayārthaḥ || tena pitrariṣṭhā dautannakṣatrādi śāṃtiṃ kṛtvā || etaccakuryādityarthaḥ || pitrariṣṭhe tyanenaiva mūlādāpiprāḥ | punarmālādi grahaṇaṃ | yatra mūlāde ścaturthapādādau tadabhāvastatraprāptyardhaṃ || janmarkṣevā trijanmarkṣe śubhavāre śubhedine | kṛtvābhyaṃgādikaṃ sarvaṃ guhālaṃkāra pūrvakaṃ || gomayenopalipyātha guhasyeśānabhāgake | paṃkajaṃ karṇaṃkāyuktaṃ rajobhiḥ svetavarṇakaiḥ || vrīhīstatravinikṣipya yadhānittāsārataḥ | navaśūrpaṃ ca tanmadhye raktavastraṃ prasārayet || sthāpayitvā śiśuṃ tatra punassūtreṇa veṣṭayet | prāṅmakhaṃ tamavākpādaṃ tila darbha gataṃ śiśuṃ || gomukhaṃ darśayitvātu punarjātaṃtu gomukhāt | viṣṇuryo nītimā ktena gavyena ssāpayecchiśuṃ || gavāmaṃgeṣviti maṃtreṇa gavāmaṃgāni saṃspṛśet | viṣṇo śreṣṭheti maṃtreṇa goprasūtaṃtu bālakaṃ || ācāryastu samādāya paśśanmātre pradapayot | pitā vastraṃ vyapohādha putrasya mukha mīkṣayet || pitre tadhā pradātavyaṃ tatomātre pradāpayet | pitā vastraṃ vyapohādha putrasya mukha mīkṣayet || go mūtraṃ go mayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiśca saṃyutaṃ | āpohiṣṭhādibhi rmaṃtrai rabhiṣice ttata śśiśuṃ || mūrdhni cāghrāyutaṃ putraṃ tanmaṃtreṇa tadā pitā | aṃgādaṃgā tsaṃbhavasi hṛdayādadhi jāyase || ātmāvai putranāmāsi sajīva śarada śśataṃ | mūrdha nitri ravaghrāyaṃ taṃ śiśuṃ sthāpaye ttataḥ || puṇyahaṃ vācametpaścā dbrāhmaṇai rvedapāragaiḥ | daridrā yādha viprāya tāṃgā mabyarcya dāpayet || go vastra svarṇa dhānyāni dadyā darkāditaḥ kramāt | yadhaśakti dhanaṃ dadyā dbrāhmaṇebya stathāpitā || tato homaṃ prakurvīta svaśābo ktena mārgataḥ | ullekhanādikaṃ kṛtvā ādyabhāgāṃta mācaret || homasyeśānadigbhāge dhānyopari śubhaṃ ghaṭaṃ | paṃcagavyaṃ ghaṭesthāpya tilāṃ statra vinikṣipet || "kaṣā yoniryāsaṃ ||" vastrayugmeca saṃchādya gaṃdhādyai rarcayettataḥ | viṣṇuṃ varuṇa mabhyarcya pratimāyaṃ vidhānataḥ || yata iṃdrādi bhirmaṃtraiḥ kuṃbhaṃ spṛṣṭvābhi maṃtrayet | "yata iṃdreti ṣaḍṛcaḥ sūktaśeṣāḥ||" dadhi madhvājya muktena homaṃ kūryātprayatnataḥ || "yukteneti bhāvoktaḥ vegenetyardhaḥ ||" āpohiṣṭeti tisṛbhi rapsumesoma ityatha | tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃpada makṣibhyā mitisūktataḥ || ṛgbhirābhiḥ pratyṛcaṃca aṣṭāviṃśati saṃkhyayā | aśaktāvaṣṭasaṃkhyaṃvā dadhi madvājya saṃyutaṃ || ādhityādi grahāṇāṃ ca homaṃ kiryātsamaṃtrakaṃ | "grahāṇāṃ ca dadhyayuta homaṃ kuryādityeke ||" anyadhā punardadhyādi grahaṇasya vaiyyardhyāvataiḥ || iti prasava śāṃtiḥ || a dha go pra sa va pra yo gaḥ karta asya bālakasya amukanakṣatrotpatti sūcita ariṣṭa śāṃtrdhaṃ gomukha prasavaṃ kariṣye || iti saṃkalpyaṃ || ādau gaṇeśaṃ saṃpūjya ācāryaṃ vṛṇuyāt | ācāryaḥ śveta curṇa padmaṃ kṛtva vrīhiṣu śūrpaṃ tatra raktavastraṃ tatra tilā nvikīrya śūrpeprājmkhaṃ śiśuṃ nidhāya sutreṇa śūrpaṃ veṣaṭimityā śiśusamīpe gomukha mānīya prasavaṃ vibhāvya viṣṇuryonimiti sūktena paṃcagavyena śiśuṃ ssāpayitvā gavāmaṃgeṣviti maṃtreṇa gāṃspṛśet | maṃtrastu || gavāmaṃgeṣu tiṣṭaṃti bhuvanāni caturdaśa || yasmāttasmācchivaṃyesyā dataśśāṃtiṃ prayacchame || tato pitā punaḥ mātredatvā || vastra mapanīyamukha mīkṣate || tataḥ ācāryaḥ paṃcagavyena śiśuṃ apohiṣṭeti tisṛbhiḥ abhiṣiṃcet || tataḥ pitā aṃgādaṃgāditi śiśuṃ mūrdni triravaghrāya || asya gomukhasya prasavasya puṇyāhaṃ bhavaṃto bṛvaṃtuḥ evaṃ vṛddhiśrīḥ kalyāṇamiti kṣistriryāca yitvā || ācāryāyatāṃgāṃ dadyāt || grahaprītyardhaṃ go vastra svarṇa dhānyāni yadhāśakti bhūyasīṃ dadyāt || tato ācāryaḥ agniṃ navagrahāṃśca prataṣṭhāpya || anvādānaṃ cakṣuṣī ājyenetyaṃtamuktvā || tatra pradhānaṃ || āpaścaturvāraṃ || dadhi madhvājyena viṣṇuṃ sakṛt || yakṣmāṇaṃ akṣībhya mitisūktena pratyṛca maṣṭaviṃśati saṃkhyayāvā || grahānaikaikayāhutvā || śeṣeṇa sviṣṭakṛta mityājyabhāgāṃte || īśānyaṃ kuṃbhaṃ saṃsthāpya | tatra paṃcagavya tilān kṣiradṛmakaṣāyāṃśca kṣiptvā || vastrayugme nāveṣṭya || pūrṇa pātre tadviṣṇo ritiviṣṇuṃ || tatvāyāmīti varuṇaṃcāvāhya || saṃpūjya kuṃbhaṃspṛṣṭvā || yata iṃdretiṣaṇṇāṃ kaṇvaputra pragāthaḥ || iṃdro | bārhataṃ pragāthacchaṃdaḥ || etān japtvā yajamānena tyāgekṛte mālitairdadhi madvājyaiḥ pratyṛcamaṣṭāviṃśati saṃkhyayāvāṣṭa saṃkhyayāvā juhuyāt || āpohiṣṭhet || tadviṣṇo rmedhātithi rviṣṇurgāyatrī || akṣībhyā mitiṣaṇṇāṃ vivṛhayakṣmahanuṣṭhun || etaiḥ pratimaṃtraiḥ aṣṭāviṃśati raṣṭauvāhutvā grahamaṃtraiścaikaikāhūtiṃ dadhi madhvājyenahutvā - sviṣṭakṛdādi śeṣaṃ samāpya brahmaṇān bhojayet || iti gomukha prasavaprayogaḥ || atha tathi nakṣatra lagna yogakaraṇādi gaṃḍāṃtajānāṃ krameṇa śātayaḥ utyate || tatra nakṣatra gaṃḍāṃtajāta śāṃti rārabhyate || satri vidhaḥ || tithi nakṣatra lagna bedhāt || gaṃḍāṃto nāma saṃthi ghaṭikāḥ || sacokto jyotirnibaṃdhe || pūrṇānaṃdākhyayostidhyoḥ saṃdhirnāḍīdvayaṃ tadhā || gaṃḍāṃtaṃ mṛtyudaṃ janmayātro dvāhavratādaṣu || kulīra sihmayoḥ kīṭa cāpayo rmīna moṣayoḥ |ṣa gaṃḍāṃta maṃtarālaṃsyāt ghaṭikārdaṃ mṛtipradaṃ || sārveṃdra pauṣmabheṣvaṃtya ṣoḍaśāṃ śābha saṃbhavaḥ || tadagrabhoṣu ca tathāpādaṃ gaṃḍāṃta saṃjñitaṃ || ratmamālā yāṃtu nakṣatreṣu matāntaramuktaṃ || pauṣmāśvinyoḥ sārpapitryarkṣa yoścayacca jyoṣṭāmūlayo raṃtarālaṃ | tadgaṃḍāṃtaṃsyā caturnāḍi kāhiyātrā janmo dvāhakāleṣvaniṣṭaṃ || atra doṣatāratamyaṃ jñoyaṃ ratna saṃgrahe || sarveṣāṃ gaṃḍajātānāṃ parityāgo vidhīyate | sarjayedadarśanaṃ yāvadvarṣaṃ ṣāṇmāsikaṃ tathā || tidhyarkṣagaṃḍe pitṛmātṛ nāśo lagnetu saṃdau tanayasya nāśa | sarvaṣuno jīvatihaṃti baṃdhūn jīvansunassyā dbahuvāraṇāśvaḥ || prayoga pārajāte gargabrahmau | aśvinī makha mūlādau triṣaṇḍavacanāḍikāḥ | revatī sārpaśākrāṃte mānartvaya saṃdhinaḥ || aśvinī makha mūlādau nāḍikādvitayaṃ tathā | revatī sārpaśākrāṃte nāḍikādvayamevahi || aśvi makha mūlānāṃ pūrvārdhe pitṛpīḍhanaṃ | pū,āhiśakrapaścārde jananīṃ bādhyate śiśuṃ || putṛghnastu divājāto rātrijātastu mātṛhā || dinastha gaṃḍāṃtajāta ityarthaḥ || ātmaghna ssaṃdhyayorjāto nāstigaṃḍo nirāmayaḥ | sarveṣāṃ gaṃḍajātānāṃ parityāgo vidhīyate || varjaddarśanaṃ śrāvaṃ taccaṣāṇmā sikaṃ bhavet | tasya śāṃtiṃ pravakṣyāmi somamaṃtreṇa bhaktimān || kāṃsyapātraṃ prakurvīta palaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirnavā | aṣṇābhiśca caturbirvā dvākhyāṃvā śobhanaṃ tathā || tanmadhye pāyasaṃ śaṃkhe navanītenapūrite | rājataṃ caṃdramamala marcayotsita puṣpakaiḥ || dhavalaiḥ kṣaumavāsāntu śukla mālyāṃbarāvṛtaḥ | somoha mitisaṃcitya pujāṃ kuryādataṃ dritaḥ || jape tsāhasrakaṃ maṃtraṃ śraddhayāca samāhitaḥ | dadyādvai dakṣiṇāṃcāpi gaṃḍadoṣa praśāṃtaye || śuklāṃ vāgīśvarīṃcaiva tāmrapātra samanvitāṃ | gaṃḍadoṣopa śāṃtyardhaṃ dadyādvedavide śuciḥ || jyotirvibaṃde ekadaṃtedhika mapyuktaṃ divājātaṃ mātṛyuktaṃtu rātrijaṃ | snāpaye tpitṛmātṛbhyāṃ saṃdhyayorubhayopapi || kāṃsyapātre ghṛtaṃ dadyā dgaṃḍadoṣopaśāṃtayo | sakṣīraṃ mauktikaṃ śaṃkhaṃ śvetavastrayugaṃ śubhaṃ || yajurveda vide dadyāt dgaṃḍadoṣāpanuttaye | dadyāddemaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca grahāṃścāpi prapūjyayot || āyurvṛddhikaraṃ japtvā kuryādbrāhmaṇa tarpaṇaṃ | atra gomukhaprasave navagraha śāṃtiśca kāryaḥ || anyat spaṣṭamiti prayogenocyate || iti gargokte nakṣatrādi gaṃḍāṃtajāta śāṃtiḥ || atha tithi lagna gaṃḍāṃtajāta śāṃtiḥ || uttara gārgyaḥ || tithi gaṃḍā ntatajātasya sutasyatudine tithau | śāṃtiḥ śubhehnivā kārya | tāvatputraṃnalokayet || tithi gaṃḍetvanaḍvāhaṃ nakṣatre dhenumevaca | kāṃcanaṃ lagnagaṃdetu gaṃḍadoṣo vinaśyati || ādyabhāgaḥ piturgaṃḍaṃ trayāṇā mabhiṣecanaṃ || mātāpitṛ śiśūnā mityarthaḥ || uttarātiṣya citrāsu pūrvāṣoḍhodbhavasyaca | kuryādvastradvayānvitaṃ || varuṇa syārcanaṃ kāryaṃ svastivācana pūrvakaṃ | kuṃbhe varuṇanakṣatrādhipatiṃ ca pūjayodityardhaḥ || śatauṣadhāni ratnāni mṛttvakpallava saṃyutān | pūjāṃte samudannājyai rhomaṃ tilayavaistathā || tataḥ pūrṇahutiṃ hutvā vedādhyāyi kuṭuṃbine | uttarā pradhamepāde tilaprātaṃ tathaivaca || tiṣyetugāṃ savatsāṃ ca suśīlāṃca payasvinīṃ | ajāṃcitrāsu vaidadyāt pūrvāṣāḍhetu kāṃcanaṃ || yavāṃsca vrīhi māṣāṃśca tilamudgān pradāpayet || tathā vattāmusāreṇa kuryā dbāhmaṇabhojanaṃ || piturāyuṣya vṛdyardhaṃ śāṃtiratra vidhīyate | evaṃ yaḥ karute samyake śāṃtikarma samāhitaḥ || āyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ saṃprāpnotidinedine || iti tithilagna gaṃḍāṃtajāta śāṃti || atha dinakṣayādi śāṃtiḥ | uttara gārgyaḥ || athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi janmakāle viśeṣataḥ | gaṃḍāṃtānāṃ ca nāmāni mahādoṣakarāṇica || dinakṣayo vyatīpāte vyāghāte viṣṭivaidhṛtau | śūle gaṃḍeti gaṃḍeca parighe yamakaṃṭake || kālagaṃḍe mṛtyuyoge dagdhayogesudāraṇe | tasmin gaṃḍadineprāpte pranūtiryadijāyate || atidoṣakarīprokta tatra pāpayutesati | dinakṣayādau gaṃḍāṃtaśabdoyaṃ pāribāṣikaḥ || yajanaṃ devatānāṃ ca grahāmāṃcaiva pūjanaṃ | dīpaṃ śivālayebhaktyā ghṛtena paridāpayet || abhiṣekaṃ śaṃkarāya aśvaddhasya pradakṣiṇaṃ | āyurvṛddhikaraṃ jāpyaṃ sarvāriṣṭa vināśanaṃ || mṛtyuṃjaya maṃtrastu āśuśśiśāna ityādi yapa ityarthaḥ | gurudai vata viprāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ gotra vardhanaṃ | sarvāriṣṭaharārdhāya grahayajñaṃ namācaret || śivāya vidhivaddhakyā dīpadānaṃ karutiyaḥ | akhaṃḍaṃ goghṛtenai vasavai mṛtyuṃ jayennaraḥ | viṣṇumūrtiṃ mahāpūṇya maśvatthaṃ śrīkaraṃsadā | pradakṣiṇaṃ sarobhakyā yaḥkaroti narottamaḥ || akālamṛtyuṃ nirjatya dīrghāyurjāyatedhruvaṃ || gāṇāpatyaṃ ca puṃsūktaṃ sauraṃ mṛtyujayaṃ śubhaṃ śāṃtiṃ japyaṃ rudrajāpyaṃ kṛtvā mṛtyuṃjayī bhavet || mulevā sārsagaṃḍevā kūryādetāniyatnataḥ | āyurvṛddhikarāyātha gaṃḍadoṣa praśāṃtaye || eṣamūlādi śāṃtyā samuccayaḥ || iti sarvagaṃḍa śāṃtiḥ || atha viṣaghaṭikā śāṃtiḥ || tadāha
