mātuśca viṣaśastrāstraiḥ krūre lagneṃśagepivā | taddoṣaparihārāya śāṃtikarma samācaret || rudro yamogni mṛtyuśca devatāḥ parakīrtitāḥ | suvarṇena yadhāśakyā tattallakṣaṇalakṣitāḥ || pratamāḥ kārayitveva māḍhaka vrīhikasthale | sthaṃḍilaṃ parikalpyātha kuṃbhamauṣadhi saṃyutaṃ || jalaiḥ saṃpūryasaṃsthāpya mṛgādiprakṣipetattataḥ | vastradvayena saṃveṣṭaya paṃcaratnāni nikṣipet || kuṃbhoparisaṃsthāpya ca tasraḥ pratimāstathā | saṃsthāpya tatra maṃtraiśca kramādarceddunettathā || samiccaru ghṛtadravyaiḥ pratyekaṃ ca yathākramaṃ | ṛtvigbhiśca sahacāryohu nedaṣṭasahasrakaṃ || aṣṭottaraśataṃ nātha aṣṭaviṃśatimenavā | tata stilairhuneddevān tattanmaṃtraiśca kṛtyavit || tatobhiṣe ca yoddānaṃ maṃtraiḥ paurāṇikaiḥ kramāt | prīyātāṃ bhagavānīśaḥ pinākī sarvatomukhaḥ || tamamurtipradānena mama pāpaṃ vināśaya | daṃṣṭrākarālavadano nīlāṃjana samūkṛtiḥ | raktākṣosigadāpāṇi rmṛtyormāṃ pāpi sarvadā || dānamevaṃ vidhairmaṃtr ryathāvidhi samāhitaḥ | go bhū hiraṇya vastrśca ācāryaṃ pūjayotsudhīḥ || evaṃ kuryādvidhā nena viṣadoṣaḥ praśāmyati || iti ghaṭikāśāṃtiḥ || atha tithi prasavaśāṃtiḥ || tatra kṛṣṇa caturdaśī jāta śāṃtiḥ || prayoga pārijāte gargaḥ || kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ prasūteṣaḍvidhaṃ phalaṃ | caturdaśīṃ ca ṣaḍbhāgaṃ kuryādādau śubhaṃ smṛtaṃ || dvitīyaḥ pitaraṃ haṃti tṛtī yo mātaraṃ tathā | caturdho mātulaṃ haṃti paṃcame vaṃśa nāśanaṃ || ṣaṣṭheca dhanahāni ssyādātmano vaṃśanāśanaṃ | yasmātsarva prayatnena śāṃtiṃ kuryādvi dhānataḥ || ācārya mṛtvijo vṛtvā svasti vācana pūrvakaṃ | rudrādi devatāṃ stasmātkarṣamātra suvarṇataḥ || tadardādhenavā kuryādvitta śāṭhya kuryādi dhānataḥ || ācārya mṛtvijo vṛtvā svasti vācana pūrvakaṃ | rudrādi devatāṃ stasmātkarṣamātra suvarṇataḥ || tadardādhenavā kuryādvi dhanātaḥ || ācārya mṛtvijo vṛtvā svasti vācana pūrvakaṃ | rudrādi devatāṃ stasmātkarṣamātra suvarṇataḥ || tadardādhenavā kuryādvitta śāṭhya vivarjitaḥ | pratimāṃ kāraye ccaṃbho | sarvalakṣaṇa saṃyutāṃ || vṛṣabheca samāsīnaṃ varadābhaya pāṇinaṃ | śuddha sphatika saṃkāśaṃ śvetamālyāṃbarānnitaṃ | triyaṃbakākhya maṃtreṇa pūjāṃ kuryādvi dhānataḥ | sthāpaye ccaturaḥ kuṃbhān vidikṣu ca yadhāvidhi | āgneyī mārabhya vidikṣvityarthaḥ || āgneyaṃ kuṃbha mārabhye tyagre darśanāt || puṇyatīrdha jalopetān dhānyasmo parisyaset || tanmadhyesthāpayetkuṃbhaṃ śatacchidra samanvitaṃ | paṃca mṛtpaṃca ratnāni paṃcatva kpaṃca pallavān || paṃca dhānyaṃ suvarṇaṃca tattasmaṃtrai rvinikṣi pet || śatauṣadhāni nikṣipya śveta vastraśca veṣṭayet || surabhīṇica puṣpāṇi śvetāni pariveṣayet | sarve samudrā ssarita stīrdhāni jaladānadāḥ || āyāṃtu yajamānasya duritakṣaya kārakāḥ | āvāhya vāruṇai rmaṃttr ranenaca vidhānataḥ || imaṃmme varuṇe tyanayā tatvāyā mītivātathā | tvanno agne ityanayā satvanna iti maṃtrataḥ || ānobhadrākhya sūktaṃca bhadrā agneśca sūktakaṃ | japtyātu puruṣasūktaṃ kadrudraṃtu kramājjapet || īśvarasyābhiṣekaṃca graha pūjāṃca kārayet | pūjāṃ karmasu nirvṛtya homaṃ kuryādhvi dhānataḥ || grahasyeśāna digbhāge kuṃḍaṃ kuryā dvidhānataḥ | vistārā yāmakhātaṃ cāpyaratnadvaya saṃmmitaṃ || kuṃḍa kaṃṭhaṃ piratyajya samaṃtā daṃgulaṃ kramāt | mekhalocchrāya vistārau catustrī dvyaṃgulaiḥ kramāt || paścime madhyabhāgetu yoniṃ kuryādvi dhānataḥ || yoniṃ ṣaḍaṃgulyāṃ tiryagdvā daśāṃguladairghikāṃ | aśvaththadala saṃkāśāṃ kiṃcinni mnāyatāṃ śubhāṃ || kuryā dāghāra paryaṃtaṃ svagṛhyokta vidhānataḥ | samidhājyaṃcaruṃcaiva tilimāṣāmaśca sarṣapaiḥ || sarṣapaiḥ sahitā tila māṣā ityardhaḥ || aśvaddha plakṣapālāśa samidbhiḥ khādiraiḥ śubhaiḥ || aṣṭottara sahasraṃvā aṣṭottara śataṃ tuvā | aṣṭāviṃśati retaiśca homaṃ kuryātprudhak‌ pṛthak || triyaṃbakena maṃtreṇa tilān vyāhṛtibhiḥ kramāt || graha evaṃca hotavyā - asmadukta vidhānataḥ | evaṃ krameṇa hutvādhā homaśeṣaṃ samāpayet || sarvālaṃkāra yuktānā trayāṇā mabhiṣe canaṃ || trayo mātā pitṛ bālāḥ || caturbhiḥ kalaśairadbhiḥ bṛhatkuṃbha samanvitaṃ - bṛhatkuṃbhaṃ śatacchidraṃ || dautāṃairāṇi dhṛtvātha kuryā dājyāvalokanaṃ || pūrṇahutiṃ juhuyā dyajamāna samannitaḥ || tatsarvaṃ parāyā bhaktyā īśvarāya nivedayet | sarvālaṃkāra saṃyuktāṃ savatsāṃgāṃ payasvīnīṃ || pratimāṃ vastrayugmaṃ cāpyā cāryaya nivedayet | īśvara prītaye śaktyā karyādbrāhmaṇa bhojanaṃ evaṃ yaḥ kurute śāṃtiṃ sarvapāpaiḥ prayucyate sarvānkāmāna vāpnoti sthirajīvī sukhī bhavet || iti kṛṣṇa caturṣaśī śāṃtiḥ || atha prayogaḥ || kartā pitrādyariṣṭādau gomukha prasavaṃ kṛtā | deśakālau saṃkīrtyā asaya bālakasya kṛṣṇa caturdaśī janma sūcitāriṣṭa nirasana dvārā parameśvara prītyardhaṃ sanava grahaṃ makha garbitaṃ kṛṣṇa caturdaśī jananaśāṃtiṃ kariṣye iti saṃkalpya || gaṇeśapūjā puṇyāhavācana nāṃdī śrāddācārya tvrīgvaraṇāni kuryāt | tataḥ ācāryaḥ āgneyādi vidikṣu caturaḥ kuṃbhānmadhyeca śatacchidre paṃcamṛdaḥ paṃca pallavān paṃcaratnāni paṃcatvacaḥ paṃcadhānyāni suvarṇaṃ satauṣadhīśca nikṣipya vastr rmalyaiścaveṣṭa yitvā || pūrṇapātre karṣata darthārda kṛtāṃ rudra pratimāṃ - triyaṃbakamiti maṃtreṇa saṃpūjya āgneyādi koṇeṣu kaṃbhān saṃsthāpya || imaṃmme - tatvāyāmi - tvanno āgne || sarve samudrā ssarita stīrthāni jalamānadāḥ | āyāṃtu yajamānasya duritakṣaya kārakāḥ || āgneyādi koṇastha kalaśa pratimāsu imaṃmme ityādi tri bhirmaṃ taiḥ sarve samudrā iti varuṇaṃ ca saṃpūjya rudraṃ paṃca śāṃtiṃ anobhadrā - bhadrāgneḥ sahasra śīrṣāṃ - kadrudrāya āyustūktāni japet || tatogre grahaṇāṃ sthāpanaṃ ca kṛtvā samidvaya mādāyaca kṣuṣyaṃtetra pradānaṃ rudra maśvattha plakṣa palāśa khādira samidājya carutila māṣa sarṣapa dravyaiḥ pratyeka maṣṭa sahasra maṣṭaśata maṣṭāviṃśati vāraṃvā tryaṃbaka maṃtreṇa prajāpatiṃ vyastābhi ssamasatavyāhṛtibhiḥ sahasmādi vibhūtiṃ dhṛtvā kāṃsyapātre rūpaṃ rūpa mityājyaṃ sakuṭuṃbo valokya sadakṣiṇaṃ saprātaṃ ācāryāyagāṃ vastrayugamṛtvigbhyaśca dakṣiṇāṃ ca datvā viprān saṃbhojya karma rudrārpaṇaṃ kṛtvā bhuṃjīteti || iti śrī kamalākara kṛta kṛṣṇa caturdaśī śāṃti prayogaḥ || atha sinīvālikuhū śāṃtiḥ || prayoga pārijāte uttaragargyaḥ || sinīvālyāṃ pranūtāsya ddāsībhāryā paśustadhā | gajāśva mahiṣīcaiva śakrasyāpi śrīyaṃ | godānaṃ vastradānaṃ svarṇaṃcorvīṃ varāṃ śūbhāṃ || daśadānācicoktāni kṣīra mājyaṃ guḍastathā | godānādi rdaśa dānāṃtargatepi dviranuṣṭhānaṃ || ājyāvekṣaṇametāni tattanmaṃtraiśca kārayet | pratiṣṭhāpya || grahaṇāṃ dhānyānivādadyāt || cakṣuṣī ājyenetyaṃte atra pradhānaṃ rudra maśvattha palkṣa palāśakhadira samudājyacaru yava tila miśra māṣaiḥ pratyeka maṣṭottara śata saṃkhyāyā maṃtraiḥ rabhiṣikto yajamāna ācāryādibhyo daśadānāni dadyāt || gavā maṃgeṣvitigāṃ || śaraṇyaṃ sarva lokānāṃ lajjāyā rakṣaṇaṃ paraṃ | suveṣadāri vastratva madhaḥ śāṃtiṃ prayacchame || iti vastraṃ || hiraṇya garbheti hiraṇyaṃ || sarvabhūtāśrayā bhūmirvarāheṇa samuddhṛtā | anaṃta sasya phaladā madaḥ śāṃtiṃ prayacchame || iti bhūmiṃ || kṣīraṃ tvidaṃ śaṃkhavarṇaṃ kṣīrādamṛta saṃbhavaṃ | kṣīrātkṣīrota kīrtiśca kṣīre prāṇasya saṃsthitaḥ || tasmāt kṣīra pradāsena adhaḥ śāṃtiṃ prayacchame || iti kṣīraṃ || kāmadhenusu saṃbhūtaṃ sarvakratuṣu saṃsthitaṃ | devānāmājya māhara madaḥ śāṃtiṃ prayacchame || ityājyaṃ || yadhā deveṣu viśvātma pravaraśca madaḥ śāṃtiṃ prayacchame || ityājyaṃ || yadhā deveṣu viśvātma pravaraśca janārdanaḥ | sāmavedastu vedānāṃ maha destu yegināṃ || praṇavaḥ sarvamaṃtrāṇāṃ nārīṇāṃ pārvātī maha destu yegānāṃ || praṇavaḥ sarvamaṃtrāṇāṃ nārīṇāṃ pārvatī yathā | tathā rasānāṃ pravaraḥ sadaivekṣu rasosmṛtaḥ || tvaṃme tasmātparāṃ lakṣmīṃ dadasvaguḍa sarvadā || iti guḍaṃ || tataḥ kāṃsya prāte rūpaṃ rūpamiti maṃtreṇa sakuṭuṃbaḥ svapratirūpaṃ vīkṣya || ājyaṃ tejassamuddiṣṭa mājyaṃ pāpaharaṃ smṛtaṃ || ājyaṃ sūrāṇāmā haramājye devāḥ pratiṣṭhatāḥ || ityājya pātraṃ || tato daśa dānāni || tānica || go bhū tila hiraṇyājya vāso dhānya guḍanica || raupyaṃ lavaṇa mityā hurdaśa dānāni paṃḍitā iti || teṣu ṣaṇṇāṃ maṃtrā uktāḥ || mahārṣe gotra saṃbhūtāḥ kaśyapasya tilāḥ smṛtāḥ | tasmādeṣāṃ pradānena mama pāpaṃ vyapohatu || iti tilān || sarva deva mayaṃ dhānyaṃ sarvottapattikaraṃ mahāt | prāṇināṃ jīvanopāya madaḥ śāṃtiṃ prayacchame || iti dhānyaṃ prītiryātiḥ pitṛṇāṃca viṣṇu śaṃkarayo ssadā | śivanetrotbhavaṃ rāpyamataḥ śāṃtiṃ prayacchame || iti rūpyaṃ || yasmādannarasāḥ sarve notkṛṣṭā lavaṇaṃ vinā | śaṃbhoḥ prītikaraṃ nitya mataḥ śāṃtiṃ prayaccame || iti lavaṇaṃ || etāni dakṣiṇāyuktāni deyāni || keciddakṣiṇāmapi pāṭhakramāṃ madhye kurvaṃti | tataḥ rudrapratimāṃ tryiyaṃbaka mityabhiṣekaṃ kṛtvā uttarapūjāṃ kṛtvā visṛjyācāryahaste datvāgniṃ visṛjya saṃpūrṇatāṃ vācayitvā || viprān bhojanayet || sīnīvālī kuhordarśa śāṃtyā samuccayaḥ || avyabhicārādikecit || tasmātsinīvālyāmeveyaṃ śāṃtirastarbhūtā || kuhvaṃtu doṣamātramuktaṃ | darśaḥ sūryeṃdusaṃgama iti kuhvā evadarśitatvāt tatra darśaśāṃtire vetiḥ nātra gomukha prasavaḥ || iti sinīvālīkuhū śāṃtiprayogāḥ || athāto darśajātānāṃ mātāpitrordaridratā | taddoṣaparihārārdhaṃ śāṃtiṃ vakṣyāmite sadā || puṇyāhaṃvāca mitvāca kratu saṃkalpapūrvakaṃ | kuṃḍaṃvā maṃḍalaṃ kuryāttaddettaddeśesthāpayodghaṭaṃ || maṃḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ - tatkuṃbhe nikṣipeddravyaṃ dadhi kṣīra ghṛtādikaṃ | ādiśabdo dgomūtra gomayasya grodhauduṃbarāśvatthacuta niṃbakā tathā - paṃcaratnāni nikṣipya vastrayugme naveṣṭayet || sarve samudrāssaritaḥ tīrdhāni jaladānadāḥ | āyāṃtu yajamānasya duritakṣayakārakāḥ || āpohiṣṭhetṛcācaiva kayānaścitra ityṛcā | yatkiṃce damṛcācaiva samudrajeṣṭhāḥ salilasyamadhyā tpunānāyaṃtya niviśa mānāḥ | iṃdroyā vajrīvṛṣabho rarādātāsāpo devī rihamāmavaṃtu || yāsāpo divyāsutavāsravaṃti khanitrimāsutavāyāḥ svayaṃjāḥ | samudrārdhayaḥ śucayaḥ pāvakāstās āpodevī rihamāmavaṃtu || yāsāṃ rājāvaruṇo yātimadhye satyānṛtesavapaśya njanānāṃ | madhuścutaḥ śucayo yāḥ pāvakāstāsāpo devī rihamāmavaṃtu || yāsurājā varuṇo yā susomo viśve devāyā sūrjaṃmadaṃti | vaiśvānaro yāḥ svagniḥ praviṣṭastāsāpo devī rihamāmavaṃtu || samudra jyaṣṭha ityṛcā || abhimaṃtryodakaṃ paścādagneḥ pūrvāprade śake | udaṅmabhakho mimatryaiva paścāt darśadevatāḥ sthāpayet || ityanvayaḥ || maṃḍalaṃ kuryāditi yaduktaṃ tadāha - hāridraṃ raktakaṃcaiva kṛṣṇaṃ śvetaṃ ca nīlakaṃ | eteṣāṃ taṃḍulaiścaiva sarvato bhadra muddharet || darśākhya devatāyāśca soma sūrya svarūpiṇī | pratimā svarṇajā śreṣṭhā rājatī tāmrajsthavā || darśadevatā rūpa soma sūrya svarūpāṃ pratimāṃ sthāpayeditya bhede nānvayaḥ - sarvato bhadra madhyeca sthāpaye ddarśadevatāṃ | graha varṇaṃ vastrayugmaṃ tadvarṇaṃ gaṃdha puṣpakaṃ || āpyāya sveti maṃtreṇa savitā paścātathaivaca | upacāraiḥ samārāthya tato homaṃ samācaret || kṛtvā vahniṃ pratiṣṭhāsya kraku saṃkalpa mīdṛśaṃ | "āyurārogya sithyarthaṃ sarvāriṣṭa praśāṃtaye || putrasya darśajanane doṣanirha raṇāyaca | mātā pitroḥ kumārasya sarvāriṣṭa praśāṃtaye || teṣā māyuśriyoḥ prāptyai śāṃti homaṃ karomyahaṃ |" iti ślokamaṃtrauḥ || hunetpa vitṛ maṃtreṇa somo dhenuṃca maṃtrataḥ | etairmatrai pṛthake caiva hunedaṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ || etairiti bahuvacanāt pitṛ daivatya homopyaṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ || dārśaśca davatā homaḥ aṣṭāviṃśati saṃkhyayā || homa mevaṃca kṛtvādhavi dadhyācchābhiṣecanaṃ || śrīsukta māyuṣaṃ sūktaṃ samudra jyeṣṭha ityṛcā | etai rmaṃtraiścābhiṣekaṃ mātā pitroḥ śiśostathā || tataḥ sviṣṭa kṛdādisyāt homa śeṣaṃ samāpayet | hiraṇyata rajataṃ caiva kṛṣṇāṃ dhenuṃ sadakṣiṇāṃ || anyebhyopi yadhāśakti dātavyā dakṣiṇā tadhā | brāhmaṇān bhojaye ttatra kāra yotsyasti vācanaṃ || atha darśaśāṃti prayogaḥ - deśakālau saṃkīrtyā, asya bālasya darśa janana sūcitāriṣṭa nira sanadvāra śrī parameśvara prītyardhaṃ darśa janana śāṃtiṃ kariṣye, iti saṃkalpya, gaṇeśa pūjā pūṇyavāhacan nāṃdī śrāddhācārya rtvigvaraṇāni kuryāt tatra ācāryaḥ kuḍāt sthaṃḍilātvāpūrve paṃcavarṇaiḥ taṃḍulai ssarvatobhadraṃ viracya, tanmadheya kuṃbhaṃ saṃsthāpya, tatra paṃcagavyaṃ nyagrodhauduṃbarāśvattha cūta niṃba vṛkṣamūlānāṃ tvakpallavāṃśca paṃcaratnāni nikṣipya, vastrayugme nāveṣṭya, sarve samudrāḥ iti maṃtreṇa, āpohiṣṭhetyṛcā || kayānaścitraḥ, yatkiṃcedaṃ, samudra jyeṣaiṭha iti cābhi maṃtrya pūrṇapātre āpyāyasveti somaṃ, savitāpaścāttāditi sūryamāvāhya, grahavarṇaiḥ gaṃdhapuṣpaiśca pūjayet || kecit pitṛn madhye, dakṣiṇo ttarayośca somasūryau, pūjayaṃti tatra mūlaṃciṃtyaṃ tatogniṃ, grahāṃśca pratiṣṭhāpya, atra prathānāṃ - grahān, somaṃ, sūryaṃca, aṣṭottara śatāṃviśatyanyatara saṃkhyāyā, samiccharvāhutibhiḥ, madhye kalpoktābhiṣecane naśeṣeṇasviṣṭa kṛtamityādi anvādadhyāt - paristaraṇādi ājyabhāgāte grahādīn hutvā, āyurārogyeti śloka maṃtrābhyāṃ homaṃ kṛtvā, hiraṇyavarṇā mitisūktena, āyuṣyaṃ varcasya mitisūktena, samudra jyeṣṭhā ityanayāca mātā pitṛ śiśū nabhiṣicya, sviṣṭakṛdādi balidānāṃte pūrṇā hutiṃ kṛtvā, homaśeṣaṃ samāpya, ācāryāya yathāśakti rajataṃ hiraṇyaṃ kṛṣṇāṃ dhenuṃca sadakṣiṇāṃ datvā, ṛtvigbhyo yathāśakti dakṣiṇāṃ datvā, uttara pūjāṃ vidhāya, visṛjyā, ācāryāya pratimāṃ dadyāt - agniṃ visṛjya, brāhmaṇān bhojayutva, śāṃti pāṭhayitvā, svastivācanaṃ kuryāt iti iti nārāyaṇabhaṭṭaṃ sūma rāmakṛṣṇa bhaṭṭātmaja kamālākarabhaṭṭa kṛta darśaśāṃti prayogaḥ iti tithi śāṃtayaḥ tatrādau jyeṣṭhā nakṣatra śāṃtiḥ tadutpattau phalaṃ brahmayāmale - jyeṣṭādau janane mātā dvitīye jananī pitā | tṛtīye jananī bhrātau svayaṃ mātā caturdhake || ātmānaṃ paṃcame haṃti ṣaṣṭhe gotrakṣayo bhavet | guptamecobha kulaṃ jyeṣṭha bhrātara maṣṭame || navameśva śuraṃ haṃti sarvaṃhaṃti daśāṃśakaḥ || vasiṣṭa - sureśa tārā janito dhavāgrajaṃ dvidaivatā rājanitastu devaraṃ | puraṃji darkṣeja nitascuta stathāsvasyāgrajaṃ haṃti saputrikāyadi || viśaṣo nirṇayasiṃdhau jñeyaḥ - prayogaḥ phārijete vṛddha gārgyaḥ - sukhāsīnaṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ gargaṃ muni gaṇānvitaṃ | kṛtvāṃja lipuṭo bhūtvā papraccha prati śānake || jyeṣṭha nakṣatra saṃbhūta gaṃḍadoṣa vinirṇayaṃ | tasyaśāṃtiṃ vithāvaṃca yathāvatkadha yāmyahaṃ || ghaṭikai kācamaitrauṃte jyeṣṭhādau ghaṭikādvāyaṃ | tayossaṃdhi ratijñeyaṃ śiśu gaṃḍaṃ samīritaṃ || prathameca dvitīyeca jyeṣṭha rkṣeca tṛtīyake | pādatreye jāta naraḥ jyeṣṭhopyatra prajāyate || jyeṣṭhāṃtya pādajātastu pituḥ svasya vināśanaḥ | jāyate nātra saṃdehaḥ daśāhābhyantare tathā || tṛtīye kanyakā jātāhaṃti śīghraṃ tathā grajaṃ | tacchāṃti tasya vakṣyāmi gaṃḍadoṣa praśāṃtiye || sudine śabha nakṣatre caṃdra tārā balānvite | bhūtakānte yathākuryā jyeṣṭhā śāṃtiṃ vidhānataḥ || vajrāṃkuśadharaṃ devaṃ airāvata gajānvitaṃ | kuryācchacīpatiṃ ramyaṃ deveṃdraṃ suranāyakaṃ || karṣa mātrama varṇena karṣārthenātha pādataḥ | tadvidhānaṃ prakurvīta vittaśāṭhyā sakārayet || śāli taṃḍula saṃpūrṇa kuṃbhasyo paripūjayet | iṃdrā yeṃdo marutvata iti maṃtreṇa vāgyataḥ || gaṃdha puṣpairdhupadīpaiḥ nānābhakṣva nivedanai | pūjaye davipralokapāla gaṇānvitaṃ || raktavastrādvayopetaṃ pūjaye tsuranāyakaṃ | tatra saṃsthāpaye tkuṃbhān caturdikṣu viśeṣataḥ || tanmadhye sthāpayetkuṃbhaṃ śatacchidra samanvitaṃ | puṇyodaka samāyuktān vastrayagma niveṣṭatān || kuṃbheṣu vinyaseddhīmān paṃcagavyaṃ samaṃtrakaṃ | paṃcāmṛtaṃ paṃcaratnaṃ mṛttikāḥ paṃcasaṃkhyākāḥ || paṃcavṛkṣa kaśāyāṃśca paṃcapallavakāṃ stathā | suvarṇaṃ kuśadūrvāśca nikṣipeccha satauṣadhīḥ || pūjayedvāruṇairmaṃtraiḥ catuḥkuṃbhān‌ prayatnataḥ | tvanno agnejapedadau satvannopi dvitīyakaṃ || samudrajyeti maṃtraṃ cemaṃmegaṃge caturdhakaṃ | pūjayedvastrayugmadyai ścaturaḥ kalaśānapi || kalaśasthān varuṇān prītyarthaḥ - japaṃkuryuḥ prayatnena maṃtrairebhiḥ dvijo ttamāḥ | anobhadrā japaṃkuryā dbhadrāagne rviśeṣataḥ || iṃdrasuktaṃ rudrasūktaṃ paraṃ mṛtyuṃjayaṃ tataḥ | iṃdraṃ saṃpūjya deveṃdraṃ varuṇaṃ kuṃbhasaṃsthitaṃ || susaṃkalpya vidhānena homakarma tataścaret | samidbhiḥ brahmavṛkṣasya śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yathā || sarpiṣā ca ruṇācaiva mūlamaṃtreṇa vāgyataḥ | hunejjapyenacaitena yata iṃdrabhayeti ca || tilān vyāhṛtibhirhutvā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ pṛthak | bhāryā śiśu samopetaṃ yajamānaṃ viśeṣataḥ || abhiṣekaṃ prakarvīta sūtrairvāruṇasaṃjñakaiḥ | samudra jyeṣṭhamaṃtraiścāpī maṃme varuṇaśṛthi || pṛthivī śāṃtādibhirmaṃtraiḥ abhiṣekaṃ samācaret | abhiṣeka nivṛttautu yajamāna ssamāhitaḥ || śuklāṃbarāṇi dhṛtvātha kuryā dājyāvalokanaṃ | rūpaṃ rūpaṃpeti maṃtreṇa citraṃ taccakṣurevavā || devatāpurataḥsthitvā dhūpa dīpa nivedanaṃ | dadyā dācamanaṃ samya ktāṃbūlarghye tathaivaca || namaste suranāthāya namastubhyāṃ śacīpate | gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayādattaṃ gaṃḍadoṣa praśāṃtaye || kāryaṃ yatpūjakādīnāṃ śubhaṃ labdhvā samarpayet | ācāryāya ca gāṃdadyā tsuśīlāṃca payasvinīṃ || raktavarṇāṃvatsayutāṃ sarvalaṃkārabhūṣitaṃ | vastrayugma pidhānaṃca yathā vibhavasārataḥ || yakṣa gaṃdharva siddhaiśca pūjitopi śacīpate | dānenānenadeveśa gaṃḍadoṣaṃ vināśaya || aṣṭottaraśataṃhutvā kuryādbrāhmaṇabhojanaṃ | tatopidakṣiṇāṃdatvā praṇipatya samāpayet || jyeṣṭha śāṃti mimāṃkṛtvā yathā vidhyuktamārgataḥ | gaṃḍadoṣaṃ vinirjatya āyuṣmān jāyate naraḥ || ityuktaṃ vṛddhagārgyeṇa śānakostra viśeṣataḥ | jyeṣṭhānakṣatrasaṃbhūta gaṃḍadoṣa praśāṃtaye || ājñānādvādhavājñānā dvaikalyādvāthanasyaca | yanyūnamatiriktaṃvā tatsarvaṃ kṣaṃtumarhapi || iti jyeṣṭānakṣatra śāṃtiḥ atha jyeṣṭhā nakṣatra śāṃti prayogaḥ || gomukha prasavaṃ kṛtvā, deśakālau smṛtvā, asyaśiśoḥ, jyeṣṭha nakṣatra sūcita sakalāriṣṭa śāṃtyardhaṃ, jyeṣṭhā nakṣatra śāṃtiṃ kariṣye, iti saṃkalpya, gaṇeśa pūjā puṇyahavācana nāṃdī śrāddhācārya rtvigvaraṇāni kuryāt, tataḥ ācāraḥ mahīdyauriti bhūmiṃ svṛṭvā, oṣada yassamiti yavānnikṣipya, ākalaśeśviti kalaśaṃ saṃsthāpya, gaṃthenābhyarcya, śāli taṃḍulaiḥ kalaśaṃ pūrayitvā, pūrṇā darvīti pūrṇa pātraṃ nidhāya, tadupari karṣatadarthārtha kṛtāṃ iṃdra pratimāṃ iṃdrā yeṃdo marutvata iti maṃtreṇa iṃdra - tattanmattraḥ lokapālāṃścā vāhva pūjayet | tataḥ pūrvādidikṣu caturaḥ kuṃbhāsmadhye śata ccidraṃ saṃsthāpya, dikkuṃbheṣu paṃcagavya paṃcāmṛta paṃcaratna paṃca mṛttikā paṃca pallava suvarṇa kuśadūrvā śatā ṣathīśchakṣiptvā, vastra yugmena veṣṭa yitvā, varuṇa māvāhya pūja yet tataḥ pūrvādi kalaśān tvanno agne - samudra jyeṣṭhā - imaṃme gaṃge - ityabhi maṃtrya āno bhadrā sūktaṃ āno bhadrāḥ kratavoyaṃtu viśvato dabdāsosāparītasasudbhidaḥ | devāno yathā sadamudvṛdesasannaprāyuvo rakṣitāro divedive || devānāṃ bhadrāsumatir ṛjūyatāṃ devānāṃ rāti rabhino nivartatāṃ | devānāṃ sakhyamupaseda māvayaṃ devānasāyuḥ pratiraṃtu jīvase || tūnpūrvayā nividā hūmahevayaṃ bhagaṃ mitramaditiṃ dakṣimasrithaṃ | āryamaṇaṃ varuṇaṃ soma maśvinā sarasvatīnaḥ subhagāma yaskarat || tannovāto mayo bhuvātu bheṣajaṃ tanmātā pṛthivī tatpitādyauḥ | tadāvāṇaḥ somasuto mayobhuva stadaśvinā śṛṇutaṃ thiṣṇyāyuvaṃ || tamīśānaṃ jagatastasdhuṣaspatiṃ thiyaṃ jinvamavase hūmahevayaṃ | pūṣāno yathā veda sāmasadṛdhe rakṣitāpāyuradabdhaḥ svastaye || svasti na iṃdro vṛddhakṣavāḥ svastinaḥ pūṣā viśvavedaḥ | svasti nastārkṣyo ariṣṭanemiḥ svastino bṛhaspati rdhathātu || pṛṣadaśvā marutaḥ pṛśnimārutaḥ śubhaṃ yā vāno vidatheṣu jagmayaḥ | agni jihvāmanavaḥ sūracakṣaso viśvenā devās āvasāgamanniha || bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāmadevā bhadraṃ paśyemākṣa bhiryajatrāḥ | sthirai raṃgai stuṣṭuvāṃsa stanūbhirvyaśema devahitaṃ yadāyaḥ || śataminnu śaradosāṃti devā yatrāna ścakrā jara saṃtanūnāṃ | putrā so yatra pitaro bhavaṃti māno mathyā rīriṣatāyurgaṃtoḥ || aditirdyau raditi raṃtarikṣa maditi rmātā sapitā saputraḥ | viśve devās āditiḥ paṃcajanā aditi rjāta maditi rjanitvaṃ || rudraṃ tryaṃbakaṃca japyvā iṃdrāyeṃdo, yata iṃdra bhayā mahe iti - itica aṣṭottara śataṃ, aṣṭā viṃśati, aṣṭā vā japeyuḥ - tatogniṃ - , grahāṃśca pratiṣṭhāpya, anvā dadyāt || atra pradhānaṃ || iṃdraṃ palāśa sasudājyaca ruḍravyaiḥ, aṣṭhottara śata saṃkhyayā, iṃdrāyeṃdo marutva iti maṃtreṇa prajāpatiṃ, tila dravveṇāṣṭottara śataṃvyā hṛtibhiḥ, śeṣeṇa sviṣṭakṛta mityādi balyaṃte pūrṇāhutiṃ pūrṇa pātra vimokaṃ ca kṛtvā, sahite kṣatra mityādi vāruṇa sūktaiḥ samudra jyeṣṭhāti caturbiḥ, imaṃme varuṇetya nayādyauḥ śāṃtiṃcābhiṣiṃcet || tato yajamānaḥ rupaṃ rūpamiti maṃtreṇa ājya mavalokya tatpātraṃsa dakṣiṇaṃ brāhmaṇāya datvā, iṃdraṃ saṃpūjya namaste suranāthā yanamastubhyaṃ śacīpate | gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayādattaṃ gaṃḍadoṣa praśāṃtaye || ityarghyuṃ datvā, ācāryādibhyo homādi janyaṃ śreyo gṛhītvā, ta miṃdrāya samarpya, ācāryāya rakta varṇāṃ vastra dvayayutāṃ savatsāṃgāṃ yakṣa gaṃdharva siddheśca pūjato siśacīpate | dānenāne nadeveśa gaṃḍadoṣaṃ vināśaya || iti maṃtreṇa dadyāt - tataḥ ṛtvigbhyonyebhyaśca dakṣiṇāṃ datvā uttara pūjāṃ vithāya visṛjya ājñānādvā thavā jñānādvai kalyādvā dhanasyaca | yannyūnāti riktaṃvā tatsarvaṃ kṣaṃtu marhasi || iti saṃprārdhya ācāryāya datvā, agniṃ saṃpūjya, vibhūtiṃ dṛtvau, visṛjya aṣṭa śataṃ viprān sadakṣiṇaṃ saṃbhojya, āśiṣo gṛhītvau, bhujīta iti jyeṣṭhā nakṣatra śāṃti prayogaḥ atha mūla nakṣatra śāṃtiḥ tatrau dauta dutpatti doṣaḥ - abhukta mūla saṃbhūtaṃ parityajettu bālakaṃ | samāṣṭakaṃ pitāvāthana tanmukhaṃ vilokayet || tadādyapādake tātaḥ vipadyat jananyadho | dhanakṣaya stṛtīyāṃśe caturdhake śubhāvahaḥ || pratīpa mantya pādesyat phalaṃtadeva sārpabhe || abhukta mūla māha vṛddha vaśiṣṭhaḥ - jyeṣṭhāṃte ghaṭikā caikā mūlādau ghaṭikādvayaṃ | abhuktamūla mityāhuḥ jātaṃ tatravivarmayet || bṛhaspatistu - jyeṣṭhāṃte ghaṭikārdhaṃtu mūlādau ghaṭikārdhakaṃ | tayoraṃtargatā nāḍī abhukta mūla mucyate || bṛhannāradastu - abhukta mūlagaṃḍā taṃ ghaṭikānāṃ catuṣṭayaṃ | tatreṃ drāṃtya ghaṭī dvaṃdvaṃ mūlādyadavaya mevaca || iti kaśyapa saṃhitā māṃtvanyadhā mūlamuktam - mūlādya pādajo haṃti pitaraṃtu dvitīyajaḥ | mātaraṃsvaṃ tṛtīyerdhān suhṛdaṃtu turīyajaḥ || phalaṃ tadeva sārparkṣe pratīpaṃtvaṃtya sādataḥ - pariśiṣṭe kātyāyanopi - prathame piturneṣṭā dvitīye mātustṛtīye dhanadhānyasya caturthe kula śokāpahaḥ svayama puṇyabhāgīsyāditi || vaśiṣṭaḥ - taurī yajaḥ śubhakaraḥ phalame tadeva | vailo yato bhujagathiṣṇya bhavasya sarvaṃ || pitrādeḥ svasyaca śubhakarīti jñeyaṃ jayārṇave - mūlaṃ stabhaṃtvaca śśākhā patraṃ puṣpaṃ | phalaṃ śikhā | vedāśca muna yaścaiva diśaśca vasava stathā || nava bāṇa rasā rudrā mūla bhedaḥ prakīrtitāḥ mūle mūla vināśā yastaṃbhe hānirdha nakṣayaḥ | tvaci bhrātṛ vināśāya śākhā mātṛ vināśakṛt || patre saparivārasya puṣpeṣu nṛpavallabhaḥ | phaleṣu labhate rājyaṃ śikhāyā malpa jīvitaṃ || anyatratu anyadhā uktaṃ - mūle saptaṃ - ghaṭīṣu mūlahananaṃ, staṃbheṣṭa sākhyakṣayaṃ | taddike baṃdhu vināśanaṃca viṭape rudrai rhato mātulaḥ || patrerkaiḥ - sukṛtīta bāṇa kujame maṃtrī phalesāgare - rājyaṃ vahni śikhālpa māyuriti sanmūlā ghruṣu syātphalaṃ patrādi ghaṭikānā mutta matveti carama doṣaḥ astyeva - yathā bhūpāla pallabhaḥ - vṛṣāśisiṃheṣu ghaṭetamūlaṃ, divisthitaṃ yugmatulāṃganāṃtye | pātālagaṃmeṣa dhanuḥ kulīra nakreṣu martyepyiti saṃsmaraṃti || etallagna phalaṃ - svargemūle bhavedrājyaṃ pātā leca dhanāgamaḥ | mṛtyuloke yadā mūlaṃ tadā śūnyaṃ samādiśet || yathā vasiṣṭhiḥ - vyatīpāteṃga hīniḥ syāt parighomṛtyu mādiśet | vaidhṛtau pitṛhāniḥ syāt saṣṭe dāvaṃ dhatāṃ vrajet || mūle samūlanāśasyāt kulanāśo dhṛtau bhavet | vikṛtāṃgaśca hīnaśca saṃdhya yorubha yorapi || parvaṇyapi prasūtiśca survāriṣṭa bhayapradā | tadvatta daṃta jātaśca pādajāta stathaivaca || tasmā cchāṃtiṃ prakurvita grahāṇāṃ kṛracetasāṃ - vyatīpātādau śāṃtigrahamakhayoḥ samuccayaḥ atrayat tat prakāreṇa grahamukha vidhānaṃ tat anārabhyā dhītasya saptadaśa ssamitrāviṃdā prakaraṇasthe naiva upasaṃhārāt itareṣu śāṃti kaṣu graha makhānāvaśyakatvārthaṃ - śaunakaḥ - athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi mūlajāta hitāvaca | mātā pitrārthanasyāpi kulasya svahitāyaca || tyāgovā mūlajātasya syādaṣṭābdātpradarśanaṃ | abhukta mūlajātānāṃ parityāgo vidhīyate || adarśanādāpi pituḥ satutiṣṭhe tsamāṣṭakaṃ | evaṃ ca duhiturgneyaṃ mūlajāta phalaṃ budhaiḥ || mukhyakālaṃ pravakṣyāmi śāṃtihomasya yatnataḥ | jātasya dvādaśāhetu janmarkṣevā śubhedine || samāṣṭake dvādaśāhe maṃṭapaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ | puṇyabhi mantritaistoyaiḥ prokṣitāmāṃkṣitautataḥ || ṛtvijastu kaśyaponoktāḥ - brāhmaṇośrotriyāścāṣṭau dvādaśatvathaṣoḍaśeti | tatroda kuṃbhaṃśukla kṣṇaṃrakta vramavivarjitaṃ || akṛṣṇa mūlanirṇiktaṃ pūrṇaye nnirmalāṃbhasā - nirṇiktaṃ hidhautaṃ - vastrāvakuṃṭhitaṃkuryāryātpūraye ttīrthavāriṇā | kurvan hemasamāyuktaṃ cūtapallava saṃyutaṃ || svastikoparivinyasya nakṣīradrumapallavaiḥ | droṇavrīheṃścanikṣapya īśānyāṃ ca nidhāpayet || paṃcaratnāni nikṣipya sarvauṣadhi samanviti | arcitaṃ gaṃdhapuṣpādyaiḥ śrīrudraṃca spṛśan‌japet || ṣaḍaṃganahitaṃ samyak saṃjapedrudrasaṃkhyayā | ऒhvṛco rudrasūktai rvachaṃdorgo rudrasāmagaiḥ || ekādaśāṣṭatridvyeka saṃkhyayā śaktitojapet | anayā saṃkhyayācaiva rudrasuktaṃ ca sāmasu || tatrā pratirathaṃ suktaṃ śatarudrānuvākakaṃ | śatarudrānuvākaḥ tvamagne rudra iti - rakṣāmaṃtraṃ tathā puṇyaṃ rakṣoghnaṃ ca spṛśanjapet || eteṣāmapi ekādaśādi saṃkhyayā japaḥ - tryaṃbakaṃtu japetasamyak‌ aṣṭottara sahasrakaṃ | ekavāraṃ tathācāpi pāvamānīṃ spṛśan‌japet || japasya paṃcakuṃbhāḥsyuḥ dvayaṃvātadalābhataḥ | rudrakaṃbho niṛtikuṃbhaśca bhinnaḥ evaṃ saptakuṃbhāḥ || rudrakuṃbho madhye īśānādikoṇa catuṣṭe catvāra iti paṃcavā - kaśyapa saḥhitāyāṃca śacicchidraṃ koṇeṣu catvāraḥ evaṃ paṃcakuṃbhāḥ - īśānādi catuṣkoṇeṣva praṇān jalapūritān | pūrvokta dravya saṃyuktān sthāpayedrakta varṇakān || śatacchidraṃ bṛhatkuṃbhaṃ sthāpaye ttaṃḍulopari tatrapūrvo dita sūkta japaḥ tevai voktaḥ - rudreṇa krama lobhadrā bhadrā agne subhaktitaḥ || ānobhadrā anenaiva puṃ sūktenaiva cārcayet || mocanī mūlajāmityaṣṭa vākyāni ekako japet - kuṃbhadvaya pakṣe catuḥ prasravaṇa muktaṃ kātyāyanena - dvitīyoda kuṃbhaṃ kṛtvṛ catuḥ prasravaṇanaṃ yuktaṃ - tatra varuṇa mupariṣṭā nmūlāni dhārayet - vaṃśa pātre kṛtvā, vastrebhadveti - paṃcakuṃbha pakṣe madhye śata mūlāni - kuṃbha dvaya māha - śrī rudrasyaika kuṃbhaśca sarva sūktāni tatratu || tathā paṃcakuṃbhaṃ pūrvoktaiḥ lakṣaṇairyuktaṃ - catuḥ prasravaṇaṃ kuryātpaṃca vaktraṃ tathaivaca | vastrāvaguṃ ṭhitaṃ kuryāt pūrayettīrtha vāriṇā || paṃcaratna samāyuktaṃ āmrapallava saṃyutaṃ | gajaḍaśva radhyā valmīka saṃgamāddhradago kulāt || rājadvāra praveśāca mṛdamānīya nikṣiṣet | kuṃbhasya naiṛte deśe hemasthānaṃ prakalpayet || demayā lepite deśe kuryāt sthaṃḍila muttamaṃ || kaśyapenatu, uktaṃ - maṃḍapaṃ caturaśraṃca - caturhasta pramāṇataḥ | caturdvāra samāyuktaṃ - toraṇaidyaira laṃkṛtaṃ || pūrvokta lakṣaṇopetaṃ kuṃḍamīśānato bahiḥ || iti || kṛtvāgnimukha paryantaṃ ullekhādi svaśākataḥ | pūrṇapātra nidhānāṃte kṛtvā pūjāṃ samārabhet || nakṣatra devatā rūpaṃ - suvarṇena prayatnataḥ | niṣkamānena vārdhena - pādenādha svaśaktitaḥ || pratamāṃ lakṣaṇenaikāṃ - kārayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ | yadvāmūla vivarṇasya - sthāpayitvā prapūjayet || saṃsmarenni rubutiṃ śyāmaṃ - sumukhaṃ saravāhanaṃ | rakṣodhipaṃ khaḍgahastaṃ - divyābharaṇa bhūṣitaṃ || jyetirnibaṃdhetu - mūlaṃ rūpaṃ vidhātavyaṃ - śvetaṃ kumapa vāhanaṃ | khaḍgakheṭa dharaṃ cograṃ - dvibhujaṃ cavṛkānanaṃ || iti uktaṃca - pratimā pūjanārdhāya - vastrayugmaṃ prakalpayet | paṃkajaṃkāra yedbhūmau - raktābhiḥ vrīhi taṃḍulaiḥ || caturviṃśati patraiścaṃ - śuklairvā karṇikānvitaṃ | tasvo paranya setpātraṃ - sauvarṇaṃ raupya mṛṇmaye || śuddha vastreṇa saṃcādya tatra mūlāni nikṣipet || mulāni śatamūlāni - muṣṇukrāṃtā sahadevī tulasī tuśatāvarī | mūlānīmāni gṛhṇīyāt śatālābhe viśeṣataḥ || sthāpayetkīrṇikā madhye vastra gaṃdhādya laṃkṛtaṃ | kūrcahe majalopetaṃ kuṃkumauṣadhi saṃyutaṃ || kūrco darbha staṃbaḥ - evaṃ vidha kuṃbhaṃsya sedityardhaḥ - kuṃbhoparinyase dvidvān - mūla nakṣatra devatāṃ | jyeṣṭhāṃ pūrvā madhāṃca - pūjayeddevatāṃ śubhāṃ || uttaraṣāḍa hukṣādya sanūrādhāṃta marcayet || catarviṃśati daleṣu uttarāṣāḍhādyāni caturviṃśati nakṣatrāṇi pūrvaditaḥ sthāpanīyā nītyardhaḥ - aiṃdrādīśāna paryaṃtaṃ - pūjayet svasva nāmataḥ | svaliṃgoktaiśca tanmaṃtraiḥ - pradānā dīnpra pūjayet || kaśyapenatu - suvarṇena pramāṇena tadardhārdenavā punaḥ | yadhā vittānu sāreṇa pratimāṃ niburute scudhīḥ || uduṃbara vaṭāśvatda plakṣāmratvaca pallavaṃ | śatauṣadhīmūla śaṃkha navaratnāni mṛttikāḥ || paṃcāmṛtaṃtu sadbījaṃ kuṃkumaṃ rocanaṃ phalaṃ | kuṣṭhaṃ māṃsī haridrīdve murā śaileya caṃdanaṃ || vacā caṃpaka mustāca sarvauṣadhyo daśa smṛtāḥ - gajāśvarathyā valmīka saṃgamasthāna saṃbhavāḥ | hradago rājanagaradvāra taścāṣṭamṛttikāḥ || tilanīṣavrīhi yavagodhumāśca priyaṃgavaḥ | caṇakaissahitāścāṣṭau sadbījākhyāni sarvadā || dadhi madhvakṣataiḥ kuṃbhān vastrestalliṃga mantrakaiḥ | moṣaṇaśceci maṃtreṇa niruṛtiṃ cārcaye ttataḥ || paṃcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya āvāhyatha samarcayet | upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaṣabhiḥ yadvā paṃcopacārakaiḥ || raktacaṃdana gaṃdhādyaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kṛṣṇasitādibhiḥ | meṣaśṛṃgādidhapaiśca ghṛtadīpai stathaivaca || surāsolikamāṃ sādyaiḥ naivedyaiḥ bhojanādibhiḥ | mātsya māṃsa suradīni brāhmaṇānāṃ vivarjayet || uktadravyādyalābhetu yadhālābhaṃ samarpayet | puṣpāṃtaṃtu samabhyarca homaṃkuryā dyadhoditaṃ || uktadravyādyalābhetu yadhālābhaṃ samarpayet | puṣpaṃtaṃtu samabhyarca homaṃkuryā dyadhoditaṃ || nirvāsaprokṣaṇādīni caroḥ kuryā dyathāvidhi | havirgṛhitvā vithivat nairuṛtyai tyṛcāhuvet || pāyasaṃ ghṛta sammiśraṃ hunedaṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ | samidājya carūnpaścā chchaktitaḥ saṃkhyayāhuvet || svamaṃtraḥ nāmamaṃtraḥ - kṛṇuṣvapeti pakṣargabhiḥ juhuyātkṛsaraṃ tataḥ | gāyatryā jātavedeti traṃbakamitica kramāt || sīrāyuṃjaṃti tāmagniṃ vāstoṣpatyagni mevaca | tāmagnivarṇāṃtapasājvalantīṃ vairocanīṃ karmaphaleṣujuṣṭāṃ || durgāṃ devīṃ śaraṇa mahaṃ pravadye sutarasitaṃse namaḥ | kṣetrasyapatavai gṛhāmāgniṃ dūtaṃ tathaivaca - śrī sūktena tathāḥ || vidvān samidājya carūn kramāt - aṣṭottaraśatai rvāpi aṣṭāviṃśatibhiḥ kramāt | aṣṭāṣṭasaṃkhyayāvāsi jūhuyācchaktito budhaḥ || tvannaḥ somena pāyasaṃ juhuyūttu trayodaśa | caturgṛhīta mājyaṃca yāte rudreti maṃtrataḥ || sruveṇa juhuyādājyāṃ mahāvyāhṛtibhiḥ kramāt | hutvāsviṣṭakṛtaṃ paśchāt‌ prāyaścattāhutiṃ huvet || kaśyapenatu - durgāṃ grahāṃśca vighnośaṃ lokapālāṃśca pūjayet | prajāpatayesvāheti mukhāṃte juhuyādghṛtaṃ || palāśasamidājyābhyāṃ satvannoṣṭa sahasrakaṃ | athavāṣṭottaraśataṃ pratyekaṃ juhuyā ttataḥ || mūlanakṣatra muṣṭābhiḥ vākyaiḥ maṃtradvayenaca | sāmitra saumya nairuṛtya maṃtrai raśvattha saṃbhavaiḥ || samidbhiśca tilairvrīhīn hutvāvyāhṛtibhiḥ stadhā | ācāryo yajamānovā agnau pūrṇāṃhutiṃ hunet || sumudrā dūrmi sūktena prājāpatya bucātathā | pūrṇā darveti sapteti maṃtraiḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ hunet || homaśeṣaṃ samāpyātha vahni māropayedbudhaḥ | grahamukha vikṛtitvāt smārtāgnaiḥ vahni samāropaḥ || kuṃbhābhi maṃtraṇaṃ kuryāt dakṣiṇe nābhi marṣayet | mṛtyu praśamānārdhāya japecca triyaṃbakaṃ śataṃ || rudra kuṃbhokta maṃtreṇa rudra maṃtraṃ spṛśan japet || rudra kuṃbhasya dakṣiṇatobhi marśanaṃ kṛtvā, yājuṣa bahvṛca sāmagābhiḥ, pūroktaṃ japaṃ japedityarthaḥ - ekādaśāṣṭa tridvyeka saṃkhyayā, rudra sūktaṃ sāmavā japedityarthaḥ - dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca nai vedyaṃ kuṃbha yugme nivedayet | rudra kuṃbhe niruṛti kuṃbhe cetyarthaḥ - prasāda mettatodeva mabhiṣekārdha mādarāt || niṛrutiṃ caṃdraṃ - tasminkāle grahātithyaṃ kartavyaṃ bhūti micchatā | pṛthak praśa stastenai va nakṣatreṣṭyāsa haivavā || tenaiva hetunā grahayajñaḥ pṛdhak praśakataḥ - mūlaśāṃtyā sahaivatyarthaḥ - abhiṣeka vidhiṃ vakṣye sarvācāryairudīritaṃ || bhadrāsanopaviṣṭanya yajamānasya ṛtvijaḥ | dāraputranametasya karyāḥ sarvebhiṣecanaṃ || akṣībhyāmitisaktena pāpamānībhirevaca | āpohiṣṭhetinavabhiḥ yata iṃdradvayenaca || sahasrākṣetyṛcācāpi devasyatvaiti maṃtrakaiḥ | śivasaṃkalpa maṃtreṇa vakṣya māṇaiśca maṃtrakaiḥ || vakṣyamāṇaiḥ ślokaiḥte ca prayogevakṣyaṃte - tacchaṃyo rabhiṣekaṃtu sarvadoṣopa śāṃtidaṃ | sarvakāmapradaṃ divyaṃ maṃgalānāṃ ca maṃgalaṃ || vastrāṃtarita kuṃbhābhyāṃ paścāt susnāpaye dbudhaḥ || tataḥ śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śukla mālyānulepanaḥ | yajamāno dakṣiṇābhiḥ toṣayet ṛtvigādikān || dhenuṃ vapayasninīṃ dadyāt ācāryāya savatsakāṃ | niṛruti pratimāṃ vastrakuṃbhaṃ hemacadāpayet || grahārdha vastrapratimā stattaduktāśca dakṣiṇāḥ | śrīrudrajāpine deyaḥ kṛṣṇonaḍvā sprayatnataḥ || tatkuṃbha vastrāpratimāṃ tasmai dadyātprayatnataḥ | itarebhyopi viprebhyaḥ śaktyā dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ || uktālābhe tatodadyāt ācārya brahmaṛtvijāṃ | tattanmūlaṃ pradātavyaṃ śaktyā vādhapradāpayet || ācāryāya ca yuddaktaṃ tadardhaṃ brahmaṇe bhavet | sadasyāya brahāmaṇo rdhaṃ ṛtvigbhyaśca tadardhakaṃ || pracchādanorṇavastradi dadyāddhenuṃca kāṃcanaṃ | dānāṃte havayedvipraḥ sarvamūlyāni tatravai || iti || deva tāca mūlāṃ - gṛhṇīyā dāśiṣiṃtebhyaḥ pramamyādhakṣa māpayet | dadyā dannaṃ pāyasādi brāhma ṇān bhojayecchataṃ || alābhe sati paṃcaśaddaśakaṃ tadalābhataḥ | sarvāśāṃteśca paṭhanaṃ brāhmaṇai rāśiṣastathā || gṛhī kṣamāpayedvidvān niṛrutiḥ prīyatāmiti | vidhāne caritesmiṃstu tataḥ śāṃtiḥ bhaveddhruvaṃ || gaṃḍaṃte pyevamevasyāt puṣyārdhe tadvadevatu | puṣyādyardhe pravavesi eva mevaśāṃtiḥ kāryā ityarthaḥ || samāṣṭake dvādaśāhe kuryādyā śāṃtimādarāt | ityuktaṃ manunāvasyak mūlajāta hitāyaca || mātā pitro rdhanasyāpi baṃdhudoṣopa śāṃtaye || iti madanaratnokta śaunakekta mūlanakṣatra śāṃtiḥ <4> śatamūlāni daivajña manohareṇa purāṇa samuccaye pradarśitānīmāni - barhiśśikhā śamī mātaluṃgī harikrāṃtā plakṣa jayantī punarnavā palāśa yavājī śārapuṃkhā aśvattha puṃḍakī varāhīca cūta droṇapuṣpī kākajaṃghā auduṃbara kuṃbhī sulakṣmaṇā jaṃbū śrīparṇī tuṃbikā nadīvṛkṣā damanaḥ karkaṃdhuḥ vetasa caṃpakaḥ karcūrī punnāga padmakaṃ kāravallikā arjunaḥ kāṃcanapuṣpikā karkocakā śokaḥ siddheśvarī cakraṃta vakulaḥ badarī śvetārka śamaṃtaka rājavakṣaḥ vyāghrapatrikā sāla dhavaḥ rudantī tāla kuṃdaḥ aśvagaṃdhā mūla mucukuṃdaḥ munalī pāṭala gojīhvā garikarṇikā śrīvṛkṣaḥ kṣīrakuṃdukā iṃduvāru bṛhatīdvayaṃ dāḍivī apāmārga balā bījapūri śaṃkhapuṣpī atibalā brāhmī kumārikā caivapāṭha mallikā pallakī nāgabala bhṛṃgarāja gaṃdhārī jātī adhopuppī nirguṃḍī vakula matpyākṣī devarāśikā ketakī cāṭarūpakā vaṭaḥ kadalī taraṃgiṇī guḍūcī kākajaṃghā kāśa niśādve barbarī ikṣumālā śatamūlikā tulasī narṣapamūlakaṃ vāgujī kula alābhecokta vṛkṣāṇāṃ sadvṛkṣāṇāṃ sāmā haret || madanaratne gārgyastu anyadā āha - svayamulpauṭaye tprājñaḥ mūlānāṃ ca śataṃ pitā || lakṣmaṇāṃ śatamūlaṃca śirepo veta sastathā | sahasāśveta mūlāca viṣṇukrāṃtātha śaṃkhinī || sarpākṣī mīna netrāca putrapāṇi kṛtāṃjalī | palāśo bilvakaścaiva rocanaṃ caṃdana dvayaṃ || kṛṣṇamāṃsī murośīraṃ bālakaṃ ca tathāmalā | gojihva tulasī iṣyā śata puṣpā salāṃgalī || brahmadaṃḍī droṇapuṣpī priyaṃgusita sarṣapaḥ | pippalākāka jaṃghāca trāyamāṇā huhūstathā || jyotiṣmatīca gāṃdhāreti gaṃdhaḥ pūrṇa kauśikī | bhagakṣamā subhacrāca guḍūcī iṃdra vāruṇī || alābukā rudaṃtīca kadalī ketakī tathā | gokṣuraṃ śata parvīca ariṣṭīkā parājitā || chinna rudrā śatha patrāni kuṃbhāca suvarcalā | aśvagaṃdhā hasti karṇī haridrā dvitīyaṃ tathā || uṣṭravau madhukāraśca aśvattho vakulastathā | barbarā cāpamārgaṃca maṃdāra ścāti muktakaḥ || mālatī svarṇa puṣpāca śrīparṇīśra phalaṃ tathā | darbamūlaṃ karavīraṃ mudayaṃtī vikaṃtakaḥ || pāṭalā muradāruśca artha sūdanika stathā | phalaṃ manmatha vṛkṣanya palāśasyaca pallavaḥ || rāsnānadī vṛkṣamūlaṃ suradāru nidārikā | śvetavīryā śvetapākā tathā nīlotpalānica || nāgakesara miṃdīrī kumārīcaiva nikṣipet || śatamūlā śatāvarī | sahakā sahadenī || śvetamūlā punarnavā | mīnanetrā matsyākṣī | putrapārā putrajīvaḥ | kṛtāṃjaliḥ | aṃjalini hātā | hodā iti prasiddhā | palāśa kaṭumūlaṃ | śveta pītaṃca || uśīvīraṇa āmalakyā bhūmyā malakī | go jihva galakuṃ bhīti prasiddhā || brahmadaṃḍī athaḥpuṣpī droṇapuṣpīca kaṃcukaḥ | kāka jaṃghā ekāṃgī | jyotiṣmatī māla kāṃguṇī gāṃdhārī pūrṇau | kauśikāko śātakī || bhagakṣamā śigruḥ | subhadrā sārivā || ālaṃbukā tuṃbī | śataparvāva cāriṣṭakā nāgavallī || chinnaruddhāpīḍaguḍūcī | śata patrāka mālinī || nikuṃbhāsa daṃtibhedhaḥ || suvarcalā sūryaphalā || hastakarṇī heraṃḍaḥ | uṣṭrapiṭaḥ || sarjarā bījakaḥ | ātimuktakaḥ || mādhavī jāti svarṇā puṣpākuśalī | damayaṃtī yudhikā | ardhasūdanīca vālakya | manmadha vṛkṣaḥ ādruḥ suradāruḥ devadāruḥ | vidārikā bhū kūṣmāṃḍī || śvetavīryā girikarṇī | śvetapākā guṃjā | npa,ṭamanyat || sa rvau ṣa dhya stu - murāmāṃsīvacā kuṣṭaṃ śaileyaṃ rajanādvayaṃ | saṭī caṃpaka mustāca sarvauṣadhi gaṇa smṛtaḥ || mūrā aikāṃgī māṃsī jaṭāmāṃsī śaileyaṃ manīśśilā sacīkacorā - svaṣṭamanyat || kā tyā ya naḥ - mūlanakṣatre mūla vidhānaṃ kuryā tsarvauṣadhyā sarvagaṃdhai śca saṃyuktaṃ catrodaka kuṃbhaṃ kṛtvā, savastra gaṃdha puṣpa sahitaṃ śveta siddhārdha kusuma saṃyuktaṃ kuryāt tasmin rudrān japitvā aprati rathaṃ rakṣoghnaca, dvitī moda kuṃbhaṃ kṛtvā catuḥ prasravaṇa saṃyuktaṃ mupariṣṭā nmūlāni dhārayet || vaṃśapātre kṛtvā vastre badhvā, tasmin pradhānāni mūlāni vakṣyāmi aṣṭadaśa māṣa hiraṇyayaṃ mūlaṃ, saptadhānyāni, kāṣmaryā sahadevyā parājitā bālā pāṭhā śaṃkha puṣpyadho puṣpī madhu yaṣṭikā cakrāṃgikā mayūra śikhā kāka jaṃghā kumārikādvaya jīvaṃtyapā mārga bhṛṃga rājalakṣmaṇā jātī vyāghrapatraṃ cakra mardakī siddheśvarāśvattho duṃbara palāśa plakṣa vaṭārka dūrvārohita kaśamī śatāvarī ityādi mūlaśataṃ pūrayitvā, tasminni ṣaddhāni vakṣyāmi bailvadhana niṃba kadaṃba rāja vṛkṣoccha śālā priyā sūdadhika pitthakovidāra śleṣmātaka vibhītaka śālmalī sarala sarvaṃkaṃṭaki varjyaṃ tatrābhiṣekaṃ kuryāt || pituḥ, śiśoḥ, jananyāḥ devasya tvetvauduṃbarvā saṃdīṃ uda gagrāṃ āstṛṇāti tatrāsīnāṃ saṃpātenābhiṣiṃcati, śirasīḥ anulomaṃ śiromeśrīḥ | ryarāśomukhaṃ ityādibhiḥ yathā liṃgamaṃgāni saṃspṛśet || snānādūrdhvāṃ nai ṛtyāṃ pāyasaṃ śravamitvā, kāṣmaryamayaṃ sruksruvaṃ pratapya; saṃmṛjyaca, āghārājyabhāgau hutvā, asunvanta miti ca tasraḥ sthālīpākena juhuyāt | kṛṇuṣvapāja iti paṃcadaśājya hutīḥ caturgahītena juhuyāt || mānastoka iti dvābhyāṃ, yāterudra śivā tanūritiṣaṭ, agne rakṣāṃsisedhati śukrajyoti ramartyaḥ śuciḥ pāvaka īḍya iti, tvannaḥ soma viśvatorakṣā rājannaṣūyataḥ || sariṣyetvāvatassakheti sviṣṭakṛdādi prāśanāṃte, kṛṣṇāgauḥ, kṛṣṇāścatilāḥ hemamayamūlaṃ saptadhānya saṃyuktaṃ ācāryāya dadyāt || kṛṣṇonaḍvān brahmaṇe, nakṣatra sūcakebhyovāso dadyāt - anyebhyo brāhmaṇebhyaḥ suvarṇaṃ dadyāt - kṛsarānna pāyasena brāhmaṇān bhojayet - sārpadaivate gaṃḍa jāta eṣavidhiḥ kātyāyanenoktaḥ kṛte śāṃtirbhavatīti || aṣṭādaśamāṣa mitaṃ suvarṇaṃ kṛtamūlaṃ kecit‌tu aṣṭadaśa māṣa mitina paṭhaṃti mathuyaṣṭakā jeṣṭhī mathu | cakrāṃkitā atibalā | mūlanāmānitu | kāṣmaryā | vālāuśīraṃ | athaḥ puṣpī | kākajaṃghā | cidrucirā | sulakṣmaṇā puttalīsadṛśī | vrāṣupatrī | siddheśvarājātī | rohitakaṃ sugaṃdhatṛṇaṃ | anyāci prasiddhānica | etādṛśānidvā triṃśadāvaśyakāni | anyāni śatamūlāntargatānigrāhyāṇi | tadabhāvekāni cidapritiṣiddhāniyāni vihitāni niṣaddhānicateṣu bhavikalpaḥ || atha śaunakokta mūlāśāṃti prayogaḥ uktakāle gomukha prasavaṃ kṛtvā deśakālau saṃkīrtyā śaunakoktavidhinā mūlanakṣatra śāṃtiṃ kariṣye iti saṃkalpya, gaṇeśa pūjana pūṇyāhavācana nāṃdīśrāddhāni kṛtvā, ācāryaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sadasyaṃ ṛtvijaṃścāṣṭau caturovā vṛtvā madhuparkaiḥ vastrālaṃkārādibhiḥ yadāthā vibhava marcayet - tataḥ ācāryaḥ prāṇānāyamya, asman karmaṇi ācārya karma kariṣye iti saṃkalpya, yadatra saṃsthitamiti sarṣapān vikīrya, apohiṣṭhādi maṃtraiḥ karmabhūmiṃ saṃprokṣya, salakṣaṇa maṃḍapa devatāpūjādi kuryāt - tataḥ tatra īśānabhāge varṇakaiḥ svastikaṃvilikhya tatra mahīdyauriti bhūmiṃ spṛṣṭva, oṣadhayaḥ samitidroṇa pramāṇān vrīhīn prakṣipya, tatra ākalaśeśviti navakuṃbhān nidhāya, imaṃme gaṃge iti tīrdhavāriṇāpūrya, gaṃdhadvārāmiti gaṃdhaṃ, yā auṣadhīya ityoṣadhīḥ oṣadhayaḥ samitiyavān, kāṃḍā tkāṃḍāditi dūrvāḥ, aśvattheva iti paṃcapallavāṃśca, syonā pṛthivīti paṃcamṛdaḥ, yāḥ phalinīriti phalaṃ, sahiratnā nīti paṃcaratnāni, āpohiṣṭhetityṛcāpaṃca gavyaṃ, hiraṇyarūpamiti suvarṇaṃca prakṣipya, yuvāsuvāsā iti vastreṇa kalaśamāveṣṭya, pūrṇadarvīti tāmra vaṃśādi mayaṃ pūrṇa pātraṃni dadhyāt - kecitvā pātato mūlavākyālocanena vastraveṣṭatavāri pūrṇapaṃcagavya suvarṇa pallavayutaṃ kalaśaṃ vrīhiṣu nidhāya, phala ratnauṣadhyādi prakṣepaṃ gaṃdhapuṣparcanādi bāhustada sāṃpradāyakaṃ | tato rudra kalaśān caturdikṣu mahīdvauriti bhūmiṃ spṛṣṭvā, śaktyāyavān prakṣivya, caturaḥ kalaśān sthāpamitvā pūrṇapātra nidhānāṃtaṃ kuryāt | tatra pratikalaśaṃ maṃtrāvṛttiḥ || tataḥ pūrṇapātro parivastre sauvarṇa nirmitāṃ rudra pratimāṃ tryaṃbakamiti maṃtreṇā vāhyacenaiva ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ pūjayet || asya vasiṣṭho rudronuṣṭup - tataḥ eka ṛtvāk kuṃbhaṃspṛṣṭvā, rudraikādaśinīṃ japedyadi yājuṣaḥ - bahvṛcastu catvāri rudrasūktāni - chaṃdogastu rudra sāmāni - atro bhayatra śaktitaḥ ekādaśāṣṭau tridvyekaṃ sakhyā grāhyaḥ - kecidrudra ssarva sāthāraṇaḥ - bahvṛca chaṃdogayostu susāmne rudreṇa saha vikalpa ityāhuḥ - tatra rudranyāsādi asmadguru kṛta rudra paddha taudraṣṭavyaṃ || … rakṣohaṇamiti paṃcaviṃśatyṛksuktasya āṃgīrasaḥ vāyuragni striṣṭun - catasroṃtyā nuṣṭubhaḥ japeviniyogaḥ - atra saṃkhyā purvoktarītyā yadhāśakti grahyā - caturdhetu pavamāna mapyakavāraṃ japet yadvā eteṣā mapi rudra kiṃbe eva japaḥ - caturṣu śāṃti japa iti kecit - evaṃ paṃca kuṃbhā saṃbhave kuṃbhadvayaṃ saṃsthāpya - asmin pakṣe rudra kuṃbhe pūrvokta rudra maṃtrādi sarva japaḥ - asya kuṃbhetu varuṇa māvāhya śāṃti rudra japaṃ kuryāt || athavā paṃca kuṃbhasthāne ekaikaḥ evaṃ catuḥ prasravaṇaḥ tatra mathya kuṃbha kāryāṇi madhyamukhe - kuṃbha catuṣṭaya kāryāṇi caturṣu prasravaṇeṣviti vivekaḥ - tataḥ pūrva sthāpita kuṃbhottara taścaturviṃśati daśa paṃca varṇaiḥ - śukla taṃḍula piṣṭenavā kṛtvā, tatra karṇikāyāṃ || mahīdvaurityādinā kuṃbhaṃ saṃsthāpya, tatra imaṃme gaṃge iti jalamāpūrya, gaṃdhadvārā miti gaṃdhaṃ kṣiptvā, tatra śatamālāni nikṣipet - tadabhāve viṣṇukrāṃte, sahadevī, tulasī, śatāvarīḥ prakṣipya, kuśān, kuṃkumaṃca prakṣipya, yāoṣadhīrityādi pūrṇapātra nidhānāṃtaṃ kṛtvā, uparivastreṣṭadasaṃ kṛtvā, karṇikāyāṃ moṣuṇa iti niṣkādardha nirmitaṃ niṛruti pratimāṃ paṃcāmṛtena snāpayitvā, saṃsthāpya, taddakṣiṇataḥ, iṃdraṃvo mathuchaṃdā iṃdro gāyatrī aneneṃdraṃ, tadu ttarata ścāpsume - medhātithirāponuṣṭup ityapaḥ sthāpayet - devatāśca viśvedevāḥ viṣṇuḥ, vasavaḥ, varuṇaḥ, acaikapāte, ahirbudhnya, pūṣā, aśvānau, yamaḥ, agniḥ, prajāpatiḥ, somaḥ rudraḥ, aditiḥ, bṛhaspatiḥ, sarpāḥ, pitaraḥ, bhagaḥ, aryamā, savitā, tvaṣṭā, vāyuḥ, iṃdragnī, mitraiti, tato logapālakā nāvāhayet - tato nai ṛrutegni sthāpanaṃ kṛtvā, tadīśānye sapagrahān tattasmaṃtrai rāvāhya, anvādhānaṃ kuryāt - tadyāthā - samiddvayamādāya, cakṣuṣyājyene tyaṃtamuktvā, navagrahāna mukasaṃkhyābhiḥ, samuccarvājyāhutibhiḥ, adhidevatā pratyadhi devatā lokapālāt, vināyakādīṃśca, pratyeka mamukasaṃkhyābhiḥ, samiccarvājyāhutibhiḥ, niṛrutiṃ pratidravyeṇāṣṭottara śatasaṃkhyākābhiḥ, ghṛtasammiśra pāyasa carusamidājyāhutibhiḥ, iṃdramāpaśca pratidravya maṣṭāviṃśati paṃcadaśaṛgbhiḥ, pratyṛta maṣṭasaṃkhyābhiḥ, kṛsarāhutibhiḥ, agniṃ, kṣetrādhipitaṃ, mitrāvaruṇī, agniṃ, etāḥ aṣṭa saṃkhyābhiḥ, kṛsarāhutibhiḥ, samidājya carvāhutibhiḥ somaṃ trayodaśa vāraṃ pāyasāhutibhiḥ, rudraṃ caturgṛhītenājyena, agniṃ, vāyuṃ, sūryaṃ, prajāpatiṃcājyena, śeṣeṇa sviṣṭakṛta mityādi pūrṇa pātra nidhānāstaṃ kṛtvā, svasvamaṃtraiḥ niṛrutyādi pūjāṃ kuryāt - tatra vastrayugmaṃ raktacaṃdana gaṃdha kṛṣṇa surabhi puṣpāṇi dhūpomeṣa śṛṃgasya, ājasyadīpaḥ paruṣāhārāya holikāḥ - brāhmaṇasya sūrāsthāne naiṃdhava miśritaṃ kṣīraṃ, māṃsasthāne lavaṇayuktaṃ pāyasaṃ - kṣatriyādīnāṃsati saṃbhave mukhyameva etāvannaivedyāṃ - ācamānādi puṣpāṃjalyaṃ tāṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā, amuṣmaityetyāda anvādhāna krameṇa pāyasa kṛsaracarūn śrapamitvā, ājyabhāgāntaṃ kuryāt - tato yajamāna dakṣiṇataḥ sarva devato ddeśa tyāgaṃ kuryāt - tataḥ ṛtviksahitaḥ ācāryaḥ juhuyāt tadyathā - navagrahādhi devatā pratyadhi devatā vināyakā dīno tatta smaṃtraiḥ samidājyacarun pūrvokta saṃkhyayā hutvā, niṛruteḥ iṃdrasya āpāca maṃtreḥ krameṇa dravya catuṣṭayaṃ ṛtvigbhiḥ juhuyāt - kṛṇuṣveti paṃcadaśa sūktasya gotamo vāmadevo rakṣohātriṣṭup kṛsapahome viniyagaḥ - pratyṛca maṣṭa saṃkhyayā jāhuyāt - grāyatryā aṣṭa saṃkhyayā samutre kṛsarāhutīḥ hūtvā, jāta vedase kaśyapo durgātriṣṭup, kṛsaraṃ, tryaṃbakaṃ vasiṣyo rudro nuṣṭup kṛsaraḥ sīrāyuṃjaṃtyasya budha saumya ṛṣiḥ ṛtviktsu tirdevatā gāyatrī cchaṃdaḥ kṛsara vome viniyogaḥ - tāmagi varṇāṃ saubharī durgā triṣṭup kṛsara maṣṭa saṃkhyābhiḥ, agniṃ kāṇavo medhāṃthiḥ agniḥ gāyatrī kṛsara maṣṭa saṃkhyābhiḥ, kṣatrasya vāmadevaḥ kṣetrapālo nuṣṭup kṛsara maṣṭa saṃkhyābhi, dṛṇānā jamadagniḥ mitrā varuṇā gāyatrī kṛsara maṣṭasaṃkhyābhiḥ, agniṃ dūta mityasyāṃgiraso vurūpāṃgārako gāyatrī kṛsara maṣṭa saṃkhyābhiḥ, hiraṇya varṇāmiti paṃcadaśa suktasya ānaṃdaḥ karda marciklīteṃdirā sutā ṛṣayaḥ śrī devatā dyāstisro nuṣṭubhaḥ caturdhī prastāra paṃktiḥ paṃcama ṣaṣṭhayoḥ triṣṭubau datoṣṭā vanuṣṭubhaḥ aṃtyā prastāra paṃktiḥ home viniyogaḥ - pratyṛca samidājya carūn aṣṭā viṃśatyaṣṭānyatama saṃkhyayā juhuyāt - tvannaḥ soma viśvata ityasya, pragādhiḥ, somastriṣṭup, pāyasahome viniyogaḥ - tavannaḥ soma viśvatogopā itivā maṃtrataḥ - tvannaḥ jakraturitivā - anayo riṃdrovimadaḥ, somaḥ prastarapaṃktiḥ - tataścaturgṛhīta mājyaṃ gṛhītvā, yāte rudreti kaśyapo rudraḥ, svarāḍanuṣṭup - anena juhuyāt || tataḥ sruveṇavyasta samasta vyābṛtibhi rājyaṃ hutvā, sviṣṭa kṛdādi prāyaścittaṃ kuryāt - tataḥ dikpālebhyo navagrahebhyo vināyakādibhyo niṛrutaye, iṃdrāya, adbhaḥ, rudrāya, kṣetrapālāca, sadīpamāṣa balīn dadyāt || tataḥ ācāryo yajamānovā srucaṃ pūrayitvā, tatra phalādi kamādhāya, pūrṇāhutiṃ juhuyāt - tatra maṃtrāḥ - samidrā dūrmirityekādaśamāktasya, gautama vāmadevogniḥ, triṣṭupe, aṃtyā jagatīpūrṇāhuti home viniyogaḥ - prajopate hiraṇyagarbhaḥ prajāpati stṛṣṭupe pūrṇādarvī viśvedevāḥ, śat‌kratu ranuṣṭup, pūrṇāhuti home vinoyogaḥ - saptate agne saptavādagnarjagatī pūrṇāhuti home viniyogaḥ - evaṃ pūrṇā hutiṃ hutvā, praṇītānayanādi karmaśeṣaṃ samāpya, agnau śāṃtikaraṇa pakṣe asminkāle samāropya, śāṃtyā sahanavagraha makha karaṇe idānīṃ tasminnevāgnau pṛdhake navagraha mukhaḥ kāryaḥ - tataḥ catuḥ kuṃbhaṃ madhyavarti kuṃbha dakṣiṇataḥ spṛṣṭvā, tryaṃbakamiti maṃtraṃ śatavāraṃ japet - bahvṛcaśce drudrasūktāni - sāmagaśce drudrasāmāni - adharvaṇaśce tryaṃbaka maṃtra mātraṃ - adhavā ekādaśāṣṭa tridvyekasaṃkhyayā saṃpūjya, tryaṃbakaṃ meṣuṇa ityupasnāya, sarva kalaśodakaṃ pātrāṃtare gṛhītvā, sartvigācāryo yajamānaṃ sarveṣaḍhībhiḥ anuliptāṃgaṃ, dhṛta navavastraṃ, tadvāmato dhṛta navavastraṃ saputrāṃ patnīṃ apaveśya, vakṣyāmāṇai - maṃtraiḥ abhiṣiṃcet - tribhiṣṭhvaṃ deveti sastānāṃ vasiṣaṭha ṛṣiḥ - ādyānāṃ trayāṇāṃ agnirdevatā - tataśca turṇāṃ viśve devāḥ - ādyā gāyatrī - ditīyānuṣṭup - tisro gāyatryaḥ - aṃtyedye anuṣṭubhau - abhiṣeke viniyogaḥ - āpohiṣṭheti navarcāṃ āṃbarīṣa ssiṃdhuḥ dvīpa āpo gāyatrī, aṃtyedve anuṣṭubhau, paṃcamī vardhamānā saptamī pratiṣṭhā ābhiṣeke viniyogaḥ - āpa idveti dvayasya saptarṣayaḥ, viśve devanuṣṭup abhiṣeke viniyogaḥ - sahasrākṣeṇeti prājāpatyo yakṣanālo yakṣahā triṣṭup abhiṣeke viniyogaḥ - devasyatvetvāpa staṃbaśākhāgataiḥ tribhirmaṃtraiḥ yajñagrata iita ṣaṇṇāṃ prajāpati manu stṛṣṭupe abhiṣeke viniyogaḥ - tataḥ - yosā vajradharodevaḥ - maheṃdro gajavāhanaḥ | mūlajāta śiśordoṣaṃ mātā pitro rvyapohatu || yosau śaktidharodevaḥ - hutabhūjkeṣa vāhanaḥ | saptajihvaśca davogniḥ - mūladoṣaṃ vyapohatu || yosau daṃḍadharodevaḥ - dharmomabahiṣa vāhanaḥ | mūlajāta śiśordoṣaṃ - vyapohatu yamo mama || yosau khaḍgadharodevaḥ - niṛrutī rākṣasādhipaḥ | praśāmayatu mūlotthaṃ - doṣaṃ gaṃḍāṃta saṃbhavaṃ || yosau pāśa dharodevaḥ - varuṇaśca jaleśvaraḥ | nakravāha pracetānaḥ - mūlotthāghaṃ vyapohatu || yosau devo jagatprāṇaḥ - māruto mṛga vāhanaḥ | praśāmayatu mūlotthaṃ - doṣaṃ bālasya śāṃtidaḥ || yosau vidhipati rdevaḥ - khaḍgabhṛt vāji vāhanaḥ | mātā pitro ściśoścaiva - mūla doṣaṃ vyapohatu || yosau paśupati rdevaḥ - pināke vṛṣa vāhanaḥ | āśleṣa mūla gaṃḍāṃta - doṣamāśu vyapohatu || viṣnośaḥ kṣetrapo durgā - lokapālā navagrahā | sarvadoṣa praśamanaṃ - sarve kurvaṃtu śāṃtithāḥ || tataḥ surāstvetyādibhiḥ abhiṣiṃcet - tacchaṃ yoḥśaṃ yurviśve devāḥ śakvarī ābhiṣeke viniyogaḥ - tato rudra niṛruti śāṃti kalaśodakena anyena śatacchidra maṃtarthāsyābhiṣikto yajamānodhaute vāsasī paridhāya, tilakaṃ kṛtvā, vibhūtiṃ dhṛtvā, saṃkalpapūrvaka mācāryādīn pūjayitvā, tebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt - tatrācāryāya savatsāṃdogdhrīṃ dhenuṃ dakṣiṇāṃca dadyāt - kaśyapenatu - ācārya vṛṣaṃ loha piṃḍaṃ dadyātsadakṣiṇaṃ ityuktaṃ - brahmaṇe vṛṣaṃ - rudra jāpine kṛṣṇa manaḍvāhaṃ - ṛtvigbhyaśca yathāśakti dakṣiṇāṃ datva,ā bhūyasīṃ datvā, nuṛrutyādīnāṃ uttara pūjāṃ vidhāya, uttiṣṭhayāṃtudeva gaṇāḥ iti nusṛjyācārya hastena prati padya ākṣadān āśiṣaḥ, agniṃ saṃpūjya, gaccha gaccheti vasṛtya, śataṃ tadardhaṃvā daśavā viprāne saṃbhojya, śāṃti sūkta japaṃkārayatvā, yasyasmṛtyeti japitvā, karmeśvarārpaṇaṃ kṛtvā, bhuṃjīta || iti kamalākarabhaṭṭa kṛte śāṃti ratne mūlaśāṃti prayogaḥ atha madanaratne pitāmaha saṃhitoktā mūlādau ca dvighaṭikā jyeṣṭhāṃte ca tathaivaca | abhuktamūlaṃ tad‌jñeyaṃ tatra jātaṃ śiśuṃtyajet || mūlasyādau piturgaṃḍaṃ māturgaṃḍaṃ dvitīyakaṃ | tṛtīyaṃ dhanadhānyasya aṃtyapādaḥ śūbhāvahaḥ || viparītaṃ phalaṃ sarvaṃ āśleṣāsvapimūlavat | śūlovyāghāta vajreca vyatīpātaśca vaidhṛtiḥ || pariṣaṃ vāradoṣaśca viṣṭiśca viṣanāḍikāḥ | apayogādikairyukte mūladoṣodhikobhavet || adhātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi śāṃtikarma vidhiṃ śubhaṃ | niṣkeṇavāyavānaṣṭau suvarṇena ca nai ṛrutiṃ || sarpabhoyadi gaṃḍaṃ ca kuryā tsarpākṛtiṃ budhaḥ | kuṃḍaṃ kuryā ddhastamātraṃ āyāmeca tathaivaca || mekhalātraya saṃyuktaṃ yonyācaiva samanvitaṃ || maṃḍapaṃkārayettatra yathā vibhava sārataḥ | puṇyahaṃvāca yitvātu susaṃkalpya ca yathāvidhi || alaṃkṛtāṃśchatu saṃkhyān ṛtājo varayedbudhaḥ | ācāryaṃ varayetpaścāt vaptradibhi kalaṃkṛtaṃ || ānīya caturaḥ kuṃbhān kṛṣṇavarṇān suśobhitān | śatacchadra samāyuktaṃ bṛhatkuṃbhaṃ śuśobhitaṃ || sūtreṇaveṣṭitaṃ madhye dhānyasyo pari vinyaset | śatamūlādi puṣpāṇi ratnāni navasaṃkhyayā || mṛtikā daśasaṃkhyākaiḥ tathā pallavapaṃcakaṃ | paṃcavṛkṣa kaṣāyāṇi paṃcagavyaṃ tathaivaca || paṃcasaugaṃdhikaṃcaiva paṇyaṃ lohatrayaṃ tathā | dhānyāni sarvāṇi tathā kuśādūrvā stathaivaca || tīrthodakāni sarvāṇi sarvakuṃbheṣu vinyaset | mūlāni nāmatovakṣye śatasaṃkhyāni yānica || sahadevī śikhā puṃkhā viṣṇukrāṃtai punarnavā | caṃdravṛkṣā sitāguṃjā dugdhikāca tathā balā || kākabaṃdhurvāyadurvā kākamācī śatāvarī | karkaraṃ surasaṃbrāhmī nirguṃḍī musalīvacā || varṣābhūḥ śaṃkhinīpāṭhā samaṃgā bṛhatīdvayaṃ | apāmārgaḥ kuśābhṛṃgaḥ kāsakhaṃdaka rūpakāḥ || śrīvṛkṣeṃdra yavaḥplakṣā brahmavṛkṣodhacāmrakāḥ | jaṃbūbilvo murāmāṃsī mustāriṣṭā niśādvayaṃ || kadalī ketaketālaḥ śrīparṇī sallakītathā | pāṭalālodhrakośaraṃ kośātatyagni maṃthakaḥ || jīvaṃtī dāḍimiśāla tamālaṃ bījapūrakaṃ | punnāgo vakulaḥ kuṃdaḥ mathuro mucukuṃdakaḥ || mudgamāṣa balācaiva naṃdyāvartaḥ kuraṃṭakaḥ | caṃpaka nyubjakākuṣṭhaṃ guḍūcyāmalakī tathā || uśīraṃ bālakhadiraṃ karaṃjaṃ ca tathaivaca | kaṃdapośvattha vṛkṣaśca karāhvādgraṃdhi parṇikā || raśanāśaṃkhinīcai va nāgāhvāpotakī tathā | kamalaṃ kumudaṃ kośo nīlolpala bṛhadvayaṃ || etaśśatāmi mūlāni sarvāriṣṭa harāṇica | abhāve śatamūlānāṃ sarveṣadhyo vinikṣipet || sarvauṣadhīnāṃcā bhāve daśauśadhyo vinikṣapet | abhāve sarvamūlānāṃ hemamātraṃ vinikṣipet || devadāru rniśāyugmīṃ padmaṃ nīlotpalaṃ tathā | kuṣṭhaṃ raudraṃ priyaṃguśca tagaraṃ mūlamevaca || dhātrīphalaṃ vacākarṇī narṣapānāgaraṃ tathā | mūpāmāṃsī tathā caṃḍī uśīraṃ vālakaṃ tathā || śailajā gṛdhraparṇīca śrīkhaṃḍaṃ tārakaṃ tathā | siddhi vṛddhi samāyuktaḥ sarvauṣadhyaḥ prakīrtitāḥ || kuṣṭhaṃ māṃsī haridredve mūrāśaileya caṃdanaṃ | vacā karpāramustāca sarvauṣadhyo daśasmṛtāḥ || yāoṣadheti maṃtreṇa auṣadhādīni nikṣipet | sahiratnāni maṃtreṇa navaratnāni nikṣipete || udhṛtāsīti maṃtreṇa mṛdamādāya vinyaset | pravoyajñeti maṃtreṇa pallavāṃśca vinikṣipet || yāścedamiti maṃtreṇa tvakṛcakaṃ vinikṣipet | gāyatryadaiḥ paṃcagavyaṃ kāṃḍātkāṃḍācca dūrvakān || madhuvāteti madhusvādaḥ pavapyeti ca śarkarāṃ | kalaśasya mukhe brahma madhye rudro athohariḥ || sarve samudrāḥ saritaḥ tīrdhāni jaladānadāḥ | āyāṃtu yajamānasya duritakṣayakārakāḥ || imaṃme varaṇetyādyaṃ tvāyāmi dvitīyakaṃ | tvanno agne tṛtīyaṃca satvannogne tataḥ paraṃ || ācāryo mūlamaṃtreṇa bṛhatkuṃbha prapūjayet | mūlaṃ prajāṃtu mūlaṃcaṃ sarvedaṃ sarpa ityapi || śatacchidrasya puraṃtaḥ devaṃ tatraivapūjayet | niṛrutiṃ sarpanāthaṃca vastrayugmena veṣṭayet || iṃdrādilokapālāṃśca svena maṃtreṇa pūjayet | evaṃ pūjāṃca nirvartya homakarma tatascharet || samidhājyena caruṇā tilai ssamyakcahāvayet | aṣṭottara sahasraṃvā aṣṭottara śataṃtuvā || mūlaṃ prajāṃtucāṣṭauca homavākyaṃ yathākramaṃ | anuhomaṃ tataḥ kuryāt ājyena caruṇāsaha || prajāpataye svāheta sarpebhyasveti maṃtrakaiḥ | vyāhṛti homaṃca kārayotsu samāhitaḥ || pūrṇahutiṃca juhuyāt abhiṣekaṃ ca kārayet | ukṣipyaca śatacchidraṃ dhāraye nmastakopari || śatacchidrekṣipeyunte maṃtrai rvāruṇasaṃbhavaiḥ | samudrajyeṣṭābhi maṃtraiḥ devasyatvā tathaivaca || śirome śrīriti maṃtreṇa āpohiṣṭhādibhiḥ tribhiḥ | punaṃtumā devājanā maṃtraiḥ trātāramevaca || dveśśāṃtetyādibhi rmaṃtraiḥ mātsyoktairapi maṃtrakaiḥ | ārdyavāsāṃsi saṃtyajya ācāryāya nivedayet || ājyāvalokanaṃ kṛtvā sadviprāya pradāpayet | ācāryāya vṛṣaṃdadyāt ayaḥpiṃḍaṃ tathaivaca || sarvālaṃkāra saṃyuktaṃ gāṃsavatsāpa dakṣiṇāṃ | tadardhaṃ brahmaṇe dadyāt ṛtvigbhyo pitadardhataḥ || brahmaṇān bhojayotpaścāt yathāśaktanusārataḥ | anenavidhānā śāṃtiṃ yaḥkuryāt prītimānnaraḥ || āyurārogya maiśvaryaṃ tasya khyātirbhaveddhruvaṃ | iti kamalākarabhaṭṭakṛtau mūlāśleṣā śāṃtaḥ || athāśleṣāśāṃtiḥ tatra pāda phalaṃ prāguktaṃ jayārṇave mūrthānya netra gala karṇa yugaṃ ca bhāhu hṛjjānu guhya pada mitya hideha bhāgaḥ || bāṇādri netra huta bhuk śruti nāga rudra ṣaṇṇaṃda paṃca śirasaḥ kramaśastu nāḍyaḥ || rājyaṃ pitṛkṣayo mātṛnāśaḥ kāma kriyāratiḥ | pitṛbhakto balīsvaṣnustyāgī bhogi dhanī kramāt || viśeṣastu nirṇaya siṃdhau jñeyaḥ śāṃti maha śaunakaḥ - yathā - āśleṣā yāṃtu jātānāṃ śāṃtiṃ vakṣyāmyataḥ varaṃ | jātasya dvādaśāheca śāṃti homaṃ samācaret || asaṃbhavetu janmarkṣe anyasminvā śubhehāni | snātobhyaṃgādi bhistasmin varayottu dvijo ttamān || vibhave paṃcakuṃbhāstu dvayaṃvā tada lābhataḥ | devatā sthāpane caikaṃ mekaṃ rudrabhi maṃtraṇe || mūlarkṣokta prakāreṇa kuṃbhe nikṣipya pūjayet | gomayā lepite deśe maṃṭapaiḥ pariśobhite || paṃkajaṃkāraye ttatra caturviṃśa ddaśānvitaṃ | taṃḍulaiḥ kārayedyadvāraktapīta sitā sitaiḥ || karṇikāyāṃ nyaseddhīmān sthāpayetteṣu kuṃbhakaṃ | ā kalaṣeṣu maṃtreṇa kalaśe sthāpanaṃ smṛtaṃ || imaṃme gaṃgeti maṃtreṇa pūrayettīrthavāriṇā | kuṃbhaṃca gaṃtha vaptradyaiḥ tattanmatraiḥ prapūjayet || yāḥ palinīḥstu maṃtreṇa kṣipedratnauṣadhīdikān | kuṃbho paristha pātretu āśleṣā pratimāṃ yajet || niṣkārtha pāda pādairvā kārayitvā svaśaktitaḥ | tatpurvottara nakṣatre dakṣiṇottara yoryajet || aiṃdrā dīśāna paryanta mitararkṣāṇi pūjayet | mūloktena vidhānena kuṃbhayo rabhi maṃtraṇaṃ || rudrārcā rudra kuṃbhetu pūrva vacceṣa mācaret | nayo astu sarpobhyaḥ pūjā maṃtra itīritaḥ || sarpo raktastrī netraśca dvibhujaḥ pīta vastrakaḥ | phalakāsi dhara stīkṣṇo divyabharaṇa bhūṣitaḥ || evaṃ dhyātvā tatobhyarcya homakarma samārabhet | kartuḥ śākhokta mārgeṇa ācārya syātha vācaret || mukhāṃtaṃ karma nirmāya havirādāya śāstrataḥ | idaṃ sarpebhyo juhu yātsādhi pratyadhi samācaret || aṣṭottara śaṃtavātha aṣṭāviśati mevavā | mūla nakṣatra vacceṣaṃ homakrama samācaret || pūrṇā hutyaṃta karmāṇi kṛtvā saṃpātakaṃ tathā | kuṃbhe japeṣu prakṣipya ābhiṣeka mathācaret || dāra putra sametasya yajamānasya pūrvavat | abhiṣiṃcetatathācāryaḥ ṛtvigbhiḥ ssapitastathā || abhimaṃtrita kuṃbhādbhiḥ abhiṣecana mācaret | tathā paurāṇa maṃtraiśca pallavairabhiṣecayet || āśleṣā ṛkṣa jātasya mātā pitrordhanasanyaca | bhrātṛjñati kulasthānāṃ dhoṣaṃ sarvaṃ pyapohatu || yosau vāgeśvaronāma ādhidevo bṛhaspatiḥ | mātā pitroḥ śiśoścaiva gaṃḍāṃtaṃca vyapohatu || pitaraḥ sarva bhātānāṃ rakṣaṃtu pitaraṃ ssadā sārpanakṣatra jātasya vittaṃca jñāti bāṃdhavān || evaṃ kṛtebhiṣeketu sārpaśāṃtirbhaveddhruvaṃ | tata śśuklāṃbaradharo yajamānaḥ subhūpitaḥ || dakṣiṇābhi stato viprān mūla vacca pratoṣayet | ityukteva vidānena sarvāriṣṭaṃ vyapohatu || sarve kāmāśca sidhyaṃti vedokta yurbhaviṣyati | arghya maṃtra māha sarpādhīśa namastubhyaṃ nāgānāṃca gaṇādhipa | gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayādattaṃ sarvāriṣṭa praśāṃtaye || mūla nakṣatra vatkuryāt sarpagaṃḍe svanāyataḥ || abhiṣeke āśleṣā mūla gaṃḍāṃtarkṣajāta svadoṣa śāṃti mityūhaḥ karyaḥ iti śaunake yā āśleṣā śāṃtiḥ atha prayogaḥ - iktakālekarta gomukhaprasavaṃ kṛtvā, deśakālau saṃkīrtya, mama asya kumārasya āśleṣā nakṣatra jananena sūcita pitrādyariṣṭādi śāṃtidvāra śrī parameśvara prītyardhaṃ navagrahomakhaṃ āśleṣā nakṣatra janana śāṃti kariṣye, iti saṃkalpya, gaṇeśapūjā, puṇyāhavācana, mātṛ,ā pūjana, nāṃdī śrāddhākṛtvā, ācāryaṃ, ṛtvijaśca, vṛṇuyāt | tataḥ ācāryaḥ - assin karmaṇi ācāryakarma kariṣye, iti saṃkalpya, yadatra saṃsthitimiti sarṣapān vikīrya, āpohiṣṭheti maṃtraiḥ karmabhūmi prokṣya, īśānadeśe paṃcavarṇaiḥ svastikaṃ vilikhya,tatra mahīdyauriti bhūmi spṛṣṭvā, oṣadayaḥ samiti droṇapramāṇān vrīhīnkṣiptvā, tatrā kalaśeśviti kuṃbhaṃ nidhāya, imaṃme, gaṃgetyāpūrya, gaṃdhadvārāmiti gaṃdhapuṣpaiḥ, yāoṣadhīrityauṣadhī roṣadayaḥ samiti yavān, kāṃḍātkāṃḍāditi, dvārvāḥ aśvettheva itipaṃcapallavān, syoneti saptamṛdaḥ, yāphalinī ritiphalaṃ, sahiratnānīti paṃcaratnāni, āpohiṣṭhetitisṛbhiḥ paṃcagavyaṃ, hiraṇyarūpa iti hiraṇyaṃ prakṣipya, vastraiḥ yuvāsuvāsā ityāveṣṭhya, pūrṇādarviti pūrṇa pātraṃ nidadhyāt - tataḥ pūrṇapātro paristhapastre suvarṇa rudra pratimāyāṃ tryaṃbakamiti maṃtreṇa mṛtyuṃjaya māvāhya pūjayet - asya vasiṣṭho radro nuṣṭup - tataḥ ekaṛtvik kuṃbhaṃ spṛṣṭhvā, rudraikādaśanīṃ japet - yadiyājuṣo yajamānaḥ - bahvṛcaścet catvāri rudrasūktāni - chaṃdogaścete rudrasāmāni sūktasāmnoḥ ekādaśāṣṭatridveka saṃkhyā grāhya - kecit rudraḥ sarvasādhāraṇaḥ - bahvṛca chaṃdogayostu sūktasāmnoḥ rudrema sahavikalpa ityāhuḥ - itthameva śiṣṭaḥ kurvaṃti tatra rudrānyāsādi śrīguru rudrapaddhataudraṣṭavyaṃ - rudra nūktānitu - kudrudrāyeti navarcāma ghoraḥ, kaṇvo rudro gāyatrī, imāradrāyetye karcakutso rudraḥ ādyā sava jagatyoṃtye, dvetriṣṭubhe, āte pitarita paṃcadaśa śarcaṃ gṛtsayado rudra striṣṭhuve, tamuṣṭuhibhauyotrī rudra striṣṭup, bhuvanasya pitariṛjijā rudra striṣṭup, tryaṃbakaṃ vasiṣṭo rudro nuṣṭape, rudrasāma ṛṣyādi tulā puruṣa paddhatau draṣṭavyaṃ - tata stryaṃbaka mityaṣṭottara sahasraṃ, pāvamānīśca madhyama kuṃbhe japet - tataḥ prākkuṃbhe āśuḥ śiśāna iti trayodaśarcāṃ, iṃdro aprati ratha ṛṣiḥ, iṃdro devatā triṣṭupe, chaṃdoṃtyā nuṣṭup, dakṣiṇa kuṃbhetva magne rudra ityanuvākasya, havyavāḍṛṣiḥ, agnyātmā,rudhro devatā, jagatīcchaṃdaḥ, paścimakuṃbhe rakṣohaṇa ityasya vāmadevogniḥ, triṣṭup - uttarakuṃbhe - rakṣohaṇamiti paṃca viṃśarcāmaṃgirasaḥ vāyuvagni striṣṭape, aṃtyāścatasronuṣṭubhaḥ, jape viniyogaḥ - atrāpi pūrvokta saṃkhyā yathā śakti grāhya - paṃcakuṃbhā saṃbhave catuḥ prasravaṇaṃ paṃca vaktraṃ kuṃbhaṃ sthāpayitvā, sarvaṃ tatraiva kuryāt - tataḥ kuṃbhasya uttarataḥ caturviṃśaddalaṃ paṃkajaṃ paṃcavarṇaṃ kṛtvā, kariṇikāyāṃ pūrva vatkalaśe sthāpayet - tatra vrīhiṣu ani yamaḥ - yāḥ phalinīriti ratnauṣadī prakṣipet - tataḥ kuṃbho paristha pūrṇa pātropari sarpokhyā māśleṣa pratamāṃ, namesta sarpebhyoḥ iti maṃtreṇa āvāhayet || tataḥ sarvo raktaḥ trinetraśca dvibhujaḥ nīla vastrakaḥ | phalakāsi tharastīkṣṇaḥ divyābharaṇa bhūṣitaḥ || iti sarpaṃdhyātvā, taddakṣiṇataḥ "bṛhaspate gṛtsamado, bṛhaspati striṣṭup" iti maṃtreṇa pratimāyāṃ bṛhaspati māvāhyauttarataśca "udīratāṃ śaṃkhaḥ pitarasvathā triṣṭup" anena pitṛ pratimā yāṃ pitṛ nāvāhya, prāgāditaḥ caturviṃśati paṃkaja daleṣu pūrvā mārabhya punarvasu paryaṃtaṃ nakṣatrāṇi taddevatāśca āvāhayet || yathā aryamā - bhaṃgaḥ savitā - tvaṣṭā - vāyaḥ - iṃdrāgnī - mitraḥ - iṃdraḥ - niṛrutiḥ - āpaḥ - viśvedevāḥ - viṣṇuḥ - vasavaḥ - ājaikapāt - ahirbudnyaḥ - pūṣā - asvinau - yamaḥ - agniḥ - prajāpatiḥ - somaḥ - rudraḥ - aditiriti || tato lokapālā nāvāhya, tataḥ ācāryaḥ agniṃ pratimāṃ, grahāṃśca, pratiṣṭhāvya, ānvādadhyāt - navagrahan prateka mamuka saṃkhyābhiḥ samiccarvā jyāhutibhiḥ, bṛhaspatiṃ, pitarānca, pratidravya maṣṭāviṃśati saṃkhyābhiḥ, ghṛta miśra pāyasānna samidā jyāhutibhiḥ, bhagādi caturviṃśati devatāḥ pratyeka maṣṭa saṃkhyābhiḥ pāyasājyāhutibhiḥ rakṣohaṇaṃ kṛṇuṣveti paṃcadaśa ṛgbhiḥ, pratyacṛ maṣṭa saṃkhyābhiḥ, kṛsarāhutibhiḥ, savitāraṃ, durgāṃ ; tryaṃbakaṃ, ṛtvikstutiṃ, vāstoṣpatiṃ, agniṃ, kṣetrāthipatiṃ, mitrāvariṇe, agniṃ etāḥ pratyeka maṣṭa saṃkhyābhiḥ kṛsarāhukhyābhiḥ samidājyacarvāhutibhiḥ, somaṃtrayo daśa saṃkhyābhiḥ, pāyasāhutibhiḥ, rudraṃ caturgṛhītena ājyena, agniṃ, vāyuṃ, sūryaṃ, prajāpatiṃca, ājyena, śeṣeṇasvi,ṭa kṛta mityādi, pūrṇapātra nidhānāṃtaṃ kṛtvā, pāyasa kṛsaṃcarūne śrapayatvā, ājyabhāgāntaṃ kuryāt || tato yajamāno dakṣimataḥ sarvadevatoddeśa tyāgaṃ kuryāt || cacaḥ ṛtviksahitaḥ ācāryaḥ homaṃ kuryāt | tadyathā - navagrahān, adhidevatā pratyadhidevatā vināyakādīn, lokapālāṃśca, tattasmaṃtraiḥ hutvā, sarvobhyo "namostu sarpebhyo" iti maṃtreṇa, bṛhaspataye pitṛbhyaśca, tattannaṃtraiḥ dravya catuṣṭayaṃ tattatsaṃkhyayā hutvā, bhagādi caturviṃśati devebhyaḥ nāmamaṃtreṇa, aṣṭa saṃkhyayā juhuyāt - tataḥ kṛṇuṣveti paṃcadaśaryā gotamo vāmadevo rakṣohaṇa striṣṭupe kṛsara home viniyogaḥ - gāyatrī, savitāraṃ, jātavedase, kaśyapodurgā, triṣṭupe kṛsarahome viniyogaḥ - tryaṃbakaṃ vasiṣṭo rudronuṣṭupe kṛsara home viniyogaḥ - sīrāyuṃjaṃtītyasya budhaḥ saumyaṛ - ṛṣayaḥ - ṛktsutirdevatā, gāyatrīṃ - cchaṃdaḥ kṛsara home viniyogaḥ - tāmagnivarṇāṃ saubhari durgā triṣṭup kṛsaraṃ - home viniyogaḥ *** vāstoṣpatervasi ṣṭhovā vastoṣpati striṣpup, kṛsaraṃ - home viniyogaḥ - gṛṇānā jamadagni rmitrāvaruṇau gāyatrī kṛsaraṃ - home viniyogaḥ - agniṃ dūtamityasya aṃgīraso virūpogniḥ, gāyatrī kṛsaraṃ - home viniyogaḥ - hiraṇyavarṇāmiti paṃcadaśarcasya suktasya, ānaṃdaḥ kardamaścīklī teṃdirāsutā ṛṣayaḥ, śrīrdevatā, ādyāstisronuṣṭubhaḥ - caturde prastāra paṃktiḥ - paṃcamī ṣaṣṭyātriṣṭubhau, tatoṣṭāvanuṣṭubhaḥ aṃtyā prastārapaṃktiḥ home viniyogaḥ - pratṛncaṃ samidājya carūnaṣṭa śatasaṣṭasya tamasaṃkhyayā juhuyāt - tvannaḥ soma ityasya carūnaṣṭa śathaṣṭānya tamasaṃkhyayā juhuyāt - tvannaḥ soma viśvatogopā itivā maṃtraḥ - tavannaḥ soma sukraturitivā - anayoraiṃdro vimadaḥ soma prastārapaṃktiḥ - tata ścaturgṛhīta mājyaṃ gṛhītvā, yātarudreti kaśyapo rudraḥ svarāḍanuṣṭup | anena juhuyāt - tataḥ sruveṇavasta samasta vyāhṛtibhiḥ ājyaṃ hutvā sviṣṭakṛdādi prāyaścitta homāṃtaṃ kuryāt || tato dikpālakebhyo navagrahebhyo vināyakādibyaḥ, niṛrutaye iṃdrāye adbhyo rudrāya kṣetrapālāyalāca, sadīpasūṣa balīn dadyāt || tataḥ ācāryo yajamāno vācaturgṛhīte navā, dvādaśa gṛhetyeva, srucaṃ pūra yitvā, tatra phalādika mapadhāya pūrṇāhutiṃ juhuyāt - tatra maṃtrāḥ samudrā dūrmirityekādaśa sūktasya, gautamo vāmadevo triṣṭupe, aṃtyā jagatī pūrṇāhuti home viniyogaḥ - prajāpetaye hiraṇyagarbha prajāpati stṛṣṭup pūrṇāhuti home viniyogaḥ - etaiḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ hutvā, praṇītāni nayanādi karma śeṣu samāsya, catuḥ kuṃbhamadhye partinaṃ kuṃbhaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ smapṛṣṭhvā, tryaṃbakamiti yājuṣaścedyajamānaḥ tā rudraikādaśanīmapi japet || bahvṛcastu rudrasūktāni - sāmagaścet rudrasāmāni - ararvaṇaścete triyaṃbaka maṃtramātraṃ - atrāpyekādaśāṣṭatri dvyeka saṃkhyayā rudrajapaḥ - śataṃ triyaṃbaka japaḥ sarveṣāṃ - tato rudra sarpān paṃcopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya triyaṃbakaṃ namestu sarvebhyaḥ ityupasthāya, sarvakalilodakaṃ prātrāṃtare gṛhītvā, sartvigācāryo yajamānaṃ sarvauṣadhībhiḥ anuliptāṃgaṃ dhṛtya navavastraṃ saputrāṃ patnimupaveśya, vakṣyamāṇa maṃtraiḥ abhiṣiṃcet | atribhyāmiti ṣaṇṇāṃ | kaśyapo vivṛhāyakṣmanāśonuṣpupe abhiṣeke viniyogaḥ - tribhiṣvaṃ deveti saptānāṃ vasiṣṭhaṛṣiḥ - ādyānāṃ trayāṇāṃ agnirdevatā tata ścaturṇāṃ viśvedevā ādyā gāyātrī dvitīyānuṣṭup tatastisrogāyatyroṃtye, dveaniṣṭubhau abhiṣeke viniyogaḥ - āpohiṣṭheta navanāṃbarīṣaḥ siṃdhudvīpaṛṣiḥ - āpogāyatryoṃtyedve anuṣṭubhau, paṃcamī vardhamānā saptamī pratiṣṭhā abhiṣeke viniyogaḥ - āpaidveti dvayo naptarṣayo viśvedevā anuṣpup - sahasrākṣeṇeti prajāpate yakṣmanāśino yakṣmahā triṣṭup || tataḥ - yīsau vajradharo devaḥ maheṃdro gajavāhanaḥ | sarpajātaṃ śiśordoṣaṃ mātā pitro rvyapohatu || yosau śaktidharo devaḥ huta bhuke meṣavāhanaḥ | saptajihvaśca devogniḥ sārpadoṣaṃ nyapohatu || yosau daṃḍadharo devaḥ dharmo mahiṣa vāhanaḥ | sarpajāta śiśordoṣaṃ vyapohatu yamo mama || yosau khaḍgadharo devaḥ dharmo mahiṣa vāhanaḥ | praśā mayatu sarpotdhaṃ doṣaṃ gaṃḍāṃta saṃbhavaṃ || yosau pāśadharo devaḥ gaṃḍāṃta saṃbhavaṃ || nakravāhaḥ pracetānaḥ sārpotthāghaṃ vyapohatu || yosau devo jagatprāṇo māruto mṛga vāhanaḥ ṣa praśāmayatu sārpotdhaṃ doṣaṃ bālasya śāṃtidaḥ || yosau nidhipatirdevaḥ khaḍga bhṛdvāji vāhanaḥ | mātā pitrościśoścaiva sārpadoṣaṃ vyapohatu || yosau paśupatirdevaḥ pinākī vṛṣa vāhanaḥ | āśleṣā mūla gaṃḍāṃtaṃ doṣa māśunyapohatu || vighneśaḥ kṣetrapo durgā lokapālā navagrahāḥ | sārpadoṣa praśamanaṃ sarve kurvaṃtu śāṃtidāḥ || āśleṣā ṛkṣa jātasya mātā pitro rdhanasyaca | bhātṛjñāti kulasthānāṃ doṣaṃ sarvaṃ vyapohatu || yosau vāgeśvaronāma adhidevo bṛhaspatiḥ | mātā pitro śiśoccaiva gaṃḍāṃtaṃ savyapohatu || pitara ssarparonāma adhidevo bṛhaspatiḥ | sarpanakṣatra jaṃbālaṃ vittaṃca jñāti bāṃdhavān || surā, stvetyādi bhirabhiṣicya, kacchaṃyoḥśaṃ yurviśvedevāḥ sakvare abhiṣeke viniyogaḥ - tato rudra sarpa kalaśodakena anyena ca śatacchidra dhārayo, abhiṣikto yajamānaḥ ācāryāya dhenuṃ, brahmaṇe vṛṣaṃ, rudrajāpine kṛṣṇa manaḍvāhaṃ, pratimāṃca ṛrvagbhyaḥ, yathāśaki dakṣiṇāṃca datvā, sarpāṇā muttara pūjāṃ vidhāya, tāmrapātre phala puṣpādiyukta marghyaṃ gṛhītvā || sarvādhīśa namastubhyaṃ nāgānāṃca gaṇādhipa | gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayādattaṃ svāriṣṭa praśāṃtaye || ityarghyaṃ datvā, uttiṣṭheti visṛṣya, saṃkalpa pūrvaka mācārmahase pratipādya āgniṃ saṃpūjya, gaccha gaccheti visṛjya, yadhāśakti brāhmaṇān bhojatvā, suhṛdyuktaḥ bhuṃjīyāt || a tha na kṣa tra vi śe ṣe pha la mu kta ṃ nṛsiha prasāde - citrādyarthe puṣyamadhye dvipāde pūrvāpāde diṣṇyapāde tṛtīye | jātaḥ putraścottarādyevidhatte mātā pitroḥ bhrātuḥ āyuṣyanāśaṃ || dvimāsaṃcottarodeṣaḥ puṣyecaiva trimāsakaḥ | pūrvāṣāḍheṣṭamānaṃ ca citrāṣāṇmāsikaṃ phalaṃ || navamāsaṃ tathāśleṣā mūlecāṣṭaka varṣakaḥ | jyeṣṭhamāsāḥ paṃcadaśa varjaye tputradarśanaṃ || yatra śāṃtiḥ noktā tatra grahamakhaḥ kāryaḥ | tasmācchāṃtiṃ prakurveta grahāṇāṃ kṛracetasāṃ || iti vasiṣṭena sarvakteḥ || mātsye - gargaḥ - divā prasūtābaḍabā śrāvaṇe ca viśeṣataḥ | māghāmāne bṛdhecaiva prasūtā mahiṣī yadi || siṃhe gāvaḥ prasūyaṃte svāmino mṛtyudāyakāḥ | jaṃgame sthāvaraṃ jātaṃ sthāvarevādha jaṃgamaṃ || tasminyoni viparyāse paracakrāgamo bhavet | tyāgo vivāsotthānaṃvā kṛtvāpyāśu śubhaṃ labhet || baḍabā hastinīgauḥyā yadi yugmaprasūyate | vijāti vikṛtiṃ vāpi ṣaḍbhirmānaiḥ mriyetasaḥ || viyoniṣu kurvaṃti maidhunaṃ sarve mūṣaka mārjāla matsyasśvāna vivarjitāḥ | jñayāḥ durbhikṣakartāraḥ svajāti piśitāśanāḥ || akālatomadodrekāt catuṣpānmṛga pakṣiṇāṃ | anyajāti bhayaṃ tasmāt dhenuśvānorviśeṣataḥ || athā naḍvāna naḍvāhaṃ dhenurdenuṃ yabhedyadi | śunīṃvā yabhate dhenuḥ śunīdhenu madhāpivā || tiryagyonau mānuṣīvā paracakrāgamo bhavet | amānuṣāḥ mānuṣāṇi balpaṃti praṇitoyadi || vikṛtaṃvā prasūyeta paracakrāgamo bhavet | tyāgo vilāso dānaṃvā teṣāṃ kāryaṃ vijānatā || tarpaye dbrāhmaṇāne ścaina bapahomān ca kārayet | mṛdaṃgavādyaiḥ paṭahaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ pūjāca kāryā tridaśeśvarāṇāṃ || dhātustadhejya vidhinācakāryā deyaṃ tathānnaṃ bahuca dvijebhyaḥ adabhutasāgare nāradaḥ - bhānau siṃhagatecaiva yasya gauḥ saṃprasūyate | maraṇaṃ tasya nirdiṣṭaṃ ṣaḍbhirmāpaiḥ nasaṃśayaḥ || prasūtāṃ takṣaṇādeva tāṃgāṃ viprāyadāpayet | tato homaṃ prakurvīta ghṛtā ktaiḥ rājasarṣapai || āhutīnāṃ ghṛtāktānāṃ āyutaṃ juhuyāttataḥ | vyāṅṛtibhiścāyaṃ homaḥ maṃtraśca devatāyāśca prajāpati sthiti vacanāt || sopavāsaṃ prayatnena dadyā dviprāya dakṣiṇāṃ | vastramugmaṃ yavāṃścaiva suvarṇaṃ ca pradāpayet || pauṣeca māhiṣī bhūte dinevāśvatarī tathā | tadānaṣṭaṃ bhavetkiṃcit tacchāṃtau śāṃtikaṃcaret || anyavāmeti sūktena tadviṣṇoriti maṃtrataḥ | juhuyācca tilājyena śata maṣṭottarādhikaṃ || mṛtyuṃjaya vidhānena juhuyācca yathoditaṃ | śrī sūktena tataḥ snāyāt śāṃti sūktenavā punaḥ || madhyāhnevā niśīdhevā yadāgoḥ kraṃdane sati | grāmevā svagṛhevāpi śāṃtikaṃ pūrva vaddiśet || evaṃ śrāvaṇeca baḍadā prasavoti vaniṣiddhaḥ ādharvaṇa vedināṃ gaurgya pariśiṣṭe - māghe budheca mahiṣī śrāvaṇe baḍadādivā | siṃhegāvaḥ prasūyante svāmino mṛtyudāyakāḥ || atra taduktāmṛtākhyā śāṃtiḥ kāryā - viśeṣo nirṇaya siṃdhau jñeyaḥ - iti siṃhādaugavādi prasava śāṃtiḥ nāradaḥ - kṛṣṇāgauḥ kapilavāsaḥ kapilaṃ kṛṣṇa evaca | tacchāṃtayetu viprāya dātavyāta kṣaṇānnaraiḥ || tato homaṃ prakurvīta śāṃtyardhaṃtu yavaistilaiḥ | namaste rudra maṃtreṇa dakṣiṇāṃtu pradāpayet || yathā vittānusāreṇa tata śśāṃtirbhaniṣyati | yena maṃtreṇa hotavyaṃ tanmaṃtraṃca tathā japet || śatāvarteti maṃtreṇa juhuyāccaiva maṃtrivit | śraphalasthāśca samidhaḥ śivārdhaṃ juhuyāttataḥ || aṣṭottara śataṃvāsi gāyatryāḥ japa uttamaḥ | śātikaṃ prajapedvipraḥ idaṃ viṣṇurvi cakrame || sahasra śīrṣā maṃtreṇa jape tpauṣṭika śāṃtaye | āpastaṃbaḥ - catuṣpādaṃ paṃcapādamavā bhavati tānyetāni tānyetāni sarvāṇi sūryadevatyāni adbhutāni srāyaścittāni bhavaṃti - udutyaṃjāta veda samiti sthālī pākāddhutvā, paṃcabhiḥ ājyāhutibhiḥ abhijuhoti - sūryāya svāhā | gṛhādi pataye svāhā | kiraṇa pāṇaye svāhā | īśvarāya svāhā | sapva pāpa śamanāya svāhā | itivyā hṛtibhiḥ hutvā atha sāmagāyati || iti kamalākara bhaṭṭa kṛte śāṃtiratne pitṛ putrayoḥ vikṛta prasava śāṃtaḥ ekasminneva nakṣatre bhrātrorvā pitṛ putrayoḥ | pragūtiścatayo rmṛtyuḥ bhavedekasya niścayaḥ || bhrātroḥ bhrātṛ bhaginyorityardhaḥ - pitroḥ nakṣatre putraduhitroḥ yati prasūti rityarthaḥ - bhrātroḥ putrayorityatra bhrātṛ putrau svasṛ duhutyabhyā mityeka śeṣaḥ - pitro rityatra pitā mātetyeka śeṣaḥ - madhyama padalopi asamardhaśca samā saścāṃdanaḥ - jyotirnibaṃdhe - samānabhe yadādevi pitā putrauca sodalau | bhaginyovā svabaṃdhūnāṃ tadā pūrvasya nāśanaṃ || taddoṣa nāśāya yadā praśastāṃ śāṃtiṃca kuryādabhiṣeca saṃca | saṃpūjya ṛkṣa pratimāṃ tadāgre dānaṃca kuryā dvibhavānurāpaṃ || tatra śāṃtiṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvācārya matenatu | śubharkṣe śubhavāre caṃdra tārā balānvite || riktā viṣṭivi varjyeva prāra bheddivase sudhīḥ | ācāryaṃ varaye tpūrvaṃ caturśca dvijo ttamān || puṇyāhaṃvāca yitvātu śāṃti karma samācaret | agne riśāna bhāgetu nakṣatra pratimāṃ tataḥ || tatta dṛokta maṃtreṇa pūjāye tkalaśopari | nakṣatra maṃtrāḥ apastaṃba śākhināṃ tṛtīyāṣṭake aṣṭavākyaiḥ prasiddāḥ || vidhānaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ janma nakṣatra pūjanaṃ || nakṣatra devatā pūjane tadadhi pratyathi devatā pūrvaka miti nibaṃdhokteḥ || rakta vastreṇa saṃbadhya vastrayugmena veṣṭayet | svaśākhoktena mārgeṇa kuryādagni mukhaṃ tataḥ || anenai vatu maṃtreṇa hune daṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ | tatta dṛkṣo ktenetyardhaḥ pratyekaṃ samidannādyaiḥ prāyaścittāṃtamevaca || abhiṣekaṃ tataḥ kuryāte ācāryaḥ pitṛ putrayoḥ | vastrālaṃkāra godānaiḥ acāryaṃ pūjayetpunaḥ || ṛtvijāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt māṣatraya suvarṇakaṃ | devatā pratimādānaṃ dānaṃ vastrādibhissaha || yānaśayyā sanādīni dadyāt māṣatraya suvarṇakaṃ | bhojayebbrāhmaṇān sarvān vittaśāṭhya vivarjitaḥ || atha prayogaḥ - mātā pitroḥ bhrātṛnakṣatro gomukhaṃ prasavaṃkṛtvā, deśakālau saṃkīrtya, asya śiśoḥ pitrādi nakṣatrotpatti sūcita sarvāriṣṭa śāṃtyardhaṃ ekanakṣatra janana śāṃtiṃ kariṣye - iti saṃkalpya, gaṇeśa pūjā ṛtvi gvaraṇānte ācāryaḥ aiśānyāṃ kalaśaṃ saṃsthāpya,tatra raktavastre jannamarkṣa pratimāṃ, tadṛkṣa maṃtreṇa, vastrayugmādyaiḥ, pūjayet || tatogniṃ grahāṃśca pratiṣṭhāpya, atra pradhānaṃ amukanakṣatraṃ taddevatāṃ vā samiccarvājyaiḥ, pratyekaṃ aṣṭasaṃkhyayā, śeṣema sviṣṭa kṛta mityādi balidānāṃtaṃ kuryāt || jyotirnibaṃdhetu - bhaktyā hariharau devau svarṇa rūpyamayau śubhau | ityuktau hariharau saṃpūjya - vividhākṛti viśvasya pitarau viśvatomukhau || priyetāṃ murtidānena devau hiriharāvubhau | ityācāryāya, anyanmaivā, dakṣiṇāṃ datvā, abhiṣekaṃ kuryāt || dāna homa videḥ paścāt dānādanvabhiṣecanaṃ ityuktaṃ || pūrṇāhutiṃ praṇītā vimekādi ca kṛtvā, kalaśajalena abhiṣicya, ācāryaya vastrālaṃkāragāḥ ṛtvigbhiśca māṣatrayamitaṃ suvarṇaṃ datvā, uttarapūjāṃ kṛtvā, visṛjya, ācāryahaste datvā, yadhāśakti dhānya vastrayānaṃ śayyāsanāni ācārya ṛtavigbhyo anyebhyo vādatvā, viprān bhojayet || iti śrī nārāyamabhaṭṭa suta rāmakṛṣṇabhaṭṭa suta kamalākara bhaṭṭakṛte śāṃtiratne ekanakṣatra śāṃtiprayogaḥ atha vyatīpāta vaidhṛti saṃkramaṇa prasava śāṃtiḥ śaunakaḥ - athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi śaunakaḥ śāṃti muttamāṃ | vaidṛtauca vyatīpāte mahādoṣobhijāyate || kumāra janmakāletu vyatī pātaśca vaidhṛtiḥ | saṃkra maścara vestatra jāto dāridyrakārakaḥ || daridrātāṃ mahāduḥkhaṃ vyāthipīḍā mahadbhamaṃ | āśriyaṃ mṛtyu māpnoti nātra kārya vicāraṇā || strīṇāṃ śokaṃ ca duḥkhaṃca sarvanāśa karobhavet | śāṃtirvā puṣkalā kāryā tatra doṣona kaścana || gomukha prasavaṃ kuryāt śāṃtiṃ kuryā trpayatnataḥ | japābhiṣeka dānāni śāṃti homaṃ viśeṣataḥ || navagraha makhaṃ kuryāt tasya doṣopa śāṃtaye | prathamaṃ gomukhājjanma tataḥ śāṃtiṃ samācaret || gṛhasya pūrva digbhāge gomayenānu lappata | alaṃkṛte sudeśetu vrīhirāśiṃ prakalpayet || paṃca droṇa mitaṃ dhānyaṃ tadardhaṃ taṃḍulenaca | tadardhaṃtu tilaiḥ kuryāt anyonyo pari kalpayet || drapya tritaya rāśautu aṣṭa patraṃ likhedbudhaḥ | puṇyāhaṃvāca yitvātu ācāryaṃ vṛṇuyātpurā || paṃcāṃgaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ dadyāt paṭṭa vastrāṃgulīyakaṃ | rāśau pratiṣṭhataṃ kuṃbhaṃ avraṇaṃ sumanoharaṃ || || tīrdhodakepa saṃgṛhya samṛddauṣadhi pallavaṃ| sagavyaṃ gaṃdha ratnaṃca vastrayugmena veṣṭayet || tasyo parisya setpātraṃ sūkṣma vasteṇa saṃyutaṃ | pratimāṃ stāpayoddhīmān sādhipatyadi devatāṃ || caṃdrādityā kṛtī pārśve madhye vaidhṛti marcamet | vaidhṛtiṃ taddevatāṃ, rudraṃ - evameva vyatīpāte śāṃtau saṃkramaṇasyaca || bhāno ruttarato rudraṃ agniṃ dakṣiṇato yajet || vaidhṛtau madhye rudraḥ - dakṣiṇo ttarayoḥ sūrya caṃdrau - saṃkrama vyatīpātayormadhye sūryaḥ - dakṣiṇottarayoḥ agni sūryā vityardhaḥ || niṣka mātreṇa vārdhena pādenāpi svaśaktitaḥ | pratimāṃkāraye ddhīmān tattallakṣaṇa lakṣitāṃ | tacca dāna paribhāṣāyāṃ mayoktaṃ || pratimā pūja nārthāya vastra yugmaṃ nivedayet | adhidaivaṃbhave tsūryaḥ caṃdraḥ pratyadhi daivataṃ || tattadvyāhṛti pūrṇeṇa tattasmaṃtreṇa pūjayet | tryaṃbakena maṃtreṇa pradhāna pratimāṃ yajet || utsūrya iti maṃtreṇa sūryapūjāṃ samācaret | āpyāyasveti maṃtreṇa somapūjāṃ samācaret || upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ yadvā paṃcopacārakaiḥ | arcitaṃ gaṃdha puṣpādyaiḥ phala naivedya marbayot || mṛtyuṃjayena maṃtreṇa pradhāna pratimāṃ spṛśet | aṣṭottara sahasraṃvā aṣṭottata śataṃtuvā || āṣṭāviṃśati maṃtraivaṃ prajapyātsva svaśaktitaḥ | sarvaṃ sauraṃ prajapyātha somārdhaṃ somamaṃtrataḥ || ānobhadreti sūktaṃca bhadrā agneśca sūktakaṃ | japecca pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ tryaṃbakaṃ ca tataḥ paraṃ || kuṃbhaṃ spṛṣṭhvā caturdikṣu japaṃ kuryā stathartvijaḥ | kuṃbhasya paścimedeśe sthaṃḍilegniṃ prakalpayet || svagṛhyokta vidhānena kāraye tsaṃskṛtānalaṃ | tryaṃbakena ca maṃtreṇa samidājya carūn hunet || aṣṭottara sahasraṃvā aṣṭottara śataṃtuvā | aṣṭāviṃśati homaṃvā kuryā tsvasyaśaktyanusārataḥ || mṛtyuṃjayena maṃtreṇa tilahomaṃ samācaret | tataḥ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ hutvā abhi,ekaṃ ca kārayet || samudra jyeṣṭheti maṃtreṇa āpohiṣṭheti maṃtrakaiḥ | ākṣībhyāmitisūktena pāvamānībhi revaca || tryaṃbakenahi utsūrya āpyāyanveti maṃtrataḥ | sūrāstva miti maṃtreṇa abhiṣekaṃ samācaret || ācāryaṃ pājaye tpaścāte vastra hemāṃgulīyakaiḥ | godānaṃ vastradānaṃ ca hemadānaṃ viśeṣataḥ || taddoṣaśamanārdhāya ācāryaya pradānayet | pracchādana paṭaṃ dadyāt tataḥ śāṃtirbhaviṣvati || jāpakebhyo brāhmaṇebhyo dakṣiṇāśca toṣaṇaṃ | dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇebhyaśca pradadyā dbhūridakṣiṇāṃ || brāhmaṇāne śatasaṃkhyākān mṛṣṭānnai dbhojayeccatān | baṃdhubhi ssahabhuṃjīta yathā vibhava sārataḥ || evaṃ yaḥkurute martyaḥ nai vaduḥkha mavāpnuyīt | āyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ mātā pitro śśiśorapi || sarvaduḥkha nivṛttiśca putra pautra pravardhanaṃ | sarvānkāmā navāpnoti sukhībhūtvā ciraṃvaset || iti śaunakīye vyatīpātādi śāṃtiḥ atha prayogaḥ - gomukha prasavaṃ kṛtvā, deśakālau saṃkīrtya, asya śiśoḥ vaidhṛti jananasūcita sarvāriṣṭa śāṃti dvārā śrī parameśvara prītyardhaṃ, vaidhṛti janana śāṃtiṃ kariṣye iti saṃkalpya, - evaṃ vyatīpāta saṃkrāṃtyeḥ eka dine tatsatvetu taṃtre ṇaikaiva śāṃtiḥ - asyatpūrvavat saṃkrāṃtau dine vaidhṛtisatve devatā bhedācchāṃti dvayaṃ pṛthakkāryaṃ tato gaṇeśa pūjā puṇyāhavācana nāṃdī śrāddhācāryartvigvaraṇāni kuryāt || tatra ācāryo yadatreti narṣapān vikīrya , bhūmiṃ prokṣya, pūrvasyāṃ mahidyauriti bhūmiṃ, spṛṣṭvā, tataḥ oṣadhayaḥ samiti paṃcadroṇamitaṃ tila rāśiṃ kṛtvā, upari samaṃ kṛtvā, tatra paṃcavarṇaiḥ aṣṭadaśaṃ kṛtvā, tatrā kalaśeṣviti kuṃbhaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya, imaṃme gaṃgeti tīrtha jalenāpūrya, tatra sapta mṛttikāḥ sarvauṣadhīḥ - paṃca pallava paṃcagavyāṣṭa gaṃdha paṃca ratnāni nikṣipya, vastrayugmenāveṣya, pūrṇa pātro pari vastre vaidhṛti śāṃtau dyāhṛti pūrvaṃ tryaṃbakaṃ vasiṣṭho rudronuṣṭupe iti madhye rudraṃ, taddakṣiṇe utpūrya iti sūryaṃ, taduttarataḥ āpyāyasveti soma māvāhayet || tataḥ paṃcavā ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya, rudra pratamāṃspṛśan, mpatyuṃ jaya maṃtra aṣṭa sahasraṃ aṣṭāviṃśatiṃvā japet - tataḥ sūrya pratimāṃ spṛśan, sarva saurān japet || yathā udutyami trayodaśa sūktasya kaṇvaputraḥ praskaṇvānavādyā gāyatryoṃtyāścata sronuṣṭubhaḥ - citraṃ devānāmiti ṣaṇṇā māṃgīrasaḥ kutsastriṣṭupe - iṃdra mitradvayo raucadhyo dirgha tapāstriṣṭupe - hagṃsaḥ śuciṣadikyasya gautama putro vāmadevo jagatī - yatvā sūryetyasya triṣṭup - yadadya sūrye tyekasya, utsūrya iti tisṛṇāṃ - udvayaṃtāni sārdhaścata sṛṇāṃ, udutya darśatāmititi sṛṇāṃ maitrā varuṇa striṣṭup aṃtyā bṛhatīśarṣaḥ - śīrṣa iti sato bṛhatī - taccakṣu riti pura utkṛt || brahmaha masīdidvorja madagniḥ pūrvā bṛhatī uttarāsato bapahatī - samo mitrasyeti dvādaśa sūktasya sūryobhi tapāḥ sūryo jagatī - sūryodipa iti paṃcasūktasya, sūrya putraśṭakṣu rgāyatrī - vitrāṭe bṛhaditi cata pṛṇāṃ sūrya putraścakṣu rvibhrāṭ jagatī - vibhrājamityasya prastāra paṃktiḥ - āyaṃ gaurityasya sārparājñī gāyatrī, sarveṣāṃ sūryo devatā - tataḥ soma pratimāṃ spṛn āpyāyasveti japet - vyatīpāta saṃkramama śāṃtau pūrvaṃ saura japaḥ - tataḥ mṛtyuṃjaya japaḥ tataścaturdikṣu ṛtvijaḥ kuṃbhaṃ spṛṣṭvā, avobhadrā iti sūktaṃ - bhadra agneriti sūktaṃ puruṣa sūktaṃ tryaṃbaka maṃtraṃca japeyaḥ - tataḥ ācāryogniṃ grahāṃśca pratiṣṭhapya anvādadhyāte || atrapradhānaṃ - rudraṃ aṣṭasahasrāṣṭa śatānyatara saṃkhyayā samidājya ca rudravyeṇa, tryaṃbaka maṃtreṇa, sūryaṃ somaṃca aṣṭaviṃśati saṃkhyayā, samidājya ca rudravyeṇa, vyatīpāta saṃkramaṇayostu sūryaṃ, rudra saṃkhyayāgni rudrauca, anuṣṭāviṃśati saṃkhyayā mṛtyuṃjayaṃ tryaṃbaka maṃtreṇa, tiladravyeṇa aṣṭasahasrāṣṭa śatāṣṭāviṃśati saṃkhyayāvā śeṣeṇa sviṣṭakṛta mityādi tataḥ uktahomaṃ kṛtvā, sarva śāṃtiṣu tilaiḥ mṛtyuṃjaya homaṃkṛtvā, balidānāṃte pūrṇāhutiṃ kṛtvā, samudrajyeṣṭhā iti sūktena āpohiṣṭheti cākṣebhyāmiti sūktena pāpamānībhiḥ, rudra sūryāgni maṃtraiḥ surāntvetyādi paurāṇa maṃtraiḥ ca abhiṣiṃceyuḥ - tato yajamāno rūpamityājya mavetrya, tatvātraṃ sadakṣiṇaṃ brāhmaṇāyadatvā, ācāryāya vastradvāyaṃgāṃ homāṃgulīyakādi suvarṇa pracchādana paṭaṃ datvā, ṛtigbhaśca dakṣiṇādi datvā, uttara pūjāṃ kṛtvā, visṛja ācāryahaste pratipādya agniṃ visṛjya, śata brāhmaṇān ṛtvijaśca bhojayet || iti śrī nārāyaṇabhaṭṭ kṛṣṇa bhaṭṭātmaja jamalākarabhaṭṭa kṛtau vyatīpātādi śāṃti prayogaḥ śaunakaḥ - grahaṇe caṃdra sūryasyaḥ prasūtiryadijāyate | vyādhipīḍā tadhā strīṇāṃ ādautu ṛtudarśanāt || itthaṃ saṃjāyate yasya tasya mṛtyurnasaṃśayaḥ | vyādhipīḍā ca dāridryaṃ śākaśca kalahobhavet || śāṃtiṃ teṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi sarāṇāṃ hitakāmyayā | yasminṛkṣe viśeṣeṇa grahaṇaṃ saṃprajāyate || tadṛkṣādhipateḥ rūpaṃ suvarṇena kalpayet | sūryagrahe sūryarūpaṃ hiraṇyena svaśaktitaḥ || caṃdraṃ caṃdragrahedhīmān rajatena viśeṣataḥ | rāhurūpaṃ prakurvīta nāgenaiva vivakṣaṇaḥ || nāgaḥ sīsaḥ - sucaudeśe prayatnena gomayena pralepayet | tasyo parinyaseddīmān navavastraṃ suśobhanaṃ || trayāṇāṃ caiva devānāṃ sthāpanaṃ tatrakārayet | śvetavastraṃ śvetamālyaṃ śveta gaṃdhānulepanaṃ || sūryaṃ saṃpūjayeddhīmān ākṛṣṇeneti maṃtrataḥ | caṃdra grahe tathā samyak āpyāya sveti maṃtrataḥ || svarbhānoriti maṃtreṇa rāhuṃ yatnena pūjayet | evaṃ saṃpūjanā ddhīmān samidbhiśchārka saṃbhavaiḥ || caṃdra grahetu pālaśa samidbhi rjuhuyānnaraḥ | dūrvābhi rjuhuyāddhīmān rāhoḥ saṃprīma nāyaca || samidbhiḥ brahmavṛkṣasya śeṣāya juhuyādbhudhaḥ | ājyena caruṇācaiva tilaiścajuhuyāttataḥ || || idaṃ sarpebhyaḥ || paṃcagavyaiḥ paṃcaratnaiḥ paṃcatvakpaṃca pallavaiḥ | jalai roṣadi kalkaiśca sahitaiḥ kalaśodakaiḥ || abhiṣekaṃ prakurvīta yajamānasya yatnataḥ | maṃtrairvāruṇa saṃbhūtai āpohiṣṭhādibhi stribhiḥ || imaṃmegaṃtu maṃtreṇa tatvāyāmīti maṃtrataḥ | abhiṣeketu nirtṛtte yajamānaḥ samāhitaḥ || ācāryaṃ pūjayetpaścāt suśāṃto vijiteṃdriyaḥ | tasmāddadyā trpayatnena bhaktyāprata kṛtitrayaṃ || gāṃcaiva dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt yajamānaḥ samāhitaḥ | anena vidhināśāṃtiṃ kṛtvā samyagviśeṣataḥ || ākāla mṛtyuṃ śokaṃ ca vyādhipīḍāṃ nacāpnuyāt | saukhyaṃ saumanasaṃ nityaṃ saubhāgyaṃ labhate saraḥ || itdhaṃ grahaṇa jātānāṃ sarvāriṣṭa vināśanaṃ | kathitaṃ bhārgaveṇedaṃ śaunakāya mahātmane || iti grahaṇa prasavaśāṃti atha yamala jananaśāṃtiḥ bhārate vṛddha gārgyaḥ - srīyāgorbaḍabāyāśca yamalaṃcaiva jāyate | jānīyādya matobhāti mārutīṃ śāṃti mācaret || kārayellakṣa homaṃca bahudānaṃca kārayet | bhojanaṃ brahmaṇānāṃca dadyādgāṃcaiva dakṣiṇāṃ || mahiṣīya malotpattau anyāsāṃcaiva janmani | dadyāccaivatutā maiṃdrīṃ deśādvā viphravāsayet || || kātyāyana || athāto yamala janane prāyaścittaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ || prāyascittaṃ bhavet tasyabhāryāgauḥ dāsīmahiṣī | baḍabāvā vikṛtiṃ prasavet pūrṇeda daśāhe | carurṇāṃ kṣiravṛkṣāṇāṃ kāṣāya mupasaṃharet || plakṣavaṭau duṃbarāśvattha śamī devadāru gaurasarṣapāḥ teṣāmaho hiraṇyaṃ dūrvāṃkuraiḥ sapallavaiḥ aṣṭaukalaśānprapūrya, sarvauṣadhībhiḥ daṃpatī snāpamitvā, āpohiṣṭheti tissabhiḥ, kayānaścitra itadvābhyāṃ, paṃcadroṇapaṃca vāruṇeneda māpaḥ pravahete tyapāda dyamiti snāpayitvā, alaṃkṛtya, taiḥdarbheghāpa viśya, tatra mārutaṃ sthālīpākaṃ śrapayitvā, ājyabhāgā viṣṭvā, ājyāhutīrjuhoti || pūrvoktaiḥ snapana maṃtraiḥ sthānī pākena jūhoti - agnaye svāhā, somāya svāhai, pavamānāya svāhā, pāvakāya svāhā, marute svāhā, mārutāya svāhā, marudbhyaḥ svāhā, yamāya svāhā, aṃtakāya svāhā, mṛtyave svāhā, bahmaṇe svāhā, agnaye sviṣṭakbhate svāhā || ityeta deva gṛhotpāte ṣuulūkogrudhraḥka poto
