gṛhaṃ viśet, śyenovāstaṃbhaḥ, prahohe dvālmīkaṃ madhujālaṃvā, bhaveduda kuṃbhaḥ, prajvalate āsana śayanayānabhaṃge, gṛhaṃgodhikā kūrmakṛkalāsśarīra sarpaiḥ praviṣṭe, chatradvaja vināśe, sārpe naiṛte gaṃḍayogeṣu anyeṣu utpāteṣu, bhūkaṃpolkā pātādiṣvevameva gṛhaśāṃtiṃ cokta vidhinā kṛtavā, ācāryāya varaṃdatvā, brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā, svasti dācavā dāśiṣaḥ prati gṛhṇīyāditi || tāvadbhahvṛca kārikāyāṃ || athayasya vadhūrgaurvā prasavedya malau tathā | samarudbhyaścaruṃ kuryāt pūrṇāhuti madhāpiceti || brahmaṇe, somāya, agnaye, marutvate, trayodaśaऱka pālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapet || āhutīrvā juhuyā ditvuktaṃ || atrāhitāgneḥ śrautena mārutaṃ trayodaśaka pālena samuccīyate || iti yamaśa janada śāṃtiḥ athatrika prasavaśāṃtiḥ śāṃti sarvasve - trisutāvā sutāstisraḥ jātāyati nṛṇāṃ tadā | mātā pitroḥ kulasyāpi tadaniṣṭaṃ mahadbhavet || jātanyaikā daśāhevā dvādaśāhe śubhedhine | ādārya ṛtvijo vṛtvā graha yajña purassaraṃ || brahma viṣṇu maheleṃdra pratimāḥ svarṇataḥ kramāt | pūjayeddhānyarāśistha kalaśo pariśaktitaḥ || paṃcame kalaśe rudraṃ pūjaye drudra saṃkhyayā | rudra sūktāni catvāri śāṃti sūktāni sarvaśaḥ || ācāryoju huyāt tatra samidājya tilāṃścaruḥ | aṣpottara sahasravā aṣṭottara śataṃtuvā || brahmādibhyaśca devebhyaḥ dikṣu graha purassaraṃ | brahmādi maṃtraiḥ riṃdrasya yata iṃdra bhayāmahe || tatasviṣṭa kṛtaṃ hutvā baliṃ pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ | abhiṣekaṃ kuṭuṃjasya kṛtvācāryaṃ prapūjayet || hiraṇyaṃ dhenumekāṃca ṛtvijāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ tataḥ | ājyasyā vekṣaṇaṃ kṛrvā śāṃti pāṭhaṃtu kārayet || iti trika prasava śāṃtiḥ atha sadaṃta janana śāṃtiḥ pādme viṣṇudharmottareca puṣkaraḥ - sadaṃta janmabālānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tannibodhame | upari prathamaṃ yasya jāyaṃte ca śiśordvijāḥ || daṃtairvā sahāyasyasyāt janma bhārgavasattama | dvitīye ca tṛtīye ca caturdhe paṃcame tathā || yadādaṃtāśca jāyaṃte mānecaiva mahadbhayaṃ | jananyā janakasyātha svadehātma saevavā || tatra śāṃtiṃ pravakṣyāmi tāṃme nigadataḥ śruṇu | gajapṛṣṭha śataṃ bālaṃ nausthaṃvā snāpayeddvijaiḥ || tadabhāvetu dharmajña kāṃcanetu varāsane | sarvauṣadai ssarvagaṃdhaiḥ bījaiḥ puṣpaphalaistathā || sthāpīpākena dhātāraṃ pūjayettadanaṃtaraṃ || saptāpaṃ cātrakartavyaṃ tathā brāhmaṇabhojanaṃ | aṣṭameha niviprāṇāṃ tathā deyātra dakṣiṇā || kāṃcanaṃ rajataṃgāśca bhūpaṃ vā dhanamevaca | ādbhuta sāgaretu sadaṃdotpattau paṃcadaśī śāṃtiruktīpādme || daṃtajanmani sāmanye śruṇusnāna mataḥ paraṃ | bhadrasane niveśyaivaṃ mūrdhni mūlaphale tathā || sarvauṣadhai sarvabījai sarvagaṃdhai stadaivaca | snāpaye dpūjayeccātra vahni homaṃ samīraṇaṃ || parvātāṃśca tathā khyātaṃ deva devaṃca keśavaṃ | eteṣā meva juhuyāt hutamagnau yathāvidhi || brāhmaṇānāṃca dātavyā yathāśaktyāca dakṣiṇā || || adbhuta sāgare bṛhaspatiḥ || bālānāmaṣṭamemāsi ṣaṣṭemāsi tataḥ punaḥ | daṃtāyasya ca jāyante mātāvāmriyate pitā || bālakaṃ phīḍayettatra svayameva mriyetvā | dadhi kṣira ghṛtā ktānāṃ aśvattha samidhāṃ tataḥ || hunedaṣṭaśataṃ prājñaḥ samaṃtreṇatu maṃtravit | dhenuṃ ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyā datassaṃpadyate śubhaḥ || jyotirnibaṃdhetu - aṣṭamamāsādiṣu śubha ityuktaṃ aṣṭamādiṣu māneṣu daṃtotthānaṃ śubha vahamiti iti sadantajāta śāṃtiḥ viṣṇudharottare mātsyeca - akāla prasavāḥ nāryaḥ kālatīta prajāstathā | vikṛtaprasavāścaiva yugmaprasavanaṃ tathā || amānuṣā amuṃḍāśca ajātavyaṃ janāstathā | hīnāṃgā adhikāṃgāśca jāyaṃteyadi vāstiyaḥ || paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścaiva tadhaiva ca sarīsṛpāḥ | vināśaṃ tasya desasya kulasya ca vinirdiśet || nirvāsayettān vṛpatiḥ svavoṣṭāt priyaśca pūjyaśca tato dvijeṃdraḥ | cikitsakaiḥ brāhmaṇa tarpaṇaiśca tatosya śāṃtiṃ samupaiti pāpaṃ || uśanāḥ - mānuṣī janayedyatra dvitriśīrṣān tadhā paśūn | ṣaṇmāsotdhaṃ bhayaṃ tīvraṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || vārāhepica - amānuṣā nmānuṣīca tathācaivāpya mānuṣī | prasūyaṃte prajānīyāt paracakrāgame bhavet || nīrīkharavṛṣoṣcrāśca śunaḥ sūkara gardabhān | rakṣasāṃśca piśācāṃśca yadāpyekaṃ prajāyate || caturvidhaṃ bhayaṃ ghoraṃ kṣiprameva pravartate || bhārata mayūra vṛddha gārgyaḥ - yatragarbha viparyāsaḥ mānuṣāṇāṃga vāmapi | adbhutāni prasūyante tasyadeśasya viplavaḥ || atrāpi śāṃtiḥ sahasākāryā paṃcadaśairbhudhaiḥ | mānuṣā mānuṣāṇāṃca go jāśva mṛgapakṣiṇāṃ || jāṃyate jātibhedāśca sadaṃtā vikṛtā stathā | bahuśīrṣā aśīrṣāva bahukarṇā akarṇakāḥ || ekaśṛṃgā dvitriśṛṃgāḥ tathai vatri caturbhujāḥ | dirghakarṇā mahākarṇāḥ gaḍakarṇāśca mānavāḥ || mānavāśvāpadā vyāghrāḥ mārjārā stanu dhārikāḥ | jāyaṃte paruṣā yatra tatra saṃgrāma mādiśet || rājyaśriyaḥ tatonāśaḥ dhanasya ca kulasyataca | yavalāyatra jāyaṃte nāreṇāṃ gajavājināṃ || brāhmaśāṃtiṃ tataḥ kuryāt yasmādbrahma praśīṃtidaḥ | aṣṭottara sahasrāṇi catuṃvai juhuyādghṛtaṃ || samidhastu palāśānāṃ tarpaye tpūrvavat dyijān | dāsīdāsa samāyuktaḥ godhānya phala saṃyutaṃ || kāṃcanaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ vastraṃ dadyā dviprāya dakṣiṇāṃ | aśirājāyate jantuḥ tathā dvitrivirāstathā || sūryādbutaṃ vijānīyāt pūjayitvā divākaraṃ | dadhyājya mathu saṃyuktāḥ samidhastvarka saṃbhavāḥ || dhenuṃ suvarṇāṃ vastraṃca dadyā dviprāya dakṣiṇāṃ | sarvadoṣāḥ vinaśyaṃti tataḥ saṃpadyate śubhaṃ || mṛgaṃ saṃjanayate sarpaṃ maṃḍūkāṃścātha mānuṣān | bṛhasavityadbhuta midaṃ tadvāretaṃ prapūjayet || jāduṃbarasya samidhaḥ dadhi sarpisa manvitāḥ | doṣopaśamanārdhāya juhuyānniyame sthitaḥ || vastraṃ suvarṇaṃ dhenuṃca dadyādviprāya dakṣiṇāṃ | strīgarbha pāto yamalau sranūyantedhavā stiyaḥ || sadantāścaiva jāyaṃte jātamātrāha santivā | budhādbhutaṃ vijānīyāt tadvāretaṃ prapājayet || vastraṃgāṃca suvarṇaṃca dadyā dviprāya dakṣiṇāṃ || ityadbhuta śāṃtayaḥ a tha su kha pra sa vo pā ya ḥ madanaratne nārāyaṇabhaṭṭikāyāṃ - karakībhūta gomūrdhā sūtikā bhavaneyadi tatkāleni hitovāyu sukha prasava kāṭhakaḥ || asthimātrā vaśiṣṭa gomastaka ityardhaḥ - upodakyāstu mūlāni taila yuktāni kārayet | yonau pralepo dātavyaḥ sukhaṃ nārī prasuyate || vaṃśa niṃbayostvak tulasī mūlaṃ kapittha patraṃca | karapīra bījametate piṣṭvā kṣīreṇa māhiṣeṇavai | samatolitaṃ satailaṃ yosiṃ liptvāca tenāsi | mṛta garbhaṃ nissārayatīkī matra citraṃ sukha prasave || iti sukha prasavopāyaḥ a tha bā la ra kṣā prathamehāni gṛhṇāṇi bālakaṃ gaṃdhinī gṛhī | gātrodyero nirāhāraḥ lālāgrīvā vivartanaṃ || niśīthe dhātakīlodhra maṃjiṣṭhā tāśa caṃdanaiḥ | dhūpame nmahiṣākṣeṇa tato muṃcati sāgrahī || bilastatraiva - matsyamāṃsa sūrābhakṣya gaṃdhā sṛgdhūpa dīpakaiḥ | maṃtrastu prayogasāre - oṃ namaścāmuṃḍe bhagavati vidyujṇihve svāhā, apasara baṃduṣṭa graha huṃ tavyathā gacchaṃtu yatonyataḥ sthāne rudra ājñāpayati svāhā, vidyujjihve hāṃ hīṃ huṃ huṃ muṃca muṃca svāhā || bālagrahāṇāṃ vidheyeṃ śasto bali nivedane || nārāyaṇīye asya maṃtraḥ || bāla graheṣu sarvatra bali maṃtrastvayaṃ smṛtaḥ | prayogasāre - kadaṃbaścakaraṃ jaśca vibhīto niṃba evaca || aśvattho duṃbaraucaiva śleṣmātaka vaṭau tathā | mātṛ vṛkṣāḥ krameṇoktāḥ pūrvādīśāṃ tadiggatāḥ || pratisthalaṃ pratyudakaṃ prati vṛkṣa mathāpikā | yatravāreca ye tatra mātaṇāṃ bali māharet || kṛtvā vinājanāṃtaṃ balimiti vidhivat bālamāhūya tatra | saṃspṛśyādbhiḥ samaṃtraṃ śirasi sakusumairakṣatai rrbhāmayitvā || kṣiptvāgre devatāyāḥ vithivadu pahitai statragītai ssumaṃtrai | kuryādraāṃ samakṣe kṣamaviva vilayaṃ yāti duṣṭa grahārtīḥ || nirijana maṃtrastu - brahma viṣṇuśca rudraśca skaṃdo vaikṣavaṇastathā | rakṣaṃtu tvaritaṃ bālaṃ muṃca muṃca kumārakaṃ || stutvāti rakṣā vidhau pādāṃtaṃ śirasaḥ spṛśedamunā maṃtreṇa dehaṃ śiśoḥ || majanaratne rāvaṇa sūnukṛte kaumāra taṃtre - saṃbhedakūladvāya mṛttikābhyāṃ mūrtiṃ vidhāyaikakara pramāṇaṃ || trilocanāṃ śūlaka pāla pāṇiṃ jaṭādharāṃ rudra tanuṃ dadhānāṃ | bhujaṃga bhūṣāṃ bhasitojvalāṃgī maṃgīkṛtā śeṣalālāmalīlāṃḥ || atramūrtau samāvāhya rudraṃ sarvagrahādhipaṃ | skaṃdādi pūtanāyuktaṃ pūjayecchaṃ danādibhiḥ || viracyataṃḍulai śśūrpe caturastraṃtara dvayaṃ | yatra saṃsthāpya pūrvāsyāṃ tāṃta darcāvidhiṃcaret || tattanmaṃtrairvi citraiśca nānopa karaṇāttataḥ | sopaskārāṃtatastāṃtu nikṣipecca catuṣpadhe || kārpāsāsthi mayūra piṃccha bṛhatī niṃbāsra paṃḍītakaṃ | kulyaṃ viṭchaśajaṃ vacā bhujagatvākkeṣaśāhi virmokakaiḥ || nāgeṃdra dvijahiṃgu bhṛṃgu maricaistulyaiśca dhūpaḥ kṛtaḥ | skaṃdosmāṃstu pisāca rākṣasa suraśvāsa jvaraghnaḥ smṛtaḥ || dvitīye divase māsi hayane vāsunaṃdave | gṛhlāti pūtanā bālaṃ yoginī svastinā pivā || tato bhavejjvaraḥ pūrvaṃ saṃkoco hastapādayoḥ | daṃtān prakhādatyaniśaṃ vimīlayati cakṣuṣi || āhāraṃ ca nagṛhṇāti divārātraṃ ca roditi | akṣirogaścardanaṃ ca bhavedbhītiḥ punaḥ punaḥ || kṛśatvaṃ ca prajāyet ityeta cchiśulakṣaṇaṃ | taṃḍula prasdhapiṣṭena vinirmāyādha putrikāṃ || trayodaśa dhvajādīpāḥ svastikāyai balodavaḥ | prasthapramāṇapiṣṭena siddhipūjāśca matsyakāḥ || māṃsaṃ cetyetadakhilaṃ paścimāyāṃ diśi kṣipet | paścimāyāṃca saṃdhyāyāṃ etaddadyāddi natrayaṃ || tṛtīye divase māse varṣevā pūtanābhidā | gṛhṇīyā dyoginībālaṃ tasya pūrvaṃ jvarobhavet || prasthapramāma piṣṭena putrikāṃ kāraye ttataḥ | raktodanaṃ dvajoraktāḥ svastiko rakta evaca || raktapuṣpaṃ raktagaṃdhaḥ tathā raktānulepanaḥ | paścimāyāṃtu saṃdhyāyāṃ udīcyāṃ nikṣipedbaliṃ || caturdhehani māsetu varṣegṛhṇati bālakaṃ | tuṣamaṃḍanikānāma pūtanāvātha yāginī || bhīṣaṇākhyaḥ tatastasya jāyate prathamaṃ jvaraḥ | gātrabhaṃgaścaru jmūdhardhno vaivarṇyaṃ cākṣimīlanaṃ || vaikathyaṃśvā matāśvāsaḥ kaṃposru ciritīṃgitaṃ | tilapiṣṭamayaiḥ kṛtvā putrikāṃ balvikaṃṭakaiḥ || aṣṭāgaṃ racayetpuṣpaṃ śuklaṃ śukla dhvajorjunaḥ | svastikordhvaṃ prasthasiddha bhaktaṃdāvadha pūpakāḥ || trisaṃdhyaṃ paścimāṃyāṃ balidadyā tprayatnataḥ | gośṛṃgaṃ sarpanirmoko laśunaṃ niṃbapatrakaṃ || manuṣyakeśa mārjāralo mānyajaṃ ghṛtaṃ tathā || etaiśca dhūpayedeka niśisaṃdhyā trayopica | paṃcame divase māse varṣvā pūtanā śiśuṃ || bikālikākhyā gṛhṇīyā tpradhamaṃ jāyate jvaraḥ | pikkāsvāsaśca mūlaṃca gātrabhaṃ gosruci stathā || taṃḍula prasthapiṣṭna nirmāyāthatu putrikāṃ | śuklodhanaṃ dhvājāḥ paṃcasvastikāḥ paṃca svistikāḥ || paṃcajojvalāḥ || paṃcadīpāśca śuklāni kusumānica caṃdanaṃ | aparāhṇ vṛkṣamūle paścimāyāṃ diśikṣipet || paṃcasūdiṣu caturdhadinokto dūpopīti madanaratne || ṣaṣṭhehani tadhā māne hāyanevāpi bālake | pūtanā śakunikānāmā gṛhṇīyāttadanaṃtaraṃ || jvara udvejanaṃ gatre śoṣaḥ śvāsārucī tathā | kāsaśca hastapādākṣi saṃkocaśceti lakṣaṇaṃ || taṃḍula prasthapiṣṭena virnamāyātha putrikāṃ | kṛṣṇodanaṃ dhvajā paṃcakṛṣṇa svastipaṃcakaṃ || kṛṣṇamevātha putrikāṃ pūrvavatkṛtvā palalaṃ śūlapācitaṃ || matsyā parpacikāścaiva raktaṃ ca prasthasamitaṃ | udīcyāṃ pūrvasaṃdhyāyāṃ balirdeyaḥ praśāṃtaye || saptame divase māse varṣe vāśuṣkarevatī | gṛhṇāṇi pūtanābālaṃ tataḥsyātprathamaṃ jvaraḥ || gātraṃbotha vidveṣa āhare kaṃparodane | prasthasaṃ mitapiṣṭhena samyakkṛtvātha putrikāṃ || saptadhvajā ssaptadīpāḥ svastikāḥ savtavaitathā | puṣpāṇa matsyaṃ māṃsaṃ ca bhaktaṃ cetyudagāharet || aṣṭame divase varṣe māsevāskramate śiśuṃ | bijālakā nāmadheyā pūtanāsya tato jvaraḥ || gātrabhodo ruciścaiva rodanaṃ netramīlanaṃ | jihvaśoṣa śirasphoṭāvā hāredveṣa evaca || taṃḍulaprasthapiṣṭena puttalīṃkārayettataḥ | pāyasaṃ madusarpiṣca kṣīraṃlājāśca śaṣkulīḥ || guggulaṃ meṣa māṃsaṃca tathā parpacikā api | dhvajādīpāśca catvāro gaṃdhā nānāvidā api || sumanāṃsica raktānī tyemamatro dito baliḥ | amuṃ samāharettūrva saṃdhyāyāṃ dakṣiṇādiśi || kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ vakṣyamāṇa maṃtreṇānena saṃyataḥ | navame dine māse hāyanevāpi bālakaṃ || gṛhṇāti naṃdanānāmnī pūtanā tadanaṃtaraṃ | jvāraśca ridrghṛṇā jñānaṃ kāsaśśvāsaśca tṛṣṇatā || gātrabhaṃgaśca śūlaṃ cihnānyetāni bālake | prasthamātreṇa piṣṭena vinirmāyaca putrikaṃ || odanaṃ matsya māṃsaṃca parpaṭīcekṣu mūlakaṃ | nikṣipe tpūrvasaṃdhyāyā muttarasyāṃ baliṃ diśi || tatra maṃtraḥ || oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya huṃ phaṭ svāhā || daśame divase māne hāyane vathabālakaṃ || pūtanā revatī nāmnī gṛhṇīyā dbālakaṃ tataḥ | jvaraścardiḥ śvāsakāsau śūlaṃ cetye tadīritaṃ || prasthapramāṇapiṣṭena putrikāṃ tatrakalpayet | aṣṭāṃgaṃ khilaye tatra bilvavṛkṣasya kaṃṭakaiḥ | guḍodanaṃ ca sarpiśca dhvajānāṃ paṃcaviṃśatiḥ | svastikānāṃ pradīpānāṃ paṃcaviṃśati revaca || catvāri raktapuṣpāṇitye taddakṣiṇa diggataḥ | saṃdhyātraye vakṣyamāṇa maṃtreṇāna vikṣipet || oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya hana hana huṃ phaṭ svāhā | ekādaśe dine māse hāyane pūtanārcikā || gṛhṇati bālakaṃ paścājvarantasya prajāyate | annadveṣo mukheśeṣo gātrabhaṃgaścarodanaṃ || ūrdhvadṛṣṭirapītye tallakṣaṇaṃ tadgṛhīci śoḥ || putrikāmāṣa piṣṭena rajitā śukla modanaṃ | puṣpāṇyapica śuklāni dhvajānāṃ paṃca viṃśatiḥ || svastikānāṃ pradīpānāṃ paṃcaviṃśati revaca | etatsarvaṃ yadhāśāyāṃ saṃdhyāyāṃ prātarāharet || oṃ namo bhagavate vajrahastāya oṃ phaṭ svāhā || dvādaśe divase māse varṣevā pūtanāśiśuṃ | rodanaṃ sarvadā daṃtakhādanaṃ raktanetratā || romāṃca snāvaitye tadakhilaṃ tasya lakṣaṇaṃ | taṃḍula prasthapiṣṭena kṛtvā tatrādhaputrikāṃ || trayodaśa svastikāśca dhvajadīpāstrayodaśa | apapā matsya māṃsaṃca tadhā parpacikāapi | etatsarvaṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi maṃtrema nikṣipet | oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya hana duṣṭasatvān huṃ phaṭ svāhā || madanaratne prayogasāre | varṣe trayodaśe bālagrahī gṛhṇīti yakṣiṇī || tacceṣṭa kilajaptveṃdrākṣiṃ hṛcchūla jvararodana hasanaṃ | śālyodana surāmāṃsa matsya kalmāṣa pāyanaiḥ || dadyātpa kṛsaraṃ śūrpe madhyāhne tridinaṃ baliṃ | pibetsarpistato muṃcati sāgrahī || varṣe caturdaśe bālaṃ svacchaṃdā nāmato gṛhī | gṛhṇīticeṣṭā tatrasyā cchoṇita srapaṇaṃ tathā || śūlaṃca nābhideśesyāttasya nāsti pratikrīyā || duṣṭagraha śāntāvasya pūrvoktamena nidhāna mityuktaṃ || varṣepaṃca daśe bālaṃ grahī gṛhṇīti vāruṇī | tatredaṃ ceṣṭataṃ taṃdrā jvaro nidrā vihīnatā || kulmaṣa kṛsarā pūpa holikā pāyasāsavaiḥ || sapūgakairbaliṃdadyātrti rātraṃ cāpi dhūpayet | caṃdanenājya saṃyuktaṃ tato muṃcati sāgrahī || ṣoḍaśe vatsare balagrahī gṛhṇāti durjayā || tacceṣā hasanaṃ kopoyā syāmīti vaco muhuḥ || kulmāṣa kṛsarā pūpatila piṣdhānna phalgukaiḥ | dadhnā sahabaliṃda dyātrpā cyāṃdīśi dinatrayaṃ || varṣe saptadaśe bālaṃ grahī gṛhṇāti bālakaṃ | kāsa śvāsauca vijñeyau nāsti tatra pratikriyā || saṃvatsara grahādyete kumārī pada parvakāḥ | ātrā paśiṣṭaṃ samānaṃ || iti śrīkamālākara chaṭṭakṛte śāṃtiratne madanaratnoktā bāla graha śāṃtiḥ || a tha pū ta nā vi dhā na ṃ tatralubdha jātakeskāṃde | sūryaṃ pratiskaṃca uvāca - yonakarma visākena śiśūnāṃ jāyate grahaḥ || tatsarvaṃ kathayiṣyāmi pṛccha taste divākara | laṃkāyāṃ rāvaṇonāma paulastyo rākṣasesvaraḥ | svasārastasya vīrasya dvādaśā san mahābhayāḥ | tābhiḥ kṛtaṃpo ghoraṃ sarvaloka bhayapradaṃ | pīḍitaṃ tātrirakhilaṃ jagattī pratavo balāt || rudra ārādhitastābhistapasātī vratejasā | prasanno bhūttadā devastābhya evaṃ paraṃdadau || rudra uvāca - varadohaṃ varārhābhyo yuṣmabhyaṃ rajanīcarāḥ | tābirvṛtaṃtadā bhakṣyaṃ bālānāṃ deha saṃbhavaṃ || vasāsṛjñmāṃsa medhosthi majjā śukrātmakaṃrave | dehi dehisya sarvaṃ bhojivato nova śaṃkaru || tacchratvā vacanaṃ tāsāṃcukopa parameśvaraḥ || brahmavaṃśa samudbhūtāstapo vṛtti parāyaṇāḥ | tatkathaṃ bālaghātevaścetasaḥ parivartanaṃ || sarvaloka mataṃ deyaṃ prārthi taṃtumanīṣibhiḥ || rākṣasya ūcuḥ || yadi prasanno bhagavan dadāsya smatpriyaṃ śiva | sarveṣāmeva bālānāṃ medasā tṛptirevanaḥ || rudra uvāca - yāstī niśāmukhe śnāti bāla spṛśati bhuṃjati | prasūti samaye bhyaṃgaṃ nakaroti pramādataḥ || nagnā nidrati rātrauvā niṣpanna suratāsatī | tasya bālaṃ dine māse varṣepica viseṣataḥ || ādyetu divase māse varṣecāpi vimocani | gṛhṇatu matprasādena jvarādyairvedanoccayaiḥ || dvitīyo mohinīnāma sunaṃdā tṛtīyake | caturdhe pūtanā nāma paṃcamyehyā surītthā | ṣṭhaṣetu piśācikā || navame pāśinīdevī śiśuṃ gṛhṇātu satvaraṃ | mahāmārītu daśame kālikātu tataḥ paraṃ || dvādaśe bhāginidevī pīḍākaraṇa tatparā | yūyameva kurudhvaṃboḥ pīḍāṃ bālika vigrahe || ātmano divase māse varṣecāpi pṛthak pṛthak | nimitte sati rākṣassya śśiśāveva kadācana | yuṣmabhyaṃ balidānaṃ yovi dadhatyakhilaṃ paraṃ | gṛhīta mapi bālaṃtaṃ saṃtuṣṭāḥ parimuṃcata || itilabdha varāssarvān | pīḍayaṃti śiśūn‌hitāḥ | dina māsābdimānena nātrakāryā vicāraṇā || prathame divase māse varṣedevī vimocanī | tasyāstu jāyatepīḍā śiśūnāṃ tīvravedanā | jvarastu prathamastāpaṃ netraroga stataḥ paraṃ || nagṛhlāti stanaṃḍiṃbho vāṃtirātyaṃkī bhavet | muṣṭiṃ badhnāmivegena daṃtā ndaṃtairdaśatyalaṃ || itthaṃ prajāyate pīḍā vimocinyā divākara || tasyāḥ pūjāṃ pravakṣyāmi bālānāṃ śāṃtikāriṇīṃ | karavīraṃ rkapuṣpaṃ caṃdanaṃ raktapuṣpaṃ caṃdanaṃ raktavastrakaṃ || dhūpastu śiva niramālyaṃ sājyaṃ bilvadalaṃ smṛtaṃ | dīpāstu paṃcavijñoyā stathā paṃcaiva polikāḥ || muṣṭikā paṃcavijñoyāḥ dhvajāḥ paṃcasupītakāḥ | tāṃbūlaṃ vaṭakāḥ paṃcapūgī phalasamanvitāḥ || raktataṃḍula bhaktastu proktassājya guḍastathā | śarāve nūtaneprājña vidheyaṃ sarvamevatat || tatastu puttalīṃ kuryānnadyā ubhayatomṛdā || nidadhyā ttatravaidhīmān pītavastra samāvṛtāṃ | pītasūtro palītāṃtāṃ pūjaye dbhaktimānnaraḥ || pūrvoktai revasaṃbharai gaṃdhapuṣpādibhi rbudhaḥ | vakṣyamāṇena maṃtreṇa pārthayottāṃ samāhitaḥ || tatra maṃtraḥ || oṃ namo bhaktavatsale vimocani svāhā | evaṃ maṃtraṃ samuccārya sarvān pūjāṃ prakalpayet || ekasninśa rāve puttalīṃ nidhāya gaṃdhādi tāṃbūlāṃ topacārānvidhāya paṃca pallavānekīkṛtya bālakāṃgebhyaḥ samuttārya saudakān || tataḥ punarnīrājanaṃ vidhāya tatsarvaṃ rātrau maṃtramuccāraya unnayet | tecapallavāḥ | jaṃbvā mroduṃbarośvattha vaṭānāṃ pallavasthatā || sarvāṃgebhyaḥ samuttīrya pīḍā bālasya saṃprajet | idaṃ nadyāṃ catuṣpathevā nikṣipediti śiṣṭhāḥ || itthaṃ rātritrayokuryā dvidānaṃ susamāhitaḥ || grāmāduttaratonityaṃ pūrvarātre vicakṣaṇaḥ || tasmin sthāne japenmaṃtraṃ bālānā śāṃtihetave | evaṃ praśāṃti māyāti śiśupīḍā sasaṃśaya iti lubdajātake skāṃdoktaṃ prathamīdivasamāsābde pīḍā śamanavidānaṃ || skaṃda uvāca - dvitīye divase māse varṣecaiva divākara | mohinīnāma deva yatra kurute pīḍanaṃ śiśoḥ || jvaraṃ netrarujaṃ kāsaṃ śvāsaṃcaiva viśeṣataḥ | chardanaṃ stasya vidveṣaṃ janayatyaniśaṃ śiśoḥ || tatra śāṃti vidānaṃca pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥ || mālatī kusumaiḥ pūjāṃ caṃdanaṃ malayodbhavaṃ | kuṃkumaṃ kesaraṃ divyaṃ karpūraṃ savilepanaṃ || divyābhakti sadācāraḥ daśāṃgaṃ dhūpakaṃ tadhā | naivedyaṃ pūrvavaddeyaṃ tathā syātpūrvavatkriyā || pūrvavattaputtalīṃ kṛtvā tsarvamaṃṃdritaḥ || tatra maṃtraḥ || sarvaśvarī sarvajanā priyaṃkari trāhi trahi jagatsarvaṃ oṃ namo bhagavati svāhā || ityanenaica maṃtreṇa sarvaṃ kṛtvā vidhānakaṃ || rātritraye vidhātavyaṃ paścime grāmatobahiḥ | prathame yāminīyāmekṛtaṃ bhavati saukhyadaṃ || iti dvatīyadivasa pīḍā śamana vidhānasaṃ || skaṃda uvāca - tṛtīye divase māse varṣe śṛṇuvidhiṃ rape || sunaṃdanāma devyatra bālānāṃ bhayadābavet | avasthāṃ kurute ghorāṃ sunaṃdācaiva bhāminī || hṛdroga chardaneśvāso jvareṇa sahajāyate | akuṃca yati gātrāṇi śiśū rodatya harniśaṃ || itthaṃ saṃjāyate sīḍā sunaṃdā kopa saṃbhavā | tasyāḥ śāṃti vidhānaṃca pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥ || śata patrāṇi puṣpāṇi caṃdanasyānu lesanaṃ | haridrā kuṃkumaṃ nāgakesaraṃ rocanānvitaṃ || gaṃdha dravyaiśca dhūpaṃca dadyādguggulu saṃyutaṃ | ghṛtākta khādirāṃgaraiḥ saṃpratāpya virocanaṃ || pūrva vatputtalīṃ kṛtvāśa rāve sanniveśayet | pasṛta trayaśālīnā modanaṃ sarpiśānvitaṃ || dīpakāḥ polīkāḥ paṃcatāvatyo muṣṭikāḥ smṛtāḥ | dhvajāṃ paṃcaiḥ va vijñeyā ssahitāḥ paṃcapallavaiḥ || vakṣyamāṇena maṃdreṇa batiṃ sarvaṃ samāharet | tatra maṃtra || oṃ namaḥ sunaṃdāyau huṃ phaṭ svāhā | ityanenaiva maṃtreṇa grāmātpūrve vinikṣipet || trirātraṃ rajanī pūrvayāme bālopaṃśāṃtaye | evaṃ kṛte vidhānetu sarvavyādhirvi naśyati || vardhate deva vadbālaḥ śukla pakṣaubjavatsukhaṃ | abjaścaṃdraḥ iti tṛtīya dina pīḍā śamana vidhānaṃ || skaṃda uvāca - caturdhe divase māse varṣecaiva vibhākara | pūtanā nāmadevyatra pīḍaṃ prakurute śiśoḥ || saṃtāpo jāyate pūrva matisāraḥ tataḥ paraṃ | muṣṭiṃ badhnāti kaṃpaśca vāraṃ vāraṃ prajāyate || tasyāḥ śyātiṃ pravakṣyāmi pīḍāyā uṣṇadīdhite | pūrvavatputtalīṃ kṛtvā śarāvena nniveśayet || veṣṭayedrakta sūtreṇa kuṃkumenānu lepayet | pūjā duttūra puṣpaiśca barbarī patra paṃyutaiḥ || matsyaṃ māṃsaca dhūpotragavye nājyena saṃyutaḥ | trayo dīpāsri koṇāstu | dhvajāstrayasvamākhyātā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || prasṛti traya muddiṣṭhaṃ taṃḍulānāṃ prabhākara | tadbhaktaṃ sarpiṣāyuktaṃ śarāve sanniveśayet || rakta vastreṇa saṃvītāṃ namaskṛtvātu puttaliṃ | dadhyākṣatādi saṃropya nidadhyāttu samāhita || pallavaiḥ paṃcabirbālaṃ sarvāṃgeṣu pramārjayet | maṃtraḥ || oṃ namaḥ pūtane mātarbaliṃ saṃgṛhya śobhanaṃ | bālakaṃ muṃcavegena balidānena harṣitā || iti maṃtraṃ samuccārya sarvaṃ bali mupaharet | pradoṣe kṣaṇa nirvitte sapta saṣte vidhiṃ śṛṇu || dakṣiṇāṃ diśi māśritya nikṣimedgrāmato bahiḥ || evaṃ kṛte balau samyak bālakaḥ sukhamāpnuyāt | iti caturdha dina māsādi pīḍā śāṃti vidānaṃ || skaṃda uvāca - paṃcame divase māse varṣecaiva prabhākara | asurīnāma devyatra bālakaṃ bādhatebhṛśaṃ || tatra cihniṃ pravakṣyāmi bālāṃgeya tprajāyate | jvarastu pradamaṃ paścāddṛdro go gṛhīṇī tataḥ || muṣṭu baṃdhaḥ pralāpasyā dudvegosnaśanaṃ tadhā | śirorugjāyate tyaṃtame tatsyāllakṣaṇaṃ rave || parva vatputtalīṃ kṛtvā pītasūtreṇa veṣṭayet | pīta vāso vasānāṃtāṃśa rāve sanniveśayet || kṛtābhyaṃgo dvartaneca haridrā lepanekṛte | tataḥ pūjāṃ prakurvīta kusumaiḥ karavīrakai || japā puṣpairbaṃdhujālaiḥ puttaśyāscha tathā nakhu || caṃdanenāma liptāṃtāṃ divya gaṃdhopa śobhitāṃ | rājakā sarṣapairdhūpo ghṛtāktotra praśasyate || dīpakā ssapta vitroyā dhvajāstāvaṃta evaca | muṣṭikāḥ polikāḥ saptasājyākta paṭakā stathā || naivedyārthaṃ samudiṣṭa modanaṃ saghṛtaṃbaliḥ | pallamaistu yadhāpūrvaṃ kāraye nmārjanaṃ śiśoḥ || maṃtra metaṃ samuccārya trivāraṃ tatrapūjanaṃ | maṃtraḥ || sukale subhage devī sarvaśatṛ nivāriṇi | kuru śāṃtiṃ śiśoścāsya balidānena rākṣasi || ityuccāryakṣipetpūrvaṃ madhyarātre trivāsaraṃ | paścimāṃ diśimāśritya yāmārdhā naṃtaraṃ rave || iti paṃcama divasādiṣu asurī pīḍa śāṃti vidhānaṃ || skaṃda uvāca - atha ṣaṣṭhadine māne varṣecāpi divākara | revatī nāma devatya śiśuṃ gṛhṇatya saṃśayaṃ || tasyādau jāyate pīḍā praṇāni śiśumūrdhani | jvarastu mukhiśoṣo pitṛṣṇā pitṛṣṇā namabhijāyate || prakaṃpati ca gātrāṇi rudatyapi punaḥ panaḥ | tatra śāṃti pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu sūrya samāhitaḥ || pūrvavatputtalīṃ kṛtvā śarāve sanniveśayet | gaṃgātoyena saṃsnāpya śuklavastreṇa veṣṭayet || śaklavastreṇa saṃvītāṃ śuklamālyānulepitaṃ | śukla dhūpotra nirdiṣṭo bilvapatraiḥ sahānagha || ājyenāktāśca viśvātman dīpāḥ paṃcapragīrtitāḥ || tāvatyo muṣṭikājñoyāḥ polikābhiḥ samannītāḥ || prasṛti trayamātrāṇāṃ vrīhiṇā modanaṃ smṛtaṃ || dadhnā sahāguḍenāktaṃ tāṃbūlaṃ sumanoharaṃ | dvajaiśca paṃcabhiryuktaṃ balimetaṃ samarpayet || vakṣyamāṇena maṃtreṇa prakṣipecca samāhitaḥ || tatra maṃtraḥ || baliṃgṛhāṇa sakalaṃ bālaṃ muṃca śubhānane | kṣemaṃ kuru jagatyasmin sobhanā bhava revati || iti maṃtreṇa samaṃtrya pradeṣe balimāharet | saṃsnārya bālakaṃ paṃca pallavaiḥ susamāhitaḥ | nagarā duttaredeśe revatyai balimāharet | evaṃ praśāṃti māyāti bālapīḍā prabhākara || iti ṣaṣṭhadinādi pīḍāśāṃti vidhānaṃ || skaṃda uvāca - saptame divase māse varṣyaiva divākara | śakuni rnāmadevyatra bālaṃ gṛhṇāti dāruṇā || jvarstu pradhamaṃ tāpacchiro regastataparaṃ || pralāpa stvatisāraśca vāṃti rātyaṃtakī bhavet | akṣornimīlanaṃ cāpi gātraṃ kaṃpobhi jāyate || tatra śāṃtiṃ pravakṣyāmi saptāśva prītivardhanāṃ | raktacaṃdana liptāṃgīṃ pūrvavatputtalīṃ kṛtāṃ || yadhākālodbhavaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjaye dyatnataḥ | sudhīḥ dhūpastu guggulośroyān dīpāḥ paṃcaprakīrtitāḥ || polikā muṣcikāścaiva paṃca paṃca suśobhanāḥ | nai vedyaṃ modanaṃ sarpisahitaṃ prasṛtairmataṃ || taṃḍulānāṃ sura śreṣṭha maṃtravūtaṃ prakalpayet | maṃtraḥ || padmapatra viśālākṣi pamāharet | dakṣiṇāṃ diśimāśritya vidadhyācchāṃtidāṃ kriyān || evaṃkṛte vidhānetu trirātraṃ surasattama | vyādhimukto bhavedbālo nātrakāryā vicāraṇā || iti saptamadivasādi pīḍā śamana vidhānaṃ || aṣṭame divase māse varṣedevī pilācikā || pīḍayatveva bālānyaijvaracaradhi śirorujaḥ | netrapījāṃga saṃkoco hṛdrogaścābhijāyet || śruṇutasya pratīkāraṃ yonatuṣye tpiśācikā | prakuryācca trirātreṇa śāṃtiṃ bālā rtihariṇīṃ || pūrvavatputtalīṃ kṛtvā śarāvesanniveśa yet | paṃcāmṛtaistu saṃsnāpya divīṃtāṃ śiśunā saha || caṃdanenānuluptāṃgī śvetapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet || thvajāḥ saptasaṃkhyātā stavantyaḥ polikāsmṛtāḥ || muṣṭiṃkāścāpi vijñeyā haridrāktā śśubhāsmṛtāḥ | pītavarṇena vastreṇa sūtreṇāpi susaṃskṛtān || vijayācūrṇadhūpotra ghṛtāktaḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ | dīpāḥ saptaghṛtenaiva pūrvayitvā niyojayet | prasṛtitraya bhaktasya ghṛtāktasya viśeṣataḥ || naivedyaṃ kalpayoddīmān devaibhaktya susaṃyutaḥ | tāṃbūlaṃca sakarpūraṃ bhaktyābhyāśe vidhīyate | śaktyāca dakṣiṇā tatra devatā prītayerave | pakṣyamāṇena maṃtreṇa svarameva vidhīyate || maṃtraḥ || oṃ namassarvabhūteśi śobhanetvaṃ piśācike | baliṃcemaṃ gṛhītvātvaṃ tvaritaṃ muṃca bālakaṃ || yathāpūrvaṃ tathā kāryā paṃcapallava satkriyā || trirātraṃ rajanīvaktre grāmātpūrvaṃ baliṃkṣipet | evaṃ kṛte vidhānetu roga śāṃtiḥ prajāyate || iti brahmayāmaloktaṃ aṣṭama divasādi bādhāśamanaṃ || skaṃdaḥ uvāca - navame divase māse varṣecaiva prabhākara | devatā pāśinī nāma bālārtiṃ kurute bhṛśaṃ || tatra cihniṃ pravakṣyāmi samāsena divākara | jvara chardigadhe pīḍā saṃkoco netrayostathā | tarjanī madhyayo ryoga magrābhyāṃ kurute bhṛśaṃ | annatyāgopa saṃtoṣo mukhe gaṃdhobhi jāyate || tatra śāṃtiṃ pravakṣyāmi pāśinī prītayorave | pūrva vastaputtavalīṃ kṛtvāśa rāve sanniveśayet | śukla sūtreṇa saṃvītāṃ śukla vastreṇa veṣṭitāṃ || pūjayeccukla puṣpaistu maṃdārādyaiḥ sugaṃdhibhiḥ || gaṃdhārdhe ghana sāreṇa yuktaṃ kaṃdana marpayot | savavāstavāpūpān pośīkānnapacottamān || tāvanto muṣṭikā dadyārdhvajāṃ ścaiva tathaivaca | nava prasṛti mānesa taṃḍulodana muttamaṃ || dadhyākṣīreṇa cābhyukṣanai vedyaṃ parikalpayet | madhyarātra traye grāmātpaścime prakṣipedbaliṃ || mastreṇānena pāśiny maṃtrocchāraṇa pūrvakaṃ | maṃtraḥ || oṃ namaḥ pāśa hastāyai rudra dattavara śubhe | grahāṇe maṃbaliṃ dattaṃ bālakaṃ muṃca rogataḥ || etāvatā vidhānena rogamukto bhavecchiśuḥ | paṃcānāṃ pallavānāṃtu pūrvavatkriyate kriyā || iti brahmayā miśoktaṃ navama dinādi śāṃti vidhānaṃ || śrī skaṃda uvāca - daśame divase māse varṣe caiva divākara śakti ratra mahamārī rākṣasī ghorarūpiṇi || mṛta kalpaṃ jvaraṃ śūlaṃ vidadhāti divāniśaṃ | viṣṭaṃbhaṃ kurutetyarthaṃ hikkākāsaṃ matitrayaṃ || tasya śāṃtiṃ pravakṣyāmi bālānāṃ hita kāmyayā | pūrva vatputtalīṃ kṛtvā śarāvena niveśayet || snāpaye tsaritāṃ vārbhiścaṃdanenānu lepayet | pītavastreṇa saṃvītāṃ puṣpa mālopa śobhitāṃ || daśāṃgaṃ dhūpaye ddhūpaṃ mahāmāryrai prakalpayet | dīpāstu paṃcavijñeyāḥ tāvaṃtyaḥ piṣṭamuṣṭikāḥ || muṣṭikāḥ paṃcavai śastādhvajāḥ paṃca sulobhanāḥ saṃskṛtaṃ sarpiṣā bhaktaṃ taṃḍulānāṃca puṣkalaṃ || naivedyārthenya settatra śarāve sumanoharaṃ || tāṃbūla sahitaṃ bhāno dakṣiṇā sahitaṃ tadhā | dakṣiṇārdhe navaṃ vastraṃ rajataṃ śaktitopivā || pallavaiḥ paṃcabiryuktaṃ baliṃ sarvaṃ samarpayet | madhyarātrā dadhastāttu baliṃ kuryāddinatrayaṃ || dakṣiṇāṃ diśimāśritya paścimena garādbahiḥ | maṃtraḥ || oṃ namo raktavarṇākṣi rakta padmanibhānane | raktoṣṭhe rktadaśane mahāmāri mahābhaye || mahābale mahākāye mahābhaya nivāraṇe | anena balidānena tuṣṭābhava suśobhane || vyādhinā pīḍitaṃ rakṣatvaṃ parameśvari | kānāṃ hinātra kāryā vicāraṇā | iti brahma yāmalokta daśamadina pīḍā śāṃti vidhānaṃ || ekadaśadine māse varṣecāpi divākara | kālikānāma devyatra tatpīḍājāyate śiśoḥ || jvarastu prathamaṃ tāvat hṛdrogasta danaṃtaraṃ | mukhaśoṣo mahāglāni statassyāccitta vibhranuḥ || tudaṃti sarvāgātrāṇipe paṃtica punaḥ punaḥ | avasthā mṛtyu kalpāsyākkālikā kopa saṃbhavā || tatra śāṃtiṃ pravakṣyāmi bālānāṃ hitakāmyayā | pūrvavatputtalīṃ kṛtvā śarāvesaṃ nivesayet || gaṃgātoyena saṃsnāpya caṃdanenānu lepayet | karavīrasya puṣpaistu pūjaye dbarbarīdalai || dhūpayennarake śaiśca sarpanirmoka narṣapaiḥ | vacāla śunaphainaiśca ghṛtayuktaiḥ ssavarjakaiḥ || dīpaistu paṃcabhiḥ sūrya kalpai rnīrājayottutāṃ | naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ kṣīraṃ pāṣṭikā stila modakāḥ || āpūpā muṣcikāḥ polīḥ paṃca paṃca prakalpayet | dhvajāśca paṃcavicñeyā śśarāve sarvamevatat || niveśya sakalaṃdevyai kālikāyai nivedayāt | maṃtreṇānena saptāśva vakṣyamāṇenatemayā || oṃ namo ghorarūpāyau ghorāyai ghoradarśane | trāhi sarvaṃ jagaddhātri bālaṃ muṃcābalaṃ priye || evaṃ vidhaṃ vidhiṃ kuryātpūrva vatpallava kriyāṃ | evaṃ kṛte vidhānetu rogamukti rbhavecchiśoḥ || baliḥ pradoṣa samayo grāmāddakṣiṇato bahiḥ | nidhāya maṃtra muccārya rakṣākāryā vibhūtinā || iti brahmā yāmaloktaikādaśa dina māsābda pīḍā śamanaṃ || skaṃda uvāca - dvādaśe divase māse varṣecaiva divākara | bhāmisī nāmadevyatra pīḍayatya niśaṃ śiśuṃ || ādau jvaraṃ prakuryāca hṛdrogaṃ tadanaṃ taraṃ | kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ tvatīsāraṃ pralāpaṃ bṛṃbhaṇaṃ tathā || kaṃpaṃti sarvagātrāṇi tathā jāḍyaṃ ca netrayoḥ | iddhaṃ nānāprakāraiśca śiśūnāṃ jāyate gadaḥ || tatra śāṃtiṃ pravakṣyāmi bālānāṃ hitakāriṇīṃ | pūrvava tputtalīṃ kṛtvā śarāve sanniveśayet || gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatā dūpadīpāśca vividhāmatāḥ | nai vedyaṃ vividhaṃ cātrabhūminyai parikalpayet || vastraṃ sukṣmaṃ dhvajaṃ chatramodanaṃ pāyasānvitaṃ | apūpaiḥ pāyavaiḥ kṣīrapāṣṭīkābhiśca saṃyutaṃ || naivedyaṃ kalpayedbhyaktā saṃdhyākaile viśāmukhe | grāmāduttaratodeśe baliṃ dadyānna saṃśayaḥ || itthaṃ paṃcadineṣveva kartavyaṃ rogamuktaye | maṃtreḍā nena saptāsva maṃtraye tsarvatobaliṃ || baliṃ grahāṇa bālasya vyādhiṃ saṃhara saṃhara | paṃcavaktra prasādena prasannā bhavabhāminī || evaṃ kṛte vidhānetu bālakaḥ kṣemamāpnuyāt | itthaṃte kathitaṃ sūrya śāṃtikaṃ lubdhajātake || iti dvādaśadina māsābdeṣu skāṃdoktaṃ hīḍā śamasavidhānaṃ || iti pūtanāvidhānaṃ samāptaṃ || <5> atha jvarotpattau nakṣatra śāṃtayaḥ tatra madanaratne - ātreya uvāca - atha nakṣatra parijñānaṃ vakṣye || aśvanī tritārā - strī - aśvamubhī - tiryaṅmakhī - pītavarṇā - kāṃci vṛkṣaḥ - kanakapakṣī - laghuḥ - aśvanau devatā - devagaṇaḥ - yonirvājī - akṣare ākāra ākārau - ṛtugamana caula śrāttha vastrī dhāraṇānna prāśana bhaiṣajya bījānāpana nāśi kerekṣu sthāpanavastu saṃgrahaṇādi kuryāt || paṃcāśannāḍi kāṃte catasro viṣanāḍyaḥ - makaramāse śūnyaṃ - budhavāre mṛtyuyogaḥ - arkavāre ānaṃda yogaḥ - kecitkalaha micchaṃti - bhaumavāre siddhayogaḥ - mudrānna bhojanaṃ kṛtvā yātrāṃ gacchet - āyuda saṃgrahaṃca kuryat - tasmin madhyāhne rakta meghotpatti ścetpaṃcadineṣa dinevā vṛṣṭisvapyat - taddine kujavāre viṣnuṃ jvarotpattiśce ddaśadinā pīḍā - nīlotpala puṣpaiḥ pūḍā - guggulu dhūpaḥ - kṣīra laḍḍuka naivedyaṃ - devasyatveti pūjā maṃtra vidhiḥ - kṣīra vṛkṣa samitprathāna dravyaṃ - gāyatyrāṣṭa śataṃ hutvā dadhyodanaṃ baliṃ dadyāt - ekādaśa dinādārabhya paṃca viṃśati dināṃte sukhīsyāt - saṃkrame madhya morghaḥ - ātra kartādeśa kālau smṛtvā mamāmuka nakṣatrai jvarotpatti sūcita sarvāriṣṭa śāṃti dvārā kṣiprārogya sidhyardha mamuka nakṣatra śāṃtiṃkariṣye - iti saṃkalpya - gaṇeśaṃ saṃpūjyā cāryaṃ vṛṇuyāt - ācāryastu homa deśādīśānye mahīdvauriti bhūmiṃ spṛṣṭvā - oṣadayaḥ samiti yavānni kṣipya ākalaśeṣvati kuṃbhaṃ nidhāyomaṃme gaṃgetyapa āpūrya - gaṃdhadvārā miti gaṃdhaṃ - yā oṣadīriti sarvauṣadhīḥ - kāṃḍātkāṃḍāditi dūrvāḥ - aśvattheva iti paṃca pallavān - syonāpṛthivīti saptamṛdaḥ - yāḥ philinīriti phalaṃ || sahiratnānīti paṃcaratnāni - hiraṇyastūpa iti hiraṇyaṃca kṣiptvā - yuvāsu vāsā iti vāsa sāveṣṭya - pūrṇā darvīti pūrṇapātre vastropari dvādaśa dalaṃ padmaṃ kṛtvā - nakṣatra devatāṃ prati māyāṃ tanmaṃtreṇāvāhya parito dvādaśa daleṣu saṃkarṣaṇa vāsudevādi dvādaśa devatā āvāhya dikpālāṃścā vāhya tatra tatrokta gaṃdha puṣpa dhūpa dīpa nai vedyaiḥ saṃpūjyāgniṃ pratiṣṭhāpya tadukta dravyairgāyatraṣṭottara śataṃ nakṣatra devatāyai saṃkarṣaṇādi bhyoṣṭau catrasra ekāṃvā āhutiṃ hutvā sviṣṭa kṛdādi praṇītāvisarjanāṃte dravyairbaliṃ datvāscāryāya dakṣiṇāṃ datvā kuṃbhodakenābhiṣekaṃ kṛtvā visṛjya pratimādika mācāryāya datvā agniṃ nisṛjya brāhmaṇān bhojayediti prayoga saṃkṣepaḥ || eva magrepijñeyaṃ || || bharaṇī tritārā - trikoṇākṛtiḥ - stī - athomukhī - yamo devatā - ugrā - manuṣyagaṇaḥ - gaḍayoniḥ - āmalakovṛkṣaḥ - pakṣī kukkuṭaḥ - akṣaऱe ikāra īkāre - madhyāhne raktameghotpattiścet ṣoḍaśadine vṛṣṭiḥsyāt - kujavāre vighnaṃ - dravya saṃgrahaṃ bṛhatī kāravallikā sthāvanaṃ ca kuryāt - caturviṃśati nāḍyaṃte viṣanāḍyaḥ - phālgune māsi śūnyaṃ || budha saptamībyāṃ sahayoge viṣayogaḥ - budhavāre nāśayogaḥ - arkavāre yamakaṃṭakaḥ - anyāṃśe dina mṛtyuḥ - karkāṭaka cāpalagne kujaṃśake dhānyasaṃgrahaṇaṃ - tasmin lagne ca kṛṣiṃ kuryāt - jvarotpattaumṛtyuḥ - saṃdehovā - guḍā papaṃ nai vedyaṃ - kṛṣṇa surabhipuṣpaṃ - mahisākṣo dhūpaḥ - triyaṃbaka miti pūjāmaṃtraḥ - ghṛta madhu tulā homadravyaṃ - paṃcadināṃte gāyatryāṣṭottaraśataṃ juhuyāt - ekaviṃśati dināṃte subhīsyāt - naśāṃtiścenmṛtyuḥ - vṛṣabha vṛścika kanyā subhadrā navamyauvinā somāṃgāraka budhānāṃ vāreṣūdaye bhūmidarśanaṃ - saṃkrame alporghaḥ || || kṛttikā ṣaṭ‌tārā - kṣurākṛtiḥ - strī - athomukhī agnirdevatā - miśrā - rākṣasagaṇaḥ - pītavarṇaḥ - pītavarṇaḥ - aḍayoniḥ - uduṃbaravṛkṣaḥ - patriṇau krauṃcakākau - akṣare ukāra ukāre - dadhi praśvayātrāṃ gacchet - mudgānnaṃ śyāmakaṃca dadyāt - bhūṣaṇaṃ dadyāt - triṃśannāḍi kāṃte viṣanāḍikā - kārtīkamāse śūnyaṃ - budhavāre mṛtyuyogaḥ - nārikelakramukailā lavaṃga sthāpanaṃ kuryāt - jvaraścennava dināni pīḍā ghṛtodanaṃ nai vedyaṃ - mallikā puṣpapūjā - sirpirdūpaḥ - punaṃtamā devajanā iti pūjā maṃtraḥ - sāvitryāṣṭottara śataṃ dadhyo danaṃ juhuyāt - sakramelporghaḥ || || rohiṇī paṃcatārā - trikoṇākṛtiḥ - strī - ūrdhvamukhī - prajāpati rdevatā - dhṛvā pītavarṇā - manuṣyagaṇaḥ - sarpayoniḥ - jaṃbūvṛkṣaḥ - dakṣiṇau mayūra kukkuṭau - akṣare ṛkārau - ṛtugamana sīmaṃta nāmakaraṇānnaprāśana caulopanayana vidyāraṃbha kalaṣa sthāpana sādukarmāṇi kuryāt - caitramāne śūnyaṃ - catvāriṃśa syugrayogaḥ - guruvāre viṣiyogaḥ - śukravāre mṛtyuyogaḥ - maṃdavāre siddhayogaḥ - sdhirarāśyāṃ vilagnistherkaje dhānyasaṃgrahaṃ kuryāt - jvaraśceddinānitrīṇi navavāpīḍā - kṣīrānnaṃ nai vedyaṃ - kamalaghṛtaṃ sarvādhyānyānica homadravyaṃ - sāvitrāṣṭottara śataṃ hutvā kṣirānnena prajāpataye baliṃ dadyāt - dvitīyadinārabhya navadināṃte sukhīsyāt - saṃkrame arghavṛddhiḥ || || mṛgaśira strītārā - mṛgaśirā kṛtiḥ - napuṃsakaḥ - somo devatā - mṛduḥ - devagaṇaḥ yonissarpaḥ khadiro vṛkṣaḥ - mayūraḥ pakṣī - lṛkārokṣaraṃ - tiryaṅmukhaṃ - mṛga māṃsa bhakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvāyā trāṃgacchet - iṃdracāpe dhṛṣṭeṣṭadine vṛṣṭisyāt - ṛtugamana sīmaṃta nāmakaraṇanna prāśana vedopa kramayāga vidyāraṃbha karṇavedhana snānavivāha bījāvāpanābhiṣeka vāstu karmago saṃgrahaṇāni śrāddhaṃca kuryāt - caturdaśanāḍi kāṃte viṣaghaṭikā - kārtīkamāse śūnyaṃ guruvāre maraṇa yogaḥ - mṛtiśca ṣaṣṭyā sahograyogaḥ - ravivāre ānaṃdayogaḥ - caṃdresiddhayogaḥ - caṃdravāre caṃdrodaye vṛṣalagne madhye sthāpana kāryaṃ kuryāt - phala vṛddhisyāt - asnin lagne vivāha bhūmau mṛtsaṃ grahaṇaṃ kuryāt - ātma sādbhati - sasya sthānaṃ kuryāt - jvaraśce tpaṃcadine pīḍā - pāyasaṃ naivedyaṃ - kumudo tpala puṣpa pūjā - daśāṃgo dhūpaḥ - navo navaiti pūjā maṃtraḥ || mudgatila paṃcagavyāni homadravyaṃ sāvitryāṣṭottara śataṃ hutvā mudga tilaiścaṃdrādaya baliṃ dadyāt - paṃcadinā dārabhya navadināṃte sukhīsyāta - saṃkrame madhyamorghaḥ || || ārdrā ekatārā - strī - rudradevatā - tīkṣṇā pītavarṇā - ūrdhvamukhī - manuṣyagaṇaḥ - śvayoniḥ - kṛṣṇakhadiro vṛkṣaḥ - pakṣīpiṃgalaḥ - ekāraikārokṣaraṃ - ekaviṃśati ghaṭikāṃ viṣanāḍikā - amutaṃ pītvāyātrāṃ gacchet - iṃdracāpaścedvṛṣṭirnāsti - meṣalagne megha parivāraścetpaṃcadine saptadinevā vṛṣṭisyāt - tatkāle kuḍodayo vṛṣalagnedravya saṃgrahaṇaṃ vidyāraṃbhaṃ karṇavedhanaṃ śrāddhaṃca kuryāt - guru vāre mṛtyuyogaḥ - sanaṃdārke maraṇayogaḥ - dvitīyāṃśe dinamṛtyu - maṃdavāre maṃdodaye setubaṃdhaḥ - arka kujavāre karkāṭakalagne auśada sevāṃ kuryāt - asnin lagne vidyāraṃbhaś kāryaḥ - jvaraccenmṛtyuḥ - dinānyeka triṃśatpīḍā - duttūra puṣpa naraka raṃji vṛkṣaḥ - agarudhūpaḥ - namaḥ śaṃbhaveti pūjā maṃtraḥ - madhyājyaṃ homadravyaṃ - sāvitryāṣṭottara śataṃ hutvā - pāyasānnena rudrāyabaliṃ dadyāt - paṃcadinādārabhya daśadināṃte sukhīsyāt - adhavāmṛtiḥ - saṃkrame samorghaḥ || || punarvasuḥ ṣaṭtārā - nāvākṛtiḥ - iditirdevatā - carā deva gaṇaḥ - mārjālayoniḥ - veṇuvṛkṣaḥ - vāyusapakṣi - akṣare okāraukārau - pumān - tiryaṅmakhī - ṛtusaṃgama sīmaṃta nāmakaraṇānnaprāśana caulopanayana vidyāraṃbha sūtikābhaiṣajya vāstukarma devatāpratiṣṭhā vastrābharaṇadhāraṇābhiṣeka bījāvāpana yātrādi kuryāt - triṃśannāḍi kāṃte viṣanāḍikāṃ - midhunamāsi yātrādi kuryāt - triṃśannāḍi kāṃte viṣanāḍikāṃ - midhunamāsi śūnyaṃ - guruvāre amṛtayogaḥ - arkavāre arthasādhanayogaḥ - siddhayogaśca kecit - jvaraścetsapta dināni pīḍā - guḍodanaṃ naivedyaṃ - mallikā puṣpapūjā - malayajo dhūpaḥ - aditirdyauriti pūjāmaṃtraḥ - ghṛta taṃḍula dravyairgāyatryāṣṭottara śataṃ hutvā - aditaye gaṃdhamālyodhanai rbaliṃdadyāt - saptadinādārabhya saptaviṃśati dināṃte sukhīsyāt - saṃkramerghavṛddhiḥ || || puṣyaḥ aṣṭatārā - śarākṛtiḥ - pumān - tirmaṅmukhī - ūrdhvamukhīca - bṛhaspatirdevatā - laghu devagaṇaḥ ajayoniḥ - aśvatthavṛkṣaḥ - jīvaṃ jīvaḥ pakṣi - akṣaraṃ kakāraḥ - ghṛtapānaṃ kṛtvā yātrāṃ gacchet - niṃśati nāḍyaṃte viṣanāḍī - ṛtu saṃgamasīmaṃta nāmakaraṇānna prāśana caulopa sayana karṇa vedhana vidyāraṃbha snānābhiṣeka bīḍāvāpana vāstukarma vastrābharaṇadhāraṇa go devatā sthāpana śrāddhāni kuryāt - kārtīkamāse śūnyaṃ - daśamyāsahograyogaḥ - somārkayoryama kaṃṭakaḥ - arke gurau siddhayogaḥ - asmin‌dine gṛhaṃ kṛtvā praveśanaṃ citralekhanaṃca kuryāt - prasūtiścenmaraṇaṃ - tṛtīyāṃśe sarvaśreyaḥ - caturthāṃśe baṃdhumaraṇaṃ - jvaraccetsaptadinānipīḍākhaṃḍamuṃḍaka nai vedyaṃ - mallikā puṣpaṃ saroruhaṃca pūjā - guggulu dhūpaḥ - bṛhaspate atītipūjā maṃtraḥ ghṛpāyasa dravyaiḥ sāvitryāṣcottara śataṃ hutvā - gaṃdha mālyodanaiḥ bṛhaspatayebaliṃ dadyāt - dinatrayādārabhya saptadināṃte sukhīsyāt - saṃkramerghavṛddhiḥ || || adhāśleṣā catustārā - lāṃgalākārā - sarpodevatā - tīkṣṇā strī - adhomukhī - rākṣasagaṇaḥ - mārjālayoniḥ - nāgavṛkṣaḥ - ḍena kākīpakṣī - akṣarekha kāragakārau - pāyasaṃ prāśyayātrāṃ gacchet - triṃśannāḍi kāṃte viṣa ghaṭikā - tṛtīyāṃśe dina mṛtyuḥ - śatṛ jayaśca - asita vāre maraṇayogaḥ - kuja budhayoḥ yama kaṃṭakaḥ ke citkujavāre nāśamicchaṃtu - kujavāreṇa saha mṛtyuyogaḥ - kṛṣṇa rakta meghe sūryodaye asyārtha ghaṭikāṃtare kārmukodaye saptadinādvṛṣṭi - ātma sādbhavati bṛhaspatyudaye asyāṃśake sarva karmāraṃbhaṃ sarva macirātsidhyati - dravya saṃgrahaṇaṃca - asminnakṣatre - kūpādikhananaṃ kuryāta - jvaraścenna vadinā pīḍāpāyasaṃ naivedyaṃ - atasī puṣpa pūjā - ghṛtamuṃḍaka nai vedyaṃ - guggulu dhūpaḥ - maduvātā iti pūjā maṃtraḥ kṛsarānnena nāgabaliṃdadyāt - naśśāṃtiścedaṣṭadine maraṇaṃ - saṃkramelporghaḥ || || māghī catustārā - yugākṛtiḥ pitarodevatā - ugraḥ - rākṣasa sagaṇaḥ - mūṣakayoniḥ - panasovṛkṣaḥ - akṣareghajā - strī - adho mukhī - tittirī māṃsabhakṣaṇaṃ - kṛtvāyātrāṃ gacchet - triṃśannāḍi kāṃte viṣaghaṭikāḥ - kṛṣibījā vāpanadhānyā saṃgrahaṇa vivāhāgrayaṇaṃ kṛtvā sahasraguṇaṃ dhānyaṃ bhavet - vyayaṃnakuryāt - kārtīkamāse śūnyaṃ - śukravāre maraṇayogaḥ - arke mṛtyuyogaḥ - sūrya somayo ryamakaṃṭakaḥ - paṃcamyā sahamaraṇayogaḥ - caṃdrodaye samastāraṃbhaḥ - asmin lagne vivāhabhūmau mṛdgrahaṇaṃ ca kuryāt - jvaraśce nmṛtyuḥ - ekaviṃsati dināni pīḍāvā - ghṛta guḍapūraka naivedyaṃ - caṃpaka puṣpapūjā - gugguludhūpaḥ - pituṃ nastoṣamiti maṃtraḥ - ghṛta madhu miśra tilākṣata vaṭapatrāṇi dravyaṃ - sāvitryāṣṭottara śataṃ hutvākṣata tilaiḥ pitṛbhyo baliṃdadyāt || naśāṃtiśceddaśadināṃte mṛtyuḥ - saṃkramedyorghaḥ || || puṇyaphalgunī dvitārā - strī adomukhī - bhagodevatā - ugrā - manuṣyagaṇaḥ - mūṣakayoniḥ - phalāśovṛkṣaḥ - kākaḥ pakṣī - akṣaraṃ cakāraḥ - śyāmakānna bhojanaṃ kṛtvā yātrāṃgacchet - jayobhavet - ṛṇaṃdadyāt - āṣāḍamāse śūnyaṃ - śukravāre mṛtyuyogaḥ - svarṇasaṃgraha vidyāraṃbha gṛhaccādanaṃ ca kuryāt - asmin māse taṃ nakṣatre pariveṣa iṃtracopovā dṛṣṭaśce ddaśadine vṛṣṭisyāt - viṃśati nāḍikāṃte viṣaghaṭikā - jvāraśceddināvi paṃcavā saptavāpīḍā bilvaphala dhūpaḥ - aryamaṇaṃ deva iti pūjāmaṃtraḥ - ghṛtapriyaṃgudravyaṃ sāvitryāṣṭottara śataṃhutvā - gaṃdhapuṣpeṇa sūryāya baliṃ dadyāt - ṣaṣṭhadinādārabhya aṣṭamadine sukhisyāt - naśāṃtiścenmṛtiḥ - saṃkrame madhyamorghaḥ || || uttara phalguṇī dvitārā - strī - ūrdhvamūkhī - āryamādevatā - dhṛvā - manuṣyagaṇaḥ - vṛṣayoniḥ - krauṃcapakṣī - akṣare cha jā - payaḥ pītvā yātrāṃ gacchet - aṣṭādaśa ghaṭikāṃte viṣa ghaṭikā - ṛtusaṃgamana sīmaṃdo nnayana nāmakāraṇānnaprāśana caulopanayana vidyāraṃbha vivāha snānavastrābharaṇa dhāraṇa grāmādi praveśa vāstubījā vāpanābhi,eka go saṃgrahaṇāni pauṣṭikaṃ ca kuryāt - mārgaśīrṣe śūnyaṃ vastrābharaṇadhāraṇe mahasiddhiḥ - arkavāre siddhiyogaḥ - śūnyaṃceti kecit - caturdhvā sahamṛtyuyogaḥ - śukravāre kalahayogaḥ - pariveṣeṃdracāpau dṛṣṭauce tpaṃcadine saptadinevā vṛṣṭiḥ jvaraśce devakaviṃśa tathināni pīḍā - kṛsara nai vedyaṃ - śveta karavīrapūjā bilvaphaladhūpaḥ - asatye veti pūjāmaṃtraḥ - tilamāṣa sarṣapavrīhi yavadravyaṃ - sāvitryāṣcottara śataṃ hutvā - tairevāryamṇe baliṃ dadyāt - aṣṭādaśa dinādārabhya ekaviṃśiti dināṃtejvara mokṣaḥ - saṃkramerghavṛddhiḥ || || hastaḥ paṃcatārā - kecicchitasraḥ - pūmān - tiryaṅmukhaḥ - savitā devatā - laghuḥ pīyaṃgu samaprabhaḥ - akṣare jhañā - devagaṇaḥ - āriṣṭho vṛkṣaḥ - ghaṃṭakī pakṣī - payoviśrama sūrikaṃ bhūktvā yātrāṃ gacchet dvātriṃśannāḍi kāṃte piṣaghaṭukā || ṛtu saṃgamādi śubha karma pūrvavat - makaramāse śūnyaṃ - maṃdavāre maraṇayogaḥ viṣayoga ityapare - arkavāre siddiyogaḥ - vastrābharaṇādi dhāraṇe mahasiddhiḥ saptamyāsaha maramayogaḥ caturdhyā saha mṛtyuyogaḥ - guruvāreṇa kalahayogaḥ - budhavāre ānaṃda yogaḥ śrārdha devatā sthāpana senāpatyādi kuryāt - dravyaṃ dadyātsaṃ gṛhṇīyā devago saṃgrahaṇaṃ - ādyāṃśe dina mṛtyuḥ - iṃdracāpe dṛṣṭe ekaviṃśati dine vṛṣṭisyāt - jarvaścenmṛtyuḥ - saṃdehovā dināni pacadaśa pīḍā - apūpa nai vedyaṃ - raktakaravīra puṣpapūjā - daśāṃgo dhūpaḥ - udutyamiti maṃtraḥ - dadhighṛta dravyaṃ sāvitryāṣṭottara śataṃ hutvā gaṃdha puṣpeṇa baliṃ dadyāt - paṃcadaśa dinā dārabhya ekaviṃśati dināṃte sukhīsyāt - saṃkrame madhyamorghaḥ || || cittā ekatārā - tiryajmukhī - tvaṣṭādevatā - mṛduḥ - vyāghrayoniḥ - rākṣasagaṇaḥ - bilvovṛkṣaḥ - haṃsaḥpakṣī - akṣareṭaṭhau - citrānna bhojanaṃ kṛtvā yātrāgaccet - eka viṃśati nāḍhyaṃte viṣanāḍikā - annaprāśna karaṇa vedhana caulopanayana vastrābharaṇadhāraṇābhiṣeka śrārdakarma kyaṣibījā vāpanāni kuryāt - vaiśākhamāse śūnyaṃ - kuṣavāre nāśayogaḥ - sanaṃdārka kujeṣu carayogaḥ - iṃduvāre dvitīyyayāsahaviṣayogaḥ - trayodaśyāṃ maraṇayogaḥ - budhavāre yamakaṃcakaḥ - maṃdavāre nāśayogaḥ - māghamāse purvāmāse pūrvāhṇe utpanne vṛṣṭi jvaraśceddināni paṃcapīḍā - modaka nai vedyaṃ - japāpuṣpa pūjā - daśāṃgo dhūpaṃ - citraṃ devānāmiti pūjā maṃtraḥ - jala mikṣaghṛta citrodanaṃ dravyaṃ - sānitryāṣṭottara śataṃ hutvā tvaṣṭre ghṛta mikṣamudaibaliṃ dadyāt - saptadinā dārabhya viṃśati dināṃte sukhīsyāt - saṃkrame madhyamorghaḥ || || svātī ekatārā - raktavarṇā - strī - vāyurdevatā - carātiryajmukhī - devagaṇaḥ - mahiṣayoniḥ - unmattavṛkṣaḥ - mayūrapakṣī - amalaka bhakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā yātrāṃ gaccet - caturdaśa nāḍhyaṃte viṣanāḍikā - ṛtugamanādi śubhakarma pūrvavat - vaiśākhamāsa śūnyaṃ - caṃdravāle siddhayogaḥ maṃdavāre amṛtayogaḥ - ravivāre siddhayogaḥ - śukravāre yamakaṃṭakaḥ - trayodasyāsaha maraṇayogaḥ - sanaṃdā kuḍayorvarayogaḥ - dravyaṃ nadadyāt - pūrvapakṣa paṃcamyāṃ vijayaḥ - maṃdavāre vṛṣodaye netu baṃdhanaṃ kuryāt - ḍakārokṣarca - jvaraścet ṣaṣṭi dināna pīḍā - jadhyodanaṃ nai vedyaṃ - damanaka puṣpapūjā - śvetāgaru dhūpaṃ - sanaḥ piteti pajā maṃtraḥ - ghṛtā ktayāvakaṃ dravyaṃ - sāvitryāṣṭottara śataṃ hutvā - gaṃdha puṣpeṇa vāyave baliṃdadyāt - daśadinā dārabhya catvāriṃśa ddināṃte sukhīsyāt - saṃkrame madhyamorghaḥ || || viśākhā catustārā - strī - śurpākārā - adhomukhī - indrāgnī devatā - miśrā vyāghrayoniḥ - vaikaṃkato vṛkṣaḥ - piṃgalaḥ pakṣi - akṣareḍhaṇau - piṣṭāṃbu bhakṣaṇaṃ gṛtvāyātrāṃ gaccet - caturdhaśanāḍyalate viṣanāḍī - śubhakarmāṇi pūrvavat - bīḍāvāpanaṃ vastrābharaṇa grahaṇaṃ ca kuryāt - dravyaṃ na dadyāt - gṛhṇīyādeva - mārgaśīrge śūnyaṃ - ārknāśayogaḥ - kecidviṣayogamicchaṃti - budhaguruvārayo ryamakaṃṭakaḥ dvitīyāṃśe dinamṛtyuḥ - śukravāre śukroḍaye kṛṣyāraṃbhaṃ kuryāt - śatrordaśanaṃce cchubhaṃ bhavati - maṃdavāresmin lagne karkāli cāpalagne kujāle dhānyasaṃgrahaṇaṃ kuryāt - tatkāle bhūmivivādaśce jayobhavati - indracāpe dṛṣṭe aṣṭadinevṛṣṭiḥ - jvaraścedviṃśati dināni pīḍā - guḍaṃ naivedyaṃ - baṃdhūka puṣpapūjā - devadāru dhūpaḥ - śanna iṃdrāgnī iti pūjāmaṃtraḥ - dugdhonna ghṛtaṃ homadravyaṃ - sāvitryāṣṭottara śataṃ hutvā - payomiśrānnairgaṃdhamālyai ridrāgnibhyāṃ dadyāt - daśadinādārabhyaviṃśati dināṃte sukhīsyāt - saṃkramolporghaḥ || || anūrādhā ṣaṭtārā - cakramālākṛtiḥ - pumān - tiryaḍmukhī - mitrodevatā - devagaṇaḥ - mṛgayoniḥ vakulovṛkṣaḥ - pakṣiṇau parapuṣpakākau - akṣarāṇi takāra thakāradakārāḥ - dvādaśanāḍhyaṃte viṣadhaṭī - kuśuddha bhakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā yātrāṃgacchet - ṛtusaṃgamana sīmaṃtonnayana nāmakaraṇānnaprāśanopanayana vidyāraṃbha śraddhabījāvāpanādīnikuryāt - mārgaśīrṣamāsi śūnyaṃ - arkavāre maraṇayogaḥ - kecinmṛtyuyoga micchaṃti - budhavāre mṛtayogaḥ - daśamyā mugrayogaḥ - tṛtīyāṃśe dina mṛtyuḥ - tatkāle cāpalagne kujāṃśe dhānya saṃgrahaṇaṃ - tatkāle vyavahāre jayobhavati - vivāhabhūmau mṛdgrahaṇaṃ kuryāt - karavīrapuṣpa nadṛśo meghodṛsyatecetta ttṛtīyadine vṛ,ṭirbhavati - jarvaścettaddinā tpaṃdaviṃśati dināni pīḍā daśadinānivā - mitrasya carṣaṇīti pūjāmaṃtraḥ - kuṃkuma gaṃdhaḥ padmapuṣpaṃ - sājyaṃ pāyasaṃ nai vedyaṃ caṃdana dhūpaḥ sūraṇa kaṃdohoma pradhāna dravyaṃ - sāvitryāṣṭottara śataṃ sūraṇakaṃdaṃ hutvā - mitrāya sājyapāya samudga māṣabaliṃ dadyāt - aṣṭadinādārabhya paṃcadaśadināṃte sukhīsyāt - saṃkramadhyamorghyaḥ || || jyeṣṭā tritārā - strī - kaṃculākṛtiḥ - tiryajyukhī - iṃdro devatā - tikṣṇaḥ - mṛgayoni - viṣavṛkṣaḥ - pakṣī kukkuṭaḥ - dhakāro kṣaऱṃ - tila bhakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā yātrāṃ gaccet - caturdhaśa nāḍikāṃte viṣaghaṭī - kecitsenā patyaṃ śrāddhaṃ - śālivāpanaṃcāhu - phālguṇemasi śūnyaṃ - ārkavāre nāśayogaḥ - guru pratipadi viṣayogaḥ - iṃdu vāre bhaumalagne kūpādi khananaṃ kuryāt - karavīra puṣpa samamegho dṛṣṭaśceddaśame dine vṛṣṭiḥ - jvaraścenmṛtyuḥ - saṃdehovā - paṃcadinādi pīḍā - citrodanaṃ nai vedyaṃ - paṭolī puṣpapūjā - karpārā garu dhūpaḥ - iṃdraṃva iti maṃtraḥ - saghṛta sūraṇa kuṃdamūlaṃ homadravyaṃ - sāvitrāṣṭottara śataṃ hutvā - gaṃdha paṣpai iṃdrāya baliṃ dadyāt - naśāṃtaścesmṛtyuḥ saṃkramelporghaḥ || || mūlaṃ navatārā - paśvākṛtiḥ - haṃsavarṇaḥ - haṃsavarṇaḥ - athomukhaṃ - napuṃsakaṃ - sīṛṛtirdevatā - tīkṣṇā - rākṣasagaṇaḥ - śvānayoniḥ - sarjaro vṛkṣaḥ - jīvaṃ jīvakaḥ pakṣī - śyāmāka bhakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā yātrāṃ gacchet - tibhakṣaṇaṃ kecit - viṃśati nājhyaṃ te viṣaghaṭī - antyāṃ śedina mṛtyuḥ - ṛtu saṃgamana nāmakaraṇānna śrāśanāgrayaṇa vivāha bījāvāpana go saṃgrahaṇāni kuryāt - ugrakarmāṇica kuryāt - dravyaṃna dadyāt - gṛhṇīyādeva - mā ghośūnyaṃ - arkavāre mṛtyuyogaḥ - saṃjārkakujayorvarayogaḥ kārmukodaye nagarasthāpanaṃca raktameghoradṛṣṭeṣṭamadine vṛṣṭiḥ - jvaraścenmṛtyuḥ - saṃdehovā - dināni daśapīḍā - matsyamāṃsa sūrāpolikā nai vedyaṃ - kartāśoka puṣpa pūjā - kṛṣmaśevaṃtikā puṣpamiti hemādrau - meṣa śṛṃgo dhūpaḥ - moṣaṇaḥ parāparā iti maṃtraḥ - brāhmaṇaḥ saravidāna iti hemādrau - saghṛtaṃ kaṃdhamūla dravyaṃ sāvitryāṣṭottara śataṃ hutvā - niṛrutaye pāyasānnena baliṃ dadyāt - saṃkramergha vṛddhiḥ || || pūrvāṣāḍhā dvitārā - strī - adhomukhī - āpodevatā - ugrā - manuṣyagaṇaḥ - kapiyoniḥ - vānarovṛkṣaḥ - śukaḥ pakṣī - akṣarāṇi sakārādi vāṃtāni - kṛnarabhakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā yātrāṃgaccen - caturviṃśati nāḍyaṃte viṣaghaṭī - go saṃgrahaṇaṃ śālivāhanaṃca kuryāt - kūpādi khanana vidyāraṃbha vrata praveśodakālaya baṃdhanāvi karmāṇica kuryāt - dravyaṃ nadadyāt - gṛhṇīyādeva - śrāvaṇamāsi śūnyaṃ - caṃdravāre viṣayogaḥ kujavāre yamodaye prākārāraṃbhaṃ ca kuryāt asminlagne kūpādi khananaṃ - āraktameghedṛṣṭe paṃcadine vṛṣṭaḥ - jvaraścetpaṃca viṃśati dinānipīḍā - maṇḍakanaivedyaṃ - kalhāra puṣpa pūjā - manaśśilā dhūpaḥ - āpohiṣṭeti pūjā maṃtraḥ - raktaśālī dravyaṃ sāvitryāṣṭottara śataṃ hutvā varuṇāya pāyasājya baliṃ dadyāt - caturdaśadinā dārabhya viṃśati dināṃteṣu sukhīsyāt - saṃkramelvorghaḥ || || uttarāṣāḍā - dvitārā - strī - ūrthvamukhī - niśvedevā devatā - dhruvā - manuṣyagaṇaḥ - gauryoniḥ - panasovṛkṣaḥ - piṃgalaḥ pakṣi - akṣarobhakāraḥ - gajavikrayaṇaṃ gajārohaṇaṃ - ca kuryāt tilabhakṣaṇaṃ ca kṛtvā yātrāṃ gaccet - viśaṃti nāḍhyaṃte viṣaghacī - ṛtusaṃgamanādi - śubha karmāṇi kuryāt - vaiśākhamāse śūnyaṃ - caṃdravāre maraṇayogaḥ - arkavāre siddayogaḥ - kujanāre kalahayogaḥ - maṃdavāre mṛtyuyogaḥ - śukravāre ānaṃdayogaḥ - tṛtīyayāsaha maramayogaḥ - raktameghedṛṣṭe ekādaśadine vṛṣṭiḥ - jvaraśce dviṃśati dināni pīḍā - paṃcabhakṣyāṇiṃ naivedyaṃ - saṃcavarṇa puṣpaiḥ pājā - lākṣādhūpaḥ - viśvedevā saāgitateti pūjā maṃtraḥ - ghṛtasallakī khaṃdāni dravyaṃ - sāvitryā ṣṭottara śataṃ hutvā - viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ pāyasānne baliṃdadyāt - ekādaśa dinā dārabhya viṃśati dināṃte sukhīsyāt - saṃkramergha vṛddhi || || śroṇā tritārādaṇḍākṛtiḥ - pumān - ūrdhvamukhū - viṣṇurdevatā - carā - devagaṇaḥ - vānarayoniḥ - nyagrodhovṛkṣaḥ - mayūraḥ pakṣi - atraromakāraḥ - maśanāḍyāṃte viṣaghaṭikā - jalaṃ pītvā yātrāṃgaccet - ṛtu saṃgamana sīmaṃta nāmakaraṇānna prāśnacaulopanayanābhiṣekābharaṇa kṛṣi bījā vāpana karṇavedhanādīvi kuryāt - vivāha śraddha yajñā dhīnica kuryāt - mārgaśīrṣe śūnyaṃ - arkavāre siddayogaḥ - cāṃdravāre mṛtyuyogaḥ - paṃcamyāṃ siṃha karkāli cāpalagne caṃdrāṃśake dhānya saṃgrahaṇaṃ kuryāt - vyapahārāraṃ bhejayo bhavati - somavāre suryodaye dvitīyāṃśe gṛhāraṃbhaṃ kṛtvā praveśanaṃ kuryāt - meghedṛ,ṭe vṛṣṭirbhavati - jvaraścenmāsadvayaṃ pīḍā - saṃdehovā kṣira śarkarāghṛta maṃḍakaṃ nai vedyaṃ - jātī puṣpapūjā - daśāṃgo dhūpaḥ - ātodevā iti pūjāmaṃtraḥ - rakta taṃḍulaṃ homa dravyaṃ - sāvitryāṣṭottara śataṃ hutvā - gaṃdhapuṣseṇa viṣṇave baliṃdadyāt - māsāṃte saṃvatsarāṃtevā sukhīsyāt - saṃkramergha vṛddhi || || dhaniṣṭhā paṃcatārā - vyaktākārā - mṛdaṃgākārā - strī - ūrdhva mukhī - nasavodevatā - rā - rākṣasagaṇaḥ - siṃhayoniḥ - śamīvṛkṣaḥ - akṣaro makāraḥ - saktubhakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā yātrāṃgacchet - daśanāḍyaṃte viṣanāḍī - jhatusaṃgamanādi śubhakarmāṇi pūrvavat - āṣāḍhamāse śūnyaṃ - kujavāre viṣayogaḥ - kecinnāśayogaḥ - maṃdavāre maṃdodaye ārāmabhūmicayaṃ kuryāt - asmin lagne yuddhaṃ ca kuryāt - kujodaye vyāpāraṃ - dravyaṃsaṃgrahaṇaṃ yuddhaṃ ca kuryāt - ādyāṃśena mṛtyuḥ - raktameghe dṛṣṭe viṃśatidine vṛṣṭiḥ jvaraśce tpaṃcadināni pīḍā sāyasaṃ nai vedyaṃ - śatasahasra puṣpa pūjā - guggulu dhūpaḥ - trāyaṃtā mihadevā iti maṃtraḥ bilvoduṃbarāśvaththa samidho dravyaṃ - sāvitryāṣṭottara śataṃ hutvā - ghṛtamiśramudgairva subhyo baliṃ dadyāt - daśadinādārabhya paṃcadaśadināṃte sukhīsyāt - trayodaśa māsāṃtevā - saṃkrame madhyamorghaḥ || || śatabhiṣak śatatārā - puṣpapuṃjanibhākṛtiḥ - napuṃsakaṃ - ūrdhvamukhaṃ - varuṇodevatā - carā rākṣasagaṇaḥ - turaṃgayoniḥ - kadaṃbovṛkṣaḥ - kaṃṭakīpakṣī - akṣarerephalakāre - annaprāśana caula puṃsavana karṇavedhanāgnisaṃdhāna dhānyāvyāpana śrāddha śastrāraṃbhāṃśca kuryāt - proṣṭapadamāsi śūnyaṃ - kujavāre maraṇayogaḥ - kecinmṛtyuyogaḥ - maṃdavāre - yamakaṃṭakaḥ - sanaṃdārka kujayormaraṇayogaḥ - guruvāre mṛtyuyogaḥ - arka kujavāre kulīralagnetvauṣadhopayogaṃ kuryāt - asmin lagne kṛṣīlavanaṃ kuryāt - apūpa bhakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvāyātrāṃ gacchet - aṣṭādaśanāḍm̐te viṣaghaṭī - jvaraścedaśadināni hutvā pāyāsānne baliṃdadyāt - ṣaṣṭadinādārabhya dvādaśadināṃte sukhīsyāt - saṃkramelporghaḥ || || pūrvābhādrapadā dvitārā - strī - adhomukhī - ajai kapāddevatā - ugrā - manuṣyagaṇaḥ - siṃhayoniḥ - āmrovṛkṣaḥ - akṣarauvaśau - apotaḥ pakṣī - guḍabhakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā yātrāṃ gacchet - ṣoṭaśanāḍyaṃte viṣanāḍikā - āśvīyujamānaṃ śūnyāṃ - gosaṃgrahaṇaṃ vidyāraṃbhaṃ ca kuryāt - dravyaṃnadadyāt - gṛhṇīyādeva - kujavāre nāśayogaḥ - aṃtyāṃśe nāgavalyādi sthāpanaṃ - dvitīyāṃśe śukrodaye kūpādi khananaṃ - raktameghedṛṣṭeṣṭadine vṛ,ṭiḥ - jvaraśce nmṛtyuḥ - saṃdehovā dvāviṃśati dināni pīḍā - dadhi ghṛta nai vedyaṃ - arka puṣpa pājā - sarvauṣadī dhūpaḥ - śanno aja ekapāditi maṃtraḥ - ghṛta kūṣmāṃḍa khaṃḍaṃ dravyaṃ - sāvitryāṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ hutvā - gaṃdhamālyādanairajaikapade baliṃ dadyāt - iṃdrādīnāṃ ca naśāṃticcenmṛtyurbhavati - saṃkrame madhyamorghaḥ || || uttarābhādra padā - dvitīrā - pumān - ūrdhvamukhī - ahirbudhnyo devatā - manuṣyagaṇaḥ - dhruvaḥ - gauryoniḥ - niṃbovṛkṣaḥ - cakravākaḥ pakṣī - akṣaraukṣasau - māṃsabhakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā yātrāṃ gacchet - caturviṃṣati nāḍyaṃte viṣaghacī - ṛtusaṃgamana sīmaṃta nāmakaraṇānna gosaṃgrahaṇāni kuryāt - rogi snātaścetsukhīsyāt - śrāvaṇa mārgaśīrṣayoḥ śūnyaṃ - tṛtīyayāsaha maraṇayogaḥ - kujavāre mṛtyu yogaḥ - arkavāre siddhiyogaḥ - tṛtīyapāde dinamṛtyuḥ - raktameghodṛṣṭaśce dekādaśadine vṛṣṭiḥ - jvaraśce ddaśadināni pīḍā - guḍasahitodanaṃ naivedyaṃ - karaṃjapatrāṇi puṣpaṃ - ghṛta dhūpaḥ - viṣṇuronimiti pūkāmaṃtraḥ - ghṛpapluta māṣa mudgāni dravyaṃ - sāvitryāṣṭottara śataṃ hutvā - gaṃdhapuṣpeṇāhi rbudhnaye baliṃdadyāt - saṃkramerghavṛddhiḥ || || revatī - dvātriṃśattārā - pumān - pītākṛtiḥ - tiryaḍmukhī - puṣādevatā - mṛduḥ - devagaṇaḥ - gajayoniḥ - madhūkovṛkṣaḥ - piṃgalaḥ pakṣī - akṣaro hakāraḥ - kṣīrapāsaṃ kṛtvā yātrāṃ gacchet - triṃśannāḍyaṃte viṣaghacī - proṣṭapadamāse śūnyaṃ - ṛtusaṃgamādi uttarābhādra padoktāni karmāṇi kuryāt - arkavāre siddhayogaḥ - budhe some ca viṣayogaḥ - maṃde nāśayogaḥ - aṣṭamyā saha viṣayogaḥ - śukravāre siddhiyogaḥ - saptamyā sahograyogaḥ - jvaraśceddvādaśa dināni ṣīḍā - tilataṃḍulapiṣṭa naivedyaṃ - maṃdāra puṣpa pūjā guggulu dhūpaḥ - hagṃssaḥ śuciṣaditi maṃtraḥ - ghṛtāmraphalasahita kadalīphalāni dravyaṃ - sānitryāṣṭottara śataṃ hutvā - gaṃdhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūṣṇe baliṃ dadyāt - paṃcadinādā rabhyaviṃśati dināṃte sukhīsyāt - saṃkrame madhyamorghaḥ - argha vṛddhiriti gārgyamāṃḍavyādayaḥ || || iti śāṃtiratne madanaratnoktaṃ nakṣatra parijñānaṃ samāptaṃ vasiṣṭha saṃhitāyāṃ - rogaśāṃtiṃ pravakṣyāmi rogartānāṃ śarīriṇāṃ | bali pūjāṃgahomaiśca japa brāhmāṇa bhojanaiḥ | yasmin dhiṣṇeyadā nṛṇāṃ rogaḥ saṃjāyate tadā | tadthiṣṇya pūjā kartavyā tadīsvara sutuṣṭaye || suvarṇena palārdhena tadardhārthenavā punaḥ | dhiṣṇyaśa pratimāṃ kalpya yadhā vittānu sārataḥ | īśānyā madhavāprācyā mūdīcyāṃ diśisaṃlikhet | tuṃḍuleṣṭa dalaṃ padmaṃ kṛta gomaya maṃḍale || paṃcāmṛtaiśca salilaistattanmaṃtraiḥ pṛthak | smāpya kalpokta maṃtreṇa pratimāṃ sthapaye ttataḥ | karṇikāyāṃsu saṃsthāpya dhyātvā devaṃ samarchayet | tadvārṇa vastra gaṃdhādyaiḥ puṣpadhūpopahārakaiḥ | ārakta varṇaṃ kuṃbhaṃca paṃcabhiḥ pallavaiḥryutaṃ | śukla vastra svarṇaratna śatauṣadi samanvitaṃ | mṛtpaṃcagavya sadbībaṃ phaladravya kuśānvitaṃ | devaṃtu pūrvataḥ sthāpya tattanmaṃtraiḥ samarcayet | tatprācyāṃ sthaṃḍile vahniṃ vidhivat sthāpayettataḥ | mukhāṃte juhuyādukta dravyeṇāṣṭa sahasrakaṃ | ukta dravyeṇa tatta nnakṣatra śāṃtau vakṣyamāṇena | tilahomaṃvyā hṛtībhiḥ aṣṭottara sahasrakaṃ | pūrṇāhutiṃca juhuyātsamyākca japa pūrvakaṃ | tataḥ sudṭopa viṣṭasya rogiṇaḥ prāṅmukhasya ca | maṃtra pūtaiḥ kuṃbha jalaibliṃgairvāri maṃtrakaiḥ | mārjanaṃ kārayettasya samyatsaṃkalpapūrvakaṃ | nīrājanaṃca śuddhātmā pūjā sthānaṃ samāgataḥ | devaṃ hutāśanaṃ bhaktyā praṇamya pārthayoditi | amṛtodbhavadiṣṇyeka yajñeśastvaṃ parātmakaḥ | rogā dasmācca māṃ rakṣa tava vaścāśca diṣṇyāpāḥ || iti prārthya tato dadyātpratimāṃ vastra saṃyutāṃ | dakṣiṇā sahitāṃ bhaktyā ācāryāya kuṭiṃbine | brahmaṇena yadhā śaktyā brāhmaṇāne bhojaye ttataḥ | kṛtvā nakṣatra pūjāṃca tithivāsara yorapi || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti rogīrogā tphramuccate | pūrvoktaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtvā tidhivārayoḥ śāṃtiṃ kuryādityarthaḥ || aśvinyā mutthitovyādhi sapta rātreṇa muṃcati | devasyetveti maṃtrasya gāyatrī kāśyapośvanau śvetavarṇau sudhāpūrṇau kuṃbhāṃ bhoja darau pṛdhak | caṃdanotpala puṣpājyaṃ gugguluśca guja prīyau | kṣīra laḍḍuka bhoktārau samidhaḥ kṣīravbhakṣajāḥ || ājyaṃ gugguluśca dhūpaḥ samidbhirhomaḥ evamagrepi | guḍodanaṃ baliṃ dadyāddīpaiḥ sārdaṃ niśaumukhe || || bharaṇyā mutthito vyādhi racirānni dhana pradaḥ | māsena muṃcat dhavā daivasya kuṭilāgatiḥ || tryaṃbakasyatu maṃtrasya coktāścaṃdarṣi devatāḥ | gaṃdhoguruḥ karavīra puṣpaṃ dhūpaścagugguluḥ | ājyadīpaṃca sarveṣāṃ nai vedyaṃca guḍodhanaṃ | pāśa daṃḍadharo raktastvājyaṃ madhvakṣatā haviḥ | mahiṣī nāyakāruḍhaḥ kṛsarānnaṃ baliṃ haret | vakṣya māṇena maṃtreṇa baliṃ samyakrpadāpayet || || kṛttikā sūtthito vyādhi rthaśarātrema muṃcati | sruksruvā bhaya varadaḥ svavargo meṣavāhanaḥ || medhātidhi rjagatyagniḥ punaṃtumā mityasyaca | caṃdanaṃ yūdhikā puṣpaṃ ghṛta dhūpaḥ sugugguluḥ || naivedyaṃ tila māṣānnaṃ vaṭakājyena saṃyutaṃ | guḍodanaṃ havistatra pāyasena baliṃ haret || || rohiṇyā mutthitovyādhi rdaśarātreṇa muṃcati | namo brahmaṇa maṃtrasya gāyatrī vidhirīśvaraḥ || śuklaḥ kamaṃḍalussavakṣa sūtrābhaya varapradaḥ | caṃdanaṃ kamalaṃ puṣpaṃ sadaśāṃgaśca gugguluḥ || naivedayaṃ pāyasaṃ sājyaṃ sarvadānnaṃ havirbhavet || || caṃdra bhecotthito vyādhiḥ paṃcarātreṇa muṃcati gadā varadapāṇiśca śveto sauratha vāhanaḥ || navo navo bhavatyasya gāyatrī gautamaḥ śaśī | caṃdanaṃ kumudaṃ puṣpaṃ daśāṃgaṃ pāyasodanaṃ || nai vedyaṃ maṃdakā puṣpaṃ kṣaudra samanvitaṃ | śarkarādadhi miśriṇa śuklānnena baliṃ haret || || ārdrāyā mutthito vyādhi racirānni danapradaḥ | māsena muṃcatyathvā daivasya kuṭilāgatiḥ | śuddhaspaṭika saṃkāśaḥ śūla khaḍgābhayeṣṭadaḥ | nama śaṃkārāyetyasya bṛhatīśo vidhi ṛruṣiḥ || caṃdanaṃ saurabhaṃ puṣpaṃ daśāṃgaṃ pāyasodanaṃ | samadhvājyāṃ havistatra dathyodana baliṃharet || || punarva saubhavo vyādhiḥ sapta rātreṇa muṃcati | kamaṃḍalvakṣa sūtredhmadarbhasruke sruvabhṛtsadā || aditidyrauśca maṃtrasya triṣṭhubho druhiṇo ditiḥ || haribrā kuṃkumaṃ gaṃdhaḥ puṣpaṃ śāmaṃtikādayaḥ || dhūpomalayajaḥ piṣṭaṃ ghṛtānnaṃ pīta varṇakaṃ | ghṛtāktaṃ taṃḍulaṃ haviḥ pītānnena baliṃ haret || || puṣye samutthito vyādhiḥ saptarātreṇa muṃcati | pīto daṃḍa kamaṃḍalvakṣa sūtrābhayadodyataḥ || bṛhaspate tītītyasya triṣṭubjī vāṃgirāṛṣiḥ | kuṃkumaṃ vārijaṃ pu,paṃ nai vedyaṃ ghṛta pāyasaṃ || maṃḍakāguḍa saṃyuktame tadeva havirbhavet | samaṃḍaka ghṛtānnena baliṃ tatra pradāpayet || || āśleṣā sūtthito vyādhiḥ kleśānmāsena muṃcati | namo astviti maṃtrsaya havyavāḍadha sarparāṭ || madhuvarṇo boga yuktaḥ khaḍga carmadaraḥ śubaḥ | sakaṃkughūgaru rgaṃdhaḥ puṣpaṃ cāgastya saṃbhavaṃ | ghṛta guggula dhūpotranaivedyaṃ kṣīra sarpaṣi || havissājyaṃ sudadhyānnaṃ dadhyodanaṃ baliṃ haren || || ritṛbocotthito vādhi racirānni thana pradaḥ | śāntirvāsārdhamāsena dhūmrodaṃḍa pavitradhṛke || āyaṃtunaḥ stvṛcossyāstu jagatī pitarobjajaḥ | caṃdanaṃ caṃpakaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpaḥ saghbhata guggulu || nai vedyaṃ ghṛta piṣcānnaṃ tilānnaṃ saghṛtaṃ haviḥ | satilājyaṃca mudgānnaṃ baliṃca patiṛ tṛpte || || pūrvāphālgu najovyādhirarthamāsena muṃcati | bhaga eva bhagavā nityasya triṣṭabdha govidhiḥ || padmā bhayakaraḥ padmavraṇaḥ siṃhāsane sthitaḥ | caṃdanaṃ mālatī puṣpaṃ bilva dhūpoghṛto danaṃ || nai vedyaṃ śarkarā pūpa laḍḍukābhiśca saṃyutaṃ | ghṛto danaṃ havistatra pāyasānṃ baliṃ haret || || āryamartrebhavo vyādhirartha māsena muṃcati | padmavarṇaḥ padma saṃsthaḥ padmagarbha samadyutiḥ | āryamāyeti maṃtrasya āryamātriṣṭu babṅajaḥ | karpūraṃ kuṃkumaṃ gaṃdhaṃ puṣpaṃ vakula saṃjñakaṃ || ghṛta guggulu dhūpotra nai vedyaṃ ghṛtapāyasaṃ | homadravyaṃ ghṛtānnaṃca śālyannena baliṃ haret || || haste samutthitovāyyādhi navarātreṇa rnavarātrema muṃcati rkatagaṃdhaṃ kuṃkumaṃca puṣpaṃ rājīvasaṃjñakaṃ | gaṃdha guggulu dhūpotra nai vedyaṃ ghṛta pāyasaṃ || madhupuṣpa tilājyānnaṃ dūrvābhissahitaṃ haviḥ | guḍaśarkara madhvājyaṃ piṣṭannena baliṃ haret || || citrāyā mutthito vyādhi daśarātreṇa muṃcati | citraṃ devānāmitrasya tvaṣṭā triṣṭuppitā mahaḥ || atrasūtrābhayakara ścitravarṇa śśipepataḥ | sakuṃkumāgarugaṃdhaḥ kusumaṃ citrarṇakaṃ || nai vedyaṃ modakājyannaṃ catrānnaṃ ghṛtaṃhaviḥ | tadannena baliṃ dadyātsarvarogāpanittaye || || svātyṛrkṣecetthito vyādhiḥ sarvadāni dhanapradaḥ | eka dvitri catuḥ paṃcamānairvāpi vimuṃcati || sanaḥ piteti maṃtrasya gāyatrī marudaṃgirāḥ || khaḍga carmatharaḥ kṛṣṇo gaṃdhaṃ kṛṣṇā gururbhuguḥ | puṣpaṃ damanakaṃ dhūpaścaṃdanā guru guggulu | nai vedyaṃ pāyasaṃ sājyaṃ havistena baliṃ haret || || dvidai vabhe bhavedvyādhi rmāsenaikenamuṃcati | iṃdrāgnī agata miti gāyatryai vāsyacaivahi || madhu ccaṃda ṛṣīṃdrāgni tayordhvānaṃca pūrvavat | śrīkhaṃḍaṃ gaṃdhaṃ tayoḥ puṣpaṃ saroruhaṃ || devadāru stayordhūpo nai vedyaṃ ghatapāyasaṃ | tadevānnaṃ havistatra citrā nnena bali haret || || mitrabhocetthitovyādhi rdaśarātreṇa muṃcati | mitrasya carṣaṇīti gāyatryaivāsyacaivahi || ṛṣi rhiraṇyastupākhyastatramitrodhidevatā | dvibhūjaḥ madmagarbhābhaḥ padmabhṛtpadmasaṃsthitaṃ | kuṃkumaṃ puṃḍarīkākhyaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ ca caṃdanaṃ | nai vedyaṃ pāyasaṃ sājyaṃ haviḥ kaṃdarba sūraṇaḥ || balistatra pradātavyo madhu śarkara pāyasaiḥ || ghṛtapūrvaka māṣānnaṃ mudgagarbhaiśca saṃyutaṃ || || jyeṣṭhāyā mutthitovyādhi mṛtyureva nasaṃśayaḥ | adhavā māsamekvā muṃcatyeva nasaṃśayaḥ || iṃdraṃva iti maṃtrasya gāyatrīṃ droṃgirāṛṣiṃ || iṃdrastu pūrvavadgaṃdhaṃ caṃdanaṃ kusumaṃ śubhaṃ | karpūradhūpo nai vedyaṃ citrānnaṃ sumanoharaṃ || havistu sūraṇaḥ karaṇaḥ madhukaṃdaḥ supāyasaṃ | vicitra puṣpa gaṃdhena dadhyannena baliṃ haret || || mūlabhecotthitovyādhi rmāsārdhena vimuṃcati | khaḍga carmadharaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ karālavadanaḥ prabhūḥ || moghāṇosyaca grayatrīghoraḥ kaṇyotha nirruṛtiḥ | gaṃdhaṃ kṛṇṇāgaruḥ puṣpaṃ padmaṃ nīpotpalaṃ śubhaṃ || dhūpaḥ kṛṣṇāgarurmāṣa mikṣānna mupaharakaṃ | tadevānnaṃ havistatra māṣānnena baliṃ haret || || vāribhecotthito vyādhī rogiṇonidhanapradaḥ | vimuṃcya tyadavāmānai rdvitriṣaṭ paṃca saptabhiḥ || āpyāya sveti maṃtrasya gāyatrī padmajojalaṃ | suvarṇo dvibhujaḥ padmapāṇi rgaṃdhastu caṃdanaṃ || padmaṃ śaileya dūpotra nai vedyaṃ ghṛtapāyasaṃ | havirmasūra piṣṭānnaṃ tadannena baliṃ haret || || viśvabhecotthito vyādhiḥ sārdamāsena muṃcati | viśvedevāsa akyasya gāyatrī viśaavadevatā || kamaṃḍalva bhayāṃbhoja varadaśca kuśāsanaḥ | caṃdanaṃ kamalaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpaḥ | samiddhirniculaispārthaṃ tadannena baliṃ baret || || śravaṇecotthito vyādhi rdaśarātreṇa muṃcati | atodevā iti maṃtrasya gāyatrī prapajoharuḥ || sītāṃbaraḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ śaṃkha cakra gadādharaḥ | caṃdanaṃ mālatī puṣpaṃ dhūpa karpūpa guggulu || śālyannaṃ ṣaḍrasopetaṃ bhakṣyabhojyādibhissaha | nai vedyaṃ havirapye tatpāyasena baliṃ haret || || vasu bhecotthito vyādhi rdaśarātrema muṃcati | trāyaṃtā miha maṃtrasyāsuṣṭubvyāso vasusattaḥ || cāpabāmadhara śuklagaṃdhaḥ karpūra caṃdanaṃ | vārijaṃ guggulurdūpo nai vedyaṃ ghṛta pāyasaṃ || pāviścoduṃbara samidguḍapāyasa saṃyutaṃ | laḍḍukāpūpamadhvājya tilapiṣṭa baliṃ haret || || vāruṇecotthito vyādhi raṣṭarātreṇa muṃcati | imaṃme varuṇetyasya gāyatrī kaṇvavāripāḥ || nāgapāśadharaḥ śrīmānnavartna vibhūṣitaḥ | malayasthāgarurgaṃdhaḥ puṣpaṃ ca kamalotpalaṃ || karpūraṃ caṃdanaṃ dhūpo nai vedyaṃ ghṛtapolikā | haviraśvattha samidaścitrānnena baliṃ haret || || ajaikapādbhavo vyādhiḥ sarvadānidhanapradaḥ | adhavā bahūbhirmāvai rdivasairvā vimuṃcati | vāmapādakare bhūmyāmākāṣetva paradvayaṃ | prasāryaprāṃjaliḥ sākṣādīśvaraṃ ciṃtayan sthitaḥ || śamagnītyasyājyaikapā dgāyatrī catarānanaḥ | kuṃkumaṃ caṃdanaṃ gaṃdhaṃ puṣpaṃ śvetārkasaṃbhavaṃ || dhūpaḥ sathauṣadhīmiśro nai vedyaṃ dadhi pāyasaṃ | haviḥ kūṣmāṃḍa khaṃḍasyāddadhyanena baliṃ haret || || ahirbudhnyabhavo vyādhiḥ sārdhamāsena muṃcati | namaste rudra itsya sarvaṃ tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ || gaṃdhaṃ caṃdana kurpūraiḥ puṣpaṃ padmotpalaṃ śubhaṃ | sabilva guggulu rdūpanai vedyaṃ ghṛtapāyasaṃ | mudgamāṣatilānnājya yavavrīhi bhavaṃ haviḥ || havistadevasajalaṃ dadhyanena baliṃ haret || || revatyāmutthitovyādhi raṣṭarātreṇa muṃcati | pūṣātva iti maṃtrasya jagatī gautamoṛṣiḥ || pūṣāca devatāṃ bhoja varṇoṃ bojadharaśśubhaḥ | raktacaṃdana gaṃdhotra puṣpaṃ maṃdāra saṃjñikaṃ || dhūpastu guggulussājyaṃ nai vedyaṃ ghṛtapāyasaṃ | havistadevasajalaṃ dadhyannena baliṃ haret || bhūteśānusṛtoyasmā droganātho māhan jvaraḥ | rogādasmāccamāṃ trāhi sarvānnaṃ cottamaṃ baliṃ || || kṛtvā nakṣatrapūjāṃ ca tithivāsarayorapi | evaṃ rāśyādiṣaḍvarga baliṃ dadyāttadīśvarān || yobaliṃ kurute samyak rogirogātpramucyate | iti nakṣatrotpanna rogaśāṃtayaḥ || prati vadyutthito vyāthi rdvādaśāhena muṃcati | agnistu devatā tatra kṛsarānnaṃ baliṃ haret || dvitīyā yāṃ bhavedvādhiḥ paṃca rātreṇa muṃcati | brahmatu devatā tatra pāyasena baliṃ haret || tṛtīyā yāṃ bhavedvyāthiḥ sapta rātrema muṃcati | girijā devatā tatra ghṛtānnena baliṃ haret || caturthyā mutthito vyādhiḥ daśarātreṇa muṃcati | gaṇeśo devatā tatra ghṛtānnena baliṃ haret || paṃcamyā mutthitovyādhi rnavarātreṇa muṃcati | sarveśo devatā tatra durthānnena baliṃ haret || ṣaṣṭyāṃ samutthito vyādhi ścatūrātreṇa muṃcati | skaṃdanu devatā tatra mudgānnena baliṃ haret || saptamyā mutthito vyādhi raṣṭa rātreṇa muṃcati | āryamā devatā tatra guḍānnena baliṃ haret || aṣṭamyā mutthito vyādhi raṣṭa rātreṇa muṃcati | aṣṭamā devatā tatra guḍānnena baliṃ haret || navamyā mutthato vyādhi rmaraṇaṃ niścitaṃ bhavet | vasavo devatā tatra tilānnena labiṃ haret || daśamyā mutthito vyādhi paṃrātreṇa muṃcati | nāgastu devatā tatra ghṛtānnena baliṃ haret || ekādaśyutthito vyāthi strī rātreṇa muṃcati | dharmastu rdevatā tatra māṣānnena baliṃ haret || dvādaśyā mutthito vyādhi rmaraṇaṃ niścitaṃ bhavet | rogasya savinirmukti yamalokaṃ sagacchati || trayodaśyāṃ bhavo vyāthiḥ sapta rātreṇa muṃcati | kāmastu devatā tatra laḍḍu kānnāṃ baliṃ haret || caturdaśyāṃ bhave dvyādhiḥ mṛtyu dassyā ddhvimāsataḥ | muṃcatyariṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ ca piṣṭānnena baliṃ haret || paurṇi mā yāṃ bhavedvyādhi strī rātreṇa vimuṃcati | caṃdrastu devatā tatra dadhyodana baliṃ haret || amāvāsyā bhavovyādhi rmāsenai kena muṃcati | adhavā maṃḍalai kena jvara dāhani pīḍitaṃ || mahamṛtyu rbhaveḍvāpi yamalokaṃ sagacchati || tatra śāṃtiṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvadoṣāpa śāṃtaye | pitṛṇāṃ pratimākāryā sauvarṇeḥ karṣa saṃmitā || samidājya tilai rmāṣa carvājyenaca homayet | aṣṭottara śataṃvāpi aṣṭā viṃśatirevavā || kṛṣṇāgauśca pradātavyā ācāryāya sadakṣiṇā | brāhmaṇān bhojayetpaścā dekādaśa svaśaktitaḥ || sarvāriṣpa praśāṃtyarthaṃ dīrghāyuśca sūkhībhavet || ravivāre bhaveddvyādhi rjvaradāhe na pīḍitaḥ | savitā devatā tatra pāyasānnaṃ baliṃ haret || iṃduvāre bhavedvyādhiḥ saptarātreṇa muṃcati | somastu devatā tatra ghṛtānnena baliṃ haret || bhaumavāre bhavedvyādhiḥ keśāya maraṇāya ca | kujastu devatā tatra raktānnena baliṃ haret || budhavāre bhavedvyādhiḥ kleśāya maraṇāya ca | budhastu devatā tatra mudgānnena baliṃ haret || guravāre bhavedvyādhiḥ paṃcarātreṇa muṃcati | gurustu devatā tatra haridrānnaṃ baliṃ haret || bhṛguvāre bhavedvyādhiḥ saptarātreṇa muṃcati | bhṛgustu devatā tatra haridrānnaṃ baliṃ haret || śanivāre bhavedvyādhi rmāsārdhena vimuṃcati | śanistu devatā tatra māṣānnena baliṃ haret || rāśyādi ṣaḍvārgapebhyo baliṃ dadyā tsukhāptaye | yo baliṃ kurute samyagrogirogā tpramucyate | adāsya nidhanapratya gjanmāhvaya vipatkare || nakṣatro janitovyādhiḥ kleśāya maraṇāyaca | āśleṣārdrā tripūrvāyama varuṇa marucchakra | tārānalākhyāḥ dvādaśyāṃ skaṃdariktā | tithiṣuca ravijāsrārkavāreṣu yeṣāṃ || rogasaṃjāyate cedya mapuramacirātprāpnunaṃ | tyevacaṃdre janmanyaṣṭākhya baṃdhunvaya | baṃdhunyaya bhavanagate mṛtyulagneca rāśau || iti kamalākarabhaṭṭa kṛtau śāṃtiratne jvarādi rogotpatti nakṣatrādi śāṃtayaḥ atha ravyādi graha vrata śāṃtiḥ madanaratne bhaviṣye - ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ hyetamuttamaṃ | yena lakṣmīrdhṛtistuṣṭiḥ puṣṭiḥ kāṃtiśca jāyate || sādityāvāre hastetu pūrvaṃgṛhya vicakṣaṇaḥ | maṃtrokta vidhinā sarvaṃ kuryātbūjādikaṃ raveḥ || pratyarkaṃ saptanaktāni kṛtvā bhaktiparonaraḥ | tatastu saptame prāpte kuryā dbrāhṇa bhojanaṃ || bhāskaraṃ śuddha sauvarṇaṃ kṛtvā yatnena mānavaḥ | tāmrapātre snāpayitvā raktapuṣṭai ssupūjayet || raktavastra yugacchannaṃ chatropānadyugānvitaṃ | ghṛtena stāpayitvāca laḍḍukāni nivedayet || homaṃ ghṛta tilaiḥ kuryādravi nāmnāca maṃtravit | samidhoṣṭottara śata maṣṭāviṃśati revavā || hotavyā madhusarpibhyāṃ dadhnācaiva ghṛtenaca || samidhorkasamidhaḥ || maṃtreṇāna viduṣe brāhmaṇāya pradāpayet || ādideva namastubhyaṃ saptasapte divākara | tvaṃ rave tārayasvāsmāna smātsaṃsāra sāgarāt || vratenānena rājeṃdra bhave dārogya muttamaṃ | dravya saṃpatsuta prāptiriti paurāṇikā viduḥ || āpisaṃpatkarī ceyaṃ śāṃtiḥ puṣṭakarī nṛṇāṃ | sūryapīḍā samaghorā sukṛtā śāṃtiḥ śubhapradā || ityāditya śāṃtiḥ atha caṃdra śāṃtiḥ - tatraiva - tadvacchitrāsu saṃgṛhya somavāraṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ | anenaivokta vithinā kuryā tpūjādikaṃ vithoḥ || saptametu tataḥ prāpte kuryādbrāhmaṇa bhojanaṃ | saptamenakte || kāṃsyapātre dhanaṃ sthāpya somaṃ rajita nirmitaṃ | śvetavastra yugacchannaṃ śvetapuṣsaiḥ prapūjitaṃ || pādukopāna hacchatra naiveḍyāsana saṃyutaṃ | homaṃ ghṛta tilaiḥ kuryā tsomanāmnāca maṃtravit || samidhoṣṭottara śata miṣṭāviṃśati revavā | hotavyā madhu sarpibhyāṃ dadhnācaiva ghṛtenaca || samidhaḥ pālāśajāḥ || dadhyānnaṃ śaśine hutvā brāhmaṇāya nivedayet | maṃtreṇānena rājeṃdra samyagbhaktyā samanvitaḥ || mahadeva priyositvaṃ puṣpaṃ gokṣīra pāṃḍuraṃ | soma saumyo bhavāsmākaṃ sarvādāte namo namaḥ || evaṃ kṛte mahacchāṃtiḥ somaḥ svastikaro bhavet || iti caṃdra śāṃtiḥ || atha bhaumaśāṃtiḥ - svātyā maṃgārakaṃ gṛhyatrapāyāṃ naktabhojanī | saptametvadha saṃprapte haimaṃtāmraṃ niveśayet | raktavastra yugacchannaṃ kuṃkumenānu lepitaṃ || nivedya bhaktyā kusaraṃ puṣpa dhūpākṣatābhiḥ | homaṃ ghṛta tilaiḥ kuryātkuja nāmnāca maṃtra vit || samidoṣṭottara śatamāṣṭā viṃśati revavā | hotavyā madhu sarpibhyāṃ dadhnācaiva ghṛtenaca || || samidhaḥ khādirāḥ || maṃtreṇānenataṃdadyā dbrāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine | kujakuprabhavopitvaṃ maṃgalaḥ paṭhi paṭhyase || aṃgalaṃ nnihatyāśu maṃgalaṃ yaccha maṃgala | evaṃ kṛte bhauma kṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ śāṃti māpnuyāt | kartavyaṃ bhomapīḍā sutasmātrpayata mānasaiḥ || ityāṃgāraka śāṃtiḥ || atha būdha śāṃtiḥ - tatraiva - viśākhāsu budhaṃ gṛhyasapta naktānya dārcayot | budhaṃ homa mayaṃ kṛtvā sthāpitaṃ kāṃsya bhājase | śuklavastra yugaccannaṃ śukala mālyānu lepitaṃ | guḍo danopa haraṃca brāhmaṇāya nivedayet || budhatvaṃ buddhijanako bodavān sarvadānṛṇāṃ | tatvāvabodhaṃ kurume somaputra nayonamaḥ || pūrva vadghṛta tilaiḥ apāmārga samidbhiḥ | budhanāmnāhomaṃ kuryāt || budhaśāṃtiriyaṃ prokta budha vaikṛta nāśinī || budha doṣetu kartavyā tadhā śāṃti rakhīṣṭadā || iti budha śāṃtiḥ || atha guruśāṃtiḥ - gurucaivānurādhāsu pūjaye dbhaktito naraḥ | pūrvoktavidhiyogena saptanaktānyadhācaret || gaimaṃ hemamaye pātre sthāpayitvā bṛhaspatiṃ | pītāṃbalayugacchannaṃ pītayatropavītinaṃ || pādukopānahacchatra kamaṃḍalu vibhūṣitaṃ | pūjaye tpītakusumaiḥ kuṃkumena vilepitaṃ || dhūpa dīpādibhidravyaiḥ phalai ścaṃdana taṃḍulaiḥ | khaṃḍakhādyopahāraśca guro ragrenivedayet || dharmaśāstrārtha tatvajña jñāna vijñāna pāraga | vibuthārtiharā ciṃtya devācārya namostute || homastu pūrvavat || ghṛtatilai raśvaddha samidbhiḥ gurunāmnā | viṣamasthe guraukāryā mahaśāṃti riyaṃnṛbhiḥ || iti guruśāṃtiḥ || atha śukraśāṃtiḥ - śukraṃ jyeṣṭhāsu saṃdṛhya kṣamāyāṃ naktabhojanī | gurūktakramamārgeṇa dvijasaṃtarapaṇenaca || saptametva dhanaṃ prāste raupyaṃ śukraṃtukārayet | vaṃśapātretu saṃsthāpya pūjayetsita paṃrajaiḥ || tadabhāvesitaiḥ puṣpai stāṃbūlai ścaṃdanenaca | agre tasya pradātavyaṃ pāyasaṃ ghṛtasaṃyutaṃ || bhārgavo bhṛgujaśśukraḥ śṛtismṛti viśāradaḥ | hṛtvā gṛhakṛtān doṣā nāyurārogyadostunaḥ || anena maṃtreṇa dadyāt homastu pūrvavat | ghṛtatilaiḥ uduṃbara samidbhiḥ śukranāmnā kuryāt || iti śukraśāṃtiḥ || itha śanaiścarādi śāṃtiḥ - śanaiścaraṃ rāhuketū lohapātreṣu vinyaset | kṛṣṇāgarussmṛto dhūpo dakṣiṇā ca svaśaktitaḥ || yadhākramaṃ śamī dūrvā kuśānāṃ sammidhaṃ smṛtaḥ | saptame tvathanaṃprāste sauvarṇāna thakārayot || kṛṣṇavastrayugaccanna mekaikaṃ kārayodbudhaḥ | mṛganābhyā samālabhya kṛsarānnaṃ nivedyaye | homānasāne tatsarvaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet || homasukta samidbiśca teṣāṃ nāmnāca kārayet | śanaiścara namastestu namaste rāhavetathā || ketave ca namastubhyaṃ sarvaśāṃtiṃ prayaccata | anena maṃtreṇa dadyāt || iti śanaiścarādi śāṃtiḥ || atha navagrahadānādīni jātakā bharaṇe sārāvaśyāṃca - yokhecarā gocaratoṣṭa vargādaṃ sākramācvāṣya śubhā bhavaṃti | dānādināte sutarāṃ prasannastenādhunā dāna vidhiṃ pravakṣye || māṇikya godhūma navatsadhenuḥ kausuṃbhavāso guḍahema tāmraṃ | āraktakaṃ caṃdana maṃbujaṃca vadaṃtidānaṃ hivirocanāya || sadvāṃśa pātra sthitataṃḍulāśca karpūra muktāphala śubha vastraṃ | yugopayuktaṃ vṛṣabhaṃcaraupyaṃ caṃdrāyadadādghṛta pūrṇakuṃbhaṃ || pravāla godhūma masūrikāśca vṛṣoruṇaścāpi guḍaḥ suvarṇaṃ | āraktavastraṃ karavīra puṣpaṃ tāmraṃca bhaumāya vadaṃti dānaṃ || celaṃca nīlaṃ kaladauta kāṃsyaṃ mudgājya gārutmata sarva puṣpaṃ | dāsīca daṃḍodviradaścanīnaṃ vadaṃtidānaṃ vidu naṃdanāya || śarkarācarajanī turaṃgamaḥ pītadhānyamapi pītamaṃbaraṃ | puṣparāga lavaṇaṃ sakāṃcanaṃ prītaye suraguroḥ pradīyate || citrāṃbaraṃ śubhratarasturaṃgo dhemaśca vajraṃ rajataṃ suravarṇaṃ | sutaṃjulājyottama gaṃdhayuktaṃ vadaṃtidānaṃ bhṛgunaṃdanāya || māṣāścatailaṃ vimaleṃdra nīlaṃ tīlāḥ kulutthā mahaṣīca lohaḥ | kṛṣṇāṃcadhenuṃ pravadaṃtisūnaṃ duṣṭāyadānaṃ ravinaṃdanāya || gomedharatnaṃ caturaṃtayāsaṃ sunīlacelā malakaṃbalājāḥ | tilāścatailaṃ khalulohamiśraṃ sarbhānavedānamidaṃ vadaṃtiḥ || vaiḍhūryaratnaṃ satilaṃca tailaṃ sakaṃbalaścāpi madomṛgasya | śastraṃca ketoḥ paritoṣahetoḥ chāgebhadānaṃ kadhitaṃ munīṃdraiḥ || a tha ra tna dhā ra ṇa ṃ tatraiva - māṇikyaṃ taraṇe spujāta mamalaṃ muktāphalaṃ śīta gormāhe yasya ca midrumaṃ marakataṃ saumaysya gārutmataṃ devejyasyatu puṣparāga masurāmātyasya vajraṃ śanernīlaṃ nirmalamasyayoścagadhite gomedha vai ḍūryake || a tha gra ha snā nā ni viṣṇudharmottire - maṃjiṣṭhā mattamātaṃgaṃ kuṃkumaṃ raktacaṃdanaṃ | pūrṇakuṃbhekṛtaṃ tāmre sūryasnānaṃ vidhīyate || mattamātaṃgaṃ gajamadaḥ uśīraṃ ca śirīṣaṃ ca kuṃkumaṃ raktacaṃdanaṃ | śaṃkhasyasta midaṃ snānaṃ caṃdradoṣa vināśanaṃ || khadiraṃ devadāruṃ ca tilānyāmalakānica | purṇakuṃbhe kṛteraupye bhaumapīḍā vināśanaṃ || nadī saṃgamatoyāni tanmṛdā sahitānica | nyastāni kuṃbhamāheya budha pīḍā vināśanaṃ || auduṃbaraṃ tadhā bilvaṃ vaṭamāmalakaṃ tathā | nyastāni kuṃbhamāheya budha pīḍā vināśanaṃ || gorocanaṃ nāgamadaḥ śatapuṣpa śatāvarī | vinyastā rājate kuṃbhe śukrapīḍā vināśanaṃ || tilānmāṣān priyaguṃ ca gaṃdhapuṣpe tadhaivaca | nyastaṃ kārṣāyase kuṃbhe sauripīḍā vināśanaṃ || gugguluṃ hiṃgalaṃ tālaṃ śubhāṃcaiva manaśśilāṃ | śṛṃgeca mahiṣenyaste rāhupīḍā vināśanaṃ || || tālaṃ haritālaṃ || varāhavihitāṃrāja nparvavatāgra mṛdaṃ tadhā | chāgakṣīraṃ khaḍgapātre ketupīḍā pināśanaṃ || grahasnāna midaṃproktaṃ sarvapīḍāpi nāśanaṃ || iti grahasnānāni || madanaratne - pippalāda uvāca - gurupūjāṃ pravakṣyāmi yadhoktaṃ brahmaṇāpura | lokānā mupakāroya sarvopadrava śāṃtaye || kanyā vivāhakāletu śuddhiryasyana vidyate | brāhmaṇasyopanayane yasyasyāddusthito guruḥ | ebhiḥ pūjā guroḥ kāryā vidhivadbhakti bhāvitaiḥ | madaṃtīkāma puṣpāṇi patraṃ pālāśa narṣapau || madaṃtī - yūthikā|| kāmodamanaṃ || guḍīcī nānyapāmārgaṃ viḍaṃgaṃ śaṃbhinīnācā | sahādevī viṣṇukrāṃtā sarvauṣadhya śśatāvarī || kuṣṭaṃ māṃsī haridredve murāśai leya caṃdanaṃ | vacākacora mustāca sarvauṣadhyaḥ prakīrtitāḥ || tathaivāśvattha bhaṃgāśca paṃcagavyaṃ jalaṃtathā | nūtanaṃ sodakuṃbhaṃca pītavastra samanvitaṃ || paṃcartnai ssamāyukta mīśānyāṃ sthāsitenalāt | yā oṣadīriti maṃtreṇa sarvāṇyasmin vinikṣipet | kuṃbhasyo paribhāgetu sthāpayitvā bṛhaspatiṃ | suvarṇapātre sauvarṇīṃ pratimāṃtu yudhiṣṭhira || kārayettu yadhāśaktyā vittaśāḍhya vivarjitaḥ | pītavastra yugaccannāṃ pīta yajñopavītinīṃ || pūjayodgaṃtha puṣpādyaistato homaṃ samācaret | samiddhośvattha vṛkṣasya hotavyāṣṭottaraśataṃ | tilairvrīhiyavairmiśraṃ hotavyaṃca yadhākramaṃ | bṛhaspateti maṃtreṇa ṛṣiccaṃda ssamanvitaṃ || maṃtreṇānena juhuyāddhānyā purvaṃca yatnataḥ | tato homāvasānetu pūjayecca bṛhaspatiṃ || pītagaṃdhai stadāpuṣpai dūpairdīpaiśca bhaktitaḥ | dadhyodanaṃca nai vedyaṃ phalatāṃbūla maṃyutaṃ || maṃtreṇānena kauṃteya samiddhavyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | namaste girijānādha vākpatetha bṛhaspate || krūra grahaiḥ pīḍitā nāmamṛtāya nayonamaḥ | pūjayitvā surācāryaṃ paścādarghyaṃ nivedayet || gaṃbhīra dṛḍharūpāṃga devejya sumate prabho || namaste vākpate śāṃtagrahoṇārghyaṃ bṛhanpate | ityarghya maṃtraḥ || arghyaṃdatvā surejyasya japahomaṃ samāpayet | bhaktyāste surācārya homa pūjādi satkṛtiṃ || kṛtāṃ gṛhaṇa śāṃtyardhaṃ vākpatete namonamaḥ | saṃkalpa maṃtraḥ || maṃtreṇānena saṃkalpya paścātsāṃ prārthayon‌nṛpaḥ || jīvo bṛhaspati ssūri rācāryo gururaṃgirāḥ || vācaspatirdeva maṃtrī śubhaṃ kuryātsadā mama | iti prārthanā maṃtraḥ || evaṃ saṃprārthayeddheva mācāryaṃca prapūjayet | sarvopacāra saṃyuktaṃ pratimāṃtāṃ yaṃdhiṣṭhira || praṇamyaca gavāyuktā mācāryāya nivedayet | adhā cāryastu niyato vedavedāṃca pāragaḥ || yajamānaṃ sapatnīkaṃ śāṃta cittaṃ jiteṃdriyaṃ | kuṃbhodakaṃ gṛhītvātu maṃtrairetaiḥ prasiṃcayet || idamāpodha maṃtreṇa tāmagni mityṛcātadhā | yā oṣadhīraśvāvatīḥ kaṣmāṃḍaiścābhiṣecayet | paccātsaṃbhojaye dviprās yadhāśaktyā yudhiṣṭhira | evaṃ kṛtvā guroḥ pūjāṃ sarvānkāmā navāpnuyāt || saṃkrāṃtāvapi kauṃteya tathā svābhyudayeṣuca | kurvan bṛhaspateḥ pūjā mabhīṣṭa phalamāpnuyāt || saṃkrāṃtau guru saṃkrāṃtau || iti gurupūjā atha prati śukradi vidhiḥ vṛddha vasiṣṭhaḥ - śukraścā staṃgateyātrā caṃdrecā stamupāgate | tathā bālye ca vardhe ca sāyātrā bhayarogadā || prati śukraṃ prati budhaṃ prati bhaumaṃ ca garhitaṃ | tīrthayātrā vithauteṣāṃ prati śukrona vidyate || kaśyapeṣu vasiṣṭheṣu bhṛgu ṣvaṃgiraseṣu ca | bharadvājeṣu vatseṣu prati śukrona vidyate || anyāṣāṃ sammukhe doṣaḥ prati śukrastu sarvādā | kṛtvā śāṃtiṃ prayatnena paścātsarvaṃ samācaret || upoṣyabhṛguvāre ca yāvacchukrodayaṃ pratī | rajatena ca śuddhenakāraye tpratimāṃ bhṛgoḥ || likhe daṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ kāṃsyapātre ca taṃḍulai | śukla puṣpākṣatairgaṃdhaiḥ pratimāṃ tatra pajayet | upacārānni vedyatha śukraṃ te anyadityṛcā || tanmaṃtreṇa japaṃ kuryā tsamyagaṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ | kṣīra gaṃdhākṣatai puṣpaiḥ rbhaktyācārghyaṃ pradāpayet || daityamaṃtrī divyadarśīcośanā bhārgavaḥ kaviḥ || śvetothamaṃḍalaḥ kāvyovidhiste bhṛgave namaḥ | datvetyarghyaṃ prayatnena prārthayoccaiva bhaktitaḥ | tvatpūjayānayā śukra sanmukho bhava śūbhana | doṣaṃ vināśayakṣipraṃ rakṣamāṃ tejasāṃ nidhe || daivajñāya tato dadyā tpratimāṃ śvetagoyutāṃ | evaṃ kṛte doṣassyā dvijayīcārdavān bhavet || mātsyepi viśeṣaḥ || athātaḥ śruṇubhūpāla prati śukapraśāṃtaye || yātrāraṃbhe ca prasthāne tadhā śukrodaye sati || śukrapūjā prakartavyatāṃ niśāmaya bhārata || rajatevātha sauvarṇe kāṃsyapātredhavā punaḥ | śuklapuṣpaṃbarayute śveta taṃḍula pūrite || nithāya rājataṃ śukraṃ śuciṃ muktāphalānvitaṃ | mahāśveta gavāyuktaṃ sāmagāya nivedayet | samaste sarvalokeśa namaste bhṛgunaṃdana | kave sarvārthasidhyarthaṃ gṛhīṇārghyaṃ namostute || datvaiva marghyaṃ kauṃteya paṇipatya visarjayet | yāvaccukrasyanakṛtā pūjā sarvopaharakaiḥ || vaṭakaipośikābhiśca godhūmaiścaṇakairapi | tāvatphalaṃ kadhyaṃ labhyaṃ strībhiḥ kāmārthasiddhaye || yeca śukrodayekurvanyātrādiṣu ca bhārata | arvāgrāśyāgamecaiva abhīṣṭaṃ satadāpnuyāt | tadvadvācaspateḥ pūjāṃ pravakṣyāmi yudhiṣṭira | sauvarṇa pātre sauvarṇaṃ mamareśa parohitaṃ || pītapuṣpaṃbaradharaṃ kṛtvā snātvādhasarṣapaiḥ | phalāśāśvaddhabhaṃgena paṃcagavya tilenataṃ || bhaṃgaḥ pallavaḥ || pītaṃga rāgavasano ghṛtahomaṃtukārayet || praṇamya ca gavāsārdhaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet | namasteṃgirasāṃ nātha vākpatetha bṛhaspate || kṛragrahaiḥ pīḍitānā mamṛtāya namonamaḥ | arghya maṃtraḥ || saṃkāṃtāvari kauṃteyayātrāsvabhyudayoṣuca || karvan bṛhaspateḥ pūjāṃ sarvānkāmānsamaśnute | saṃkrāṃtau guroḥ || athavāmauktikānyeva suvṛttāni bṛhaṃtica | bhārgavāṃgirasauṃcitya tānyeva pratipādayet || bhaktyā mauktikadāne natvanena kurunaṃdana | kurūpatā daśā pusāṃnakadā citprajāyate || yo bhārgavodaya mavāpyasa vastrapuṣpaṃ kurvaṃtya nanyamanasoṃgiranaśca pūjāṃ | teṣāṃ gṛhepravasatāṃ prati śukra jātovighnena saṃbhavati bhārata puṇyabhājāṃ || iti guru śukrapūjā || madanaratne bhaviṣye - tato maṃdasyadivase snāna mabhyaṃga pūrvakaṃ | kāryaṃ deyaṃcaviprāya tailamabhyaṃga hetave || yastu saṃvatsaraṃ yāvatprāpte śani dine naraḥ || tailaṃdadāti viprebhyaḥ svaśaktyā pūjitopivā || tataḥ saṃvatśarasyāṃte prāptetasya dine punaḥ || loha paṭṭārpitaṃ sauriṃtaila kuṃbhe vitikṣipet || lohe vāmṛṇmayovātha kṛṣṇa vastra yugānvite || kṛṣṇā go dakṣiṇāyaṃktaṃ nīla kaṃbala śāyinaṃ || svayamabhyaṃ jita ssnātvā kṛṣṇapuṣsai stamarcayet | sugaṃdha gaṃdha puṣsaiśca kṛsarānnai stilodanaiḥ || pūjayitvā sūrya putraṃ kṣamasveti punaḥ punaḥ | kṛṣṇāya dvijamukhyāya tadabhāvedarāyaca | devaśśanaiścaro bhaktyā maṃtreṇānena vedvija || krūrāvaloka navaśādbhavanaṃ nāpnoti yograha krauryāt | tuṣṭodhanakanaka sukhaṃ dadāti sosmān śanaiścaraḥ pātu | yaḥ puna rnaṣṭa rājyāya narāya paritoṣitaḥ | svapne dadaunijaṃ rājyaṃ same sauri srasīdatu || koṇaṃ nīlāṃjana prakhyaṃ maṃdaceṣṭā prasāriṇaṃ | cāyā mārtāṃḍa saṃbhūtaṃ namasyāmi śanaiścaraṃ || namorka putrāya śanaiścarāya nīhāra varṇāṃjanamebhāya | śṛtvārahasyaṃ bhavakāma dastvaṃ phala pradome bhavasūrya putra || namostu pretarājāya kṛśadehāyavainamaḥ | śanaiścarāya krūrāya śudda budhi pradāyine || yaebhirnāma bhistauti tasya tuṣṭiṃ dadātyasau | tadīyaṃtu bhayaṃ tasya svapnepi sabhaviṣyati || ityanena vidhānena śaniṃ natvā visarjayet || evame tadvrataṃ nityaṃ yocariṣyaṃti mānavāḥ || vāsare vāsare prāpte vatsaraṃ yāvadevataṃ | teṣāṃ śanaiścara pīḍā deśepi nabhaviṣyati || kṛṣṇāya sena ghaṭitāṃ yamarāja murtiṃlohe nidhāya ghaṭake tilataila pūrṇe | yobrāhmaṇāya ravijaṃ pradadāti bhaktyāpīḍā śanaiścara kṛtā sahibādhatetaṃ || skāṃde || dvādaśāṣṇama janmasthe śanau sarvagraheśvare || kiṃkartavayaṃ naraiḥ kiṃvā vidhānyāṃ kleśa śāṃtaye || skaṃda uvāca - śrāvaṇemāsi saṃjāte śobhane śanivāsare | loharūpaṃ śaniṃ kṛtvā snāpya paṃcāmṛtenavai || puṣpai raṣṭavidhairdhūpaiḥ phalaiścaiva viśeṣathaḥ | nāmabhiḥ pūjaye detaiḥ
