krameṇa graha sattamaṃ || koṇasthaḥ piṃgalo babruḥ kṛṣṇo rudro yamoṃtakaḥ | saurī śanaiścaro maṃdaḥ pippalādena saṃstutaḥ || śanno devīti sarvatra vaidikenaca pūjayete | pūjayitvāca nai vedyaṃ tataḥ kuryātkrameṇatu || samāṣa bhaktaṃ pradamaṃ dvitīyaṃ pāyasaṃ śubhaṃ | devīti sarvatra vaidikenaca pūjayete || pūjayitvāca naivedyaṃ tataḥ kurayātkrameṇatu || samāṣa bhaktaṃ pradamaṃ dvitīyaṃ pāyasaṃ śubhaṃ | tṛtīyetvaṃ balīkāryā caturthe pūrikā śubhā || aṃbalī takra taṃḍula piṣṭa kṛtāyavāgūḥ | prathamādi sabdhovāsara paraḥ || iti śanaiścara śāṃtiḥ || atha śanaiścarādi stotraṃ skāṃde nāgarakhaṃḍe nāradaḥ - gṛhagāvo nareṃdraśca brāhmaṇāśca viśeṣataḥ | pūjītāṃ pūjayaṃtyete nirdahaṃ tyapamānitāḥ || tasmā tkurustutiṃ cāsya svaśaktyā bhāskare prabhoḥ | bālaka uvāca - piṣpalādo dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ | namaste koḍasaṃsdhāya piṃgalāya namostute || namaste babhṛrupāya kṛṣṇāyaca namostute | namaste raudradehāya namaste cāṃtakāyaca | namaste yamasaṃjñāya namaste saurayevibho | namaste maṃcasaṃjñaya śanaiścara namostute || prasādaṃ kurudeveśa dīnasya praṇatasyame | śanaiścara uvāca - parituṣṭosmite vatsa stotreṇānena sāṃprataṃ | vataṃ varayabho vatsa tavayacchāmi vāṃchitaṃ || pippalāda uvāca - adyaprabhṛtino pīḍā bālānāṃ ravinaṃdana | tvayākāryā mahau bhāgana svakīyākadaṃcana || yāvadvarṣāṣca kaṃjātaṃ mamavākyena sūryaja | stotreṇānenayonyastvaṃ stoṣyetprātarupasthitaḥ || tasya pīḍā nakartavyā tvayā bhāskaranaṃdana | tasyapīḍā nakartavya deyo lābho mahābhuja || ardhāṣṭamikayāyoge tāvake saṃsthite naraḥ | sārtha saptavarṣa eva arthāṣṭamikā || tava vāretu saṃprāpteya stilānnoha saṃyutān | śaktyā dadātino tasya pīḍā kāryātvayā vibho || kṛṣṇāṃ gāyatu viprāyatavoddeśenayaccati | arthāṣṭamikayā pīḍā tasyakāryā tvayānaca || śamīsamidbhiryo hmaṃ tavoddeśena nirvapet | tathā kṛṣṇatilaiśaiva kṛṣṇapuṣpānulepanaiḥ || pūjāṃkarotiyastubhyaṃ dhūpaṃ vai gugguluṃ dadet | kṛṣṇavasteṇa saṃveṣṭyatyāji tasya tvayāvyadhā | sūta uvāca - evamuktaḥ śaninaina bāḍhamityena jalpyaca | nāradaṃ samanujñāya jāgamanijasaṃśrayaṃ || madanaratne prabhāsakhaṃḍe - yaḥ punaḥ śraddhayāyuktaḥ śuciḥ prātassamāhitaḥ || śamīpatraiḥ samabhyarca pratimāṃ lohajāṃ mama | māṣodanaṃ tilairmiśraṃ dadyāllohaṃ ca dakṣiṇāṃ || kṛṣṇāṃgāṃ vṛṣabhaṃvāpi yāmedadyā dvijāyavai | tasya pīḍāṃnacai vāhaṃ kariṣyāmi kadācana | iti śani stutiḥ || atha rāhu śāṃtiḥ || jyotiṣye - jānmāṃtya paṃcacaturaṣṭa navadnisapte rāhugraho yaditucāra vaśenagacchet | āloḍanaṃ nṛpabhayaṃ kṣayamardha nāśanaṃ rogapranavāsa maraṇāgni bhayaṃ karoti || <6> mātsye - horāyāṃgra nateyasya nakṣatrevā niśākaraṃ | prāṇa saṃdeha māpnoti maraṇāṃvā samṛcchati || yasyātra janmanakṣatre grasyete śaśi bhāskarau | tajjātānāṃ bhavetpīḍāye janāḥ śāṃti varjitāḥ | yasya rājat samāsādya bhavet grahaṇa saṃbhavaḥ | tasyasnānaṃ pravakṣyāmi maṃtrauṣadhi samanvitaṃ || caṃdroparāgaṃ saṃprāpya kṛtvā brāhmaṇa vācanaṃ | saṃpūjya caturo viprān śuklamālyānu lepanaiḥ || pūrvamevoparāgasya samānīyauṣadhādikaṃ | sthāpayeccaturaḥ kuṃbhāne agratassāgarādiṣu || gajāśvaratthyā valmīka saṃgamā hṛdagokulāt | rājadvāra praveśācca mṛdamānīya nikṣipet || paṃcagayyaṃ paṃcaratnaṃ paṃcatva kṛṃca pallavaṃ | rocanaṃ padmakaṃ śaṃkhaṃ kuṃkumaṃ rakta caṃdanaṃ || muktāsphaṭika tīrthaṃbusita sarṣapa guggulūn | madhukaṃdeva dāruṃca viṣṇukrāṃtāṃ śatāvarīṃ || balāṃca sahadevīṃca niśā daśā dvitīya mevaca | etatsarvaṃ vinikṣipya kuṃbheṣyā vāhayotyurān || sarve samudra ssarita stīrthāni jaladānadāḥ | āyāṃtu yajamānas duritakṣaya kārakāḥ || gaṃgeca dhiṃ kuru || yosau vajrabharodevo ādityānāṃ prabhūrmataḥ | sahasra nayanaścaṃdra grahapīḍāṃ vyapohatu || mukhaṃ yassarvaṃ devānāṃ saptārcira mitadyutiḥ | caṃdroparāga saṃbhūtā magniḥ pīḍāṃ vyapohatu || yaḥ karmasākṣi lokānāṃ darmo mahīṣavāhanaḥ | mama caṃdroparāgotthāṃ gahapīḍāṃ vyapohatu | nāgapāśa dharodevaḥ sadā makaravāhanaḥ || caṃdroparāga kaluṣaṃ varuṇome vyapohatu | prāṇarūpo hilokānāṃ sadākṛṣa mṛgapriyaḥ || vāyuścaṃdropa rāgotthāṃ grahapīḍāṃ vyapohatu | yosaunidhipatiḥ khaḍgaśūla cakra gadādharaḥ | cdroparāga duritaṃ dhanadome vyapohatu | yosāviṃdu dharo devaḥ pinākī vṛṣavāhanaḥ || caṃdroparāga pāpāni nivārayatu śaṃkaraḥ | trailokye yānibhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇica || brahmā viṣṇvarka rucrāśca dahaṃtu mamapātakaṃ | evamāvāhayeddevān maṃtrai rebhiśca vāruṇaiḥ || etāneva tathā maṃtrān svarṇapaṭṭe vilekhayet | tāmrapaṭṭe thavālikhya navavast tathaivaca || mastake yajamānasya nidadhyustedvijo ttamāḥ | kalaśān dravya saṃyuktān nānātīrtha namanvitān || gṛhītvā sthāpayedgūḍhaṃ bhadrapīṭho paristhitaṃ | pūrvoktereva maṃtreśca tsvarṇapaṭṭaṃ nivedayet | ācārye dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādgodānaṃca svaśaktitaḥ || gaṃdamālyairdūpadīpaiḥ pūjaye ddevatuṣṭaye | homaścāpi prakarta vyaḥ tilairvyāhṛtibhistadhā || samāpya homaṃvidhi vadbhrāhmaṇebhyo viśeṣataḥ | dānaṃna śaktito dadyādya dīcchedātmano hitaṃ | sūryagrahe sūrya nāma yuktānmaṃtrāśca kīrtayet || anena vidhināyastu grahaṇe snāna mācaret | natasya grahaṇo doṣaḥ kadācidapi jāyate || itimātsyokta grahama śāṃtiḥ || madanaratne graṃdhāṃtare || dūrvāṃkurośīra śamīśilajicca ratna sarvārtha sarvauṣadhi paṃcamṛddhiḥ | snānaṃ vidadyādgrahaṇe ravīṃdvoḥ pīḍā bhavaṃ śāṃti mupaiti doṣaṃ || jyotaṣe || triṣaṭ daśāyopagataṃ narāṇāṃ śubhapragaṃ syādgrahaṇaṃ ravīṃdroḥ || || āyuḥ ekādaśa | naṃdanava | iṣanaḥ paṃca || madanaratne gargaḥ - janma saptāriṣṭa ripsāṃka daśamasthe niśākare || dṛṣṭoriṣṭa prado rāhu janmartre nidhanepica || ripphaṃ dvādaśaṃ || aṃkāva nidhanaṃ sapta matārā | pṛthvi caṃdrodaye viṣṇudharme || yaṃ nakṣatraṃ gato rāhurgrasate śaśi bhāskarau || tajjātānāṃ bhavetpīḍāye sarāḥ śāṃti varḍitāḥ || tadhaiva purāṇāṃtare - sūryasya saṃkramevāpi grahaṇe caṃdra sūryayoḥ | yasvatri janmanakṣatre tasya rogothavā mṛtiḥ || tasya dānaṃca homaṃca devārcana japasthathā || uparāgābhiṣekaṃca kurvācchāṃtiṃ bhaviṣyati | svarṇena vādhapiṣṭena kṛtvā sarpasyacā kṛtiṃ || brāhmaṇāya dadettasya narogādiśca tat kṛtaḥ | janmadaśa maikena viṃśati tārāḥ || trijanma tārāḥ || sarvapya tadākārasya rāhoḥ || adbhuta sāgare bhārgavaḥ - yasyarājasya nakṣatre svarbhānurupajāyate | rājya bhaṃgaṃsuhṛnnāśaṃ maraṇaṃ cātranirdiśet || rājyasya rājyābhiṣeka nakṣatranasyetyartha bārgavārcacana dīpikāyāṃ || jyotissāgare || sauvarṇaṃ kārayonnāgaṃ palenārdha palārdataḥ | tadardenata dardhena tadaradhena paṇāyāṃ mauktikaṃ nyaset || tāmrapātre nidhāyātha ghṛta pūrṇe viśeṣataḥ | kāṃsyevā kāṃtilohevānyasya dabyātpadakṣiṇaṃ | caṃdra grahetu rūpyasya biṃbadadyātsadakṣiṇam̐ || nāgaṃ rukmamayaṃ sūryagrahe biṃbaṃcahemajaṃ | turaṃga radha go bhūmi tila sarpiśca kāṃcanaṃ || ||kālavileke || suvarṇa nirmitaṃ nāgaṃ satilaṃ kāṃsya bhājanaṃ | sadakṣiṇaṃ navastraṃca brāhmaṇā nivedayet || sauvarṇaṃ rājitaṃvāsi biṃbaṃ kṛtvā svaśaktitaḥ | uparāga bhatakleśa cchidevi prāyakalpayet || maṃtrastu || namo yama mahabhīma soma sūrya vimardana | homatārā pradānena mama śāṃti pradobhava || vidhuṃtu danamastubhyaṃ siṃhikānaṃdanācyuta | dānenānena nāgasya rakṣamāṃ vedhaḍādbhayāditi || viśeṣastu matkṛta nirṇaya siṃdhau jñeyaḥ || jyotiṣe || janmāṃtya paṃca caturaṣṭa navadvisapta rāhu grahoyadi tucāravaśena gaccet | āloḍanaṃ nṛpabhayaṃ bhaya mardhanāśaṃ roga pravāsa maraṇāgni bhayaṃ karoti || avarvaṇi grahaṇetvadbhuta sāgare mayūracitre | aparvaṇi śaśāṃkā rkautviṣṭonāma mahāgrahaḥ || āvṛṇoti tamaḥ śyāmaḥ sarvaloka vipattaye | jāduṃbara sahasrāṇi aṣṭauca tāhuyādbudhaḥ || madhvaktānica tānyatra jātavedasa ityṛcā | viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāddhenuṃca vṛṣabhaṃ tadhā || iti hahu śāṃtiḥ || tatphala māhājyoti rviśiṣṭa saṃhitāyāṃ | ketorudayāstamayaṃ jñātuṃ gaṇitānna śakyate yasmāt || divyātarikṣabhaumāste trividhāḥ ketuvo jagati || || ekottara śatabhedā dṛśyaṃtevā sahasrabhedaste | autpātika rūpatvādbhavaṃti bahavastathaikovā || || divi ṛkṣagrahajāste divyākhyāḥ ketavo mahīphaladāḥ | varipeṣaṇeṃdravara dhanurulka gaṃdharva nagara vikhyātāḥ || || gaganavikārajameta nmadhyama phaladaṃ tathāṃtarikṣaṃca | bhūmibhavā bhaumāssyuścarāsthsirāvastu saṃbhavā yeca || || tedhama phaladāsteṣāṃ kathayāmi phalāni rūpāṇi | varṣe māse pakṣe kramaśaḥ paripāka mupayāṃti || || snigdhaprasannarūpaḥ śuklanibho hṛtsvadaṃḍavatsaumyaḥ | udayāstamaye tvevaṃ subhikṣa saukhyāvahaḥ ketuḥ || || dhūmanibho dhūmākhya keturdoṣaprado bhavati | iṃdraśarāsana rūpaḥ sthūpanibho varṣabhītidaḥ samyake || || bahubhiśśikhā bhiratulā vidyunmaṇihāra hemanibhāḥ | apareṃdra diśodṛśyā mahā havaṃtaddigeśānāṃ || || śukamukha baṃdhūkanibhā vahnisutāḥ kṣatajanannibhārūkṣāḥ | dṛśyāṃte naladiśiyaditāvaṃtastepi viśikhino bhayadāḥ || || mṛtyusutā vakraśikhāḥ kṛṣṇārūkṣauḥ praharṣakarāḥ | dṛśyaṃte yāmyaṃ yejanamāraka bhayapradāstepi || || kṣitinayana dvātriṃsadadarpaṇa sadṛsāssa raśmayo viśikhāḥ | kṣudbhayadāḥ saśiraskāya tanayā mṛtyu dāśca śailanibhāḥ || || śaśitanayāḥ kusumanibhāḥ kuṃdeṃdu kṣira rajatanibhāḥ | uttarabhāge śikhono jaṃtūnāṃte subhikṣakarāḥ || || triśikha strivarṇayukto brahmasuto brahmadaṃḍanibha | aniyatadikprabhanosau śāṃtikaro brahyadaṃḍakhyaḥ || || śanitanayāstārākhyāḥ śuklāṛjavaścaṣaṭsaṃkhyāḥ | dṛśyaṃte dvitradinai śśubhadāmānai rmahābhayadāḥ || || jīvasutā vikacākhyā śśuklastārāḥ śritāḥ snigdhāḥ | yāmyāyāṃ diśi saṃsthā bahavastetāpadā ssatataṃ || || budhatanayāścorākhyāḥ śuklāḥ sūkṣmāyatheṣṭadik prabhavāḥ | āmayabhayadāssatataṃ jaṃtūnāṃ paṃcapaṃcāśat || || kujatanayāḥ kṣatajānalasaṃnibhāstri śūladharāḥ | yāmyāyāṃ diśisaṃsthākṣudbhayadā ṣṣaṣṭisaṃkhyākāḥ || || tāmasakālaka saṃjñā rāhusutā sūryamaṃḍale dṛṣṭāḥ | teṣāṃ tannikhilaphalaṃ samyaktathitaṃca sūryavārepi || || agnisutā stvāgneyāṃ viṃśatyadhikāśca śatasaṃkhyāḥ | pralayānala ladṛśāḥ svarbhanava āvahnibhī padāstepa || || aruṇākhyāḥ śyāmalanibhāḥ śukrasutā vividharūpa saṃkīrṇāḥ | śastrakṣudbhaya dāste saptottara saptatiśca saṃkhyākāḥ || || daṃḍakasaṃjñāścaṣṭau tārā sadṛśāḥ prajāpatestanayāḥ | dvācatvāriṃśattora śatādhikāḥ pāpadā vidhātṛsutāḥ || || varuṇabhāvāḥ karkākhyā dvātriṃśa dvaṃśagulmayaṣṭinibhāḥ | śaśivatprabhāsame tārājanyatvaṃ prakurvaṃti || || kālabhavāṣṭaṇṇavatika saṃkhyā steṣāṃ kabaṃdhanibhāḥ | tannāmānaḥ śikhinaṃ pauṃḍrāmaya bhitidā jagataḥ || || vimalāstārākāra daśadikṣu samudbhavāḥ śśikhinaḥ | evaṃ sahasrabedāḥ pāpaiścaiṣāṃ viśeṣamabidhāsye || || paścimadiśi saṃbhūtaścottara namraśca saumya ketuyutaḥ | kurute subhukṣamatulaṃ sitavarṇo saumahāsnigdhaḥ || || dakṣiṇanamraḥpācyāṃ tadhā vidhomāmya ketuśca | rūkṣaṃ kṣudbhayakārī narakabhayaṃvā karotyeva || || dhūmanibho yāmyāyāṃ kapāla keturpuhattamaḥ snigdhaḥ | vikṣuvidikṣuprabhavaḥ kṣudbhayado dṛṣṭirogakaraḥ || || prācyāṃ diśinaṃbhūtaḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ bhramati cakravadrūkṣaḥ | taccakra keturaniśaṃ kapāla ketośca tulyaphalaḥ || || paścimatassaṃbhūto yāmyadiśaṃ bhramati ca pradakṣiṇyaṃ | dhūmanibho viṣamākhyaḥ ketu rbhūbhāramapi nayati || || katipayadivasaṃ gatvā gamananivṛttiṃ karoti dhūmanibhaḥ | narapati kalahājjagataḥ karoti vilayaṃ sacakrākhyaḥ || || gaganatribhāgadīrghaḥ śyāmanibho saumahabhayakaraśca | ṛja vakragatiṃ kurute kramaśo jagatāstribhāgaharaḥ || || upakaraṇeṣu ca rājñāṃ suragṛha taru parva teṣu sadaneṣu | darśanamupaiti patitaṃ vināśināmeva niyamena || || kumudanibhaḥ kumudākhyo divasaiḥ ṣaḍbhirvipa paścime dṛṣṭaḥ | prāguttaradiśiye śubhadosau kṣīradhāreva || || tāroparimaṇi keturyāmyāyāṃ diśi sakṛddṛṣṭaḥ | udayāstamāna samaye śubhadosau kṣīradāreva || || jaladhārevahi ṛjvinatayā śikhayā pareṇadṛṣṭassaḥ | jalaketurjalasadṛśaḥ subhikṣakaraḥ sarva jaṃtūnāṃ || || harilāṃgūlanibha bhavaḥ ketustukra kacasannibhovāpi | bahuroga bhayaṃ kurute sarpākārastu sarvadā bhavati || || aparopipadma ketuḥ padmanibhaḥ padmagarbha saṃkāśaḥ | kṣemakaro nṛpatīnāṃ subhukṣada sarvajaṃtūnāṃ || || āvarta ketukaparaḥ prādakṣiṇyena dīptimān śuklaḥ | śubhadovyatyaya ketustvatulāmaya bhīti rītikaraḥ || || ākrāmya gaganamakhilaṃ saṃvartākhyā sadhūmanibhā | śūlaprastva tarovāsa keturasakṛdbhayaprado jagataḥ || || śubhadā śuklanibhāye kṛṣṇāstva śubhapradā jagataḥ | ketūnāṃ phalamuktvā vakṣye yadvakrabheṣu jātānāṃ || || aśvinyāṃyadi keturjātastadaśva jīvanaṃ hanyāt | yāmyemleccādhipatiṃ śikhitārāyāṃ kaliṃga kādhipatiṃ || || rohiṇyāmatulabalaṃ nihaṃti ketuśca śūraneneśaṃ | auśī naramukhyapatiṃ saumye raudreca jalajaṃtūn || || aśmakadeśādhi patiṃ tvāditye puṣyabheca magadhapatiṃ | āryādhipatiṃ sarpe pāṃḍyādhi patiṃ ca pitṛdhiṣṇye || || bhāgyarkṣetu ṛṣīṇāṃcottarabhe daṃḍanāyakāṃstvakhilān | hastarkṣe dhanikavaraṃ citrāyāṃ kurubhavāṃ stvakhilān || || kāṃbhoja nṛpati mukhyaṃ prabhaṃjanejāta keturapi | ikṣvākuvaṃśa nāśaṃ dvidaivabhe mitrabheca gauḍeśaṃ || || jyeṣṭhāyāṃ yadijātassaganyate sarvamaṃgalādhīśaṃ | mūle bhadrādipatiṃ jalapati daive kaliṃga delapatiṃ || || ghūrgharikā devasthān hanyādvaiśvādhi diṣṇyajassopi | kekayanādhaṃ hanyācchravaṇakṣye vasubhavokhilān draviḍān || || nau mila nṛpatiṃ hanyācchatibhiṣajastvajāṃghrijaśca pāṃcālān | ahirbudhnyarkṣabhavaḥ saṃkarikān kirātakoṇabhavān || || pauṣṇarkṣa bhavaḥ ketu rdvijanajjana dharmamārgaśtān | abhijinnakṣatra bhavaḥ koṃkaṇadeśe niśācarāṃścāpi || || yeketavaścāśvi mukharkṣajātāstā rāgrahan dikṣvapisaṃbhavāśca | kurvaṃtite tīkṣṇaphalajaṃ nānāmanvesi sāmānya phalapradāssyuḥ || || ādiśabdoddhruva saptarṣyādiṣu | anyepicala ketu gada ketvādayodbutasāgare uktāḥ || || praśnavelave || bhūkaṃpavirghāta rajonipātādā saptarātrādgrahaṇaṃ ravīṃdvoḥ | ulkānipātāḥ pariveṣacāpāḥ syuryatratardeśa nṛpasyanāśaḥ || || yasyāśśikhāsyā śikhidhūmaketoḥ prayātimāmyā muditothaketuḥ | raudrasya śeṣānica yāniyāniteṣāṃ sadeśe nṛpatiṃ nihanyāt || || jyeṣṭhāsthitārkeṇa kuḍenayukto rāhuścanirvāpyudi taśca ketuḥ | tadātadānīṃ bhuvisārvabhaumo rogādraṇādvā labhate praṇāśaṃ || || atraprāgukta koṭihomovā kāryaḥ || iti ketu śāṃtiḥ || a tho lkā di la kṣa ṇa ṃ dāradaḥ - svargacyutānāṃ rūpāṇi yānyulkāstāni vai bhuvi | diṣṇyolkā vidyuda śanitārāḥ paṃcavidhāḥ smṛtāḥ || || pīḍācoṣṭrohi gomāyu khara go gaja daṃṣṭrakāḥ | kapi godhā dhūma nibhāvi vidhāḥ pāpadā nṛṇāṃ || || udayā stamaye rkeṃdvoḥ patitolkā śubhapradā | sitāraktā pītā sitā solkāhaṃti dvijātinaḥ || || rāja rāṣṭra vināśāya prasāda prati māsuca | gṛheṣu svāmināṃ pīḍā nṛpāṇāṃ parvateṣuca || || dikṣu tattaddigīśānāṃ karṣakāṇāṃ khaleṣuca | goṣṭhe go svāmināṃ pīḍā śilpakānāṃ jaleṣuca || || vartu lolkāpuraṃ haṃti chatrākārā purohitaṃ | vaṃśa gulma latākārā rāṣṭra vidrā viṇītathā || || atra prāguptāgargokta tārā vikāra śāṃtiḥ kāryā || atha prati sūryaḥ mayūra citrokti - udīya mānassūryo vedṛśyate prati rūpakaṃ | trīṇyabdā nibhavennāśo māsārdhena saṃśayaḥ || atha pariveṣaḥ - kiraṇāvāyu nihatā ucchrito maṃḍalīkṛtaḥ | nānā varṇākṛtī bhūtaḥ pariveṣaśśaśīnayoḥ || muhurmuhuḥ pralīyaṃte sacapūrṇa phala pradāḥ | aneka vṛtt varṇaśca pariveṣo nṛpāṃtakṛt || dhvimaṃḍalacca mūnādhaṃ nṛpaghnotha trimaṃḍalaḥ | dvaugraho pariveṣasthaukṣitīśa kalahapradau || kurvaṃti kalahā narthaṃ pariveṣa gatāstrayaḥ | catvāraḥ paṃriveṣasthānṛpasya maraṇa pradāḥ | pariveṣa gatāḥ paṃca jagatpraśayadā grahaḥ | nṛvahāviḥ kujādīnāṃ pariveṣaḥ pṛthak ppṛdhak || prāvṛḍḍṛtaucaśaradi pariveṣo jalapradaḥ | prāyeṇānyeṣu ṛtuṣutadukta phaladāyinaḥ || anyatrāpi || ravi śaśi pariveṣe pūrvayāmeca pīḍā ravi śaśi pariveṣe madhyamecāti vṛṣṭiḥ | ravi śaśi pariveṣe dhānyanāśa stṛtīye | ravi śaśi pariveṣe rājya nāśaśca turthe || atha graha yuddhaṃ - adbhuta sāgare gargaḥ - chādanaṃ rodhanaṃcaiva raśmirodhana tathaivaca | apanavyaṃ grahaṇāṃca caturthā yuddhamucyate | etanneṃdu sūryayoḥ | kiṃtvanyeṣāṃ || tārāgrahaṇāṃ paṃcānāṃ yuddānyuktāni yogata ityukteḥ || tathā || grāho grahaṃ samāgamya śyāmobhavatiyo bhṛśaṃ | hāniṃ prāpnotica vyaktaṃ syaṃdateca muhurmuhuḥ || tatphalaṃ nistarabhayānnocyate || nāradaḥ - nānāvarṇāṃśavobhāso sābhravāyu vighaṭṭitaḥ | tadvyomnicaiva saṃsthāna miṃdracāpaṃ pradṛśyate || athavāśeṣa nāgeṃdra dīrghaviśvāsa saṃbhavaṃ || vidikṣujaṃ diśi vṛṣṭyāma vṛṣṭidaṃ | apanīgāḍha macchinnaṃ pratikūlaṃ dhanurdvayaṃ || nṛpāṃtakṛdyadibha vedānukūlyetu taccubhaṃ | atra śāṃtyaniktau gargakta śāṃtirvakṣyate || atha ṣaḍgrahādiyoga tatpala śāṃtiḥ madanaratne brahmayāmale - adhātassaṃpravakṣyāmi grahayogasya śāṃtikaṃ | amāvāsyādi tathima graha yogobhavedyadi | ekarkṣebhinnarālauvāpyeka rāśyarkṣa bhedane || śaśi sūrya samāyukte grahatraya samanvite | durbhikṣaudi bhayaṃcaiva caturgraha samanvite || mahāroga bhayaṃ rāṣṭrakṣayo vṛṣṭi vināśanaṃ | paṃcagraha samāyoge durbhikṣaṃ saṃkarādikaṃ || nṛsaveraṃ garbhanāśo jāyate jananāśanaṃ | graha ṣaṭka samāyoge maṃtriṇāṃ maraṇaṃ bhavet || paśvaśvādi bhayaṃ sarvaṃ saṃkarādi jana kṣayaḥ | paṭṭarājño vānāśo vāmaha bhaya madhāpivā || saptagraha samāyogekṣitīśa maraṇaṃ dṛvaṃ | jagatpralaya mevāpi tadā nirmānuṣaṃ jagat || ata ūrthvaṃ mahotpāto nānāduḥkha manākulaṃ | sūryastadvyatiriktaśce ttadāyogo mahadbhutaṃ || vinā caṃdreṇayogopi jagatpraṇayakāraṇaṃ | tadṛkṣajāta jaṃtūnāṃ mahārogo mahābhayaṃ | arthanāśaḥ sthānanāśo mānahanirmupīḍanaṃ | vātapi ttādi saṃbhūta mahāpīḍā mahābhayaṃ || samayogo gṛhānnrūṇāṃ doṣān kurvaṃti sarvadā || ṣaḍvāsābhyaṃtare vāpi ayurhaviḥ śriyastadhā | janmāṣṭadvādaśerāśau caturdhe paṃcamepivā || pūrvoktaphalamevā tratasyā śśāṃtiṃ prayatnataḥ | kuryāddoṣānusāreṇa vittaśāṭhyaṃ nakārayet || tattadgrahakṛtiṃ kṛtvā sauvarṇena prayatnataḥ | palaikena tadarthena pādenāpi kanīyasā || vittaśāṭhyaṃ nakartavyaṃ śaktitonaraiḥ | pūrvoktalakṣaṇaṃ naiva gṛhīmūrtiṃ ca kārayet | grahasyaikaika kalaśaṃ grahayogapramāṇataḥ | kārayetkuṃbhamekaṃvā nirvaṇaṃ sudṛḍaṃnavaṃ || grahasyeśāna digbhāge śuddhadeśe samasthale | kuṃḍevā sthaṃḍilevāpi homaṃ kuryādvidhānataḥ || tasya pūrvottaredeśe parvāsthānaṃ prakalpayet || caturaśraṃ hastamātraṃ sthaṃḍilaṃ taṃjulenatu || likhedgrahākṛtiṃ tatra sthāpaye tpratimāṃ thathaḥ | adhipratyādhidevoca dakṣiṇottarataḥ kṣipet || uktagaṃdhai stadā puṣpai satattanmaṃtraiḥ prakalpayot | tattadgraho ktamaṃtreṇa pūrvoktainaivapūjayet || svasti vācana pūrveṇa ācāryān dṛtvijai ssaha | grahapūjādikaṃ kṛtvā nai vedyaṃtu samarpayet || tato homaṃ prakurvīta svagṛhyoktavidhānataḥ | caturdhyaṃtaṃ prakurvīta kalaśasthāpanaṃ tataḥ || pūrvoktavidhānena śuddhatoyena pūrayet | paṃcāmṛtaṃ paṃca gavyaṃ paṃcatva kpaṃcapallavān || tattanmaṃtreṇa vinyasyajauṣadhāni vinikṣipet | tattadgraho ktavidinā mūlānyādāya nikṣipet || abliṃgairvāguṇairvāsi kalaśaṃ pūrayodguruḥ | tattadgraho ktavidhinā tattanmaṃtrairhunedatha || catvājyai rjuhuyātpaścā tilāhuti yathācaret | atha sviṣṭakṛtaṃ hutvā homaśeṣaṃ namāpayet || bhadrāsanopaviṣṭasya yajamānasya ṛtvijaḥ | kalaśasthodakenaiva mabhiṣekaṃ samācaret || yogagraho ktamaṃtraiśca ādhipratyadhimaṃtrataḥ | navagraho ktamaṃtraiśca jātavedādi paṃcakaiḥ || triyaṃbakeneti maṃtreṇa kṣetrasyapatinastadhā | yata iṃdra bhayenaiva lokapālāṣṭatakairapi || sūrāstvā miti maṃtreṇa yena devādayaḥ kramāt | anyaiśca puṇyamāktaiśca abhiṣekaṃ samācaret || abhi ṣekaṃplutaṃ vastra mācāryāya nivedayet | tata śuklāṃ baradharaḥ kuryādājyāvalokanaṃ | ṛtvik‌bhyo dakṣiṇaṃ dadyāddhenuśaṃkhādi kānapi | tadabhāse yadhāśakti hiraṇyamapidāpayet || brahmaṇānbhojaye dpaścā dyadhāvibhava sārataḥ | evaṃ yaḥ kurutebhaktyā grahadoṣa vivarjitaḥ | pūrvokta sardoṣaiśca vimuktaḥ putravān sukhī | āyuraiśvarya saṃpanno jīvedvarṣa śataṃ varaḥ | ihaloke sukhībhūtvā paścāccivapuraṃ vrajet || iti madanaratne ṣaḍgrahayoga śāṃtiḥ || atha bhūmikaṃpa phala, tacchāntiśca bhūbhārakhinnanāgeṃdra śeṣaviśrāma saṃbhavaḥ | bhūkaṃpassopijaga tāma śubhāya bhavetsadā || nāradaḥ - yāmakrameṇa bhūkaṃpo dvijātīnā maniṣṭadaḥ | rātrau viśāṃkṣitī śānāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ saṃdhyayorapi | aryamādyāni catvāricasreṃdva ditibhānica | vāyavyamaṃḍalaṃtve datasminkaṃpo bhavedyadi | nṛpaśca paṇijaścaiva śilphivṛṣṭi vināśadaḥ | puṣyadvidaiva bharaṇī pikṛbhāgyāḍapāgnibhaṃ | āgneyaṃ ṃḍalaṃtve tadasminkaṃpobhavedyadi | rājanāśāya rogāya haṃtimārjāra uṃdurān | mūlāhi rbudhnya varuṇa pauṣṇīṃdrāṇyahibhānitu || vāruṇaṃ maṃḍalaṃtve tadasminkaṃpobhavedyadi | rāja nāśakarāhaṃti pauṃḍracīna puliṃdakān || nṛpavṛṣṭyarthanāśāya haṃti srāvaka saṃkarān | abhijiddhādṛ vaiśvaṃdra masu vaiṣṇavamitrabhaṃ || vāsavaṃ maṃḍalaṃtve tadasminkaṃpobhavedyadi | prāyeṇa nikhilotphātāt kṣitīśānā maniṣṭadaḥ || ṣaḍbhirmānaiśca bhukaṃpodvābhyāṃdāha phalapradaḥ | anuktāḥ paṃcabhirmānai stadānīṃ phaladaṃraja || nidānaṃ māmakaślokaṃ - kecidikkadi kuṃbha cānalabhavaṃ vātābhighātodbhavaṃ | kecinnīradhivīci dolanabhavaṃ tanmīnajātaṃ vare | bhūkaṃpaṃ bruvatevayaṃ hariguṇaśreṇi | samākarṣaṇa prodyadvarṣa phaṇīdrakaṃpita śiraśrśeṇībhavaṃ brūmahe || mūlaṃtu vārāhyaṃ jñeyaṃ | tatraiva | pradhitanareśvara maraṇaṃ vyasanānyāgneya vāyumaṃḍalayoḥ | kṣudbhayakarakāvṛṣṭi bhirupatapyaṃte janāścaiva || vāruṇa pauraṃdaryo ssubikṣa śivavṛṣṭihārdayo loke | gāvoti bhūripayaso nivṛttavairāścha bhūpālāḥ || pakṣeśca ścaturbiṃravila strī bhiragnirdevarāṭe ca saptāhān | sadyaḥ phalatica varuṇoyeṣu nakālodbhūte ṣūktaḥ || tricaturthe ptadine māse pakṣe tathā tripakṣevā | yadi bhavati ca bhūkaṃpaḥ pradhāna nṛpanāśako bhavati || atra pūrvokta lakṣahomaḥ koṭi homevā kāryaḥ || iti bhūkaṃpaḥ || arathajaḥ - nāradaḥ - site narajasācchannādi grāma vana parvatāḥ | yadātadā bhavaṃtye teni dhanaṃ yāṃti bhūmipāḥ || bhūmodbhavastu yasyāṃ vaitasyāṃ diśi vināśanaṃ | ṛtāvasyatra śiśirāsatsaṃ pūrṇa phaladaṃ rajaḥ || iti rajaḥ || atha digdāhaḥ - bṛhaspatiḥ - yadāstamita ādatye vahnijvālā pradṛśyate | diśāṃ dāhaṃtutaṃ vidyāditi bhārgavabhāṣitaṃ || adbhutasāgare nāradaḥ - digdāhaḥ pītavarṇaśce tkṣitīśānāṃ bhayapradaḥ || adbhutasāgare mayūrajitre | tilairdūrvādibhiścaiva jauduṃdarayavaistathā || dhānyairauduṃbarībhiśca śrīphalai rāhutikriyā | samāptau bhojanaṃ kṛtvā nara prekṣaṇamā diśet || vyoma madhyagataṃpaśyedyadi sūryabhayaṃ naraḥ | dadhi kṣāra ghṛtāktānāṃ juhuyādayutaṃ śuciḥ || uṣoṣyārkasamiddhomaṃ dhenuṃ dadyāddhvijātaye || athādbhuta phalakālaḥ adbhutasāgare parāśaraḥ - tatrotpāta phalaṃ divyaṃ pūrṇe varṣe vipaccate | aṃtarikṣaṃ tathā bhaumaṃ māsaiṣṭaḍbhiścata nṛbhiḥ || nirghātastu tribhirmāsai rgaṃdharva nagarāṇica | agniścasaptarātreṇa māse nolkāvi paccate || puracaityādi bhaṃgeṣu purasaṃkramaṇeṣuca | puradhvajādi bhaṃgeṣu phalaṃ māsā dvipacyate || ariṣṭaṃ paricyate ṣaṭsumāseṣu phalahetuṣu | atiharoṣati śokaśca sadya evavipacyate || kīṭamūṣaka sarpāṇāṃ mākṣikādiṣu yatphalaṃ | pacyate taddvimāsena madhu sapta supacyate || hayānāṃ hastināṃ caiva śakunaṃca śunastathā | sadṛstryahādvaniyata mulūkasyata thaivacaḥ || videhavāke saṃśravaṇaṃ darśanaṃ yakṣa rakṣasāṃ | paśūnāṃ vikṛtaṃ yacca ṣṭhaṣemāsi vipacyate || māṃsaṃ taila vikāreṣu dehaṃga syaṃda neṣuca| vastrajāti vikāreṣu phalaṃ syātsaptamehani || citra karmaṇi māsābhyāṃ śayane ṣaṣṭha māsikaṃ | valmīke ṣaṭsumāseṣu kṣayovṛddau tathātriṣu || jayo chrayeṣu bhagneṣu yajña karṇaṇi vaikṛte | somadhvaja vikāreca vikāra ssaptamāsikaḥ || taṃtubīje vikāreṣu rājñaḥ śastreṣu jṛṃbhaṇe || padmotpala phalādīnāṃ paliṣāṇmāṣikaṃ bhavet || vināśe viphalaṃteṣāṃ pākakāleni vartate || gargaḥ - pakṣādvāpāka sūryasya pākaspomasya māsikaḥ | māsadvayesmṛtorāho strībhirmānaistu kai tavaḥ | saṃvatsara vipākautu jñeyau budhabṛhaspatī || ṣāṇmāsikaścauśasa sassūryajasyatu paṃcabhiḥ | tribhirmāsaistu bhaumasya ulkāpātastu māsikaḥ | aṣṭabhirbhūmikaṃpastu nirghātaḥ pacyate tribhiḥ | anārtavaṃ puṣpaphalaṃ ṣabhirmāsairvipacyate || pakṣikīṭa pataṃgānāṃ daśāhātphala mādiśet | ghṛtataila vasāvarṣe sadyaḥ phala mudāhṛtaṃ || rātrā viṃdra dhanu dhṛṣṭvā rājñaśśīla viparyayaḥ || vānarāṇāṃ narāṇāṃca tadhaiva gajavājināṃ | nānāvādi traśabdānāṃ phalaṃ māsādvipacyate | gṛdhra gomāyu siṃhānāṃ phalaṃ māsā dvipacyate || biḍālana kulānāṃ ca varāha vyāghrayostadā | śrutvā tariṃkṣe śabdaṃtu phalaṃ māsādvipacyate || adbhuta sāgare parāśaraḥ || rājñaśśarīre lokeca puradāra purohite | pāka māyā titatreṣu tathākośeca vāhane || māts - adbhutetusamutapanneya divṛṣṭiśśivā bhavet | saptāhābhyaṃtarejñeya madbhutaṃ niṣphalaṃtutat || tatrasāmyānena nmadhye kuṃḍaṃkāryaṃ samaṃ tataḥ || khātaṃhastaiśca rbiścava pratyaya samanvitaṃ || ṣaḍaṃgu lonnatatastvādyodvā daśāṃgula vistṛtaḥ | adyā athāmekhalā - aṃgulaṃca yothāśṛ tamevanatu kuṃḍaṃ |
