vṛddhyūrdhvataraṇaṃplavāḥ | saraṇaṃcādrigrehānāṃ varṣāsuna bhayāvahaṃ || divyastrī bhūtagaṃdharva vimānādbhuta darśanaṃ | grahanakṣatra tārāṇāṃ darśanaṃ ca divāṃbare || gītāvāditranirghoṣā vanaparvata sanuṣu | sasyavṛddhirapāṃhani rapāpāḥśara dismṛtāḥ || śītānilatuṣāratvaṃ nardanaṃ mṛgapakṣiṇāṃ | rakṣo yakṣodisatvānāṃ darśanaṃ vāgamānuṣī || diśo dhūmāṃdhakāraśca sanabhovanaparvatāḥ | uccaiḥ sūryodayāstauca hemaṃte śobhanāḥ smṛtāḥ || himavātānilotpātā virūpādbhutadarśanaṃ | kṛṣṇāṃjanābha mākāśaṃ tārolkāpātapijaraṃ || citragarbodbhavāḥstrīṣu gojāśva mṛgapakṣiṣu | patrāṃ kuralatānāḥ ca vikārāḥ śiśireśubhāḥ || ṛtusvabhāvajāhyete dṛ,ṭāḥsvartau śubhapradāḥ | ṛtoranayatracotpātā dṛṣṭāsaicāti dāruṇāḥ || unmattānāṃ ca yagāthāḥ śiśūnāṃbhāṣitaṃcayet | sriyoyacca prabhāṣaṃte tasyanāsti vyatikramaḥ || pūrvaṃca ratideṣu paścādgacchati mānuṣān | nācoditāvāgvadati satyāhyeṣā sarasvatī || utpātān gaṇitavarjitopi budhvā vikhyāto bhavati nareṃdravallabhaśca | etattanmunivacanaṃ rahasyamuktaṃ yatjñātvā bhavati narastrikāladarśī || iti vārāhyānānotpāta śāṃtayaḥ || madanaratne garga uvāca - puruṣāpacārā niyata maparajyaṃti devatāḥ | aparāgāccadevānā mupasargaḥ pravartate | divyāṃtarikṣa bhaumaṃca trividhaṃ parikīrtitaṃ || graharkṣa vaikṛtaṃ divyamāṃtarikṣe nibodhame | ulkāpoto diśāṃ dāhaḥ pariveṣastadhaivaca || gaṃdharva nagaraṃcaiva vṛṣṭiśca vikṛtācayā | ऎvamādituleke sminnāṃta rikṣaṃ vinirdiśet || carasthira bhavaṃ bhaumaṃ bhūkaṃpāścaiva bhūmijaṃ | jalāśayānāṃ vaikṛtyaṃca bhaumaṃca parikīrtitaṃ || bhaume bahu phalaṃ jñayaṃ cireṇaca vipacyate | abhrajaṃ madhya phaladaṃ madhyakāla phala pradaṃ || ābhrajamāṃta rikṣaṃ - adbhutetu samutpanne yadi vṛṣṭiśśivā bhavet | saptāhābhyaṃtare jñeyaṃ madbhutaṃ naṣpalaṃhitat || adbhutaśca vipakaśca vināśādyāna dṛśyate | tribhirvarṣai stadhājñeyaṃ sumahadbhaya kārakaṃ || rājñāṃ śarīre lokecapure dāragṛhe tathā | pākamāyāti putreṣu tathā vaikośe vāhane || ṛtu svabhāvā rājeṃdra bhavaṃ tyadbhuta saṃjñitāḥ | śubhāva haste vijñeyāstāṃ ścamevadataḥ śruṇuḥ | vajrā śani mahīkaṃ pasaṃdhyā nirghāta nisvanāḥ || pariveṣo rajo dhūma raktārka sumanādayaḥ | drumebhinnara sassneho bahu sasya phalodgamaḥ || go pakṣi maṃda vṛddhiścha śubhāni madhu mādhave | tārolkāpāta kaluṣaṃ kapilārkeṃdu maṃḍalaṃ || anagni jvala nāsphoṭa dhūma evani lāhataḥ | rakta padmāruṇaṃ sāṃdhyāṃ nabhaḥ kṣubdārṇavopamaḥ || saritāmaṃbu saṃśoṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā grīṣm śubhaṃ vadet | śakrāyudhaṃ parīveṣo guru śukra virohaṇaṃ | kaṃpodvartana vai kṛtyaṃ hrasanaṃdaraṇaṃ kṣiteḥ || navoda pāna sarasāṃ vṛddhvārdhva taruṇa plavaḥ | śīrṇānicā virohīṇāṃ varṣā suśubha muṣyate | śītānale tuṣāratvaṃ nardanaṃ mṛgapakṣiṇāṃ | rakṣo yakṣa piśācānāṃ darśanaṃ vāgamānuṣī || diśo dhūmāṃ dhakāraśca sanabhovana parvataḥ | uccaiḥ sūryodayāstauca hemaṃte śobhanāḥ smṛtāḥ || divya strīrūpa gaṃdharva vimānādbhuta darśanaṃ | graha nakṣatra tārāṇāṃ darśanaṃvāga mānuṣī || gītavāditra nirghoṣo vana parvata sānuṣu | navyavṛddhi rasotpāte śaratkāle rasāssmṛtāḥ || himotpātā nilotpātā virūpādbhuta darśanaṃ | kṛṣṇāṃjanābha mākāśaṃ tārolkā pātā piṃjare || citra gabhodbhavaḥ sthrīṣu gojāśva mṛga pakṣiṣu | patrāṃ kuralatānāṃca vikārāśśiśire śubhāḥ || ṛtusvabhāve savinādbhutasya jātasya duṣṭanasyatu śīghrameva | śrutvāgamaṃśāṃti ranaṃtaraṃtu kārtyāya dhoktā vasudhādipena || garga uvāca - devatārcāḥ pranṛtyaṃti vepaṃt prajvalaṃtivā | ārohaṃtica rohaṃti prasvidaṃtiha saṃtica | uttiṣṭaṃti niṣīdaṃti prathāvaṃtiva maṃtica | bhajaṃti vikṛtā ceṣṭā mānuṣāṇāṃ bhayāpahāḥ || aāṅmukhāvātiṣṭhaṃti sthānātthsānaṃ bhramaṃtica | vamatyagniṃ tathā dhūmaṃ snehaṃ raktaṃ tathāvasāṃ || evamādīni dṛśyaṃte vikārā ssahajotthitaḥ | liṃgāyatana citraṣu tatravāsaṃ narocayet || rājñovā vyasanaṃ tatra sacadeśo vinaśyati | devayātrā sucotpātān dṛṣṭvāvaśyaṃ bhayaṃvadet || yātrā saṃbaṃdinaḥ śakaṭākṣa dhvajabaṃgādaya ityardaḥ | paśūnāṃ rudrajaṃjñeyaṃ nṛpāāṃ lokapālajaṃ | rudrajaṃ tpratimābhaṃgo paśubhayada mityardhyaṃ || evaṃ sarvatra jñeyaḥ - senāpatīnāṃ nāśaṃsyā tksaṃdajaṃ ca viśākhajaṃ | lokānāṃ viṣṇu vasviṃdra viśvakarma samudbhavaṃ || vināyakodbhavaṃ jñeyaṃ gaṇānāṃ sevakāyavā | devadūtecayāḥ preṣyā devāḥ strīṣunṛpastriyaḥ || vāsudeveṣu vijñeyaṃ gṛhāṇāmevanānyadhā | devatārca vikāreṣu śucisnātaḥ purohitaḥ || devatārcāṃtugatvāvai snātāmācchādya pūjayet | madhuparkeṇa vidhiva dupaṣṭhe danaṃtaraṃ || talliṃgena ca maṃtreṇa sthālīpāka yathāvidhi | pūrodhā juhuyādvahau saptarātra mataṃdritaḥ || viprāśca pūjyā madhurānna pānaiḥ sadakṣiṇaiḥ saptadinaṃ nareṃdraiḥ | prāpaiṣṭamhnikṣiti gopradānai ssaṃkācanaiḥ śāṃtimupaiti pāpaṃ || iti deva pratimāvaikṛti śāṃtiḥ || garga uvāca - agniḥ pradīpyate yatrarāṣṭrai bhṛśamaniṃ dhanaḥ | nadīpyate ceṃdhanavāṃ stadrāṣṭaṃ pīḍyate nṛpa || jaledārdraśca vahnirvā tadhādrānaṃ mṛdhāsuvā | prāsādaṃ toraṇaṃ dvāraṃ nṛpaveśmasurālayaṃ || etāni yatra dahyaṃte tatra rājabhayaṃ vadet | vidyutāvā pradahyaṃte tatrāpi nṛpatebhayaṃ || anai śānitamāṃ syarchirvināpāṃ surajāṃsica | dhūmaścāgnijo yatra tatra vidyānmahābhayaṃ || taṭidvānābhraṃ gaganebhayaṃ syādvṛṣṭi varjite | devāsa tāre gagane tadaiva bhayamādiśet || lohāyudha vikārassyā ttatrasaṃgrāma mādiśet | trirātro poṣita statra purodhāssu samāhitaḥ || samadbhiḥ kṣīravṛkṣāṇāṃ sarṣapaiśca ghṛtenaca | homaṃ kuryādigni maṃtrai rbrāhmaṇāṃścaiva bhojayet || dadyātsu varṇaṃca tathā dvijebhyogāṃścaiva vastrāṇi tathābhavaṃti | evaṃ kṛte tatsamupaiti nāśaṃ yadagnivaikṛtvā bhavaṃ dvijeṃdra || ityagnivaikṛta śāṃtiḥ || garga uvāca - pureṣuyeca dṛśyaṃte pādapādaiva coditāḥ | rudaṃto vāhā naṃtovā vamaṃto vārasābhuvi || rudaṃto vyādhirabhyoti vasaṃto deśa vibhramaḥ | śākhābhrapatāne kuryāt saṃgrame yodhapātanaṃ || bālānāṃ maraṇaṃ kuryādbālānāṃ phala puṣpataḥ | svarāṣṭrabhedaṃ kurute phalaṃ puṣpa manārtavaṃ || kṣiraṃ sarvatra gaṃbhīraṃ snehaṃ durbhikṣa lakṣaṇaṃ | vāhanā pacayaṃmadhye rakto saṃgrāma māniśet || madhuprāve dvyādhirjala prāveca varṣati | āroga śoṣaṇaṃ jñeyaṃ brahma durbhikṣa lakṣaṇaṃ || śuṣkeṣu saṃprarohatyu vīrya mannaṃca hrīyate | utthāne patitānāṃca bhayaṃbheda karaṃbhavet || sthānātthsāneṣu gamane deśa bhaṃgaṃ tathādiśet | jalpatsvapica vṛkṣeṣu svanatsvapi dhanakṣayaḥ || etatpūjita vṛkṣeṣu sarvarājño vipacyate | puṣpaiḥ phalai rvāvikṛte rājñāṃ mṛtyuṃ tathādiśet || ānyeṣu caiva vṛkṣeṣu vṛkṣotpāteṣva taṃdritaḥ | āccādayitvātaṃ vṛkṣaṃ gaṃdhamālyairvi bhūṣayet || vṛkṣoparitathā chatraṃ kuryātpāpa praśāṃtaye | kecittu vṛkṣotpāte vṛkṣacchedana mahustadetadviro dhācchiṃtyaṃ || śivamabhyarcaye ddhevaṃ paśuṃ cāsmai nivedayet | ebhya iti rudrebhyaḥ hatvā rudraṃ japettataḥ || madvāṭya yuktenatu pāyasena saṃpūjya viprāṃśca bhavaṃca dadyāt | gīte nanṛtyena tathārcayettaṃ devaṃ haraṃ pāpa vināśaheto || iti vṛkṣa vaikṛta śāṃtiḥ || atha kadalī duṣṭaprasava śāṃtiḥ u mo vā ca - prathama prasave devaraṃbhāyā dṛśyateyadā | dakṣiṇābhimukho vidvān vividāni phalaṃnahi || bhūpāle karṣakecāpi phalaṃ kasmiṃ stujāyate | śrī mahādeva uvāca - yadā yāmyamukhā devī kadalītu prasūyate | tadā gramapate rnāśaṃ vidadhāti nasaṃśayaḥ || evaṃ viphrasamutpanne vidhānaṃ tatrakārayet || sūtakīcopa sarpāsā kadalīhīna micchata | tarśetu jāgaraṃ kṛtvā homaḥkāryastataḥ paraṃ || ṛṅmaṃtrairhavanaṃ kāryaṃ vaiṣṇavai ssamudāhṛtaiḥ | sahasraṃ japatovāgmī japaṃ śāṃti ranekaśaḥ || viṣṇustu devatā tatra talliṃgo maṃtra ucyate | viprebhya ssaptadhānyāni deyāni vividānica || dadyāttāṃ kadalīṃ rājā vipravaryāya dhīmate || evaṃ kṛtavidhāne ca vipraśāṃti stujāyet | pūjite vipravaryeca kartā sukhamavāpnuyāt || iti kadalī duṣṭaprasava śāṃtiḥ || atha vṛṣṭivaikṛta śāṃtiḥ garga uvāca - ativṛṣṭi ranāvṛṣṭi rdurbhikṣādau bhayaṃ tataḥ | anṛtau tudivānaṃtā vṛṣṭirvayādhi bhayāyatu || anabhravaikaścaiva vijñeyā rājahiṃsakāḥ || vaikṛtāgarjitādayaḥ || śītoṣṇānāṃ viparyāse ṛtūnāṃ ripujaṃ bhayaṃ - śoṇitaṃ varṣateyatra tatra śastra bhayaṃ bhavet | phalaṃ puṣpaṃ tadhādhyāna pariṇāti bhayāyatu | pāṃsu jaṃtu phalānāṃca varṣaṇe rogajaṃ bhayaṃ || chidraṃvānna pravarṣeṇa sasyānamativardanaṃ | virajaskara vaivyabhreyadācchāyāna dṛśyate || dṛśyatetu pratīpāvā tatradeśa bhayaṃ bhavet | pratīpā pratikūlacchāyā vivarītacchāyotyardhaḥ || satataṃ varṣete yatra tatra śatṛ bhayaṃ bhavet | nirabhreva tathā rātrau śvetaṃ yāmyottareṇatu || iṃdrāyudhaṃ tathā dhṛṣṭvā ulkotpātaṃ tathaivaca | digdāha paripeṣauca gaṃdharva nagaraṃ tathā || paracakra bhayaṃ viṃdyādḍeśopadrava mevaca | digdāha pariveṣauca gaṃdharva nagaraṃ tathā || dhānyāni go kāṃcana dakṣiṇāśca deyāddvijā nāma dhanāśaheto || iti vṛṣṭyagi vaikata śāṃtiḥ || atha jalāśaya vaikṛta śāṃtiḥ garga uvāca - nagarādapa sarpaṃte samīpa uvayāṃtica| nadyonada prasravaṇā nirasrāvai bhavaṃtivā || vivarṇaṃ kaluṣaṃ taptaṃ ṣenāvartāti saṃkulaṃ | kṣīrasneha surāraktaṃ vahaṃti vyākulodakaṃ || kṣāṇmāsābhyaṃtare tatra paracakra bhayaṃ viduḥ | jalāśayānitenaiva prajvalaṃti kataṃcana || vimuṃcati tadhā brahmanā jvālā dhūmaṃ rajāṃsica | akhātevā jalotpatti ssasatvāvā jalāśayāḥ || saṃgīta śabdā ḍṛśyaṃte janamṛtyu bhayaṃ viduḥ | divyaṃ mahābhayaṃ viddhi madhu mātrāvasecanaṃ || japtavyā vāruṇā maṃtrāstaiśca home jale bhavet | madhvājya yuktaṃ paramānna matra deyaṃ dvijānā madha bhojanārthaṃ | gāvaścha deyāsita vastra yuktāstathoca kuṃbhāḥ sakalāghaśāṃtyai || iti jalāśaya vaikṛta śāṃtiḥ || atha yānādyupaskara vaikṛta śāṃtiḥ gargaḥ uvāca - yāṃtiyā nānya yuktāni yuktānyaṃ visayāticet | codyamānāni tatrasyā nmadbhaya mupasdhitaṃ || vādyamānāna vādyaṃte vādyaṃte vāpya nāhatāḥ | acalāśca calaṃtevāca lālcaiva calaṃtina || ākāśe tūrya nādaśca gīta gaṃdharva nisvanaḥ | kāṣṭadarvī kuṭhārādi vikāraṃ kuruteyadi || lāṃgalaṃ śūla saṃghāśca striyaḥ strīvāpi ghātayot | upaskarādi vikṛto ghoraṃ śastraṃ bhayaṃ bhavet || vāyoścapūjāṃ dvija saktubhiśca kṛtvāni yuktāṃśca japecca maṃtrān | dadyātrpabhūtaṃ paramānna matra sadakṣiṇaṃte naśamosya bhūyat || iti upaskara vai kṛta śāṃtiḥ || atha mṛgapakṣivaikṛta śāṃtiḥ garga uvāca - prativiṃśati yadhā grāmānāraṇyā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ | araṇyaṃ yāṃtivā grāmyāḥ sthalaṃyāṃti jalodbhavāḥ || sthalajāvā jalaṃ yāṃti ghorā vāsaṃtinirbhayāḥ | rājadvāre puradvāre śivāścāpya śivapradāḥ || divā rātriṃcarāvāpi rātrauvāpi divācarāḥ | grāmyāstyajaṃti gramaṃvā śūnyatāṃ tasyanirdiśet || dīptaṃ vāsaṃti saṃdhyā samaṃḍalānica kuryate | vādyaṃteni sarvaṃ yatra tadāpye tatpalaṃ labhet || pradoṣe kukkuṭovāse hemaṃte vāpi kokilaḥ | arkodayorkābhimukhī śivārauti bhayaṃ diśet || grahe kapotaḥ praviśetkra vyādho mūrdhnicāpatet | madhuvāmakṣikā kuryāt mṛtyurgehapate rbhavet || prākāradvārageheṣu toraṇāpaṇa vīdhiṣu | kecicchatrāyudhādyeṣu kravyāda ssaṃśrayedyadi || jāyate nātha valmīkī madhuvāsyaṃdateyadi | sadeśo nāśamāyāti rājā camriyate tadā || mūṣakān śalabhān dṛṣṭvā prabhūtaṃ kṣudbhayaṃ bhavet | kāṣṭholmukāsthi śṛṃgāḍhyāḥ śvānamarkaṭa vedanāḥ || durbhikṣa vedanājñeyāḥ kākādhyānamukhāyadi | janānabhi bhavaṃtaśca nirbhayāraṇya vedinaḥ || kāko maidhunayuktaśca śvetastu paridṛśyate | rājānāmriyate tatra sadeśovā vinaśyāti || ulūkovāsyate yatra nṛpadvāre tathā gṛhe | jñeyā gṛhapatermutyuḥ dhananāśa stadhaivaca | mṛgapikṣi vikāreṣu kuryāddhomaṃ sadakṣiṇaṃ || devāḥ kapota itica japtavyāḥ paṃcabhirdvijaiḥ | sudeva iticaikena deyāgāvaśca dakṣiṇāḥ || japeccha kuṃtasūktaṃca samo vedaśirāṃsica | maṃtrā ṛgvede prasiddhāḥ namo brahmaṇa iti || vedaśirāṃsi upaniṣadaḥ gāvaścadeyāvidhiva | ddvijānāṃ sakāṃcanā vastrayuto ttarīyāḥ || evaṃ kṛte śāṃti mupaiti pāpaṃ mṛgairdvijauvān pi niveditaṃyat || iti mṛgapakṣivaikṛta śāṃtiḥ || atha mātsyoktādbhuta śāṃtiḥ garga uvāca - prāsādatoraṇadvāra dvāra prākāraveśmasu | animittakaṃtu patanaṃ dṛḍhanāṃ rāḍamṛtyave || rājasāvāthathūmena diśo yatra samākulaḥ | ādityaścaṃdratārāśca vivarṇābhayavṛddhaye || rākṣasā yatra dṛśyaṃte brāhmaṇāścavidharmiṇaḥ | ṛtavaśca viparyastā apūjya pūjyatejanaiḥ || nakṣatrāṇi viyogīni tanmahadbhayalakṣaṇaṃ | ketudayo parāgauca chidraṃvā śaśi sūryayoḥ || graharkṣa vikṛtiryatra tatrāpi bhayamādiśet | strīyaśca kalahaṃyaṃte bālānighnaṃti bālakān || kriyāṇā mucitānāṃca viccittiryatra dṛśyate | hūya mānastu yatrāgni rdīpyatenaca śāṃtiṣu || kravyādā vāya sāyatra yāṃti cottara tastathā | pūrṇa kuṃbhāḥ sravaṃte vāhavirvā vipralupyate || māṃgalya dhvanayoryatrana śrūyaṃte samaṃtataḥ | kṣavathurbādhate vātha protsāh satinardataḥ || nacadveṣu varteta yathāvā brāhmaṇeṣuca | vedaghoṣāṇi vādyāni vādyaṃte vistarāṇivā || gurumitra dviṣoyatra śatrupūjā ratā sadā | brāhmaṇaścha suhṛnmānnayo janoyatrāva manyate || śāṃti maṃgala homeṣu nāstikyaṃ yatramanyate | rājānāmriyate tatrāsthavādeśo vinaśyati || rājñe vināśe saṃprāste nimittāni nijothame | brāhmaṇān prathamedveṣṭi brāhmaṇāṃśca viniṃdati || brāhmaṇasvāni cādatte brāhmaṇāṃśca jighāṃsati | naitān smarati kṛtyeṣu yānitaśca prakupyati || ramate niṃdayāteṣāṃ praśaṃsānābhi naṃdati | āpūrvaṃ duṣkaraṃ lobhaṃ tathā sāta yatidvije || gāvaścadeyā dvijapaṃga vebhyo bhuvaṃ tathā kāṃcana maṃbarāṇi | homaścakāryo dvijayajñaye tadevaṃ kṛte śāṃti mupaiti pāpaṃ|| adbhutetu samutpanne yadivṛṣṭi śśivā bhavat | saptāhabhyaṃtare jñeya madbhutaṃ niṣpalaṃ hitat || iti matsyoktādbhuta śāṃtiḥ || atha nānotpāta śāṃtiḥ madanaratne gargaḥ - autpātikāṃ mahāśāṃtiṃ tatvataḥ śṛṇumedhunā | yatravyādhi ranāvṛ,ṭiḥ paracakra mupasthitaṃ || durbhikṣaṃ janamṛtyuvān rūjño maraṇamevaca | tatra śāṃti kramaḥ prokto mahākratumihārabhet | punarhomaścakartavyobṛhaspatimataṃ yadhā || gāvastadhaivadātavyāstadhai vāyurvivardinī | rājñobhiṣekaṃ kurvīta tadhaivacasa ṛtvijaḥ || trirātraṃ saptarātraṃvā upoṣṭaca purohitaḥ | audaṃbarīṇāṃ vidhivatsamidhāṃca śataṃ dahet || brāhmaṇā nbojayettatra hutāṃ te bhūridakṣiṇā | yavānāṃ homayedroṇān ghṛtāktānāṃ tathaivaca || dvijaiḥ ghṛtādṛḍaṃdadyā dyāvacchāṃtirbhaviṣyati | rājñaḥ kulepradhānevā ghṛtadroṇāṃ vidhīyate || vṛṣabhai kādaśāgāśca viprebhyaḥ pratipādayet | kuleyasya sarohaṃti putrā duhitarastathā || sarvajīvopa sargaśca tatra karma prayojayet | sāvitryā kārayotkarma tataḥ pāpaṃ praśāmyati || atyuṣṭamatiśītaṃca ativarṣamaṃ manādakaṃ | anārtavaṃ puṣpa phala matimātraṃca mārutaḥ || vāhanānāṃ mṛtiśaiva atimātraṃca mūṣakaḥ | araṇye mṛgasaṃghāta mathavāyu ranuttamaḥ || bheravaṃcāti mātraṃca rudaṃti mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ | vidyuttsanitanirghoṣa manabhrevāti varṣaṇaṃ || siṃha vyāghra tarakṣūṇāṃ darśanaṃ ca catuṣpathe | īdṛśai rlakṣaṇotpātai rvināśa makhilakṣayet | anyatra jāyate rājā tathā cānyaḥ purohitaḥ || tatra śāṃtiṃ pravakṣyāmi pāpa praśamanīṃ śubhāṃ | auduṃbarāṇāṃ samidhāṃ śata maṣṭottaraṃ haret || sahakṣīra ghṛtāktānāṃ mahāmastra gaṇaiśśubhaiḥ | hutvā śatasahasraṃtu parāṃ śānti mavāpnuyāt || yatraṃtu musalaṃvā visphuṭate vāpyulūkhaṃ | bhūtāvicaiva bibhyanti gṛhe devakule tathāḥ || ākasmātsphurate yatrakaṃpatevā vasuṃdharā | tathā yuktama yuktaṃ vāyānayuktaṃ pradhāvati || ācalaṃ calate yatra vivādaścaiva maṃtriṇāṃ | āyuktaṃ brāhmaṇai ssārtha vivadaṃdi tathābhṛśaṃ || īdṛśeṣu nimitteṣu mahābhaya mudāharet | śreṣṭhīnāṃ sārtha vāhānāma mātyānāṃ bhayaṃ vadet || mahājana vivādāṃśca maṃtrīṇāṃca vinirdiśet | tatra śāṃtiṃ pravakṣyāmi prājāpatyeti viśṛtaḥ || aśvattha samidho hutvā ghṛtāktā madhu saṃyutāḥ | sāvitryāṣṭa sahasreṇa prājā vatyāṃstu maṃtrayet || pāyasairbhojaye dviprān bhuktyaṃte bhūri dakṣiṇāṃ | tataḥ praśāmyate pāpaṃ prajāpati mataṃ yathā || yamalānica jāṃyetasśubhāni nijavāhane | muṃḍavaktra mukhāścaiva krūrāścakuṇapāstathā || anūnuṣā mānuṣāṇāṃ gajānāṃ mṛga pakṣiṇāṃ | jāyate uparidaṃtā aśvāśca vikṛtānanāḥ || bahuśīrṣa maśīrṣaṃvā bahuvarṇā avarṇākāḥ | ekaśṛṃga maśṛṃgaṃvā caturbhuja mathābhujaṃ || dīrghakarṇamakarṇaṃvā ajakarṇamukhaṃ tathā | vyāśavyāghra mukhākāraṃ biḍāla mukhamunnataṃ || īdṛśāni virūpāṇi dṛśyaṃte yatra gautama | tatra saṃgramato brūyādbhayaṃ kṣayakaraṃ mahat || janakṣayaṃ ca paurāṇāṃ rātrāṃ śreṇīvadhaṃ tathā | tatra śāṃtiṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvapāpa praṇāśanaṃ || khādirāśvaddha samidhassaha srāṣṭottaraṃdahet | nirūpākṣeṇa maṃtreṇa vidhivatsu samāhitaḥ || virūpākṣo agnimūrdhetyādi tatra virūpākṣa ṛṣiḥ || dadyācya kapilaṃdhenuṃ homaṃte śāṃtimiccatā | tatastacchāmyate pāpaṃ jātavedopaco yadā || yādhākāryāṇi jāyaṃte adaṃḍyaṃ daṃḍayennapaḥ | apūjyāścaiva pūjaṃte mānyaśyaivāva mante || anaḍvāśca pibeddhenaṃ dhenuścānaḍvahaṃ pibet | vidhuneti ca gaurvatsaṃ prajātaṃ nābhinaṃdati || prajātaṃ vatsagaurīti śeṣaḥ medhunaṃ viparītaṃca akāle mṛgapakṣiṇāṃ | brāhmaṇābhinnamaryādā natiṣṭhaṃti sarvakarmasu || īdṛśairlakṣaṇotpātai rvidyāddeśasya vibhramaṃ | kalahaṃ jāyateghoraṃ durbhikṣaṃ janamārakaṃ || rājāmātyavināśaṃca paurāṇāṃ ca mahadbhayaṃ | tatra śāṃtiṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvapāpa praṇāśanīṃ || prajvālyāśvattha samidāḥ kṛtvā saṃstaraṇaṃ mahat | auduṃbarāṇāṃ samidhā sahasrāṣṭottaraṃ budhaḥ || juhuyādvithivadvahnau parāṃśāṃti mavāpnuyāt | dāsī dāsa samāyuktaṃ gṛhaṃdadyā ddvijātaye || tataḥ praśāmyate pāpaṃ gautamasya vacoyathā | kṛṣṇāpipīlikāyatra grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca || dṛśyaṃte hyati mātraṃc durdhvaṃvaṃśa kṛtālayāḥ | śāṃtiṃgṛhe devagṛhe tathāca nṛpatergṛhe || uparyu parimātraṃca dṛśyaṃte veśmavattadā | makṣikā maśikādaṃśā ati mātraṃ bhayāvahaḥ || īdṛśairlakṣaṇotpātai rmahaccora bhayaṃ bhavet | dravyāṇāṃ haraṇaṃ brūyātpara cakrasya cāgamaṃ || tatra śāṃtila pravakṣyāmi viśvāmitropa darśitāṃ | aśvaththa samidhāṃcaiva hutvā cāṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ || pūrṇapātrāṇipai dadyāddhomāṃt bhūri dakṣiṇāṃ | sarvopaskara saṃyuktaṃ gṛhaṃ dadyā ddvijātaye || tilapātraṃ pradātavyaṃ tilān juhvati saṃpadaḥ | anagnirjvalat yatra adhūm dhūma darśanaṃ || balai ssaha kumārāśca kalahaṃ yatra kurvate | gavādyānāṃ bhavennityaṃ tathā ghoṣa nivāsināṃ || calatāṃ sārthavāhānāṃ kalahoyatra jāyate | rājā mātya vināśaṃca paurāṇāṃca mahadbhayaṃ || tatra śāṃtiṃ pravakṣyāmi pitā mahā vacoyathā | pālāśa samidhāgnau sahasrāṣṭottaraṃ huvet || brāhmaṇā nbhojayottatra paramānnaṃ ghṛtaplutaṃ | tatastu śamayetpāpaṃ pitāmaha vacoyathā || prākāre nagare ramyego purāṭṭāla keṣuvā | radhyāṃ catuṣpathe caiva devatā yataneṣuca || nivāsaṃ yatra kurvaṃti bakāḥ kākāśca kauśikāḥ | gṛdhrāḥ parabhṛta ścaiva āraṇyā mṛga pakṣiṇāḥ || nirūpetkalahaṃ ghoraṃ siddhānāṃ vacanaṃ tathā | nirūpetarkayot || tatra śāṃtiṃ pravakṣyāmi nāraḍnopa lakṣiṇaṃ | aśvattha samithānāṃtu ghṛtāktānāṃ vibhāvasoḥ || vāyavynha maṃtreṇa nivedyaṃca suśoṇitaṃ | tatastu śāmyate pāpaṃ nāradasya vacoyadhā || mṛtaḥ śmaśānaṃyo nītaḥ punarjīvati mānavaḥ | gṛheyasya praviṣṭo sautiṣṭedyadi kadācana || acirāsmṛtyutāṃyāti hṛtadāra parigrahaḥ | tatra śāṃtiṃ pravakṣyāmi dharmarāja mataṃyathā || sakṣirāṇāṃ ghṛtāktānā magnerhutvā mukhe budhaḥ | audubaṃrīṇāṃ vidhivattataḥ śāṃtiḥ kṛtā bhavet || sāvitryāṣṭa nahasreṇa kṣīraśāṃtiṃ tukārayat | kṣīraśāṃtiśca raktānāmekavarṇānā mityādīnāṃ vakṣyamāṇānāṃ || kapilā tila kāṃsyāni homāṃte bhūridakṣiṇāṃ | tatastacchāmyate pāpaṃ dharmarāja mataṃ yathā || śvāsṛgālothavā gṛddraḥ kākovāyadi mānuṣaḥ | śmaśānānmāṃsamādāya puramadhye praveśayet || nagaraṃ paṭṭaṇaṃvāpi grāmaṃvā yadivā gṛhaṃ | acireṇaiva kātena śmaśānaṃ tadbhaviṣyati || coramaṃḍala saṃprāptiḥ paracakrasya cāgamaḥ | anārogya manāvṛṣṭirda bhikṣaṃ janamārakaṃ || saṃgrāmaṃ śastra saṃghātaṃ kṣiprameva vinirdiśet | tatra śāṃtiṃ pravakṣyami tasya pāpasya śāṃtidāṃ || aśvadtha samidho gṛhya tilāṃśca madhusaṃyutān | virūpākṣeṇa maṃtreṇa virūpākṣaṃ suśoṇitāṃ || tilapātropa hāraṃca kṣīraṃ śāṃtiṃca kārayet | tatastacchāmyate pāpaṃ prajāpati mataṃ yadā || sautrā maṇiḥ pākayajñaḥ paśubaṃdha stathaivaca | kratavaścā pravartaṃte anadhītya kṛtodayaḥ || yasmiṃ stadhā pravartaṃte krodha lobha bhayādapi | adatvā dakṣiṇyā samyaṅmaha dutpāta lakṣaṇaṃ || anārogya manāvṛṣṭi durbhikṣaṃ janamārakaṃ | jvaraḥ kāsastathā śvāsaḥ kuṣṭa dadru viṣūcikāḥ || śirorogārśa rogāśca pāṃḍu rogo galagrahaḥ | ādayaśca pravartaṃte durdṛṣṭe svapna lakṣaṇaiḥ || tatra śāṃtiṃ prapakṣyāmi bṛhaspati maṃtayadhā | trirātro poṣito bhūtvā haviṣyāśī purohitaḥ || sakṣirāṇāṃ ghṛtāktānāṃ samidāṃśca śataṃ dahet | vajra miṃdrāśa nirvāpi jvalanyai nipatedyadi || purojanapadevāpi tatra vidyānmahadbhayaṃ | saṃvatsare tatoghere vidyādbhahu janakṣayaṃ || rājā mātya vināśaṃca nirdiśennātra saṃśayaḥ | tatra śāṃtiṃ pravakṣyami iṃdrāgni vacanaṃ yathā || apāmārgasya samidhāṃ sahasrāṣṭottaraṃ dahet | pāyasaṃ bhojiye dviprān kṣīraṃ śāṃtiṃca kārayet || raktānāṃ moghavarṇānāṃ gavāṃ kṣīraṃ samādiśet | hutvāhuti śataṃ vipra māheṃdreṇaiva maṃtravit || suvarṇa maṇivarṇānāṃ gavāṃ kṣīraṃ samādiśet | hutvāhuti śataṃ vipra māheṃdreṇaiva maṃtravit || suvarṇa maṇisaṃghātāṃ homāṃte bhūridakṣiṇāṃ | tatastaccāmyate pāpa miṃdrāgnivacanaṃ tathā || pratasoto mahanadyaḥ pravahaṃti jalāśayāḥ | unmārgapathagāmāni jalānyupaharaṃti ca || udgiraṃti jalaṃbhūmau puṣkariṇyo jalāśayāḥ | kumudotpala puṣphāṇāṃ nadyassrotasi saṃbhavaḥ || darśanaṃ saptaṛṣīṇāṃ nāgānāṃ jalaśāyināṃ | caityavṛkṣā maholkāśca puṣpavaṃti phalaṃtica || pūyaśoṇita gaṃdhāśca kṛpāpāṇāṃ sugaṃdhitā | krimiśoṇita varṣaṃca chinnābhinnaḥ purohitaḥ || īdṛśāni nimittāni saṃtiyatraiva gautama | paracakrāgamaṃ viṃdyā tsarvaloka bhayāvahaṃ || rājāmātya bhayaṃbrūyā tpaurāṇāṃca mahadbhayaṃ | auduṃbarīṇāṃ vidhivatsamidhāṃvai samāhitaḥ || sahastrāṣṭottaraṃhutvā tviṃdrāgneyena maṃtravit | rudrajāpaścakartavyo vāyavyaścasamaṃtataḥ || devalayoṣu sarveṣu nānāvāditra nisvanaiḥ | modakākṣata patraiśca brāhmaṇai ssvastivācayet || dvijātanāṃ gosahasraṃ homāṃte bhūridakṣiṇā | utpātādi nimuttāstu yekecidbhaya dāruṇāḥ || gopradānena śāmyaṃti prajāpatimataṃ yadhā | vratopavāsai rniyamairhomai brāhmaṇatarpaṇaiḥ || divyotpāte samutpannai māheṃdraṃ sāthayeccaruṃ | vāruṇaṃcāṃtarikṣe ca āgneyaṃ pārthivetathā || tathā saṃgrāmakālepi prahārāṇāṃ nivṛttaye | evamityādikaṃloke divya bhomāṃtarikṣajaṃ || niyamairvrato pavāsaiśca śāṃtibhiśca praśāmyāti | devatāyatrapūjyaṃte sāṃvatsara purohitā || guravo grahanakṣatraṃ tadāhuḥ śubhalakṣaṇaṃ | iti madanaratne gargoktānānotpāta śāṃtayaḥ || <7> apacāreṇalokānā mapakārāddurātmanāṃ | aparaktavināśāya sṛjaṃte devatāmune || utpātānvividhākārā ndivyabhaumāṃtarikṣajān | saprācīṃ diśa manvāvartate thayadāsya maṇikuṃbhā sthālīdaraṇe yānaccatra śayyāsanā vasadathvaja patākāgrahaika deśa prabhaṃgajivājimukhyāḥ pramīyaṃta ityeva mādīnitāni sarvāṇīṃdra devatyānyadbhutāni prāyaścittāni bhavaṃtīṃdraṃvo viśvata sparīti sthālīpākā daṣṭaśataṃ hutvā paṃcabhirājyāhuti bhirjuhuyā diṃdrāya svāhā śacīpataye svāhā vajrapāṇaye svāheśvarāya svāhā sarvapāpa praśamanāya svāheti vyāhṛtibhiśca pṛthagjuhoti || dakṣiṇāṃdiśa manvāvartatetha yadasya prajāyaṃ paśuṣu śarīrevāriṣṭāni prāgurbhavaṃti vyādhayo hyaneka vidhā ati svapna dusvapna mati bhojana mālasyā jīrṇāni gṛhadvāreṇa vāyasogacchati kapotaḥ praviśati śarīre vārohāti kṛṣṇā strī ādarśana mādarśe ityeva mādīnitāni sarvāṇi yamadaivatyā nyadbhutāni bhavaṃti nāke suvarṇamiti sthālīpākā aṣṭaśataṃhutvā paṃcabhi rājyā hutībhi rjuhoti yamāya svāhā pretādhi pataye svāhā daṃḍapāṇaye svāheśvarāya svāhā sarvāpāpa praśamanāya svāheti vyāhṛtibhiśca pṛthagḍuhoti || napratī cīṃdīśa manvāvartateyasya kṣetra gṛha saṃstheṣu dānyeṣvadbhutāḥ prādurbhavaṃtyupadravā anekavidhā ākhupataṃga pipīlikā mathvaka bhaumaka śuka śakabhaka saukṣmaka mityeva mādīni tāni sarvāṇi varuṇa daisatyāni bhavaṃti || ghṛta vatīti varuṇasyottaṃbhana masīti sthālīpākā daṣṭaśataṃ hutvā paṃcabhirājyāhutī rḍuhauti varuṇāya svāhāspāṃ pataye svāhā pāśa pāṇaye svāheśvarāya svāhā sarvapāpa praśamanāya svāheti vyāhṛtibhiśca pṛthagjuhoti || saudī cīṃdi śamanvāvartete thaya dāsya kanaka rajata vajra vaiḍūrya mūktāmaṇi viyogo bhavatyā raṃbhovā vipadyaṃte mitrāveva virajyaṃte veśyani madhūnyalābūni vājāyaṃte valmākā ścocchrīyaṃte śuṣka vṛkṣāḥ prarohaṃti tailaṃ styāyasti rātrā vidra dhanirdhṛṣvādivā śvetavāya saṃśmaśānāgnau dhūmojāyate śvatarīgarbhaṃ gṛhṇāti evamādhīnivai śravaṇa dhaivatyānyadbhutāni bhavaṃti | abhityaṃ devamiti sthālīsākādaṣṭa śataṃ hutvā paṃcabhi rājyāhutīrjuhoti || vaiśravaṇāya svāhā sarvapāpa śamanāya svāheti vyāhṛtibhiśca pṛthagjuhoti | sa pṛthivī manvāvartate thayadasya pṛthivīsphuṭa tiskhalatikaṃpati jvalati rudati dhūmāyatya kasmātsali lamudgirati plapati majjati nimagnamu paplavatyakāle puṣpa phalānītyeva mādīnāgni daivatyādbhutāni bhavaṃtyagniṃ dūtamiti sthālī pākāddhutvā paṃcabhi rājyā hutī rjuhotyagnaye svāhā rciṣmate svāhā śakti pāṇay svāheśvarāya svāhā sarvapāpa śamanāya svāhoti vyāhṛtībiśca pṛthagjuhoti | soṃtarikṣa manvāvartate sayadāsyavi vātā vātā vāyaṃtre bhreṣu cāpa rūpāṇi dṛśyate kharakaraṃbha gṛdhra kaṃka kapoto lūkaśyena māvāya saṃgo māṃsaṃ yūkṣṇānyu pari paśu māṃsa paśvasthi rudhira varṣāṇi pravarkaṃtekāka maidhunāni dṛśyaṃt rātrau maṇadhanuḥ paśyecchaśakā grām viṃśati vṛkṣāssrapaṃti ruthirāṇyākāse nagarasya satītyeva mādīni vāyu daivatyā nyadbhutāni bhavaṃti || vāta āvātviti sthālī pākāddhutvāṣṭottara śataṃ paṃcabhi rājyāhutī rjuhoti vāyav svāhā mahādbhutādhi pataye svāhā śīghrapāṇaye svāheśvarāya svāhā sarvapāpa harāya svāhetivyā hṛtībhī rhutvātha sāmagāyet || sadiva manvāvartatetha yadā tārā varṣāṇi colkāḥ pataṃti dhūmāyaṃ tidi śodahyaṃti ketavaścottiṣṭhaṃti gavāṃ śṛṃgeṣu dhūyo jāyate gavāṃ staneṣu rudhiraṃ sravatya tyarthaṃhimaṃ nipatyeva mādīni soma devatyānyadbhutāni bhavaṃti somaṃ rājā namiti sthālī pākā daṣṭottara śataṃ hutvā paṃcabhi rājyāhutī rjuhoti somāya svāhā nakṣatra patame svāhā śīta pāṇayo svāheśvarāya svāheti sarvapāpa harāya svāhetica vyāhṛtībhiśca pṛthagjuhoti || saparāṃ diśamanvāvartate devā yatanāni kaṃpaṃte devatā prati māhasaṃti nṛtyaṃti gāyaṃti sphuṭaṃti khidyatyunmīlaṃti nimīlaṃti pratiyāṃti nadyaḥ || tabaṃdha māditye dṛśyate jalaṃca paritapyate ketūpatākā cchatra vajra viṣāṇini prajvalaṃtyaśyā vādhiṣvaṃgārān kṣaraṃtya hatāni karmāṇi kraṃdaṃtyeva mādīni viṣṇudaivatayādbhutāni bhavaṃtīdaṃ viṣṇuriti sthālīpākāddhutvā paṃcājyāhuti rjuhoti viṣṇave svāhā sarvabhūtādhipataye svāhā cakrapāṇaye svāheśvarāya svāhā sarvapāpaharāya svāheti vyāhṛti bhirhutvātha sāmagāyet || khanana dahanābhimarśanāgdhobhirā kramaṇācca caturbhiśśudhyate bhūmiḥ - paṃcamaścopalepanāt | saṃbhārānpradakṣiṇa mānīya brāhmaṇaiḥ svasti vācayitvā saṃbhārairya dupanṛṣṭaṃ tadabhyukṣe cchāmyatīha brāhmaṇaān bhojayet | hiraṇya gaurvāsośyādi takṣiṇāṃ dadyāt || sodhastāddiśa manvāvartatetha yadāsya maniṣya gomahiṣya joṣṭrāḥ prasūyaṃte pīnāṃgāsyati riktāṃgāni kṛtarūpāṇi vājayanai acalānicalantyva mādīni rudradaivatyā nyadbhutāni bhavaṃti || āvorājānamiti sthālīpākā daṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā paṃcājyāhutī rjuhoti rudrāya paśupataye śūlapāṇaye īśvārāya sarvapāpaharāya cetivyāhṛtī bhirhutvāsāmagāyat || ūrdhvādiśa manvāvartaṃthetha yadāsya māniṣāṇā mati duḥkhaṃ parvatāsphuṭaṃtinipatyaṃ tyākāśādbhumiḥ kaṃpaṃte mahādrumā śśuṣyaṃtyaśmānaḥ plavaṃte catuṣpadaṃ paṃcapādaṃ bhavaṃtyevamādi sūryadevatyā nyadbhutāni bhavaṃtyudutyā miti sthālīpākadaṣṭottara śataṃ hutvā paṃcabhirājāyahutī rjuhoti sūryāya sarvagrahādhipataye kiraṇapāye īśvarāya sarvāpāpaharāyeti vyāhṛtī bhirhutvātha sāmagāyet || sanarvādiśo anvāvartatetha yadāsyastriyo yamalāni prasūyaṃte śvetakākaḥ kākamaithanaṃ ca dṛśyate sarvadiśāṃ dāhaśca jāyaṃte piśāca rākṣasa gojāvyuṣṭeṣvagniśco dbhavati paśuṣumānuṣā bhavaṃti mānuśeṣu sarvāṇi satvānijāyaṃte vājmanaḥ karmabhīrudraṃdveṣṭi strī puṃpayoḥ pauṃścalya bhāvaḥ sarvapāpeṣu buddhiḥ pravartata ityeva mādīni rudradaivatyādbhutāni bhavaṃti viśvataścakṣuriti sthālīpākaṃhutvā paṃcabhirājyāhutiṃ || rudrāya umāpataye śūlapāṇaye īśvarāya sarvāpāpa praśamanāyetidyā hṛtībhiścajuhoti || bhūmikaṃpodiśāṃdāho grahayuddhaṃ ca jāyate || gagane dṛśyate ketu rādityaiścaiva kaṃpate | āditye dṛśyate chidraṃ kṛṣṇa varṇobhijāyate | viparītā nadīcaiva rudhiraṃ ca pravāhayet | gaganā crūyate gītaṃ nirghoṣṭaśaiva jāyate || evamādīvi sarvāṇya dbhūtāni bhavaṃti teṣāṃ prāyaścittāni bhavaṃti | gṛhe gṛhe bhaveccāṃtiḥ bhrātṛṇāṃ yajanaṃ baliḥ || dānaṃ japaṃ rudraṃ nityaṃ paśu bhāskara pūjanaṃ | lakṣa homaṃ koṭi homaṃ dūrvā homaṃ puhohitaḥ || go bhū hiraṇya vastāṃnna tila dānaṃ śubhavahaṃ | pāyasaṃ dadhi kṣī rājyaṃ deyaṃ pipreṣu bojane || atha pūrṇāhutiṃ hutvā dūrvā darbha śamī vīraṇāṃdī dhasarpissarṣa pānphali nīrapāmārga tila yava vrīhayaḥ samidaḥ ścaitānyā hare tsnātaḥ sthaṃḍila mupalipyataṃ treṇo danaṃ kṛsaraṃ yavānsaktu pāyasaṃ dadhi madhu ghṛtāktāḥ pṛthakaścaravaḥ sarveṣāṃ pāyasa magniṃ samidhāya juhuyā diṃdraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhane | nāke suparṇaṃ varuṇasyottaṃbhanamasi || abhitvaṃ devagṃ savitāraṃ | agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe || idaṃ viṣṇuḥ | viśva taścakṣuḥ | gaurīmimāya | kāṃḍātkāṃḍāt | dhṛvāsi dhṛvoyaṃ yojānāti naya jñāyaṃte | ihai vastaṃ māvyoṣṭaṃ | punaṃ patnī magniradā dāyuṣā sahavarcasā | dīrghāyu rasyāyuḥ patirjīvātu śaradaḥ śatamiti || iti madanaratne devī purāṇoktādbhuta śāṃtayaḥ || atha prāsāda kalaśa liṃgārcābhaṃga śāṃtiḥ adbhuta sāgar nāradaḥ - yatra devakule vajraṃ vatedgṛdhrothavā punaḥ | kaṃkasya patanecaiva cūjāyā magni darśanaṃ || liṃgaṃvā bhidayate yatra kaṃpatecā nimittataḥ | cūḍā bhaṃgo bhavedyatra pratimābhidyate tathā || grāmotsādo bharettatra svāmino maraṇaṃ diśet | catra śāṃtiṃ pravakṣyāmivayena saṃpadyate śubhaṃ || kuṃḍaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena tato homaṃ samācaret | caruṃcaya madaivatyaṃ sātha yitvā vidhānataḥ || na suvarṇena hastena tataḥ karma samārabhet | aṣṭottara śataṃ hutvā ghṛtāktaṃ samidhastataḥ || māṣa mudgstilaiścaiva ghṛtena madhunā saha | ebhiḥ paṃca sahasrāṇi śakti bījena homayet || homāṃte tarpaye dvipran dakṣiṇā bhojanādibhiḥ | bhūmiṃ dhenumanaḍvāṃhaṃ svarṇaṃ dhānyaṃ sadakṣiṇaṃ || paṃcagavyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā snāyaddevālaye dvajaḥ | baliṃ datvā nidhānena kṛsaraiḥ pāyasai stathā || īśānaṃ sthāpaye tatra baliṃ datvā vidhānataḥ | evaṃ kṛtvā vidhānaṃtu kṛta kṛtyo bhavennaraḥ || maṃṭapasya tathā bhitti ścūḍā devakulasyaca | hujāyāṃ pārthivasyāpi pratimāyāṃ tadhaivaca || akasmānnipatedyatra kaṃpatevāsnimittataḥ | dadhikṣaudra ghṛtāktānāmaśvadtha samidhāṃ tataḥ || juhuyā daṣṭa śataka mimārudreti maṃtravit | dhenuṃca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāttila pātraṃ sakāṃcanaṃ || iti śāṃtiratne liṃgārcādi bhaṃga śāṃtiḥ || ma da na ra tne pa ri śi ṣṭe gṛhamadhye sthūṇā virohita kapotovāgāramadhye nipatedvāya sovā gṛhaṃ | praviśe dgaurva gṛhamārohe dvalmīkaṃ vopajāyaṃte || gaurātmānaṃ pratinaye danaḍvān divaṃtūlli khedhanagnauvā dhūmraṃ jāyate chatāṃkaṃ niryāsaṃvopajāyate maṃḍūko dṛṣṭovā vāsena svapne sthidaṃta patanevā gṛhapatirjaya yāsahoparatiṃ viṃdet | anyeṣuvā gṛhotpāteṣu devayajanollekhana prabhṛtyagni mukhātkṛtvā sthālī pākājjuhoti || yata iṃdra bhayāmahe iti puronu vākyā manūcya svasti dāvivaspatiriti yājya yājuhotyathājyāhutīrupa jahoti vāstoṣpateśaṃ na iṃdrāgnī kayānaścitra ābhuvatko adābhya vataṃ nassamanasālīti sviṣṭakṛtprabhṛti siddhamādhenu vara pradānā dathāgreṇa śamīparṇeṣu hutaśeṣaṃ nidadhāti śanno devī rabhiṣṭaya iti sthālī pākaṃ saṃkṣālana mājya śeṣa muda kaśeṣaṃca pātryāṃ samānīyaniye trpokṣayedvā tacchaṃ yorāvṛṇī maha ityannaṃ saṃskṛtya brāhmaṇānsaṃpūjyā śiṣovāca yitvā śivaṃ bhavedityadbhuto vyākhyātaḥ || itha janamāra mahāmāryādi śāṃtiḥ hemādrau gargaḥ - janamārasamutpattiṃ pravakṣyāmi saśāṃtikaṃ | yadālobha samāviṣṭāḥ pīḍyāṃte pārdhivāḥ prajāḥ || ramatyābhidrutataro nacadharmeṇa tiṣṭhati | vacastasyānuvartaṃte prajāmaṃdharihāyataḥ || krodha lobha samāviṣṭāḥ sādhvācāra vivarjitāḥ | pūjayaṃtica nābhikṣṇaṃ devānviprāṃ stathā suhṛt || tāsvadharmābhibhūtāsu tato rudraḥ prakupyate | aṃtyakorapyeṣa bhagavānbhūtānāṃ prīta evaca || kurute sauvikārāṃśca hetubhūtā npṛthagvidhān | tārāgrahānketu daṃḍānrāhu vīrakakārakān || nasūryasaṃdhyāvikṛti rghorānvā mṛgapiṇaḥ | bhūkaṃpolkāni pātaśca sītoṣṇānilavikriyaḥ || ativarṣa mavarṣaṃtu tadhaivartu viraryayaḥ | oṣadhyo rasahīnāśca bhavedṛtu viparyaye || rasavīrya vihīnāstā roganutpādayaṃ tyatha | divyabhaumāṃtarikṣāsyu rutpātā doṣasūcakāḥ || saṃbhavaṃti tatārogā dāruṇā janamārakāḥ | rudraprakopajaṃtasmā jjanamāraṃ pracakṣate || tenābhibhūtāssarvepi ca laṃte buddhivaikṛtāt || satvaṃbalaṃca vikṛtiṃ yāṃtiprāyeṇa jaṃtuṣu | brahmasvaharaṇaścāpi gurudrohātsatāṃvadhāt || lakṣyate janamāroyaṃ samutpanna iti śṛtiḥ | tadrudrakojaṃ tasmā jjanamāra praśāṃtaye || tasmātprapādaye dyatnāddeva devaṃ mahāśvaraṃ | daivajñānā pratiṣṭena vidhināsu samāhitaḥ || gāṇāpatyena vithivā adharva śirasastathā | yāmalena vidhānena kuryādeva prasādanaṃ || śivastuktamumāstuktaṃ japecca śatarudriyaṃ | jalyupahārānvividhāṃśca tvareṣu nivodayet || āvāhayāmitvā sagaṇaṃ rudraṃvā śivamevavā | brāhmaṇānbhakṣya bhojaiśca dakṣiṇābhiśca toṣayet || prasādite tatorudre janamāro nivartate | nahyeṣa nānādaivatyo vividhaiścānya karmabhiḥ || balācchamayitaṃ śaktyo rudrakopa samutthitaḥ | tasmātprasādhayedyatnai rbhavaṃtu jagatohitaṃ || śivaṃ prajānāṃ bhavati yadā saṃprīyate śivaḥ | dharmamaṃgalaśīlaśca devabrāhmaṇa paṃditaḥ || japopavāsa nirato nṛpati ssaṃyateṃdriyaḥ || yukto homaṃ prakurvīta niyamena yadhāvidhi || evaṃ yuktasyanṛpateḥ karmasiddhiḥ prajāyate | karmaṇa stasyamūlaṃhi śraddhadhānonṛpasmṛtaḥ || uṣoṣito naraḥ snātaṃ śukla vastra samāhṛtaḥ | ātmarakṣāṃ svayaṃkṛtvā tataḥ śāṃtiṃ prayojayet || dharmātmā dharmaviduṣāṃ rājārāja purohitaḥ | rājāvai saguṇomeṣāṃ kuśalaṃ tatra vardhate || viṣṇudharmottare - rudrāṇāṃ ca tathājāpyaṃ sarvāghavinighādanaṃ | sarvākāmakarohoma stathā sarvata śāṃtidaḥ || ajāvikā nāmaśvānāṃ kuṃjarāṇāṃ tathāgavāṃ | manuṣyāṇāṃ nareṃdrāṇāṃ bālānāṃ yoṣitāmapi || grāmāṇāṃ nagarāṇāṃ ca doṣānāmapi bhārgava | uddhūtānāṃca dharmajña vyādhītānāṃ tathaivaca || maraṇesamamaprāpte ripujeca tathābhaye | rudrahomaḥ parāśāṃti pāyasena ghṛtenaca || mārkaṃḍeyapūrāṇe - upasarge narāṇāṃtu mahāmārī samudbhavaṃ | tadhātrividhamutpātaṃ māhātmaṃ śamayenmama || atra prāgu ktanṛsiṃha gāyatryā | lakṣa homa koṭi homauca jñeyau || iti janamāra mahāmāryādi śāṃtiḥ atha kāka maithuva śāṃtiḥ adbhutasāgare gargaḥ - kākasya maithunaṃ paśye tkāka śśirasice dviśet | śirasyusivākuyān tpakṣadhātuṃ nakhestathā || vicāraṇaṃca kuruteśa yānaṃca spṛśedyadi | tadāvadettu maraṇaṃ mahāriṣṭa madhāpivā | śāṃtiṃ tatra prakurvīta vidhānena yadhoditu | uddiśyāriṣṭa śamanaṃ kuryātsaṃkalpa pūrvakaṃ || śucaudeśe ratnimātre sthaṃḍilegni nidhāyaca | tadīśāne cāṣṭadale kuṃbhasyopari śaktitaḥ || hiraṇya nirmitaṃ tviṃdraṃ lokāpāla samanvitaṃ | pūja yitvā svaśākhokta vidhināśra payeccaruṃ || kṛtvājyabhāga paryaṃtaṃ juhuyā tkamaśo haviḥ | pālāśa samidhovrīhi carvājyāni yadhākramaṃ || aṣṭottara śata mahasraṃvā śata maṣṭottaraṃtuvā | yata iṃdreti maṃtreṇa lokapālebhya evaca || śaktyā hutvā svaśākhokta prāyaścittāhutīrhunet | lokapāla baliṃdadyā diṃdrāgnyādeśca śeṣataḥ || vāyasebhyo baliṃdadyā daidra vāruṇa maṃtrataḥ | aiṃdravāruṇa vāyavyā ssaumyāyā myāśca naiṛtāḥ || tekākāḥ pratigṛgahṇantu bhūmāpannaṃ mayārpitaṃ || pūrṇāhutiṃ tatodatyā ācāryaṃ pūjiye ttataḥ | kuṃbhodake nābhi,eko yajamāvasyavistarāt || ācāryā yeṃdra pratimāṃ dadyātsopaska rāṃtataḥ | śaktyāca bhūyasīṃ dadyā dvijānāṃ bhojanaṃ diśet || śataṃta dardha mardhaṃvā śakyābhāve daśāpivā | kāromaidhuna yuktaśche cchvetassayadi dṛśyate || iti hemādrau gargaḥ - kecittu śveta kākamaidhuna darśane viśiṣṭo doṣaḥ na kevala ityāhuḥ | tecedya dipadābhyāṃ dṛśyate yadāvṛtyācani mittyabhedhāt jñānānmṛtā ityupekṣaḥ || iti kāka maiduna śāṃtiḥ || atha vāyasa śāṃtiḥ mānava saṃhitāyāṃ - adhātassaṃpravakṣyami vāyasaḥ praviśedgṛhaṃ | praviśedvāratogacche nmāsamekaṃ visarjayet || dvārāṃtare yadāgacchet ṣaṇmāsāṃstu visarjayet | devālaye nṛpāṇāṃtu grāmanāśo bhaviṣyati || gṛhapraveśane kāko gṛhāśeṣakṣuyaṃkaraḥ | śvānamārjāratogacche dvāyasaḥ praviśedgṛhaṃ || gṛhastha maraṇaṃviṃdyā tsarvanāśo gṛhebhavet | eteṣāṃ doṣajātānāṃ śāṃtivakṣye samāsataḥ || praveśasthānadeśeṣu dakṣiṇevā gṛhattataḥ | ācāryaṃ varayedādau brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragaṃ || vrīhidroṇesuślakṣṇaṃ sthāpayedavraṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ | paṃcapallavasaṃyuktaṃ paṃcagavya samanvitaṃ || paṃcaratna samāyuktaṃ pūyamettīrthavāriṇā | tasyoparinyasetpātre kākarūpaṃ śacīpatiṃ || kargamātra suvarṇena pādenātha svaśaktitaḥ | yata iṃdreti maṃtreṇa arcayitvātu daivavit || iṃdrādīśanaparyaṃta marcayellokapāla kramāt | kaṃbhābhimaṃtraṇaṃ kuryācchrī rudraṃca spṛśaṃjapet || svagṛhyoktena vidhinā homakarma samācaret | yata iṃdreti maṃtrābhyāṃ samidhājyacarūn hunet || aṣṭottara śatasahasraṃvā aṣṭottaraśataṃtuvā | triyaṃbakeṇa maṃtreṇa tilānaṣṭaśataṃhunet || idaṃ viṣṇustumaṃtreṇa lājahomaṃ samācaret | vupahomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā mahavyāhṛtibhirhūnet || iṃdrāya svāhā vāyasotpātataśamanyāya svāhā śāṃtāya svāheti | tataḥ sviṣṭakṛtaṃhutvā homaśeṣaṃ samācaret || saṃpātairabhiṣiktastu gomugmaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ diśet | ājyāvalokanaṃ kṛtvā mahāśāṃtiṃ paṭhettataḥ || iti vāyasa śāṃtiḥ - nāradaḥ - śrīdhānya bandhunāśaśca vittahanistathāsyaśaḥ | bandhukleśaṃ putrahāniḥ strīcintāca madgadaḥ || pūrvāhāni phalānveṣā miṃdralupteca mastake | paṃcatvakpalla vasvarṇa paṃcāmṛta phalodakaiḥ || abhyajya maṃtritairmaṃtrai ssnāddoṣaṃ vimuṃcati || evamevāgnidāhepi mastake madhyadūṣite | daṃtacchede kāka haṃtau saraṭīpatanepica || lābhadaḥ kuḍhya godhātra śubhadovyatyaye vyayaḥ | dakṣiṇesphuraṇelābhaṃ vāme sphuraṇamanyathā || strīṇāṃ viparītaṃ - sītā harīṃdrakṣaṇadā carāṇāṃvā māninetrāṇi samullasaṃ tīti rāmāyaṇokaiḥ || iti vāyasa śāṃtiḥ || atha kāka maitha narmada naratnoktā śāṃtiḥ madanaratne nāradaḥ - divāvāyadi vārātrau yaḥpaśyetkāka maidhunaṃ | sanaro mṛtyu māpnoti yadivā sthāna nāśanaṃ || kāghāta vrataṃ yadvā vidadhītathā vatsaraṃ | pitṛ vadvai dvijān bhaktyā pratyahaṃcābhi vādayet || jiteṃdriyojita krodhaḥ satya dharma parāyaṇāḥ | taddoṣa śamanāyatha śāṃti karma samācaret || gṛhasyeśāna bhagetu homa sthānaṃ prakalpayet | svagṛhyokta vidānena tatra sthāpya hutāśanaṃ || mukhāṃte samidannājyairhune daṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ | prati maṃtraṃ tryaṃbakena apamṛtyu dvayenaca || apamṛtyu mapakṣudamiti maṃtradvayaṃ taittarīye prasiddhaṃ | vyāhṛtībhi rvrīhiti lairjayādyātaṃ prakalsayet || pūrṇāhutiṃ juhuyātkartā śuciralaṃ kṛtaḥ | svarṇa śṛṃgīṃ paupyakhurāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ dhenuṃ payasvinīṃ || vastrālaṃkāra sahitaṃ niṣka dvādaśa saṃyutāṃ | tadardhena tadarthena tadarthenā thatavāyutāṃ || yathā vittānusāreṇa tanvyū nādhika kalpanā | ācāryāya śrotriyāyatāṃ gāṃdadyā tkuṃṭuṃbine || yasmāttvaṃ pṛthivī sadyo vaiplutādagni sannibhāt | sarvamṛtyuṃ harennitya mataḥ śāṃtiṃ prayacchame || brāhmaṇebhyo viśiṣṭebhyo yathā śaktyāca dakṣiṇāṃ | brāhmaṇā nbhojayetpaścāte svastivācana pūrvakaṃ || evaṃ yaḥ kurute namyaksatudoṣā tpramucchate || madanaratne vṛddha gāryāḥ - murdhnirājya śriyorāpti rnetrayorbhaṃdhu darśanaṃ | nāsikāyāṃtu saubhāgyaṃ vaktre mṛṣṭānna bhojanaṃ || kaṃṭhenityaṃ priyāśleṣaḥ skaṃdhayorvijayaṃ dhṛvaṃ | dhanalābho bāhuyugme karayorardha saṃcayaḥ || vakṣasthaleca saubhāgyaṃ putra prīti vivardanaṃ | putralābhaltu kukṣau syānnābhau kīrti vivardanaṃ || ardalābhastu pṛṣṭesyā dūrūjānvostu vāhanaṃ | jaṃghayośca nirudyogaḥ pādayo rrbhamaṇaṃ bhavet || pādataścordhva gamanaṃ kuryādā mastakopari | gātra pradakṣiṇāṃvāpi rājya labho bhavettadhā || mastakātpāda paryaṃtaṃ yagigacce dadhopivā | gātrā pradikṣiṇaṃvāpi hāniśokau samādiśet || saraṭīpatane hāniḥ sarvaṃgeṣu ca sarvadā | ūrdhva gacchedadhovāpi kuṭuṃbakalaba pradaḥ || iti palyāḥ prapātasya phalaṃ jñeyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ | etadeva phalaṃ viṃdyātparaṭasya prarohaṇe || palyāḥ prapātanecaiva saraṭasya prarohaṇe | paṃcarātrā bhavettasya vyādhipīḍā viśeṣaṭhaḥ || patanānaṃtaraṃ tasyārohaṇaṃ yadi jāyate | patane phala mutkṛṣṭaṃ rohaṇe viphalaṃ bhavet || ārohaṇaṃ cordhva vaktra adhovaktreni pātanaṃ | bhavedyadi sahasreṇa tatphalaṃ jāyate dhṛvaṃ || mṛtyuyoge daddhadine pāteca mama kaṃṭake | caṃdāṣṭameca nidhane janmarkṣe viṣanāḍike || aṣṭameśe krūrayute viṣāṣṭhi vaidhṛti saṃyute | durniputte nidhotpāte nidhanaṃjāyate dhṛvaṃ || tayosparśanna mātreṇa sacaila snānamācaret || gavyaṃ paṃcavidhaṃ prāśya kuryādājyāpa lokanaṃ || śastevāpyadha vājasya yadicchedātmana śśubhaṃ | puṇyāhaṃvāca yitvātu śāṃti karmaṃta taścarek || pratirūpaṃ tayaḥ kuryātsuvarṇena svaśaktitaḥ | rakta vastreṇa saṃveṣṭya gaṃdhapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet || agni saṃsthānaṃ kṛtvā homaṃ kuryā dvidhānataḥ | mṛtyuṃ jayena maṃtreṇa samidbhiḥ khādiraiśśubhaiḥ || tilaiḥ vyāhṛti homaṃca aṣṭottara sahasrakaṃ | aṣṭottara śataṃvāvi kuryādvittānu sārataḥ || mahāvyāhṛti homaṃca sarpikṣireṇa kārayet | abhiṣekaṃ tataḥ kuryādyajamānasya murdani || puṇyairvāruṇa sūktaiścadyauḥ śāṃtyādika maṃtrataḥ | dhenuṃ vastrayutaṃ dadyādyaḥ kuryācchāṃti muttamāṃ || tasyāyurvijayo lakṣmiḥ kīrtiḥ puṣṭiśca jāyate | pallīsaraṭayoḥ śāṃti nādhānaṃ launakoditaṃ || kīrtitaṃtu phalopetaṃ vṛddhagārgyeṇa dhīmatā || iti pallīsaraṭayoḥ śāṃtiḥ || a tha nāradhokta pallīsaraṭa śāṃtiḥ nāradaḥ - palyāḥ prapatanecaiva saraṭasya prarohaṇe | śubhā śubhaṃ vijānīyā ttattasthāna viśeṣataḥ || palyāḥ prapatanecaiva phala muktaṃ śūbhā śubhaṃ | śīrṣe rājyo śrīyovāpi phālttvaiścarya vardhanaṃ || savyabhuje jayaḥ proktaḥ āpasavye mahadbhayaṃ | kukṣaudakṣiṇabhāgetu dhanalābhastadhaivaca || vāma kukṣtuni dhanaṃ kaditaṃ pūrva sūribhiḥ | navya haste mitralābho vāmahastetu nisvanaḥ || udare dakṣṇebhāge suputrāvā prāpti rucyate | vāmabhāge mahārogaḥ kaṭyāsavye mahadyaśaḥ || vāmakaṭyāṃtu hāniḥ syānmavibhistatva danśibhiḥ | jānvorevaṃ vijānīyā tsavyapāde śubhāpahaṃ || vāmapādetu gamanamiti prāhurmaharṣayaḥ | strīṇāṃca sarapecaiva vyatyastaṃtu phalaṃ vadet || pallī prārohaṇaṃcaiva saraṭasya prapātane | sarvāṃgeṣva śubhaṃ vidyācchāṃtiṃ kuryātsvaśaktitaḥ || śubhasthāne śubhāvāptira śubhaṃ duḥsthaleyadi | tatsvarūpaṃ suvarṇena rudrarūpaṃ tathaivaca || mṛtyaṃ jayena maṃtreṇa vastrādibhi rathārcayet | agniṃ tatra pratiṣṭāpya juhuyāttila prayasaiḥ || ācāryovāruṇaiḥ suktaiḥ kuryāttatrābhiṣecanaṃ | gaṇeśa kṣetrapālārka durgākṣoṇyaṃga devatāḥ || tāsā prītyai japaḥ kāryaśśeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret | ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyā dvitta śāṭhyaṃna kārayet || iti nāradho kta pallīsaraṭa śāṃtiḥ || atha kapota piṃgalādi śāṃtiḥ madanaratne nāradaḥ - arohettu gṛhaṃ yasya kapotovā praveśayat | sthānahānirbhave ttasya yadvanartha paraṃparā || doṣāyani dhanāyaiva daridrāyā śivāyaca | tacchāṃtiśca prakartavyā japahoma vidhānataḥ || brāhmaṇānvarayettatra svastivācana pūrvakaṃ | ṣoḍaśa dvādaśāṣṭauvā śrautasmārta kriyāparaḥ || devāḥ kapota ityādi ṛcaḥ paṃcajapetsudhīḥ | kuṃḍaṃ kṛtvā prayatnena svagṛhyokta vidhānataḥ || īśānyāṃ sthāpayedvahniṃ mukhāṃteṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ | pratyekaṃ samidājyānnaiḥ prati praṇava pūrvakaiḥ || yata iṃdra bhayā mahe svastideti triṃyabakaiḥ | tribhirmaṃtraiśca juhuyāttilaiḥ vyāhṛtibhiḥ saha || jayāṃdīṃśca tato bhaktyā kartā pūrṇāhutiṃ svayaṃ | viprebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāddoṣa śāṃtistado bhavet || brāhmaṇonbhojaye tpaścā tsvayaṃ bhujīta baṃdubhiḥ | evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā tasmāddoṣā trpamucyate || piṃgalasya svarepyevaṃ madhu valmīka yorapi | saṃpūrṇa maṃdire hāniḥ śūnya sadmani maṃgalaṃ || prākāreṣu puradvāre prāsādādyeṣu vīdhiṣu | tatphalaṃ grāmanāthasya sīmni sīmādhi pasyaca śāṃti | karmākhilaṃ kāryaṃ pūrvoktaina krameṇatu || iti kapota piṃgalādi śāṃtiḥ || athāśvina śukla pratipadi revaṃta pūjā | tatra maṃtraḥ śālihotreṇa nirdiṣṭaḥ || namo davādidevāya turaṃga balacāriṇe | sūryaputrāya devāya turaṃgāṇāṃ hitāyaca || turaṃgapariṣadyasya nṛgajoparidāvati | turaṃgapariṣadyasya nṛgajoparidāvati | sāśva maśvāparaṃ kṣetraṃ śaraṇaṃ ttvāṃ vrajāmyahaṃ || rūpanārāyaṇīyeca ācāraprāptamaṃtāṃtaraṃ yathā | sūryaputra mahābāho chāyā hṛdayanaṃdana || śāṃtiṃ karu turaṃgāṇāṃ revaṃtāya namostute | tatraiva bāhmai || āśvīja śukla pakṣetu svātīyoge śubhedine | pūrvamucchaiśravānāma prathamaṃ sūryamāvahate || tasmātsvāśvairnaraistatra pūjyo sauśraddhayā tathā | pūjanīyāstu raṃgāśca navamīyāvadevahi || śāṃtiḥ svastayanekāryā tadāteṣāṃ dinedine | dhānyaṃ bhallātakaṃ kuṣṭaṃvacā siddhārthakāstathā || paṃcaraṃgeṇa sūtreṇa tadā teṣāṃtu baṃdhayet | vāyavyai rvāruṇai ssauraiḥ śākai rmaṃtre ssavaiṣṇavaiḥ || vaiśvadevai stathā yajñe rhomākāryo dinedine | turagārakṣaṇīyāśca puruṣaiḥ śastrapāṇibhiḥ || nai vatāḍyāḥ kvacitatra nacabādhyāḥ kathaṃcana | aśvina śuklapakṣeya syāṃti dhauprātaḥ | svātīyoga stadādi navamī paryaṃtaṃ | pratimāyāṃ revaṃtapūjā pūrvaka muccaiśrśava | saṃ saṃpūjyā nyāśvān pūjaye dityardhaḥ || śālihotre - nīrājate turaṃge kṛte lohabhisārikeyajñe | abhiṣikte rājāśve tatosrūṇāṃ bhavedyatra || aśvīja śukla pakṣatithau dvitīyādi saptarātraṃtu | baḍabārūpeṣaikā svātiḥ sūryasyavahati rathaṃ || sābhāreṇākrāṃtā kruddhāyānyā nirakṣate tīkṣṇā | teṣāṃ tejastatvaṃ balaṃ ca kṛtsnāni gṛhṇati || tasmātsvātyupapāte turaṃga pīḍā bhavesmahatī | evaṃca saptarātraṃca saṃpāta evanirdiṣṭaḥ || tatra divākara kiraṇai raspṛṣṭāvājino rakṣyāḥ | śālāṃtadopaliptāṃ manoramāṃ varjitāṃ ca ravikiraṇaiḥ || nānākāraiḥ puṣpai ralaṃkṛtāṃ dūpitāṃ cataṃ kukyāt | tasyāṃ snātāsturagāḥ sapūjitāścārcitā dvitīyāyāṃ || puruṣaiḥ saśastrahastai ssaptāhaṃ rakṣitavyāstu | guggulu hiṃguyavasthāṃ satvacāpā mārgataṃḍalaṃ lohaṃ || siddhārthācailasthātva vathāryā vājināṃ kaṃṭhe | yavasthā āmalakī taṃḍulaṃ bījaṃ || vedīṃ ca kalpayitvā madhyevidānena pāvakaṃ juhuyāt | śālihotre gaditena maṃtreṇānena homayettatra || rohitāśva mahābhāga havyavājamarottama | dhūmadhvaja kratūddhāra svargasya prathitaḥ pathi || uttiṣṭha homaṃ saṃgṛhyā śāṃtiṃ kuruhayoṣuca | svāheti tatramaṃtreṇa pātayetpradhamāhutiṃ || tatra prājāpatīṃdrābhyāṃ somāya varuṇāyaca | vinasvate kuberāya suṣeṇāyā hiśāyine || ādityebhya stathāśvibhyāṃ rudrebhyo vasubhiḥsaha | viṣṇośca viśvedevānāṃ sādhyānāṃ varutāsaha || svāhākāreṇa juhuyātprathamaṃ vāvyavahane | prājāpatyādi samastebhya ekāhutiṃ rudrāṃtebhyaḥ || iti rūpanārayaṇaḥ - vidyādhara yakṣa gaṃdharva nakṣatroḍugaṇa gṛhāṇaṃ | vāsukī prabhṛtināgānāṃ paurṇamāsī devatānadīnāṃ || sāgara vasaspatīnāṃ svāhākāreṇa juhuyāt || anyobhyo devebhyo svāhā iti tisraḥ | vāditraṃ vāhanāgāre gānaṃ nityaṃ prayojayet || atikramya ca saptāha maṣṭamyāṃ snāpayeddayān || varuṇāya baliṃdattvā paścāttoyena gāhayet | aṣṭamyāṃ dvitīyādyaṣṭatithau navamyā vityarthaḥ || tataḥ śukla navamyāṃtu niṣkrāmyanagarādbahiḥ | navamyā matītāyāṃ daśamyā mityarthaḥ || tathā ca bhojarājaḥ - utsavavithiśca vitataḥ nīrājanaṃ ca bālavṛddhyai | āśvayujeṣvaṣṭamyādiṣu kurvīta yathākramaṃ nṛpatiḥ || diśi pūrvottarāyāṃtu deśe prākpravaṇaiśucau | tatra toraṇamutthāpya daśahasta samuchritaṃ || vistāreṣṭāsamākhyātaṃ dhvaja toraṇa bhūṣitaṃ | śuddhasnātvā tatovāhā snānnāhika purassaraṃ | puṇyahā brahmaghoṣaiśca gītāvādi tranisvanai || sūtamāgadhagaṃdharvai stūyamānā svalaṃkṛtāḥ | śatrahasteśca puruṣaiḥ tadaivāśvopajīvibhiḥ || taireva rakṣyāmānāśca tatra toraṇasannidhau | dakṣiṇe staṃbhavikaṭe hutvācāgniṃ purohitaṃ || aṣṭau manuṣyā avyāṃgā ulkāhasta dhvidhānvitā | tenāgnivyatihāreṇa kuryurulkā pradīpanaṃ || haviśśeṣeṇarājāśvaṃ prokṣayitvātu tarpayet | tarpayet - caruśeṣeṇa piṃḍaṃ vājine dadyādityarthaḥ || aśvārāja purodhāstu viṣṇuste purataḥ sthitaḥ | varuṇapāśahastaṃ stvāṃ pṛṣtaḥ sthitaḥ | varuṇapāśahastaṃ stvāṃ pṛṣṭataḥ parirakṣatu || vaivasvata kubherauca pārśvayorabhirakṣatāṃ | caṃdrādityau pṛṣṭhavaṃśe udire pṛthivī dharaḥ || rakṣetu vakrta gaṃdharvā balimiṃdro dadātute | haniśśeṣa baliṃ pāśya vijayārthaṃ mahīpateḥ || taṇestu prāśitaṃcāpi pūraja dviṣa jāṃbaraḥ | karṇajāya midaṃcāsya kṣidabhi śravaṇenyaset || kulābhijana saṃjāptā lakṣaṇa vyajanotthitaṃ | bhattāramata rakṣatvāṃ śivastava bhaviṣyati | arkadaṃḍa miniṣṭatvaṃ kṣamasva turagottama | evamā maṃtritauvājī brahmaghoṣa nināditaḥ || sicyamānaḥ kuśotsṛṣṭairvā rabhirmaṃtra saṃskṛtaiḥ | tatastoraṇa madhyetu maṃtribhiḥ sahapārdhivaḥ || nirgadchejja yamuddhoṣya śaiṣairanu gatohayaiḥ | kuryādāśvayujaṃkarma sarvametadviśeṣataḥ || iti rūpanārāyaṇakṛta śālihotroktāśva śāṃtiḥ || atha madanaratneśva śāṃtiḥ utpāteṣu nimitteṣu vājināmāgateṣuca | hayaśālottarebhāge sthaṃḍilaṃ tatra kalpayat || trirātro poṣita statra śāṃtiṃ kuryātpurohitaḥ | navavāsobhirāstīrṇaṃ sthaṃḍilaṃtu cutardiśaṃ || udakuṃbhāśca catvāraḥ sthāpanīyāścaturdiśaṃ | rasapātrāṇi dyāni pūrṇakaṃ bheṣu yeṣvatha || āhutiṃ juhuyādvahni ghṛtenatu samāhitaḥ | pitā mahāya rudrāya skaṃdāya varuṇāyaca || āhutiṃ juhuyādvāhni ghṛtenatu samāhitaḥ | pitā mahāya rudrāya skaṃdayā varuṇāyaca || aśvibhyāṃcaiva śarvāya śakrāyaca tathāgnaye | vāyavecātha harayośriyai devyai tathai vaca || gaṃdharvebhyaśca somā ucchai śrava evaca | devatāya bhavettatra utpātasyatukāriṇī || maṃḍaletāṃ viditvāda baliṃcātha prapūjayet | śata maṣṭādikaṃ hutvā pratidevaṃ puhohitaḥ || tatastu pūjanaṃkuryā ddevatānāṃ viśeṣataḥ | pāyasaḥ polikā dīpā dhūpa mālyāsu lepanaiḥ || madhupāyasa miśraṃ viprābhojyā ssadakṣiṇāḥ | ekaikaṃ devamuddiśya daśa saptādi paṃcavā || suvarṇaṃ caṃdanaṃ vāsogāṃca kāṃsyaṃca dakṣiṇāṃ | niṣkṛtyarthaṃ tadādeyaṃ trirātraṃtu mahī bhujaḥ || vāhaśca pūjayetsarvān svastivācodvijottamaiḥ | etaddhi śāṃtidaṃ kāryaṃ sarvotpāta vināśanaṃ || rājño vijayadaṃ pūṇyaṃ dhanadhānya vivardanaṃ || iti madanaratneś śāṃti || madanaratne gāruḍe - atha rājā prakurvīta caturdhāḥ gajavājināṃ | śāṃtiṃ mayāyattaptānāṃ tadutpannodaye pati || kaṃbhalinica nādatteyadātva śrūṇimuṃcati | tato vyādhi samutthābhiḥ pīḍyateyadā || tadā śāṃtiṃ prakurvīta gajānāṃ vājināṃ tathā | śāṃtyarthaṃ gajavājīnāṃ maṃṭapaṃ caturaśrakaṃ || dvādaśaratnimānena vitataḥ kārayetyādhīḥ | kuṃḍaṃ trimekhalaṃ kuryā dvṛttaṃvā caturaśrakaṃ || tatpurastāddakṣiṇataḥ paścimottare tathā | caturaśraṃ tataḥ kuryā tkuṃḍahastrapramāṇataḥ || koṇeṣuca tathā kārya dvṛttaṃ cārdaṃ trikoṇakaṃ | arkaiḥ khadirapālāśa bilvāśvatthairvaṭairapi || auduṃbarā apāmārgā ssamidhastatra uttamāḥ | madhye sarvasamiddhirvā pālāśai rvājya bilvaktaiḥ || tilataṃḍulalājābhiḥ saktusiddhārthaśālabhiḥ | yavairapi trimadhvakte rmadhye sarvamitisthitiḥ || dadnāca payasācaiva ghṛtena madhunāpica | koṇeṣuca tathājyena madhyetu kalaśopari || sthāpayocca tataḥ kuṃbhānaṣṭāvaṣṭhāsudikṣuca | vastrayugmai nasaṃchannā ssarṣauṣadhi samanvitān || sarvatartanayutān yukatān gaṃdhapuṣpodakairapi | caturaḥ kalaśāṃstatra caturdikṣu samaṃ tataḥ || koṇeṣu canyasetkuṃbhān jalavastrādikairyutān | smare tpradhānakuṃbhetu narasiṃhākṛtiṃ hariṃ || śaṃkha cakra gadā padma carmāsi śaraśaktayaḥ | pūrvādi kramayogena dyātavyāḥ kalaśeṣvapi || bahiḥ śakrādi dikpālā statatra ca pūjayet | pradhāna kuṃbhātpurataḥ kuryā caccakrāramaṃḍalaṃ || tatra saṃpūjya deveśaṃ paścāddhomādisādhayet | kuṃjalāgre tathā kuṃḍaṃ kuṃbhāgre kuṃḍayevaca || sarvātrā nalasaṃskāraḥ svagṛhyoktena karmaṇā | juhuyādagnisiddhyarthe sājyāhuti sahasra maṃtraḥ || samidhājya ca rūpetaṃ hutvā maṃtrī samāhitaḥ | saṃpātyājyāhutināṃ ca sahasraṃ vāyutaṃcaret || tataḥ sviṣṭakṛdādīni samāsya vidhivattataḥ | saṃspṛśannuda kuṃbhaṃca japeddaśa sahasrakaṃ || pūrvādikalaśāṃ spṛṣṭā japettatra sahasrakaṃ | anaṃtareṣu kuṃbheṣu gāyatryā praṇavenavā || ṛtvikbhiryugapatkāryaṃ homaṃ tatrapūrvavat | pratikuṃbhaṃ sahasraṃ ca japettānapyupaspṛśan || pūjayellokapālādīn gaṃdhādibhirataṃdritaḥ | atha rājā samaskuryāt nṛsiṃhādī nyathākramaṃ || kuṃbhodakena devāgre tanmaṃ treṇābhiṣecayet | paritaḥ kalaśaiścaipi nṛpayāna gajādinā || avaśiṣṭenatoyena snāpanaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ | anyavāhan dvipāṃścaiva sarvāneva samāhitaḥ || bāhyakuṃbhodakenaiva snāpayettatrasādhakaḥ | rājño nīrājanaṃ kuryā dvāhaneṣuca maṃtravit || dakṣiṇāmapyalaṃdatvā ṛtvigbhyo guravenṛpaḥ | vastra vāhana bhūmyādī nācāryāya nivedayet || ācāryo rājabhavane nṛpaṃ saṃveśaye tsvayaṃ | pūrvasnātā vaśiṣṭena kuṃbhatoyena maṃtravit || gajaśālāṃ ca saṃprokṣya vājiśālāṃ tathaivaca | siddhārtha taṃḍula tilaiḥ puṣpaiścāpyavakīryaca || śālāmadhyaṃ praviśyātha nṛsiṃhāṃ ca sudarśanaṃ | datvācāryāya gurave dhenuṃ datvā prapūjayet || grāmadānaiśca ratnaiśca vipeṃdrānyo jayetasudhīḥ | sarvābharaṇa saṃyuktāṃ rājavāho paristhitaṃ || rājānāṃ gaṃdhapūṣpādhyaiḥ kṛtvālaṃkāra saṃyutaṃ | saktubhiḥ kṛsarānnena kuryā dbhūtabaliṃ bahiḥ || tataṃ śālāsu sarvā subrāhmaṇān bhojayedbahūn | tata spaṃveśane kuryā dācāryo gajavājināṃ || evaṃ śāṃtau kṛtāyāṃtu sarvābādhā vivarjitaḥ | suputro gajayuktastu nṛpati ssamahīyate || iti madanaratne gāruḍe gajāśvādi śāṃta || atha paśumāra śāṃtiḥ paśumāra pratāpe brahmaṃḍe - yadhā paśūnāṃpura deśamadhye duṣṭavraṇāḥ krimiyutāḥ prabhavantyakāle | jvarāturaṃcāpi tadeva viṃdyānmanāksamudreka mupāgametsaḥ || tatra mātsye jvaraṃ mātraśa kṛdbhandhaḥ pramehaṃ vāvirecanaṃ || eteṣu dṛśyamānaṣu raudraśāṃti stadeṣyate || gargaḥ - vyādhayaścarakeproktā gavāṃ vakṣyāmitāṃśṛṇu | udvego hṛdayagrāhī tapanaṃ mohatā tathā || gāliṃgaḥ pūtanācaiva dāruṇo ghcakastathā | karma laṃbaśca goghnaśca daśaitaivyādha yasmsṛtāḥ || teṣāṃ rūpa samutthānāṃ śāṃtiṃcāpi bravīmite | rātrau goṣṭheṣuyāgāvo vicaraṃti yatastataḥ || aśru pramokṣaṃ kurvaṃti purīṣaṃ mūtramevaca || huṃkāraṃcaiva kurvaṃti romaṃthopina kāyate | pratiṣṭhāpya tatodevān vediṃ kuryātpramāṇataḥ || pūrṇa kuṃbhān kuśānmalyāṃ lājāśchaivātha polikāḥ | matsyaṃ māṃsaṃ supakvaṃca tathaiva tila piṃḍakān || ghṛta varṣaphatailānna narṣapā nakṣatāṃ stathā || śukla prati sarānarka samidhaśca samā haret | jāduṃbaraṃ palāśaṃca khadiraṃ bilvamevaca || aśvāddhaṃcaiva dūrvāṃca samidha statra kārayet | tato rudraṃ saṃpūjya stutiḥ || yathā - brāhmaṇā brahmaśabdena stuvaṃte sataṃtuyaṃ | saśivaḥ śāśvato devo goṣu rogānna yacchatu || pūjyate satataṃ bhaktyā viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā | śivāya śrīmate tasmai devadevaya yogine || rudrāya sthāṇave nityaṃ harāyo mādhavāyaca | pareśvarāya siddhāya maṃtra siddhi pradāyine | tryayaṃbakāya maheśāya anaṃtāya samo namaḥ || abhimaṃtryi śivaṃtoya maitai maṃtrai rvadhākramaṃ | prokṣayettu gavāṃdehaṃ tataḥ śāṃtirbhave ddhṛvaṃ || idaṃ yaḥpaṭhate goṣu rogātān su viśeṣataḥ || gośāṃti kṛtsadākālamagoṣu śāṃtirbhave ddhṛvaṃ || iti go śāṃtiḥ || paśumāra pratāpe skāṃde - deśamanyaṃ nayetkṣi pravāhanādīni dūritaḥ | revataṃ pūjayettatra mahākālaṃ hariṃ haraṃ || sahasra kalaśa snānaṃ kārayedbhaya nāśanaṃ || aśvāvāṃ vyādhayo yatra śaktyā brāhmaṇa bojanaṃ | dadyādevaṃ kṛte kṣipraṃ vyādiḥ śāmyati vājināṃ || īśvarasya kuberasya yamasya varuṇasyaca | bṛhaspate ruśanaso rmaheṃdasya vivasvataḥ | pūjāṃ kuryānnaro nityaṃ homaṃcāpi vicakṣaṇaḥ || tatra maheśvarā ssapta mahādevā dvinirgatāḥ || catvāro rāja sāsteṣu munibhiḥ parikīrtitāḥ || trayastatrā surājñeyā yecaivaghnaṃti vājinaḥ | hayaprāṇa harārājane rudrasya vaśavartinaḥ || tridinaṃcaiva saptāhaṃ savāhaṃ pakṣamevaca || tāvakatkālaṃ karma kuryātpūjaye ttāva devahi | tāva devaca hotavyaṃ graha yajña purassaraṃ || devatā prasādena rogānmuṃcati vājinaḥ || śālihotre - pnānādi karma kṛtvādha śivapūjā vidhīyate | uccai śravāhayaḥ pūjyo nakṣatreśaṃca janmanaḥ || vināyako yastuṣṭena pūjyo gaṇapatirbhavet | haya māre samutpanne hayamāra upadrave | imāṃ śāṃtiṃ pravakṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śruṇu || āhorātroṣito bhūtvā śāṃtiṃ kuryā tpurohitaḥ | catvāro brāhmaṇāstatra sahāyāstu jiteṃdriyāḥ || ṛgveda pāṭhakaścaiko dvitīyo yājuṣāṃ varaḥ | tṛtī yo ssāma vinmukhya ścaturthaśyāpya darvavit || madhye kuṃḍaṃ prakarvīta maṃṭapaṃtu samaṃ tataḥ | vidikṣu visya setkaṃbhā sṛrṇā nauṣadi saṃyutān || pūrṇa pātraṃ nyasetteṣu īśānādi krameṇatu | sarphiṣā payasādadhnā madhunāca yathā kramaṃ || pūrvakubhe prakurvīta umāṃdeveśvaraṃ vibhuṃ | dakṣiṇetu yamaṃ kuryā tpaścime varuṇaṃ tathā || uttaretu yadhābhāge yajedyai śravaṇaṃ vibhuṃ | devāśca pūjyā vidhi vadājya homa stato bhavet || tataḥ pūrvādi krameṇa devatā maṃtra japaśchābhiṣekaśca | iti śāli hotroktāśva śāṃtiḥ || iti aśva śāṃtiḥ || paraśumāra pratāpe skāde gāruḍe - aṣṭottarāyutaṃ kuryādagni sūktena vai dvijaḥ | japahomaṃca rughṛtaiḥ kharāṇāṃ śāṃti kāraṇaṃ || agniṃdūta miti sūktena || iti khara śāṃtiḥ || kṛṣṇa uvāca - mahā śāṃtiṃ pravakṣyāmi mahā devena bhāṣitāṃ | pārdhivānāṃ hitārdhāya mahādusta patāriṇī || nṛpābhiṣeke sākāryā yātrākāle nṛpasyatu | dussvapne durnimitteca rogavai guṇyasaṃbhave | midyudulkāni pāteca janmarkṣe gṛhabhedane || ketūdaye ca nirghāte kṣitikaṃpasya saḥ bhave | prasūto mūlabhejāto yamalasya saṃbhave || chatrāṇāṃ ca dhvajānāṃ ca svasthānātpatane bhuvi | kākolūka kapotānāṃ praveśe veśmanastathā || krūra grahaṇāṃ ca kreṣujanmādiṣu viśeṣitaḥ | janmani dvādaśaicaiva caturthevāṣṭame tathā || yadāsyu rgurumaṃdārā sūryaśaiva viśeṣataḥ || ārobhomaḥ - yuddhegṛhāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ sūrya śītāṃśukīlake | vastradāhedha durvāte mastake śayanāsane || yadyagniḥ paridṛśyeta rātrāviṃdra dhanustathā || veśmanaścatulābhaṃge garbheṣva śvatarīṣuca | ravibiṃbadvayedṛṣṭe mahāśāṃtiḥ praśasyate || sarvāṇidurnimittāni praśamaṃyāṃti sarvathā || tāṃkuryurbrāhmaṇāḥ paṃcakulaśīla samanvitāḥ | caturvedāstrivedāśca dvivedāścāpi pāṃjava || adharvaṇaviśeṣajñā bahvṛcāśca susaṃyutāḥ | śucayaśśrutisaṃpannā japahoma parāyaṇāḥ || kṛchropavāsanartadyaiḥ kṛtakāya viśodhanāḥ | pūrvāmārādhyamaṃtraistu prārabheyurataḥ kriyāḥ || daśadvāraśa hastaṃvā maṃṭapaṃ kārayecchubhaṃ | tanmadhye vedikākuryā caturhasta pramāṇataḥ || āgneyyāṃ kārayetkuṃḍaṃ hastamātraṃ suśobhanaṃ | mekhalātrayasaṃyuktaṃ yonyācāpi samanvitaṃ || ravīṃdroruparāgeṣu maholkā pataneṣuca | utpāteṣu tadhānyeṣu nimitteṣuca sarvaśaḥ || sarvāriṣṭopaśamanī mahāśāṃtiṃ praśasyate | cārucaṃdasamūleca toreṇālaṃkṛte tathā || gomaye noparipteca maṃṭapete dvijāyataḥ || śuklāṃbaradharāsnnātāḥ śuklamālyānulepanāḥ || karmakuryuritiśeṣaḥ - tataśca paṃcakalaśāṃ stasyāṃ vedyāṃ niveśayet | āgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu paṃcamaṃ madhyamaṃ tadhā || aṣṭapatrakṛteradme cūtapalla vadhāriṇā || brahmakūrcavidhānena paṃcagamyaṃtu kārayet || gomūtraṃ tāmravarṇāyāḥ śvetāyāścāpi gomayaṃ | payaḥ kāṃcanavarṇāyā nīlāyāśca tathā dadhi || ghṛtaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇāyāḥ sarvaṃ kapilamenaca || alābhe sarvavarṇānāṃ paṃcagavyeṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ | gomūtraṃ māṣakāsvaṣṭā gomayasyatu ṣoḍaśa | kṣīrasya dvādaśaproktaṃ dadhnastu daśakīrtitāḥ | gomūtravadghṛtasyāṣṭā tadardhaṃtu kuśodakaṃ || paṃcagavyaṃtu paṃcabhiḥ maṃtraiḥ kṛtvetyardhaḥ | auṣadhīḥ paṃcaratnāni rocanaṃ caṃdanaṃtadhā || siddhārtharkāśamīdūrvān kuśānvrīhiyavāstathā | apāmārgaśca phalavānya grodhoduṃbarastadhā || plakṣāśvattha kapitthāśca priyaṃguṃ cutavallavaṃ | hastidaṃtamṛdaṃcaiva koṇakuṃbheṣu vinyaset || phalavatīgaṃdhapriyaṃguḥ - puṇyatīrdhodakopetāḥ paṃcagavyaṃ ca madhyame | ṛucaṃ prācīmitādaṃhi vahnikuṃbhābhi maṃtraṇaṃ || āśuśśiśānūnai ṛtye yaddevāyugocare | īśāvāsyaṃ caturthasya kuṃbhasya tvabhimaṃtraṇaṃ | madyametvathajaptavyā rudrāḥ kuṃbhe yajurbhavāḥ || gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatai rmaṃtrai rnaivedyai ghṛtapāyasaiḥ || phalaiśca nārikelādyaiḥ dīpakaiḥ kuṃbhapūjanaṃ || svastivācanakaṃcaiva kāryettadanaṃtaraṃ | krameṇānena śanakairagnikārye prayojayet || agniṃ dūtamityaṃgniṃca pūrvavattu vidhāpayet || pūrvavattu kalaśasthāpanān hiraṇyagarbha miti brahmasatrayojane || kayānaścitramitica maṃtreṇa viniveśayet || kṛtvācā staraṇaṃvahne rājyasaṃskāra mevaca || athavā sādhayedyatra dravyaṃ yasya prayojanaṃ | tataḥ puruṣasūktena pāyasasayārpaṇaṃ bhavet || abhighāryātha saṃsiddaṃ pāyasaṃ sthāpayedbhuvi | aṣṭādaśapramāṇena dadyā dathaśamīmayān | pālāśā ssamidhaḥ saptasaptate iti dāpayet | āgharāvājyabhāgautu hutvā pūrvakrameṇatu || juhuyā dāhutī ssaptajātavedasya itvṛcā | sthālīpākena juhuyā tpunarvai jātavedase | taratsamaṃdasūktena catasrojuhuyātattaḥ || idaṃ viṣṇustataḥ saptajuhuyā dāhutiṃnṛpaḥ | nakṣatrebhya statohutvā saptaviṃśati rāhutī || nakṣatrāhutayaśca kṛttikādibhyaḥ | svāhetyādibhi rmaṃtrai kāryaḥ || tatra rohiṇīdvaya puṣyahastādi trayānūrāda | titrayābhijadvaya śatibhiṣagrevatī ṣvekavacanaṃ | punarvasū phalguvīdvaya viśākhāśvinīṣu dvivacanaṃ || śeṣeṣu bahuvacanaṃ - triyaṃbakena juhuyā ttataḥ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ punaḥ || gṛhahoma ntataḥkāryastilai rājyaplutaiḥ | prāyaścittaṃ tatohutvā homakarmasamāpayet || tatastūrya vinighoṣaiḥ kāhalā śaṃkha nisvanaiḥ | yajamānasya kartavyohyabhiṣekaṃ dvijottamaiḥ || kārṣmarya vṛkṣa saṃbhūte same bhadrāsane sthitaṃ | kāṣmaryaḥ śrīparṇī - vedīmadhyagataṃ kṛtvā durnimitta praśāṃtaye | paṃcabhiḥ kalaśaiḥ pūrṇermaṃtrai retairmadhā kramaṃ || sahasrākṣeṇa pradhamaṃta taśaiva śatāyuṣā | sajoṣā iṃdra itica viśvāni varuṇeca || drupadādi vetica tatassnāpayeyuḥ samāhitāḥ | tato diśāṃbalaṃdadyā dvichitrānna samanvitaṃ || namo astviti sarvatra maṃtra meta mudāharet | snātasya brāhmaṇāssarve paṭheyuḥ śāṃti muttamāṃ || śāṃtitoyena dārāṃcapāta yitvā namaṃ tataḥ | puṇyāhavācanaṃ kṛtvā śāṃtikarma samāpayet || tīrthe devālayovāpi godohaṃkāyedbudhaḥ | kṣitiṃ hiraṇyaṃvāsāṃsi śayanānyāsanānica || viprebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādyadhā śaktyā vimatparaḥ | dīnānāthavi śiṣṭhebhyo dadyāccaivaṃ yudhiṣṭiraṃ || bhojanaṃcā viśaṃ dadyāttata ssarvaṃ prasiddhyati | āyuśca labhate dīrghaṃ śatrūṃ nvijayatekṣaṇāt || durgāṇicāsya siddhyaṃti putrāṃśca labhate śubhān | yathā śastra pravāhāṇāṃ kavacaṃ vāraṇaṃ bhavet || tathā daivopa ghājānāṃ śāṃtirbhavati vāraṇau | ahiṃsa kasyadāṃtasya dharmirjita dhanapyaca | dayā dākṣiṇyā yuktasya sarve sānugrahāgrahāḥ || ardhān samardha yati vardayateca dharmaṃ | kāmaṃ prasātha yatitasya pinaṣṭi pāpaṃ || yaḥ kārayetsa kaladoṣaharīṃ mahārdhāṃ śāṃtiṃ | praśāṃta hṛdayaḥ puruṣassadaiva || iti bhaviṣyokta mahā śāṃtiḥ || tatra mahābhāratastha kṛṣṇa sahasranāma stotra maṃtrasyāyutaṃ sraṃ vājapaḥ kāryaḥ || taduktaṃ bhārate - rogārto mucyate rogā dbaddho mucyeta baṃdhanāditi || tathā - bhīṣmaparvasthārjuna kṛta durgā stotraṃvā pūrva saṃkhyayā japet || taduktaṃ tatraiva - vivāde jaya māpnoti baddo mucyeta jaṃdhanāditi || ubhayatra tadda śāṃśena pāyasena tilai rvāhomaḥ || tathā - harivaṃśasthaṃ anirudda kṛta māyā stotro kṛṣṇā vatārasthaṃcāryā stotraṃ bali kṛtaṃ vamana stotraṃvā japet || ṛgnidhānepi - khaddovāpya varuddhovā vāgatyaḥ prayutaṃ japet | yāṃstānādidya daivatyān sadyo mucyeta baṃdhanāt || tathā thṛvāsitvā japenmaṃtraṃtya yutaṃ śṛṃkhalādinā | baṃdhanāmmacyate satyaṃ nārīvā puruṣopivā || taddinaṃ naktamudu ttama mitidvayorvā japaḥ kāryaḥ | varuṇasya tārkṣasya vāpalena tadardhenavā kṛtāṃ suvarṇa pratimāṃdadyāt || anyepi vaṭuka bhairava stotrasya kārtavīrya stotrasya japādayojñeyāḥ | yadvā maṃtrakośetā rohīlīyugaṃ baṃdīdevījñeyā namoṃtakā || ekādaśakṣaro maṃtrai bhairavastriṣṭubhaḥ punaḥ | baṃdī mucayādibhiḥ proktā ekena dyṛṃśa kaṃgakaṃ || vidhāya saṃnmare baṃdī ratnasiṃhāsana sthitāṃ | sattoya pādhoda samāna kāṃtī saṃbhoja yāṣakarī rahastāṃ || surāṃganārādhita pādapadmāṃ bhajāmi baṃdī bhavabaṃdhamuktyai | lakṣayugmaṃ japenmaṃtraṃ pāyasainnairdaśāṃ śataḥ || hutvā pūrvodite pīṭhe pūjaye dbaṃdhamuktaye | aṣṭadaśa padmagaṃdhai caturasre ityarthaḥ || aṃgapūjā kesareṣu śaktayaḥ patramadhyagāḥ | pīṭhapūjāṃ kṛtvā ṣaḍaṃgāni pūjayet || kāmadā mānadāsaktā madhurā madhurānanā | narmadā bogadānaṃdā prāṇapīṭhe śvaśaktayaḥ | manohata baṃdī yogapīṭhe mama iti pīṭha | pūjāṃ kṛtvā śaktiṃ pūjayodityarthaḥ || kālī tārā bhagavatī kaḍbāsā śītalāpica | tripurāmātyakā lakṣmirdigīśā āyudhānica || evamārādhitā baṃdī prayacchedīpsitaṃ nṛṇaāṃ | ekaviṃśa tyahorātraṃ tvayutaṃ pratyahaṃ japet || vāgbījaṃ bhuvaneśānī ramā baṃdīca keśavaḥ | amuṣya baṃdhatomekṣaṃ kuruyugmaṃ jaḍadvayaṃ || vasucaṃdrārṇa maṃtroyaṃ kṣipraṃ baṃdī vimokṣadaḥ | aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ bhava āyuṣyaṃ baṃdhamokṣaṃ kuru kuru svāhā svāhā || iti maṃtraḥ - tasminnapūpe saṃpūjya baṃdī māvaraṇānvitāṃ | rākāniketanasthāya mitrāya pratyahaṃ suhṛt || saśuddhovāgyato bhūtvā bhakṣayettamapūpakaṃ | tasmin saṃbhakṣite baṃdho mucyate baṃdhanāddhrutaṃ || evaṃ vaikathitāṃ baṃdī smaraṇādbaddamuktidā || iti śāṃtiratne baṃdhamokṣaḥ || athāta śṛṇurājeṃdra śakrotthānaṃ mahotsavaṃ | yaṃ kṛtvā nṛpatiryāti nakadāci tparābhavaṃ || tathā || arjunaścāśvakarṇaśca priyakodhava evaca | uduṃbaraśca paṃcaite ketvarthe satvacasmatā || anyeca devadārvā diśālādyāstaravastadhā | nacavṛkṣaṃ rujedrātau pṛṣṭvāmaṃtra midaṃpaṭhet || rujedbhedayet || atrā yama kramaḥ - yānivṛkṣaṣu bhūtāni tebhyaḥ svasti namo namaḥ || upahāraṃ gṛhītvemaṃ kriyate vāsavadhvajaḥ | vanaspate prārthayetvāṃ svastinostu nagottama || dhvajārthaṃ devadevasya chitvā caturaṃgulaṃ | tatonītvā puradvāraṃ ketunirmāya tatravai | śuklāṣṭamyāṃ bhādrapade ketuvediṃ praveśayet || dvātriṃśa hastamānaṃtu adhayaḥ keturucyate || dvātriṃśastu tato jyāyāṃśca tustrīśa ttatovaraḥ | kumāryaḥ paṃcakartavyāḥ śakrasya nṛpasattama || śālimapyastutāḥ sarvāḥ aparācakamātṛkāḥ | keto pādapramāṇena kāryāḥ śakrakumārikāḥ || mātṛkārtha pramāṇaṃtu yatra hastadvayaṃ tathā | evaṃkṛtvā kumārīśca mātṛkāṃtetu evaca || mātṛkārtha pramāṇaṃtu yatra hastadvayaṃ tathā | evaṃkṛtvā kumārīścamātṛkāṃtetu evaca || ekadaśyāṃsitepakṣe yāṣṭināmadhivāsanaṃ | adhivāsya pratimāṃ kuryātkāṃcavīṃdīravīṃ tathā || anytaijana bhūtāvā sarvābāleca mṛṇmayī || tāṃ maṃḍalasya madhyetu pūjayitvā viśeṣataḥ | tataḥ śubhe mūhūrtetu ketumutthāpaye nṛpaḥ || vajrahasta surārighna bahunetra puraṃdhara | kṣemārdhaṃ sarvalokānāṃ pūjeyaṃ pratigṛhyatāṃ || ehyehi sarvāmarasiddhasaṃghai rabhiṣṭato vajradharāmareśa | samutthitastvaṃ śravaṇāṃghripāde gṛhāṇa pūjāṃ bhagavannamaste || iṃdra maṃtreṇa taṃtreṇa nānānaivedya caṃdanaiḥ | ghaṭeṣu daśadikpālān gṛhān sthāpya prapūjayet || sādhyādīn sakalān devān mātṛ ssarvāśca pūjayet | tataḥ śubhe mūhurteca janivardaka saṃcutaḥ || ketusthāpana bhūmiṃca yajñavedyāśca paśmime | śiṣṭeḥ purohitai ssarthaṃgacchedrājā sumaṃgalaiḥ || kumārī bhiśca saṃyukto dikpālānāṃca pallavaiḥ | yadhā varṇo yadhādeśo yojitairvarṇa veṣcitaṃ || citra mālyāṃbaraścāpi cārubiścāpito raṇaiḥ | utpāta ynnahā ketuṃ rājā mātyaiśsanaiḥ śanaiḥ || tāmra pratimayāyukte ketau śakraṃ viciṃtayet pūjaye tpārva vattatra śacīṃ mātali mevaca || jayaṃtaṃ tanayaṃ tasya ceṃdra mairāvataṃ tathā | gṛhāṃścāpyatha dikpālān sarvāśca gaṇadevatāḥ || pūjitānāṃca devānāṃ homaṃcāpi samācaret | homāṃtetu baliṃ dadyā dvāsavāya mahātmane || tilaṃghṛtaṃ cākṣataṃca puṣsaṃ dūrvāstathaivaca | etai retān svasvamaṃtrairjuhuyustānna rottamaḥ || tato homāna sānetu brāhmaṇānapi pūjayet | evaṃ prapūjaye nnityaṃ saptarātraṃ dine dine || trātāramiti maṃtroyaṃvā savasya priyaṃsadā | evaṃ kṛtvātu bhāvena śakrotthāpana māditaḥ || śravaṇarkṣa yutāyāṃtu dvādaśyāṃ pārdhiva svayaṃ | āṃtya pāde bharaṇyāṃtuniśi śakraṃ vivarjayet || sapteṣu sarvalokeṣu yadhārājā napaśyati | sārthaṃ surāsura gaṇaiḥ puraṃdara śatakrato || upahāraṃ gṛhītvemaṃ māheṃdra dhvajagottama | utpāte saptarātrāṇī tadhopaplava darśane || vyatītya śanibhaumauca anyarkṣepi vivarjite | yathā rakṣo nṛpaḥ ketuṃ nṛpate śakuni stathā || śanaiḥ pātu mahotpātai stathotthāpana māditaḥ | vinṛjya sarvaketuṃca sālaṃ kāraṃ tathāniśi || kṣipepanena maṃtreṇa agādhe salile nṛpaḥ | tiṣṭhaketo mahābhāga yāvatsaṃ patparaṃ jale || bhagavan saryalokānā maṃtarāyaṃ vināśaya | utthāpaye tanṛvaraiḥ sarvalokasya vai punaḥ || evaṃ yaḥ kurute pūjāṃ vāsavasya mahātmanaḥ | natasya rājye durbhikṣaṃ netayo dharmavarjitāḥ || iti kālikāpurāṇe śakradhvajocchrayaḥ || āyuṣkāmiyainavāḍu tana janma nakṣatramaṃdunu janmatāra yaṃduni janmatithiyaṃdunu krūra kālaṃbulalonu īyāmuṣyahomamunu ceyucu vaccinavāriki āyurvṛddhigalgi vardhilledaru tadaku saṃvatsaramuda kokatūriyainanu tana puṭṭina danamunāḍu ceyuṭa mikkili maṃcidi madanaratne śaunakaḥ - āyuṣya homaṃ vakṣyāmi śaunakohaṃ dvijanmanāṃ | kuryāttu janma nanakṣatre viṣuve saṃkrame tathā || paurṇamāsyā mamāyāṃ vāgrahe caṃdra sūryayoḥ | alaṃkṛtvā svastivācya mannaṃ dadyāddhvijātaye || athājya bhāgaparyaṃtaṃ avadānasya saṃpadā | anobhadrāḥ kratava ityṛ cāṃdaśa kenatu || imaṃstoma marhata ityṛcāṃ ṣoḍaśakenaca | jātavedasetyapyṛjāhu netviṣṭa kṛtaṃ tataḥ || homaśeṣaṃ samāpyātha brāhmaṇān bhojaye ttataḥ | svastivācya dvijānannairdenuṃ dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ || ityāyuṣya homaḥ ā yu ssu ktā ṃ yobrahma brahmāṇa ujjahāra prāṇaiśśiraḥ kṛttivāsāḥ pinākī | īśānodevassana āyurdadhātu tasmai juhomiha viṣāghṛtena svāhā - īśānāyedaṃ || || vibhrājamāna ssarirasyamadhyā drocamāno gharmarucirva āgāt | samṛtyu śāpāśādapa sudyaghorā dihāyuṣeṇo ghṛtamattudevaḥ - gharmarucaya idaṃ || || bṛṃhajjyoti rbrahmapatnīgha garbhaṃ yamādadhātpuru rūpaṃ jayaṃtaṃ | suvarṇaṃbha grahamarkamarcaṃta māyuṣe vardhayāmo ghṛtena - brahmaṇejyotiṣa idaṃ |||| śriyaṃ lakṣmī maupalāmaṃbikāṃgāṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ jayāmiṃdrassetyudāhuḥ | tāṃ vidyāṃ brahmayoniṃ sarūpāmihāyuṣe tarpayāmo ghṛtena - brahmayonaya idaṃ || || dākṣāyaṇya ssarvayonya ssayonya ssahasraśo viśvarūpā varūpāḥ | sasūnava ssapataya ssayūdhya āyuṣeṇo ghṛtamidaṃ juṣaṃtāṃ - dākṣāyaṇībhya idaṃ || || divyāgaṇā bahurūpāḥ purāṇā āyuccidona prabudhnaṃtu vīrāḥ | tebhyojuhomi bahudhā ghṛtena mānaḥ prajāṃrīriṣo mota vīrān - dākṣāyaṇībhya idaṃ || || ekaḥ purastādya idaṃ babhūvayato babhūva bhujanasya gopāḥ | yamapyeti bhuvanaṃ sāṃparāye sanoha virghṛta mihāyaṣettudevaḥ - īśānāya brahmaṇa idaṃ || || vasū nrudrānādityā nmarutotha sāthyānna bhūnnakṣān gaṃdharvāṃśca pitrūṃśca viśvān | bhṛgūn sarpāṃścāṃgirasotha sarvān ghṛtaṃ hutvā svāyuṣyaṃ mahayāmaśaśvat - vasvādibhya idaṃ || || viṣṇo tvanno antamaśśarma yaccasahantva | pratedhārā madhuścuta utsaṃduharate akṣitaṃ - viṣṇava idaṃ || || ityekāhutiraṃte || <8> māsi māsi pratyabdaṃvā janmartre kuhū śanivāra saṃkramaṇa caṃdrasūrya grahaṇādiṣu janmanakṣatra yoge jvārādi mahāvyādhi pīḍāyāṃvā apamṛtyu parihārārthaṃ āyuṣya homaṃ kuryāt || || vighneśvara pūjā purassaraṃ rāśau jātasyāmuka śarmaṇaḥ āmukadoṣa nivṛtyarthaṃ karma kartuṃ ācāryaṃtyāṃ vṛṇī mahā ititayācāryaṃ vṛtvā | ācāryaḥ āmuka nakṣatre rāśau jācasyāmuka śarmaṇaḥ āyukadoṣa nivṛtyarthaṃ māyuṣya homākhyaṃ karma kariṣya iti saṃkalpya deva yajanollekha nādyagniṃ pratiṣṭhapya praṇītā praṇayanāntaṃ kṛtvāgnerīśānyabhāge taṃḍulai ścaturaśraṃ sthaṃḍilaṃ kṛtvāṣcadala padmaṃ nilikhya tadupari kastūrī kuṃkumādi vāsita puṇya tīrthapūritaṃ paṃcatva kpaṃca pallavādi śobhitaṃ nārikela vastramugma sahitaṃ kuṃbhaṃ nidhāya tasmin karṣamātra suvarṇa nirmitāṃ mṛtyuṃjaya devatā pratimāṃ paṃcagavyādinā saṃśuddhāṃ nidhāya tryaṃbakamiti maṃtreṇa mṛtyuṃjaya devatā māvāhya sarvopacārai ssaṃpūjya prāṇa carumāyuṣmaccaruṃca pratyekaṃ nirvāpaṇa dharmeṇa śrapayiputvābhighārya pracīna mūdī cīnaṃvodvāsya pratiṣṭhata mabhighābrahmajya saṃskārādyagni mukhāntaṃ kṛtvā āyuṣmaccaroravadāna dharmeṇāvadā yāmuṣṭe viśaavato dadhatiti pūronuvākyā manūcyāyurdā agniiti yājyayā hutvā sviṣṭakṛta mavadāyānnataḥ paridhi sādayitvāṣṭau ṣaṭcaturovā brāhmaṇānvṛtvātairyo brahmetyādyaṣṭa bhirghṛta sūkteryā vadaṣṭottara sahasra mājyā hutī rupajuhotyaṃtime paryāye viṣṭotvanno antama iticahutvātairyo brāhmatyādyaṣṭa bhirghṛta mitivyanno antama itihutvā pratisvāhakāraṃhuta śeṣamājyaṃ prāṇacarau saṃpātaṃ ninayda muka syāpa mṛtyurnaśyatvā yurvardhitā mitivyastābhi ssamastā bhirvyāhṛtibhiḥ prati maṃtraṃ juhuyā dathasviṣṭakṛtaṃ havyavāhamiti hutvā jayādi taṃtraśeṣaṃ samāpya kuṃbhe punaḥ pūjāṃkṛtvā devamudvāsya vāruṇai rabliṃgairmārjayitvā hutaśeṣānne nāgnḥ purastādbahiḥ paristarāddūrvā nṛkṣatodakaṃninīya namo astu vastra pratimādi datvā dakṣiṇāmṛtvigbhyodatvā doṣa tāratamyānusāra mapamṛtyu nivāraṇārdhaṃ tila kūṣṇāṇḍāyaḥ piṇa kṛṣṇa kaṃbalādi dānaṃ katvā bhūritānaṃkṛtvā brāhmaṇān bhojayedityāha bhagavān bodhāyanaḥ - kecidāyuṣmaccaroḥ pradānāhutiṃ hutvāyobrahmetyādyupahomaṃ tadanna samidājyaiḥ kurvanti śeṣaṃ samānaṃ || iti āyuṣya homa prayogaḥ || atha apamṛtyu nivāraka śāṃtividhānaṃ ī mṛtyuṃjaya vidhānaṃbu apamṛtyu prāstamainappuḍunu, rogopodravamulace bahukālamu pīḍiṃpabaḍunappuḍunu atyāvaśyaka mugā ceyuṭa śreyassādhakaṃbu athapa mṛtyunivāraṇaṃ - madanaratne bodhāyanaḥ - atha mṛtyuṃjayakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmo janmanakṣatre puṇyanakṣatre trijanma nivāra brāhmanannena parituṣya puṇyāhaṃ svastiṛddhiritivāca yitvā devayajanollekhanā dyagnimukhāṃtaṃ kṛtvā sāvitryāyavān pakvān juhoti prādeśamātrāsti srodūrvā samiddhoṣṭa sahasra maṣṭa śataṃvā dadhi madu ghṛta payāṃsisaṃmelyā bhyajyā dadhāti || || apaitu paraṃmṛtyo mānomahaṃtaṃ mānastoke triyaṃbakaṃ || || ete sahasra mityathājyāhutīru juhoti | mṛtyurnaśya tvāyurvartha tāṃbhū svāhā || || mṛtyurnaśya tvāyurvarthatāṃ bhuva svāhā | mṛtyurvaśya tvāyurvarthatāṃsvaṃ svāhā | mṛtyurnaśya tvāyu varthatāṃ būrbhuvassvu svāhā || iti sviṣṭaka tprabhṛti siddhamādhenu varapradānā dathāgneṇāgniṃ dūrvāstaṃbhe huta śeṣaṃ baliṃ dadhāti taccaṃ yorāvṛṇī maha ityatha dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti dhenuṃ vṛṣabhamanaḍvāhaṃ hayaṃ hiraṇyaṃ kāṃsyaṃvā sovetyāhā bhodāyanaḥ || athakramaḥ - kartāṣṭā caturovā viprān saṃpūjya puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā saṃkalpāgniṃ pratiṣṭāpya nirvāpaṇādinā sāvitryācaruṃ śrapayitvājya bhāgāṃtecaru mavadāya sāvitrī mānūcya tadaivahutvāti svastisro dūrvā gavyaṃ dadhyādyaktā apaitumṛtyuriti ṣaḍbhiḥ ṣaḍgṛhītāni hutvā brahma visarjanāṃtegne ragreṇadūrvā staṃbheskṣato dakaṃ ninīya hutaśeṣeṇa tacchaṃyoriti baliṃ datvākṣatodakaṃ ninīyāgnaṃ saṃpūjya sūryaṃ namaskṛtya viprān bhojayet || evaṃ svakartṛtve - ācāryapakṣe grahayajñaṃ dinatrayaṃ rogiṇāṃ kāryaḥ | prajalarogo yāvadroga nivṛttistāvat pratyahaṃ kāryaḥ || atha mahā mṛtyuṃjayādurvā guḍūcī homāḥ atha mahā mṛtyuṃjaya homaṃ vyākhyāsmāmaḥ - kuryādrogebhicāre dīrgharoge grahapīḍāyāṃ mṛtyuṃ prāpto mahāvyādhau mahāpadi caṃdra sūrya grahamadoṣe janmanakṣatre viṣanāḍhyāṃ kuhūyoge vānyeṣu mahāmayeṣu parihārārthaṃ māsi māsi janmanakṣatre prokaiprokaikāle vatsarevā ācāryeṇāvā svayaṃvā āyuṣkāmaḥ kuryāt || snātvā puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā prāṇānāyamyamukaśarmaṇa āyuṣkāmo mahā mṛtyuṃjaya homaṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpāgne rupasamānādhi pātra prayogakāle dūrvātrikanyaṣaṭtraṃiśa dadhikaṃ śatapatra māsādayet || guḍācī khaṃḍāni caturaṃgula pramāṇāni brāhmaṇaṃ dakṣiṇato darbheṣu niṣādya vrīhi tuṃḍulānnirvapāmīti tūṣṇīmavahatān kṛtvā prakṣālyājyaṃ saṃskṛtya caruṇā saha paryagnikaraṇaṃ kṛtvā sruvasrucamārjanaṃ saṃskṛtya caruṇā saha parvagnikaraṇaṃ kṛtvā sruvasrucamārjanaṃ paṃcāvattinobhi ghāryaḥ || apetu mṛtyuṃ śacīpatiritastaṃ puronuvākyā manūcya paraṃmṛtyo amaparehivīrā nityantayājyayā juhoti - mṛtyuvadamitityāgaḥ || pūrvādupastīryāvadāya harigṃ
