saktabhojī mitāharaspaṃ srayansaṃ staraṃsadā || || naitaṃ purāyuṣo mṛtayurnayatena suta prajaṃ | phalāhāro jayenmṛtyuṃ tribhirvaśyo mitāśanaḥ || yadvātatraiva || kṣīṇāyuriti manyeta kaṃcidyassuhṛdaṃ priyaṃ | yutteya miti susnātaḥ tasyamūrdhnāna sūlabhet || sahasra kṛtvaḥ paṃcāhaṃ japedāyurlabhetasaḥ || ghṛtena siṃdu dvīpasya sūktenainaṃca lepayet | saṃviśeccha yanenityame tanmaṃtraṃ japetalai || jīvāmīti prayuṃjīta nityametāṃ gṛhevasan | srotāṃbhasya bhyajyagātrāṇi sukhī bhavati vijvaraḥ || anyeca lakṣapārthipa pūjādayo matkṛte pūrva kamalākare jñeyāḥ || tathā || rudreṇa tila tailena rudrābhiṣekopyapa mṛtyu parihāraḥ | rudra vidhānaṃca vakṣyāmaḥ || iti apamṛtyu nivāraṇaṃ || a nā vṛṣṭi pa ri hā ra ḥ athānāvṛṣṭi śāṃtiḥ || ṛgvidhāne - athāvaheti sūktāṃtu vṛṣṭikāmaḥ prayojayet | nivāhāraḥ klinnavāsā abhireṇa pravarṣati || hutvāyutaṃ vaitasīsāṃ kṣīrāktnānāṃhutāśane | mahadvarṣa mavāpnoti sūktenābdaitenahi || tatraiva - nābhidaghnaṃ vigāhyaṃbhaḥ prāṅmukhaḥ prayataśśuciḥ | sūktābhyāṃ trivṛdetākhyā mupatiṣṭhe ddivākaraṃ | trisrovācaḥ parjasya ehityādaya ityarthaḥ || anaśnatātu japtavyaṃ vṛṣṭikāmena yatnataḥ | paṃcarātre vyatītetu mahadvārṣa mavāpnuyāt || tādvā tatraiva || vṛṣṭikāmo yatāhāraḥ prapadyeta bṛhaspatiṃ | pāyasenopa hareṇa homenaca namanvitaḥ | bṛhaspate atītyeta dvṛṣṭikamaḥ prayojayet | parjanyaṃca namaskṛtya vṛṣṭiṃ viṃdati śobhanāṃ || ityānāvṛ,ṭiḥ vaikhāyanaḥ - adātaḥ parjanyaḥ vṛṣṭiṃ vyākhyāsyāmo brāhmaṇān vedapāragān pūrva mabhyarcya varuṇa pratighāṃ pūjayitvodake sthitvā varuṇaṃdhyātvā tatsavituriti paccordarcaśosnavānaṃ vedādīn japatī maṃmme varuṇeti paṃcarca muduttama mitiṣaḍṛcaṃ yadaṃti yaccheti udāyuṣāmahagṃ iṃdroya ojasāvāca miṃdriyoṇayovainastadaśa maitrā varuṇī masausārīṃ varuṇaṃ prajāpatiṃ varuṇāya vāyuvetā dvehiraṇya varṇāḥ || pavamāno vṛṣāso āgṃśuḥ siṃdheyo sauyopasūdi sarvānuvākān suvarṇaṃ sahasraśīrṣādbhyaśca ādityovai pṛthivī samityanuvākān paṭhitvā jalādbhahirgatvā pratyuṅmakho bhūtvā pīvonnāmityanuvāke mekādaśa vāraṃ japitvā | punarmāruta masīti caturonuvākān japitvā ehiparjanya | ehivaruṇa - ehyapāṃpate - purovātaṃ janaya janaya - paścādvātaṃ śamaya śamaya - sadya ssuvṛṣṭiṃ dhehiparjanyo mityucaistraṃ vāraṃ japet | nibhaṇḍakasuta śrīmān - ṛṣya śṛṃgāya - yasmakeśeṣu - maitrāvaruṇīṃ dvirūpā mālibheta - māruta masīti caturonuvākān - parjanyāya pragāyeteti - varṣapradaṃ - apohiṣṭheti - hiraṇya śṛṃgamiti jahitvā śukla vastrāṇi dhārayantataḥ parjanya homaṃ kariṣye iti saṃkalpya vidhi vadagniṃ pratiṣṭhāviṃśativān purovāto varṣanniti juhuyādṛṣān yapuro vātāyetyuddeśa tyāgaḥ || tato jayādīn pūrṇāhutiṃ hutvā śāṃtipāṭhaṃ kuryādācāryāya varuṇa pratimāmṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇāmiti sāmānya parjanya vidhiḥ || iti parjanya śāṃtiḥ || atha ṛgvidhāne viniyukta maṃtrāṇaāṃ sāmānya vidhiḥ tatraiva - punaścaraṇa mādautu karmaṇāṃ siddhikārakaṃ | keśaśmaśṛloma nakhānvāpayitvā plutaśśuciḥ || tiṣṭhe dahanirātrautu śucirā śītavāgyataḥ | satyavādī pavitrāṇi japecca vyāhṛtī stadā || oṃkārādyāṃ stutīn japtvā sāvitrīṃ catadityṛcaṃ | apohiṣṭheti sūktaṃtu śuddhavatyoghamarṣaṇī || śaṃvatyaḥ svastimaṃtryaśca pāpamānastadhaivaca | sarvatrai tatprayo ktavya mādāvaṃte ca karmaṇāṃ || āsahasrādāśatā dvātaddaṃśāṃ śamathojapet | oṃkāra vyāhṛtiḥ stisraḥ sāvitrī mathavāyutaṃ | tarpayedadbhistathācārya ṛṣīṃ śchaṃdāṃsidaivatān | prapadyeti virūpākṣa raudra maṃtragaṇaṃ japet || ānāryairnacabhāṣeta naśūdrairnāpigarhitaiḥ | narasvalayānāryā patitai rnāṃtyajairnṛbhiḥ || maṃgaśācāryayuktasyā trirahnobhyapayannṛpaḥ | aṃte dvādaśarātrasyā tsalīpākaṃ prakalpayet || agneye cādhasomāya tṛtīyāca tayossaha | vaiśvadevī ca raudrī ca juhuyāduttare tathā || avasānasya pataye tathā mamatayepica | dhanvaṃtarāya ityanyā gaṃdharvāpsarasāmapi || daśamī brāhmaṇaspatyā varātu brahmaṇesmṛtā | sarasvatī tadheṣṭoroṃ tyāsauṣiṣṭakṛttathā || ājyāhutayaevādau sthālīpākehute punaḥ | hutvāgniṃ tarpayodviprān pitṛbhyaśca prakalpayet || hutaṃśeṣaṃ vidhānena śucirbhuṃjīta vāgyataḥ | tathā prājāpatyakṛchraṃ kṛtvā cāṃdrāyaṇādyapi || ebhirvratairvipūtātmā kuryā tkarmāṇyataṃdritaḥ | iṣṭānkāmāṃ stataḥ sarvā navāpnoti nasaṃśayaḥ || kaṇapiṃṇyākatakrāṇā mekaikaṃ śodhanaṃ bhavet | evaṃ śuddhapyakarmāṇi maṃtrairyakṣyuṃtu tadyadhā | trirātra mevopavase dāditaḥ sarvakarmaṇāṃ | trīṇina ktāni vākuryā ttataḥ karmasamārabhet || tathā - sarvatra dakṣiṇāṃdadyā ddānaṃvā siddhikāmadaṃ | natvevā dakṣiṇaṃ karma kiṃcida stīti śaunakaḥ || śaktyāthapūrṇapātreṇa saṃmitāyata bodhavet | vṛṣabhaidaśa dadyā dyenavātuṣyate guruḥ || iti ṛgvidhānokta maṃtrasāthanaṃ a tha śrī sū kta vi dhi ḥ ṛgvidhāne - yaicchedvaradāṃ devīṃ śriyaṃ nityaṃkulaisthitāṃ | saśuciḥ trayatobhūtvā juhuyādājyamanvahaṃ | śrīyaḥ paṃcadaśarmaṃca śrīkāmassatataṃ japet | āvāhaye chriyaṃpadme paṃcabhiḥ kanakepivā || upaharānupahāracchuklān bhakṣyānpayodadhi | sthālīpākaṃ ca śālīnāṃ payasā saṃprakalpayet || cāṃdrāyaṇa vipākassyā tprapadye tprayataḥ śiyraṃ | sarvauṣadhībhiḥ sārābhi ssnātvādbhiḥ pāvanairapi || upaiṃtumāṃ devasakha iti rājñobhiṣecanaṃ | manasaḥ kāmityeva paśukāmābhiṣecanaṃ || kardamenetiyaḥsnāyān prajākāmaḥ śucivrataḥ | aśvapūrvāmitisnāyā drājyakāma śucirvratī || rohite carmaṇisnāyāt brāhmaṇastu yathāvidhi | rājā carmaṇive yāghre kṣatriyastvatha raurave || bastacarmaṇivaiśastu homaḥkārya stvanaṃtaraṃ | caṃdrāmititu padmāni juhuyātsārpiṣādvijaḥ || ādityavarṇa ityanayā bilvahome vidhīyate | bilvastha evavāgnisyāt sthālīpākaṃhune dvijaḥ || daśasahastrīkohomaḥ śrīkāmaḥ prathamovidhiḥ | hutvātu prayutaṃ samyaganaṃtāṃ viṃdeta śriyaṃ || ayutaṃ śatakṛtvastu japvā śriyamupāśnute | anaṃtā mavyaciccinnāṃ śāśvatīṃ viṃdateśriyaṃ || asaktaujapa evai kodaśa sāhastrīko paraḥ | japtvātu prayutaṃ samyaganaṃtāṃ viṃdyate śriyaṃ || ayutaṃ śatakṛtvāstu japtvā śriyamupāśnute | juhuyānnityaṃ padmānyayutakeśini || dṛṣṭvā śriyaṃtūparame tkilāsatvāddvijastuvai | bilvāśī bilvanilayaḥ śuddhabilvāni sarpiṣau || ekaviṃśati rātreṇa parāṃ siddhiṃ vindadi | padmānyathāpī bilvāni satyakāmassamṛcchati || atra viṣṇudharmeṣu puṣkara uvāca - hiraṇyavarṇāṃ haraṇīṃ mṛcaḥ paṃcadaśa dvija | śrīsūktaṃ kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ ṛgvede puṣṭivardanaṃ || rathe aśveṣu vājeṣu catusraśca tathā ṛcaḥ | sūktametadvajurvede kathitaṃ puṣṭivardanaṃ || śriyaṃtiyaṃ tathā sāma sāmavede prakīrtitaṃ | śriyaṃdī dātumayidehi proktamādharvaṇe tathā || śrīsūktaṃyo japet bhaktyā tasyāslakṣmīrvinaśyati | juhuyāthyaśca dharmajño haviṣyeṇa viśeṣataḥ || śrīsūktenatu padmānāṃ ghṛtāktānāṃ bhṛgūttama | ayutaṃ homayedyastu vahnau bhakti yuto naraḥ || padmahastadvayālakṣmī rbhajaṃta mupatiṣṭhati | daśaiyutaṃtu padmānāṃ juhuyādyastathājale || nāpaititatkulāllakṣmirviṣṇorvakṣagatā yathā | ghṛtāktānāṃtu bilvānāṃ hutvā rāmāyutaṃ tathā | jahuvittamavāpnoti sayāvanmaseccati || bilvānāṃ lakṣahomena kulalakṣmi mupāśnute | padmānā mathabilvānāṃ koṭihomaṃ samācaret || satyaloka mavāpnoti deveṃdratva mapidhṛvaṃ | saṃpūjya devīṃ varadāṃ yathā vatpadmaiḥ sitairvā kusumaisthathānyaiḥ || kṣīreṇa dhūpaiḥ paramānna bhakṣyairlakṣmī mavāpnoti vithāna taśca || iti viṣṇu dharmottare śrīsūkta vidhiḥ || a tha nī rā ja na ṃ tatraiva puṣkara uvāca - pūrvottareca digbhāge nagarātsu manohake | vistīrṇaṃkāra yodrājāsu manohara maṃṭapaṃ || kaṭairgaptaṃ kuśāntīrṇaṃ patākādhvaja śobhitaṃ | toraṇa tritayaṃ śastraṃ pāṅmakhaṃkāra yocchubhaṃ || kāryaṃ ṣoḍaśa kantetu tatra kāryaṃ bhṛgūttama | toraṇāddakṣiṇebhāge tatra kāryaṃ yathāśrayaṃ || devatārcābhave tatra tathāgni havani kriyā | paṃcaraṃgaka sūtreṇa śatagraṃdhi manoramāṃ || madhame toraṇe kuryācchata pāśitu madhyamāṃ | chādayitvā kuśaistāṃtu mudā saṃchādhayetpunaḥ || tassāśca laṃghanaṃvarjyaṃ prayatnā tsarvajaṃtubhiḥ | nalaṃghitā sāyāvatsyā tprathamaṃ rājahastināṃ || citraṃtyaktvā yadāsvātīṃ savitrā pratipadyate | tataḥ prabhṛtikartavyā yāvatsvātau ravisthitaḥ || maṃṭape pratyaharidevāḥ pūjanīyā dvijottama | brahmaniṣṇuśca śaṃbhuśca śakrasaivānilā nalauḥ || vināyakaḥ kumāraśca varuṇo dhanado yamaḥ | viśvān devānmahābhāga ucchaiśrava samevaca || aṣṭau mahagajāḥ pūjya steṣāṃ nāmānimeśṛṇu | kumudairāvatau padmaḥ puṣpadaṃtotha vāmanaḥ || supratīkoṃ janonīla etoṣṭvau devayonayaḥ | pūjākāryā gṛharkṣāṇāṃ tadhaivaca purodhana || tataśca juhuyādvahnau purodhāssu samāhitaḥ | yathā vimatadevānāṃ matraistalliga saṃjñakaiḥ || tathāca maṃtrahīnānāṃ praṇavena mahābhuja | samidhaḥ kṣīra vṛkṣāṇāṃ tathā siddhārḍakānica || ghṛtaṃtilāni dharyajña tathā caivākṣatānica | hutavāca kalaśān kuryātsodakān dhānya saṃyutān || bhallāca kali siddhārthavacā kuṣṭa priyaṃgukaḥ | toraṇān paścimebhāge kalaśaiḥ pūrva kalbhitaiḥ || tataḥ ssaṃsnāpa nīyāstu maṃtrapūtairgajottamaḥ | turaṃgāṃśca mahābhāgā nalaṃkṛtya tataḥ stutān || tatobhiṣekonāṃgasya tathā tatturagasyaca | piṃḍānnaṃtu tatodeya mabhimanyu purodhasā | tasyābhinaṃdane rājño vijayaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || prāgevatasya vijñeyaṃ mahadbhayamu patthitaṃ | niṣkāsayottoraṇā thastatohi prathamaṃgarjā || tatrāpi prathamaṃ rāmaṃ abhiṣekaṃ gajottamaṃ | tasyāgre gaja āneṣyo naraḥ paṃcanakopivā || laṃghanyo laṃghayettāṃtu rājño maraṇa mādiśet | laṃghayedvā mapādena yaditāṃ nṛpakuṃjaraḥ || rājñīpurohitā mātyarāja putrāhitaṃ bhavet | rājña sumaraṇaṃ brūyādā kramettu yadā tadā || rājña vijaya mācaṣṭe laṃghayoddakṣiṇenatāṃ | niṣkameyusta tapsarve prāṅmakhāsto raṇairgajāḥ || tatośvāstu mahābhāgatatastu narasattamaḥ | tataśchatraṃ dhvajaścaiva rājaliṃgāniyānica || maṃṭapetyāni saṃsthāpya pūjayedā yadhānica | paṃcaraṃgaka sūtreṇa yāstāḥ patisarāḥ kṛtāḥ || dhūpyā dhūrasi maṃtreṇa nibadhnī yātpurohitaḥ | sarveṣāṃ nṛpanāgānāṃ turaṃgāṇāṃca bhārgava || svagṛheṣu tatoneyāḥ kuṃjarāsturagai ssaha | svātistha ssavitāyāvattā vacchāyāsu saṃsthitān || pūjaye tsatataṃ rāmanakrośennaca tāḍayet | rājacihnani sarvāṇi pujaye nmaṃṭa pesadā || varuṇojyāca bhūtejyā rātrau balibhiruttamaiḥ | vasetā māśrame nityaṃ sāṃvatsara purohitau || aśvavaidya pradhānaśca tadhā nāgabhiṣagvaraḥ | dīkṣitaistai stathā bhāvyaṃ brahmacāribhi revaca || svātiṃtraktvā yadāsūryo viśākhāṃ pratipadyate | alaṃkuryādvane tasminvāhanāṃ staviśeṣataḥ || hastīnāṃ turagaṃ chatraṃ khaḍgaṃ yānaṃcaduṃdubhiḥ | dhvajaṃ patākāṃ dharmajñakālajña stabhimaṃtrayet || atra chatrādi maṃtrājñeyāḥ - abhimaṃtrya tataḥ sarvāskuryāt kuṃjara dhūrtagaḥ | ulmukānāṃtu nicaya mādī pitamanaṃtaraṃ || rājā pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryā ttrirātraṃ susamāhitaḥ | caturaṃgabalopetaḥ sarvasaisya samanvitaḥ || ekaṃgatvā gṛhaṃgacce drājā sainya purassaraḥ | janvāsaṃpūjya ca tataḥ sarvameva vivarjayet || śāṃtirnīrājanābhyoyaṃ kṣemavṛddhikarī tathā || viṣṇudharmottare | rājovāca śāṃtimācakṣvame devaghṛtakaṃbaśalaṃsaṃjñikāṃ || puṣkara uvāca - pūrvottaretu digbhāge śātyagāraṃtu kārayet | abhiṣeca nikāmaṃtrāye mayābhi hitāḥ purā || devādayastu yeteṣāṃ sthānaṃ trata prakalpayet | āvāhanaṃ tataḥ kuryātsnānaṃ tatra upoṣitaḥ || aāhitānāṃ sarveṣāṃ gaṃdhamālyādi saṃpadā | devatpūjanaṃ kuryā ttathā maṃtripurohitau || evaṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā sopavāstāte trayaḥ | kuryā tribhāgaśeṣāyāṃ rātrāvutthāyaśaṃtikaṃ || kṛtvā daśaguṇāṃ statra snāpayettaṃ narādipaṃ | pūrvameva tathāsnānaṃ siddhārthai spādhitaṃ tathā || pūrṇena ghṛtakuṃbhena maṃtreṇāna kālavit | ājyaṃ tejassamuddhiṣṭaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ paraṃ || ājyaṃ surāṇāmāhāra mājye lokāḥ pratiṣṭitāḥ | baumāṃtarikṣaṃ divyāṃ vāyattekilbiṣamāgataṃ || sarvaṃ tadājya saṃsparśā tpraṇāśa mupagacchatu | tato virūpākṣa taṃtaṃ cāpyagrānvediṃ sarāthipa | gaccetāṃtu puraskṛtya sāṃvatsara purohitau || snānavedistu kartavyā rājñākusumamaṃjitā | caturbhiḥ pūrṇakuṃbaiśca vidikṣuca suśobhitāṃ || catvāri tasyacarmāṇi prāgrīvāṇi samānyapet | vṛkṣasya dvīpinaścaiva siṃha śārdūlayostathā || bhadrāsanaṃ nyasedrāma teṣā muparicāriṇāṃ | svāstīrṇe nṛpatiṃ tatravastrairācchādayonnavaiḥ | kārpāsakai stataḥ paścā dāvikaiḥ krimijaistataḥ || tatastu sarvijaḥkuṃbhaiḥ pūrṇesta mabhiṣecayet | kuṃbhāṣṭakaṃtu kartavya maṣṭāviṃśati revaca || athavāṣṭaśataṃrāma vṛddhireṣāṃ gaṇottarā | tatopavīyavastrāṇi tasyāṃ vedyāṃ purohitaḥ || śūlenamṛṇmayaṃbhiṃdyā cchatraṃ krodhasamanvitaḥ | rājñastu kalaśaṃdadyā tsvayāṃsāṃ vatsarastataḥ | rājābhiṣekaṃ maṃtreṇa svarcitaṃ kalpitaṃdṛḍhaṃ || jyotiṣmatīṃ trāyamāṇāṃ abhayā maparājitāṃ | jīvāṃ viśveśarīṃpārāṃ namaṃgā mabhayāṃ tataḥ || sahāṃca sahādevīṃ ca pūrṇakośaṃ vaśatāṃvarīṃ | ariṣṭikāṃ śivāṃ bhadrāṃ kalaśe tatravinyaset || brāhmiṃ tremāvacāṃcaiva sarvabījāni kāṃcanaṃ | maṃgalyāśca yathālābhaṃ sarvauddyorasāṃ stathā | ratnāni sarvagaṃdhāṃśca bilvaṃca savikaṃkataṃ || evaṃ svātoghṛte dṛṣvāvadanaṃ darpaṇe tathā | maṃgalālaṃbhanaṃkṛtvā thautavāsāḥ samāhitaḥ || abhyarcanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā devādīnāṃ pṛdhak pṛthak | teṣāmeva tatovahnau caturdhaṃtaistu nāmaḥ || oṃkārapūrvaṃ juhuyāt ghṛtaṃ hitapurohitaḥ | āyuthābhyarcanaṃ kāryaṃ vāhanābhyarcanaṃ tataḥ || rājihnārcanaṃ kṛtvā alaṃkṛtya svakāṃtanuṃ | anulepa samādadyādgaṃtu dvāreti maṃtritaṃ || śriyaṃ dhātumayīṃ dehi maṃtrassumanasāṃ bhavet | rāyaspoṣeti ca tathā maṃtrolaṃkaraṇe smṛtaḥ || keśanābhyarcanaṃ kṛtvā vahnisthānaṃ tato vajret | vahnau ruttarabhāgetu prāgrīve proktacarmaṇi || siṃhāsanaṃ nyasetpraṣṭe parārthyā staraṇānvitaṃ | vṛṣasya carmacāstīrya kareṇośca tadhopadhi || tayoruparisiṃhasya vyāghrasya ca tataḥ paraṃ || eṣāṃtu rāmacarmāṇi prāgīvāṇitu vinyaset | dhruvādyau ritimaṃtreṇa nṛpaṃ tatra praśayet || tataḥ purothā juhuyādbrahmamaṃtrairghṛtaṃ śuciḥ | raudra vaiṣṇavavāyavya śāktai ssaumyaissavāruṇaiḥ || bārhaspatyai stataḥ kuryā ttaṃtramu ttarasaṃjñitaṃ | daivajñaḥ prayataḥkuryā ddevatānāṃ visarjanaṃ | annena brāhmaṇān‌bhojya tato dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ || iti viṣṇudharmottaredhṛta kaṃbala vidhiḥ || sarvīrtha sādhanaṃ snānaṃ vakṣyeśāṃtikaraṃ śṛṇu | snāpayecca sarittīre gṛha viṣṭaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || devālaye jvarotpāte vināyaka gṛhārdite | vidyātīrthe hṛdegehe japakāmasya tīrdake || padminyāsnāpayetkṣīrairga bheyasyābhavetvatha | aśoka sannidhau prāpya jātoyasya viniśyati || puṇya tīrdāśca puṇyadyaiḥ putriṇāṃ caivasāgare | gehe saubhāgya rūpāyāṃ sarveṣāṃ viṣṇu sannithau || viṣṇvukṣe revatī puṣye sarveṣāṃ snāna muttamaṃ|| snāna kāmasya saptāhaṃ pūrva mapyādanaṃ śṛṇu || punarvavārocanāca śatahvā maruṇāṃtvacaṃ | madhūkaṃ rajanīdveca tagaraṃ nāga kesaraṃ || asurā caiva maṃjiṣṭā māṃsīyava samardakaiḥ | priyaṃgu sarṣapā puṇyaṃ vacābrāhmīca kuṃkumaṃ || paṃcagavyaṃ saktumiśraṃ udvartya snānamācaret || maṃḍale karṇikāyāṃca viṣṇuṃ brahmaṇa marcayet | madhye kāmaharaṃ pūrvaṃ maṃtraiḥ pūrvādi dikkramāt || libhe diṃdrādi kāndevān sāyudhān sahavāhānān | snāna maṃḍala kāndikṣu kuryāccaiva vidikṣuca || viṣṇu brahmeśa śakrādi sahasrāṇyapi homayet || ekaikasya tvaṣṭa śataṃ samidhastu tilaissaha | bhadraḥ subhadraḥ siddārdhaḥ kalahā puṣṭivardhanaḥ || amodāścitra bhānuśca parjanyotha sudarśanaḥ | sthāpayettu ghaṭānetā nsāśvibhyāṃca marudgaṇān || viśvedevā stathādityā vasavo munayastadhā | śrāddheśāḥ saṃtu suprītā stathānyāapi devatāḥ || auṣadīḥ prakṣipetkuṃbhe jayaṃtīṃ vijayāṃ jayāṃ | śatāvarīṃ śaṃkha puṣṭāṃ viṣṇukrāṃtāṃ parājitāṃ || jyotiṣmatīṃ balāṃ caiva caṃdano śīrakesaraṃ | kastūri kāṃcarpūraṃ vālukaṃ patraketvacaṃ || jātīphalaṃ sugaṃdhaṃca mṛttikāḥ palaṃca gavyakaṃ | bhadrapīṭhesthite madhye sthāpaye yurdvijo ttamāḥ || rājābhiṣekaṃ maṃttrokta devānāṃ havanaṃ pṛthak | pūrṇāhutiṃ tatodatvā gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadet || iṃdrobhiṣikto guruṇā purādaityān jaghānaha | dikpālasynānataḥ proktā ssaṃgrame vijitāpūn || iti agnipurāṇe sarvārdha sādhana śāṃtiḥ || a thai ka va stra snā na ṃ vīra siṃhāvaloke rudrayāmale - śukreṇa prārthitaḥ śaṃbhuḥ praṇipatya jagadguruṃ || ekavāso vidhiṃbrūhi svāmi nvistarato mamaḥ || śṛṇubhārgava yatnena duḥkha vaidhavya nāśanaṃ | vaṃdhyātvaṃ vilayaṃyāti yasminvastra vidhaukṛte || śivonāmeti maṃtreṇa bhānāvanudite sati | aṣṭa vatraṃ likhetpadaṃ kramataḥ śukla taṃḍulaiḥ || vedoktavidhinā maṃtrai nsūktai rveda vidhānataḥ | paṃcavaktraṃ daśabhūjaṃ triṇetraṃ pārvatī patiṃ || padma midhyennase ddevaṃ śivo nāmeti maṃtrataḥ | iṃdraṃ viśveti maṃtreṇa iṃdramāgneya koṇake || yece hetica maṃtreṇa dakṣiṇe yamapūjanaṃ | yedevā iti maṃtreṇa ntaiṛtye sanakādayaḥ | tattvāyāmīti maṃtreṇa paścime paruṇaṃnyaset || gaṇānāṃtveti maṃtreṇa vāyuvyeti gaṇeśvaraṃ | abhigotreṇa maṃtreṇa uttare garbhamātaraḥ || īśānyāṃca grahān sarvān sthāpayetsvanva maṃtrataḥ | ṛtavastha ṛtān maṃtrān pūrvasyāṃ vanyasetsmaraṃ || tasmadhye vinyasetkuṃbhaṃ pūrayttīrtha vāriṇā | pūrṇapātrayutaṃ madhye sarvauṣadhi sasunvitaṃ || sahiraṇyaṃ savastraṃca nārikelena saṃyutaṃ | pratiṣṭāṃca vidhāyādau maṃtraiḥ pūjana mācaret || śrīrudraṃca japettatra ṣaḍaṃgaṃ vidhi pūrvakaṃ | sīpuṃsābhyāṃ vidhātavyaṃ pūjanaṃ nidhivattataḥ || abhyacyan vidhināsamyakkṛtvā snānaṃ ttataḥ || nāṃdī mukhābhidaṃ śrāddhaṃ vidheyaṃ vidhivatpunaḥ | prāśnīyānmadhyamaṃ piṃḍaṃ garbosītica maṃtrataḥ || japaprārthanā - pratyagāśā pate rājan jalanāmadhipa prabho | naṣṭagarbha prasṛṣṭātvaṃ garbhaṃ dehi mamepsitaṃ || nadīnada taṭākāni tathaivānya jalāśayāḥ | tvāṃvinānaiva śobhaṃte garbhaṃdehi jaleśvara || pūrvajanma niyatpāpaṃ kusaṃ sarvātsvayaṃ kṛtaṃ | ihāpi salile sthitvā garbhadehi prasīdaye || ṣaṭṭaṣṭikoṭi tīrdhānāṃ nadyādināṃ prabhurbhavān | saptānāmapisindhūnā mīlagarbhaṃda thasvame || tvameva pāśapāṇistutva mevahyaṃbhasāṃ patiḥ | āpastu prāṇināṃjīvā garbhaṃ dhehi prasīdaye || tavahaste jaliṃvāme dakṣiṇe jīva jīvanaṃ | mastakeca jaṭāpiṃgā garabhaṃ dhehidayāṃ kuru || aṃtirāyaṃ prabhocchitvā garbhaṃ dhehi dayāṃ kuru || iti jala prārdhanā - auṣadhi prārthanā - sarveṣāṃ jagato bhānāṃ grahāṇāṃ nidhipassadā | tavasvāmi nnahaṃdāso dhehi garbha mahauṣadhe || auduṃbarī phalavata śākhāyā sarvamaṃtravit | oṣadhaḥ somarājīti kāminyā marpayodbhudaḥ || śākhāyā laṃbanaṃ kāryaṃ hṛdicetasi narmalaḥ | samālaṃbhyakare dūrvā nārikelākṣatāpi | varuṇopāsanaṃ kuryātsūkta pāṭhaparāyaṇaḥ || brahma viṣṇuśca somaśca kaṃdarbho vṛṣavāhanaḥ | pārvatī subhagābhadrā sāvitrī vāstu devatā || etehivāsasī śśubhre avyaṃge guru daivate | sarvabhūṣaṇa ramyeca baṃdhanena śipaṃ bhavet || mudga taṃḍula godhūma yavakaṃgusuśālibhiḥ | rājamāṣodibirvidvā svaṃpātraṃ prapūjayet || vinyasya dīpakaṃ tatra phalānāṃ saptakaṃ tathā | dhānāvaṃteti maṃtreṇa dhyānasnānaṃtu kārayet || nārikelaṃca nāraṃgaṃ dāḍimaṃ bījapūrvakaṃ | ucatthyaṃcai vapūgaṃca saptamaṃ damanaṃsmṛtaṃ || kūrmapṛṣṭhanibaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ kṣiranīraprapūritaṃ | triṇetraṃ śaṃbhudaivatvaṃ nārikelaṃ sutapradaṃ || vṛttaṃ kanakavarṇābhaṃ subijaṃ sumanoharaṃ | tuhinena samaṃ śītaṃ nāraṃgaṃ garbhadaṃmama || caṃdrabiṃba samānaṃtu bahubīja supīritaṃ | sugaṃdhaṃ somadaivatyaṃ garbhadaṃ bijapūrakaṃ || udyadarkasamaṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ siṃdhūrasannibhaṃ | bījapūrodaroyasmāggarbhadaṃ ḍāḍimaṃ mama || phalaṃta ccakradevatyaṃ sūtraṃ vaisadṛśopamaṃ | jñānayoni prapūrṇaṃtu dehitvaṃ garbhamuttamaṃ || pūgastu sūryadevatyo lākṣārasa samaprabhaḥ | ārdraḥ phalānāṃ pravarogarbhaṃ dadyātsadā mama || utsaveṣuca sarveṣu śubhadaṃ sarvadaivataṃ | gorocana samābhāsaṃ garbhadaṃ madanaṃ phalaṃ || iti phalai śśubhaṃ - ādhauṣadhisnānaṃ - vardāvaraścarāsnāca ekākīvacakī tathā | dhānyāniśā bahulāca sarvauṣadhya imāsmṛtā || yā oṣadha iti maṃtreṇa sarvauṣadyabhiṣecanaṃ | kareṇamūrdhnivinyasya vaṃśapātraṃtu bhārgava || ṛgvedoktān sarvamaṃtrān tatyāyāmītipūrvikān | dhīmān pratyekamuccārya daṃpatīssnāpayettataḥ || vāruruḥpāvitāmaṃtrā varuṇo ttabhanaṃ tataḥ | ete śatamimaṃcaiva idamāpaḥ punaṃtumāṃ || imānvai yājuṣānmaṃtrān śirometya niruktayā | ghṛtavatī bhunanānā pāvamānīḥ punaḥ punaḥ || sāmno varuṇasāmnātha pāvakān sarasvatī || śanno devyādhātharvamaṃtrai ssnāna mudāhṛtaṃ || tato rudrajapasnānaṃ kartavyaṃ sutamiccatā || atha bhārgava saṃsthāpya sdhaṃḍile pāvakaṃ śubhe || gṛhyo ktenavidhinānena pāyasaṃ śravayecyaruṃ || āghārāvājyabhāgauca deyau tatra ghṛtāhutīḥ || apāṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ nihotāca punastveti tathā samit || vājaḥ purastādagnetva madātyaṃ garbhamevaca || tataḥ sarasvatīyonyāṃ taṃ patnīṃ bhirataḥ paraṃ || ādityai rāsnāsīti maṃtrayonarṣa yopica || garbhoasyoṣadhīnāṃ ca maṃtrāṃ tāhutayaḥ kramāt || ebhirmaṃtraiśca ruṃhutvā tataḥ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ hunet || ṛṣabhaṃ brahāṇedadyā dācārye surabhiṃ tathā | itarebhyopi viprebhyo rakṣaṇe svecchayā punaḥ || abhiṣekaṃ tataḥ kuryā tpavitraiḥ kuṃbhavāribhi || surāstvāmiti maṃtrādyaiḥ pavitrai rbhrāhmaṇaissaha || āśāsyakāmadai rmaṃtrai rguhṇīyāt phalasaptakaṃ || sadīpaṃ vaṃgapātraṃca nītvāyāyāccivālayaṃ || śivasya puratonyasya vaṃśapātraṃ praṇamyaca || devadeva jannādha gaurīnādha maheśvara || bhaveśāna mahādeva namostu sutadobhava || aṣṭau doṣāścayostrīṇāṃ navamaḥ puruṣasyaca || tattadoṣa vināśāya sastrīkaḥ snānamācaret || vikṛtaṃ yacacamedehe saṃtānaparipīḍanaṃ || tatsarvaṃ bhasmatāṃyātu nirdoṣāsyāṃ suputriṇi || varuṇatvaṃ ca bhūtānāṃ pāpaśuddhikaraḥ prabhu || tava tīrthaprabhāvena saṃtānaṃ dehimebahu || tataśca puroḍāśa mādhatraityādi nāśayet | brāhmaṇānan bojayitvāca varaṃdadvā visarjayet || idaṃ nirmūlamapi gurjareṣu pracārāduktaṃ || iti vīrasiṃhāvaloke rudrayāmaloktamevastra snānaṃ || aruṇa uvāca - ī yekavastra snānavidhi yanu śāṃtikarmamu saṃtoṣamu leka vaṃśamu nilicipoyinavāralu bhaktiśraddhalato dīni nācariṃcinavāralaite tappaka vāru satsaṃtānamu galigi vaṃśābhivṛddhigā nuṃduru, dīni vidhānamu kṃcamu kaṣṭamugā tocinanu kaṣṭī phalī yanunaṭlu dāniki taginaṃta suphalamu galadani yऱugasagunu yatvāyā kadhitaṃ svāmi nneka vastrābhiṣecanaṃ || daṃpatyorana padyādi daurbhāgya śamanaṃ paraṃ || vithiṃ tasyā khīlaṃ brūhiyathāśruti nirūpitaṃ || devatā kātrake maṃtrā vidhiḥ tasyā khīlaṃ brūhiyāthāśrūti nirūpitaṃ || devatā kātrake maṃtrā vidhiḥ tāvā phalaṃ tataḥ || kadṛgvastraṃ kathaṃ dhārya mubhābhyā meva tatpunaḥ || kathaṃ tasmin kṛtespatya siddhissyānnara yoṣitoḥ || śrīsūrya uvāca - pūrākalpāśa sānetu kalpasyāsya samudbhave || āririppsuryadhā sṛṣṭiṃ śruti smṛti vidhirvidhiḥ || sasmārata nayāsapta manasān prajā patiḥ | teyadā tapasākliśyanna śekussṛṣṭi sādhane || śivamārādhya tapasā prasannaṃ samāyācire || prajāmeva prajākāmāḥ prajāpati sutāstute || bhagavaṃ stapa sākhinnāḥ prajāpeto prajāpateḥ || ākarma pacanānmohādvārā niṣpalalakṣaṇāt || tatohina prajāsiddhi rasmākaṃ śiva jāyāte || prajārdhaṃtvāṃ prapannāsmsa būhita tsiddhikṛdvidhaṃ || prārditastu tadā śaṃbhuḥ kṣaṇaṃ dyātvā bravīccatān || śṛṇudhvaṃmunaya ssarve prajā yāyada saṃbhave || kāraṇaṃmunaya ssarve yuddṛṣṭaṃ jñāna cakṣuṣā | anapatyakaraṃ karmacakreya tpūrva saṃplave || kāle bhuktāva śeṣeyat daurbāgya tadduvaṃ tanau || viluptamanu maṃtrādi bhedabhinnaṃ dvayorapi || vālasaikenata ddehāyugalaṃ paridhāyaca | kurudhvaṃ vidhi vatsnānaṃ tathā daurbhāgya nāśanaṃ || ānakhā grācchake śāṃtaṃ yāvadaṃgaṃ viśukravat || eva māyati daurbhāgyaṃ paṃcadhāyatprakīrtitaṃ || tasya śayyāsana vidhiḥ sahapratyaika vāsasā || snātvā samyake videḥ putrāḥ saṃtateḥ śreya apsyatha || ityuktvāntarhite śaṃbhāva kurvanmunayaścaha || yathaika vasanasnāna māditaḥ sumahadvidhiṃ || yadhā śatṛṃyathādṛṣṭaṃ śrutibhyo jñāna cakṣuṣā || śubhamāsesite pakṣe sānukūle grahedine || nadanadyoḥ samāyoga mahānadyordhva yodapi pratyuṣe siddhi māsthāya śarīrasya yathāvidhi || vidhiṃ vividha māsthāya patnyā saha marhaṇāṃ || vidhāya śraddayā yukto maṃtrayetamudīrayet || karmasārtri jagannādha yanmayā pūrva janmani || paṃcathā patyadaḥkhākhya daurbhāgyamatulaṃ bhavet || prāptastasya vināśāya vidhikalpa manuttamaṃ || sahapatnyā dināvādha tatra siddhiṃ prayacchame || evamucyārya tadvāstra mahataṃ dvidaśātmakaṃ || sārdahasta dvayā yāmaṃ paṃcaviṃśa karonnataṃ || vitatma taṃtubhiḥ ślakṣṇestanmadhyenyūta madbhutaṃ | yūvāsuvāsā maṃtreṇa maṃtritaṃ daiva vedisā || samyaddattaṃ tadādāya paridha dhyātsavastrakaṃ || dṛḍhānī virabhinnācade hetri higuṇīkṛtaṃ || tacchaiṣā ddakṣiṇāṃgasthāsa patnīkaṃ suputrikā || paridadhyātprayatnena saṃvṛtta vamamastakā || kuśānsaṃmṛjya saṃgopya yātipṛṣṭhānugāminī upaviśva jalasthānetāvṛbhauvapidaṃ patī || prakṣālya pāṇipādauca svācāṃtau mamasanmakhau || vaidikān laukikāṃścāpi sāvadānaujiteṃdriyau || tīrthatvamapi sarneṣāṃ devanāmigraṇīḥ prabhuḥ | jīvanaṃ sarva jaṃtūnāṃ garbhaṃ dehi mamaprabho || yāniyānīha pāpāni anapatya karāṇinau | hatvātānyakhilānīśa garbhaṃ dehi mamaprabho || yadāvābhyāṃ mahatpāpaṃ purājanmani duḥkhataḥ || kṛtaṃtanme vinirbhūya garbhaṃ dehi mamaprabho || tvavaivādhiṣṭitā ssarvenadīnada jalāśrayāḥ || punaṃti pāpinaḥ varvān garbhaṃ dehi mamaprabho || āśāsmahe mahābhāge saṃtatiṃ lokapāvanīṃ || pasannādbhavataḥ svāmin garbhadehi mamaprabho || bhūtapreta piśācādyāyo nausaṃtati vighnidāḥ || pāśenāhṛtyatān sarvān garbhaṃdehi mamaprabho || evaṃ saṃprārthyātā āpaḥ daṃpatītau balādbahiḥ || susnāya prājñmukhaḥ stiṣṭhenmaṃtraṃ suśrāvayediti || imā maṃgīrasa - ādatyobhyodvaya mimaṃ śubhaṃ || śrāvayānbhuvi vinyapātraṃta tpraṇa mecchamāṃ || tatonyevāsasī śubhre śucinī parithāyatau || upa viśvāsane śubhre puṇya srakcraṃda nārcitā || tatassa kanakaṃ sarpispraśeta marabhīṃdvijan || praṇīpatya tataḥ śeṣaṃ karma sarvaṃ samāpayet || ācāryastu vidhānena daivajñenānu moditaḥ || hastamātre tatastatra sthiṃḍile kalaśaṃnyaset || avraṇaṃ payasā pūrṇaṃ svarṇa puṣpakṣatairyutaṃ || pūrṇa pātraṃnyase tatra pūrṇaṃ puṣpaphalākṣataiḥ | svasva maṃtraiḥ pratiṣṭhāvya māheśa mumayānaha || tasyāgre prajapeyuste brahmaṇāṃ maṃtrakevidaḥ | paṃcāṃgādvidhi vanmaṃbhatrān rudrasūktaiśca yājaṣaiḥ udvāsyāthacaruṃ samyagācāryaḥ svavidhānataḥ | āghārāvājya bhāgauca hutvā vāhyanibhāvasuṃ || dikpatīnparitaḥ pūjya sasva maṃtraissamā hitaḥ | prajāpate rathāgneyāṃ garbhaṃdhehi ticāparāṃ | apāṃ pṛṣṭhāṃ tathā hotā imaṃme saptavāruṇaṃ || tataḥ sviṣṭa kṛtaṃ hutvā karma śeṣaṃ samācaret || homāṃte śiva mabhyarca saśivaṃ vidhipūrvakaṃ | japaṃ homaṃ nivedyāsmai vidhivatvija kovidaḥ || tato viprāya viduṣe nuśāṃtāya payasvinīṃ | savastra dakṣiṇopetāṃ savatsāṃ dhenumuttamāṃ | tathālaṃkṛta sarvāgaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ śubha lakṣaṇaṃ || datvādau daṃpatī paścāddaivajñenānapa moditau || maṃtra muccārayodtāṃ vaividhipadvi hitārvāṇaiḥ || devadeva jagannādha sarvapāpaughanāśana || karmaṇānena dānena tathā goyugalasyatu || saṃtuṣṭaḥ satataṃ bhūtvā saṃtatiṃ dhehimeprabho || tatastu vaiṇapaṃ pātraṃ śivasyāgre nivedayet || ācāryāya pradeyā nidānāni nijaśaktitaḥ | guravevāsasīdatvā karmaśeṣaṃ samāpayet | praṇamya devatābhyaśca visṛjyica vidhānataḥ | tataḥ kuṃbhāṃbhasā viprā abhyaṣiṃceyurādṛtāḥ || maṃtraiśca vāruṇai ssauraiḥ śāṃti svastyayanādibhi || paurāṇairāga moktaistu nānāphala vidāyinaḥ || naṃdīmukhena vidhinātataḥ śrāddaṃ samārabhet || namova iti maṃtreṇa samaskāra mudīrayet || saptatetāṃtrikā maṃtrāḥ chāṃdasāḥ paṃcavāruṇāḥ || tvaṃ naḥ prabhṛtayo mantrā vāruṇau cāvarāvapi | tvanno agne satvanno agne dveime tatvāyāmi cetyādyairvāruṇa sūktakaiḥ etaṃ tajjalamā maṃtryastutvā maṃtraiḥ praṇamyaca || nimajyonmajyaca punastaṃtra snānaṃ samācaret || prayogaṃ vidhiva vatkṛtvā putrakāma samṛddhaye | snāsyāmahe sabhagavān prajetānau prasīdatu || snāyī yātāṃ tataḥ snānaṃ dravyairmaṃtrābhi maṃtritaiḥ || mṛtsnāgomaya gomūtrerdra vyairdadhipayo ghṛtaiḥ || tilāmalaka piṣṭaiśca sarvauṣadhi kuśodakaiḥ || nivṛtya vidhivatsnānaṃdaṃ patītā vubhauvapi || snāpitaiva tataḥ patnī ekaika dyavya saṃcayaiḥ || auduṃbaraṃ bahu phaliṃbibhratī nijamūrdhani || maṃtrapūrvaṃ nvapatinā dattāṃ śākhāṃ prajānvitāṃ | saptauṣidhi susaṃ pūrṇaiḥ kalaśai rathasaptabhiḥ || maṃtrapūtaiḥ sadaivajñaḥ snāpayetāṃ vidhānataḥ || vardā karaścarāsnāca sahādevīśatāvarī || paṃcailā lakṣmaṇācet saptauṣadyobhiṣecane | yājātā anuvākastu saptauṣadyabhiṣecane || tatastu vaiṇavaṃ pātraṃ saptadhānyopa saṃbhṛtaṃ || mudga taṃḍula godhūma yava śāli samanvitaiḥ || sakaṃgu sahamāṣaiśca dhānyairitica saptabhiḥ || palāni vinyase ttatrayāḥ palinīriti maṃtrataḥ || nārikelaṃca nāruṃgaṃdāḍi maṃbīja pūrakaṃ uttathī matha pūgaṃca jaṃbīraṃ tātra saptamaṃ | laukikaistuta maṃtraiśca pūrvoktai reva saptabhiḥ śirometyama vākena snānaṃ daurbhāgyaṃ prāguva sthitaṃ | paudāguṣṭhā dānakhāgrādāke śāṃtaṃ samutpṛjet || sanāne nānename devatāṃ tsarvānapasāraya || iti vijñapya varuṇaṃ māṃca karmādi sākṣiṇaṃ || ekacitta ssmareddeva mumayā sahitaṃ śivaṃ || tatastvetāneva devān manuṣyān sahapūrvajaiḥ || nāṃdī mukhena vidhinā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ | vibhrāḍityanuvākena phala puṣpāṃkṣa tāṃjaliḥ || upasthāya tataḥ paścātkarma śeṣaṃ samāpayet || tatastaddvaiṣṇaṃ pātraṃ śirasyādhāya yoṣitaḥ | kuśāgreṇa samālabhya vaṭhenmaṃtrān suśāṃtikān | tataḥ svastyayanāyaiva śāṃtayeca muhurmuhuḥ || madhyamamaṃ piṃḍamaśnāti patnī daivajña coditā | adhatta pitaro garbhamiti maṃtreṇa matritaṃ | ācamya nidhivatpaścātkarmaśeṣaṃ samāpayet || śataṃcabhojanayedanyān dvijān saṃtoṣya śaktitaḥ || kṛtakṛtyauca tausyātāṃ putra pautra sukhānvitau || iti sūryāruṇa saṃvāde ekavastra snānavidhiḥ || adṅutasāgare dharmaśāstra nibaṃdhane gargaḥ | ūrdhvaṃviṃśati varṣāttu madho bhavativāraṇe | tadarvāgya dimādyeta svāmino maraṇaṃdiśet | kārayettatraśāṃtiṃca brāhmaṇāṃścāpi tarpayat | ekarātrokṣita ssnātvā priyaḥ prayatamānasaḥ | aṣṭottara sahasraṃtu maṃtraṃcāpi japeccuciḥ | tataḥ prajyapya maṃtrestu salilaṃcābhi matraṃyet | gajānāṃ gajatatvajñaḥ sarvadoṣāvaharaṃ śubhaṃ | gajasnānaṃ prakurvīta taddinetūryanisvanaiḥ pūrvāhṇecāgānikāryaṃ ca kṛtvā kuṃbhaśatenahi | tatohomaṃ prakurvīta vidhidṛṣṭena homavit || agnaye svāhā rudrāya svāhā gamapataye svāhā varuṇāya svāhā bṛhaspataye svāhā śukrāya svāhā || snānaṃ kuṃbhaśateneha sarvopadravanāśanaṃ | dvijapūjana pūrvaṃsyātsalilaṃ guḍamiśritaṃ yavayāvaka saṃyuktaṃ piṃḍaṃ madhunātha dhūpayedbahuśaḥ | kṛtapūjā saṃskāraṃ gaṇādhipaṃ vaṃdayettūrṇaṃ | īśvarasya mahāsaṃpadumā lalāṭasaṃbhava | idaṃ kṛtvopanītaṃtuṃ nai vedyaṃ bhakṣayasvanaḥ | iti nai vedyamaṃtraḥ || ityakāle gajamadi śāṃtiḥ || madaṃ yadātusurabhi rvisṛjetsūtimevaca | purerāṣṭe vanevāpi gṛhevāhastinīyadā | mattāmūtra purīṣāṇi yadāsaṃhrāyatiṣṭhati | mattayābhujyateyuddhe hastinyāyadivāraṇaḥ | mahādbhayaṃ tatra bhaveddeśasya nagarasyaca | upoṣyabāṃdhavaistatra sāmātyassa purohitaḥ | hasti vatkalpitāṃdhenuṃ viṣāṇābhyāṃ ca yojitāṃ | athaināṃ hastinīṃ nītvā śatṛrāṣṭre viyokṣayet | ityevamevatkurvīta rātrau vanavāsinī | athavā pūrvavatkṛtvā śāṃtiṃ kṛtvāvanedvayaṃ | suvarṇana sutaptena vanameva vidārayediti || gokariṇāṃ mada śāṃtiḥ || atha dhaniṣṭhā tripuṣkarādi śāṃtiḥ ī śāṃtikarta ātyaṃtāvaśyakaṃbu - saṃsārikulaku iṃḍlalo dhaniṣṭhā paṃcakādi mṛta prakriya galginappuḍu pillalu strīlu vīralaku bhayādulu leka gṛha rakṣaṇa mukhyamu kāvuna dīnini āṃdarunu yājakula mūlamugā neऱiṃgiyuṃḍaginadi madanaratne gāruḍe - ādhau kṛtvā dhaniṣṭarkṣametanna kṣatrapaṃcakaṃ | revatyaṃ taṃ sadādūṣya maśubhaṃ dāhakarmaṇi | śavasyatu samīpetu kṣeptavyāḥ puttalāstadā | darbhaiḥ kṛtāstu catvāro ṛkṣamaṃtrābhi maṃtritāḥ | tato dāhaścakartavya staiśca puttalakaissaha | sūtakāṃte tataḥ patraiḥ kāryāśāṃtiśca pauṣṭikī | paṃcakeṣu mṛtoyāvai nagatiṃ labhate naraḥ | tilāścaiva hiraṇyaṃca tamuddiśya ghṛtaṃ dadet || kriyānibaṃdhe - bhājano pānahauchatraṃ hemamudrāṃcavāvasī | viprebhyo dakṣiṇā deyā sarvapātaka mocanī || madanaratne gārgyaḥ - yadi bhadrātithīnāṃsyā dbhānu bhauma śanaiścaraiḥ | tripādṛkṣaiścaṃsayogodvayo ryogodyi puṣkaraḥ | dvitripuṣkarasyayogetu mṛtirmutyaṃta rāvahaṃ dahase maraṇecaiva triguṇaṃsyāttri puṣkare | khananepyevamevasyā detaddopaśāṃtaye | tilapiṣṭheryavairvāpi śarīraṃ kārayetattaḥ | śūrpenidhāyālaṃkṛtya dāhayetpaitṛkopari || bodhāyanaḥ - asmāttva mitimaṃtreṇa tilapiṣṭaṃ pradāhayet | dvitripuṣkara yorvogaṃ tribhiḥ kṛcraiḥ vyapohati | vāsave maraṇaṃcaitsyādgṛhevāsi punarmṛtiḥ | suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇāṃdadyā tkṛṣṇavastra madhāpivā || vāsavaṃ dhaniṣṭhā - brāhme - kuṃbhamīnasthite caṃdre maraṇaṃ yasyajāyate | natasyorthvagatiḥ dṛṣṭā saṃtataucā śubhaṃbhavet | natasyadāhaḥ kartavyo vināśātsveṣu jaṃtuṣu | atha vātiddinekāryo dāhastu vidhipūrvakaṃ | dhaniṣṭhā paṃcake jīvo mṛtoyadikathaṃcana - tripuṣkareyāmyabhevā kulajānmārayeddruvaṃ | tatrāniṣṭavināśārthaṃ vidhānaṃ samudīryate | darbhāṇāṃ pratimāḥ kāryāḥ paṃcorṇāsūtraveṣṭitāḥ | yavapiṣṭenānuliptā stābhissahaśavaṃ dahet | pretavāhaḥ pretasakhaḥ pretapaḥ pretabhūmipaḥ | pretahartā paṃcamastu paṃcanāmānyanukramāt | atra pratimāḥ saṃpūjya śironetra vāmakukṣi nābhipādeṣu krameṇa nyasyatanyāmabhirghṛtaṃ hutvāya māyasomaṃ tryaṃbaka mitimaṃtrābhyāṃ pratyekaṃtā svājyaṃhuneditibhaṭṭāḥ || sūtakāṃte tataḥ putraḥ kuryācchāṃtiṃ ca pauṣṭikīṃ | kāṃsyapātra sthitaṃ tailaṃ vīkṣyadadyā ddvijanmane | brahma viṣṇu maheśeṃdra varuṇaprītaye tataḥ | māṣamudgayavrīhi priyaṃgu pratipādanaṃ | svarṇadānaṃ rudrajāpyaṃ lakṣahomo dvijārcanaṃ | go bhūdānaṃ ṣaḍaṃśena kuryāddoṣopaśāṃtaye || aparārke smṛtyaṃtare - dhaniṣṭhā paṃcaka mṛte paṃcaratnāni tanmukhe | prāsyāhuti trayaṃ tatra hunedvaha vapāmiti | tato nirvaraṇaṃ kuryādeṣa sāgnervidhismyṛtaḥ | itaraṃ nikhanedeva jalevā prati pādayet | tripādṛkṣe mṛte tadvaddhiraṇya śakalaṃ mukhe | tasyapiṣṭa mayaṃkuryā tpuruṣa trivayaṃ tataḥ | homaṃ prati mukhaṃ kuryāttathā vahavapāmiti | kārṣṇāya saṃca karpāsaṃ kusumaṃ pratipādyaca | niryātyasāgniṃ saṃskuryādbhuvyagnau vāsya mutsṛjet | tatraiva - kanakaṃ hīrakaṃ nīlaṃ puṣparāgaṃca mauktitaṃ | paṃcaratna midaṃdeya mṛṣibhiḥ parikīrtitaṃ | ratnānāṃ cāpyabhāvetu svarṇaṃ karṣārthaṃmevavā | suvarṇa syāpyabhāvetu ājyaṃ jñeyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ || madanaratne pyevaṃ - tathai - ekāśīti phalaṃ kāṃśyaṃ tadarthaṃ vātadarthakaṃ | navaṣaṭtri phalaṃvāpi dadyā dviprāya śaktitaḥ || anyatrāpi - svagṛhyokta vidhānena kṛtvāgneḥ stāpanaṃ tataḥ | anyādhānaṃ nirvapaṇaṃ devatānāṃ tathā hutuḥ | yamāya dharmarājāya mṛtyave cāṃtakāyaca | vaivasyatāya kālāya sarvabhāta kṣayāyaca | auduṃbarāya dadhnāya nīlāya parameṣṭine | vṛkodarāya citrāya citraguptāya vaikramāt | vidhinā śravaṇaṃ kṛtvā ekaikā māhutiṃ huneti | kṛṣṇāṃgaṃ kṛṣṇa vastraṃca hemaniṣka samanvitaṃ | dadyādvi prāya śāṃtāya prīto bhavatume yamaḥ || tripādṛkṣye pyevameva || aparārke - punarvasūttarāṣāḍhā kṛttiko ttara phalgunī | pūrvābhādrā viśākhāca jñeyame tattri pādabaṃ | brahmacāri maraṇe kuṣṭhī maraṇe garbhiṇīrajasvalā sūtikā maraṇepi dānāsyasyaśca viśeṣo matkṛte nirṇaya siṃdhau jñeyaḥ | iti dhaniṣṭhā paṃcaka tripuṣkarādi mṛtau śāṃtiḥ || atha vasiṣṭhalpoktaṃ tripuṣkarādi mṛtau vidhānaṃ || ī mṛtyuṃjaya vidhānaṃbu tattatsamayocitaṃbugā saṃbhaviṃdunaṭṭi yupamṛtyuvulanu nivāriṃcuṭakai cppaṃbaḍinadi yani spaṣṭamaiyunnadi buddhiśāluraina āstikaśikhāmaṇulu tatvāvicāraparulai yājñikulato nālociṃci homādikaṃbulanu jarupavalasiyuṃḍunu apamṛtyu prayuktaṃbulagu rogaṃbulalo nāyāroganivāraṇopāyaṃbulu rakṣā vidhānādulu mikkili cakkaganunnivi vasiṣṭhakalpoktaṃ saṃgṛhyocyate mṛtyuṃjaya vidhānaṃ tadyādā - triyaṃbakasya vidānaṃtu kīrtayiṣye munīśvarāḥ || yadho ktavithināyuktaṃ saṃsyṛtaṃ brahmaṇāpurā | mṛtyuṃjayastridhāprokta ādyo mṛtyuṃjaya smṛtaḥ | mṛtasaṃjīvinīcaina mahāmṛtyuṃjaya stataḥ | mṛtyuṃjaye kevalesyā dghaṭito mṛtajīvanī | tāra tribījavyāhṛtvā ghaṭitastu triyaṃbakaḥ | mahāmṛtyuṃ jayaḥ proktā ssarvamaṃtra viśāradaiḥ | mṛsaṃjīvinī tāraṃ praṇavavyāhṛtiḥ purā | tatastriṃbakomaṃtraḥ punaraṃte tadhoccaret | mṛtyuṃjayo yamovātra kadhito maṃtravittamaiḥ | māyātārādikācaiva vyāhṛtitrayaṃ tataḥ | ghaṭatastryaṃbakamanu rmutasaṃjīvinī matā | sabījoyastu maṃtro vai mahāmṛtyuṃ jayaḥ smṛtaḥ | praṇavovyāhṛtīścaiva praṇavādyaḥ paṭhetpurā | tata striyaṃbakamanuraṃte vyāhṛtaya stathā | tribīja praṇavāṃteca vahnijāyā matoccaret | praṇavāṃte prasādaśca mṛtihāraka evaca | bhūrādi vyāhṛtayaśca tryaṃbaketicaṛktataḥ | viparyeṇa tribījaṃ tadvāktvaṃ vyāhṛtitrayaṃ | svāhaṃte manureṣotra śukreṇārādhitaḥ purā | mahāmṛtyaṃjaya iti vilṛto bhuvanatraye | oṃkāraiḥ saṃhitaḥṣaḍbhiḥ caturdaśabhirevaca | mṛtyuṃbayaṃtaṃ vidhivadupāsyepsita māpnuyāt || tathā vibhaktamaṃ travarṇairvā ṣaḍaṃgānāṃ prakalpanā | hṛdayaṃ tribhirākhyāta caturbhiḥ śiraucyate | śikhāṣṭabhiḥ samuddiṣṭā navabhiḥ kavacaṃ mataṃ | paṃcabirṇetramākhyāta mastra tribhuradāhṛtaṃ | pūrvapaścimayāmyeṃdu vaktaiṣu tadanaṃtaraṃ | purṇamaṃtraṃsya sedūrdhva mukhye tryaṃbakasaṃjñakaṃ | śirogaśāsyākṣi yuganābhi hṛtpraṣṭakukṣiṣu | liṃgapaiyūrumūlāṃta rjānuyugme tataḥ paraṃ | tadvṛttayugme tattanayoḥ pārśayoḥ pādayoḥpunaḥ | pāṇyornāsika yośśīṣṇri maṃtrarṇaunyasetkramāt | padānyekādaśanyasya śirobhrūyugalākṣiṣu | vaktaigaṃḍayugebhūyo hṛdaye jaṭharepunaḥ | guhyorujānupādeṣu nyāsamevaṃ samācaret || etatprayoge vyaktirbaviṣyati - ādauprāsādabījaṃ tadanumṛti haraṃtāraṃ vvāhṛtīca proccārya traṃbakaṃ yojapati mṛtiharaṃ bhūya evaitadādyaṃ || kṛtvānyāsaṃ ṣaḍagaṃsravada mṛtakaraṃ maṃḍalāṃtaḥ praviṣṭaṃ | dhyātvā yogīrudraṃ sajayaṃti maraṇaṃ śukramidyā prasādāt || vedādibhūrāda padatrayaṃ ca madhyejapesmṛtyuharaṃ tryaṃbakaṃ | japetphalārdhī vidhivatprayuktaṃ prāsāda mṛtyuṃjaya saṃpūṭena || oṃkāra tritayādyaśca oṃkāra tritayāṃtakaḥ | vyāhṛti tritayaṃcaiva prāsāda tritayaṃtathā | ojkārairmanusaṃkhyākai rjānīyātsarvisiddhaye || mahāmṛtyuṃjayaścaiva mṛtyuṃjaya striyaṃbakaḥ | triṃbakamanuryuktaḥ pūrvecāṃtedvayenaca | mahāmṛtyaṃjayoleke śukrasayārādhanāddhruvaṃ | bījaṃvināca śuddhastu mṛtyuṃjaya samākhyakaḥ || anye mahāmṛtyuṃjaya iti vidyā tridāhyamuṃ manuṃvadasti || tathā anyatra - caturdaśasvarai ryukto hakāreṇaca biṃdunā | prāsādākhyaṃ bhavedbījaṃ jakāreṇaca biṃdunā | mṛtyuṃjayaṃ samākhyātaṃ bījaṃ mṛtyuharaṃ paraṃ | savisarga spakāraśca tārakaṃ parikīrtitaṃ | sāraṃ sthiraṃ sakarṇeṃdu bhṛgusarga samanvitaṃ | akṣarātmāni gadito maṃtro mṛtyuṃ jayātmakaḥ || iti mṛtyuṃjaya vidhiḥ - vasiṣṭha prokte - kuṃḍasya pūrvadigbhāge kālījihva prakīrtitā | āgneyāṃtu karālīsyā ddakṣīṇetu sulohitā | manojayātu nai ṛtvāṃ dhūmravarṇīca vāruṇī || visaspulaṃgītu vāyuvyāṃ somye viśvarucistadā | kālyāṃ karālyāṃvā kuryāccāṃti kaṃpauṣṭikaṃ tadhā | bhūtapreta piśācādi śāṃtau lohita jihvikā | manojayāyāṃ jihvāyā mabhicāro vidhīyate | juhuyā ddhūmra varṇāyāṃ vṛṣṭikāmo yadhābhavet | spuliṃginītu yājihva tasyā muccācanaṃ viduḥ | yātu viśvarucirjihva kuṃḍasyottara bhāgataḥ | sarvārtha sādhakāseti procyate maṃtra vittamaiḥ | apareva sudhāreti jihvaṃ pūrvottara viduḥ | kuṃḍasya madhyamaṃ bhāgamagne rāsyaṃ pracakṣate | tasmin sarvāṇi kāryāṇi kārayonmāraṇaṃ vinā | aupāsanāgni mānīya tasmin kuṃḍe vinikṣipet | athavāśrotri yāgārānmadhitaṃvāsa māsayet | arcaye lokapāśca prāgārabhya pradakṣiṇaṃ | kuṃde kṛtvājya bhāgāṃtaṃ sarvamullekha nādikaṃ | svagṛhyoktavidhānena pāyase naivahomayet | ayuḥ kāmoghṛte nāgnau juhuyāllakṣa saṃkhyayā || āyutaṃvā sahasraṃvā śata maṣṭottaraṃtuvā | dūrvātrikairvā juhuyānmadhu ratraya naṃyutaiḥ || guḍūcī khaṇḍakairvāpi caturaṃgula māyataiḥ | adhavā juhuyādvidvān mikṣitaistila taṃjulaiḥ | prakṣālitai stilairvāpi juhuyādgoghṛta plataiḥ | palāśa samidhohutvā sarvamāyu ravapnuyāt | adhavā tarpayeddeva mudakena samāhitaḥ | ārogyakāmo juhuyādarka kāṣṭhe ghṛtaplutaiḥ | payasāvāpi juhuyāddravye nājyenāvā punaḥ | phalāśa samidhovāpi sarvaroga praśāṃtaye | ācciddrai rāmraparṇaistupayoktai juhuyājjvare | guḍucī khaṇḍakairvāpi juhuyādgoghṛta plataiḥ | pramehe madhunāhomaḥ payasāvā ghṛtenavā | auduṃbara samidbhirvā homa āmalakenavā | gulmeśālmali homasyāttilaiḥ kṛṣṇaighṛtenavā | vardamāna samiddhomaḥ sadyaḥ śūla harobhavet | karaṃja samidhovāpi nirguṃḍī samidhopivā | taile nābhyajya juhuyādvātaroga praśāṃtaye | śamī samidbhirjuhuyādati sārapraśāṃtaye | śāṃtyartha makṣirogasya palāśa samidhaḥ smṛtāḥ | usmatta samidhohutvā apasyārātpra mucyate | kuberākṣī ndravallībhyāṃ netra śūleṣu homayet | tailenābhyajya juhuyādvajra khaṇḍaista daivaca | mātaliṃga guḍūcīnāṃ homaḥ kāmala nāśanaḥ | madhuratraya homena śāṃtiḥ syādrāsa yakṣmaṇāṃ | homācca phalamūlānāṃ garbharogaḥ praśāmyati | kuṣṭhe masūrikai rṣoh madhutritaya saṃyutaiḥ | chinnotpalaistu juhuyātsalā śairvā ghṛtaplutaiḥ | athavā taila saṃyuktai rjuhuyādgaura sarṣapaiḥ | yocānye mukharogāḥ syuḥ śiro rogāstadhaivaca | tesarve praśamaṃyāṃti tilai rṣomādghṛta plutaiḥ | audarāṇāṃ turogāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ śāṃti micchatā | bilvavṛkṣa samiddomaḥ kartavyo dvijanattama | atha srāvetu juhuyā tsarmavatrai ghṛtaplutaiḥ | dūrvābhirvāpayoktābhi rjuhuyā ccaṃdanenavā | aśvaddhasya samidbhiścarakta srāvetu homayet | athavā goghṛtenaiva raktātisāraśāṃtaye | anyarogeṣu sarveṣu kaṇṭharoge mahodare | tribhiḥ phalaistu juhuyānmadu kṣīraghataplutaiḥ | madhuraratraya homastu sarvaroga praśāṃtaye | āyurvedeṣu yatproktaṃ yasya rogasya bheṣaṇaṃ | tasyarogasya śāṃtardhaṃ tena tenaca homayet | athavāte namaṃtreṇa pāvamānābhirevavā | tīrthatoyenadeveśī mabhiṣiṃce tsamāhitaḥ | bhūta jvare grahadīnāṃ sarveṣā mapiśāṃtaye | athavā tarpaṇaṃkuryā nmaṃtraiḥ pūrvoktasaṃkhyayā | athavā niyatāhāro japenmaṃtraṃ samāhitaḥ | evaṃ homaṃ japaṃ kuryā ttarpaṇaṃ japamevavā || āyurārogyasiddhyartha mātmanovā parasyaca | ekāhaṃ vātryahaṃvāpi daśāhaṃ dvādaśāhakaṃ | pakṣaṃ māsaṃ dvimāsaṃvā māsatraya mathāpiva | athavā caturomāsān ṣaṇmāsāne kahāyanaṃ | bhamemahāti saṃjāte dīrghakālaṃ samāhitaḥ | alpelpakālaṃkurvīta jupahomādikaṃ trayaṃ | rogakālopayuktaṃ yaddravya śayyāsanādika | rogamuktastu tatsarvaṃ nopayuṃjyātkadācana | apamṛtyu jayopāya mahaṃ vakṣyāmyataḥ paraṃ | madhuratraya yuktābhiḥ dūrvābhirjuhuyādbhudhaḥ | sahasramayutaṃvāpi śatamaṣṭottaraṃtuvā | śvetārkakusumairvāpi juhuyādgoghṛtenāvā | apamārgasamidbhiścatilaiḥ kṛṣṇairyavairapi | madhuratraya yuktābhiḥ dūrvābhirjuhuyādbhudhaḥ | sahasramayutaṃvāpi śatamaṣṭottaraṃtuvā | śvetārkakusumairvāpi juhuyādgoghṛtenavā | apamārgasamidbhiśca tilaiḥ kṛṣṇairyavairapi | athavā goghṛtenaiva payasāvāpi homayet | kapilā goghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ praśaṃsaṃti manīṣiṇaḥ | śanaiścaradhineśvardhaṃ spṛśanmaṃtra mimaṃjapet | sākṣānmṛto dvijaḥ kuryā tkiṃpunaḥ svayamutsṛjet | athavāpaya sādeva mabhiṣicya ghṛtenavā | palāśa khadirāśvattha samidbhi rjuhuyāttuvā | bilvavṛkṣo dbhavairvāpi sopimṛtyorvi mucyate | athavāśra payitvātu caruṃ raudraṃ dvijottama | aṣṭottara śataṃ hutvā mṛtyuṃjayati mānavaḥ | athopāyāṃtaraṃ vakṣye sākṣānamṛtyu nivartanaṃ | hastamātra pramāṇena vediṃ kuryā dvicakṣaṇaḥ | tanmadhye sthāpayetkuṃbhaṃ pīta sūtreṇa veṣṭitaṃ | taṃḍulairvrīhibhiścaiva caturasraṃ samaṃtataḥ | vāso yugmaina saṃvaiṣṭya tīrdatoyena pūritaṃ | pallavān kṣīravṛkṣāṇā mathavā cūta pallavān | prakṣapya tatrā laṃkṛt gaṃdha mālyākṣatādibhiḥ | tatrā vāhya mahādevaṃ devaṃ tryaṃbaka mīśvaraṃ | pūjaye dgaṃdha puṣpaidyaiḥ tryaṃbaketya nayāṛcā || tatobhi maṃtrametkuṃbhaṃ maṃtreṇānena maṃtravit | aṣṭottara sahasraṃtu abhiṣiṃcetatonaraṃ || srokṣaye dvāthakūrcena rājanaṃtu niśeṣataḥ | nāpa mṛtyu bhayaṃ tasya pacavyādhi kṛtaṃ bhayaṃ || parārthe dhanalobhena mohādajñānatopivā | mṛtyuṃjaya japaṃ kuryātsvayaṃ mṛtyu mavāpnuyāt || mātaraṃ pitaraṃ putraṃ rājācāryau vinā sadā || mahā mṛtyuṃjaya vidhāne ratrāvidhiḥ atha rakṣāvidhiṃ vakṣye sarvabhūta bhayāsahaṃ | aupānasāgni hotrotthaṃ gṛhītvā janmavaisitaṃ || mṛtyuṃjaye nāyātaṃvā sahasra mapivāśataṃ | tatobhi maṃtryatadbhanmate nāṃgānica saṃspṛśet || ādhāraṃ pravakṣyamāmi rogamṛtyu bhayāpahaṃ | grahapretora gādibhyo bhayaṃcaiva najāyate || yadaiṣṭena suvarṇena kārayedaṃgulīyakaṃ | paṃcalohe navākuryā trilohenaivāpunaḥ || thataḥ saṃpūjyadeveśaṃ gaṃdha puṣpākṣatādibhiḥ | triyaṃbaketi maṃtreṇa manastena samāhitaḥ || kuṃḍevā sthaṃḍilevāpi vidhivanmaṃtrakovidaḥ | goghṛte naiva juhuyāddyātvā devaṃ janārdanaṃ || śataṃ sahasramayutaṃ niyutaṃvāpi tattvataḥ | hotuśca dakṣiṇepārśve haimevā rājatepivā || kāṃsyevā mṛṇmayevāpi pātrenya syāṃgulīyakaṃ | sarvāhutiṣu saṃpātaḥ tasminnarpayate budhaḥ || aṃgulīyaṃ spṛśanmaṃtraṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ japet | aṃgalyāṃ sarvarakṣārthaṃ dhārayedaṃgulīyakaṃ || anenaiva vidhānena sarvāṇyābharaṇānica | navānidhārayonnityaṃ jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sukhī || atha śāṃti pravakṣyāmi sarvopadravanāśinī | adbhuteṣu ca sarvaṣu dussvapneṣu dvijottama || divyāṃtarikṣabhaumānā madbhutānāṃ ca darśane | pratyakṣaṃ pratibhāteṣu nānārūpeṣu sarvaśaḥ || bhūta preta piśācānā māveśaṃkite tathā | graha madhyegni mādhāya śrapayetpāya saṃcaruṃ || tenāva bāhuyādagnau maṃtreṇānena saṃyataḥ | tilodanaṃvā juhuyā ccuddodana madhāpivā || aṣṭottara śataṃ maṃtrai rjuhuyādgo ghṛtenavā | palāśa khadirāśvattha bilvānya groda saṃbhavaiḥ || apāmārga samidbhirvā juhuyādatha vātilai | athavānena maṃtreṇa kocihomaṃtu kārayet || gavyena sarpiṣā vidyān yavavrīhi tilai stuvā | agnimādāya juhuyātsamiccuru ghṛtādikaṃ || bhūtapreta piśācāścaye cāpyanye grahādayaḥ | tesarve homagaṃdhena dhūpa saṃnparśanenaca | maṃtrasyāsya prabhāvena virgaccaṃti gṛhāttataḥ || āthavānena maṃtreṇa pūrṇa kuṃbhaṃ samīhītaḥ | abhimaṃtryagṛhaṃ sarvaṃ prokṣayettena vāriṇā || athanyāsa vidhaṃvakṣye maṃtrasyāsya mahāmune | trayastriṃśa dasmin maṃtretu devatāḥ || ādā vaṣṭau vasūn vidyāt rudrānekādaśottare || tataśca dvādaśādityaḥ prajāpati ranaṃtaraṃ | vaṣaṭkārastu bhūteṣu sarvarakṣā karaśśivaḥ || evametāni rūpāṇi devānāṃ kadhitānivai | akṣarāṇinyasenmaṃtrī sarvāṃgeṣu samāhitaḥ || mūrdhādi paṃcasthāneṣu pradamaṃ paṃcakaṃ nyaset | dakṣiṇasya karasyāpi saṃdisthāneṣu paṃcasu || tataḥ parāṇi paṃcaiva vāmahastenya settataḥ | tatastu dakṣiṇepāde saṃdisthāneṣu paṃcasu || parāṇi paṃcavinyasya vāmapāde tathānyaset || tataśca dakṣiṇepārśve vāmapārśvenya setkramāt | pṛṣṭhenābauca guhyeca kukṣauca tritayaṃ nyanet || bhrūmadhye śirasigale hṛdaye mātṛkānyaset | evaṃ vinyasyasarvāṇi tatoṃtre praṇapaṃ japet || svasyāṃgeṣu nyasedeva devamaṃtraṃ samāhitaḥ | evaṃ kartumaśaktastu kuryādrakṣāṃ dvijottamaiḥ || a tha kā mya ka rmā ṇi atha kāmyāni karmāṇi pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥ | śrīkāmo bilvavṛkṣasya samidbhiradhavāphalaiḥ || patrairvāpyasya juhuyā nmahatīṃśriya māpnuyāt | gokāmaḥ payasā homāllabhategāṃ payasvīnīṃ || vidyārthī juhuyādyastu rudrākṣai rgoṣṛtaplutaiḥ | vidyāṃcāyustatovittaṃ lakṣatenātrasaṃśayaḥ || anyādyakāmo juhuyādanna mevaṃ ghṛtaplutaṃ | palāśasamidhohutvā brahmavarca ssamāpnuyāt || vṛṣṭikāmastusaṃpūjya devadeva triyaṃbakaṃ | arghyapādyādibhirdeva mabliṃgai rabhiṣecayet || āpohiṣṭhetitisṛbhiḥ hiraṇyavarṇādibhistadhā | pavamānuvākena tryaṃbaketya nayāṛcā || vaitasībhiḥ samidbhistu juhuyātpayasāplutaiḥ | āyutaṃvā sahasraṃvā juhuyatpayasāpivā || puṇyāhaṃvā cayeccaiva brāhmaṇān bhojayettataḥ | daśāhābhyaṃtarevṛṣṭi rbavatyeva nasaṃśayaḥ || vṛṣṭikāmāścardravāsā vaṭavṛkṣa samudbhavaiḥ | samidbhirjuhuyānmaṃtrā ssadyovṛṣṭi mavāpnuyāt || nābhimātre jalesthitvā dhyāyanvai puṣṭimāpnuyāt | japetriyabakaṃ maṃtraṃ mahātīṃ puṣṭimāpnuyāt || agnohotrā tsamādāya sitaṃbhasitamuttamaṃ | anayātuṛcāhutvā jalevṛṣṭiṃ nivārayet || jaletvetyarthaḥ - putrakāmastu juhuyātpāyasaṃ ghṛtasaṃyutaṃ | curuśeṣaṃ svayaṃbhuktvā putramāpnoti mānavaḥ || pārṇa māsyāṃ tilān‌hutvā ghṛtāktān vidaṃtesukhaṃ | gocarmamātramālipya gomayenādhabhūtale || dhānyarāśiṃ vinikṣipya tanmadhye sthāpayedbudhaḥ | viṃśatiṃ kalaśāṃstattrasitasūtreṇa veṣṭitān || tīrdhatoyenapūrṇā nbhūṣitān pallavādibhiḥ | triyaṃbaketi ca maṃtreṇa kalaśānpūjayetsudhīḥ || kalaśānabhimaṃtryādha sūktāni prajape dbudhaḥ | atha vaṃdhyāstriyaṃtaistu akṣibhyāmādi maṃtrakān || triyaṃbakaṃ ca japitvātha tīrdhaiḥ pratyaṃgamārjanaṃ | kṛtvātāṃ prāṅmakhīṃ kṛtvā kalaśai rabhiṣiṃcayet || acirāllabhateputra māyuṣmaṃtaṃ yaśasvinaṃ || vastrakāmastu juhuyātkusumaiḥ kālasaṃbhavaiḥ || yadvarṇaṃ juhuyātpuṣpaṃ tadvarṇaṃ vastramāpnuyāt | dhānyaṃ tilājyasaṃyuktaṃ hutvā kanyāmavāpnuyāt || devatāvaśyakāmastu kṛsaraṃ ghṛtasaṃyutaṃ | aṣṭottara sahasraṃtu juhuyātpāyasenavā || haviśśeṣaṃ svayaṃbhuktvā japenmaṃtramimaṃ punaḥ | devatāyāṃ samiddiśya karotyeva mataṃdriyaḥ || pratyatra bhūtāsā devī varamīṣṭaṃ prayaccati | itthaṃ lokaṃvaṃśe kuryānakṣatre rudradaivate || karavīrasamidbhistu tailaināktaiḥ ghṛtenavā | aṣṭottara sahasraṃtu hutvaivoccāṭayedripūn | nirkuṃḍikā samudbhiścaśvetārka kṣīsaṃmitaiḥ || kārayettatra homaṃtu kurvato bhramate ripuḥ | unmatta samidho hosūtpurasyoccāṭanaṃ bhavet || adānyapi yātkrūraṃ kalpoktaṃ māraṇādikaṃ | tatsarvaṃ naivakartavyaṃ brāhmaṇena nṛpeṇavā || laiṃge uttarārthe tripaṃcādaśa dhyāye | sūta uvāca - tryiṃbakena maṃtreṇa deva devaṃ triyaṃbakaṃ | pūjayedbāṇa liṃgevā svayaṃ bhūtepivā punaḥ || ṛṣitīrthe devatīrthe yadhāva danupūrvaśaḥ | aṣṭottara - sahasreṇa puṃḍarīkeṇa śaṃkaraṃ || raktotpalasahasreṇa tathā nīlotpalenaca | saṃpūjya pāyasaṃ datvā ghṛtamaudanikaṃ punaḥ || mudgānnāṃ madhu saṃyuktaṃ bhakṣyamāṇi surabhīṇica | agnauhomaśca vipulo yadhāvadunu pūrvaśaḥ || pūrvoktairapi puṣpaiśca caruṇāca viśeṣataḥ | japedvainiyutaṃ samyakkāla mṛtyūpa śāṃtaye || jātīpuṣpeṇa vaśyārthī juhuyā dayuta trayaṃ | ghṛtena karavīreṇa kuryā dākarṣaṇaṃ tvijaḥ || vidveṣaṇaṃ viṣeṇaiva kuryāddālāhalasyaca | taile noccāṭanaṃ proktaṃ ntaṃbhanaṃ madhunāsmṛtaṃ || tilena mohanaṃ proktaṃ tāḍanaṃ rudhireṇaca| kharasyaca gajasyātha uṣṭranyaca yadhā kramaṃ | staṃbhanaṃ sarṣapaiścāpi pāṭanaṃ laśunenaca || māraṇoccāṭanaṃ caiva drohabījena suvratāḥ | baṃdhanaṃ snuhi patreṇa senāstaṃboyataḥ paraṃ | ghṛtena sarvasiddhiḥ syātpāyasādṛdhi rucyate | tilena roga nāśaśca kamalena dhanaṃ bhavet || kāṃtiṃ madhūka puṣpeṇa sāvitryā cāyuta trayaṃ | japādi prabhṛtiṃ kuryāt sviṣṭāṃtaṃ pūrva vatsmataṃ || rudrādhyaye pyepaṃ - iti vasiṣṭha kalpaḥ || dā na he mā drau śau na ka ḥ triyaṃbakaṃ yājamaha iti śikhāyaṃ nyaset || sugaṃdhiṃ puṣṭivardhana miti hṛdaye | urvāruka miva baṃdhanāditi bāhvoḥ || mṛtyoriti guhye mukṣīya māmṛtāditi nābau | pādagulpeca jiṃhorujaghane kaṭimeḍhrayoḥ || nābhau kukṣidvaye pārśveka kṣayoḥ kucayoḥ hṛdi | skaṃdeca kukṣikāyāṃca kūrpare maṇibaṃdhake || kaniṣṭināmikā mathyā tarjanyāṃguṣṭa pāṇiṣu | kaṃṭheca cubuke vaktre nāsikākarṇaca kuṣī || lalāṭe mūrdhni cūḍāyāṃ varṇāsmaṃtrasya vinyaset || devīpurāṇe - oṃ - jūṃ - saḥ iti maṃtroyaṃkhyāto mṛtyuṃjayaḥ puraḥ || mṛtyuṃ jayastu devoyaṃ caturbāhu strī ṇetrakaḥ | akṣamālādharodevo dakṣiṇenatu pāṇinā || vāmenāmṛta kuṃḍīca dhārayeda mṛtānvitāṃ | varadā bhayapāṇiśca divyābharaṇa bhūṣitaḥ || śuklaḥ sunīla vāsāśca padmasyopari saṃsthitaḥ | tāraṃ tasya śirojñeyaṃ hauṃ juṃ saśca śivārcane || aṣṭautu śaktayaḥ pūjyāḥ paṃcākṣara samanvitāḥ | jayāca vijayācaiva ajitācā parājitā || oṃ jūṃ saḥ iti maṃtreṇa pūjyo mṛtyu jayaḥ śiva iti || a tha pra yo ga ḥ kartādeśa kālau nmṛtvā mama jīvaccarīrā virodhenā muka rogasya samūla nāśenāpamatyu niharaṇa dvārā kṣiprārogyārdamamuśa saṃkhyayā mahamṛtyuṃjaya japamahaṃ kariṣye | vipradvārā kārayiṣye itivā saṃkalpya || gaṇeśa pūjā puṇyāhavācana mātṛkā pūrvaka vṛddhi śrāddhāni kṛtvācāryaṃ vastrādyaiḥ vṛṇayāt || atha ācāryaḥ - ācamya prāṇānāyamya deśakālaustmatvā ayukasya kṣiprā rogārdhamamukājñayā triṃbaka pūjana japādikaṃ kariṣye || ityuktvā - pṛthvīti maṃtreṇasanaṃkṛtāpa sarpantviti bhūtānyutsārya || tāśatrayaṃkṛtvā mūle nalamiti dvādaśāvṛtyā - vāmanāsāpūrya || mūlaṃ yamiti ṣoḍaśāvṛtyā - kuṃbhaṃkṛtvā || mūlena ramiti dvātriṃśadāvṛtyā - recayete | yamiti dvādaśāvṛtyā - dehaṃ saṃśoṣyaramityagni bījena dagghvāvamitya mṛtabījena āplāvyātmana ākāśaḥ ākāśādvāyuḥ vāyoragni ragnerāpaḥ adbhyaḥ pṛthivīti tasya dehotpattiṃ vibhāvyavamitya mṛtaṃ śrāvayitvā prāmapratiṣṭhāṃ kṛtvā śivoha mitivibhāvyeṣṭa devaṃnatvā vāme guhu paramaguru parāparaguru parameṣṭigurān svabījanāmabhirnatvā mūlena prāṇānāyam || inya śrīmṛtyuṃjaya mahāmaṃtrasya vasiṣṭhaṛṣiḥ anuṣṭhup chaṃdaḥ || mṛtyuṃjaya maṃtrajape viniyogaḥ || śuddha tryaṃbaketryaṃ bījaṃ | aṃ śakti | vaṃ kīlakamiti maṃtrakośe akṣi śiromukha hṛdaya guhyapādeṣu ṛṣyādī nvinyasyamūlena karaśuddhiṃ kṛtvā praṇavaṃ karatala yoḥ syaset | oṃ agnaye hṛdayāya namaḥ | triṃbakāya śirase svāhā | trinetrāya śikhāyai || vasiṣṭhāya kavacāya huṃ | anuṣṭup chaṃdase netratrayāya vauṣaṭ rudro devatā astrāyaphaṭ || atha ṣaḍaṃgaḥ - tryaṃbakaṃ hṛdayāya | yajāmahe śirase | sugaṃdhaṃ puṣṭivarthanaṃ śikhāyai | urvāruka mivabaṃdhanā tkavacāyahuṃ || mṛtyo rmukṣīya netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | māmṛtādastrāya phaṭ || atha pādanyāsaḥ - oṃ tryiyaṃbakaṃ yajāmahe pūrvavaktraya namaḥ | oṃ sugaṃdhiṃ puṣṭivardhanaṃ paścima vaktrāya namaḥ | oṃ uruvāruka miva baṃdhanāt dakṣiṇa vaktrāya nāmaḥ | oṃ mṛtyo rmukṣīya māmṛtādityuttara vaktrāya namaḥ | omiti sarvarchā ūrdhvā vaktrāya namaḥ || adhākṣara nyāsaḥ - sarvatra praṇavādi namoṃ tatvaṃ | tryaṃ dakṣiṇapādamūle | baṃda dakṣiṇajānuni | kaṃ dakṣiṇagulphe | yaṃ dakṣiṇa pādāṃguli muleṣu | jāṃ tadagreṣu | maṃ vāmapāmūle | hṃ vāmajānuni | suṃ vāmagulbhe | gaṃ vāmapādāṃgūli mūleṣu | diṃ tavagreṣu puṃguhye | ṣṭiṃ ādhāre | vaṃ udare | rdhaṃ hṛdaye naṃ kaṃṭhe || urvāruka mitye tāni dakṣiṇa bāhu saṃdhiṣu | vabaṃdhanānmṛṃ vāma bāhu saṃdhiṣu || tyoṃ mukhe rmuṃ kṣiṃ dakṣiṇa vāmanāsayoḥ || yaṃ netrayoḥ | māṃ karṇayoḥ || mṛṃ bhṛvormadhye | tāt śirasi || adha vadanyānaḥ | tryaṃbakaṃ śirase || yajāmahe bhṛvormadhyāya sugaṃdhiṃ netrābhyāḥ | puṣṭivardanaṃ mukhāya | urvārukaṃ gaṃḍābhyāṃ | iva hṛdayāya | baṃdhanāt udarāya | mṛtyorgulphāya | mukṣiya mūrubhyāṃ | amṛtātpādābhyāṃ || adhākṣarādinyāsaṃ oṃ triṃ adharvāya śirase namaḥ | yaṃ dhṛvaya netrābhyāṃ baṃsaumāya karṇābhyāṃ | kaṃ adphyonāpā puṭāya | yaṃ anilāya mukhe | jāṃ ānalāya dakṣiṇa bāhumūlāya | kuṃ pratyūṣāya kūrparāya | heṃ prabhāsāya dakṣiṇa maṇi baṃdhāya | suṃ vīrabhadrāya dakṣiṃguli mūlebhyo | gaṃ śaṃbhave tatagrāya | dhiṃ giriśāya vāma bāhu mūlāya | puṃ acaika pādāya vāma kūrparāya | ṣṭiṃ ahirbudhnyāya vāmamaṇi baṃdhāya | vaṃ pinākine vāsūṃguli mūlebhyo namaḥ | rdhaṃ aparājitāya tadagrāya | naṃ bhuvanādhīśvarāya dakṣiṇa pādamūlāya | uṃ kapāline dakṣijānave namaḥ | rvāṃ sthāṇeve dakṣagulbhāya | ruṃ bhargāya dakṣa pādāṃguli mūlebhyo | kaṃ thātre tadagrebhyo namaḥ | miṃ aryamṇevāmoru mūlāya | vaṃ miāya vāma jānave namaḥ | baṃ varuṇāya vāmagulphāya | dhaṃ dharmāya vāmapādāya | nāt bhagāya tadireṣu | mṛṃ iṃdrāya dakṣa pārśvāya | rtyoṃ yamāya vāma pārśvāṃ | muṃ pṛṣṭhe pṛṣvā | kṣīṃ parjanyāya bhṛvormadyāya | yaṃ tvaṣṭre lalāṭāya | māṃ viṣṇave śirase namaḥ mṛṃ prajāpataye kaṃṭhāya | tādvaṣaṭkārāya hṛdayāya praṇavaṃ japet || athā paraḥ - triṃbakaṃ yaṃ - etānmukhasya pūrva paścima dakṣiṇottareṣu nyaset | jāṃ urasimaṃgale | heṃ mukhe | sugaṃnetrayoḥ | dhiṃnābhau | puṃ hṛdaye | ṣṭiṃ pṛṣṭhe | rthaṃ kṛkṣyoḥ | naṃ liṃge | uṃ pāyau | rvāṃ ūrvoḥ | rudhakaṃ jānyoḥ | miṃ vaṃjaṃghayoḥ | baṃdhaṃstanayoḥ | nāṃsmṛṃ pārśvayoḥ | tyoṃrmuṃ pādayoḥ | kṣīṃ yaṃ pāṇyoḥ | māṃ mṛṃ nāsikayoḥ | tāt śirasi | adhahemādrau śaunakoktanyāsaḥ | traṃbakaṃ yajāmahe śikhāyāṃ | sugaṃdhiṃ puṣṭivardhanaṃ hṛdaye | urvāruka mivabaṃdhāna dbāhoḥ | mṛtyormukṣīya māmṛtāt nābhau | tyaṃ pādayoḥ baṃgulbhayoḥ | kaṃjaṃghayoḥ | yaṃ ūrvoḥ | jāṃ jaghane | maṃ kaṭau | hṃ meḍhre | suṃ nābhau | gaṃ kukṣauḥ dhiṃ pārśvayoḥ | puṃ vakṣasi | ṣṭiṃ stanayoḥ || vaṃ hṛdirdhaṃ skaṃdhayoḥ | naṃ kaṃṭhe | uṃ kūrparayoḥ | rvāṃ maṇibaṃdhayoḥ | ruṃ kaniṣṭhayoḥ | kaṃ anāmikayoḥ | miṃ madhyamayoḥ | vaṃ tarjanyoḥ | baṃ aṃguṣṭhayoḥ | dhaṃ pāṇyoḥ | nāṃ kapolayoḥ | mṛṃ cubuke | tyoṃ mukhe | rmuṃ nāsayoḥ | kṣiṃ karṇayoḥ | yaṃ netrayoḥ | māṃ lalāṭe | mṛṃ mūrdhani | tāt śikhāyāṃ | ete kevalaṃ mṛtyuṃ jayanyāpāḥ | mahā mṛtyuṃjayepyeta deva kiṃtu pratyakṣaraṃ vyāhṛti trayaṃ praṇava pūrvaṃvadet || oṃ bhūḥ - oṃ bhūvaḥ - oṃ suvaḥ - oṃ tryaṃ dakṣiṇa pāda mūle - hauṃ - oṃ - juṃ - oṃ saḥ itivā prativarṇaṃ pratipada mādau vadet | athanāma ṣaḍaṃgaḥ | oṃ hauṃ oṃ juṃ oṃ saḥ oṃ namo bhagavaṭhe rudrāya śūlapāṇaye svāha hṛdayāya namaḥ | oṃ hauṃ oṃ juṃ oṃ saḥ oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya amṛta mūrtaye māṃjīva ya śirase | oṃ hauṃ oṃ juṃ oṃ saḥ oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya caṃdra śirase jaṭise śikhāyai | oṃ hauṃ oṃ juṃ oṃ saḥ oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya tripurāṃtakāya hrīṃ hrīṃ kavacāya | oṃ hauṃ oṃ juṃ oṃ saḥ oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya bhilocanāya ṛgyajussāma maṃtrāya svāhā netratrayāya vauṣace | oṃ hauṃ oṃ juṃ oṃ saḥ oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya pralayāgni rudrāya netratrayāya jvala jvala māṃ rakṣa rakṣa aghoramūrtaye astrāya phaṭ | atha tṛtīya ṣaḍaṃgaḥ - oṃ hauṃ oṃ juṃ oṃ saḥ oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya triyaṃbakāya trinetrāya tripurāṃtakāya tryiṃbakaṃ hṛdayāya | oṃ hauṃ oṃ juṃ oṃ saḥ oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya nīlagrīvāya śaśāṃka dhṛtaśekharāyāmṛta varṣiṇe yajā mahe śirase | oṃ hauṃ oṃ juṃ oṃ saḥ oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya vyāghra carma paridhānāya kapardine sugaṃdhiṃ pu,ṭi vardhanaṃ śikhāyai | oṃ hauṃ oṃ juṃ oṃ saḥ oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya pinākadhāriṇe nāgābharaṇāya daṃḍamālā dharāya urvāruka mivabaṃdhanā tkavacāya huṃ | oṃ hauṃ oṃ juṃ oṃ saḥ oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya ṛgya jussāma maṃtrāya jyoti rūpāya jñānātmane mṛtyormukṣīya netratrayāya | oṃ hauṃ oṃ juṃ oṃ saḥ oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya agnijījāya duṣṭagraha nivāraṇāya dūrjaṭine aghoramūrtaye jvala jvala rudra śakti triśūladhara māṃ rakṣa rakṣa sarvatos bhayaṃ diśa aghorāya māmṛtā castrāya phaṭ | tataḥ pīṭhā daumadhye vṛttaṃ | dbahiścatu rasraṃtadbahiḥ ṣaḍrasaṃ - tadbahi raṣṭadala dvayaṃ tataścatuṣkoṇa miti yaṃtraṃ vilikhya | dharmāya jñānāya | vairāgyāya | aiśvaryāya | adharmāya | ajñānāya | avairāgvāya | anaiśvaryāya | kṛtāya | tretāya | dvāparāya | kalaye | satvāya | rajase | tamase | sūrya maṃḍalāya | soma maṃḍalāya | vahnimaṃḍalāya | vahnaye | iti saṃpūjya || mṛtyaṃ jayastu devoyaṃ caturbāhu strīṇetrakaḥ | akṣamālādharo devo dakṣiṇenatu pāṇinā | vāmena ghṛta kuṃḍīca dhārayanna mṛtānvitaṃ || varadā rudradā bhaya pāṇiṃca divyā bharaṇa bhūṣitaṃ | śuklaṃ sunīla vāsāśca padmasyo pari saṃsthitaḥ || iti hemādau || accasvaccāraviṃdasthiti rubhaya karāṃka sthitau pūrṇakuṃbhau dvābhyāṃ | vegākṣamāle nija karakamālākhyāṃ ghaṭau nitya purṇau || tābhyāmitthaṃ sravaṃtaṃ śirasi śiśakalā baṃdhureplāva yaṃtaḥ | ssoyaṃ devo dadhānaḥ praviśatu niśadakalpajāla śśriyaṃ naḥ || iti prapaṃca sāra maṃtra kośa rītyā || baddapiṃga jaṭājūṭaṃ nāgabhūṣaṇa bhūṣitaṃ | dvādaśākṣaṃ paṃcapaktra maṣṭādaśa bhūjaṃ vibhu mitivā || hastābhyāṃ kalaśadvayāmṛta rasai rāplāva yaṃtaṃ śirodvābhyāṃtau dadhataṃ mṛgākṣa valayaṃ dvābhyāṃ vahastaṃ paraṃ | āṃkanyasta karadvayāmṛta ghaṭaṃ kailāsa saṃsthaṃ śivaṃ nvasthāṃ bhojagataṃ naveṃdu makuṭaṃ devaṃ trinetraṃ bhaje || iti dyātvāmūle nanāsāgra mārgeṇa madhye devatā māvāhya sthāpanī sannidhāpanī sannirodhinī || mudrāḥ pradarśya - mūlenāsana pādyāghyātacamana madhuvarka snāna vastra yajñopavīta gaṃdha puṣpāṇi samarpya || āvaraṇa pūjā kuryāt - madhye īśānaṃ | pūrvavaktre tatpuruṣaṃ | dakṣiṇe vāmadevaṃ | paścime aghoraṃ | uttare vaktre sadyojātaṃ | tataḥ ṣaṭkoṇeṣu | hrāṃ hṛdayāya | hrīṃ śirase | hrūṃ śikhāyai | hraiṃ kapacāya | hrauṃ netratrayāya | hraḥ hastrā phaṭ || purataḥ || nai ṛte pratiṣṭhāyai - vidyāyai śāṃtyai - iticatuṣkoṇe | gaṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ | maṃ mṛtyave namaḥ |maṃ durgāyai namaḥ | kṣaṃ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ | iti catuḥ patre | aṣṭadale brāhmyai - maheśvaryai | kaumāryai | vaiṣṇavyai | vārāhyai | iṃdrāṇyai cāmuṃḍāyai | tadbahiścaṃja bhairavāya | krodha bairavāya | unmatta bhairavāya | kapāla bhairavāya | saṃhara bhairavāya | āpaduddhāra bhairavāya | kāla bhairavāya | gaura bhairavāya | tadbahiḥ | laṃ iṃdrāya | raṃ agnaye | yaṃ yamāya | naṃ niṛtaye | paṃ varuṇāya | vāṃ vāyave | saṃ somāya | īṃ īśānāya | īśāneṃdra madhye āṃ brahmaṇe namaḥ | nai ṛti paśchama yormadhye hrīṃ viṣṇave namaḥ | iti saṃpūjya dhupa dīpa naivedya tāṃbūla dakṣiṇau nīrājana pradakṣima namaskārā nkṛtvā || mṛtyulajaya mahārudra trāhimāṃ śaraṇāgataṃ | janmamṛtyu jarā rogaiḥ pīḍitaṃ karmabaṃdhanaiḥ | tāvakastvadgataprāma stvacittohaṃ sadāmṛḍa || iti vijñapya deveśa japenmṛtyuṃ jayaṃ paraṃ tato japaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ ṣaḍaṃgaṃ kṛtvā || japaṃ nivedayet - āyutaṃ vunaścaraṇaṃ | tataḥ prayogaḥ | atha maṃtroddhāraḥ | oṃ bhūḥ | oṃ bhūvaḥ | oṃ suvaḥ | oṃ triyaṃbakaṃ yajāmahe buk | oṃ suvaḥ oṃ bhuvaḥ oṃ bhūḥ oṃ | iti mṛtyuṃ jayaḥ | kevalayā ṛcā | oṃ jūṃ saḥ iti pūrvā | oṃ hauṃ jūṃ saḥ iti oṃ bhūrbhuvassvaḥ iti pūrvā - aṃte pratilomaṃ sarvatra itivā mahā mṛtyuṃ jayastu yathā | oṃ hauṃ jūṃ saḥ oṃ bhūḥ oṃ bhuvaḥ | oṃ svaḥ oṃ triyaṃbakaṃ ṛk | oṃ svaḥ | oṃ bhūvaḥ oṃ bhūḥ oṃ saḥ oṃ jūṃ oṃ hauṃ oṃ svāhā | caturdhaśa praṇavaḥ | ṛgvidhāne | trirātraṃ niyatonaśnan śrapayetpāyasaṃ caruṃ | tenāhuti śataṃ pūrṇāṃ juhuyātsarpiṣādvijaḥ | samuddiśya mahādevaṃ tryaṃbakaṃ tryaṃbaketyṛcā - etatsarvaṃ śataṃ kṛtvā jīvedvarṣa śataṃ sukhī || iti mṛtyuṃbaya vidhiḥ || a tha pu ru ṣa sū kta pu na śca ra ṇa ṃ atha puruṣasūkta vidhiḥ viṣṇudharmottare - puṣkara uvāca - pratidevaṃ mahābhāga yatsūktaṃ pauruṣaṃsmṛtaṃ || sarvakāmakaraṃjñeyaṃ pavitra madhusūdanaṃ | ekaika ṛcārāma snātodatvā jalāṃjalīṃ || pauruṣeṇatu sūktena mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ | aṃtarjalagatojaptvā sūktametattupauruṣaṃ || sarvakalmaṣa nirmukto yatheṣṭāṃ labhategatiṃ | ekaikayā ṛṭāsnātaḥ paṃsepuṇyaṃ nivedayet || puruṣārthaṃjalerāma sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate | ekaikayā ṛcāsnāto datvorāma phalaṃlabhet | sarvakāmanavāpnoti yānkāṃści smanasecchati || pauruṣeṇatu sūktena prāṇāyāyo mahāphalaḥ | japahomau tathārāma sarvakalmaṣanāśanau || surāpo brahmahanena tadhaiva gurutalpagaḥ | pāpebhyo vipramucyeta japtvā sūktaṃtu pauruṣaṃ || kṛccaiḥ viśodhitaṃ pūrvaṃ madhyāhne salilaṃgataḥ | snānastu pauruṣaṃsūktaṃ japennitya mataṃdritaḥ || saṃvatsareṇa deveśa vāsudevaṃ praviśyati | svayaṃcaiva mahābhāga śākamūla phalāśanaḥ || taṃtu kāmamavāpnoti yaṃ rāmamanasecchati | śriyamāgryāṃ tathā rūpaṃ jīvitaṃ dīrghamevaca | aṇimāṃ laghimāṃprāptiṃ mahimāṃ ca bhṛgūttama || duḥkhāpagamamanyadvā yatkiṃci nmasaseccati | kāmaḥ pauruṣaṃjaptvā yātiviṣṇo paraṃpadaṃ || māṃgalyametatparamaṃ pavitraṃ saṃsāra duḥkhauga vināśakārī | sukhapradaṃ darmavidāṃ narāṇāṃ manorathāvāptikaraṃ pradaṣṭaṃ || maharṇave ṛgvidhāne - vakṣye puruṣasūktasya vidhāsaṃtvarcanaṃ prati | agnikāryaṃ japavidhiṃ stotraṃcaiva tadhātmakaṃ || snātvā yadhoktavidhinā prājñmakhaḥ śuddhamānasaḥ | prathamāṃ vinyasedvāme dvitīyāṃ dakṣiṇekare || tṛtīyāṃ vāmapādetu catarthīṃ dakṣiṇenyaset | paṃcamīṃ vāmajānautu ṣaṣṭhīṃvai dakṣiṇetathā || saptamīṃ vāmakaṭyāṃtu aṣṭamīṃ dakṣiṇetathā | navamīṃ nābhimadhyetu daśamīṃ hṛdayetathā || ekādaśīṃ kaṃṭhade dvādaśīṃ vāmabūhuke | trayodaśīṃ dakṣiṇeca asyadeśe caturdaśīṃ || aṣṇoḥ paṃcadaśīṃcaiva ṣoḍaśīṃ mūrdhnivinyaset | evaṃ nyāsaṃ vidhiṃkṛtvā paṃcāgāni samācaret | brāhmaṇosyetyādikābhiḥ ṛgbhiḥ paṃcāṃgakalpanā || hṛdayaṃ śiraḥ śikhā kavaca mastraṃceti paṃcāṃgāni | yadhādehe tathādeve nyāsaṃkṛtvā vidhānataḥ || tadādau saṃkalpaṃkṛtvā nyāsadvayaṃ kuryāt | asya sūktasya nārāyaṇaṛṣiḥ | puruṣodevatā | anuṣṭup chaṃdoṃtrātriṣṭhup | jape viniyogaḥ - tatra japahomeca ṛjmantrameva niyatamitita devaha | adyayāvāhāyeddevamṛ cātu puruṣottamaṃ | dvitīyayāsanaṃ datyātpādyaṃcaiva tṛtīyayā || caturthārghyaṃ pradātavyaṃ paṃcamyā ca manaṃtathā | ṣaṣṭhyāsnānaṃ prakurvīta saptamyā vastramevaca || yajñopavītamaṣṭamyā navamyābharaṇaṃ tathā | daśamyāṃ gaṃdhadānaṃsyā dekādaśyāca mālyakaṃ || dvādaśyā dūpanaṃdatvā ttrayodaśyātu dīpakaṃ | caturdaśyātu naivedyaṃ paṃcadaśyā namaskriyā || udvāsanaṃtu ṣoḍaśyā upacārastu ṣoḍaśa | snāne vastreca nai vedye dadyādācamanīyakaṃ || dadyā tpuruṣasūktena yaḥ puṣpaṃjali mevavā || arcitaṃ tenavai sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaraṃ | takṣiṇāṃtu yadhāśaktyā ṣoḍaśarcā pradāpayet || tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃkuryā japaṃkuryā tsamāhitaḥ | yathāśakti japitvātu sūktaṃcaistamai nivedayet || devaśya dakṣiṇepārśve kuṃḍasthaṃḍilamevavā | kārayetpradhamarcātu prokṣaṇaṃ tṛtīyayā || tṛtīya yāgni mācathyā cca turthvātu samiṃdhanaṃ | paṃcamyā tvājyasaṃskāraśca rośca śravaṇaṃ tadhā || ṣaṣṭvā nalasya madhyeta kalpaye tpadmamānasaṃ | ciṃtaye tatradeveśaṃ kālanala samaprabhaṃ || vivṛttāsyāṃ vāhiśīrṣaṃ raktāsyaṃ raktalocanaṃ | tato gaṃdhaṃ ca puṣpaṃca dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ nivedayet || paṃcabiśca tataḥ kuryā tsaptamyādi yathākramaṃ | vahau pūjaye dityarthaḥ || samidbhiḥ pratyṛcaṃpūrvaṃ juhuyādabhighāribhiḥ | tato ghṛtenajuhuyaccaruṇā tataḥ punaḥ || evaṃ hutvā tataścaiva anujñāpya yadhākramaṃ | agnerbhagavattastya samīpestotramuccaret || jitaṃte puṃḍarīkākṣa namaste viśvabhāvana | namastestu hṛṣīkeśa mahāpuruṣa pūrvaja || namo hiraṇyagarbhāya pradhānāvya ktarūpiṇe | oṃ namo vāsudevāya śuddhajñānasvarūpiṇe || devānāṃ dānavānāṃca sāmānya madhidaivataṃ | sarvādā caraṇaṃ dvaṃdvaṃ vrajāmi śaraṇaṃ tava || ekamastvamasilokasya sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ | adyakṣaucānumaṃtāca guṇamāyā samāvṛtaḥ || saṃsārasāgaraṃ ghoraṃ anantāṃ kleśanāśanaṃ | tvāmeva śaraṇaṃprāpya nistaranti manīṣiṇaḥ || naterūpaṃ nacākāro nāyudhāni nacāspada | tathāpi puruṣākāro bhaktānāṃ tvaṃ prakāśane || naiva kiṃcitparokṣovā pratyakṣovā nakasyacit | naiva kiṃcidapidvaitena ca siddhosikasyacit || kāryāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ pūrvaṃ vacasāṃ vākyāmuttamaṃ | yogināṃ paramaṃsiddhaṃ tvāṃ vadantimanīṣiṇaḥ || ahaṃ bhītosmideveśa saṃsāresmin bhayāvahe | pāpimāṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa nājāne śaraṇaṃ paraṃ || kāleṣvapi ca sarveṣu dikṣusarvāsu cācyuta | śarīre vigatecāpi varthateme mahādbhayaṃ || tvatpādakamalā danyannāsti janmāṃtareṣvapi | nimittaṃ kuśalasyāpi yonagaccāmi sadgatiṃ || vijñānaṃ yadidaṃprāptaṃ yadidaṃ jñānavarjitaṃ | janmāṃta repimedeva mābhūdasya parikṣayaḥ || dargatā vapijātasyatvaṃ gatistvaṃ matirmama | yadinādhaṃ ca viṃdeyaṃ tāvatāsmikṛtī sadā || amuṃkaluṣitaṃ nattaṃ mamate pādayoḥ sthitaṃ | kāmayodvaiṣṇavaṃ tatvaṃ sarvajanmasu kevalaṃ || ityeva manayāstutyā stutvā devaṃ dinedine | kiṃ karomīticātmānaṃ devāyaiva nivedayet || puruṣasya hareḥ sūktaṃ svargyaṃdhanyaṃ yaśaskaraṃ | phalāharo japennityaṃ paśyannātmā namātmani || phalāni bhūktopavasenmā samadbhiśca vartayet | araṇye nivasenityaṃ japanni mamṛṣiṃ muniḥ || ṛṣiṃ maṃtraṃ ṛgnistriṣavaṇaṃkāle yādapsu samāhitaḥ | snāne etābhirmārjana maghamarṣaṇaṃcetyarthaḥ || ādatyamupitaṣṭheta sūktenānena nityaśaḥ | ājyāhutīranenaiva hutvevaṃ ciṃtayedṛṣiṃ || ṛṣiḥ sūktaṃ draṣṭo nārāyaṇaḥ | urdhvaṃ māsātphalāharastri bhirvaṣai rjapedidaṃ || tadbhakta stanmanoyukto daśavarṣāṇya nanyabhāk | sākṣātpasyatitaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇa manāmayaṃ || anāsā dayamānopi bhaktaṃ saparihasayet | bhaktānukaṃpī bhagavān jāyate puruṣottamaḥ || yenayenaca kāmena japeta prayatassadā | prāptakāma samṛddasyā cchraddadhyānasya kurvataḥ || homaṃ vāpyathavājapya mupahāra madhocaruṃ | kurvītayenakāmena tatsiddhi mupadhārayet || jñātiśraṣṭhyaṃ mahādvittaṃ yaśoloke parāṃgatiṃ | pāpena vipramokṣaśca bhavetsarvaṃ sasaṃśayaḥ || athābhidhīyatekarma putrakāmasya veṣṇavaṃ | śuklapakṣe śukravāre sunakṣatre sugocare || dvādaśyāṃ putrakāmastu caruṃkurvīta vaiṣṇavaṃ | daṃpatyo rupavāsasyā dekādaśyāṃ surālaye || ṛgbhiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ samyakarcayitvā janārdanaṃ | caruṃ puruṣasūktena śrapayetputrakā manaḥ | prāpnuyādvaiṣṇavaṃ putra macirātsaṃtati kṣamaṃ || dvādaśa dvādaśī spamyakpayasānirvapeccaruṃ | yaḥ karoti sahasraṃtu yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padaṃ | hutvāgniṃvidhi vatsamyak ṛgbhi ṣṣoḍaśa bhirbudhaḥ | kṛtvāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā stavaṃtābhiḥ prayojayet || keśamaṃ mārgaśīrṣetu pauṣe nārāyaṇaṃ viduḥ | mādhavaṃ māgha māsetu goviṃdaṃ phālgune tadhā || caitre caiva tadhā viṣṇuṃ vaiśākhe madhusūdanaṃ | jyeṣṭhe trivikramaṃ vidyā dāṣāḍe vāmanaṃ viduḥ || śrāvaṇe śrīdharaṃ viṃdyāddṛṣikeśa mataḥ paraṃ | aśvine padmanābhaṃca dāmodara mataḥ paraṃ | dvādaśaitāni nāmāni prati māsaṃtu hāvayet || svagṛhyokta vidhānna payasi caruḥ kāryaḥ śravaṇa samayestūkta māvartayat - sakala sūktena ekāhuti revaṃ sahasra homaḥ || naca āyuta japottaraṃ kāryaḥ - kṛṣṇaikādaśyā mupakramya āyutaṃ japtvā | śuklaikādaśyāṃ daṃpatī upoṣya dvādaśyāṃ | curaṃ sahasraṃ juhuyāditi mahārṇavaḥ | athāparaḥ prakāroya mekādaśyāma bhojanaṃ || daṃpatyoḥ pauruṣa sūktaṃ nitya karmā virodhica | kāle japedidaṃ sūkta nitya karmā virodhica | kāle japedidaṃ sūkta mekādaśyāṃ niraṃtaraṃ || dvādaśa dvādaśīṣvevaṃ payasā nirvapeccaruṃ | eva mekādaśyupavāsādi nāhutvājyaṃ vidhi || vacchātraḥ ṛgbhiḥ ṣoṣaśa bhidbhudhaḥ | kṛtāṃja lipuṭo bhūtvāntuvan tābhiḥ prayojayet || samidhośvattha vṛkṣasya hutvājyaṃ juhuyātbunaḥ - upasthānaṃ hutāśasya dhyātvātu madhusūdanaṃ - agnenaya maṃttrrupasthānamiti maharṇavaḥ | yuktaṃtu puruṣasūktenaiva || havirṣo maṃtataḥ kuryā tpratsṛcaṃ vagyataḥ śuciḥ || sūktena juhuyādajya mādāvaṃteca pūrvavat || haviśśeṣaṃ namaskṛtya nārī nārāyaṇaṃ patiṃ | bhakṣayitvā haviśśeṣaṃ bhaktvāvāmaśāyīsyādityardhaḥ | tataḥ kṛtvādvidaṃ karma kartavyaṃ dvija tarpaṇaṃ | dvitīyāṃ striyaṃ nivarteta yāvaggarbhaṃ naviṃdati || yayā sahedaṃ karma kṛtaṃtāṃ vihāyānyāmṛtā vapinopeyāt | sarvābhissaha vratācaraṇetu nadoṣaḥ | ṛtāvapyanyastriyā agamane ātikrama doṣānāstveva - kiṃtpalpaḥ - tatraikaḥ śaktau prājā patyāḥ - aśaktau trirātra dvirātrādi - aputrā mṛta putrāca yācakanyāṃ prasūyate | kṣipraṃ sājana yetputra mṛṣyaśṛṃgo yadhā bravīt || bṛhatparāśaro pyevaṃ vidhimuktavān | homāṃte dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāddenuṃvāsa stathā tilān || bhūmiṃ hiraṇyaṃ bhakṣyāṇi yathā saṃbhavamevaca || iti puruṣastūkta vidhiḥ| <9> sartvśca japādau dīpasthāpanaṃ kāryaṃ tadyathā - yugmaṃ svarāṇāṃ vilikhecca pūrvaṃkādīṃśca vargāskramaśo vilikhya | sthānādipādya kṣaramasti yaṃtraṃ taṃ dīpadeśaṃ munayovadaṃti || idamevakūrma cakraṃ yasyatubhedoya drāma nāmādyavarṇena | kūrmamukhamiti taduktaṃ śivacaṃdrikāyāṃ || akārāda svaradvaṃdv pūrvādiṣvaṣṭasunyaset | ugadādīn sadāvarṇā nnyasecchidradaśāṃvinā | grāmasyāntyādyavarṇastu yasyāṃ diśyavatiṣṭhati | tatra kūrmamukhaṃjñeya manyāṃgānāṃ paratraca | mastrasiddhiṃ mukheviṃdyā tkarayoralpakaṃ phalaṃ || niṣpalaṃ pādayormadhye audāsinyaṃca pādayoḥ | vadhabaṃdhananisvāni pucchadeśe bhavaṃtahi || evaṃ rudrapādāva pītikecit - anyetvasyātāṃtrika japaparatvādvaidikajapena niyamamityāhuḥ | asyāpavādastatraiva - kurukṣetre prayogeca gaṃgasāgare saṃgame | mahodayādaukāśyaṃ ca dīpasthāpanaṃ naciṃtayet || iti dīpasthānaṃ|| rudra puraścaraṇavidhiḥ sacarāvaṇabhāṣya bhaṭṭabhāskara vidyāraṇyabhāṣyahemādri mahārṇa vādyālocanenocyate | tatra rudrasyajape rahomobhiṣekeca śṛtismṛtyādau viniyoge dṛśyate | tatra jābāliśrutiḥ kiṃ japyenā mṛtatvanno brūhi | śatarudrīyeyenetyetā nihavā amṛtānāmadhye yānyetairhavā anṛtā bhavantīti kaivalyopaniṣadiyaḥ śatarudrīya madhītesognipūto bhavati - svarṇa steyātpūto bhavati brahmahatyāyāḥ pūto bhavati kṛtyākṛtyātpūto bhavati | kaivalyaphalamaśruta iti || || hemādrau bodhāyanaḥ - atha paṃcāṃga rudrāṇāṃ japahomārcanavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | vidhiśabdasya japādiṣu pratyeka manvayaḥ | arcana mabhiṣeka iti mahārṇavaḥ - parāśaraḥ || madyaṃ pītvā gurudārāṃśca gatvāsteyaṃ | kṛtvā brahmahatyāṃ ca kṛtvā | kabhasmacchanno bhasmaśayyāyāṃ śayano | rudrādhyāyā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || ida mahārahaḥ kṛte māsamātraṃ jñeyaṃ || rudrādhyāyī bhava bhevedbhaktyā māsamekamataṃdritaḥ | prāyaścittaṃ bhavedetadrahasyasya nasaṃśa iti parāśara purāṇāt || pādme śivagītāsu - yanturudraṃ japennityaṃ dhyāyamānomamākṛtiṃ || ṣaḍakṣaraṃvā praṇavaṃ niṣkāyovi jiteṃdriyaḥ | athādharvaśiro maṃtraṃ kaivalyaṃvā raghāttama || satenaivacadehena śivassaṃjāyate dhṛvaṃ || vāyanīye - sarveṣu grahadoṣeṣu dusvapnādbhutadarśane | japanrudrān sakṛdvipraḥ sarvadoṣaiḥ pramucyate || yamaḥ - paṃcabṛṃhaṃvāla khilyān nivitpreṣān vṛṣākapiṃ hohṛ nrudrānsakṛjñāptā mucyate sarvapātakai | śukriyāraṇya kaḍapogāyatryāśca viśeṣataḥ || sarvapāpa harāhyete rudraikādaśini tathā || hemādrau kauśika bodhāyanau - rudraikādaśinītveṣā sarvakāma phalapradā || sarvapāpa kṣayakarī sarvaśāṃti pradāyinī || viṣṇu dharmottarepi - rudrāṇāṃca tathā jāpyaṃ sarvāṣu vinighādanaṃ | sarvakāmakaro homastathā sarvatra śāṃtidaḥ || ajānikānāma śvānāṃ kuṃjarāṇāṃ tathā gavāṃ | manuṣyāṇāṃ nareṃdrāṇāṃ bālānāṃ yoṣitāmapi || grāmāṇāṃ sagarāṇāṃca deśanāṃcāpi bhārgava | upadravāṇāṃ dharmajña vyādhitānāṃ tathaivaca || mārakesa manuprāpte rapujeca tathā bhaye | rudhrahomaḥ parāśāṃtiḥ pāyasena ghṛtenavā || hemādrau kālikā purāṇo - yaḥ puna ssatataṃ bhaktyā abhyarcya śaśiśekharaṃ || japedthyāye tsadārudrānyopiyāti paraṃ padaṃ || adhaihike phalaṃ kiṃcidaihikaṃ puṣkalaṃ tathā | tānevahi jape dudrān śucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ | athavedaṃ jagatsarvaṃ śaśīkartuṃ samīhate || tadā rudraṃ japedbhūyo dhyāyamāno maheśvaraṃ | tena japarudro homarurrobhiṣeka rudraśceti tridhā rudra uktaḥ || ādyodvidhā kepala japātmakā homāṃgaśca || tatrātryaṃgirsau - ekadaśa guṇān‌vāpi rudranāvartyā darmavit | mahāpāpairapi spṛṣṭo mucyatenātra saṃśayaḥ || sarva pāpāni naśyaṃti rudraikādaśinī tatheti | kālikā purāṇādau japamātrokteḥ || japāddaśāṃśato homastathā homāttu tarpaṇaṃ | tarpaṇasya daśāṃśena mārjanaṃ kadhitaṃ kila || mārjanasya daśāṃśena brāhmaṇānapi bhojayet | japorcā pūrvako homastarapaṇaṃcābhi ṣecanaṃ || bhūdevapūjanaṃ paṃcaprakāroktā puraskriyā | homāśakto japaṃkuryāddhomasaṃkhyā caturguṇaṃ || eṃkṛtetu maṃtrasya jāyate siddhiru ttameti | puraścaraṇa caṃdrikādau japamātre taddaśāṃśa homokteḥ || tena tarpaṇādyapi siddhaṃ | homarudretu tarpaṇādya nāvaśyakameva || japamātre taduktaiḥ anyetu puraścaraṇaṃ evāyaṃ vidhiḥ | tataeva hemādri mahārṇavādau tarpaṇādyanuktiḥ || tena tadu ktahomo japo viprabhojanaṃ cetye | tattrayaṃ kārya mityāhu rvruddhāḥ | vṛddha yājñavalkyāḥ - surāpaḥ svarṇahīrīca rudrajāpī jalesthitaḥ | sahasraśīrṣajāpīca mucyate sarvakilbhiṣaiḥ || sarvapāpaharāhyete rudraikhādaśinī tathā | vedamekaguṇaṃjajaptvā tatohnai vaviśudhyati || hemādrau kālikāpūrāṇe - yadāmuṣmikamīheta phalaṃ lokeṣvanalpakaṃ | tadārudraṃ japennityaṃ dhyāyamāno maheśvaraṃ || yaśca sāgaraparyantāṃ dadyādbhūmiṃsa kāṃcanāṃ || tasmādapyadhikaṃtasya kṛdrudra japādbhavet | vāyupurāṇepyevaṃ - namakaṃ camakaṃcaiva puruṣasūktaṃ tadhaivaca | nityaṃ trayaṃ prayuṃjāno brahmaloke mahīyate || camakaṃ namakādarvā kpuṃsūkta mapiyojapet | praviśetsa mahādevaṃ gṛhaṃ grahapatiryadhā || rāgovān pāpavāṃścaiva rudraṃ japtvā jiteṃdriyaḥ || rogātpāpātpramukto sāvatulaṃ sukhamaśnule | liṃge uttarārthe tripaṃcāśa dadhyāye - mṛtyujaya vidhiṃ vakṣye bahanākiṃ dvijottama | rudrādhyāye vidhināghṛtena niyataḥ kramāt || saghṛtena tilenaiva kamale naivayatnataḥ | dūdvayā ghṛtagokṣīra miśrayā madhunātadhā || caruṇāna ghṛtenaiva kevalaṃ payasāpivā | juhuyā tkālamṛtyostu pratīkāraḥ prakīrtitaḥ || sūtasaṃhītāyāṃ - yaḥ śraddayāyutonityaṃ śatarudrīya mabhyaset | svarṇasteyātsurāpānā duṣkṛtāca raṇāttathā || mucyate brahmahatyāyā iti kaivalya śākhinaḥ | vāyupurāṇe - tapastapatiyotyarthaṃ sahasrābdāni saṃyamī || gavāṃ koṭipradānaṃ yaḥ karoti vidhivadgurau | nasatphala mavāpnoti yassakṛdrudrajāpakaḥ || rudrebhyastu paraṃnāsti japodhyānaṃhutaṃ tapaḥ | tadhā || anapatyādidoṣeṣu śākinyādi graheṣuca || sarvajvaravināśāya rudrajāpo viniścitaḥ | āpastaṃbhaḥ - tasya rudraḥ prajāṃ paśū nabhimasyate || yajñādisūktakalpa ityādi rāvamabhāṣyejñeyaṃ || tatrādau vratamuktaṃ hemādrau kālikāpurāṇe | kṛchramādau svayaṃcītvān parākaṃcatadhā punaḥ || kṛtvādhyāya nmahādeva mevaṃbhūyaḥ samācaret | snātvādheśaṃ samabhyarca uṣitā saptaśarvarīḥ | japedudrāṃ stadhājasraṃ tadannaṃ prāśayeddhutaṃ || āparehanisaṃjāte samāpyaivaṃ vrataṃ punaḥ | bhāskarābhimukhobhūtvā tasminnyastekṣaṇo japet | bhūyuścāhni parerudraṃ saṃpūjya vidhivatkṛtaṃ | ghṛtāktai bilvapatraiśca rudrahomaṃ prakalpayet || evaṃ samyakkṛtenyūnaṃ kartāsaujāyate dvijaḥ | sākṣādudromahātejā stataḥ kāmāṃśca sādhayet || śāṃtihomādrau kauśikaḥ - bodhāyanoktamevāhaṃ pravakṣye śaunakodvijaḥ || kāmināṃ sarvakāmārdhaṃ akāmānāṃ śatarudriyaṃ || liṃgabhyā śethavā tīrthe snānaṃ kṛtvā yadhāvidhi | rakṣārdhaṃtu śikhā graṃdhi mūrthakeśeti maṃtrataḥ || bhūtāni prārthaye ttadva duttiṣṭhaṃtviti maṃtrataḥ | upaviśya sucaudeśe prāṇānāyamya vāgyataḥ || saṃkalpa japahomautu yadardāya taducyate | rudra praśnasya chedhotrasyā danuṣṭu bṛṣistadā || aghoraḥ sarvapāpaghna adityo devatāparaḥ | nyāsaṃbhavādibhiḥ kṛtvā namoṃtaiḥ praṇavānvitaiḥ || maṃtrai raṣṭābhirīśānaṃ bilādyuktaiḥ śubha pradaiḥ | bhavaṃcapādayornasya śarvaṃnyasyoru madhyataḥ || īśānāṃ guhyadeśetu nābhau paśupatiṃ nyaset | vinyasya hṛdaye rudra mugraṃ vinyasya vaimukhe || bhīmaṃ lalāṭa deśetu mahāṃtaṃ śīrṣṇi vinyapet || mahāṃstu kavace kārya mekaikenāstra muttamaṃ | tathaivāntyānuvākasya maṃtrairadvādaśakhiḥ śuciḥ || ādyaṃtu pādayorsya dvitīyaṃ jānu deśake || ūrvostṛtīyaṃ vinyasya caturdaṃguda deśataḥ | paṃcamaṃ nābhideśetu ṣaṣṭhaṃtu hujayesyaset || saptamaṃkaṃṭha deśetu mukhecāṣṭama muttamaṃ | navamaṃ nāsikāyāṃtu daśamaṃ netrayordayoḥ || ekādaśaṃ lalāṭetu dvādaśaṃ śīrṣi vinyaset | trayodasaṃtu kavacehuṃ kṛtvā stretu phaṭ tataḥ || evaṃ nyāsa vidhiṃ kṛtvā tato mudrāṃ pradarśayet | eṣate rudrabhāgastamiti mudrā pradarśanaṃ || śrīkāmaḥ śīrṣṭikarvī tatejiskāmastu netrayoḥ | mukhyetvanyādya kāmastu grīvāyāṃroga nāśane || hṛdaye sarvakāmastu nākhau jñānī pradarśayet | prajā kāmastu guhyevai paśukāmastu jaṃghayoḥ || jānvostu grāma kāmastu rāṣṭra kāmastu pādayoḥ | vaśīkaraṇa kāmastu vāmahaste pradaśśayet || pāpakṣayobhicāre vāvyādherapagame tathā | bahiśśarīrātkurvīta śivasyājñeti casmaran || evaṃ pradarśayitvātu tatodhyānaṃ samācaret | triloca saṃcaturbāhuṃ sarvābharaṇa bhūṣitaṃ || nāga carma parīdhānaṃ vyāghra carmottarīyakaṃ | vṛṣaskaṃtha samārūḍhamu mādehardha dhāriṇaṃ || amṛte nāplataṃ śāṃtaṃ caṃdrārda kṛta śekharaṃ | śudda sphaṭika saṃkāśaṃ jaṭā makuṭa maṃḍitaṃ || varadābhaya hastaṃca sarvakāma phalapradaṃ | evaṃ dhyātvādvija ssamyaganaṃ gāṃgaharaṃ haraṃ || aṃgānāṃ yajasaṃkūryā tsamyagbhakti parāyaṇaḥ | hṛdaye hṛdayaṃ japtvā mūrdhni sūktaṃca pauruṣaṃ || śukhiyā muttaraṃ caiva nārāyaṇa manuttamaṃ | kavacenā pratiradhaṃ japtvedhdhaṃ śatarudriyaṃ || japtvāṃgāni japeccāṃtiṃ ttriḥ śāṃtiriti coccaret | śāntiṃ śanyovāto namovācaṃ satrividhopi rudraḥ pratyekaṃ paṃcathā || rudraṃ rudrī rudro mahārudroti rudraśceti | tatra namaka camaka mātramu bhayaṃ rūpaṃ || anyeśātā tapenoktāḥ - ṣaḍaṃgaikādaśinī rudro rudraikādaśa rudrataḥ | ekādaśabhirotābhirmahā rudraśca kathyate || ekādaśa mahā rudrairati rudra itīritaḥ || asārdha mahā mahārṇavaḥ || pūrvanyāsaṃte ekādaśa namakān paṭhitvā ādyaṃca makānuvākaṃ paṭhet | punastāv paṭhitvā dvitīyaṃca makānuvāka mityekādaśāvṛtyā rudra ityucyate || ekādaśinyā rudra iti paryāyaḥ | tadāha bodhayanaḥ || namaste rudra manyava ityekādaśānu vākānāmagnā viṣṇū sajoṣana ityaikaina manuvākaṃ japediti | sarva namakān paṭhitvā ekaikaṃ camakānuvākaṃ paṭhedityarthaḥ || tenaikarūpe sarva camaka japonatu vibhāgaḥ | tairekādaśa rudraiḥ rudrītyucyate || saivalaghurudraḥ rudraikādaśi nīticocyate || tābhirekādaśabi rmahārudraḥ | tai rekādaśāvṛttiratirudra iti || etadevāhaturhemādrau kauśika bodhāyanau | sadyādi paṃcavaktrāṃśca rudrānai kādaśaivaca || japitvā sarvaruṃdraṃśca camakādyaṃtato japet | punareta jjapetsarvaṃ dvitīyaṃ camakaṃ tadhā || rudraikādaśanītyeṣā sarvakāma phalapradā | sarvapāpakṣayakarī sarvaśāṃti pradāyinī || ekādaśaguṇaisaiva rudra ityabhidhīyate | mahānekādaśaguṇya stvati rudra ihocyate || rudraṃ mahātirudraṃca japetkāryasya gauravāt | ayaṃ rudraikādaśinīrītyā mahārudrādi prakāraḥ || sarvaśākhināṃ japasamayobhiṣeke ca samāsaḥ | kāṇya kātyāyanīyānāṃ tvekādaśadhā camakavibhāgaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ || tathā - tato homaṃ prakurvīta namaḥ śaṃbhavamaṃtrataḥ | rudraikādaśa jāpyeva trayastriṃ śadadhāhutīḥ || laghurudreśa taṃproktaṃ ṣaṣṭyātryadhikayā tataḥ | catvāraśca tathārudre sahasrāḥ saptavarjatāḥ | catvāriṃśa tsahasrāśca hotavyā ścaturottarāḥ || ūnāścaivāṣṭasaptatyā tvatirudre viniścayaḥ | pāpakṣayebhicāreca tathā vyādhivimocane || pālāśasyamidhaḥ kāryā nānyatrotpāta darśanāt | auduṃbaryāśca samidho mathvaktāśca tathākṣatāḥ || grāhyaścānnādyakāme naśriyai śāṃtyaica pāyasaṃ | sarvakāme navāgrāhya māyurvudhyai tilāḥ smṛtāḥ || ghṛtāktā athavādūrvā stejaskāmenavai ghṛtaṃ | vrīhayaḥ paśukāmena śatarudrīyaṃ - rudradhyāyaṃ - adātaḥ śatarudrīyaṃ juhotītitasyaiva | śatarudrīya śabṇenā pyabhidhānāt || evaṃ taittirīyāṇāmapi - mahārṇavastutvamagne rudra iti śatarudrīyaṃvarda brāṃtaeva | paṃcāgānni mātrasya ekādaśāvṛtthiḥ | ekādaśapurāṇān - rudrān japitvā rudratān vrajeti | bṛhatparāśarādyaiḥ rudramātra japokaiḥ | camakāṃnāṃca rudraśabdavācyatvā bhāvāditikecit - tannaasya prayogāṃta anaḍvāhaṃca vastraṃca dadyāddenuṃ sadakṣiṇāṃ || samāptaukarmaṇi tadhāviprāndvi daśabhojayet | namo gaṇebhya ityasya maṃtrasya brāhmaṇo yutaṃ || japtvāca śrīphalai rhūtvā sarvakāryeṣu siddhibhāk | namo astunīlagrīvā yetye tanmaṃtreṇa saptaca | āvartyodakamāmaṃtrya viṣārtaśravaṇenyaset || viṣeṇamucyate sadyaḥ kāladaṣṭopi jīvati | grahagrastastadhāpreta rakṣaḥ śākinidūṣitaṃ || pramuṃcadhanvana iti || ityādijñeyaḥ - atha prayogaḥ - kartādeśakālau smṛtvā amuka kāmanayāmuka rudra japahoma mabhi,ekaṃ vāsvayaṃ brāhmaṇadvārāvā kariṣya iti saṃkalpya gaṇeśa pūjana puṇyahavācana mātṛtāpūjana
