pravartate - nakutaścidbhayaṃ viṃdate ṛjmuyo yajurmayasyā mamayodharvamayastejo mayomṛtamayaḥ saṃbhūtaya brahmaivāpyeti tasmādetannā brahmacāriṇenā tapasvinenā saṃvatsaroṣatāyanā pravaktreṣu brūyādityādi tade tadbrahmayajñe sarva japeṣu cektānu kramaṇeva | asya rudrajapamātrāṃ gatve kiṃ māsamitina vidmaḥ || tathā - jātavedaseti puraścaraṇaṃ - catusraktirityāsanaṃ - manojyotiriti hṛdayaṃ - abhodyagniriti śirasi - mūrthinaṃdiva iti śikhāyāṃ - marmāṇīti kavacaṃ - viśvataścakṣuriti netraṃ - mānastoka ityastraṃ - adanyāsaḥ - tatra paṃcāṃgaṃnyāseṣu śikhādyastrāṃta mekatriṃśa daṃganyāsaḥ pradamaḥ - mūrdādi pādāṃ tadaśāṃganyāpo dvitīyaḥ - pādādi mūrthāṃtaṃ pacāganyāsa stṛtīyaḥ - guhyādi mastakāṃtaṃ paṃcāṃganyāsa ścaturdhaḥ - hṛdayādyastrāṃtaṃ paṃcāṃgaḥ paṃcamaḥ - ṣaḍaṃganyasa pakṣe prajananādi ṣoḍaśāṃganyāsaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ || hemādrau mahārṇaveca bodhāyanaḥ - adātaḥ paṃcāṃga rudrāṇāṃ nyāsapūrvakaṃ japa homārca nābhiṣeka vidiṃ vyākhyāsyāmo yāterudreti śikhāyāṃ | asminmahatyarṇava iti śirasi - sahasrāṇī tilalāṭe - hagṃ saśśuci ṣaditi bhṛvormadhye - triyaṃbakamiti netrayoḥ || ā trakātyāyanā nāmagnirjotiriti netraṃ - namaḥ srutyāyeti karṇayoḥ mānastoketi nāsikāyāṃ - avatatyeti mukhe - nīlagrīvaudvau kaṃṭhe - namaste astvāyudāyeti bāhvoḥyāte hetiritayupa bāhvoḥ - ye tīrthā nītihastayoḥ - sadyojātamiti paṃcānuvākān paṃcasvaṃgulīṣu - namovaḥ kirikebhya iti hṛdaye - ye vṛkṣeṣvityudare - namaḥ śaṃbhava iti kukṣ - namo gaṇebhya iti pṛṣṭhe - namo hiraṇya bhāhava iti pārśvayoḥ - vidyaṃdhanuriti jaṭhare - hiraṇya garbha iti guhye - saśirājāta vedā ityapāne - māno mahaṃta mityūrvoḥ - eṣateti jānvoḥ sagṃ nṛṣṭajiditi jaṃghayoḥ - viśvaṃbhūtamiti gulbhayoḥ - ye pathāmiti pādayoḥ - adyavocaditi kavacaṃ - namo bilmina ityupa kavacaṃ - namo astu nīlagrīvāyeti tṛtīya netraṃ - pramuṃca dhanvana ityastraṃ - etāvaṃtīśceti digbaṃdhaḥ - iti pradayonyāsaḥ oṃ namo bhagavate rudrayeti samaskāraṃ nyaset | oṃkāraṃ mūrdhni ninyasya nakāraṃ nāsikāgrataḥ - mokāraṃtu lalāṭe vaibhakāraṃ mukha madhyataḥ - gakāraṃ kaṃṭhadeśetu - vakāraṃ hṛdinyaset | tekāraṃ dakṣiṇe haste rukāraṃ vāmatonyaset | iti dvitīyaḥ || atra kātyāyanā stṛtīya nyāsāṃtara māhuḥ - yathā - śīrṣetu ninyasedudraṃ lalāṭe caṃdra śekharaṃ | netre trilocanaṃ devaṃ bhairavaṃ śotrayornaset || ghreṇetu śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ mukhe paśupatiṃ nyaset | nīlakaṃṭhaṃ kaṃṭhadaṃśe hṛtaye vyāpakaṃ nyaset || kare gaṃgādharaṃ devaṃ śivaṃ nābhautu vinyaset || mahadevaṃ tathā guhye jaṃghayostryaṃbakaṃ nyaset | sarvajñaṃ vinyasetpāde śivaṃ sarvatra vinyaseta || itī tannīrmūlaṃ - bodhāyanaḥ - sadyaṃca pādayornyanya vāmaṃsyasyoru madhyataḥ | aghoraṃ hṛdi vinyasya mukhe tatpuruṣaṃ nyaset || īśānāṃ mūrdni vinyasya haṃsonāma sadā śivaḥ | haṃsa haṃseti yobrūyāddhaṃ sonāma sadā śivaḥ || evaṃnyāsa vidhiṃ kṛtvā tatassaṃpuṭa mārabhet || ita tṛtīyaṛ - trātāra miṃdraṃ tvanno agne sugaṃsaḥ paṃthā masunvaṃtaṃ tatvā yāmyāno niyudbirvayagṃ soma tamīkānamasme rudrāsyonā pṛthivītyeta tsaṃpuṭa miṃdrādīn dikṣu vanyasyaivamevātma niraudrīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā || tvagasthigatai ssarvapāpaiḥ prayucyate sarvabhūteṣva parājito bhavati tato yakṣa gaṃdharva bhūta preta piśāca brahma rākṣasa yamadūta śākinī ḍhākinī sarpaśvāpada taskarādyupa dravādyupa ghātāḥ sarve jvalaṃtaṃ paśyaṃtumāraṃ rakṣastu - manojyoti rabhodyagni ragpirmūrdhā mūrthānaṃ marmaṇitejā taledā iti guhyedara hṛdaya mukha śironābhiṣvabhi maṃtrya brahmatma svada sṛjitetyātma rakṣā kartavyā || iti caturdhaḥ - śivasaṃkalpaṃ hṛdayaṃ puruṣasūktaṃ śiraḥ uttara nārāyaṇaṃ śikhā āśuśśiśānetya pratiradhaṃ kavacaṃ śataradrīya mastraṃ paṃcāṃgaṃ sakṛjjapet aṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇamya | hiraṇyagarbhoyaḥ prāṇato brahma jajñānaṃ mahīdyau rupaśvāsa yāgnenayayāte agnaimaṃ yama prastara mityṛcojape dadhātmānaṃ rudrarūpaṃ dhyāyet - atra kvacidardha ucyate - sarvatraita taittirīya pāṭhaḥ - upabāhuḥ prakoṣṭhaḥ sadyojātādi paṃcasvaṃ gulīṣvaṃ guṣṭhatarjanyādiṣu - namovaḥ kirikebhya ityādau devānāgṃ hṛdayebhya ityasyotta raṣvenuṣaṃgaḥ - namo hiraṇyetyādau namoṃtayajñaḥ saśirājāta vedā itya pānaiti āsvārthaṃ - jātavedase sunavāmedyasyā ṛca agnetvannaḥ - tāmagnivarṇāṃ agnetvaṃ pāraya viśvāninodurgahā pṛtanājitagṃ sahamāna mugramitiṛk catuṣṭayaṃ śiraityucyate tena jātavedasa ityādyāḥ paṃcarca apānenyasediti tvatīyānyāse oṃ nama iti samaskṛtya oṃ murdhne namaḥ - naṃ nāsikāyai - moṃ lalāṭāya nama ityādinyaset - tṛtīyo sadyojātaṃ prapadyāmi ityādi paṃcamaṃtrān paṃcasthāneṣu vinyaset | tatra īśānaḥ sarvavidyānā mityate sadāśivoṃ haṃ iti mūrdhnivinyaset - atrakātyāyana hemadryukaiḥ - sadyojātādi paṃcabhiḥ paṃcavaktrānyase - prāleyācala miṃdu kuṃdadhavala mityādi paṃcaślokaistadhyānaṃ budhyādyaṣṭatriṃśatkalānyā saṃcāhustatpratiṣṭhāyāmuktaṃ - atratu yajamāna hemādryukaiḥ - sadyojātādi paṃcabhiḥ paṃcavaktrānyase - prāleyācala miṃdu kuṃdadhavaśa mityādi paṃcaślokai stadhyānaṃ budhyādyaṣṭatriṃśatkalānyā saṃcāhustatpratiṣṭhāyāmuktaṃ - atratu yajamāna pratāraṇamātraṃ nirmūliṃcetyupekṣyaṃ | caturthetrātāra miṃdra mityādidi daśamaṃtraiḥ iṃdrāya nama ityādyaiśca pūrvādi diṣviṃ drādibhyoṃjaliṃ kuryāt - saṃpuṭoṃjaliḥ etai ssaṃpuṭaṃkṛtvā punaretai rāvṛtya namaskuryāditi mahārṇavaḥ - manojyotirguhyaṃ abhodyagniriti nābhiḥ agnirmūrthā udaraṃ mūrthānaṃ divaḥ hṛdayaṃ marmāṇite iti mukhaṃ - jātavedāyadivā pāvako - dabhyāvavṛtsveti śirasi || idamevātmarakṣetyucyate - paṃcamanyā setu yajñāgrata iti ṣaḍṛcaḥ paṭhitvā śirase svāheti śirasi - tatra tadhālokāg akalpayannityaṃte vedahametaṃ puruṣaṃ mahaṃta dhātā purastādyamudājahāreti ṛgdvayamupāṃtya madika atra - adbhyaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ pṛthivyai rasāccetyādi sarvaṃ manniṣāṇe manniṣāṇetyaṃta muttara nārāyaṇaṃ paṭhitvā śikhāyaipaṣaṭ - āśuśśiśāna iti paṃcadaśarcaṃ viśvāhāśarmayaccha tvityaṃtaṃ - kātyāyanāstu saptadaśarcaṃ sūkta muktvā kavacāya huṃ - iti kavacaṃ kātyeyanāstu vibhrāḍiti daptadaśargbirnetra matrāhuḥ - tataḥtvamagne rudra ityanu vākena śatu rudrīyeṇāti bhūrbuvassuvaḥ svasvāhetyaṃte nāstrāya tyādau śata rudrīya śabdena rudrasyaivokteḥ yattu sāvitracayane śrutau tvamagne ddra iti śata rudrīya yasyarūpa mityuktaṃ - tadrūpa mityukte gauṇaṃ - racātra gauṇa grahaṇe mānamasti - tena rudrādhyāyenai vāstraṃ yuktaṃ mahārmavastu brāṃta eva - atranyāsāṃga mātrāṇā mṛṣadaivata chaṃdāṃsi pāṭhabhedaśca mahārṇave jñeyaḥ || vistarānnocyate - kātyāyanāstu - namaste rudrati ṣoḍaśarmaḥ śatukudrīya māhuḥ | tato hiraṇyagarbha ityādye raṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇamya | dhyānaṃ yadhā - śuddha sphaṭika saṃkāśaṃ triṇetraṃ paṃcavaktrataṃ || gaṃgādharaṃ daśa bhūjaṃ sarvābharaṇa bhūṣitaṃ | nīlagrīvaṃ śaśāṃkāṃkaṃ nāgayajñopavītinaṃ || vyāghra carmottarīyaṃca vareṇya mabhaya pradaṃ | kamaṃḍalvakṣa sūtrābhyā manvitaṃ śūlapāṇinaṃ | jvalaṃtaṃ piṃgala jaṭā śikhā mudyota kāriṇaṃ | amṛte nāplutaṃ hṛṣṭa mumādehārda dhāriṇaṃ | divya siṃhāsanā sīsaṃ divyabhoga samanvitaṃ | digdevatā samāyuktaṃ surā sura samanvitaṃ | digdevatā samāyuktaṃ surāsura namaskṛtaṃ | nityaṃca śāśvataṃ śuddhaṃ dhruva makṣara mavyayaṃ | sarva vyāpina mīśānaṃ rudraṃ vaiviśva rūpiṇaṃ | evaṃ dhātvāsyajaḥ samyak tatoyajanamārabhet | iti paṃcāga syāsaḥ || śātāta pamate ṣaḍaṃganyāsāḥ tatra paṃcoktāḥ - ṣaṣṭhastu - prajanane brahmā tiṣṭhatu | tiṣṭetāṃ tiṣṭaṃtu yadārthe sarvatra paṭhet - pādayoḥ viṣṇuḥ - hastayorharaḥ - jaṭhare agniḥ - hṛdaye śivaḥ - kaṃṭhe vasavaḥ vaktre sarasvatī - nāsikayorvāyuḥ | nayana yosyūryācandramasau - karṇayo raśvinau - lalāṭe rudraḥ - mūrdnyādityāḥ - śirasi śivaḥ - pṛṣṭhepinākī - purataḥ śūlī - pārśvayo śśivaṃśakarau - sarvatra vāyuḥ - bahi ssarvatogni jvālā mālā parivṛtastiṣṭhatu - sarveṣvaṃgeṣu sarvādevatā yathā sthānaṃ tiṣṭhaṃtu - māṃ rakṣaṃtu - agnirmevāca śrita ityā dyairyathā liṃga maṃgāni saṃspṛśet - yathā agnirmevāci śritaḥ - vāgghṛdaye - hṛdayaṃ mayi ahamamṛte - amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi || iti jihvaṃ - vāyurme prāṇeśritaḥ || prāṇo hṛdaye - iti nyāsam - sūryome cakṣuṣi śritaḥ - mano hṛdaye iti vakṣaḥ - diśomeśrotre śritāḥ - śotrag hṛdaye - iti śrotre | apome retasi śritāḥ - reto hṛdaye - iti guhyaṃ - pṛthivīme śarire śrītā - śarīragaṃ hṛdaye iti śarīraṃ | oṣadi vanaspatayo meloma suśritāḥ | lomāni hṛdaye | iti lomāni - iṃdrome baleśritaḥ - balagṃ hṛdaye iti bāhvoḥ - parjanyome mūrdhni śritaḥ mūrdhāhṛdaye - iti mūrdhni - īśānome manyau śritaḥ - iti manasi ātmāma atma niśritaḥ ātmā hṛdaye - tadeva - punarma ātmā punarāyurāgāt - punaḥ prāṇaḥ punarākūta yāgāt vaiśvānaroraśmi bhirvā vṛdhānaḥ - aṃtastiṣṭhatvamṛtasya gopāḥ - iti sarvāṃgaṃ iti ṣaḍaṃgaḥ || hemādrau kauśikastu - saṃkalpa japahomā vityuktvā nyāsadvayamāha - tadyathā - nyāsaṃ bhavādibhiḥ kuryānna moṃtaiḥ praṇadānvitaiḥ || bhavaṃca pādayornyasya śivaṃ syasoru madhyataḥ - īśānaṃ guhya deśetu nābho paśupatiṃ nyaset - rudraṃca hṛdaye nyasyamukhe cograṃca vinyaset - tathaivā nyānuvākanya maṃtrairdvādaśabhiḥ śuciḥ | nyāsa kṛtvāsu lomyesa varjayitvāābhicārakaṃ - ādyaṃtu pādayornyasya dvitīyaṃ jānudeśataḥ || ūrvostṛtīyaṃ vinyasya caturthaṃ guhya deśataḥ | paṃcamaṃ nābhideśetu ṣaṣṭhaṃca hṛdayenyaset | saptamaṃ kaṃṭhadeśetu mukhe cāṣṭama muttamaṃ | navamaṃ nāsikāyāṃtu daśamaḥ netrordvayoḥ | ekādaśaṃ lalāṭeca dvādaśaṃ śīrṣi vinyaset | trayodaśaṃtu kavacaṃ kṛtvāstreṇa phaḍitya iti - atha sāmānyato rudrasya ṛṣyādi - tatra sarveṣā magnirbhagavānṛṣiḥ - rudra śśaṃbhurdevatā - mahā virāṭ cchaṃdaḥ - camakānuvākā nāmagniḥ kāṃḍaṛṣiḥ || ādyā gāyatryāgni vaiṣṇavī śiṣṭaṃ yaju | vājādayonnādi veśeṣā devatāḥ | jape viniyogaḥ || atha viśeṣataḥ - yathā ādyāyāḥ kaśyapastata ātreyastataḥ kaśyapaḥ tatodvayorgautamo dhūmrastataḥ kaṇvastatodvayoḥ kaśyapomarutvān stato bhagavāṃ statastisrūṇāṃ bhavavān | dvitīyānuvāke maṃḍūka stṛtīye bhagavān ścaturtheḥ duravāsāḥ paṃcamaṣaṣṭhyo rbhagavān saptamānuvāke hemakośoṣṭame navame ca namovaḥ kirikāṃtaṃ bhagavāsvasiṣṭhaścāgni rdaśamānuvākedrapa iti bhagavānnārada ityatristuhi pratamitivai yaughraḥ pariṇo rudrasyeti bhagavān tato vairājastataḥ pulahastato nāradaḥ tataścaturṇāṃ durvāsāḥ - ta āsamānairdevala ityṛṣayaḥ - atha devatāḥ - asauyastāmra itidvayorādityātmā || yāte rudretiskaṃdātmā - mānomahaṃtamiti saṃdīsvarātmā - yāta iṣurathyavo cannamo astu nīlagrīvāyetyāsāṃ caturtha paṃcama ṣaṣṭhānuvākānāmārātte mīḍhuṣṭhametidvayośca śaṃbhuryāte hetiriti tisroraṣṭamānuvāke navameca namovaḥ kirikāṃtaṃ mānastoke pariṇoradrasyetyeṣāṃ ca bhagavānvasiṣṭho nārado rudra iti devatāḥ - atha chaṃdāṃsyasauyastāmra avatatye tanayorāstā rapabtarasauyova sarpatī tiṣaṭpadā jagatī - imā rudrāyeti catasro jagatya ārātta iti tisrastriṣṭubhaṃ mīḍhuṣṭameti paṃcapadātriṣṭup dvitīyānuvāke mahā gāyatrī tṛtīye bṛhatī caturyuṣṇik - paṃcama ṣaṣṭayo rmahāvirāṭ saptame mahā pajtki raṣṭama navamayo rmahātriṣṭup śiṣṭāni yajūṃṣi caṃdāṃsi jape viniyogaḥ | athābhiṣeke paṃcāṃga rudrāṇāṃ japaḥ - homārcanavidhi miti badhāyanokaiḥ - prāguktāḥ paṃcāṃganyāsābhavaṃtyeva athāto rudra snānārcanavidhiṃ vyākhyā syāma itite naivoktā prajanane brahmatiṣṭha tvityādi ṣaṣṭhanyāsokaiḥ ṣaṣṭhepidhapati tataścasamuccayaḥ tenāgni rmevāci ityādyairthathā liṃgamaṃgāni saṃspṛśvetyaṃtaṃ prāguktanyāsa ṣaṭkaṃkṛtvā - ārādhito manuṣyaiḥ stvaṃsiddai rdevāsurādibhiḥ - ārādhayāmi bhaktyātāṃ māṃ grahāṇamaheśvareti manasāvāhya gaṃdhādyaiḥ paṃcopacārai ssaṃpūjya - triṃbakaṃ yajāmahe ityathaina mārādhayet - āvāhanābinnān paṃcaṣaḍvā tryaṃbakaṃ yadāmaha ityāvāhyādhaiva mārādhayet - āvāhana hīnā paṃcaṣaḍvā tryaṃbakamityane nāvāhanaṃ kuryā dityarthaḥ - ātvāvahaṃtu harayaḥ sacetanaḥ śvetaraśvaisaha ketumadbhiḥ vātājivairbalavadbhi rmanojavai rāyāhi śrīghraṃ mamahavyāya śarvomiti dakṣiṇanāsāyāṃ puṣpeṇapīṭhasthliṃge saṃyojyāvāhya sadyojātaṃ prapadyāmī tyāvāhanaṃ dadyāditi - triṃbakaṃ sadyojācāyapai namo nama ityāsanaṃ | triṃbakaṃ bhave bhavenāti bhave bhavasvamā miti pādyaṃ | triṃbakaṃ bhavodbhavāya nama ityabliṃgābhiśca snānaṃ || āpohiṣṭhetyādibhiḥ | āthādbhistarpayati || bhavaṃ devaṃtarpayāmi | śarvaṃ devaṃta | īśānaṃ devaṃ tarpa | vaśupatiṃ devaṃ tarpa | rudraṃ devaṃ tarpa | tryiṃbakaṃ jyeṣṭhāyanama ityācamanīyaṃ | tryaṃbakaṃ śreṣṭhāya nama iti maduparkaṃ | tryaṃbakaṃ rudrayanama iti gaṃdhaṃ | tryaṃbakaṃ kālayanama iti puṣpaṃ | kalavi karaṇāya nama iti dhūpaṃ | bali nikaraṇāya nama iti dipaṃ | balāya nama iti nai vedyaṃ || bala pramadhanāya nama iti tāṃbūlaṃ | sarvabhūta damanāyanama iti nīrājanaṃ | manosmanāya nama iti mastra puṣpaṃ | aghorebhya ityṛcā namaskāraḥ || sarvatra tryaṃbakasyāvṛtiḥ | athāṣau puṣpāṇi | bhavāya devāya namaḥ śarvāyadevāya | īśānāya devāya | paśupataye devāya | rudrāya devāya || ugrāya devāya bhamāya devāya | mahāte devāya nama iti | athāsyā gorebhya iti tribhiḥ sadāśivo mityetaira ghoratanurupatiṣṭhate - adaitasya hiraṇyena mūrdni kalaśena saṃtata dhārāṃ niṣiṃcet | madhunā sarpiṣāpayasācekṣu rasena nārakeleṇāmrara senavā tada lābhe udake navā - namaste rudra manyava ityekādaśā nāmanuvākānā magnā niṣṇūsajoṣasa ityekaika manuvākaṃ japetsarveṣāṃ vāre vāre punarā rādhaye duttamārādhanaṃ | pāpakṣayārdhī vyādi yocanārdhī śrīkāma śśānti kāmaḥ putra kāmaḥ puṣṭi kāmo yokṣārdhīca kuryā devaṃ kurvansiddhi mavāpnotyā cāryāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti daśagāvaḥ savatsā || suvarṇabhūṣitā vṛṣa ekādaśastada lābhe ekāṃgāṃ dadyādatyāha bhagavān bodhāyanaḥ || atha mahāsnānaḥ - hemādrau laiṃge | sānaṃ phalaṃ śataṃ jñeya mabhmaṃgaḥ paṃcaviṃśati|phalānāṃ dvi sahasraṃtu mahāsnānaṃ prakīrtataṃ || smāpya liṃgaṃca madhunāgavye nai vaghṛ tenaca| viśothya sarvadravyai ntu parabhiṣicyaca | mahāspāne prasa ktetu snāna maṣṭaguṇaṃ nmṛ taṃ | jalena kevalenai va gaṃdhatoyena śaktitaḥ | ālepanaṃca tatsarvaṃ paṃca viṃśatpalenavai | śamīpatraṃca vidhivā bilvapatraṃca paṃkajaṃ | daśadroṇaistu naivedya maṣṭadroṇa mathāpivā | daśadroṇa samaṃ puṇya māḍhaketu vidhīyate | vittahānasya bhaktasya nātrakāryā vicāraṇā - jāga raṃkārayettatra pārthayettu yathā kramaṃ | nṛtyaiḥ pradakṣiṇai ssardhaṃ prārthya liṃgaṃ maheśvaraṃ | dravyahīnaiḥ rmaṃtrahīnai śraddāhinai ssureśvari | kṛtaṃcānya kṛtaṃcāpikṣaṃtu marhasi śaṃkara | atra viśeṣovrata kamālākare jñeyaṃ || iti mahānyāsa snānaṃ a tha ru dra ho ma ḥ atha rudrahomaḥ - sadvedhā - namagrahomaḥ prathānabhūto japāṃga bhūtaśceti - tatrādye mūlaṃ || japahomārcana vidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | rudhrahomaḥ | parāśāṃtiḥ pāyase ghṛtena vetyādi bodhāyana viṣṇudharmādi vacanaṃ prāguktaṃ | aṃgabhūtastu daśāṃśa homaśśatāṃśaśca | satilādyaiḥ kārya iti mahārṇavaḥ | atra yadyapitena mūlaṃ noktaṃ tadhāpi asya maṃtra japa sāmānyatoktara | ājyaṃ dravyamanādeśe hometu pravidhīyate japa sāmānyatoktaṃ | ājyaṃ dravyamanādeśe hometu pravidhīyate iti sāmānyavacanā dājyaṃ nasyāt | tattu tiladravyake mānamapti ateeva hemādriṇā rudra japāṃga homovācaka evoktonatu daśāṃśādi yathāha || tatraiva bodhāyanaḥ || tatohomaṃ prakurvīta namaśśaṃbhava maṃtrataḥ | rudaikādaśinī proktaṃ traya striṃśadathāhutīḥ | laghurudreca catvāraḥ catvāraśca mahārudrau sahasrassaptavarjitāḥ | catvāriṃśa tsahasrāśca kartavyāśca tadhottarā | ūnāśca sapta sapta tyāhutu rudre viniścayaḥ | sacahomo namaśśaṃbhaveti maṃtreṇa kāryamiti hemādriḥ | sacapūrvokta viṣṇudharmokaiḥ || pāyasena ghṛtenavā kāryamitiyuktaṃ pratibhāti | tena homādrimate maṃtra vibhāga evanāsti | ayaṃca japāṃgahoma eva || japye iti saptamyā miti maṃdrapāyaṇīyā mitivadarītyāva gateḥ | pradhāna bhūta samagra hometu asyāṃ saṃbhavāt | maharṇavoktaḥ pratisūktaṃ kalpasūtrādiṣu cayanaprakaraṇokta eva maṃtravibhāgo grāhyaḥ || mahārṇavenatu pradhāne samagrahome maṃtravibhāgasyā paśyakatvājjapāṃge ayameva grāhyaḥ || kluptatadvādapekṣi tatvāccoktaṃ | śiṣṭaiścāmevādhṛtaḥ sa idānī mucyate || tatra maṃtra vibhāgaḥ | paṃcadhātredhā ṣoḍasadhā aṣṭaśatvāriṃśa tpakṣaḥ | ekona saptatyuttara śatapakṣaśceti || ādyaḥ prati maṃtrapakṣa ityucyate | tatrādyāścaramāyā miṣṭakāyāṃ juhoti traya imekobhāgaḥ | aparaṃ catuṣkuṃ dvitīyobhāgaḥ | aṃtyānuvākatrayaṃ tṛtīyobhāga ityaya mekapakṣaḥ | yadvā | samaste rudhretyārabhya sabhā patibhyaścavo namastena rudramasyava ityetānamavākāṃstrthā vibhajyeti atra dvaupakṣau | ādyānuvāka catuṣkamokobhāgaḥ | aparaṃ catuṣkaṃ dvitīyobhāgaḥ | aṃtyānuvākatrayaṃ tṛtīyobhāga ityaya mekapakṣaḥ | yadvā | namaste rudretyārabhaya sabhā patibhyaścavo nama ityaṃta ekobhāgaḥ | namo aśvebhya ityādi vāryāya cetyaṃto dvitīya | namaḥ prataraṇa yetyādirāsamāpte stṛtīyaḥ | ṣoḍavibhāgastutisra uttarā āhutī rjuhoti ṣaṭsaṃpadyaṃte ṣaḍvāṛtava iti śrutyokai | sacāśītyāṃ ca svāhākāretyānā ṣoḍhā vibhāga uktaḥ | yadhā āpivā pradhamādupakramya namastakṣabhya iti jānudaghne jalesthitvā juhotīti | rathakārebhyaścava ityupakramya namaḥ svāyudhā yeti nādhadaghne || śeṣeṇa prāgavatāridādbhyaśca asyadaghnehutvā | sahasrāṇi sahasraśa iti daśānuṣaṃgavatān hutvā nvārohān juhoti | namo rudrebhyoye pṛthivyāṃ yeṣāmanna miti jānudhaghnaṃ dhārayamāṇo namo rudrebhyo yontarikṣe yoṣāṃ vāta iti nābhidaghne namo rudrebhyoy diviyeṣāṃ varṣamityāsyadaghne juhotītyete trayaḥ pakṣāḥ pracaraṃti | atha aṣṭacatvāriṃśa tpakṣaḥ | atrādyānuvāke paṃcadaśa maṃtrāḥ | tatoṣṭānuvāka aṣṭāyajūṃ kṣītikṛtsorūkt navamāṃtaṃ trayoviṃśatiḥ | daśame dvādaśeti paṃcatriṃśat | ekādaśe daśamaṃḥtrīṇi yajūṃṣīti trayodase tyaṣṭā catvāri śat | tadayaṃ saṃgrahaḥ | saṃgrahaḥ | ādye paṃcadaśaproktā daśame dvādaśasmṛtāḥ | ekādaśegni bhūmyasyuraṣṭaśiṣṭa yajūṃṣica | pratimaṃtra pakṣetvekopasaptatyuttara śatamaṃtrāḥ | tatra pradhamānuvāke paṃcadaśa maṃtrāḥ | dvitīye trayodaśa tṛtīye caturdhayoḥ pratyekaṃ saptadaśa ete dvitīyādi caturthyaṃta mubhayato namaskāra maṃtrāḥ | paṃcamaṣaṣṭayoḥ pratyekaṃ paṃcadaśa maṃtrāḥ | saptame ṣoḍaśca | aṣṭame saptadaśa | navama ekonaviṃśatiḥ || eṣu paṃcamādi navamāṃteṣu purastānnamaskāramaṃtrāḥ | tatra devānāgṃ hṛdayebhya ityasyottara maṃtra catuṣṭayonuṣaṃgaḥ | ayaṃca homādāveva evaṃ vibhajyaprayogaḥ | japābhiṣekādautu vibhāgābhāvā dyathādhyayanaṃ pāṭhaḥ | eva manyatrāpyanuṣaṃgo jñeyaḥ | daśame dvādaśamaṃtrāḥ || ekādaśe trayodaśeti | yattu śākapūrṇiḥ dvitīyādi navamāṃtānuvākeṣu namaskārādi namaskārāṃtaṃ yajurityāha | tatro bhayato namaskāreṣu spapṭopabhāgaḥ | maṃtraiko namaśśabdaḥ yathā - namobhavāyaca rudrāyaca namaḥ śarvāmotrādrau | tatra dvitīye namaḥ śabdaḥ pūravasyāṃ tatvena dvitīyasyādityenacakā kākṣipa dubhayatra saṃbadhyate - yadvā dvitīya tṛtīya caturthānuvāka paraṃ | yaccayāskaḥ namaskārādyekaṃ yajuriti | tatpaṃcamādi savamāṃtaparamiti mahārṇavaḥ || tadayaṃ saṃgrahaḥ - bāṇeṃdavo vahnibhuvo śvabhūmmoṃ nageṃdavaḥ paṃcadaśe ṣubhūmayaḥ || nṛpāśvabhūmyoṃ kabhūvotha bhāskarā viśve samastā graha bhūmayaḥ smṛtāḥ | ete vibhāgānā maṃkeṣveva camakeṣutvāha bodhāyanaḥ || agnā piṣṇū sajoṣana iti caturgṛhītaṃ hutvā vājaścame prasavaścama iti saṃtatāṃ vasordārā juhotyā maṃtra samāpanādini | matraḥ sarmecakāḥ ādyāsu vākovā | tenādyarcāhutvā sarvaiścamakai rekāhutiḥ pratyanāvākāṃta mekādahahutayovā | tenadve āhutī dvādaśavā idaṃ vasoddhārokta mapyapekṣi tatvāddomepi jñeyaṃ | yadvā ekādaśā namanuvākā nāmeka mekaṃ japediti bodhāyano kteryathā jape ekaipisya camakasyā vṛttiḥ tadhāpi homepite nādya camakena sarveṇa hutvānyaiḥ pratyeka mityekā daśāhutaya iti pakṣatrayaṃ mahārṇave uktaṃ | atra tredhā vibhāgādi nāśatāṃśe nagahomasyacārā bhāvāddaśāṃśa home samagrahome cāṣṭācatvāriṃśatpakṣe prati maṃtra homa pakṣecāhuti saṃkhyocyate tatraika rūpo daśāṃśa homo nāśaṃkya eva vibhāgā bhāvā dekādaśinyātvekena rūpeṇahomaḥ | śiṣṭekarūpe vibhāgāyogānna daśāṃśa homa emahā nrūdrā dāvapīti maharṇavaḥ | asmaddura stvaṣṭā catvāriṃśatpakṣe vaṃcāhutayaḥ || prota mitra pakṣaṃca saptadaśāhutayaḥ || ādyairmaṃtraiḥ kāryaḥ | antāllopo vivṛddhirmetāpa staṃbhokterityāhuḥ | yattu yatra tribipālo savakapāla iti saṃkhyāśrutāta traiva | atra tadabhāvānna tadyuktaṃ | ata eva sama vibhāgā bhāvā smūlābhāvācca homādryuktā vācanika eva namaśśaṃbhaveti mūlamaṃtreṇa homonatu daśāṃśe netyasmābhi rmaharṇava maṃgīkṛtya tūcyate | tatra mākāḥ ślokāḥ || rudre daśāṃśeṣṭā catvāriṃśatpakṣekha vedakāḥ | samagra home tatraivakha veda śara saṃkhyayā - prani maṃtrairdaśāṃśetukhādri caṃdrāhutī rhunet - prani maṃtre sarva home śarādrivasu caṃdramāḥ - iti rudraikā daśinyāṃ saṃkhyā | lakṣa rudre daśaṃśetukhāṃka bāṇāhutīrhunet - namagrahaumeva dāmyahaṃ - caṃdrādri śarakhayūgmā - laghu rudretvidaṃ smṛtaṃ - iti || lagharudre mahārudre daśāṃśetvāhutīrhunet | ṣaṭsahasra śaraśatīścatvāriṃśa ddaśāṃśake tatraiva sarvahometu khaledāgani śarartavaḥ - pratimaṃtre mahā rudre daśāṃśetvā hutīrhunet | dvāviṃśati sahasrāṇiṣaṭ śatāni daśaivaca || - prati maṃtraṃ mahā rudre sarvahome dadāmyahaṃ | lakṣa dvayaṃ sahasrāṇi ṣaḍaviṃśati rathāpica || dveśate saptatiścaikādhikā saṃkhyeya mīritā - iti mahā rudre homa saṃkhyā | athāti rudreṣṭā catvāriṃśa tpakṣe daśāṃśake | eka saptati sahasrāṇya śītyaṃ tāṣṭa śatyapi - prati maṃtraṃ daśāṃśetu sārtha catuśśatī | prati maṃtraṃ sarvahome paṃcaviṃśati lakṣakāḥ | ekādaśa sahasronāstvati rudre samīritāḥ || kvacidalpātaraṃ tatra nagaṇyaṃ sūribhirmama | idaṃ taittīya śākhoktaṃ | vājasaneya kāṇvādi śākhināṃtu prati maṃtra pakṣe ṣaṣṭyuttara śata vibhāgāsnnyūna saṃkhyā namaśśaṃbhavetivā home jñeyaḥ | iyaṃ vasordhārā sahitāhuti saṃkhyā | ghṛta tuṃbhairva sordhārāṃ pātaye danalopari | auduṃbarī mathā rdrāṃca ṛbvīṃkoṭara varjitāṃ | bāhu mātrāṃ sṛcaṃ kṛtvā tatastaṃbhadvayopari | ghṛta dhārāṃta yāpyājyamagneruparipātayet | śrāvaye tsūktamāgneyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ raudra maiṃdavaṃ | mahā vaiśvānaraṃ sāma jyeṣṭha sāmaṃca pāṭhayediti mātsyokte || || āgneya sūktādi prāgukta bodhayanokte ssarva camakāṃte jñeyaṃ || || vasordrārāyadyapi mātsye lakṣahoma evoktā | tathāpicayane dṛṣṭatvā tphalahetutvācca rudrekāryeti mahārṇavaḥ | sacapūrṇāhutyanaṃtaraṃ kāryaḥ || || launakopi - āyāścetyādi bhirvutvā samudrā dūrmisūktataḥ | saṃtatamājya dhārāṃtaṃ pūrṇāhuti mathācaret - atrapūrṇāhuteru paryājyadhārā tūṣṇīṃ deyeti kecit | vasordhārā paramititu yuktaṃ | ata eva hemādrau madana ratneca śāṃtikāṃḍe devīpūrāṇeca vasordhārotpatti muktvā sarvatra soktā | atrahoma saṃkhyāva śātkuṃḍaṃ kāryaṃ | taduktaṃ bhaviṣye - ratni mātraṃ śatārdhetu śatecāratni mātrakaṃ || || sahasretvatha hotavye kuryātkuṃḍaṃ karātmakaṃ | dvihastamayute tadvallakṣahome catuṣkaraṃ | daśa lakṣamite home ṣaṭkaraṃ saṃpracakṣate || yattumātsye - dvihastavistṛtaṃ tadvaccaturhustāya tanaṃ punaḥ | lakṣahome bhavetuṃḍaṃ yonivaktraṃ trimekhalaṃ | tatri śīghradāhighṛtadau dvihastaṃ lakṣahome jñeyaṃ || || yavacarvādau caturhastaṃ - siddhāṃtaśekhare - lakṣārthe tritaraṃkuṃḍaṃ cakṣahome cakuṣkaraṃ | kuṃḍaṃ paṃcakaraṃ proktaṃ daśalakṣāhutau kramāt | ṣaḍḍastaṃ lakṣaviṃśatyā koṭyarthehasta saptakamiti | atra | nyūnasaṃkhyādi tekuṃḍesdhikohomo vidhīyate || iti kuṃḍaratnākarokaiḥ - aṃtarāliko homo nyūnasaṃkhyokai kuṃḍe kāryaḥ - tacca - kuṃḍamaiśānyāṃ maṃṭapamadhye ca vediḥ | tatraikā vedikākāryā yajña maṃṭapamadhyataḥ | madhya staṃbhāṃtaraṃ yāvattāvanmānā karoccrayet || paraśūrāmo kairitikecit - prāguttaraṃ samāsādya pradeśaṃ maṃṭapaśyatu | śobhanaṃkārayetkuṃḍaṃ yadhāvalli kṣaṇānvita | mityayuta homemātpyokte | hemādyādi lekhanāccaiva bhāti | asmadguravastu | paraśūrāmokai nirmūlatvāt | madhyetu maṃṭapasyāpi kuṃḍaṃ kuryādikṣaṇaḥ || iti vṛddhavasiṣṭokaiḥ - mātsyecapākpūrva maṃṭapasyottara mutkṛṣṭaṃ madhyama pradeśaṃ prāpyetyarthānmadhye kuṃḍaṃ | anyathā - gartasyottara pūrveṇa vitastu chrāyosaṃmitā | pūrvettare hastamitāhi vedirgrahādi deveśvara pūjanāyeti mātsye bādhāpatteśca lakṣihome tanmadhye kuṃḍaṃ tadvikṛtitvādityāhuḥ | madhye vedīśca dikṣātulādāveva | nātraupa yogābhāvāt | rudravediścaiśāne grahavederbhinnācāra prāptātāṃtrikīvāstu | rudrasya kāmyatvepi grahamakha vikṛtitve bhavati || yattu paraśurāmaḥ - maṃṭapoṣṭa guṇātkuṃḍaṃ homānusārata iti | sacaturhaste kuṃḍe dvātriṃśaddastasya maṃṭapasya kvāpanukte rnirmūlomurkhācāraśce | tyupekṣaḥ atrakecidvādhā rudramāhuḥ || yadhoktaṃ skāṃde - praṇamya jagatāmīśa mumādehārthadhāriṇaṃ | yaṃtroddhāra mahaṃ vakṣye rudrakalpānusārataḥ | madhyevṛttaṃ samālikhya tanmadhyeca daśākṣaraṃ | bahiraṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ tataḥ ṣoḍaśapatrakaṃ | caturviṃśati patraṃ taddvātriṃśatpatrakaṃ tathā | catvāriṃśa tvatrakaṃtu vṛttaṃ sūryastama prabhaṃ | paṃcadmātmakaṃ vṛttaṃ catusraṃtu bhāgṛhaṃ | satvaṃ rajastamaśceti triguṇaiḥ paritovṛtaṃ || caturdvāraṃ dvāradeśe bahirnāga samāvṛtaṃ | catvāriṃśa cchataṃcaikaṃ devatānāṃtu vinyaset | soyaṃ daśākṣaromaṃtraḥ sarvakāmārthasiddhidaḥ | praṇavādi namoṃtāni paṃcāsyāni tataḥ paraṃ | sadyojātaṃ vāmadeva maghoraṃ tadanaṃtaraṃ | tatastatpuruṣaṃprokta mīśānaṃ paṃcamaṃkramāt | daleṣvaṣṭasunaṃ dyādīn pūrvādi kramatonyaset | pūjya pūjakayormadhye prācīsyādyaṃtralekhane | ādau saṃdīṃ mahākālaṃ gaṇeśaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ kramāt | anaṃtaraṃ bhṛṃgiriṭaṃ skaṃdo mācaṃḍasaṃjñakān | ṣoḍaśāre tataḥ padme dvitīyāvaraṇaṃ yajet | anaṃtaṃ ca tathā sūkṣmaṃ śivaṃcaika tadaṃ tathā | ekarudraṃ trimūrtiṃca śīkaṃṭhaṃ vāmadevakaṃ | jyeṣṭaṃ śroṣṭhaṃ tathā | tṛtīyāvaraṇepadme caturviṃśaddale tathā | aṇimāmahimā ceti laghimāgarimā tathā | prāptiḥ prākāmyamīśatvaṃ vaśitvaṃ cāṣcasiddhayaḥ | tataḥ paṃrakrameṇaiva nyasedbhrāhmyadi devatāṃ | brāhmī mahīśvarīcaiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavītathā | vārāhaiṃdrīca cāmuṃḍā caṃḍikā cetitāḥ kramāte | asitāṃgo ruruścaṃḍaḥ krodha unmattabhairavaḥ | kālabhīṣaṇa saṃhāra bhairavāṣṭā prakīrtitāḥ | dvātriṃśatpatrike pūrvaṃ bhavāṣṭaka mudāhṛtaṃ | bhavaśśalavelāna paśupati rudrogabhīmakāḥ | mahāṃ ccaiveti vikhyātā bhavādyaṣṭā prakīrtitāḥ | tatonaṃto vāsukiśca takṣakaśca kulīrakaḥ | kārkoṭaka śśaṃkhapālaḥ kaṃlośvatarastathā | tatoṣṭamasunyase dvainyaṃ pṛdhurhaihaya marjunaṃ śākuṃtaleyaṃ bharataṃ nalaṃ rāma miti kramāt | tataḥ kulācalā naṣṭādale ṣvaṣṭasuvinyaset | himavānniṣadhoviṃdhyo mālyāvān pārayātrakaḥ | malayo hemakūṭaśṭa gaṃdhamādana saṃjñikaḥ | caturthāvaraṇeṣveva paṃcamāvaraṇe tataḥ | catvā riṃśaddale padmepaṃcamāvaraṇenyaset | iṃdrādyaṣṭaulokapālau naṣṭasukra malolibhet - idamagniṃ yamaṃcaiva niṛtiṃ varuṇaṃ tadhā | vāyuṃ kuberamīśānaṃ dale ṣvaṣṭasuvinyaset || iṃdrādilokapālā nāmaṣṭaśaktyā statonyaset | śacī svāhā ca vārāhī khaḍginī vāruṇī tadhā | mṛgārūḍhā ca kauberī śūlinīca tadhāṣṭamī | tatoṣṭānāmāyudhāni vajrādīnya ṣṭasunyaset || vajraṃ śakti rdaṃḍa khaḍgau pāśāṃkuśa gadhā api | triśūlaṃ lākapālānā māyudhāni kramāllabhet || tatoṣṭauvāhanānveṣā maṣṭasukramaśo labhet | airāvataṃ tadhā meṣaṃ mahiṣaṃ pretanaṃjñikaṃ || makaraṃ ca mṛgaṃcaiva naraṃca vṛṣabhaṃ tathā | airāvatādayovyaṣṭau diggajā stadanaṃtaraṃ || airāvataḥ puṃḍarīko vāmanaḥ kamudoṃ janaḥ | puṣpadaṃta ssārvabhaumaḥ ssupratīkaśca digagajāḥ || iṃdrādayoṣṭau dikpālāḥ paṃcapadmātmakādbahiḥ || virūpākṣaṃtu vinyasyedāgneyyā magniyogataḥ | naiṛtyāṃ naiṛteyoge viśvarūpaṃ ca vinyaset || vāyavyāṃ vāyuyoge ca libhe tpaśupatiṃ tathā urdhvaṃ liṃgaṃ tathe śānyāṃ nyasedīśānayo gataḥ || prāgādi kramato lekhyāḥ śeṣādyā bhūgṛhādbahiḥ | śeṣaṃ vinyasyapūrvasyāṃ sahasra phaṇi maṃḍitaṃ || agneyāṃ takṣakaṃcaiva vāruṇyāṃyutaṃ saptaśataiḥ phaṇaiḥ || kaṃbalaṃ caiva kauberyāṃ saptatriṃśa tphaṇairyutaṃ | kārkoṭakaṃ tathe śānyāṃ śvetaṃ triṃśatphaṇānvitaṃ || rudrapīṭha midaṃsarvaṃ rudrakṛtyeṣu ca smṛtaṃ || śaṃbhunāsvayamākhyātaṃ bhaktānugraha kāmyayā | kuṃku māgaru karpūpa bharjapatrethavā paṭhe || likhitaṃ pūjitaṃ bhaktyā sarva kāmārthasiddhidaṃ | etā devatāścaturthyaṃta namotai stannāmamaṃtrai rāvāhyapūjayet || atramūlaṃ ciṃtyaṃ - tadaiśānyāṃ rudra kalaśaṃ saṃsthāpya tatra varuṇaṃ saṃpūjya rudraikādaśinī japārdhaṃ vipraṃ vṛṇuyādityāhurvṛdthāḥ | tato yaja mānenatyāge kṛte gṛhebhayaḥ sāṃgebhyo grahayajña vaddhutvā rudrahome hute rudra pīṭha devatabhya ājyaṃ hutvā sviṣṭa kṛdādi prāya ścitta homāṃte dikpālebhyo navagrahadibhyaśca māṣa bhaktalīn datvā samudrā dūrmitititricena mūrdhānaṃ punastvādityā pūrṇādarvī saptatedhāmaṃte iti pūrṇāhutiṃ hutvā pūrvaṃ camakena agni mīleti navabhirviṣṇo rnukamiti ṣaḍbhirāte pitaḥ paṃcabhiḥ svādhiṣṭayeti daśabhiḥ mahāvaiśvānara jyeṣṭha sāmabhyāṃca vasordhārāṃ kṛtvā pūrṇapātra vimokādi śeṣaṃ samāpya ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt - atra pūrṇapātra vimokādi śeṣaṃ samāpya ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt - atra rudra mahanyāse bodhāyanoktā dakṣiṇā suvarṇo pathānaṃvā dadyāt ṛṣabho rudrasya dakṣiṇā | ekādaśagāṃ dadyāditi śālikaḥ | upadhāsaṃ haima taṃtukṛta rūpyopabarhaṇaṃ - sauvarṇaṃ śataṃ śaticcidraṃ rudro laghu rudraḥ prakārāstareṇa dakṣiṇā māha mahārṇavaḥ |tatra sauvarṇa niṣkāṇāṃ daśa sāhasri kottamā || tadarthaṃ madhya māproktā tritīyā trisahasrikā | uttamātri śatā vāsyā dviśatī madhyamāmatā || śata mātrādha mājñeyā prakāraḥ kīrtyate paraḥ | uttamātu catuṣṣaṣṭī stadarthaṃ madhyamāmatā || caturviṃśati ranyasyā dathanyo vidhisthitiḥ || tatograhādi kalaśodake nābhiṣakto yajamāno gṛhādīnā muttara pūjāṃ kṛtvā visṛjya || śrī rudra pratimāṃ svarṇamayīṃ vastrayugānva itāṃ | śrī rudra prītayecāpi prāptāniṣṭa svarṇamayīṃ vastrayugānvitāṃ | śrī rudra prītayecāpi prāptāniṣṭa nivṛttaye | prārthitābhīṣṭa saṃsiddhyai tubhyaṃ śrī rudra rūpiṇe | saṃpradadyāṃ vidhānena yathokta phalamastume || iti rudra pratimā mācāryāya datvāgniṃ saṃpūjya visṛjya viprān rudraikādaśinyāṃ trīnekaṃceti saṃbhojya karmeśvarārpaṇaṃ kuryāditi - putrārtha mahārudre viśeṣaṃtvana patyatva hara karmavipāke vakṣyāmaḥ | itara maṃtra | prayogā bhāṣyoktā bhaṭṭa bhāskaroktāśca mahārṇa vejñeyāḥ | pracārābhāvānnocyaṃte || iti śrī mannārāyaṇabhaṭṭa sūnu rāmakṛṣṇa bhaṭṭātmaja kamalākarabhaṭaṭakṛte śāṃtiratne rudra vidhānaṃ samāptaṃ ve da yadantarā viramettrin prāṇānāyamya praṇavaṃvā vadanvipreṇavadeta yāvatkāla madhīyūta | tataḥ sarva niśāṃ niśāṃtaraṃ saṃgrāmāraṇya salilaṃlopya paridhadhyāt | niśāntaraṃ saṃdhyāniśādīn lopya vihāya mṛgbhiśca bhojana ihānṛtebhyaḥ pramucyate - tribhiḥ patanīyebhyaḥ śūdyāṃ retassiktau gaṃgāpsuni majya pūto bhavati caturbhiḥ pārā yaṇaiḥ | śūdrānnabhojanāttattsī sevanācca paṃcabhira yājya yājanā dagrāhya grahaṇāt | ṣaḍabhiḥ brāhmaṇa svaharaṇāt strilohita karaṇāt paśuhananātsuvarṇaste yātpatita saṃyogācca sastabhiḥ prājāpatyasay hīnācaraṇāgadyajñopa baṃdhanāccāṣṭabhiścāṃdrāyaṇasya gurutalpa gamanādra jasvalāgamanācca navabhiḥ surāpānāddaśabhira somapānā dekādaśabhi brahma hananāddvādaśabhiḥ pūrva janmeha janmanica kṛtai ssartvḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate svargalokaṃ gacchatyagniṣṭomādi kratu bhiriṣṭaṃ bhavati | vedādhyāyī sadai vasyādapāpmā satyavāk śuciḥ | yaṃ yaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ taṃ taṃvedena sādhayet | asādyaṃ nāsti yatkiṃci dbrahmaṇohi phalaṃ mahaditi || ṛgvidhāne - ādāvevatu sāvitryā karma kurvītaśāṃtaye | tuṣṭaye paśulabhāya dhanalābhāya bhūpate eṣāhi saṃhitā devaiḥ sarva brahma mayītri vṛt | ugreṇa tapasādṛṣṭā viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā | homāṃśca japayajñāṃśca nityaṃ kurvītavai tadhā | sarvakāma samṛdhardhaṃ paraṃ brahmeca mucyate | eṣaiva pratilomoktaḥ paccaḥ śatru vināśinī | akṣara pratilomeca tvibhicāreṣuśasyate | sarva saṃhitayā pratyṛcaṃ homaḥ | ājyaina tilaivān - ājyaṃ dravyamanādeśe homeṣu tuvidhīyate || iti brahmokaiḥ - sarvapāpaharo homa stalaissarvatra śasyata iti viṣṇu dharmoktareca | śātā tapaḥ | kṛtnso rudra trayaṃ caiva vedapārāyaṇaṃ tathā | tilahoma sahasraṃca namametacca tuṣṭayaṃ || iti kamalākarabhaṭṭakṛte veda pārāyaṇaṃ jā ta ve da sa vi dhā na ṃ śaunakaḥ - jātavedasa ityetatsūktaṃ sarvārthasādhanaṃ | āyurārogya sukhadaṃ bhūtidaṃ śatṛnāśanaṃ || yadyadvāṃchativāmartya stattadāpnotya saṃśayaṃ | sūktenānena juhuyā cchuklāṃbaradaraḥ śuciḥ || japedvā niyatomaṃtraṃ haviṣyāśī jiteṃdriyaḥ | paśu putra dhanārdhīca pratyekaṃ lakṣamabhyaset || kuṃḍevā sthaṃḍilevāpi homaṃ kuryāda taṃdritaḥ | caturaśraṃ bhavetkuṃḍaṃ mekhalādvaya saṃyutaṃ || sthaṃḍilādyājyabhāgāṃtaṃ yajñataṃtraṃ prakalpayet | durgāmāvāhayetkuṃbhe sāyudāṣṭamahābhūjāṃ || nīlotpaladaśaśyāmāṃ kirīṭādyairvibhūṣitāṃ | tataścārādhyatāṃ devīṃ tasmin tīrthodakānvite || āvāhyānena haviṣā samidbiśca pṛthak pṛthak | maṃtreṇānena juhuyā daṣṭottara śatāhutīḥ || tataḥ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ hutvā homaśeṣaṃ samāpayet | utthāyātha japenmaṃtrametaṃ śraddhā samanvitaḥ || ṛgvidhāne - jātavedasa ityādi sadāsvastyayanaṃ paṭhet | durgepathi prayātasya nāsyāribhyo bhayaṃ bhavet || rājakāryedviṣadyudhe abhiśastopyanekadhā | aśakto brāhmaṇaiḥ kāryobhaye prāṇāṃtikepivā || jātavedasa ityetāṃ japaṃ stebhyaḥ pramucyate | sisādhayiṣuritthaṃca prasthito manasā japet || sidhyarthaṃ svastimāneta ccorairbādhyetanādvani | kṛtārthaḥ svagṛhe tiṣṭhannetāmeva sadābhyaset || udite savitaryeṃtāḥ japedastaṃgate tathā || ahnisvastyayanaṃ śastaṃ rātrau dusvapnadarśane | vyupṭāyāṃ ca japannitya metāṃ dusvapnanāśanī || iti jātavedasa kalpaḥ tva ri ta ru dra ka lpaḥ atha tvarita rudraḥ - śivapūjāṃ vidhāya saṃkalpamūlena prāṇānāyamya - asya śrī tvarita rudramaṃtrasya adharvaṇaṛṣiḥ - anuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ - tvarita rudrodevatā nama iti bījaṃ | astviti śaktiḥ tvarita rudraprītyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || adha mūlenakaraśuddhiṃ kṛtvā praṇavaṃ karatalayorvinyasya ṣaḍaṃgaṃ kuryāt || tadyāthā - oṃ yo rudraḥ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ agnau tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ yo apsumadhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ yo oṣadhīṣu anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ yo rudro viśvābhūvanāviveśa kaniṣṭikābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ tasmai rudrāya astu karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | evaṃ hṛdayādinyāsaḥ - oṃ yo rudro hṛdayāya namaḥ | oṃ yo agnau śirase svāhā | oṃ yo apsu śikhāyaivaṣaṭ | oṃ yo oṣathīṣu kavacāya huṃ - oṃ yo rudro viśvābhūvanāviveśa netratrayāya vauṣaṭ - oṃ tasmai rudrāya namo astu astrāya phaṭ | ityastrṇa dirbaṃdhaḥ || atha pādanyāsaḥ - oṃ yaḥ pādābhyāṃ namaḥ - oṃ rudraḥ jaṃghābhyāṃ namaḥ - oṃ agnau jānubhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ yaḥ ūrubhyāṃ namaḥ - oṃ apsu gulbhābhyāṃ namaḥ - oṃ yaḥ meḍrāya namaḥ | oṃ oṣathīṣu nābhyai namaḥ - oṃ yaḥ udarāya namaḥ - oṃ bhuvanāmukhāya namaḥ - oṃ viveśa nāsikāyai namaḥ - oṃ tasmai netratrayāya namaḥ - oṃ rudrāya bhrūmadhyāya namaḥ - oṃ namaḥ lalāṭāya namaḥ - oṃ astu śirase namaḥ || atha dhyānaṃ - rudraṃ caturbhujaṃ devaṃ trinetraṃ varadābhayaṃ | dadhāna mūrthva hastābhyāṃ śūlaṃ ḍamarumevaca || aṃkasaṃsthāmumāṃ padme dadhānāṃca karadvaye adhaḥ karadvaye kuṃbhaṃ mātuliṃgaṃ ca bibhratīṃ || evaṃ dhyātvā - evaṃ mūlamaṃtreṇā vāhanādi ṣoḍaśopacārai rabhyaraca nitya maṣṭottaraśataṃ japet | eṣate rudrabhāga iti mudrā || atha homavidhiḥ - liṃgābhimukha upaviśya ghṛtāhutī rjuhuyāt - evaṃ kṛte puraścaraṇaṃ bhavati ghṛtākṣatai rmuktikāmaḥ - dūrvābhirayuṣkāmaḥ - kanyākāmolojaiḥ - apāmārgai rardhakāmāḥ - madhupuṣpai rvaśyakāmaḥ - śrīphalaiḥ śrīkāmaḥ - siddhārthai puṣṭikāmaḥ - guḍūcīkhaṃḍairjvaranivṛtti rbhavati - utpalai rdadhimadhughṛtai raṣṭasahasraṃ juhuyāt | yatheṣṭā śrīrbhavati - bilvapatrai rdadhimadhughṛtāktai ssahasrahomo jjvaraṃ nāśayati - śālmakhī samidbhiśśaśarudhirāktaiḥ sahasraṃ juhuyāt śatṛṇāṃ sadyomaraṇaṃ bhavati - akli nnavāsā arkābhi mukhaḥ sahasraṃ māsai kamātraṃ japtvā yakṣa rākṣasa gaṃdharvārdīvaśaṃ nayati - māsadvāye neṃdrādīn vaśaṃ nayati - māsena brahmadidevāḥ samāgacchaṃti sanaro virūpākṣo bhūtagaṇaiḥ parivṛto mahādevo bhavatītyāhā bhagavān bodhāyanamaḥ || hemādrau śāṃtikāṃḍe bhīṣma uvāca - atha tvarita rudrasya nyāsamudrāḥ krameṇataṃ | japahomādikaṃ sarvaṃ kadhyate sarvasiddhaye || yasya kukṣau jagatsarvaṃ sthāparaṃ jaṃgamaṃcayat | duḥkhaccide namastastmaibrahma viṣṇu śivātmane || chaṃdonuṣṭubatharvāca ṛṣistvarita saṃjñake | devatātvaritorudro bījaṃ śaktirnamostviti || devāgāre nadītīre śucaudeśe pivāgyataḥ | upaviśya niyamyāstraṃ saṃkalpya vidhimadbudhaḥ || karayorubhamaiścaiva mūlamaṃtreṇa vinyaset | krameṇatu ṣaḍaṃgānāṃ nyāsassyā rdṛdayādibhiḥ || nyāsaṃ maṃtrapadaiḥ kuryā tpaṃcabhirhudayādikaṃ | yorudro agnau hṛdinyasya śīrṣiyospsviti vinyaset | viśvā bhūvanāviveśeti netraṃ vaisamudāhṛtaṃ || śeṣeṇa kavacaṃsasya vyāhṛtyā baṃdhayeddiśaḥ | aṃgalyagrāṇi mūlena kṛtvāṃguṣṭhenapīḍayet || sāmudrā subhagāproktā tatodhyānaṃ samācarat | eṣate rudrabhāgeti aṃgamudrā pradarśanaṃ || śrīkāmaḥ śīrṣṇikurvīta tejaskāmastu netrayoḥ | mukhe tvannā dyakāmastu grīvāyāṃ roganāśanaṃ || hadaye sukhakāmastu nābhau jñānapradaṃ bhavet | prajākāmastu guhyevai paśukāmastu jaṃghayoḥ || jānvostu grāmakāmastu sarvakāmastu guhyake | vaśīkaraṇa kāmastu vāmabāhau pradarśayet || pāpakṣayebhicārevā vyādherapagame tathā | bahiḥ śarīrātkurvīta śivasyāgretu saṃsmaret || caturbhujaṃ trinetraṃca śuddhasphaṭikasannibhaṃ | amṛtenacapūrṇaudvau kalaśau hastayordhvayoḥ || hastadvayena yogasya kṛtamudraṃ sthirāsanaṃ | sarvakāmapradaṃ śāṃtaṃ śaṃkaraṃ karuṇākaraṃ | ugrakarmaṇicai vogra mūrtiṃ dhyāye dumāpatiṃ | dvibhujaṃ nāgapāśaṃ ca śūlapāṇiṃ jaṭādharaṃ || evaṃ dhyātvā mahādevaṃ namastubhyarcyasu bhaktitaḥ | adhaśśāyījitakrodhā brahmacārī haviṣyabhuk || ayutedve japetpūrvaṃ pratyahaṃ pūjayecchivaṃ | juhuyāttu daśāṃ śena tadarthāṃśena tarpaṇaṃ || mārjanaṃ taddaśāṃśena tato brāhmaṇa bhojanaṃ | puraścaraṇa mevaṃca kṛtvā saṃpūjya śaṃkaraṃ | japettvarita rudraṃtu sarnakāma phala pradaṃ || śrīkāmaḥ śāṃti kāmovā japellakṣa mataṃdritaḥ | bailvai ssamidbhiḥ śrīkāmaḥ śāṃti kāmaḥ śamīmayaiḥ || juhuyā dājya saṃmmiśrai starpaṇaṃ mārjanaṃ tadhā | evaṃ sarveṣu kāmeṣu homāṃte juhuyādyavaiḥ || japtvā lakṣaṃtu putrārdhī pāyasaṃ juhuyāttataḥ || vittarthaṃ śrīphalairmoma āyurvṛdhaica mārnayā | tilai rapyājya saṃmiśrai stejaskāmo ghṛtenavai || vrīhibhiḥ paśukāmastu rāṣṭravemastuvai yavaiḥ | pāyasai ssarvakāmeṣu hotavyaṃ śarkarānvitaṃ || madhvaktānyāmra parṇāni tīvra jvara vināśane | mahābhūtābhācārevai guḍūcī bhirhunedghṛtaṃ || sarvaroga vināśāya sūryasyābhi mukho japet | āyutedve japeddhomaḥ kāryorkaśa kalai śśubhaiḥ || auduṃbarairanna kāmaste jaskāmastu khādhiraiḥ | apāmārga samiddhomā dbhūtabhādhā vinaśyati || gṛhabādhā vināśāya japedaśvaddha sannidhau | lavaṇaḥ śīta tīkṣṇogra samidhośvattha saṃbhavāḥ || dadhyaktāḥ samidha śuṣkāḥ svāhāṃtaṃ maṃtra muccaret | daśa paṃcāhutīrhūtvā gacca gacchetyu dīrayet || yāvaddomaṃbalirdeyaḥ puruṣāhāra saṃmitaḥ | evaṃ kṛte vimucyeta pumān strīvā mahāgrahāt || yaṃjetu micchetpuruṣa statthānābhi mukho japet | juhuyāccha tapatrāṇi saduṣṭaḥ kṣayamāpnuyāt || lāja homena kanyārthī kanyāṃ prāpnoti rūpiṇīṃ | lājāśca madhu saṃyuktāḥ śveta puṣpāṇivā punaḥ | hūyaṃte hiratairannai stasya viśvaṃ vaśaṃ bhavet | vāmāṃga munnataṃ kṛtvā strī vaśītu vicakṣaṇaḥ | hastyaśvamāṃdya śāṃtyarthaṃ tilaiścājyena saṃyutaiḥ | homasthānetu saṃsthāpya kuṃbhamekaṃ jalānvitaṃ | maṃtrayitvāṣṭa sāhasraṃ cūta śākhāṃtu nikṣipet | abhiṣekaśca ttenaiṣāṃ śākhā prokteḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ || graha grāmādi śāṃtiśca sartvaiḥ kāryātu pūrvavat | vāstupūjāca kartavyā ekāśīni padai śśubhaiḥ || īśānāya baliṃ kāryo bhūtānāṃ pataye tathā | evaṃ kṛte paśūnāṃca prajānāṃ śāntimāpnuyāt || adbhuteṣuca sarveṣu niśāyāṃ grāma bāhyataḥ | upaviśya jape dudraṃ tvaritaṃ balikhissaha || homaḥ pālāśa kāṣṭhaiśca kartavyoghṛta saṃyutaiḥ | īśānāya baliṃ kāryo yasyāṃ diśita dadbhutaṃ || tadāśā patayecaipa paśūnāṃ pataye tathā || vṛddikāmo japellakṣaṃ tilai rhomaṃ ghṛtānvitaiḥ | bali pūjā prakartavyā śivasya varuṇasyaca | sarvakāmeṣu caivātha tvaritasya japobhavet || ayutadvaya malpetu yāvallakṣaṃtu nodhike || evaṃ kṛtetu siddhisyānniṣkāmaḥ prāpnuyāccivaṃ | aihikāmuṣmikān bhogān bhuktvā sāyujya māpnuyāt || iti hemādrau śāṃti kāṃḍe gāṃgeya proktastvarita rudra vidhiḥ sva pna pha lā ni atha svapnāḥ - tatra daivajñādīn devaṃca saṃpūjyetyuktā adbhutasāgare parā śaraḥ - abhyarcya maṃtraistru purohitaṣtu saṃyamyata syāṃbhuvi saṃyutā yāṃ - brahmeśa pūrvāparabhāga puṣpaṃ kṛtvopathānaṃ śirasi kṣitīśaḥ - tadhaikabhugdhakṣiṇa pārśvaśāyī svapnaṃ parīkṣeta yadhopadeśaṃ | namaḥ śaṃbho trinetrāya varadābhāya pāṇaye || vāmanāya virūpāyasvapnādhi pataye namaḥ | bhagavān devadeveśa śūla bhṛdvṛṣa vāhana - iṣṭā niṣṭaṃ mamācakṣva svapnesuptasya śāśvataṃ - eka vastraḥ kuśāstīrṇe suptaḥ prayata mānasaḥ | niśāṃtepaśyate svapnaṃ śubhaṃ vāya divā śubhaṃ || śubhasvapnānāha bṛhadyātrāyāṃ varāhaḥ | śaila prāsāda bhāgāśca vṛṣabhārohaṇaṃ hitaṃ || caṃdra tārā grahāṇāṃca parimārgaṇa mevaca || bhūmyaṃ buthīnāṃ grasasaṃ śatrūṇāṃca vadha kriyā | jayo vivādho dyūteṣu saṃgrāmeca tathā jayaḥ || bhakṣaṇaṃ caiva māṃsānāṃ matsyānāṃ payasāṃ tadhā | darśanaṃ rudhiraṃ syāpi snānaṃvā rudhireṇaca || surā rudhira māṃsānāṃ pānaṃ kṣirasya caivahi | āṃtreṇa veṣṭitaṃ bhūmau nirmalaṃ gaganaṃ tadhā || sukhena dohanaṃ śastaṃ mahiṣīṇāṃ tadhā gavāṃ | siṃhānāṃ hastināṃ caiva baḍabānāṃ tathaivaca | prasādo deva viprebhyo gurubhyaśca tathā śubhaṃ | aṃbhasāṃ tvabhi ṣekaśca jñeyaṃ rājyapradaṃ hitat || rājyābhi ṣekaśca tathā chedanaṃ śirasopica | maraṇaṃ vahnilābhaśca vahnidāho grahadiṣu || tathodakānāṃ taraṇaṃ tadhā viṣama phalaṃ ghanaṃ | hastinī baḍabānāṃca gavāṃca prasavo gṛhe || arohaṇaṃ gajeṃdrāṇāṃ rodanaṃca tathā śubhaṃ | parastrīṇāṃ tathā lābhastathā liganamevaca | nigalairbaṃdhanaṃ dhānyaṃ tadhā viṣṭanu lepanaṃ | bījānāṃ bhūmipālānāṃ suhṛdāmapi darśanaṃ || śudhānyetāni proktāni rājyalābha karāṇica adbhutasāgare parāśaraḥ - bhaddhovā nigalairgra secca dahanaṃ cāsīsthito bāhunā chatraṃ vā | dviradādri rohaṇaṃ vidhirdivyopivā brāhmaṇaḥ || dinakara śaśitārā bhakṣaṇaṃ sparśanaṃvā viśaraṇamapi mūrdhnaḥ saptapaṃca tridhāvā - vṛṣabha graha nareṃdra śveta sihmadhiroha grasana mudadhi bhūmyorbūmi rājya pradāni | vipula raṇa vimarda dyūtavā dairjayaśca paśumṛga manujānāṃ labdhirathyāsa naṃca | viḍaśana parileposgamya nārī gamovā svamaraṇa śikhilābhassasya saṃdarśanaṃca || sita surabhi manojñālepa mālyāṃbarāṇāṃ dvija suraguru rājñāṃ darśanānyāśiṣaśca | maṇi rajata suvarṇaṃ bhojya pātreṣu bhuṅkai ghṛta dadhi paramānnaṃ sarvame tacchubhaṃca || bṛhaspati saṃhitāyāṃ - yastuśvetena sarveṇadaṃ śito dakṣiṇe bhuje | sahasra lābhastasyasyātpūrṇetu daśamedine | urago vṛścikovāpi jaṃbuko daṃśate yadi || vijayaṃcārtha siddhiṃca putraṃ tasya vinirdiśet | bālā kāṃku kkuṭīṃ krauṃcīṃ labdvāyaḥ prati budhyate || krośāṃtāṃ labhate bhūmiṃ bhāryāṃvā priyavādinīṃ | rudhiraṃ pibate svapne surāṃvā pibati kvacit | brāhmaṇo labhate vidyāmitarastu dhanaṃ labhet || kṣīraṃ pibatiyaḥ svapnena phenaṃ dohanekṛte | soma pānaṃ bhavettasya dhanaṃvā bahucādiśet || dadhilābhe dhanaṃ tasya ghṛtalābhe druvaṃ yaśaḥ || ghṛta prāśe mahakleśo yaśastu dadhi bhakṣaṇe| godhūmai rvāyavairvāpi lābhaṃ siddhārdamevaca || puṣpeprāpte dhanaṃ vidyā tphalevṛddhiranuttamā || āsane śayaneyāne śarīrevāhane gṛhe || jvalamāne vibudhyeta tasyaśrīḥ sarvatomukhīḥ || varāhaḥ - vṛścikādi daśanaṃ maṇi ratna kāṃcanaṃ kalaśadīpakiśorāḥ | vatsahaṃsa śaśakādayorbhakalābhadaḥ paśu gajāda lābhadaḥ || viṣṇudharme - ekasyāṃ yadivārātrau śubhaṃ vāyadivā śubhaṃ | paścāddṛśye ttadā tatra tasyapāka vinirdiśet || atha dusvapnāḥ - adbhutasāgare devalaḥ - raktagaṃdhāṃbarasragvī gacchedvā dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ | kharoṣṭra mahiṣārohe trimāsānnādhijīvati || śvabhre yonipatetsvapne dvāraṃvāsyāpi dhāyate || naco tiptati yastasmā ttadaṃtaṃ tasya jīvitaṃ || mārkaṃḍeyaḥ - vāṃtyāṃ mūtraṃ purīṣaṃtu suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tadhā || pratyatra madyavāsvapne jiveta daśamāsikaṃ | keśāṃgāraṃ tathā bhasma uragaṃ nirjalāṃ nadīṃ || dṛṣṭvāsvapne daśāhaṃtu mṛtyu rekādaśedine | kārālai rvikaṭaiḥ kṛṣṇaiḥ puruṣai rudyatāyathaiḥ | pāṣāṇaistāḍita ssvapne sadyomṛtyu rbhaveddruvaṃ || raktakṛṣṇāṃbaradharā gāyaṃtī ca tathā haset | dakṣiṇānāṃ nayennārī svapnesopina jīvati || varāhaḥ - hariṇorohe bhramaṇaṃ mṛtya rnareṇa sūkarārohe | uṣṭrorohevā vṛddhisyā tkuṃjarārohe || vatsyo viṣṇudharmeca - malināṃbara dhāritvaṃ abhyaṃgaḥ paṃkadiggatā | uccātprapatanaṃcaiva ḍolārohaṇamevaca || śakradhvajasya patanaṃ patanaṃ śaśi sūryayoḥ | devadvijādi bhūpānāṃ prajānāṃ krodhaevaca || āliṃganaṃ kumārīṇāṃ vidhavānāṃca maidhunaṃ | hāniścaiva svagotrāṇāṃ vīraḥ kaṃṭhe manaḥpriyā | dakṣiṇā śābhigamanaṃ vyādinābhi bhavastathā || phalopahāraśca tathā śāḍvalānāṃ viśodhanaṃ | grahaṇāṃcaiva bhaṃgaśca gṛhasammārjanaṃ tathā || krīḍāpiśāca kravyāda vānarā śvataraipari | kāṣāyavastracāritvaṃ tadvitkrīḍanakaṃ tathā || tailapānaścāgaroha ścavamālyānulepanaṃ | evamādīnicānyāni dusvapnānivinirdiśet || parāśaraḥ - kāyasyā lepanaṃvā kaluṣajalanipītasneha | pakvānijagdhijihvadaṃta prajāhupravatana madhavānardhaśokapradāyi || laiṃge - muktakeśohanaṃścaiva gāyaṃtaṃ nṛtyete naraḥ || yāmyāṃ diśamitogacche ttadaṃtaṃ tasya jivitaṃ || anyevyudyoga bhīṣma droṇa karṇaparva yuddhakāṃḍādau | bhārata rāmāyaṇādau jñeyāḥ || mātsyeviṣṇudharmo ttareca - svarnetu pradhameyāme vatsarānte phalaṃ bhavet || ṣaḍbhirmāsai rdvitīyeca tribhirmānai striyāmakeḥ | caturthe māsamātreṇa phalaṃ bhāvati nānyathā || parāśaraḥ - pādadvipādo ttara pādavṛdhyā varṣārdhamāsatraya māsakālāḥ | niśāvibhāgena caturṣudṛṣṭāḥ svāpnā aniṣṭeṣṭa phala pradāḥ syuḥ || varāhaḥ - ādyevarṣe vatsarārdhe dvitīyepāko varṣerdhārdhabhāge tṛtīye | māsātpākaśśarvirī paścimāṃte svapne pākansūribhissaṃpradiṣṭaṃ || du sva pna śā ntiḥ puruṣaṃ karāla daṃtaṃ paśyatisa enaṃ haṃti varāha enaṃ haṃti markaṭa ena māskada yatyāśu vāyurenaṃ pravahati - suvarṇaṃ khādayitvā pagirati bhakṣayatyekaṃ puṃḍarīkaṃ karālaiḥ kharairvarāhairyuktairyānairyāti kṛṣṇāṃ dhenuṃ kṛṣṇa vatsāṃ vāpaśyati naladamālī dakṣiṇāmukho vrajati yoyadyeteṣāṃ kiṃcatpaśyedu poṣyasapāya naṃsthālī pākaṃ śrapayitvā rātri sūktena pratyṛcaṃ hutvānne nāmenavā viprān bhojayitvā caruṃ svayaṃ prāśnīyāditi atra lakṣahomaḥ kāryaḥ gausvapnādbhuta darśana iti pūrva mukteḥ || tathā caṃḍī pāṭhopi - śāṃti karmaṇi sarvatra tadhā duḥsvapna darśane | grahapīḍā sucograsu māhātmyaṃ śruṇu yānmama || dusvapnaṃca nṛbhirdhaṣṭaṃ susvapna mupajāyate | ityādi mārkaṃḍeya purāṇāt || parāśaraḥ - deva dvijādi prati pūjanāni maṃtropavāsādica viprasevā | tilānna go bhūmi hiraṇya dāvaṃ dusvapna haṃtṛṇi payaścagāṃgaḥ | tilanāma yutaṃ tatrajuhuyāttu samāhitaḥ || tilosītica maṃtreṇa dhenuṃ dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ | brāhmaṇān tarpayettatra dakṣiṇā bhojanādinā || dānaṃca vividhaṃdeya maśubhānāṃ nivṛttaye | ṣaḍbhirmāsaistu saṃpūrṇairanyadhā maraṇaṃ bhavet || mātsye - stutiṃca vāsudevasya tadhā tasyaca pūjanaṃ | gajeṃdra yokṣa śravaṇaṃ jñeyaṃ dusvapna nāśanaṃ || viṣṇu sahasranāma japaḥ puṇyo dusvapna nāśana ityukteḥ || prayoga pārijāte śaunakaḥ - svapnotpāteṣu caiteṣu kālikātrādhi devatā | pūjā vidhānaṃ pūrvoktaṃ kuryā datrāpi yatnataḥ || svapnādi nāśa maṃtreṇa hune daṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ | homaṃ kuryātprayatnena rātrāveva dvijottamaḥ || pratyṛ caṃpāyasaṃ hutvā rātrī vyakhyāditi kramāt || aṣṭottara śataṃ hutvā maṃtreṇānena yatnataḥ | kālarātri maṃtreṇe tyarthaḥ - gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyā dvastraṃ hema paśūnapi | yadyukta dakṣiṇā dānepya śakto homakarmaṇi || hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātta dānīmevavā budhaḥ | vastra kuṃbhādi sakalaṃ taddhotre vratipādayet || saeva - yadya niṣṭaphalaṃ svapne paśyettasyocyate vidhiḥ | ādyānodeva savitarityṛcā pūrvamekayā || tataḥ paraṃ paraṃ yacca dunvapna svapna paṃcabhiḥ | ṛgbhiḥ paraṃ tato home rājanyujjya itityṛcā || ṛgbhi ssarvābhiretābhiru patiṣṭheta bhāskaraṃ || evaṃ kṛte tuduḥ svapna darśanaṃ niṣpalaṃ bhavet | atha svapnasyeti japan prātaḥ prātardine dine || dusvapnaṃtu vadetkṛtsnaṃna tasmādviṃdate bhayaṃ | atraśrāddamapi kāryaṃ - śrāddārha dravya saṃpattau tathā dusvapna darśane || janmarkṣe grahapīḍāsu śrāddhaṃ kurvī taveccayeti | pṛthvī caṃdrodaye mārkaṃḍeya purāṇa vacanāt | eta dasmābhi rnirṇaya sidhāpuktaṃ || iti kamalākara bhaṭṭakṛte śāṃtiratne dussvapna śāṃtiḥ vā stu śāṃ tiḥ atha vāstu śāṃtiḥ - tatkālosmābhirnarṇayasiṃdhāvuktaḥ kaściducyate || nāradaḥ - saumya phālguṇa vaiśākha māgha śrāvaṇa kārtikāḥ | mānāḥsyurgrahanirmāṇe putrārogya dhanapradāḥ || bādarāyaṇaḥ - vaiśākhe pālguṇe pauṣe śrāvaṇe mārgaśīrṣake | gṛhāraṃbha śśilānnāyasaḥ staṃbhāraṃbhaḥ praśasyate || śokaṃ dhānyaṃ paṃcatāni ṣpaśutvaṃ svāptiṃnisvaṃ saṃgaraṃ bhṛtyanāśanaṃ | svaśrīprāptiṃ vahnibhītiṃca lakṣmīṃ kuryāścaitrādyā gṛhāraṃbhakāle || mātsyetu - āṣāḍhe bhṛtyaratnādi paśuvarga vināśanaṃ | mārgaśīrṣe tathā thānyaṃ pauṣe taskarato bhaya | mityāṣāḍo śubhaḥ pauṣaścā śubhada uktaḥ || ratnamālāyāṃ - karkinakrahari kuṃbhagaterke pūrva paścima mukhāni gṛhāṇi | taulimeṣa vṛṣa vṛścikayāte dakṣiṇo ttara mukhāni vadaṃti - gargaḥ - tryuttarāmṛga rohiṇyāṃ puṣpe maitrekaratraye | dhaniṣṭā dvitīye pauṣṭe gṛhāraṃbhaḥ praśasyate || mātsve - āditya bhaumamarjaṃtu sarvevārāḥ śubhāvahāḥ | caṃdrāditya balaṃ labhdhvā lagne śubhanirīkṣite || staṃbhoccrāyādi kartavya manyattu parivarjayat || prāsādeṣveva mevasyātkūpa vāpīṣu caivahi || bhūparīkṣoktātatraiva - aratnimātra garaivaisvanu liptetu sarvataḥ | ghatamāna śarasthaṃ kṛtvāvarti catuṣṭayaṃ | jvālaye dbhūparīkṣārthaṃ pūrṇaṃ tatparvatodiśaṃ || dīptau pūrvādi gṛhṇīyādvarṇānāmānupūravaśaḥ | aratni mātraṃ gartaṃtu kṛtvā tatkhātapūraṇe || tripaṃca saptarātreṇa yatra rohaṃtitānyasi | jyeṣṭhottarā kaniṣṭhā bhūrvārjanīyetarāmatā || va rā ha - dakṣiṇa pūrvakoṇe pūjāṃkṛtvā śilāṃnyase tprathamāṃ | śeṣāḥ pradakṣiṇena staṃbhāścaiva samuddhāpyāḥ || lallaḥ - sthānaṃ pākaśayanaṃ ca bhojyaṃ gajālayaṃ vājigṛhaṃ dhanasya | devasya pūrvādidiśāṃ krameṇa madhyesamā bhūpaniveśanāya || aśvalāyana sūtre - yātrāpaḥ sarvatomadhye sametya pradakṣiṇaṃ śayanīyaṃ | parityajya prācyaḥ syaṃderanna pravahatyatra sarvaṃsamṛddhaṃ || vasiṣṭhaḥ - svagṛhātpaścimebhāge pitṛvyā gajamaṃdiraṃ || gargaḥ - parakoṇe paradvāraiḥ parastaṃbhaiḥ paradrumaiḥ | kūpavṛkṣādibhiccaiva kṛtaṃgehaṃ nirarthakaṃ || nāradaḥ - praveśo madhyamojñeyaḥ saumyakārtikamāsayoḥ | māgha phālguṇa vaiśākha jyeṣṭhamāseṣu śobhanaḥ || vasiṣṭhaḥ - kṛtvā sukraṃ pṛṣato vāmatorkaṃ viprān pūjyapyagrataḥ pūrṇakuṃbhaṃ | ramyaṃ harmyaṃ toraṇasra gvitānaiḥ strībhissadbhirgītavādyai rviśecca || lagnātprāgādikādikṣu dvaudvaurāśiṃ niveśayet | ekamekaṃnyasetorṇevāme śakraṃ viciṃtayet || nārada - akavāṭanāccanna madattabali bhojanaṃ | gṛhaṃsapraviśeddīmā nāpadāmākarohitat || mṛtpeṭikā svarṇaratna dhānya śaivālasaṃyutāṃ | grahamadye hastamātragartevāstuṃ ca vinyaset || hemādrau mātsye - ekāśīti padaṃ kṛtvā rujubhiḥ kanakenatu | paścātpīṭhenānulipte sūtreṇālojya sarvataḥ || daśapūrvāyatā rekhā daśacaivottarāyatāḥ | sarvavāstu vibhāge ca vijñeyānavakānava || padasthān pūjayeddevān catvāriṃśacca paṃcaca | dvātriṃśa dbāhyadeśeṣu pūjyāścāṃte trayodaśa || madhye navapade brahma catvārastripadāḥ smṛtāḥ | viṃśatitvekapadakāstāvaṃto dvipada smṛtāḥ || nāmatastrāvakṣyāmi sthānāni ca nibodhata | ūśānakoṇādi suran pūjaye tkramaśo nana || śibhīcaivatu parjanyo jayaṃtaḥ kuliśāyudhaḥ | sūryanatyau bhṛśaścaiva ākāśo vāyurevaca | pūṣācavitathācaiva gṛhatakṣa yamāvubhau || gaṃdharvo bhṛṃgarājaśca mṛgaḥ pitṛgaṇastathā | dauvārigodha sugrīvaḥ puṣpadaṃto jalādhipaḥ || asuraḥ śoṣapāpaśca rogohi rbudhnya evaca | bhallāṭaḥ soṣasarvauca aditiśa ditistathā || bahirdvā triṃśadetetu tadaṃtaśca turaṛśruṇu | īśānādi catuṣkoṇa saṃsthitānpūjedbuthaḥ || āpaścaivātha sāvitro jayorudra stadhaivaca | madhye napapade brahma tasyāṣṭauca samīpagāḥ || aryamāssavitācaiva vivasvān vibudhādhipaḥ | mitrodharājayakṣmāca tathā pṛthvīdaraḥ smṛtaḥ || aṣṭamaścāpavataśca parito brahmaṇaḥ smṛtāḥ | apaścaivāpasatsaśca parjanyohyaditistadhā || tanmadhyetu bahirviṃśa dvipadāstetu sarvataḥ | aryamāca vivasvāṃśca mitraḥ pṛthvīdhara stadhā || brahmaṇaḥ paritodikṣu tripadāstetu sarvataḥ | mūrdhanyagniḥ samāviṣṇo mukhe āpaḥ namākṣitāḥ || pṛthvīdharoryamācaiva tanusthānamadhiṣṭitau | vakṣasthale cāpavatsaḥ pūjanīyaḥ sadā budhaiḥ || satyasomādaya stadvādbahoḥ paṃcaca paṃcaca | rudraśca rājayakṣmāca hastayo rmaṇikabaṃdhane | sāvitraḥ savitātadvaddhastaṃ dakṣiṇa mākṣitau | vivasvānathamitraścajaṭhare saṃvyasaṃsthitau || pūṣāca pāpayakṣmāca hastayo rmaṇibaṃdhane | tadhaivā suraśoṣauca vāmapārśvo samāsthitau || pārśvetu dakṣiṇe tadvadvitatha ssaṃgrahaḥ kṣataḥ | ūrvoryamāṃbupaujñeyau jānvorgaṃdharvapuṣpakau || jaṃghayo rbhṛṃgasugrīvau sphikthsodauvāriko mṛgaḥ | jayaśakrau tathāmeḍhre pādayoḥpitara stathā | madhye navapadebrahmā hṛdayosatu pūjyate | catuṣaṣṭipadovāstuḥ prāsāde brahmaṇāsmṛtaḥ || brahma catuṣpade tatra koṇeṣvekapadastathā | bahiḥ koṣṭheṣucāṣṭotu sārthaśco bhayasaṃsthitāḥ || viṃśatirdavipadāścaiva catuṣṣṭipade smṛtāḥ || pūjāmahānāradaḥ - vāstumaṃtreṇa vāstujño dūrvā dadhyakṣatādibhiḥ | vasiṣṭhaḥ - praṇavenārcayodvāpi athavā svasvāmabhiḥ || homastrimokhalekāryaḥ kuṃḍe hastavramāṇake | yavairapi tilaiścaiva samidbhiḥ kṣīravṛkṣajaiḥ || pālāśaiḥ khādiraiścā sāmārgo duṃbara saṃbhavaiḥ || kuśadūrvā bhavairvāpi madhu sarpi samanvitaiḥ | kāryāstu paṃcabhirbilvai rbilvabījai stadhāpivā || homaṃte bhakṣyabhojyaistu vāstudeśe baliṃ haret | īśakoṇe ghṛtāktannāṃ śikhinevi nivedayet || odanaṃ sotpalaṃ dadyā tparjanyāya ghṛtānvitaṃ | jayaṃtā yadhvajaṃpītaṃ paiṣṭaṃ kūrmāya sanyajet || iṃdrāya paṃcaratnāni paiṣṭaṃca kuliśaṃ tadhā | vitānakaṃca sūryāyā pūpaṃ saktuṃ tadaivaca || satyāya ghṛta godhūmaṃ matsyān dadyādbhṛśāyaca | śaṣkuliścaṃta rikṣāya dadyātsaktuṃca vāyave || lājāḥ pūṣṇeca dātavyāḥ vitathecaṇa kodanaṃ || gṛhakṣatāya madhvannaṃ yamāya piśitodanaṃ | gaṃdhodanaṃca gaṃdharve bhṛṃge meṣasya jihvikāṃ || mṛgāya yāvakaṃdadyā tpitṛbhiḥ kṛsaraṃ tathā || dauvārike daṃtakāṣṭaṃ gṛhakṣata baliṃ tathā || sugrīve pūpakān dadyātpuṣa daṃtāya pāyasaṃ || kuśastaṃbhena saṃyuktaṃ tathā padmaṃca vāruṇe || paiṣṭaṃ hiraṇyayaṃ dadyāda surāya surāmatā | ghṛtodanaṃ soṣapāya godhāṃ paipāpa yatrmaṇe || ghṛta laḍḍustu rogāyā hirbudhnyāya sumaphalaṃ | trakṣyaṃ mukhyāya dātavyaṃ mudgodana mataḥ paraṃ || bhallāṭa sthānake dadyātsomāya madhupāyasaṃ || nāgāya śālijaṃ piṣṭamadityai pośikā stathā || ditestu marikāṃ dadyādi tyevaṃ bāhyato baliḥ || kṣīra māpāya dātavyā māpavatsāya vaidadhi | sāvitre laḍḍukaṃ dadyā tsamarīcaṃ kuśodanaṃ || sāvitre guḍapūpāṃśca jayāya ghṛta caṃdaṃ | vivasvate punardadyā drakta caṃdana pāyasaṃ || haritālo danaṃ dadyā diṃdrāya ghṛta saṃyutaṃ | guḍodanaṃtu mitrāya rudrāya ghṛta pāyasaṃ | amaṃ pakvaṃ tadhā māṃsaṃ deyaṃ syādrāja yakṣmaṇe || pṛthvī dharāya māṃsāvi kuṣmāṃḍānica dāpayet | śarkarā pāyasaṃ dadyādaryamṇe pānamevaca || paṃcagavyaṃ yavān brāhme tilākṣata haviścaruṃ | bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃca vividaṃ brahmaṇevi nivedayet || evaṃ saṃpūjitā devāḥ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtume sadā | sarveṣāṃ kāṃcanaṃ dadyā dbhrahmaṇegāṃ payasvine || rākṣasānāṃ balirdeyo māṃsodana sasunvitaḥ | māṃso danaṃ ghṛtaṃ padmaṃ kesaraṃ haviṣānvitaṃ || īśānabhāga māśritya caraktyevi nivedayet | māṃso danaṃ sarudiraṃ haridro danamevaca || agneyīṃ diśamāśritya vidāryaivi nivedayet | dadyodanaṃca rudhiraṃ matsya khaṃḍaiśca saṃyutaṃ || pīta raktaṃ baliṃ dadyā tyūtanāyaitu mānavaḥ | vāyavyai pāpa rākṣasyai matsya māṃsaṃ surāsavaṃ || pāyasaṃvāpi dātavyaṃ svanāmnā sarvataḥ kramāt | namaskārānu yuktena praṇavādyena sarvataḥ || tataḥ sarvauṣadha snānaṃ yajamānasya kārayet || dvijāṃstu pūjayodabhaktyā yocānye graha māgatāḥ | etadvāstūpa śamanaṃ kṛtvā karma namācaret || prāsāda bhavanodyāna prāraṃbhe parivartane | jīrṇoddhāre tadhodyāne tadhā gṛha niveśane || dvārādi sthāpane tadvatprāsāda paṃvartane | puraveśma praveśena sarvadoṣopa śāṃtaye | vāssūpa śamanaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ sūtreṇa veṣṭayet | rākṣasoghnyā pāvamānena sūktena bhavanādikaṃ || nṛtyaṃ maṃgalavādyaṃca kuryā dbrāhmaṇa vācanaṃ | anena vidhināyastu prati saṃvatsaraṃ budhaḥ | gṛhe vāyatane kuryānnasa duḥkha mavāpnuyāt|| gṛhyokta homa vidhinā balikramaṃ kuryāt || prāsāda vāstu śamane vidhirya uktaḥ | atra paurāmavāstu śāṃteḥ svagṛhyokta| vāstuśāṃtyā samuccayo vidhīyate || saṃtarpaye ddvijavarānadha bhakṣyabhojyai śśuktāṃbaraśca bhavanaṃ praviśetsu rūpaṃ | kṛtvā puhodvija varānanupūrṇa kaṃbha dadhyakṣatairmṛdula puṣpa phalopa śobhanaṃ | datvā hiraṇya vasanāni tathā dvijebhyo māṃgalya śāṃti nilayaṃ svagṛhaṃ viśecca || aśvalāyanaḥ bījavato grahan prapadyet - vasiṣṭa saṃhitāyā mapyevaṃ śāṃtiruktā - kiṃcidviśeṣa uktātatraiva - vāstupūjāma kṛtvāyaḥ praviśennava maṃdiraṃ | rogānnānā vidhān kleśā naśnute sarva saṃkarān || iti vāstu śāṃtiḥ| <10> atha paramaśāyi vāstuśānti prayogaḥ athāsma tpitṛkato vāstuśāṃti prayogaḥ - ukta gṛhapraveśa dinātpūrve śubhe pūrvāhnena strīkaḥ śiciḥ prāṇānāyamya deśakālau nmṛtvā gṛhāraṃbhādau asya vāstoḥ śubhatā siddhyarthaṃ sanavagraha vāstu śāṃtiṃ kariṣye | iti saṃkalpya tadaṃgatyena gaṇapati pūjana puṇyāhavācana mātṛkā pūjana nāṃdī śrāddācāryādi varaṇāni kariṣye iti saṃkalpyatāni kṛtavācāryādīn vṛtvālaṃkāra vastrādibhiḥ pūjayet - tatra ṛtvijaścatvāraḥ | tataḥ ācāryaḥ karma kariṣya iti saṃkalpya gorasarṣapān vikiredebhi rmaṃtraiḥ || yadatra saṃsthitaṃ bhūtaṃ sthānamāśritya sarvadā | sthānaṃ tyaktvātutatsarvaṃ yatrasthaṃ tatra gaccatu | aprakrāmaṃtu bhūtāni piśācā ssarvatodiśaṃ || sarveṣā mivirodhena śāṃtikarma samārabhet | bhūta preta piśācādyā apakrāmaṃtu rākṣasāḥ | sthānāsmādvrajaṃtvaṃnyaṃ svīkaromi bhuvaṃtvi māmiti || tato gāyatryā gomūtraṃ gaṃdhadvāreti gomayaṃ | apyāyasvetikṣīraṃ dadhikrāvṇa iti dadhighṛtaṃ mimikṣira iti ghṛtaṃ | āpohiṣṭeti kuśodakaṃ caikatra samādhāya praṇavenāloḍhya kuśaiḥ | śucīvo havyetitṛcena sarvān gṛhādīn prokṣayet || tato grahadau yacajamānasyaika hastapramāmaṃ gartaṃ caturasraṃ sayoniṃ trimekhalaṃ kuṃḍaṃ caturaṃguloccrayaṃ sthalaṃvā vidhāya tatpūrvata ścaturaṃguloccritaṃ hastamitaṃ vedidvayaṃ mṛdāvidāya | uttara vadyā mīśānyādikoṇa catuṣke caturaḥ śaṃkūn ropayet || oṃ viṃśatubhūtale nāgāloka pālāśca sarvataḥ | asmin gṛhevatiṣṭhaṃtu āyurbalakarāssadeti maṃtreṇāropayet || pratiropaṇasya maṃtrāvṛttireva magrepi | pāsādādautu grahāpadettattannāmānya pyūhāniyāni | evaṃ prāsāde pītisarvāṃtesti deśān | tatoropaṇa krameṇa śaṃku pārśve māṣa bhaktabalīn dadyāt | agnibhyo pyathaparpebhyo yocānyetra samāśritāḥ | tebhyo baliṃprayacchāmi puṇyamodana muktamamiti dadyāt | tato vedyuparinūtnavastre kuṃkumādinā suvarṇa rajatādiśalākayā | śāṃtāṃ yaśovatīṃ kāṃtāṃ viśālaṃ prāṇavāhinīṃ | satīṃ sumatīṃ sunaṃdāṃ subhadrāṃ suradhāṃ daśa | ityoṃkākādi namoṃtai rnāmabhiḥ paścādārabdhāḥ | prāgatāḥ udak saṃsthāḥ samāḥ | aṃguśadvayāṃtarā daśarokhāḥ kṛtvā | punaḥ hiraṇyāṃ suvrataṃ lakṣmīṃ vibhūtiṃ vimalāṃ priyāṃ | jayāṃ balāṃ viśokaṃca īḍāmiti daśakramāt | iti nāmabhi stadaiva dakṣiṇāraṃbhāḥ udagaṃtāḥ praksaṃsthāḥ | prāgvaddaśarokhāḥ kṛtvā kuṃḍe sthaṃḍile vāstuṃ saṃsmṛtyāgniṃ pratiṣṭhāpya dakṣiṇavedyāṃ vastrenavagraha maṃḍalaṃ vilikhya tatra grahādīn saṃsthāpya ṣośopacāraiḥ saṃbūjyata dīśānyāṃ kalaśaṃ saṃsthāpya vāstoṣpatyā vāhane viniyogaḥ oṃ vāstoṣpate pratijānīhyāsmāniti maṃtreṇa sthāpayet | naca svarṇasya rūpyasyavā | tato maṃḍalasya bahirīśā nāgneya naiṛtya vāyuvya koṇeṣu krameṇa carakī vidārī pūtanā pāvarākṣasī pūrva dakṣiṇa paścimottarā dikṣukrameṇa | skaṃda maryamaṇaṃ jṛṃbhakaṃ pilipiccaṃca prāgvannāma maṃtraiḥ saṃsthāpya | prāgādyaṣṭadikṣu | iṃdraṃ | agniṃ | yamaṃ | niṛtiṃ | varuṇaṃ | vāyuṃ | kuberaṃ | īśānaṃ | tattanmaṃtrairnā mabhirvā sthāpyā vāhvāsanā dyupacāraiḥ pratyeka meka travā kālaka mavraṇaṃ kalaśaṃ saṃsthāpya tatra gaṃdhauṣadi yava dūrvā paṃca pallava sapta mṛttikā paṃca ratnāni pakṣipya | vasreṇābhiveṣṭya yuva pūrṇa pūrṇapātraṃ nidhāya paruṇa māvāhya tatra tīrthā nāvāhayet | tata ācāryonvādhānaṃ kuryāt | tatra cakṣuṣī ājyenetyaṃta muktvā navagrahā namuka saṃkhyābhiḥ samidbhisti lājyāhutibhiśca adhi devatāḥ pratyadhi devatāḥ vināyakā dīnamuka saṃkhyābhiḥ samitti lājyā hutibhiḥ śikhyādi paṃca cacvāṃriṃśa ddevatā amuka saṃkhyākābhiḥ samittila pāyasājyāhuti bhirvāstoṣpateti cata sṛbhiḥ ṛgbhiḥ krameṇāmuka saṃkhyābilvai stadbhīḍairvācarakyā dinamuka saṃkhyāyā samidādi caturāhutibhiriti pradhāna devatāḥ saṃkīrtya śeṣeṇa sviṣṭakṛta mityādyuktān samidhādīn juhuyāt | tataḥ yajamāno gnerdakṣāṇata upaviṣṭaḥ sarvadevatā dravyāṇica saṃkīrtyaitābhya etānyutsṛjet | nama metyādi svatvatyāgaṃ kuryāt | bahvṛtvikkartṛte home pratyāhuti svatvatyāgasya kartumaśakyatvāt tata ācārya idma dānādi kṛtvā pradhāna homaṃ sartvikkuryāt || tatta dravyāṇi tatta tsakhyācocyate | navagrahebhyaḥ krameṇa arka pālāśakhādirā pāmārga pippalo duṃbara śamī dūrvā kuśākhyāḥ samidhaḥ pratyeka maṣṭottara śata maṣṭāviṃśatyaṣṭauvā pradeśa mātrāstatpaṃkhyāśca tilāhutī rjuhuyāt | yadātebhyaśca rupari tadāpyāhuti saṃkhyāsaiva kecitvaikaikā carvāhutirityāhuḥ | tatodhi devatā pratyadhi devatā vināyakādibhyaśta nyūna saṃkhyāyā tathaiva tadgṛhadi dhevatādibhyastattadgrahā samidhaḥ palāśovā grahāṇā maṣṭapakṣe etābhyaśca tasra iti siṣṭāḥ || atra tisṛbhirdūrvābhi rekāhuti riti saṃkhyākāryā kuśetrivatreṇaiketi | tataḥ śikhyādibhyaḥ | prāgukta praṇavādi svāhāṃta nāmabhiḥ pratyeka maṣṭamasahasra maṣṭaśata maṣṭāviṃśati raṣṭauvāhutibhiḥ samitila pāyasājyaṃ juhuyāt | atra samidha uduṃbarasya mukhyāstadalābhe aśvātthādīnāmapi | sarvāḥ samidho madhu ghṛta dadhi kṣīraivān bhaktā hotavyāḥ | tilāḥ kṛṣṇā evayavo gaurava evakeci ttileṣu yāvānāhuḥ | vāstoṣpata iti catasṛbhiḥ krameṇa samittilapāyasājyaṃ pratyeka maṣṭottaraśataṃ | tato vāstavevāstoṣpate dhruvetica pratyṛcaṃ paṃca pa ca ekaikaṃvāgha tāktaṃ bilvaṃ juhuyāt | vāstoṣpata iti catasṛṇaāṃ visiṣṭho vāstoṣpati striṣṭap aṃtyā gāyatrī homo viniyogaḥ | vāsatoṣpate druvāstūṇā miti bahirvāstoṣpati bṛhatīhome viniyogaḥ | tataścarakyādibhyo mukhyaṃ nyūnasaṃkhyāyā catvāri dravyāṇi juhuyāt | mukhyoṣṭasaṃkhyāyāṃ anyatra catussaṃkhyāyā mitiśiṣṭāḥ | etāni sarvāṇi dravyāṇi hasainaivahotavyāni | tataḥ sviṣṭa kṛdādi prāyaścitta homāṃtaṃ kṛtvā | iṃdrādi dikpālebhyaśca sadīpa māṣa bhaktabaliṃ datvā | srūcayājyaṃ dvādaśa grahītaṃcatuḥ gṛhītaṃvā kṛttvānārikelādi phalaṃ tatra saṃsthāpya mūrthānamiti pūrṇāhutiṃ juhuyat | mūrdānaṃ divo bhāradvajo vaiśvānarasriṣṭup home vinoyogaḥ | tataḥ praṇītāni nayanādi karmaśeṣaṃ samāpya | vāstumaṃḍala paścimadeśe śikhine eṣate pāyasa balirnamametyavaṃ śikhyādibhyo baliṃdadyāt | tānvipraiḥ ghṛtayuta pāyase nakṣatriyādau vakṣyamāṇaiḥ paktvai stada tata ācāryādaya ssamudrajyeṣṭhā ityādi vaidikaiḥ surāstvetyādi paurāṇaisca maṃtre ryajamānaṃ sapatnikaṃ śāṃtikalaśodake nābhiṣicya sarvausibhūṣitāṃ srīrūpāṃ pṛthvi dhyātvā | oṃ dharāyai nama iti maṃtreṇa būjayet sarva devamayaṃ vāstu vāstudevamayaṃ paramiti || tato gṛhaṃ pragādi trisūtryā pāvamānenasūktena rakṣoghnenaca trisūtreṇa veṣṭayot || chinne sūtre śubhaṃ - tato dugdhapūrṇa yāca stanakubhyā jalapūrṇayāca stanakuṃbhyā tadhaiva sūktadvayena dhārādyaya mavicchinnāṃ kuryāt || tato yajamāno gṛhasyāgneye ākāśapade jānudaghnamavaṭaṃ khātvātaṃ gomaye nopalipya śukla caṃdana puṣpākṣatādibhi ralaṃkṛtya śālyādi saptabījāni dadhyodanaṃca pakṣipya navakuṃbhajala pūrṇaṃ śukaika puṣpayutaṃ gaṃdhādibhirarcitaṃ hastadvayenādāya jānūbhyā mavanīṃ gatvā | oṃ namo varuṇāyeti tajjavena gartaṃpūrayet || tatrāvarte pradakṣiṇe puṣpe corthvamukhe śubhaṃ | tato mṛnnirmita pecikāyāṃ saptapīja dadhyodana śaināla phalapuṣpāṇi prakṣipya pūrva sthāpitaṃ vṛṣavāstuṃ tūryamaṃgalaghoṣeṇānīya tasyāṃ saṃsthāpya gaṃdhādibhiḥ saṃpūjya prārdayeddhvābhyāṃ || pūjatosimayā vāsto homādyairarcanai śśubhaiḥ | prasīdapāhi viśveśa dehime gṛhājaṃ sukhaṃ || vāstupuruṣa namastentu bhūśayyā nirata prabho | madgṛhe dhana dhānyādi samṛddhiṃ kuru sarvadeti || tataḥ peṭikāyā mācyādya tasmin garte śanai rnikṣipe danena || saśaila sāgarāṃ pṛthvīṃ yathā vahasi mūrdhani || tadhāmāṃ vaha rbhūṣayet || tatogneḥ paścimata ācāryāṃ saṃpūjyā laṃkṛtāṃ | navatsāṃgāṃ vāsoyugaṃca dakṣiṇāṃ datvā | brahmadyṛtvigbhyo yadāśakti dakṣiṇāṃ datvā | grahāṇāṃ śikhyādi vāstu devatānāṃca pūjāṃ kṛtvā
