rajodarśana śāṃtiḥ tatpalamāha - amāriktāṣṭamī ṣaṣṭhī dvādaśī prati tsvapapi | parighasyāpi pūrvārthe vyatīpātecavau dhṛtau || saṃdhyā sūpaplave viṣṭava śubhaṃ pradhamārtave | upaplavo grahaṇaṃ - rogī pativratā duḥkhī putraṇī bhoga bhāginī | pativratā kleṣabhāgī sūryavārādiṣu kramāt || vaidhanyaṃ sutalābhaśca maitraṃ śatṛ vināśanaṃ | mitralābhaḥ śatruhāniḥ kamatirbaṃdhu nāśanaṃ || maraṇaṃ vaṃśavṛddhiśca nirāharaḥ kulakṣayaḥ | tejaścasutanāśaśca kulahīni stithi kramāt|| gargaḥ - subhagācaiva duśśīlā vaṃdhyā putra saminvitā | dharmayuktā vrataghnīca parasantānamodinīḥ || suputrācaiva duṣputrā pitṛdeśmaratāsadā | dīnā prajāpatīcaiva putrāḍhyā citrakāriṇi || sādhvī pati priyā nityaṃ suputrā kaṣṭacāriṇī | svakarma niratāhaṃsrā puṇya putrādi saṃyutā || nityaṃ dhanacayūsaktā putradhānya samanvitā | mūrkhāvajñā puṇyavatī dasrādyṛkṣa kramātphalaṃ || nāradaḥ - kulīra vṛṣa cāpāṃtya nṛyukkanyātulāghaṭāḥ | rāśayaśśubhadā jñeyā nārīṇāṃ pradhamārtave || gargaḥ - śubhagā śvetavastyā ddṛḍhavastrā pativratā | kṣauma vastrākṣitīśānyā nnavavastrā śukhīnvitā || durbhagā jīrṇa vastrāsyā drogiṇī raktavāsasā || nīlāṃbara dharānārī puṣpitā vidhavātataḥ | vastresyu rviṣamā rakta biṃdavaḥ putrasūpnuyāt || sasūścetkankāceti phalaṃ syātrpadha mārtave | srī saṃgavarjanamāha vasiṣṭhaḥ - prabhūtadoṣeyadi dṛśyate tatpuṣpaṃ tadāśāṃtika karmakāryaṃ | visarjaye devatayaika śayyāṃ yāvadrajodarśana muktamehniḥ || jyotirnabaṃde vasiṣṭhaḥ - ādyartau pauṣaśukrorjamadu śicinabhasya śśubhāḥ pāpavārā | riktāparvāṣṭa ṣaṣṭyaḥ paragṛhakupade rātri saṃdhyā'parāhaḥ || miśro grāmūlatīkṣṇāvivaramu naruṇolpādhikā sraṃgarāṣṭo | ttātā pāpasyalagnaṃ nasadaruṇajarannīla citrāṃparaṃ ca || ādyarau darbhagānārī viṣkaṃbhece drajasvalā || vaṃdyā caivātigaṃḍeca śūle śūlavatī bhavet | gaṃḍeṣu puṃścalīnārī vyāghāte cātmaghātinī || vajreca svairiṇīproktā pāteca patināśinī | parighe mṛtavaṃdhyāca vaidhṛtau patimāriṇī || śeṣaiśśubhāvahā yogā pārijāte śaunakaḥ - sārtavānāntu nārīṇāṃ śāṃtiṃ vakṣyāmi śaunakaḥ | paṃcamehni caturthevā grahātidhya purassaraṃ || droṇa pramāṇadhānyena vrīhirāśitrayaṃ yataḥ | kuṃbhatrayaṃnyasedrāśau tantuvastrādi veṣṭitaṃ | pūrayetīrthasalinaiḥ pratikuṃbhaṃ pṛthak pṛthak || sūktenātha navarcena prasuva āpa ityatha | ṛcāyā pravatastadvā dgāyatryāca tataḥ kramāt || madhyakuṃbhe kṣipeddhānya mauṣadhānica hemaca | uduṃbaraṃ kuśān dūrvān rājīva vaṭabilvākāṃ || viṣṇuṃkrāṃtāṃca tulasīṃ barhiṣaṃ śaṃkhapuṣpiṇīṃ | śatāṃvaryaśva gaṃdhāṃca nirguṃḍīṃ sarṣapadvayaṃ | apāmārgaṃ palāśaṃca panasaṃjīvakaṃ tathā || priyaṃga vaṃca godhūmān vrīhī naśvatthamevaca | kṣīraṃ dadhica sarpiśca padmapatraṃ tathotpalaṃ || kuraṃṭakatrayaṃ guṃjāvacā bhadraka mustakān | dvātriṃśa dauṣadhānīha yathā saṃbhava māharet || mṛttikāścauṣadhānīha tanmatreṇa kṣipetkramāt | kuṃbhoparinyasetpātraṃ kāṃsya mṛdveṇu tāmrajaṃ || bhūvaneśvarīṃ nyasettatra iṃdrāṇīṃca puraṃdaraṃ || ācāryāḥ pūjayedvānyo gāyatryā maṃtrasārayā || iṃdrāṇīṃ pūjayoddhevī miṃdrāṇī māsunāriṣu || iṃdratvā vṛṣabhaṃ tviṃdraṃ upacāraiḥ prapūjayet | madhyetu saṃspṛśetkuṃbhaṃ maṃtreṇa bhuveśvarīṃ || japedgāyatrāmā homācchrīsūktāṃ japettataḥ | spṛśyanvau dakṣiṇaṃ kuṃbhaṃ mṛtvigovo japettathā || catvāri rudrasūktāni caturmaṃtro ttarāṇica | saṃspṛśannuttaraṃ kuṃbhaṃ śrīrudraṃ rudra saṃkhyayā || śanna iṃdrāgni sūktaṃca tatravai saṃspṛśan japat | kuṃbhanya paścimedeśe śānti homaṃ samācaret || dūrvābhisti lagodhūmaiḥ pāyasena ghṛtenaca | tinṛbhiścai vadūrvābhirekai kācāhutirbhavet || aṣṭottara sahasraṃvā śata maṣṭottaraṃ tuvā | gāyatryevatu hotavyaṃ haviratra catuṣṭayaṃ || tataḥ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ hutvā samudrā dūrmi sūktataḥ | saṃtatā mājya dārāṃtāṃ pūrṇamāhuti mācaret || athābhiṣekaṃ kurvīta pratikuṃbha sthitodakaiḥ | āpohiṣṭheti navabhiḥ sūktenaca tataḥ paraṃ || iṃdro aṃgatṛcainaiva pāvamānaiḥ krameṇatu | ubhayaṃ śṛṇavaccannaḥ svastidāviśa ekayā || tryaiyaṃbakena maṃtreṇa jācavedasa ekayā | samudra jyeṣṭhā ityādi trāyaṃtyāca tribhiḥ kramāt || imā āpaḥ tṛcenaiva devasyatveti maṃtrataḥ | maṃtreṇādhata mīśānaṃ tvamagne rudra ityadhaḥ || tamuṣṭuhīti maṃtreṇa bhuvanapya pitaretadhā | yāte rudreti maṃtreṇa śiva nakalpamaṃtrataḥ || iṃdratvā vṛṣabaṃ paṃca maṃtraiścai vābhiṣeṭayet | dhenuṃ payasvinīṃ dadyā dācāryāyaca bhūṣaṇaiḥ || nadakṣiṇa manaḍvāhaṃ pradadmā drudrajāpine | mahāśāṃtiṃ prajasyātha brāhmaṇān bhojayettataḥ || ādhāsma tpitṛkṛta prayogaḥ - kartā mamapatnyāḥ pradama rajo darśane duṣcamāsādi sūcita sarvāriṣṭa sāṃthyarthaṃ sagraha makhāṃ rajo darśna śāṃtiṃ kariṣye iti saṃkalpya gaṇeśapūjā puṇyāvāhacana mātṛkāpūjana nāṃdī śrāddāni kṛtvācārya mṛtvijaśca vṛṇuyāt | ācārya aiśānamadhye dakṣiṇottarayośca mahidyauriti bhūmiṃ spṛṣṭvauṣadhayaḥ samiti droṇa pramāṇa vrīhirāśitraye ākalaśeṣviti kuṃbhatrayaṃ maṃtrāvṛtyā saṃsthāpya prasuva āpaiti navānāṃ pratimedhānadyo jagatī | yāḥ prato vasiṣṭho nadyaḥ śakvarī | ābhyāṃjalenā pūrvā gaṃdhadvārāmiti gaṃdhaṃ yā oṣadhīriti sarvauṣadhīḥ oṣadayassamiti yavāṃśca triṣukṣiptvā - auduṃbhara kuśa dūrvārakatotpala caṃpaka bilva vuṣṇukrāṃtā tulasī barhiṣa śśaḥkha puṣpi śatāvaryaśva gaṃdhā nirguṃḍī raktapīta narṣasā mārga palāśa panasa baṃdhūka priyaṃgu dodhūma vrīhyaśvaddha dadhi dugdha ghṛta padmapatra nīlotpalasita raktapīta kuraṃṭaka guṃjāvacā bhadra mustakākhyāni dvāśriṃca dauṣadhāvi yadhā saṃbhavaṃ vākṣipet || tatastriṣu kalaśeṣu kāṃḍātkāṃḍāditi dūravā aśvaddheva iti paṃcapallavān‌syoneti sapta mṛdaḥ yāḥ palinīriti phalaṃ | sahi ratnānīti paṃcaratnāni hiramyarūpa iti vastreṇā veṣṭyā pūrṇā darvīti yavādi pūrṇaṃ pūrṇa pātrāṇi savastrāṇi nidhāya || tatrāṣṭa dālāni kṛtvā madhye gāyatryā bhavaneśvarī māvāhya || dakṣiṇa kuṃbhe iṃdrāṇīṃ vṛṣākapiriṃdrāṇī pajtki ritīṃdrāṇī māvāhya | uttara kuṃbhe iṃdratvā viśvāmitra iṃdro gāyatrī || itīṃdra māvāhya | tattanmaṃtraiḥ ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ pūjayat | tato madhya kuṃbhaṃ spṛṣṭvā gāyatra maṣṭa sahasraṃ aṣca daściklīta iṃdirā sūtā ṛṣayaḥ - śrīrdevatā ādyāstrisro suṣṭubhaḥ ekā prastāra pajtkirdve triṣṭubhoṃtyā prastāra pajtkiḥ jape viniyogaḥ || tata ekaṛtvik dakṣiṇakuṃbhe - kudrudrāyeti navānāmaghoraḥ kaṇvorudro gāyatrī | imārudrā ityekādaśānāṃ kutso rudro jagatyoṃtye triṣṭubhau || ātepitarīti paṃcadaśānāṃ gṛtsna madorudra striṣṭup | imā rudrāya sthiradhanvine iti catasṛṇāṃ rudratriṣṭup | treyaṃbakaṃ vasiṣṭo rudhrodaśānāṃ vasiṣṭho viśvedevāstriṣṭup || iti japet - adāgniṃ pratiṣṭhāpyaiśānāṃ gṛhan rudromāskaṃda viṣṇu brahmeṃdra yama kāla citraguptā nadhidevatān agnirāpo bhūmirviṣṇuriṃdredrāṇī prajāpati ssarva brahmaṇaḥ pratyadhidevatān vināyakārdi paṃca lokapālakāṃścāvāhya saṃpūjyeśānyāṃ kuṃbe varuṇaṃ saṃpūjyanvā dadhyāt | cakṣuṣvaṃte navagrahān amukasaṃkhyābhi ssamiccavān jyāhutibhiḥ samittilājyairvādi devādīn ekaika yāhutvā bhuvaneśvarīṃ pratyekaṃ durvā tilamiśra godhūma pāyasājyāvā maṣṭottara sathāṣṭhāviṃśatyanyata rāhutibhi riṃdāṇī miṃdraṃca pratyeka muktadravyai raṣṭāviṃśa tyaṣṭānyata rāhutibhiḥ śeṣema sviṣṭakṛta mityādi ukta devebhyo muṣmaitvena manasā tūṣṇīṃ nirūpya kṣīre caruṃkṛtyāj bhāgāṃte yajamānena tyāgekṛte uk saṃkhyayā homaḥ | tatra tisṛbhirdūrvābhiḥ dadhi madvā jyāktābhi rekāhutiḥ || evaṃ samidhobhyaktāḥ - tataḥ - sviṣṭakṛdādi prāyaścitta homāṃte dikpālakebhyo navagrahebhyo bhunaneśvarīṃdrāṇīṃdrebhyaśca sadīpamāṣa bhaktabalīnā datvā samudrā dūrmirititṛcasya vāmadevogni striṣṭup | iita pūrṇāhutiṃ hutvā praṇitā vimokādi karmaśeṣaṃ samāpya vadhūvarau vadhūṃ vābhiṣiṃcet | āpohiṣṭheti navabhiḥ - yaeka idvidayate gautama iṃdrastriṣṭup | tribhiṣvaṃ deveti saptānāṃ vasiṣṭhastrayāṇāṃ agnistato viśvedevā ādyā gāyatrī tatonuṣṭup || tisro gāyatryoṃ tyenuṣṭhubhau | samudra jyeṣṭhā iti catasṛṇāṃ vasiṣṭhaāpa striṣṭupe || devasyatve tyāpastaṃha śākhīya tribhiḥ - tamīśānaṃ gotama īśāno jagatī || tvamagne rudrasta muṣṭītyaṃgirasastiraścā rudra striṣṭup || yajjāgatra iti ṣaṇṇāṃ prajāpati manustriṣṭup || iṃdratvā vṛṣabhaṃ paṃcānāṃ viśvāmitra iṃdro gāyatrī - tatassurā nvaitayādyai rabhiṣiktogniṃ saṃpūjyā cāryāya dhenuṃ rudrajāpine anaḍvāhaṃ sadakṣiṇa manyebhyaśya dakṣiṇāṃcadatvā | devatānāmuktarapūjāṃ kṛtvā | visṛjyācāryahaste datvāgniṃ saṃpūjya gaccagacceti visṛjya mahāśāṃtiṃ paṭhitvā viprān saṃbhojyasvayaṃ bhuṃjīta || iti kamalākarabhaṭṭa kṛte śāṃtiratne rajodarśna śāṃtiḥ || madanaratne ṛṣiputra saṃhītāyā tvanyadhoktaṃ | pradhamārtava doṣāṇāṃ śāṃtiṃ kuryā danaṃtaraṃ || tithi nakṣatra vārādi devānāṃ pūjanaṃ pṛthak staṃḍilaṃkārayettatra caturāḍhaka śālibhiḥ - āḍhaṃkaṃ taṇḍulāṃścaiva āḍhakau tilayāvakau | āḍhakaḥ kuḍavaḥprastha āḍhakodroṇa evaca | dhānyamāneṣu boddavyāḥ kramaśoti caturgāṇā ityuktaḥ uparyu parasaṃ stīrṇaṃ tanmadhye nalinaṃ libet || darbhairājacchādya tanmadhye karṇakāyāṃ nyasedghaṭaṃ | puṇyodevyaika patrāca viṣṇukrāṃtā satradrikā || bilvapatraṃ siṃhitāni cūrṇa yitvānyaset ghaṭe | kuṣṭhaṃ māṃsī haridre dvemurāśaileya caṃdanaṃ || vacākacchoramustākhyā ssarvauṣadhyo daśasmṛtāḥ | gajāśca radhyā valmīka saṃgramāhrada gokulān | rājadvāra pradeśācca mṛdamānī nikṣipet || paṃcagavyaṃca kuṃmudaṃ tathā muktāphalānica|| vaja vaiḍhuryā māṇikya vidrūmāni vinikṣipet | evaṃ kuṃbhaṃ samāsādya arcegganthādhibhiśśubhaiḥ || sāvitrīṃ ca japetkuṃbhaṃ spṛśanda śataṃ dvijaḥ | evaṃ pradoṣakāletu etaistau snāpaye ttataḥ | svagṛhyoktavidhānena homaṃ kuryā tprayatnataḥ || dūrvājyena tilairhutvā gātryācaiva maṃtrataḥ | aṣṭottarasahasraṃvā śatamāṣṭādika tathā || tatsaṃkhyāyā tridhāhutvā dūrvājyena tilaissamaṃ | brāhmaṇān bhojayitvātu devaṃ saṃpūjyayettataḥ || evaṃ samāsataḥproktaṃ nārīṇāṃ prathamārtava iti || tatraiva nāradaḥ - tatraśāṃtiṃ prakurvīta ghṛtadūravā tilākṣataiḥ | pratyekāṣṭaśataṃcaiva gāyatryā juhuyāttataḥ | svarṇabhūgo tilān dadyātsarvadoṣānupattaye | iti śiṣṭhaiśca prayoga pārijādyaiśca śaunake nāpyādṛtā || iti kamalākarabhaṭṭa kṛtau rajodarśana śāṃtiḥ | a tha nā ga ba liḥ śaunakaḥ - athavakṣyāmi sarpasya saṃskāra vidhimuttam | sinī vālyāṃ paurṇa māsyāṃ paṃcamyāṃvāpi kārayet || kṛta sarpa vadho vipraḥ pūrvajanma nivāyadi | vadhaṃ prakhyāpaye tpāpī caretkṛchraṃ ścaturdaśa | viprāya lohadaṇṭaṃca tanmūlyaṃvāpi dāpayet || yājñavalkopyāha uraga hatyā māyasodeya iti | mūlyamāha - niṣkatrayaṃ dviniṣkaṃvā niṣkaye kaṃkanīyasaṃ || anumatyādi kartṛṇāṃ niṣka mardaṃta darthakaṃ || idaṃ svarṇa raupyayoḥ sakhyā jñeyaṃ | tadā - priyaṃgū vrīhi godhuma tila piṣṭhenavā punaḥ || kṛtvā sarpākṛtiṃ śūppe nidhāya prārthaye dahiṃ | ehi pūrvaṃ sarpa mṛtaḥ asmin piṣṭhe samāviśa | saṃskārārda mahaṃ bhakyā prārdhayāmi samāsataḥ || vastropanīta gaṃdhādyaiḥ saṃpūjyaca haredbahiḥ | kuryātsaṃskāraṃ saṃkalpaṃ prāṇāyāma purassaraṃ | yajñopavītinā kāryaṃ sarpa saṃskāra karmaṇi || laukikāgni pratiṣṭhāpya samidā saṃprokṣya vāribhiḥ || citiṃ kṛtvā dhanaṃ stīrya kuśairāgne kāgrakaiḥ | paryukṣāgniṃ paristīrya pariṣicya samarcayet || kṛtve dhmāthāna māghārau cakṣuṣīca yadhāvidhi || sarpaṃ gṛhītvā yatnena citimāropa yotsudhīḥ | sṛveṇa juhuyādadājya magnauvyāhṛti bhistṛbhiḥ || sarpāsye jabuyādājyaṃ vyāhṛtyāca samagrayā | ājya śeṣaṃ sruveṇaiva sarvadehe niṣecayet || camasasthairjalai ssarpaṃ vyāhṛtyā bhyukṣyapāṇinā | agne rakṣāṇa ityanayā sarpā yāgniṃ pradāpayet | jñānato jñānatovāpi kṛta ssarpa vadhomayā || pūrvajanma nivāsarpa tatsarvaṃ kṣaṃtu marhasi | kṣīrājyena tataścigniṃ prokṣyavyāhṛti bhirjalaiḥ || nāsthi caryādi kaṃkāryaṃ triradrā śaucamiṣyate || brahma caryādi kaṃkāryaṃ trirātrā śaucamiṣyate | sacelaṃtu caturthehni snātvā viprān sarmacayet || sarponasantastathā śeṣaḥ kapilo nāga evaca| kālikaḥ śaṃkha pālaśca bhūtha ralceti nāmabhiḥ | gaṃdha puṣpākṣatai rdūpai rdīpādyai rarcaye dvijān | ghṛta pāyasa bhakṣyaiśca dvijā naṣṭautu bhojayet || evaṃ kṛte vidhānena sarpa saṃskāra karmaṇiḥ | sarpahiṃsā kṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || || iti nāgabaliḥ || tatra mārkaṇḍeyaḥ - lālavaidhavyayogetu kuṃbhedu pratimādibhiḥ | kṛtvā śāntiṃ tataḥ paścātkanyo dvāhyeticāpare || tatra punarbhūtvā bhāvaukto vithānakhaṃḍe | svarṇāṃbu pippalānāṃtu pratimāṃ viṣṇurūpiṇīṃ || tayāsaha vivāhetu panarbhūtaṃ najāyate || sūryāruṇa saṃvāde - vivāhātpūrva kāleca caṃdra tārā balānvite || vivāhoktena maṃtreṇa kuṃbhena sahavodvahet | sūtreṇāveṣṭayotpaścā ddaśataṃtu vidhānataḥ || kuṃkumālaṃkṛtaṃ dehaṃ tayo rekātamaṃdare | tataḥ kuṃbhaṃca nissārya prabhajya salilāśaye | tatobhiṣecanaṃ kuryā tpaṃcapalla vavāribhiḥ || kuṃbhaprārdhanā tatraiva - varuṇāṃga svarūpāya jīvanānāṃ samāśraya | patiṃ jivayakanyāyāściraṃ putrasukhaṃ kuru || dehi viṣṇovaraṃdeva kanyāṃpālaya duḥkhataḥ | tato lajkāravastrāḍyāṃ varāya pratipādayet || mūrtidānamapi tatraivoktaṃ - brāhmaṇaṃ sādumāmaṃtrya saṃpūjya vividhārhaṇaiḥ | tasmai dadyādidhānena viṣṇommūrtiṃ caturbhujāṃ || śuddhavarṇa suvarṇena vittaśaktyāthavā punaḥ | nirmitāṃ rucirāṃ śaṃkha gadā cakrāñka saṃyūtāṃ || dadhānāṃ vāsasīpīte kumudotpala mālinīṃ | dadakṣiṇāṃ ca tāṃ dadyā nmaṃtrameva mudīrayan || yanmayāprācijanuṣi hatyāpatyu ssamāgataṃ | viṣopaviṣaśastrādyairhatovāti viraktayā | prāpyamānaṃ mahāghoraṃ yaśaṛ saukhya dhanāpahaṃ || vaidhavyādatiduḥkhaugha nāśāya sukhalabdhaye | bahusaubhāgyasiddhyarthaṃ mahāviṣṇorimāṃ tanuṃ || sauvarṇanirmītāṃ śaktyā tubhyaṃ saṃpradadedvija | anaghādyāhamasmīti trivāraṃ prajapediti || tato vaivāhikaṃ kuryā dvidhiṃ dātāmṛgīdṛśaḥ || ityādi nirṇasiṃdhau jñaiyaṃ || iti vaidhavyayoga śāṃtiḥ || atha arka vivāhaḥ atha tṛtīya mānuṣī vivāha niṣedhāttadartha markavivāha ucyate || proyaga pārijāte mātsye | udvahedrati sidhyarthaṃ tṛtīyāṃ nakadācana || mohādajñānatovāpi yadi gacchettu mānūṣīṃ | naśyatye vana saṃdeho gargasya pacanaṃ yadā || saṃgrahe - caturdhādhi vivāhārdaṃ tṛtīyorkaṃ samudvahet | āditya divasevāpi hastarkṣevā śanaiścare || śubhedineca pūrvāhṇe kuryādarka vivāhakaṃ || brāhme - grāmātrpācyā mudīcyā vāsa puṣpaphala saṃyutaṃ || kṛtvārkaṃ puratastiṣṭhan prārthayettu dvijottamaḥ | trolokavāsin saptāśva chāyayā sahito rave | tṛtīyo dvāha jaṃdoṣaṃ nivāraya sukhaṃ kuru | tatrādhyoropya deveśaṃ cāyayā sahitaṃ raviṃ || vastrairmālyai stathā gaṃdhai stanmaṃtreṇaiva pūjayet | caturda divasātīte pūrvavṛttāṃ prapūjyaca | visṛjya homamagniṃca udvahenmānuṣīṃ parāṃ || vyasaḥ - supuṣpa phalaśākaika marka gulmaṃ samāśrayet | arka kanyā prathānārtha mācāryaṃ kalpayetpūrā || arka sannidi māgatya tatra svastyā tatra svastyā divācayet | nāṃdī śrāddhāṃ suvarṇena aṣcavargā nrpapūjayet | pūjayenmadhu parkeṇa varaṃ viprapya hastataḥ | yatropavīta karāyoyaṃ mayāsṛṣṭā purātanī || arkāṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kurvān japenmākaṃ prati rakṣatu | punaḥ pradakṣiṇī kuryānmaṃtreṇānena maṃtravit || arkajā brahmaṇā sṛṣṭā asmākaṃ prati rakṣatu | punaḥ pradakṣiṇī kuryānmaṃ treṇānena maṃtravit | namaste maṃgaledevi namaḥ saviturātmaje | trāhimāṃ kṛsayādevi patnītvame ihāgatā || arkatvaṃ brahmaṇā sṛṣṭaḥ sarvaprāṇi hitāyaca | vṛkṣāṇāmādi bhūtastvaṃ devānāṃ prīti vardhanaḥ || tṛtīyo dvāhajaṃ doṣaṃ mṛtyuṃcāśu vināśaya | tataśca kanyāvaraṇaṃ tripūruṣaṃ kulamuccharet || mūhurtairkaṃ nirakṣyeta svastisūkta mudīran || arka kanyāmimāṃ vipra yadhāśakti vibhūṣitāṃ | gotrāya śarmaṇe tubhyaṃ dattāṃ vipra samāśraya || aṃjalyakṣata pūrvāṇi kṛtvā kaṃkaṇa pūrvakaṃ | yāvatpaṃcāvṛtaṃ sūtraṃ tāvadarkaṃ praveṣṭayet || svaśākhoktena maṃtreṇa gāyatrī madhavājapet | paṃcavīkṛtya punaḥ sūtraṃ skaṃdhe badhnāti maṃtrataḥ || arkasya purataḥ paścāddakṣiṇottara tastathā | kuṃbhāṃśca nikṣipetpaścā dāgneyādi catuṣṭaye || prati kuṃbhaṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ saṃpūjya parameśvaraṃ | punaḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtyā maṃtrameta mudīrayet || mayākṛta midaṃ karmasthāvareṣu jarāyuṇā | arkā patyāninodehi tatsarvaṃ kṣaṃtu marhasi || ityuktvā śāṃti sūktāni japtvātāṃ visṛjetpunaḥ | goyugmaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādaṃte puṇyāha mācaret || śaunakaḥ - tṛtīye strī vivāhetu saṃprāpte puruṣasyatu | nāṃdī śrāddhaṃ prakurvīta sthaṃḍilaṃca prakalsayet | arkamabhyarcya sauryāca gaṃdha puṣpākṣatādibhiḥ || sauryā sūryadevatayā ṛcā akṛṣṇeneti || arkasyottara deśetu samanvārajdha etayā | ullekhanādi kaṃkūryā dāghārāṃtamataḥ paraṃ || ājyāhutiṃcajuhu yātsaṃgobhi ranayaikayā | yasmaitvā kāmakāmāye tyetayarcā tataḥ paraṃ || vyastābhiśca samastābhiḥ tataśca sviṣṭakṛdbhavet || pariṣecana paryaṃta mayāścetyādakaṃ kramāt | atra prayogotkṛte nirṇaya sindhaujñeyaḥ || iti rāmakṛṣṇa bhaṭṭātmaja kamālākarabhaṭṭaka te śāṃtiratne'rka vivāhaḥ | ru dra snā na pra yo gaḥ athāsmatpikṛto rudrasnāna prayogo likhyate - udagayanādau guruśukrāstādi rarite śuddhemāsi śukla pakṣe ṛtau viśeṣeṇa caturdehni aṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃvā ravivāsarevā śubhanakṣatre caṃdra tārābalādyanukūlye tatkartavyaṃ || idaṃ ca caturvidha vaṃdyatve viśeṣato mṛtāpatyatve bhavati || etasmahānadyorna dorvāśoṣyasaṃgame saṃgamamātrevā kāryaṃ | udaṃca udagayanānaṃbhave sarvamāseṣu dakṣiṇāyaneca kāryaṃ || sarveṣvapihimāneṣu brāhmaṇānumateṣu ca | tasmādavaśyaṃ kartavyaṃ putra strī sukhamicchatā || iti hemādrau bhaviṣyottaroktaiḥ - tatra pūrvaṃ kartā sabhāryodīrghāyāḥ suputrādyutpatti pratibaṃdhaka | duritanirāsārthaṃ yadhāśakti prayaścitta manutāpayuktaḥ kuryāt || taccaphalaṃ tāratamyāvagata durita tāratamyena | ṣaḍbdatryābdasārdābda rūpaṃ cāṃdrāyama kṛcchrāti kṛcrarūpaṃvā | japa homa tīrthayātrā brāhmaṇa bhojanādi | pratnāmnāyauḥ kāryaṃ sabhyopadiṣṭaṃ || tataḥ śrī rudraprītyarthaṃ kṛṣṇāmekāṃ dhenuṃ | śaktyopaskārasaṃyutāṃ dadyāt || tatrāśakto lakṣatadarthaṃ ayutaṃvā | gāyatrī japaṃ taddaśāṃśena tilahomaṃca karyāt | evaṃ kṛte rudrasnānādikārī bhavati || tataḥ prāgukaikāle deśeca sabhāryāḥ kṛtasnānaḥ | śaddhaśsudhevāsasī paridhā āsanopaviṣṭa ācāṃtaḥ | bhūmi śuddhipūrvakaṃ prāṇānāyamya deśakālau smṛtvā || mama sabhāryasya dīrghāyuḥ putrādi santati pratibaṃdhakena | ihājanma nyanyajanma nivākṛte nāṣṭakāparvādi paitṛka namittā | kāraṇenavā paradveṣeṇavā anyenavā mṛgaśāba trakṣaṇenavā || bālaghūtenavā patnāpahareṇanavā | vatsa viyojanenavā pitṛ mātṛ dveṣeṇavā || anyena vākarmāṇotpanna caturvidha vaṃdhyatvānyataravaṃdhyātvadoṣa nirāsadvārā tathā strīyāḥ kukṣidoṣa jñātājñātarajo duṣṭastrī celāṃcala sparśadoṣa tadekāśana śayana śacyādidoṣa janitadoṣādi sarvasaṃtati pratibaṃdha nirāsadvārā umāsahita śrīrudrapītyarthaṃ dīrghāmuṣya suputrādi saṃtatyavāptarthaṃ bhodāyanokta vidinā rudrakalaśasnānakarma kariṣye iti saṃkalpya gaṇeśa pūjana puṇyāhavācana mātṛkā pūjana nāṃdīśrāddhānica saṃkalpa pūrvakaṃ pūjana puṇyāhavācana mātṛkā pūjana nāṃdīśrāddhānica saṃkalpapūrvakaṃ kuryāt |tānikṛtvā pradhāna saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt || tata ācārya brahma ṛtvigvaraṇaṃ kariṣye | iti sakalpya varumaṃ kartuṃ brāhmaṇān prarthayet || brāhmaṇāssaṃtumeśāṃtāḥ pāpātmāṃtu samāhitāḥ | devānāṃcaiva dātārastrātāraḥ sarvadehināṃ || japtairyajñe stadhāhomairdānaiśca vividhaiḥ punaḥ | devānāṃ ca pitrūṇāṃ ca tṛpyarthaṃ yājakāsmṛtāḥ || yoṣāṃ dehesthitāvedāḥ pāvayaṃti jagatrayaṃ | temāṃ rakṣantasatataṃ japayajñeryavasthitāḥ || tataḥ - āgitāgniṃ dvijaṃ śāntaṃ darmajñaṃ satyavādinaṃ | snānārthaṃ prārthayeddevaṃ nipuṇaṃ rudrakarmaṇi || iti lakṣaṇayuta mācāryaṃ vṛṇuyāt | tato brāhmama mṛtvijaścaikādaśa vṛṇuyāt || tataḥ sarvāsmaduparka vastrālaṃkārādibhiḥ pūjaye dyadāśakti | tataḥ ācārrādi sahito ṣaṇṭapaṃ praviśet || tataḥ rartvigācāryaḥ saṃkalpapūrvakaṃ salakṣaṇe maṇṭape | īśānyāṃ sarvatobhadra liṃgatobhadhra maṣṭadaṃlaṃvā pratyekaṃ kṛtvā || tatsamīpe paritaḥ saptadhānyāni maṇḍalārthaṃ | nidhāya śrityasarvadāsthānaṃtyaktvātu tatsarvaṃ yatrasthaṃ tatragacchatu || apakramāntu bhūtāni piśācāḥ sarvatodiśaṃ | sarveṣā mavirodhena brahmakarma samārabhe iti ca narṣapānvikīrya pañcagavyena śucīvo havyetṛcābhyukṣya maṃṭapapūjāṃ vidhāyāsane upaviśya bhūtaśudhyādika mātmā rakṣāṃ ca kṛtvā śrī rudraṃdhyātvā ārādhito manuṣyaistvaṃ siddairdevā surādibhiḥ || ārādhayāmi bhaktyātvāṃmāṃ grahāṇa maheśvareti prārthayet || tataḥ - pratyekamiṃdradi dikpālān praṇavādi namoṃtaistattannāmamantrairnatvā mahīṃdyau riti bhūmiṃspṛṣṭvā oṣadhayassa miti yavān | yā oṣadhīriti sarvauṣadhīḥ kāṇḍātkāṃḍāditi dūrvāḥyāḥ phalinīriti phalaṃsyonā pṛthivīti saptamadaḥ || aśvaddeva itivañcapallavān sahiratnānīti paṃcaratnānihiraṇyarūpamiti hiraṇyaṃkṣiptā - yuvaṃ vastrāṇīti vastrpeṇi raktasūtreṇa veṣṭayitvā pūrṇādarvīti vaṃśapātrāṇi nidhāya|| kalaśasya mukheviṣṇu rityādinā kalaśeṣu devatīrthā nāvāhya | devadānava saṃvāde ityādi kalaśeṣu devatirthā nāvāhya | devadānava saṃvāde ityādinā kalaśaṃ | saṃprārthyā tryaṃbakamiti rudra māvāhayet || tatassamudrā dūrmiriti samudra māvāhayet || kalaśamūle brahmajijñāna miti brahmaṇaṃ | madhye idaṃ viṣṇuriti viṣṇuṃ | kaṃṭhe namaśśaṃbhaveceti rudraṃ mukhe indrāgnī āgata | mitīṃdrāgnī yamena dattamiti yamaṃca sarvata| iṣetveti devān āditpratnasyeti sūryaṃ || viśvata ścakṣuriti parameṣṭinaṃ | pārśvayornamo astu sarpebhya iti sarpān || pūrve agnimīle ityṛgvedaṃ| dakṣiṇe iṣetveti yajurvedaṃ || paścime agni āyāhīti sāmavedaṃ | uttare śnodevī rityatharvavedaṃ || madhye tatsavituriti gāyatrīnyaset | pūrvā dyaṣṭadikṣu tattanmaṃtrai | rnāmabhivān iṃdrā dīnaṣṭaunyasya || kāṃḍātkāṇḍāditi dūrvāḥ - śirasi nikṣipet - tato vaṃśapātre ṣvaṣṭadalayutāni vastrāṇi saṃsthāpya | tatra niṣkatadardha suvarṇanirmitāṃ aśaktauvallāvara| suvarṇa nirmitāṃśīrudrapratimāṃ vañcāmṛtābhiṣeka pūrvākaṃ saṃsthāpya || tāsvātvāvahantvati umāsahita rudra māvāhayet | evamāvāhya sadyojātaṃ prapadyāmītyāsanaṃ | sadyojātāyavai nama iti pādyaṃ | bhave bhavenāti bhave bhavasvamāmityarghyaṃ || bhavodbhavāya nama ityācamanīya | vāmadevāya nama ityācamanīya| vāmadevāya sama iti āpohiṣṭhādyaiśca snānaṃ | datvācamanaṃ ca datvāṣṭabhistarpayet || bhavaṃ devaṃ tarpayāmi | śarvaṃ devaṃ tarpayāmi | īśānaṃ devaṃ tarpayāmi | vaśupatiṃ devaṃ tarpayāmi | rudraṃ devaṃ tarpayāmi | ughraṃ devaṃ tarpayāmi | bhīmaṃ devaṃ tarpayāmi | mahantaṃ devaṃ tarpayāmi | vāmadevāya nama iti snānaṃ tato | jyeṣṭhāya nama iti vastraṃ || tūṣṇī mācamanaṃ - śreṣṭhāya nama ityupavītaṃ | rudrāya nama ityalaṃkāraṃ | kālāya nama iti gaṃdhaṃ | kalavikaraṇāya nama iti puṣpaṃ | bala vikaraṇā nama iti dhūpaṃ | balāya nama itinaivedyaṃ | tūṣṇī mācamanaṃ | balapramadhanāya nama iti tāṃbūlaṃ | sarvabhūta damanāya nama iti nīrājanaṃ | manonmanāya nama iti dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt || tatpuruṣāyeti namaskāraṃ atāṣṭau puṣpāṃjalīn dadyāt || oṃ bhavāya devāya naṃmaḥ | oṃ śarvāya devāya namaḥ | oṃ īśānāya gevāya namaḥ | oṃ paśupataye devāya namaḥ | oṃ rudraya devāya namaḥ | oṃ ugrāya devāya namaḥ | oṃ bhīmāya devāya namaḥ | oṃ mahate devāya namaḥ || athāsyā ghoratanū raghorebhya ityupatiṣṭhet || tato namaskāraḥ - viśveśvara vipūrākṣa viśvarūpa sadāśiva | śaraṇaṃ bhavabhūteśa karuṇākara śaṃkara || hara śaṃbho mahādeva viśveśāmaravallabha | śiva śaṃkara sarvātma nnīlakaṃṭha namostute || mṛtyuṃjayāya rudrāya nīlakaṃṭhāya śaṃbhave | amṛteśāya śarvāyamahādevāyate namaḥ iti || tataḥ prārthanā - rājasena svayaṃbrahma sātvikena svayaṃ hariḥ || tāmasena svayaṃ rudra strīyaṃtvayi saṃsthitaṃ | namāmitvāṃ virūpākṣa nīlagrīva namostute || trinetrāya namastubhya mumādehārdhadhāriṇe | triśūladhāriṇe tubhyaṃ bhūtānāṃ pataye namaḥ || pinākine namastubhyaṃ magriyāyacate namaḥ | namāmitvāṃ mahādevā patayete namāmyahaṃ || bhoktābhojyasvameveśa bhaktānāṃ śarmadaḥ svayaṃ | sūryarūpaṃ samāsādya dehināṃ dehadārakaḥ || mūnīnāṃ muktidātāca bhaktānāṃ bhūktidaḥ svayaṃ | yadṛccayā sarvamida tvāmaryeti cayātica | nānyasya vijayaṃdātuṃ śaktirastitvayāviti|| tataḥ - ārādhitomaniṣyaistaṃsviddhairdevāsurādibhiḥ || ārādhayāmi bhaktyātyāṃ māṃ gṛhāṇa | mahāśvaretyātmānaṃ nivedayet | tataḥ pūrvā dyaṣṭakamaladaleṣu iṃdrādyaṣṭadikpālakān | saṃpūjyānnādi balimupahṛtya prārthayet | iṃdrādyāśca surāsvarve lokapālā stadhaivaca|| ādityā vasavodevā viśvedevā marudgaṇāḥ | tesarvepūjitāḥ śāntiṃprayacchantu yadhepsitamiti || tatassarve prāṇānāyamya deśakālau smṛtvā | yajamāna syāyuṣma tputrādi | santatyavāpyardaṃ rudraikādaśinī japa nañkalpa sādhāraṇa | nyāsānte viśeṣanyāsān kariṣyāma iti saṃkaspya || sadyojāta miti paṃcabhiḥ - praṇavavyāhṛti pūrvaktaiḥ vyāhṛti praṇavāntairvyantai | ssastaihṛdayaśira śśikhā kavaca netrāstrāṇi | svasminvinyasyaiva meva kalaśeṣunyasediti | tato rājasena svayaṃbrahmeti stitipūrvakaṃ svasvakalaśān | spṛṣṭvā yajamānasya śubhaṃ dhyāyantaḥ pratyekaṃ rudraikādaśinī | japaṃ kṛtvā rājasena svayaṃbrahmeti stutvā | samāpayeyuḥ hīnovibhakati varṇaiśca vyaṃjanaiśca sarvaistathā | japo mekṣamyatāṃ deva prasādaṃ kurukiñkare | mahā rudra japoyome nyūna ścaivādikaścayaḥ || sarvaḥ saṃpūrṇatāṃ yātutva tprasādātsadāśiva || yadakṣaraṃ paritraṣṭaṃ mātrā hīnāṃca yadbhavet | tatsarvaṃ kṣamyāmāṃdeva prasīda parameśvarā iti || tataḥ ācāryaḥ kuṇḍesthiṃḍilevā svaśākhokta vidhināgniṃ pratiṣṭāpya || tūṣṭiṃ nirvāpādinācaruṃ paktvājya bhāgāntāṃ kṛtvā | samittila carvājyaiḥ pratidravyaṃ japadaśāṃśena | homaṃ kuryādṛdvigbhissaha || atra sarveṣāṃ rudraikādaśanī japarūpāṇi śatadvā triṃśacca taddaśāṃśaḥ trayodaśa rūpāṇita evāhute yāṣṭā catavāriṃśa tbakṣeṣaṭ śatāni caturviṃśatiśca śiṣṭarūpadvaye daśāṃśa āhutayodaśa camakāhutayaścaturdaśa sarvodayanyūna sārdaṣaṭ śatāni etān pratidravyaṃ homaḥ || aśaktau ṣoḍa śadhādi pakṣeṇa homaḥ kāryaḥ | tataḥ ekādaśa śatasaṃkhyāḥ arka patrairmūlamastreṇa homaḥ kāryaḥ || sarvopivā mūlamantreṇaiva homaḥ kāryaḥ || mūlamantrasya parameśvara ṛṣiḥ | rudro devatā pañtkicchaṃdaḥ || homādau viniyogaḥ - adhanyāsaḥ | parameṣṭhine ṛṣaye namaḥ śirasi | paṃkti caṃndase namaḥ mukhe | rudhro devatāyai namaḥ hṛdajaye | nama iti śikhāyāṃ | śrambava iti śirasiceti lalā ṭemaya iti netrayoḥ || iva iti śrotrayoḥ cetināsikāyāṃ | nama iti mukhe śaṃkarāyetigrīvāyāṃ || meti hṛdaye maya itijaṭhareskarāyetinābha | cetikṣoṇyaḥ sama iti kaṭyāṃ || śivāyo tyūryoḥ ceti jaṃghayoḥ śiva tarāyeti jānvoḥ | cetipādayoḥ namaśśaṃbhaveti hṛdaye mayobhave ceti śirasi || namaśśaṃkarāya ceti śikhāyāṃ || mayaskarāyaceti kavacāya huṃ | namaśśivāyacetinetratrayāya vauṣaṭ || śivatarāyacetyastrāyaphaṭ || evaṃ homaṃ kṛtvā sviṣṭa kṛdādi pūrṇāhutiṃ prāktanaṃ homa śeṣaṃ samāpyācāryādayo gaṃdhādyupacāraiḥ pūjyānte rudhrasyottara pūjāṃ kṛtvā'bhiṣekārdhaṃ rudraṃ prasādya agne ruttarata ścaturaśraṃ svastikopetaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā tatro duṃbara kāṣṭha pīṭhadvaye parivīta śuddhaśveta vastrau dampati prāñmukhā vupaveśya || svaya mudañmukhāścaturadhika saptaśata saṃjñā bhavaṃti | tenaikena maṃtreṇaikaikena ārka pratreṇa rudraikādaśinyā mūla maṃtreṇainābhiṣiṃceyuḥ || atra mādhyannina śākhāyāṃ rudrādyāya gatānāṃ catuṣaṣṭi mantrāṇāṃ ekādaśinyāca caturadhika saptaśatasaṃjñā bhavatitenaikaikena mantreṇaikaike nārka patreṇābhiṣicya patrāṇityajet || anyeṣāṃtu śākhānāṃ mūla mantraiṇaivatā vadvārāvṛtena tathaivābiṣeka itibodhāyana saṃpradāḥ || tataḥ pallavairāśuḥ śiśāna iti sūktenāpyāya sveti soma sūktena ārohiṣṭhetyutibhiḥ samudra jyeṣṭhā ityādibhiḥ sahasra śīrṣeti sūktena sūrāstvāmityādi paurāṇaiścābiṣicya śivaṃ śivamiti padeyuḥ | ihavā nāryonyānyarka patrāṇi gṛhāṇīrityeke || ṛtvija evārka patrai rekādaśinyā ācāryastu pañcapallavaiḥ sūkteribhiṣiṃcedityuktaiḥ | tataḥ sarvauṣadhībhiḥ sapta mṛdbiḥ sadyā ubhayatāla mṛdāca sarvāṃge anuliptau dampatī viśeṣataḥ kukṣideśenu liptāṃ striyaṃ siṣṭhe noddṛte sasarvakalaśodakena kṣālitāṃgau śuddodakena snāpayeyuḥ | tatastayoḥ || śarīra sthāścaye doṣāye doṣā garbabījayoḥ | tesarvenāśa māyāṃtu karmaṇānenabo dvijā iti mantra mucchāryābhiṣeka vāsasītyaktvā || śudde vāsasī paridhāya śukla candana mālādya lañkṛtau bhavetāṃ | tata ācāryo yajamānābhyā manvārabdhaḥ samudrā dūrmi rityādi maṃtraiḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ hutvā vasordārāṃ juhuyāt || tataḥ - śrāvaye tsūkta māgneyaṃ vaiṣṇaṃ raudra maiṃdavaṃ | mahāvaiśvānaraṃ sāmaṃ jyeṣṭhā sāmaṃca pāṭhayet || tato yajamānaḥ sapatnīkaḥ kṛtatrāyuṣa karaṇaḥ pūjā pūrvaka mācāryāya payasvinīṃ dhenuṃ suvarṇaṃca yadhāśakti dakṣiṇāṃca datvā || brahmaṇe vṛṣa mṛtvigbhyo yadhāśakti ḍatvākṣamāpya śrīrudrā dyāvāhita devatā nisṛjya śrīrudra prītyarthaṃ śataṃ tadarthaṃvā brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā jivatpati putriṇībhiḥ suvāsinībhiḥ kṛtā padāna gāna maṃgalo brāhmaṇā śiṣo gṛhmīyāt || anena vidhinā kārvo rudraḥ kalaśa saṃjñakaḥ | bhūktvaiva sakalān bhogān prasādāccaṃ | karasya cetyāha bhanavān bodhāyanaḥ || bhaṭṭa rāmeśvara suto bhaṭṭa nārāyaṇātmajaḥ || rāmakṛṣṇastvimāṃ cakre śrīrudrasnāna vaddatiṃ | iti śrīmannārāyaṇabhaṭṭa sūri sūnu rāmakriṣṇabhaṭṭu kṛto rudrasnāna vidhiḥ | vandyā tva nivāraṇa rudrasnāna vidhiḥ atha hemādrau bhaviṣyoktaṃ rudrasnānaṃ | yudiṣṭhira uvāca - devasenā patiṃ skaṃdaṃ rudhra putraṃ ṣaḍānanaṃ || agastyomuni śārdhūla śukhāsīna muvācaha - sarvajñohi kumāratvaṃ prasādācacaṃ karasyavai | snānaṃ rudra vidhānena striṇāṃ brūhikadhaṃ bhavet || skaṃda uvāca - mṛtavatsātu yā nārī durbhagā ṛtu varjitā || yā sūte kanyakāṃ vandhyā snāna māsāṃ vidhīyate | aṣṭamyāṃvā caturdaśyā mupavāsa parāyaṇā || ṛtau śudde caturdhehni prāpte sūrya dinethavā | sadyostu saṃgame kuryā nmahanadyo rviśeṣataḥ | śivālayethavā goṣṭhe viviktevā grahāṃ gaṇe | ahitāgniṃ dvijaṃ śāntaṃ dharmajñaṃ satyavādinaṃ || snānārdhaṃ prārdaye denaṃ nipuṇaṃ rudra karmaṇi | tatastu maṃṭapaṃ kuryā ccaturasra mudaklpavaṃ || badda candana mālaṃca gomayenānu lepitaṃ | tanmadhye śveta rajasā saṃpūrṇaṃ padmamā likhet || tasyamadhye mahādevaṃ sthāpayetkarṇikopari | dadyāddaleṣu nandyādīn caturṣu vidhipūrvakaṃ || iṃdrādi lokapālāṃśca deleśvaṣṭa suvinyaset | devīṃ vināyakaṃ caiva sthāpayettatra pārdhiva | datvārgaṃ gaṃdha dūpaṃca puṣpaṃ dīpaṃ guḍodanaṃ || bhakṣyā nnānāvidhāndeyā tphalāni vividhānica| catuḥ koṇeṣu bhṛṃgāra maśvattha dhalapūritaṃ || ekaikaṃ vinyasedbrahmān sarvauṣadhi samanvitaṃ || maṃṭapasya caturdikṣu dadyādbhūta baliṃ tadhā || āgneyyāṃ diśi kartavyaṃ maṇṭapasya samīpataḥ | agnikāryaṃ śubhe kuṃḍe patra puṣpairalaṃkṛte || lavaṇaṃ payasā yuktaṃ ghṛtena madhunāsaha | mānasoktena juhuyātkṛte home navagrahe || dvitīya syāgni kāryasya kartāca brāhmaṇo bhavet | rudra japye tadhādhāryaḥ sita candana carcitaṃ || sitavastra parīdhānaṃ sitamālya vibhūṣitaṃ | śobhayetkaṃkaṇai rukmaiḥ karṇa veṣṭāṃgulīyakaiḥ || pūrva maṃḍala vatkāryaṃ dvitīyaṃ maṃḍalaṃ śubhaṃ | tanya madhyetu sānārī śvetapuṣpai ralaṃkṛte || śvetavastra parīdhānaṃ śvetagaṃdhānu lepanaṃ | sukhānano paviṣṭasyā dācāryo rudra jāpakaḥ || abhiṣiṃcettataścaināṃ arkapatra puṭāṃbunā | catuṣṣaṣṭī bucaṃcaiva rudre naikādaśenatu | śatāni sapta parṇānāṃ caturbi radhikānitu | parṇānāmiti bucāṃtāsāṃ catuṣṣaṣṭi | saṃkhyānāṃ ekādiśa kṛtvaḥ paṭhitānāmiyaṃ saṃkhyā || accidreṇeti maṃtreṇa snānārthaṃ viniveśayet | aśvasthā nādgajasthānā dvalmikātsaṃga māddradāt || vaiśyāṃgaṇā drājagṛho dgoṣṭādānīya vaimṛdaṃ | sarvauṣadhīrocanaṃca nadītīrthodakānica || etatsaṃkṣipya kalaśe kuśalākāci daṃganā | rudrābhijaptena tataḥ pnāpayetkalaśenatāṃ || toya pūrṇodakalaśai raśvadala pūritaiḥ | sarvadiksaṃ sthitau paścāt sthāpayetkalaśākṣataiḥ || evaṃsnātā snāpakāya dadyādgāṃkāṃcanaṃ tadhā | hoturevātra nirdiṣṭā dakṣiṇāgauḥ payasvinī || brāhmaṇānā mathānyeṣāṃ svaśaktā munipuṃgava | sragvastra kāṃcanādīni datvā sarvān kṣamāpayet || kṛtenānena vipreṃdra rudhrasnānena bhāminī | subhagā kāṃti saṃyuktā bahuputrā prajāyate || sarveṣvapi himāseṣu brāhmaṇānumateṣuca | tasmāda vaśyaṃ kurvīta strī putraṃ sukha mṛcchatī || yatsnāna mācarati rudramiti prasiddhaṃ | śraddanvātādvijavarānu matenatāṃgī || doṣānnihatya sakalāṃśca śarīrabhājo | bhartuḥ priyābhavati bhārata jīvavatsā || iti hemādrau bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ vaṃdhyātvaharaṃ vaṃdhyātvaharaṃ rudrasnānaṃ | atha hemādrāvasyathā snānaṃ - pārvatyuvāca - mṛta prajā'prajāvāpī strī prajāvāpi jāyate | graharogānvitāvārapityaktātyajativā patiṃ || vada devakathaṃ tasyāḥ sarvameta dvinaśyati || jāyete ca tathābhīṣṭamataḥ pṛcchāmi śaṃkarī || īśvara uvāca - śruṇuyena praṇasyanti doṣāḥ strīṇāṃ tvayoditāḥ | jāyateca tathākhīṣṭaṃ yadāvatkadhayāmite || gomātra gomayābhyāṃ ca bhūśuddhiṃ parikalpayet | avṛte vitatedeśe yatra nānyaḥ pravaśyati || kuṃbhān samānayettadva ddaśaikaṃ ca tadhādvijān | āhuya prārthayetsarvā carcadhetiśakṛnmṛdā || prakṣālya sthāpayetkuṃbhān pūrayettīrthavāriṇā | kṛtvātmarakṣāṃ vidhivatsvustikaṃ ca tathāsanaṃ || yajenmāṃ sarvakāmeśaṃ prāṇānāyamya vāgyataḥ | saṃkalpyacārya kuṃbhetu māmevā'tvāvahaṃtviti || āsanādi samastaṃtu tatraiva parikalpayet | kuṃbhasya bāhyadeśetu lokapālān prapūjayet | bodhāyanoktavidhinā gatānīśānasannidhau || tvaritaṃ catatonatvā iṃdrādīn mūlamaṃtrataḥ || praṇavaścāditaḥ kāryo namaścāṃte tadhaivaca || devatāpadamadhyastu mūlamaṃtraḥ prakīrtitaḥ | rudraikādaśinīmekāṃ spṛṣṭvā kuṃbhodakaṃ japet || punaḥ saṃpūjyavidhivanmā miṃdrādīṃ stadhaivaca | evaṃ sarveṣu kuṃbheṣu sarvaiḥ kāryo dvijo ttamaiḥ || tataḥ kuṃbhān samādāyakramānmārdnivisarjayet | etadedaśaguṇaṃ kartavyaṃ dvijasattamaiḥ || ekādaśehni vidhivatkartavyaṃ dvijatapakṣaṇaṃ | datvāṃca dakṣiṇāṃtebhyo namaskṛtya visarjayet || evaṃ doṣāḥ praṇaśyaṃti jāyatetu yadhepsitaṃ | puruṣasyāpi kartavyaṃ graharogānvitasyaca | puṣṭyāyurbalakāmasya kṣatriyasya jayārdhinaḥ || pratisaṃvatsaraṃyustu caitraśukle śubedine | karotiśraddhayāyukta anekāpadvimuktaye || iti rudrasnānaṃ| caṃḍīkalpaḥ atha śataca ḍī sahasracaṃḍīca - caṃjīpāṭhe phalaṃdevī śruṇuṣva gadatomama | saṃkalpapūrvaṃ saṃpūjyasya syāṃgeṣu anukramāt || paṭhanādbalidānādvā siddimāpnoti sādhakaḥ | upasargopaśāntyarthaṃ trirāvṛttyā sadāpaṭhet || grahopaśāṃtau kartavyā paṃcāvṛttirvarānane | mahābhayesamutpanne saptāvṛtyā samunnayet || navāvṛtyā bhavecchāṃtirvājapeya phalaṃlabhet | rājavasyāya bhūtyaica rudrāvṛttyāpyudīrayet || ārkāvṛtyā kāmasiddhirvairihaniśca jāyate || manvāvṛtyā vairināśa stathā svavaśyatāmiyāt | saukhyaṃ paṃcadaśāvṛttyā śrīyamārpoti mānavaḥ || kalāvṛtyā putrapautra dhanadhānyāgamaṃ viduḥ | rājabhīti vimokṣāya vairasyoccāṭanāyaca || kuryātsa paṃcaviṃśatyā bhavedbhaṃdhavimokṣaṇaṃ | saṃkaṭe samanuprāpte duścikitsyāmayotathā || jātidhvaṃse kulaccede āyuṣonāśa āgate | vairivṛddhau vyādhivṛddhau dhananāśe tathākṣaye || tadhaiva trividhotpāte tathācaivāti pātake | kuryā dyatnācchatāvṛttyā tataḥ saṃpadyate śubhaṃ | śreyovṛddhiḥ śatāvṛtyā rājyavṛddhi stadhāparā | manasā ciṃtitaṃ devī siddhyaṣṭottarātcatāt | sahasrāvartanāllakṣmīrā vṛṇoti svayaṃ sthirā || bhūktvāmanoradhān kāmān naromokṣamavāpnuyāt | caṃḍyāṃ śatavṛttipāṭhāt sirvāssiddhyāṃti siddhayaḥ || śatasāhastrikāvṛtyā dikcakrādhipatirbhavet || tataḥ - oṃ nārāyaṇāya namaḥ - oṃ nārayā namaḥ - oṃ narotta māya namaḥ - oṃ devyai namaḥ - oṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ - oṃ vyāsāya namaḥ - iti natvā paṭhet - vidhivākya pāṭhasva mūlo bhrāntānāṃ || ādhyāyaṃ prāpyaviramennatu madhdhye kadācana | tṛtevirāmemadhdhyetu ādyāyādi paṭhennaraḥ || tathā - devārcāmagrataḥ kṛtvā brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ || grandhiṃvā śithilaṃkuryā dvācakaḥ kurunaṃdana || atha śatacaṃḍī sahasracaṃḍī prayogaḥ | natvā gaṇeśvaraṃ devīṃ pitarau rāghavaṃ śivaṃ | kāmakṛṣṇa tanūjena kamalākaraśarmaṇā | ḍāmaraṃ yāmalaṃcaiva yoginī taṃtramevaca || vārāhī taṃtramanyaiṃśa graṃdhānālocya yatnataḥ | sahasra caṃjīkāyāśca śatacaṃḍyā stadaivaca || navārṇanyāsavidhinā prayogaḥ samudīritaḥ | tatra yajamānaḥ - śubedeśe maṃṭapa cikīrghurgaṇeśa karmaśeṣa vasudhānā | pūjanaṃkṛtvā śatacaṃḍyāḥ ṣoḍaśahastaṃ | sahasra caṃḍyā viṃśati hastamaṃṭapaṃ | prasādya tadāgneya staṃbhavaṭevā || pūrvoktadevānāṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā tāmrapātrerghamādāya | jānubhyā mavanīṃgatvā āgacca sarvakalyāṇī vasudhe lokadhāriṇī | uddhṛtāsivarāheṇa saśaila vanakānanā || maṃṭapaṃkāyā myadyatva dūrdhvaṃ śubhalakṣaṇaṃ | gṛhaṇārghyaṃ mayādattaṃprasannā śubhadā bhaveti bhūmyai arghyaṃdatvā - maṃṭapaṃ vidhāya tanmadhye īśānyāṃ hastamātrāṃgulavaprāṃ grahavediṃ kṛtvā paścime śatacaṇḍyā dvihastaṃ sahasracaṃḍyā ścaturhastaṃ ṣaḍḍastaṃvā caturasraṃ padmaṃ padmakuṃḍaṃvā kuryāt | tatrāṣṭa catvāri śadaṃgulāni caturhastekaraṇīyā || aṣṭa paṃcādaśa daṃgulāni saptaya vāyukādvayaṃca ṣaḍḍhaste karaṇīyā | evaṃ kuṃḍaṃ kṛtvā maṃṭapamadhyeṣṭa koṇāṃ vediṃ kuryāt - tadyadhā - madhyastaṃbha cakuṣka madhye sama caturasraṃ kṛtvā śoḍaśa hasta maṇṭapeṣṭā daśāṃgulairviṃśatyaṃ gulādhika hastenakoṇeṣū bhayatoñkamadi kṛtyāṣṭasūtra dānā daṣṭāsramini rāghavabhaṭṭoktaḥ prakāraḥ || athavā ṣoḍaśāṃgulādhika hastamātraṃ madhye catarasraṃ kṛtvā tatsaṃlagnāni caturdikṣu tanmānāni catvāri caturasrāṇi kṛtvā bāhya caturasrāṇāṃkoṇe tvakṣṇayāṣṭa sūtrāṇi datvādikṣu caturasraścaturdāṃ śāstyājedityaṣṭāsraṃ eva maṣṭakoṇāṃ hastoccāṃ vediṃ kṛtvā - tadupari vāruṇa maṃḍalaṃ sarvato bhadraṃvā kṛtvoparivitānaṃ kiñkiṇi cāmarādi yutaṃ badhvāśata caṃḍvāṃpalena tadarthena tadardenavā sahasra caṇḍyāṃtupala paṃcakena tadaddhenavā devīmūrtī maṣṭādaśa bhūjāṃ kuryāt - atha prayogaḥ - śubhehnikartā sapatnikaḥ tilatailena kṛtābhyāṃgo bhūṣita saṃpūrṇa kalaśahasto bhadraṃ karṇebhiriti maṇṭapaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya paścimadvāreṇa praviśopya viśvadeśa kālau smṛtvāmameha janmani durgāprītidvārā sahasra caṃḍīṃvā svayaṃ brāhmaṇadvārāvā kariṣye - tadaṃgatayā gaṇeśapūjana puṇyāhavācana mātṛkāpūjana mātṛkā pūjana nāndī śrāddhānica kṛtvā'cāryāṃ vṛtvā prārthayet || ācāryastu yadhā svarge śakrādīnāṃ bṛhaspatiḥ | tathatvāṃ mamayatresmi nnācāryo bhava suvrateti || tato brahmaṇaṃ vṛṇuyāt - yadhā caturmūkho brahmā svargeloka pitāmahaḥ - tathatvaṃ mamayajñesmin brahmāṇaṃ tvāmahaṃ vṛṇe || tataḥ sadasyaṃ gāṇāpatya japārdhaṃca vṛtvāsmi skarmaṇi ṛtviktve natvāmahaṃ vṛṇe iti śatvāmahaṃ vṛṇe iti śatacaṃjyāṃ navaṛtvijo vṛṇuyāt - sahasra caṃḍyāṃ śataṃ tatoṣṭaudvārapālān vṛtvā saṃbhave sarveṣāṃ madhuparkapūjāṃ kṛtvā || aṃgulīya karṇabhūṣaṇa vastradvaya jalapātrā sanārghyā pātrāṇi dadyāt - dviguṇa mācāryāya adhācāryoyadatra saṃsthitaṃ bhūtamiti sarṣapān vikīrya paṃcagavyena kuśaiḥ śucīvohavyetitṛcena āpohiṭheti tṛcenaca maṃṭapaṃpokṣyāsvastyayanaṃtārkṣyā miti maṃtradvayaṃ paṭet - tato matkṛta tulāpaddhati mārgeṇa maṃṭapapūjāṃ prāgagni sthāpanātkuryat || tataḥ pūrve - kādaṃbari gajāruḍhe vajrahaste ehyohi āgaccha āgacca - gaṃdha puṣpasahita mimaṃ kṣīrāktānna baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa - mamepsitaṃ kuru kuru svāheti baliṃdatvā - dvāraśākhayorbāhmi māheśvarī cicchaktyai māyāśaktyai dhātre vidhātre śaṃkhanithaye padmanidhaye dvāraśriyai nama iti saṃpūjyāthaḥ vāstupuruṣa masitāṃga bhairavaṃ ca pūjayet - tata āgneye ulke ajārūḍhe śakti haste ehyehityādi rurubhairavaśca - daśriṇe karāli mahiṣārūḍhe - daṃḍahaste ehyehityādi dvāraśākhayoḥ kaumārīṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ pūrvavaccaktyādīn saṃpūjya caṃjabairavaṃ pūjayet - tato nai ṛtyāṃ raktākṣi pretārūḍhe khaḍga haste ehyehītyādi - krodhabhairavaśca - tataḥ paścime kauberī aśvārūḍhe pāśahaste ehyehītyādi - dvāraśākha yorvārāhī miṃdraṇī cicchaktyādīṃśca saṃpūjya unmattabheravaṃ pūjayet - tato vāyuvye mṛgavāhaneṃ kuśahaste ehyehītyādi - kapāla bhairavaśca - tata uttare yakṣiṇī siṃhāvāhinī gadāhaste ehehītyādi - dvāraśākhayoḥ cāmuṃḍāṃ lakṣmīṃ ca cicchaktyādīn saṃpūjya - bhīṣaṇa bhairavaṃ pūjayet - īśānyāṃ kālī vṛṣārūḍhe śūlahaste ehyehītyādi saṃhāra bhairavaśca - īṣānya pūrvamadhye sarvarājye ahi vāhane cakrahaste ehyehītyādi bhūmi pūjā ca paścima niṛtimadhya suraśreṣṭhe haya vāhane - atrasūtra kamaṃḍaluhaste ehyehītyādi - aṃtarikṣa pūjā ca - tato vedyāmāgneye viṣṇave - pūrve rudrayā - īśānyāṃ brahmaṇe - paścime gaṇeśāya - madhye mahākālyai mahā lakṣmyai mahāsarasvatyai dhyaja patākocchrayaṇaṃ kṛtvā pūjayet || tata ācārya grahavedyāṃ - grahān saṃsthāpya saṃpūjya madhyavedyāṃ pīṭhe upaviśya - guṃ gurave namaḥ - gaṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ - dvāṃ dvāraśriyai namaḥ - duṃ dūrgāyai namaḥ - kṣaṃ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ - hraḥ astrāya phaḍiti vāstupūruṣāya mahālakṣmyai namaḥ - iti natvā pṛthvītyānasaṃ kṛtvā anantāsanāya namaḥ - vimalāsanāya namaḥ - padmāsanāya namaḥ - iti dvābhyāṃ vāmapāda ghātatrayaṃ kṛtvā - hraḥ astāya phaḍati tālatrayaṃ kṛtvā - gaṇapati sarasvatī kṣetrapālān satvāraḥ phaḍityagni prākāraṃ viciṃtya samastāt jaladhārāṃ datvā mūle nācamya prāṇānāyamya deśakālau smṛtvā asmin śatacaṃḍīyokarmaṇi śrī mahālakṣmyānavavārṇava vidhānena nyāsapūjādikaṃ kariṣye iti saṃkalpya bhūtaśiddhiṃ kuryāt || svajīvaṃ haṃsassohamiti śirasthita paramātmani saṃyojya pādādijānu paryaṃtaṃ laṃ pṛthvīmapsu iti sarvatrānuṣaṃgaḥ || jānvādyānābhi paryaṃtaṃ - vaṃ - apastejasi - upasaṃharāmi - nābherākaṇṭha - raṃ tejovāyau upasaṃharāmi | kaṃṭhāte bhrāmādhya paryaṃtaṃ yaṃ - vāyu mākāśe upasaṃharāmi | bhrūmadhyādā brahmaraṃdhra paryaṃtaṃ - aṃ - ākāśa mahaṅkāre upasaṃharāmi | ahaṃṅkaura mahati - mahātrpakṛtau - prakṛtiṃ puruṣe - puruṣaṃ paramātmani mahālakṣmi saṃjñe brahmaṇi upasaṃharāmītṛnu ṣaṃgeṇa bhūtāni saṃhṛtya | vāṃ kukṣāvaṃguṣṭha mātraṃ pāpa puruṣaṃ yamiti pūrakeṇa ṣoḍaśāvṛtyādagdhvā - ramityagpi bīcena kuṃbhakana catuṣṣaṣṭyā vṛtyādagdhvā - vamati recakeṇa dvātriṃśadā vṛtyānissārya vāmitya mṛtabījenāplavya | lamiti sammelya glaumitighanī kṛtyaha mitivyomabījena dehāvayavān dvātvā jīvaṃ haṃsassohaṃ haṃsa ititatra saṃyojya || brahmaṇaṃ prakṛtiḥ | prakṛtermahat - mahatohaṃkāraḥ - ahaṅkarādākāśaḥ - ākāśādvāyuḥ - vāyoragniḥ - agnerāpaḥ - adbhyaḥ pṛthivī - oṣadayaḥ - oṣadhībhyonnāṃ annādretaḥ - retasaḥ puruṣa itidehotpattiṃ vikāvya prāṇa pratiṣṭhā kuryāt || asyaśrī amuka caṃjīprāṇa pratiṣṭhā mahāmaṃtrasya brahmaviṣṇu rudrā ṛṣayaḥ || ṛgyajussāmāni chaṃdāṃsi - caitanya rūpiṇī jagatsṛṣṭikartrī prāṇa śaktirdevatā - āṃ bījaṃ - hrīṃ śaktiḥ - kro kīlakaṃ asyāścaṃḍyāḥ prāṇa pratiṣṭhāyāṃ viniyogaḥ - oṃ aṃ - hrīṃ - kroṃ - aṃ - kaṃ - khaṃ - gaṃ - ghaṃ - ṅaṃ pṛthivyāptejo vāyavyākāśātmane āṃ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ || hṛdayāya namaḥ || ṛgyajussāmāni karapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ - evaṃ - āḥ karatala karapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ - evaṃ hṛdayādi ṣaḍaṃṅganyāsaḥ | tataḥ kaṃṭhastha ṣoḍaśadala padme akārādi ṣoḍaśa svarāndale - eṃ namaḥ - āṃ namaḥ - iṃ ityādi - hṛdayastha dvādaśadale kāditāntān - nābhau daśadalethadiphantān - tadathaḥ ṣaḍḍalebādilāṃtān ādārecaturdale vādisāntān lalāṭe dvidale - haṃ - kṣaṃ - ityaṃtarmātṛkāḥ - atha brahmahītṛkānyāsaḥ - ṛṣyādi ṣaḍaṅgaḥ pūravavat aṃ namaḥ śirasi - aṃ mukhe - iṃ dakṣiṇanetre - īṃ namaḥ vāmanetre - uṃ dakṣiṇakarṇe - ūṃ namaḥ vāmakarṇe - ṛṃ namaḥ dakṣiṇanāsāpuṭe - ṛṃ namaḥ vāmavāsā paṭe - lūṃ namaḥ - vāmanāsāyāṃ - lūṃ namaḥ daśriṇa kapole - lūṃ namaḥ vāmakapole - eṃ namaḥ ūrdhveṣṭhe - aiṃ namaḥ ādharoṣṭe - oṃ namaḥ ūrdhvadanta paṅkau - auṃ namaḥ ādhodantapaṅtkā - aṃ namaḥ jihvāyāṃ - āṃ namaḥ kaṭhe - kaṃ namaḥ dakṣiṇabāhumūle - khaṃ namaḥ dakṣiṇakūrrape - gaṃ namaḥ dakṣiṇa maṇibaṃdhe - ghaṃ namaḥ dakṣiṇāṃguli mūle - ṅaṃ namaḥ dakṣiṇāṃgulyagre - caṃ namaḥ vāmabāhumūle - chaṃ namaḥ vāmakūrpare - jaṃ namaḥ vāmaṇibaṃde - jhaṃ namaḥ vāmāṃgulumūle - ñaṃ namaḥ vāmāṃgulyagre - ṭaṃ namaḥ dakṣiṇapāda mūle - ṭhaṃ namaḥ dakṣiṇajānuni - ḍaṃ namaḥ dakṣiṇagulphe - ḍhaṃ namaḥ dakṣiṇapādāṃgulumūle - ṇaṃ namaḥ dakṣiṇapādāgaṃlulyagre - taṃ naḥ vāmapādamūle - thaṃ namaḥ vāmajānuni - daṃ namaḥ vāmagulphe - dhaṃ namaḥ dakṣiṇapādāgaṃlumūle - naṃ namaḥ dakṣiṇapādāgaṃlulyaghre - paṃ namaḥ dakṣiṇapārśve - ghaṃ namaḥ vāmapārśve - baṃ pṛṣṭhe - bhaṃ nābhau - maṃ udare - yaṃ namaḥ hṛdaye - raṃ namaḥ dormūle - laṃ kakudi - vaṃskaṃdayoḥ - śaṃ hṛdayādi dakṣakare - ṣaṃ hṛdayādi vāmakare - saṃ namaḥ hṛdayādi dakṣapāde - haṃ namaḥ hṛdayāda vāmapāde - laṃ mūrdādipādintaṃ - kṣaṃnamaḥ pādādimūrdātaṃ athanivṛdyādiśānāśaṃsaḥ || aṃ nivṛtyai namaḥ - śirasi - āṃ pratiṣṭhāyai namaḥ mukhe - iṃ vidyāyai namaḥ lalāṭe - īṃ śānyai namaḥ dakṣa vāmakrameṇa netrayoḥ - uṃ īdikāyai - ūṃ dīpikāyai dakṣavāmakrameṇa karṇayoḥ - ṛṃ recakāyai - ṛṃ mocikāyai nāsayoḥ laṃ parāyai - lāṃ sūkṣmāyai kapolayoḥ - ema sūkṣmā mayāyai - aiṃ jñānāmayāyai dantayoḥ oṃ sāvitryai - auṃ vyāpinyai oṃṣṭhayoḥ - aṃ surūpāyai jihvayāṃ - āḥ - anastāyai - kaṃṭhe - atha dakṣakare - kaṃ sṛṣṭyai - khaṃ budhyai namaḥ - gaṃ - samṛtyai namaḥ - ghaṃ medhāyai namaḥ - ṅaṃ kāṃtyainamaḥ - itidakṣiṇa karamūla kūrpa ramaṇi baṃdhāṃguli mūlāṃgulyagreṣunyaset - caṃ lakṣmyai - chaṃ dhyutyai - jaṃ sthirāyai - ghaṃ sthityai - ñaṃ siddhye - itivāmakare pūrvavannyaset || ṭaṃ - japāyai - ṭhaṃ - pālinyai - ḍaṃ kānyai - ḍhaṃ - īśvaryai - ṇaṃ - ratyai iti dakṣapādamūla jānugulphāṃguli mūlāṃgulyagreṣunyaset - taṃ kāmikāyai - thaṃ varadāyai - daṃ hladinyai - dhaṃ prītyai - naṃ dīrghāyai - iti vāmapāda mūlajānvādi krameṇa - paṃ tīkṣṇāyai - phaṃ raudyai - kukṣā dakṣa vāmakrameṇa - baṃ ābhāyai - pṛṣṭe bhaṃ nidrāyai nābhau - maṃ taṃdryai - udare - yaṃ - kṣudāyai namaḥ - hṛdi - raṃ - krodinyai - kaṃṭhe - laṃ - kṛpāyai - kakudi - vaṃ - ulkāyai namaḥ - skaṃdhayoḥ - śaṃ mṛtyuve namaḥ - hṛdayādi dakṣakare - ṣaṃ - pītāyai - hṛdayādi vāmakare - saṃ śvetāyai - hṛdayādi dakṣapāde - haṃ - aruṇāyai - hṛdayāda vāmapāde - laṃ - asitāyai mūrdhnādi pādāntāṃ - kṣaṃ anantāyai namaḥ pādādi mūrdhāṃ taṃ - iti kalānyāsaḥ || tato mūlena triḥ prāṇānāyamya - asya śrī navārṇa maṃtrasya brahma viṣṇu rudrā ṛṣayaḥ - mahākālī mahālakṣmī mahāsaravasvatyo devatā | gāyatryuṣṇiganuṣṭup chaṃdāsi - naṃ dāśākaṃbarī bhūmāścaktayaḥ - raktadantikā durgā bhrāmaryo bījāni - agnirvāyu ssūryastatvāni - japa pūjādau viniyogaḥ adhaikādaśanyāsaḥ - hrīṃ bījayuktān akārādi kṣakārāṃtāne varṇān bahirmākṛkāsthāneṣunyaset - hrīṃ aṃ namaḥ śirasi ityādi - iti pradhamaḥ || oṃ āṃ hrīṃ klīṃ bījāni karadvaye kaniṣṭikāṃguṣṭhāṃtaṃ karataṃ kara pṛṣṭha maṇibaṃdheṣunyaset | oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ klīṃ namaḥ kaniṣṭakābhyāṃ namaḥ ityādi - evaṃ hṛdayādi ṣaṃgaḥ - evaṃ daśadikṣuca || iti dvatīyaḥ || oṃ hrāṃ aiṃ - brāhmi pūravatomāṃ pātu - oṃ hrīṃ hrauṃ māheśvarī āgneyāṃ māṃ pātu - oṃ hrīṃ klīṃ kaumārī dakṣiṇe māṃ pātu - oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ vaiṣṇavī naiṛtyāṃ māṃpātu - oṃ - hrīṃ - hrūṃ vārāhyai namaḥ paścimāyāṃ pātuṃ | oṃ hrīṃ glau iṃdrāṇyai vāyavye māṃ pātu - oṃ hrīṃ bhryāṃ cāmuṃḍāyai īśānyāṃ māṃ pātu - oṃ hrīṃ vyomeśvartyai ūrdhve māṃ pātu - oṃ hrīṃ saptadvīpeśvartyai bhūmi māṃ pātu | oṃ hrīṃ nāgeśvaryai pātāle māṃ pātu || iti tṛtīya || sarvatrādau praṇavaḥ - oṃ ānaṃdajāyai purvāṃge māṃ pātu | ksauṃ raktadaṃtikāyai dakṣiṇāṃge māṃ pātu | ksauṃ śāṃkaṃbharyai pascimāṃge māṃ pātu | ksauṃ durgāyai vāmabhāge māṃ pātu - hrūṃ pātrakarāyai śirasi māṃ pātu - mātaṃgakanyāyai mastakādi pādāntaṃ māṃ pātu | śrīṃ citrakāntikṛdbhramaryai namaḥ - pādādi śirontaṃ māṃ pātu || iti caturdhaḥ || oṃ hrīṃ brahmaṇe namaḥ | pādādi nābhivaryantaṃ māṃ pātu oṃ hrīṃ vaiṣṇavyai namaḥ nābherviśuddhiparyaṃtaṃ māṃ pātu | oṃ hrīṃ rudrāya viśuddheḥ brahmaraṃdrāṃtaṃ māṃ pātu | oṃ hrīṃ haṃ haṃsāyai padadvaye māṃ pātu | oṃ hrīṃ vainateyāya karadvaye māṃ pātu | oṃ hrīṃ vṛṣabhāya namaḥ cakṣuṣoḥ māṃ pātu | oṃ hrīṃ gajānanāya sarvāṃge māṃ pātu | oṃ hrīṃ parāya pūrvāparadeha bhāgayauḥ ānaṃdamaya hare sarvāṃge māṃ pātu || iti paṃcamaḥ || oṃ hrīṃ mahālahmyai madhyadehā māṃ pātu | oṃ aiṃ sarasvatyai ūrdhvadehe māṃ pātu | oṃ klīṃ mahākālyai adhodehe māṃ pātu | oṃ hrīṃ kṣvoṃ sihmayahastayoḥ māṃ pātu | oṃ hrīṃ haṃsāya netrayoḥ māṃ pātu | oṃ hrīṃ mahiṣapretābhyāṃ namaḥ haṃsāya māṃ pātu | oṃ namaścaṃḍikāyai sarvāṃge māṃ pātu || iti ṣaṣṭaḥ || oṃ aiṃ namaḥ mūrdhnī | oṃ hrīṃ namaḥ dakṣiṇanetre | oṃ klīṃ namaḥ vāmanetre - oṃ cāṃ namaḥ dakṣiṇakarṇe māṃpātu | muṃ namaḥ vāmakarṇe māṃpātu | ḍāṃ cāṃ namaḥ dakṣiṇa nāsikāyāṃ | yaiṃ namaḥ vāma nāsāyāṃ | oṃ namo namaḥ nāsāmukhe māṃpātu | cai namaḥ pāyau māṃpūtu ||iti saptamaḥ || ceṃ pāyau - viṃ mukhe - yaiṃ vāmanāsāyāṃ - ḍāṃ dakṣiṇa nāsikāyāṃ māṃ - muṃ vāmakarṇe māṃ - cāṃ dakṣiṇakarṇe māṃ | kliṃvāmanetre māṃ | hrīṃ dakṣiṇanetre māṃ - aiṃ mūrdhi māṃ || ityaṣṭamaḥ || aiṃ hrīṃ klīṃ cāmuṃḍāyai vicce svāheti mūlamantaiṇa pratyakṣaraṃ praṇavapūrvaṃ namontaṃ māmagre dakṣiṇa paścima vāmāṃgeṣu ārohāvarohābhyāṃ śirastaḥ pādāṃtaṃ pādādi śirontaṃ nyaset || iti namaḥ || pūrvokta namagra mūlamaṃtreṇa hṛdayādi ṣaḍaṃgaḥ || iti daśamaḥ || tataḥ - khaḍginī śūlinī ghoretyekaṃ ślokamuktvā nīlavarṇāṃ dhyātvā hṛdayāya namaḥ || śulena pāhinodevīti ślokacatuṣṭayamuktvā raktavarṇāṃdyātvā śirase svāhā || sarvasvarūpe sarveśīti ślokapaṃcakaṃ paṭhitvā śvetavarṇāṃ dhyātvā śikhāyaipaṣaṭ || ityekādaśaḥ || tato yonimudrāṃ pradarśayet - sācaivaṃ dakṣiṇakarasya tarjanyā vāmasyā nāmikāṃ vāmatarjanyā dakṣiṇasyā nāmikāyāṃ ca dhṛtvāgre madhyamāṃgulidvaya tadagre kaniṣṭakādvayaṃ tadagreṃguṣṭadvayamiti || atha dhyānaṃ - śvetānanā nīlabhūjā suśvetastanamaṃḍalā | raktamadhyāraktapādā nīle jaṃgherurunmadā || sucitra jaghanā citramālyāṃbara vibhūṣaṇā | citrānilepanā kāṃti rūpa saubhāgyasālinī || aṣṭādaśa bhūjā pūjyāsā sahasrabhūjā satī | āyudhānyatravakṣyante dakṣiṇādhaḥ karakramāt || akṣamālāṃca kamalaṃ bāṇāpiḥ kuliśaṃ gadāṃ | cakraṃ triśūlaṃ paraśu śaṃkaṃ ghaṃṭāṃ ca pāśakaṃ || śaktiṃ daṃḍaṃ carmacāpe pānapatraṃ kamaṃḍalumiti | tato vedyāṃ sarvatobhadraṃ kṛtavā tatra devatāḥ sthāpayet || madhye brahmaṇaṃ | uttarādi somādīn || vāyu somamadhyādiṣu krameṇa janmayā atretivasūn | ārudraca iti rudran | tyānnu kṣatriyāniti dvādaśādityān || aśvināvartyetyaśvinau | abhityaṃ devamiti saptayakṣān || āyaṃ gauriti sarpān | apsarasāṃ gandhavān‌ṇāmiti gaṃdharvāpsarasaḥ || brahma somamadhye kumārammāteti kumāraṃ | ṛṣabhammetyṛṣabhaṃ || aditirhyajaniṣṭheti dakṣaṃca | brahmeṃdramadhyetāmagnivarṇāmiti durgāṃ | idaṃ viṣṇuriti viṣṇuṃca| brahmāgnimadhye udīratā mitisvadhāṃ | brahma yama madhye paraṃmṛtyo iti mṛtyurogān || brahmani ṛtimadhye gaṇānānvaiti gaṇapatiṃ | brahmavaraṇa madhye śannodevīrityāpaḥ | brahmavāyumadhye marutoyasyetimarutaḥ || brahmaṇaṃ pādamūle syoneti bhūmiṃ | tatraiva imaṃme gaṃge iti gaṃgādinadyaḥ | dhāmnodhāmna iti saptasāgarāṃśca | bahissomādi sannidhaukrameṇa gadāṃ triśūlaṃ vajraṃ śaktiṃ daṃḍaṃ khaḍgaṃpāśa maṃkuśaṃca | punaruttarādi | gautamaṃ bharadvājaṃ viśvāmitraṃ kaśyapaṃ jamadagniṃ visiṣṭhamatri maruṃdhatīṃ ca | pūrvādi aiṃdrī kaumārī brāhmī vārāhī cāmuṃḍā vaiṣṇavī māheśvarī vaināyakī || tatastradastu ityāvāhya saṃpūjya balīndatvā | tanmadhye mahīdyauriti bhūmiṃspṛṣṭvā || oṣadayassamiti saptadhānyāni kṣiptvā ākalaśeṣviti hemaṃ rājataṃ tāmramayaṃvā kalaśaṃ sthāpya | imaṃmme gaṃgetyudakenā pūrva || gaṃdhadvārāmiti gaṃdhaṃ | yā oṣadhīriti sarvauṣadhīḥ || kāṃjātakāṃjāditi dūrvāḥ | aśvaddeva iti paṃcapallavān | syoneti saptamṛdaḥ yāḥ phalinīrīti phalaṃ pūrṇādarvīti pūrṇapātraṃ ca nidhāya tatra vastreyastraṃ likhet || yathā - caturdhvāraṃ caturasratrayaṃkṛtvā tanmadhye trikoṇaṃ kṛtvā tatpaścimārthe dakṣiṇakoṇaṃ kṛtvā pūrvastha paścimarekhā saṃlganakoṇa manyatrikoṇaṃ kuryāt | tena bahikoṇadhyeca ṣaṭkoṇāḥ saṃpadyante | tanmadhye vānya trikoṇaṃ kṛtvā tatsaṃlagna manyatrakoṇamiti || uddāroyadhā - yadvāmadhye trikoṇaṃ tadbahiḥ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ tadbāhyevṛttaṃ tadbāhyeṣṭaudalāni | tadbāhye caturdvāraṃ caturasratrayamiti | evaṃ yastraṃ vilikhya tatra śatacaṃḍyāḥ palena hemnā tadarthenavākṛtāṃ sahasracaṃḍyāstu viṃśatidaśa paṃcānyatama suvarṇa pratimāṃ kṛtvāḥ dhnānoktā maṣṭādaśabhūjāṃ rahastyoktā maṣṭabūjāṃvā mahiṣāsura haṃtrīṃ sihmāsthāṃ devī mūrtiṃraktapaṭṭa dukālamūgacchannaṃ saṃsthāpya pūjayet || tadyadhā - svavāmestrāya phaḍitā kṣālitaṃ mūlena jalapūritaṃ kaṃbaṃ nidhāya puṣpakṣata gaṃdhādibhirmūlena tatpātrāṇyā pūrva deva dakṣiṇenyaset || tato matsyamudrāyā trikoṇaṃ tadbahiḥ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ tadbahiścatu rasraṃ tadbāhyevṛttaṃ gomayena jalenavā vilikhya śaṃkhamudra yāvaṣṭabhya vahnaye daśakalātmane - dhūmrārcyai ūṣmāyai jvālinyai - misphiliginyai - śucyai - surāpūyai - kapilāyai - havyavāhāyai - kavyavāhāyai namaḥ | ityabhyarcya ṣaṭkoṇe agni niṛtivukoṇeṣu hṛyāya namaḥ | śirase svāhā - śikhāyaivaṣaṭ - kavacāya huṃ miti agre netratrayāya vauṣaṭ - sarvataḥ astrāyaphaḍiti akṣataissaṃpūjya - astrakṣālitaṃ śaṃkhaṃ saṃsthāpya - haṃ māṃ sūryamaṃḍalāya dvādaśa kalātmane namaḥ - tapanyai - tāpinyai - dhūmrāyai - marīcyai - jvālinyai - rucyai - suṣumnāyai - bhogadāyai - viśvāyai - bodhinyai - dāriṇyai - kṣayāyai - iti śaṃkhamakṣataiḥ saṃpūjya - tatra gaṃdhapuṣpāṇi hṛdaya maṃtreṇa kṣiptvā | kṣaṃ namaḥ - laṃ namaḥ haṃ namaḥ - ityādi viloma mātṛkābhiḥ śiro maṃtreṇa jalanā pūrva - uṃ somamaṃḍalāya ṣoḍaśakalātmane - amṛtāyai namaḥ - mānadāyai namaḥ - puṣāyai namaḥ - caṃdrikāyai namaḥ - kāṃtyai namaḥ - jyotsnāyai na - śrīyai namaḥ - prītyai namaḥ - aṃganāyai namaḥ - pūrṇāyai namaḥ - pūrṇāmṛtāyai namaḥ - kāmadāyinyai namaḥ | ityabhimaṃtryāṃ kuśamudrayā - sūryamaṃḍalāttīrthamākṛṣyā vāhinyādi mudrāṃ pradarśya śikhā mantreṇa dhenumudrāṃ gālinī mudrāṃ garuḍa mudrāṃcapradarśya - karadvayāṃguṣṭa tarjanyagrasaṃyoge gālinī mudrā karadvayasya pṛ,ṭaṃ saṃyojyakaniṣcikānāmikāvavaṣṭabhya adhoṃguṣṭaṃ puratastarjanyau saṃyaujya madhyamānāmikayormaktayoḥ pakṣatulyatve garuḍa mudraṃca pradarśayet - netramaṃeṇa saṃvīkṣya - kavacamaṃtreṇa saṅkalīkṛtya tatra ṣaḍaṃgāni ninyasyāstra maṃtreṇa rakṣaṃ kṛtvā mūlena gaṃdhapuṣpai rabhyarcya hastevācchāryamūlena saptavārabhimastrya - cakramudrayā saṃrakṣya tajjalaṃ kiṃcitkuṃbhekṣiptvā ṣaḍaṃgaṃ kṛtvātmānaṃ gaṃdha puṣpairabhyarcya mūlena triḥsvasirasi puṣpaṃjaliṃ datvādhūpadīpa naivedyādi manasā nivedya devarūpaḥ sanmūlaṃjaptvā - devāya japaṃ nivedya puṣpamāghrāya kuṃbhodarāya nama iti vāme kṣiptvā hastaṃ prakāśyapīṭhaṃ pūjayet - yadhā devī dakṣiṇe guṃ gurobhyo namaḥ - paṃ paramagurubhyo namaḥ iti saṃpūjya - vāme gaṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ - duṃ durgāyai namaḥ - kṣaṃ kṣatrapālāya namaḥ - madhye ādhāraśaktyai namaḥ - mūlaprakutyai namaḥ - varāhoya namaḥ - ananyāya namaḥ - bhūmyai namaḥ - amṛrārṇavāya namaḥ - ratnadvīpāya namaḥ - hemagiraye namaḥ - kalpatarave namaḥ - ratnavedikāyai namaḥ - śvetachatrāya namaḥ - ratanasiṃhāsanāya nama iti saṃpūjya - agneyādikoṇeṣu dharmāya namaḥ - jñānāya namaḥ - vairāgyāya namaḥ - aiśvaryāya namaḥ - pūrvādidikṣu adharmāya namaḥ - ajñānāya namaḥ - avairāgyāya namaḥ - anaiśvaryāya namaḥ - urdhvaṃ brahmaṇe namaḥ - athaḥ ānanyāya namaḥ - madhye vāstupuruṣāyeti saṃpūjya - madhyesaṃ satvāyaniṃ vidyayai namaḥ - pīṭhāstu pūrvādyaṣṭadikṣu - oṃ oṃkāra giripīṭheśvarī sahitāṃ oṃkārāgiri pīṭhaśvarvaṃbāṃ pādukāṃ pūjayāmi | oṃ oḍḍhyāyainamaḥ - pīṭhastu pūrvādyaṣṭadikṣu - oṃ oṃkāra giripiṭheśvarī sahitāṃ oṃkāragiri pīṭheśvarvaṃbāṃ pādukāṃ pūjayāmi | oṃ oḍḍhyāṇa pīṭheśvarī sahītāṃ oḍḍyāṇa pīṭhaśvaryaṃbā śrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi - kalātītāṃ ākārādyakṣa rātmikaṃ | anaṃta śakti sahitāṃ kāmākṣīṃ pūjayāmyahāmiti caturthīṃ || kāmacārīṃ kālarātriṃ kāladaṃḍa svarūpiṇīṃ | kāmadāṃ karuṇodārāṃ kālīmāvāhayāmyahāmiti paṃcamī || caṃḍa vīryāṃ caṃḍamayīṃ caṃḍamuṃḍa prabhaṃjanīṃ | brahmeśa viṣṇunamitāṃ caṃḍīkāṃ pūjayāmyahāmiti ṣaṣṭhī || sukhānaṃda karīṃ śāṃtāṃ sarvedeva namaskṛtāṃ | saryabhūtātmikāḥ devīṃ śāṃbhavīṃ pūja yāmyahāmiti dānā nyācāryādibhyo nyebhyovā pāṭhakāya dadyāt | yathā vipraṃ saṃpūjya kapilāṃgāṃ svarṇa śṛṃgīṃ raupya khurāṃtāmra pṛṣṭhā || kāṃsyadohānāṃ navatsāṃ saṃpujya | kapile sarvabhūtānāṃ pūjanīyā śiromaṇi | vipraṃ saṃpūjya - aśvaṃ hemapalyayaṇaṃ raupyakaṭakavagajadanta vajranetra tāmramaya kharakṣaumacchatra svarṇa lalāṭapaṭṭa sukakṣāsvāyudha graiveya vastrayutaṃ dhānyaṃratne paristhaṃkṛtvā || mametayuktvā karṇaṃ viprahaste dadvā maṃtraṃ paṭhet || maharṇa vedasamutpanna ucchaiśśrava saputraka | mayātvaṃ vipramukhyāya tattohaya sukhībhava || imaṃ vipramanyastubhya maśvaṃte pratipāditaṃ | pratigṛhmīṣva vipreṃdra mayādattaṃ suśobhanamiti || tataḥ suvarṇa dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt | tataḥ ihāmutrātapatrāṇaṃ kuru kevavameprabho || chatraṃ tvatvrītayodattaṃ brāhmaṇāya mayāsaheti chatraṃ | śaśāṃka karasaṃkāśa himaḍiṃḍīra pāṃḍura || protsārayā śudiritaṃ cāmarāmaravallabheti cāmaraṃ || sarvasyāśrayā bhūmirvarāheṇa samuddhṛtā || anatta sasyaphaladā ataḥ śāṃtiṃ prayaccatu || iti bhūmiṃ - yathāva kṛṣṇaśayanaṃ śūnyaṃ sāgarajātayā | śayyāmamāpyaśūnyāstu tathā janmani janmani || iti śayyāṃ - tṛptiṃ karoti bhūtāni nāmaihaloke paratraca | tasmātrpadīyate dhānya mataśśāṃtiṃ prayaccame || iti saptadhānyāni - tato dvārajāpakebhyonyebhyaśca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt | tataḥ sarvakalaśodekena sāmātyaṃ yajamānaṃ | samudrajyeṣṭhā ityādyaiḥ surānvaityādi paurāṇaiścābhiṣiṃceyuḥ || tato yajamāno navagrahāṇā muttara pūjāṃ kṛtvā | visṛjyācārya haste datvā devīṃ saṃpūjya baliṃ dadyāt || tatra kṣatriyā dināca meṣachāga mahiṣāṇā manyataraṃ deyaṃ | vipreṇa kūśmāṃḍaṃ bilva mikṣuśca deyāḥ | yadā - devīṃ droṇa puṣpa bilvāmrala jāti caṃpakaiḥ | saṃpūjya uḍaṅmukhaḥ kartā pūrva mukhaṃ devī muṃkhavā | baliṃ gaṃdhādinābhyārcyā - paśusastvaṃ bali rūpeṇa mama bhāgyādupa sthitā | praṇamāni tata sparya rūpiṇaṃ bali rūpiṇaṃ || caṃḍikā prīti dānena tāturāpadvi nāśanaṃ | cāmuṃḍā bali rūpāyabaletubhyaṃ namostute || yajñārdhe balayaḥ sṛṣṭhāssvayameva svayaṃbhūvā | atastvāṃ ghātayāmyadhya tasmādyajño vado'vadha iti abhimaṃtrya || aiṃ hrīṃ śrīmati tatra puṣpaṃ kṣiptvā | rasanātvaṃ caṃḍikāyāḥ suraloka prasādhakaḥ || hrāṃ hrīṃ - khaḍga āṃ hrūṃ paḍiti khaḍga manyadvā śastraṃ saṃpūjya | oṃkāli kaliyajñeśvari loha daṃḍaiyai nama iti chedayitvā || oṃhrīṃ āṃ hrīṃ kauśiki rudhireṇāpyāyatāmiti devyai nivedyaśeṣaṃ gṛhītvā pūtanāyai carakyai vidāryai pāparākṣastyai nivedya māṣa piṣṭa mayaṃ śatruṃ kṛtvā khaḍgena cedayitvā skaṃdāyaviśākhāyaca datvā bali śeṣaṃ rakṣobhyo haret || mastrastu - hrīṃ sphura sphara kaṃbha kuṃbha sunu sunu gulu gulu dhanu dhanu māraya māraya vidrasaya vidravaya - kaṃpaya kaṃpaya pātaya pātaya kṛṃtaya kṛṃtaya pūrvaya pūraya oṃhrīṃ oṃhruṃ phaṭ phaṭ huṃ mardaya mardaya huṃ iti || tataḥ śeṣeṇa bahirdadyāt - tatra mantaḥ baliṃ gṛhṇatvime devā ādityā vasavastadhā maruto dāśvinau rudrāḥ suparṇrāḥ pannagā grahaḥ | asurāyātudhānāśca piśācoraga rākṣasāḥ || ḍākinno yakṣa bhetāla yoginyaḥ pūtanāḥ śivāḥ | jṛṃbhakā ssiddha gaṃdharvāḥ mālā vidyā dharānagāḥ | dikpāla loka pālāścayeca vighna vināyakāḥ || jagatāṃ śānti kartāro brahmadyāśca mahārṣayaḥ | mā vighnaṃ mācame pāpaṃ mānastu paripanthinaḥ | saumyā bhavantu tṛptāśca bhūtapreta sukhāvahā iti || tataḥ snātvā tilakaṃ dhṛtvā | khaḍginī śūlinī tyakena śūlena pāhine devīti catuṣṭayena | namo devyā iti paṃcakena prārthayet | rūpaṃ dehi yaśodohi bhagaṃ bhagavati dehime | putrān dehi dhanaṃ dehi sarvānkāmāṃśca dehime || mahiṣaghni mahāmāye cāmuṃḍe muṃḍa mālinī | āyurārogya maiśvaryaṃ dehi devi namostute || tataḥ - guhyoti guhya goptṛtvaṃ gṛhāṇāsmatkṛta japaṃ | siddhirbhavatume devi prasādāttava suṃdari || iti devyai nivedya mūlena puṣpeṇa devī mudvāsya nāsayāhṛdi | pratiṣṭhā vibhāṣya suśrītā varadhā bhaveti ṣaḍaṃgaṃ kṛtvā || vavarātre viśeṣaḥ - daśamyāṃ devī visarjayet | maṃtrastu - uttiṣṭha devi caṃḍeśi śubhāṃ pūjāṃ pragṛhyaca | kuruṣva mama kalyāṇamaṣṭa bhiśśukti bissaheti utthāpya | gacca gacca paraṃ sthānaṃ svasthānaṃ devi caṃḍike || vajrasrote jalaṃ vṛddhyai sthīyatāṃca jaletvihā | durgedevi jaganmātaḥ svasthaānaṃ gacca pūjitā || saṃvatsare vyatītetu punarāgama nāyavai | imāṃ pūjāṃ mayādevi yathā śaktyopa pāditāṃ || rakṣārthaṃ tvaṃ samādāya vajra svasthāna muttama mitijale pravāhāyet | tatogniṃ saṃbūjya - vibhūtiṃ dṛtvā gacca gacceti visṛjya sahasra caḍyāṃ sahasramanyatra śathaṃ yadhāśaktivā viprān saṃbhojyayasya smṛtyeti samarpya | pramādātku karvatāmiti japitvā pūrṇatāṃvāca yitvā karmeśvarārpāṇaṃ kṛtvā suhṛdyukto bhuṃjīta || akha kadalī guṣṭapraśava śāntiḥ yenaiva sthāpitovṛkṣaḥ satyasa phalamaśnute | pramātāpūrvadigbhāge raṃbhāsaukhya nivardhanī || dakṣiṇe cārdanāśāya śoka saṃtāpakārakaṃ | paścimesyāddi saṃkrāmaṃ kauberyāṃtu śubhāvahā | agneyādi vidikṣvātra madhyamaṃ phalamucyate | tasya doṣasya śāntyarthaṃ kuryāccāntikamuttamaṃ || duṣṭaprasūtāraṃbhāṃ ca pītavasreṇa veṣṭayet | kuṃcukaṃ kaṃṭha sūtraṃ ca vividhābharaṇaṃ tathā || nivedya kadalīmūle tatastāṃ paripūjayet | tilaścājyena dūravābhirhune daṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ || ato devīti sūktena sūtikāvṛttistadheṣyate | daśadānāni dadyācca ācāryāya kuṭuṃbine || ato devīti sūktena sūtikāvṛtti stadheṣyate | daśadānāni dadyācca acāryāya kuṃṭuṃbine || sarvāriṣṭa praśāstyardhaṃ vittaśāṭhya vivarjitaḥ | tatassā kadalīdayā vipravaryāya dhīmate || dānamaṃntrastu - anurāṇāṃ kulotpannāraṃbhā bāhu phalānvitā | atastava pradānena nantatirmebhivarthatāṃ || ājya saṃpūrikekāṃsye tilataila prapūrite | vilokya pratibiṃbaṃtu dadyādrajata saṃyutaṃ || viprānanyāṃśca saṃntoṣya dakṣiṇādibhirādarāt | evaṃ kṛtevidhānena vighnaśāntiśca jāyate || putrān pautrān priyaṃcaiva labhate nātrasaṃśayaḥ | iti vidhāna mālāyāṃ kadalī duṣṭaprasavaśāṃti vidhānaṃ samāptaṃ || śrīmannārāyaṇākhya ssamajanivibudho rāmakṛṣṇābhidhānaḥ | tatsūnu ssarvavidāṃbudhi nija culakīkāritaḥ kuṃbhajannāṃ | dṛṣṭvā nānānibaṃdhānvya pacaya datulaṃ graṃtha mabjākarākhyaḥ | pitroḥ pādājjabhṛṃgo raghupatipadayoḥ svāśraṃ prāpayaccaḥ || yobhāṭṭa tantragahanārṇava karṇadhāraḥ | śāntrāntareṣu nikhileṣvapi marmabhettā || yotraśrayosti vihitaḥ kamalākareṇa | prītomunāstu sukṛtī budha rāmakṛṣṇaḥ || iti śrīmatpadavākya praṇāṇa pārīṇa rāmeśvarabhaṭṭa sūri sūnu nārāyaṇabhaṭṭa suta mīmāṃsaka rāmakṛṣṇa bhaṭṭātmaja kamalākarabhaṭṭa kṛtaṃ śāntiratnaṃ samāstaṃ|| śrī mṛtyuṃjayāya namaḥ śāṃtikamalākara graṃthasya uttarapīṭhikāyāṃ atha śaunakoktogra ratha śāṃtirlikhyate atha grartha śāṃtiṃca śaunakohaṃ dvijanmanām | pravakṣyāmi samāsena sarvāriṣṭa nivṛttaye || janmataṣṣaṣṭame varṣe mṛtyuṃrugra rathosṛṇām | daśabhistvidiketasmin mṛtyurbhima rathonṛṇām || vijayākhyā ratomṛtyu raṣcasaptatime bhavet | ṣāṇmāsānmṛtyu māpnoti dhanahāniśca nadītīre svagṛhevā śubhasthele | gṛhasye śānadigbhāge maṃṭapaṃ kārayecchubhaṃ || vrīhirāśiṃ vinikṣipya tadarthaṃ taṃḍulaṃ nyaset | tadarthaṃtu tilānnyasya padma maṣṭadalaṃ likhet || madhye likhitvā
