taduttarabhāge mṛtyuṃ jaya pratimāṃdyāyet || mṛtyuṃjaya namastestu vṛṣa vāhana śaṃkara | śamayograradhotpannaṃ jayaṃme phālalocana || m̐bhūḥ mṛtyoḥ pratyadhi devatāṃ mṛtyuṃjaya māvāhayāmi || oṃbhuvaḥ ityādi || tryambakamiti pūjā japaśca || tatpari tassaptacirajāvino'tthāmādīn pūjayet || saptacirajīvi pūjā tatrādau - brahmasūtrojvala bhūjo rājatkṛṣṇācajināsanaḥ | aśvaddhāmā ciraṃjīvi dīrghamāyurdadātume || oṃbhūḥ aśvaddāmānamāvāhayāmītyādi || || balīḥ pātālanilayo dhanurbāṇa dharonṛpaḥ | viṣṇupādāṃkita śirāściraṃjīvī prasīdatu || oṃbhūḥ balimityādi || || vyāsa ssamastadharmāṇāṃ vaktāmunivareḍitaḥ | ciraṃjīvī dīrghamāyurdadātu jaṭilomama || oṃbhūḥ vyāsamityādi || || hamumānrāmapādājja saṃgīvarṇi varaśśiciḥ | saṃcīvanopahartācarogaśāṃtiṃ dadātume || oṃbhūḥ hanumaṃtamityādi || || vibhūṣaṇo dharmaparo rāmarcana parāyaṇaḥ | dadātu cirajīvitvaṃ cirajīvī jiteṃdriyaḥ || oṃbhūḥ vibhūṣaṇamityādi || || kṛpaḥ kṛpāpayorāśistapasvīcīra vastradhṛt | vitanotu prasannātmā yāvajjīva marogatām || oṃbhūḥ kṛpamityādi || || paraśūjjvala hastābjo jaṭāmaṃḍalamaṃḍitaḥ | dadātu cirajīvitvaṃ prasannātmā bhṛgūdvāhaḥ || oṃ bhūḥ paraśūramamityādi || || eteṣāṃ oṃ namo'śvatthāmne itvādinā pūjā japaśca || atra kalpāṃtare nava cirajīvina ityuktaṃ || tadrītya mārkaṃḍeya prahlādaupūjyau || ṣaṣṭivatsara pūjī tataḥ prāgbhāge dvādaśa saṃkhyayā prāgapavargāḥ paṃcavīdyātmikāḥ janma saṃvatsara mārabhya ṣaṣṭivatsara devatā āvāhayet || tattaddhyānāni - akṣādyaṃkita pāṇipadmamabhayaṃ cinmudrikāṃ hastayorbhibhrāṇaṃ caturānanaṃ pravikacatpadmāsanāṃ tataḥ stitam || vakṣobhāga virājamānaviśada śrī brahmasūtrojjvalaṃ vaṃdehaṃ prabhavābhidaṃ kamalajaṃ śreyobhivṛddhipradaṃ || oṃ bhūḥ prabavābda devatāṃ kamalaja māvāhayāmi || || bhāsvatkirīṭaṃ varacakra śārjga gadābhīrāmai ssahitaṃ caturbhiḥ | karaipanantāsana sanniviṣṭaṃ dhyāyedhrameśaṃ vibhavābhidānam || oṃ bhūḥ vibhuva devatāṃ rameśa māvāhayāmi || || jaṭila muragabhūṣā bhūṣitāṃgaṃ trinetraṃ śaśidhara makucāntaṃ vyāghracarmottarīyaṃ | vṛṣavarakṛtavāhaṃ śuklasaṃjñaṃ girīśaṃ namadamaramūnīṃdraṃ sūlapāṇiṃ namāmi || oṃ bhūḥ śuklasaṃvatsara devatāṃ śūlapāṇi māvāhayāmi || || karīndravaktraṃ kanadekadaṃtojjvalaṃ pramodadūta kṛtābhidhānaṃ | pratyūhaśāṃti pradamākhu saṃsthaṃdhyāmeddṛdhajje satataṃ gaṇeśaṃ || oṃbhūḥ pramoduta saṃvatsara devatāṃ gaṇeśa māvāhayāmi || || daṃtīṃdra vaktraṃka gatāṃ suśaktiṃ catarurbhajāṃ caṃdrakalāvataṃsāṃ | bhakteṣṭapādhonadhi pūrṇacaṃdraṃ vaṃde prajotpatti kṛtābhi dānan || oṃbhūḥ pajotpatti saṃvatsara devatāṃ śakti māvāhayāmi || || śaktyulaika bāhuṃ śaśadharamakuṭaṃ mayūramārūḍhaṃ aṃgīsābhidānaṃ ṣaṇmumīḍe'mareṃndra sevānyam || oṃ bhūḥ aṃgīrasābdadevatāṃ ṣaṇmukha māvāhayāmityādi || || caṃdramukhīṃ cārudṛśaṃ kukkuṭavāhaṃ guhādṛtā maniśam | śrīmukhasaṃjñāṃ vallīṃ śreyovṛddhi pradāmahaṃ kalaye || oṃ bhūḥ śrīmukha saṃvatsara devatāṃ vallīmāvāhayāmi || || gaurīṃ girīṃdratanayāṃ vvaṣavarasaṃsthāṃ kalādharāṃ śaśinaḥ | bhāvākhyāmahamīḍe bhavakutukāmbodi pūrṇacaṃdraṃtāṃ || oṃ bhūḥ bhāvasaṃvatsara devatāṃ gaurīmāvāhayāmityādi || || yusaṃjñā mahamīḍe brahmiṃ brahmādivaṃditāṃghrīṃyugām | haṃsavarārūḍhāṃ tāṃ śambhumanohari rūpasaubhāgyam || oṃ bhūḥ yavasaṃvatsara devatāṃ brahmī māvāhayāmītyādi || || maheśvarī hṛdabdevilasatu satataṃ ca dhātu saṃjñāme | caṃdrāvataṃsa sahitā śreyovṛddhi pradā sadā śaṃbhoḥ || oṃ bhūḥ dhātu saṃvatsara devatāṃ māheśvarī māvāhayāmi || || kaumārī mahā miḍe saṃpaḍdātrīṃ sadā śukāruḍhām | tā mīśvarābhi dhānāṃ śaṃkaratoṣa pradāṃ svarūpeṇa || oṃ bhūḥ īśvara saṃvatsara devatāṃ kaumārī māvāhayāmi || || bahudhānyanāma deyāṃ satataṃ hṛdayena vaiṣṇavīṃ kalaye | śaṅkara vāmāṃkasthāṃ namatā miṣṭārdha dāyikā maniśaṃ || oṃ bhūḥ bahudhānya saṃvatsara devatāṃ vaiṣṇavī māvāhayāmi || || vārāhīṃ praṇa māmo dhūrjaṭi harṣābdi pūrṇacaṃdrāṃtām | yaśrayobhi vṛddidhātrīṃ kṛta nija nāmnīṃ pramādhīti || oṃ bhūḥ bhūḥ pramādhi saṃvatsara devatāṃ vārāhī māvāhayāmi || || māheṃdrīṃ ravayāmo virkama saṃjñāṃ vṛṣāsanārūḍhāṃ | viṣanāmmiṃ saruvaṃdyāṃ daityakula dhvaṃsakāriṇī maniśaṃ || oṃ bhūḥ viṣṇusaṃvatsara cāmuṃḍā māvāhayāmi || || erogāhvaya mīḍehaṃ citra bhāmaṃ sadāmude | turagaṃ mavarārūḍhaṃ makuṭaujvalahastaṃ || oṃ bhūḥ citrabhānu saṃvatsara devatā māroga māvāhayāmi || || ārogya siddhidaṃ nṛṇāṃ svabhānuṃ bhrāja saṃjñitam | gajārūḍhāṃ lasatkhaḍgakheṭa hastaṃ samāmyaham || oṃ bhūḥ svabhānu saṃvatsara devatāṃ bhrāja māvāhayāmi || || aṃtarhṛdabjesatataṃ kalaye paṭarāhvayam | tāruṇaṃ sūryagamanaṃ śūlodbhāsi karaṃbhaje || oṃ bhūḥ tāraṇa saṃvatsara devatāṃ paṭaramāvāhayāmi || || pataṃgaṃ patāṃgāruḍhaṃ pārthivāhvaya māśraye | śaṃkha cakradharaṃ divyapītāmbara mahaṃ bhaje || oṃ bhūḥ pūrthivasaṃvatsara devatāṃ pataṃgamāvāhayāmītyādi || || svarṇaraṃ kokilāruḍhaṃvyaya saṃjñakramāśraye | caṃdāvaṃtaṃsaṃjaṭilaṃ triṇaetraṃ śūlabhāsuraṃ | oṃ bhūḥ vyaya saṃvatsara devatāṃ svarṇamāvāhayāmi || || sarvajitsaṃjñakaṃ vaṃde jyotiṣīmaṃtamiṣṭadaṃ | bhruśuṃḍī pāśahastājjaṃ vyāghrārūḍhaṃ trilocanaṃ || oṃ bhūḥ sarvajitsaṃvatsaradevatāṃ jyotiṣīmaṃtamāvāhayāmi || || vibāsanāmakara bhānuṃ sarvadhārikṛtāhvayam | iṣṭaprāstyai sadāvaṃde sapāśva radhamāsthitam || oṃ bhūḥ sarvadhāri saṃvatsara devatāṃ vibhāsamāvāhayāmi || || meruśṛṃgāsanasthaṃtaṃ virodhi kṛtanāmakam | kaśyapaṃ paṃcavadanaṃ daśahastaṃ samāmyaham || oṃ bhūḥ virodhi saṃvatsara devatāṃ kaśyapamāvāhayāmi || || raviṃ vikṛtināmānaṃ triśīrṣaṃ ṣaḍbhujaṃ bhaje pannageśvaramārūḍhaṃ cārupītāṃbarāvṛtaṃ || oṃ bhūḥ vikṛti saṃvatsara devatāṃ ravimāvāhayāmi || || sūryābhidhaṃ kharaṃ vaṃde catuvaktraṣṭahastakam || khagavaryasamārūḍhaṃ nīlāṃbara samāvṛtaṃ | oṃ bhūḥ kharasaṃvatsara devatāṃ sūryamāvāhayamāmi || || bhānuṃ nandananāmānaṃ bhāsācārupariṣkṛtaṃ | mṛgendravāhanaṃ paṃcavaktraṃ daśabhūjaṃ bhaje || oṃ bhūḥ nandana saṃvatsara devatāṃ bhūnu māvāhayāmityādi || || ṣaṇmukhaṃ dvādaśabhūjaṃ vyāghrāhana māśritam | vyāghracarmāmbaraṃ vaṃde khagaṃ vijayasaṃjñakaṃ || oṃ bhūḥ vijayadevatāṃ khṛgamavāhayāmi || || pūṣaṇaṃ jayanāmānaṃ jayadaṃ bhaktasantate | śaṃkha cakrāṃkita karadvandvaṃ hṛdi samāśraye || oṃ bhūḥ jayābdadevatāṃ pūṣaṇamavāhayāmi || || haṃsavaryādhirūḍhataṃ vīṇāmaṃḍita hastakam | hiramyagarbhaṃ vadehaṃ mannadākhya maniṣṭah‌ || oṃ bhūḥ manmada saṃvatsaradevatāṃ hiraṇyagarbha māvāhayāmi || || marīciḥ durmukhākhyānaṃ manyuṃ markaṭamāśritam | vivṛtāsyaṃ jagadbhītidāyakaṃ saṃśrayemude || oṃ bhūḥ durmukhārdidevatāṃ marīcimāvāhayamāmi || || ādityaṃ tejasāṃ sthānaṃ hevilambi kṛtāhvayam | saptasaptisamārūḍhaṃ jagatāṃ netra māśraye || oṃ bhūḥ heviśamci saṃvatsaradevatā mādityamāvāhayāmi || || vilambi saṃjñaṃ manasā savitāraṃ smarāmyahaṃ | cāpabāṇa dharaṃdorbyāṃtu rajgavara vāhanam || oṃ bhūḥ vilaṃbi saṃvatsara devatāṃ savitāra māvāhāyāmi || || arka vikārināmānaṃ karkaṃti krakacāyudham | krura vyāghrasamārūḍha mekanetraṃ samāmyahaṃ || oṃ bhūḥ vikārināma saṃvatsara devatāmarka māvāhayāmi || || bāskaraṃ śārvarī saṃjñaṃ bhāṣāpūrita diṅmakham | cakrojvalakaraṃvaṃde bhāsvadratha samāśrayaṃ || oṃ bhūḥ śārvari devatāṃ bhāskara māvāhayāmi || | agniṃ namāmi satataṃ jvālā mālataṃ mopaham | ajāruḍhaṃ carurhastaṃ dviśīrṣaṃplava saṃjñikam || oṃ bhūḥ plavasaṃvatsaradevatā magni māvāhayāmītyādi || || jātaveda samījehaṃ śubhakṛnnāmakaṃ sadā | āṃdolikā samāruḍhaṃ khaḍgakheṭa dharaṃ śubhaṃ || oṃ bhūḥ śubhakṛtsaṃ vatsara devatāṃ jātaveda samāvāhayāmi || || sahojasaṃ śobakṛtaṃ nṛṇāmiṣṭada māśraye | śibikā vāvānāruḍhaṃ vāmaradva bhūpāṇikam || oṃ bhūḥ śobhakṛddhetavatāṃ sahojanamāvāhayāmi || || ajirā prabhūmīḍehaṃ krodhīkṛta nāmakam | goradhā rūḍhamaniśaṃ kuṃtojvala kadhāṃbūjaṃ || oṃ bhūḥ krodi devatāṃ majirā prabhu māvāhayāmītyādi || || vaiśvānaraṃ bhaje nityaṃ viśvāvasu kṛtāhvayaṃ | naravāhanamārūḍaṃ khaḍgakheṭa dharaṃ vibhūm || oṃ bhūḥ viśvāvasuvatpara devatāṃ vaiśvanara māvāhayāmi || || parābhavāhvayaṃ vaṃde narāyapasamudarciṣaṃ | uttuṃga turagārūḍhaṃ paraśūjjvali pāṇikam || oṃ bhūḥ parābhava saṃvatsara devatāṃ naryāpasa māvāhayāmi || || vajkirādha samīḍegniṃ plavaṃga iti viśṛtaṃ | śvetāśva vāhanārūḍhaṃ śārṅabāṇa dharaṃ sadā || oṃ bhūḥ plavaṃga devatāṃ paṅkirādha samāvāhayāmi || || visarpiṇaṃ hutavahaṃ kīlakāhvaya māśraye | uttuṃga gajamārūḍhaṃ śūlojvali karāṃ caliṃ || oṃ bhūḥ kīlaka saṃvatsara devatāṃ visarpiṇa māvāhayamāmi || || matsyamūrti hariṃ vaṃde śirasā saumya saṃjñikam | śaṃkha cakrojvalakaraṃ bhaktyābīṣṭa pradāyakaṃ || oṃ bhūḥ saumyasaṃvatsara devatāṃ matsyamūrti māvāhayāmītyādi || || kūrmākṛti mahaṃ vaṃde mandarācaladhāriṇam | kaumodakī śārjgahastaṃ sādhāraṇa kṛtāhvayam || oṃ bhūḥ sādhārama devatāṃ kūrma māvāhayāmi || || daṃṣṭrārūḍha mahībhāgaṃ kroḍarūpadharaṃ rahim | varadābhayadaṃ vaṃde virodhikṛdi tiśrūtaṃ || oṃ bhūḥ virodhikṛdṭevatāṃ varāha māvāhayāmi || || sṛkesari tanuṃvaṃde hariṃ staṃbhavidāraṇam | prahlādiharṣadātāraṃ harim | balipratāramakaraṃ pramādīca kṛtāhvayam || oṃ bhūḥ pramādīca saṃvatsara devatāṃ vāmana māvāhamītyādi || || jagadānaṃda janakaṃ sītāvallabha māśraye | rāmamānaṃda nāmānaṃ dhṛtakodaṃḍa mārgaṇaṃ || oṃ bhūḥ anaṃda saṃvatsara devatāṃ rāma māvāhayāmītyādi || || kūṭhāraprojvalakaraṃ jaṭāmaṃḍala maṃḍitaṃ | bhārgavaṃ rāmamāśāne rākṣasābhidhamaṃjasā || oṃ bhūḥ rākṣasa saṃvatsara devatāṃ bhārgavarāma māvāhayāmi || || sīrodbhāsikarāṃ bhojaṃ nīlāṃbara samāvṛtaṃ | balarāma mahaṃvaṃde nīlāhvayaharniśam || oṃ bhūḥ naradevatāṃ balarāmamāvāhayāmi || || kṛṣṇaṃ paṃgalanāmānaṃ barhibarhojvalākṛtim | navanītojvalakaraṃ nṛtyaṃtaṃ hṛdi saṃśraye || oṃ bhūḥ piṃgala devatāṃ kṛṣma māvāhayāmi || || mleccāvali kṛtadveṣaṃ kālayukti kṛtāhvayam | āśraye karkamārūḍhaṃ danurbāṇadharaṃ sadā || oṃ bhūḥ kālayukti devatāṃ kalkina māvāhayāmītyādi || || siddārdhikṛtanāmānaṃ huddhākṛtimahaṃ bhaje | nagnaṃ vipapavapuruṣaṃ strī pradarśanakāraṇam || oṃ bhūḥ siddhārdhidevatāṃ buddhamāvāhayāmityādi || || durgāṃ vipattidutaye raudrīti kṛtasaṃjñikām | dhyāyāmidaityahaṃtrīṃ tāṃ raktasvādana tatparām || oṃ bhūḥ raudri saṃvatsaradevatāṃ durgā māvāhayāmītyādi || || yātu dānaṃ vakramukha mekākṣaṃ dāruṇākṛtim | dhyāyāmyaniṣṭaśāṃtyarthaṃ durmatīti kṛtāhvayam || oṃ bhūḥ durmati devatāṃ yātudhānamāvāhayāmītyādi || || duṃdubhīti kṛtābhyāsaṃ samastaripubhairavam | bhāravaṃ śvavarādhūḍhaṃ digaṃbara mupāśraye || oṃ bhūḥ duṃdubhi devatāṃ bhairavamāvāhayāmityāti || || hanumaṃtaṃ vāyusutaṃ rudhirodgādi saṃjñākam | samudralaṃghanodyuktaṃ ghanodyuktaṃ dhīrghalāṃgūla māśraye || oṃ bhūḥ rudhirodgāri saṃvatsaradevatāṃ hanumaṃtamāvāhāyāmityādi || || sarasvatīṃ bhāsamāna vīṇojjvala karāṃbujām | raktākṣi saṃjñikāṃ devīṃ prapadye vāgvi bhūtidām || oṃ bhūḥ raktākṣi saṃvatsara devatāṃ sarasvatīmāvāhayāmityādi || || dhākṣāyaṇī krodhanābhyāṃ dakṣatratu kūrapriyām | śukā rūḍhāśūla dharāṃ bhaje'bhīṣṭhasya siddaye || oṃ bhūḥ krodhana saṃvatsara devatāṃ dākṣāyaṇīmāvāhayāmityādi || || prapadhyekṣaya saṃkhyānāṃ lakṣmīṃ kṣīrābdi kanyakāṃ | haṃsārūḍhāmiṃdumukhīṃ pāṇidvaya kṛtāṃbujām || oṃ bhūḥ kṣaya saṃvatsaradevatāṃ lakṣmī māvāhayāmi || || eteṣāṃ oṃ bhūḥ prabhavā yetyādinā pūjā japaśca || āyana ṛtu māsadhyānādi prathana dakṣiṇadigbhāge dakṣiṇāyana devatāṃ varṣādi ṛtutrayadevatāḥ karkaṭakādi māsa ṣaṭka devatāśca vāhayet || daduttaradigbhāge udagayana devatāṃ śaśirādi ṛtutraya devatāḥ | makarāda māsaṣaṭka devatāścā vāhayet || tattaddhyānāni - śreyase bhūyase nityaṃ dakṣiṇāyana māśraye | bhāsvadratha gataṃ sūryacandra nakṣatra saṃnṛtam | oṃ bhūḥ dakṣiṇāyana māvāhayāmītyādi || || kleśāpanuttaye nityamuttarāyaṇa māśraye | divyaṃ nyandasamārūḍhaṃ sūryādigraha saṃyutaṃ || oṃ bhūḥ uttarāyaṇamāvāhayāmi || || śirasāpraṇamāmyadyavarṣāharṣa pradāyikāḥ | brasīniviṣṭā ssatataṃ dakṣiṇāmukha mākṣitāḥ || oṃ bhūḥ varṣaṛtumāvāhayāmi || || śārado bhavitāhyasmatprārdhitānāṃ pradāyakaḥ ṛtuḥ pratyaṅmakhāsīnaḥ sphāṭikaṃ valayaṃvahan || oṃ bhūḥ śaradṛtumāvāhayāmi || || hemāntaṛtarasmāka mudaṅmaka mūpāśritaḥ | śikhīyajñopavīti ca prasīdatu śubhapradaḥ || oṃ bhūḥ hemaṃtaṛtu māvāhayāmi || || śiśiraṃ śirasānaumi ṛtumārthamukhaṃ sthitaṃ | sūryabiṃbāhitadṛśaṃ paṃcākṣara japodyatam || oṃ bhūḥ śiśiraṛtu māvāhayāmi || || vasantamṛtu mīḍehaṃ vasantaṃ vyāghracarmaṇī | akṣamālojvalakaraṃ brahmasūtra vibhūṣitaṃ || oṃ bhūḥ vasantaṛtu māvāhayāmi || || grīṣmaṃ prāṅmukhamāsīnaṃ viṣṭaremunipūjite | kamaṃḍalūjjvalakaraṃ namāmi śirasānvaham || oṃ bhūḥ grīṣmaṛtu māvāhayāmi || || adhamāsa devatāḥ - dviśīrṣa kaṃcaturhastaṃ pannageśvara vāhanam | upāsmaheśuciṃ māsaṃ bhaktābhīṣṭapradāyakam || oṃ bhūḥ śucimāsayāmi || || caturmukhaṃ cāṣṭabhujaṃ varāha varavāhanaṃ | nabhomāsa namāmyadyakaiśā nāmapanuttaye || oṃ bhūḥ nabhomāsa māvāhayāmi || || paṃcavaktraṃ daśabhūjaṃ sāraṅgapravarasthitam | namāmyahaṃ nabhasyākhyaṃ māsamiṣṭasyasiddhaye || oṃ bhūḥ nabhasyamāsa māsamāvāhayāmi || || ṣaṇmukhaṃ dvādaśabhūjaṃ bhallūka varasaṃsthitam | bhaktābhīṣṭapradaṃ nityamiṣaṃmāsa mupāsmahe || oṃ bhūḥ iṣamāsa māvāhayāmi || || triṇetraṃ cārujaṭilaṃ cāru caṃdrārthaśekharam | kailāsaśukharārūḍha mūrjaṃ māsa mupāsmahe || oṃ bhūḥ ūrjamāsa māvāhayāmītyādi || || vṛṣārūḍhaṃ śūlapāṇiṃ pramathāvali sevitam | namāmi śirasā devaṃ sahākhyaṃ māsa manvaham || || śārikā vāhanārūḍhaṃ khaḍgakheṭa lasatkaram | dyāyāmi manasānityaṃ sahasyaṃ māsamādarāt || || candrahasojvalakaraṃ śaka pravara vāhanam | dyāyāmīṣṭakṛte nityaṃ tapo māsa mananyadhīḥ || || tapasyaṃ māsamīḍehaṃ kokila pravara sthitam | brahmasūtrojvalāṃ saṃca kirīṭāṃ cita mastakaṃ || || śaṃkha cakrojjvala karaṃ kirīṭodbhāsi mastakam | jagadānanda janakaṃ madhumāsa mupāsmahe || || kaumedakī śārjadharaṃ māsaṃ mādhava saṃjñakaṃ | garutmadvāhana gataṃ vande'bhīṣṭasya siddaye || || triśīrṣaṃ ṣaḍbhujaṃ bhrahmasūtrojjvala bhūjāṃtaram | vyāgravāhana mārūḍhaṃ śukraṃ māsa mupāsmahe || || yeteṣāmonna maśśuci māsāyotyādinā pūjā japaśca || pradhānasyāgneyadigbhāge pakṣa depate āvāhayet || dinedineca gīrvāṇairvahnīndra yamapūrvakaiḥ | āpūryamāṇa pakṣauya namaśśvetavapuṣmate || oṃ bhūḥ śukla pakṣaddevatāṃmindhumāvāhayāmi || iṃdurdevānāṃ - mahate saubhagāyeti yaddavā itivā pūjā japaśca || || dine dine devagaṇān puṣṇate'mṛtadhārayā | asitāya namastestupitṛ prīti karāyavai | oṃ bhūḥ kṛṣṇapakṣa devatāṃ sūrya māvāhayāmi || kṛṣṇāyadgoṣṛruṇīṣu - āsmṛtadru iti - imaṃ yamaitivā pūjā japaśca || || prathamādi tithi devatā dhyānādi pakṣadevatā dakṣiṇa digbhege tithi devatā āvāhayet || ehisākṣādihāgnetvaṃ devānāṃ havyavāhaka | śāṃtikarmaṇi pūjārthametā mūrtiṃ samāviśa || oṃ bhūḥ pratipattithi devatā magniṃ āvāhayāmi || āgnenayoti pūjā japasca || || tvaṣṭarjagattrayī dhātarihehi dayayā mahīm | pratimāyāmamuṣyāṃtvaṃ saṃnithatsva caturmukha || oṃ bhūḥ dvitīyā tithi devatāṃ brahmaṇaṃ āvāhayāmi || brahmadevānāmiti pūjā japaśca || || pratimāyāṃ hiraṇmayyāmehi parvata kanyake | namasyāmi padābjaṃte pumardha pratipattaye || oṃ bhūḥ tṛtīyā tithi devatāṃ gaurī māvāhayāmi || ṛcigaurīrmimāyeti || yajuṣī gaurī mimāyeti pūjā japaśca || || vighnaṃdhakāra bālārka pārvatimalasaṃbhava | gajānanārcāṃ gṛhmaṣva pratimāyāṃ niṣīdabho || oṃ bhūḥ caturthītidhi devatāṃ gaṇeśaṃ āvāhāyāmi || gaṇānāṃtveti pūjā japaśca || || sarpabhyohi mayāhutaḥ pratimāyāṃ kṛtādaraḥ | pūjayāmi padāṃbhojaṃ sarva saṃpada vāpteya || oṃ bhūḥ paṃcamītithi devatāṃ sarpānāvāyāmi || namo āstu sarpebhya iti pūjā japaśca || || ṣaḍānana namasyāṃte karavāṇi padābjayoḥ | pratimāyāṃ hiraṇmayyā mehivallī manaḥ priya | ṣaṣṭhītithi devatāṃ ṣaṇmukhaṃ mavāhayāmi || kumāraṃ mātā yuvatiriti pūjā japaśca || || sahasra bhāno caṃḍāṃśo pratimāmehi sādaraṃ | trayītanonamasyāṃte bhūyo bhūyaḥ karomyaham || saptamī tithi devātaṃ ādityaṃ || ākṛṣṇeneti āsatyenetivā pūjā japaśca || || savyojāta namastestu gaurīnātha jagatpate| prasādaṃ kurume śaṃbho pratimāṃ prapnuhinabho| aṣṭamī tithi devatāṃ rudraṃ || sadyo jātamiti pūjā japaśca |||| dirge trinayane caṃdrakalāṃcita śiroruhe ihāgatya prasādaṃmmeracayāśu maheśvari|| navamī tithi devatāṃ durgā - jātavedasa iti pūjā japaśca |||| bhubhāra bhugnagravāya viśṇu pādāṃka maulaye|namo namostu nāgāya pratimā mohi satvaraṃ||daśamī tithi devatā mādi śeśaṃ - yā iṣapa iti pujā japaśca|||| śrutivedya svarūpāya yāgādi kṛtumurtaye |bhuriśreya ssadhanāya dharmaya mahate namaḥ||ekādaśī tithi devatā dharma - oṃ namo dharmayaiti pūjā japaśca |||| hāre jagajñatrayādhīśa lakṣmīvallabha mādhavaḥ |pratimāmetya sabasāprasādaṃ kurume prabho|| dvādaśītithi devatāṃ viśṇuṃ - harigaṃ harate mita pujā japaśca |||| rati vallabha puṣāstra nārayaṇa tanūdbhavaḥ| ehimāṃ pratimāṃ turṇaṃ prasīdamayi manmadha|trayodaśī tithi devatāṃ kāma - oṃ namaḥ kāmayaiti pujā japaśca|| sarva dharma prahartāraṃ sarva pāpa pravartakaṃ| paṃcanā caturaṃ vaṃde bhūtayo kalibhūpatiṃ || caturdaśītithi kalidevatāṃ kali māvāhayāmi|| oṃnamaḥ kalayaiti pūjā japaśca|||| sarvagīrvāṇa sevyaya lakṣmī kāmakacakṣuṣe | kṣirābdi priyaputrāya namaścandamanestame|| purṇimā tithidevatāṃ candramāvāhayāmi|| apyayanveti puja japaśca|||| pitruloka nivāsibhaḥ pitrubhostu namonamaḥ | pratimāṃ prapya sauvarṇīṃ prasīdaṃtu sadāmayi|| amavāsya tithīdevatāṃ pitrunāvāhayāmi|| punarmaḥ pitara iti pujā japaśca|||| pakṣa devatā paścīmadigbhāge vāradevatā avāhayet |āditya iṃdu raṃgāro budhaścaiva bṛhaspatiḥ|śukraśśaniḥ kramādete kadhitā vāradevatā|||| agnyapo bhūmi viṣṇvaṃdrāṃ idrāṇīca prajāpatiḥ || bhanvādi vārādūśānāṃ kramokta adhidevatāḥ|||| sivo durgā gṛhoviśṇurbrahmedraḥ iṃdrāṇica prajāpatiḥ || bhānvādi vārādhīśānāṃ kramoktā adhidevatāḥ|||| bhānvādi vārābhimāni devatā dhyanakramaḥ - vṛṣārūḍhaṃ śūlāpāṇiṃ pramādā parinevitaṃ| śirasā praṇāmā myadya ravivāradipaṃ devātāṃ śivamāvāhayāmityādi|||| durgāṃ vipattidutaye bhujāśṭaka vibhuśitāṃ| dhyāyāmi daityahaṃtriṃ tāṃ raktāsvādana tatparām|| oṃ bhūḥ iduvarābhimāni devatā durgā māvāhayāmi|||| śaktyu jjvālai kabāhuṃ śaśidharamakuṭaṃ mayāramāruḍhaṃ aṃgārakādhināthaṃ ṣaṇmukha māvāhayāmi|||| bhasvātkirīṭaṃ kabāhuṃ śaśidharamakuṭaṃ mayūrāmārūḍhaṃ |agāra kādhināthaṃ ṣaṇmukha mīḍemareṃdrase nyānaṃ || oṃ bhūḥ bhaumanārābhimāni devatāṃ viṣṇu māvāhayāmi || || caturmukha ścaturbāhuḥ kamaṃḍalvakṣasūtra bhṛt | varābhaya karaśśuddho guruvārādhipo mataḥ | oṃ bhūḥ guruvārābhimāni devatāṃ brahmaṇamāvāhayāmi || || iṃdraṃ gajavarāruḍhaṃ vajraṃkuśa varābhayam | karaiścatubhirdadhataṃ śukrādhīśvara māśraye || oṃ bhūḥ śukravārābhimāni devatāṃ miṃdramāvāhayāmi || || pāśa daṃḍojjvala bujadvayaṃ māhiṣavāhayanaṃ | yamaṃ nīlatanuṃ bhīmaṃ śanivārādhipaṃ bhaje || oṃ bhūḥśanivārābhimāni devātaṃyama māvāhayāmi || || aṣṭavasvekādaśa rudra dhyānādi tatpaścimabhāge aṣṭau devāvasava iti matreṇāṣṭa vasudevatā āvāhayet || tattadhyānakramaḥ - akṣamālādharaṃ bhrahmasūtrojjvala bhujāṃtaraṃ | dhrūvāya yaśa drumasecistayāmi sadā mudā || oṃ namo dhṛvāyeti pūjā japaśca || || sṛksruvāṃka kapadvaṃdaṃvaṃ vyāghracarmāṃbaraṃ śuciṃ | agniśuśrūvaṇarata madhvaraṃ hṛdi khāvaye || oṃ namo'dhvarāyeti pūjā japaśca || || jagadānandajanaka mamṛtasrāvicakṣuṣaṃ | ratnisaṃhāsana gataṃsomaṃ hṛdibhāvaye || oṃ namossomāyeti pūjā japaśca || || sarvapāpa vināśipyassamudra premapūritāḥ āpaśśubhapradāssaṃtu matsyavāhana saṃgatāḥ oṃ namodbhya iti pūjā japaśca || || śubhāyame sadābhūyādanilo lokapāvanaḥ | samasta devanivahasaṃdyamāna padāṃbujaḥ | oṃ namonilāyeti pūjā japaśca || || adhirūḍhaṃ śubhadaṃ svāhādevī samanvitaṃ | kirīṭojjvamūrdhā namanalaṃ bhāvayāmyahaṃ || oṃ namo'nalāyeti pūjā japaśca || || śvetavastradharaṃ śveta candanāliptadehakam || pratyuṣaṃ cintayobhūyuḥ pratyūhonmūlakāraṇaṃ || oṃ namo pratyuṣāyeti pūjā japaśca || || vasudevatā dakṣiṇabhāge kudrudrāyeti maṃtreṇa ekādaśa rudrānāvāhāyet || tattadhyānāni - dakṣvādhara dhvaṃsa karaḥ koparūpa mūkhāṃbujaḥ | śūlapāṇi ssukhāyāstu vīrabhadro mamāniśaṃ || oṃ namovīrabhadrāyeti pūjā japaśca || || brahma viṣṇu girīśāna devadānava rākṣasāḥ | yasmātrpajajñire devāstaṃ śaṃbhuṃ praṇamāmyahaṃ || oṃ namośśaṃbhava iti pūjā japaśca || || kailāsa śikhara prodyanmaṇi maṃdiramadhyagaḥ | girīśo girijā prāṇavallabostu mudemama || oṃ namogirīśāyeti pūjā japaśca || || tisṛṇāṃca pūrāṃhaṃtā kṛtāntamadabhaṃjasaḥ | khaḍgapāṇistīkṣṇadaṃṣṭobhairavostu mudemama || oṃ namobhairavāyeti pūjā japaśca || || kṣamāradha samārūḍhaṃ brahmasūtra samanvitaṃ | caturvedāśaavasahitaṃ pināki namahaṃbhaje || oṃ namopinākina iti pūjā japaśca || || vāmājgakṛta saṃveśa giri kanyā subhāvaham | sthāṇuṃ samāni sirasā sarvedava namaskṛtaṃ || oṃ namosthamapa iti pūjā japaśca || || caṃdrāvataṃ sojaṭilaṃ strīṇetrobhanmapāṃḍaraḥ | hṛdayāsthassadā bhūyādbargo bhaya vināśanaḥ || oṃ namo bhargāyeti pūjā japaśca || || brahmābhūtvā sṛjan lokaṃ viṣṇurbhūtvāca pālayan || rudro bhūtvā harannaṃte gatirmestu sadāśivaḥ || oṃ namossadāśivāyeti pūjā japaśca || || yodīrndanuta pādāhjaṃdvaṃntvātīta janāśrayaṃ | vedānta kṛta saṃcāraṃ smarāriṃ śaraṇaṃ bhaje || oṃ namosmṛrāraya iti pūjā japaśca || || grāyaśrī prati pādyāya oṃkāra kṛta sadmane | kalyāṇa guṇadhāmneca śivāya nihitānatiḥ || oṃ namośśivāyeti pūjā japaśca || || āśīviṣairhara kṛte devauṣu praṇatāṃghraye | vinākāṃkita hastāyaharāyāstu namaskriyā || oṃ namo harāyeti pūjā japaśca || || rudra devatā paścimabhāge nakṣatra yogakaraṇa devatā āvāhayet || kṣa tra de va tā dhyā nā di kṛttikādi krameṇa - kṛttikāhyagni daivatyā meṣavāhana saṃsthitāḥ | srutsruvābhīti varadhṛccaturhastāna māmyaham || kṛttikānakṣatra devatāmagni māvāhayāmi || agnirnaḥ pātvīti pūjā japaśca || || prajāpati ścaturbāhuḥ kamaṃḍalvakṣa sūtra dhṛt | varābhaya karaśśuklo rohiṇedevatāstume | rohiṇī nakṣatradevatāṃ prajāpati māvāhayāmi | prajāpate rohiṇī vetviti pūjā japaśca || || śveta varṇākṛti ssomodvibhūjo varadaṃta bhṛt | daśāśvaradhamārūḍho mṛgaśīrṣostumemude || somorājeti pūjā japaśca || || rudraśśveta vṛṣārūḍha śśvetamālya ścaturbhujaḥ | śūlakaḍhgā bhayavarān dadhānome prasīdatu || ārdrā nakṣatra devatāṃ rudra māvāhayāmi || ārdrayo rudra iti pūjā japaśca || || aditiḥ pīḍavarṇāca sruksravaṃ darbha saṃyutaṃ | dadhānā śubhadābhūyā tpunarvasu kṛtāhvayā || punarno devīti pūjā japaśca || || vaṃde bṛhaspatiṃ puṣya devatāṃ mānuṣā kṛtiṃ | sarvābharaṇasaṃpannaṃ devamantiṇa mādarāt || puṣya nakṣatra devatāṃ bṛhaspati māvāhayāmi || bṛhaspatiḥ pradhamamiti pūjā japaśca || || sarporakta triṇetraśca phalarāsi karadvayaḥ | āśreṣā devatāpītāṃbara dhṛdvaradontume || idagaṃ sarvebhya iti pūjā japaśca || || pitaraḥ piṃḍahastāśca kṛśādhūmrāḥ pavitriṇaḥ | kuśalaṃ dadyulasmākaṃ maghā nakṣatra devatāḥ || upahutāḥ pitara iti pūjā japaśca || || saṃpūja yāmyarya maṇaṃ phalguvītāra devatān || dhūmravarma rathārūḍhaṃ saśaktikara saṃyutam || pūrvāphalgunī devatāṃ sūryamāvāhayāmu || gavāṃ vatiriti pūjā japaśca || || bhagaṃvara radhārūḍhaṃ dvibhujaṃ śaṃkha cakriṇaṃ | phalgunī devatāṃdhyāye dbhaktābhīṣṭa varapradaṃ || uttarāphalgunī nakṣatradevatāṃ bhagamāvāhayāmi || śreṣṭho devānāmiti pūjā japaśca || || savitāra mahaṃvaṃde saptāśaavaratha vāhanam | padmānanasthaṃ chāyeśaṃ hastānakṣatra devatām || āyutu devassavitopayātviti pūjājapaśca || || tvaṣṭāraṃ radhamārūḍhaṃ cittānakṣatra devatāṃ | śaṃkha cakrānvitakaraṃ kirīṭina mahaṃbhaje || tvaṣṭā nakṣatra mabhyetīti pūjā || || vāyuṃ mṛgavarārūḍhaṃ svātī nakṣatra devatāṃ | kheṭa carmojjvala karidvitayaṃ praṇamāmyahaṃ || vāyurnakṣatra miti pūjā || || iṃdrīgnī śubhadau syātāṃviśākhā devate ubhau | namomyeka rathā rūḍhau varābhīti karāṃbūjau || viśākhā nakṣatra devate iṃdrāgī māvāhayāmi || dura masma ccatrava iti pūjā || || mitraṃ padmāsanārūḍha manūrādheśvaraṃ bhaje | śūlāṃguśa dharaṃ bāhvoḥ devaṃ śoṇitavarṇakam || ṛdhyāsmahavyairiti pūjā || || iṃdraṃ gajavarā rūḍhaṃ vajrapāśa varābhayam | karaiścaturbhirdhadhataṃ jyeṣṭhaṃdhīśvara māśraye || iṃdro jyeṣṭhāmiti pūjā || || karāla vadanaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ yātu dhānaṃ nṛvāhanaṃ | ūrdhvakeśaṃ virūpākṣaṃ bhaje mūlādhi devatām || mūlaṃ prajāmiti pūjā || || āṣāḍhā devatā nityamāva ssaṃtu śubha pradāḥ | samudra gāstaraṃgiṇyaḥ pāvinya ssarvadehinām || pūrvāṣāḍā nakṣatra devatā apa āvāhayāmi || yā divyā iti pūjā || || viśvān devānahaṃ vaṃde'ṣāḍhā nakṣatra devatāḥ | śrīpuṣṭi kīrtidhīdhātri ssarvapāpāpa nuttaye || uttarāṣāḍhā nakṣatra devatā viśvān devānāhayāmi || tanno viśva iti pūjā || || nirguṇaṃ brahma bhūyānmejñā naiśvarya pradaṃ sadā | abhijittarā keśānaṃ vedāṃta kṛta saṃśrayam || abhijinnakṣatra devatāṃ brahmamāvāhayāmi || yasmin brahmeti pūjā || || śāntākāraṃ caturhasantaṃ śroṇā nakṣatra vallabham || viṣṇuṃ kamalapatrākṣaṃ dhyāye dgaruḍa vāhanam || śravaṇā nakṣatra devatāṃ viṣṇu māvāhayāmi || śṛṇvāṃ tīti pūjā || || śraniṣṭhā devatāṃ vaṃde vasūn ratha varāśritān | śaṃkha cakrāṃkita karān kirīṭāṃkita mastakān || dhaniṣṭā nakṣatra devatāvasūmāvāhayāmi || aṣṭau devā vasava iti pūjā || || varuṇaṃ natataṃ vaṃde sūdhā kalaśa dhāriṇaṃ | pāśahastaṃ śatabhiṣagdevatāṃ deva vaṃditam || śatabiṣaṅna nakṣatra devatā varuṇamāvāhayāmi || kṣatrasya rājeti pūjā || || śirasāha nujaṃ vaṃde ekapādaṃ tamopahaṃ | mude proṣthapade śānaṃ sarvadeva namaskṛtam || pūrvābhādapada nakṣatra devatā majamekapādamāvāhayāmi || āja ekapādudagāditi pūjā || || ahirme budhniyo bhūyānmude proṣṭhapadeśvaraḥ | śaṃkha cakhrāṃ kita karaḥ rarīṭo jvalamaulimān || uttarābhādra devatā mahirbudhniyamāvāhayāmi || ahirpudhnaya iti pājā || || pūṣaṇaṃ dvipadaṃ vaṃde revatīśaṃ samuddaye | varā bhayojjvala karaṃ ratna siṃhāsane sthitaṃ | revatī nakṣatra devatāṃ pūṣaṇamāvāhayāmi || pūṣā revatyanveti pūjā || || aśvinau devate śvetavarṇau taudvi bhūjāstumaḥ | sūdhā saṃpūrṇa kalaśa karābbāvaśva vāhanau || aśvinī nakṣatra aśvināvāhayāmi || dataśvināviti pājā japaśca || || pāśa daṃḍojjvala bhūjadvayaṃ mahiṣa vāhanam | yamaṃ nīlatanuṃ bhīmaṃ baraṇī devatāṃ bhajhe || bharaṇī nakṣatra devatāṃ yama māvāhayāmi || tadyayorājeti pūjā japaḥ || || a tha yo ga de va tā dyā nā di viṣkaṃbhaṃ śirasā vaṃde viṣṇugotra samudbavam || prāṅmukhaṃ prāṃjali karaṃ trikoṇopari saṃsthitam || oṃ namo viṣkaṃbhāyetyāvāhanādi pūjā || || prīti mīḍeha maniśaṃ brahmagotra samudbhavaṃ | prāṅ mukhaṃ puṃḍarīkasthaṃ japamālā dharaṃ śubhaṃ || oṃ namaḥ prītaya ityā vāhanādi pūjā || || āyuṣaṃta mahaṃ vaṃde yogaṃ yogibhirīḍitam | praṅ mukhaṃ paṃcakoṇstha matri gotra samudbhavaṃ || oṃ namaḥ āyuṣmata iti pūjā || || saubhāgyaṃ naumi śirāsa catuṣkoṇa mupāśritaṃ | kauṃdinya grotra janitaṃ prāṅ mukhaṃ japatāṃ param || oṃ namaḥ ssābhāgyāyodi pūjā || || prāṅ mukhaṃ paṃcakoṇasthaṃ śāṃḍilyānvaya saṃbhavam | śobhanaṃ śobhanakaraṃ samātā māśraye sadā || oṃ namaḥ śśobhanāyeti pūjā || || vādhulānvaya saṃbhūtaṃ paṃcakoṇo paristhitaṃ | ati gaṃḍābhidhaṃ vaṃde japaṃtaṃ prāṅmukhaṃ sadā || oṃ nameti gaṃḍāyoti pūjā || || sukarmāṇaṃ yoga mahaṃ dakṣaṇāmukha māśraye | kauśikānvaya saṃbhūtaṃ japaṃtaṃ loka pūjitaṃ || || oṃ namaḥ ssukarmaṇa iti pūjā || || dhṛtiryoga ssadābhūyā dātre yānvaya saṃbhavaḥ | dakṣiṇāmukha māsino vedā mreḍana tatparaḥ || || oṃ namo dhṛtaya iti pūjā || || śūlanāmā mahānyogo bhūyā diṣṭordhado mama | dakṣiṇāmukha māsīnaḥ kuṃḍinānvaya saṃbhavaḥ || oṃ namaśśulāyeti pūjā || || yogostu gaṃḍanāmāmemu deśāṃḍilya vaṃśajaḥ | dakṣiṇāmukha māsino brahmapārāyaṇaṃ paṭhan || oṃ namaḥ gaṃḍāyeti pūjā || || vṛddi rvṛddi pradomesu kauśiko dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ | ciṃtaya nbrahmā paramaṃ brasī māśrītyaviṣṭitaḥ || || oṃ namaḥ namo vṛddaya iti pūjā || || dhṛtyai dhrūvostume nityaṃ yogoyaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ | akṣamālāṃkarebibhradgāyatrī mādarājjapan || || oṃ namadhṛvāyeti pūjā || || vyāghāta śirasānaumi vyāsānvaya samudbhavam | pratyak mukhopa viṣṭaṃtaṃ prryagraravi sannibham || oṃ namaḥ vyāghātāyeti pūjā || || harṣaṇaṃ harṣaṇaṃ vaṃde pratyaṅ mukha mudarbiṣam | paṭhaṃtaṃ dedamaniśaṃ kāśyapānvaya sambhavam || oṃ namaḥ harṣaṇāyetipūjā || || vajranāma bhavedhyogo bharadvājānvayodbhavaḥ | pratyaṅ mukhamupāsīnaḥ paṭhan praṇava manvaham || oṃ namaḥ prajāyotipūjā || || pratyaṅmākho brahmavaṃśya siddhi siddhi pradostume || viṣṭaro parisaṃviṣṭo sedāṃta paṭhanonmukhaḥ || oṃ namaḥ ssaddhaya iti pūjā || || smarāmyahaṃ vyatīpātaṃ vītahavyā nvayodbhanam | pratyaṅmakhaṃ pāṭhayaṃtaṃ vedāṃcciṣyā saharniśam || oṃ namovyatīpātāyeti pūjā || || varīyānmāma yogoyaṃ varadostu sadāmama | pratyaṅmakhaḥ prāṃjalikaḥ sāmaveda kuloditaḥ || oṃ namaḥ varīyana itipūjā || || udaṅmakho brahmagotro yogaḥ parighanāmakaḥ | kailāsa śikharārūḍha ssāmagāyn bhavanmude || oṃ namaḥ varīyasa iti pūjā || śiva śivāya me bhūyācchi vārādhana tatparaḥ | niṣṇu vaṃśasamudbhāta ṛgadhyāpana tatparaḥ || oṃ namaḥ varaghāyeti pūjā || || siddhi siddhi pradomestu kaṃḍivānvaya saṃbhavaḥ | udaṅmakha ssvaśiṣyebhyo yajuṃṣi satataṃ paṭhana || oṃ namaḥ namassidhāyeti pūjā || || sādhyanāmā bhavedyoga śśokānāmapanuttaye udanmakho mahāmaṃtra mādharvaṇa manusmaran || oṃ namassādhyāyeti pājā || || śubha śubhayame bhūyā dvāsiṣṭhānvaya saṃbhavaḥ | udaṅmakho japanmaṃtraṃśaivaṃ paṃcākṣaraṃ śubham || oṃ namaḥ śubhayeti pūjā || || śuklanāmā mahan yogo yogī svayamudaṅmakhaḥ | pratyagdṛṣṭirmude bhūyā tkauśikānvaya saṃbhavaḥ || oṃ namaḥ śuklāyetipūjā || || brāhmo brahmakulodbhūto mahā nūrdhṛmukha sthitaḥ | brahmaṇyāhita tṛṣṭissan tapannastu sukhāyame || oṃ namo brāhmāyeti pūjā || || aina dāya pramatirmesyā dūrdhva prerita dṛṣṭaye | vādhūlānvayajātāya varadāya sadānṛṇām || oṃ nama aiṃ drāyetipūjā || || vaidhṛtirnāmayo gosāpūrdhva dṛṣṭi śubhostume | kauḍisya gotrajo brahma saṃsmaranmanasānvaham || oṃ namovaidhṛtaya iti pūjā japaśca || || atha karaṇa devatādhyānādi sadyojātaṃ bavākhyānaṃ caṃdrārdhakṛta śekharam | tapasvi saṃghasaṃsevya karaṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham || oṃ namo bavāyotyāvāhanādi pūjā || || karaṇaṃ bāla vākhyānaṃ vāmadeva namāmyahaṃ | netratrayojjvala mukhaṃ namāmi jala vṛddhidam || oṃ namaḥ bālavāyoti pūjā japaśca || || aghoraṃ kaulavākyānaṃ carmāṃbaradharaṃ śucim | namāmi mokṣadātāraṃ vedāṃta pratipāditaṃ || oṃ namaḥ kaulavāyoti pūjā japaśca || || taitulākhyaṃtatpuruṣaṃ gaṃgodbhāsita mastakam | samastagīrvāṇa nutaṃ naumi putrādi vṛddhidam || oṃ namastaitulāyeti pūjā japaśca || || namāmi śirāsa nitya mīśānaṃgarajāhvayam | vāmāṃga nityasaṃviṣṭaṃ hemādri tanayojjvalam || oṃ namaḥ garajāyeti pūjājapaśca || || śivaṃ vaṇiksvarūpaṃtaṃ śirasā pramamāmyahaṃ | pramathāvṛtaparyaṃtaṃ śūlojjvala karāṃcalam|| oṃ namo vaṇija iti pūjādi || || virūpākṣa mahaṃvande śakunīti kṛtāhvayam | ārogyadaṃ praṇamatāṃ jaṭā maṃḍala maḍitaṃ || oṃ namaḥ śakunaye iti pūjā || || bhadrāya mahate bhūyā dbadrakhyaḥ pārvatī patiḥ | rudrākṣa mālikodbhāsi kaṃdhara śubhavardanaṃ || oṃ namo bhadhrāyeti pūjā japaśca || || catuṣpatkṛta saṃjñāya nīlakaṃṭhāya śaṃbhave | amarasantutya pādābja yugalāya namo namaḥ || oṃ namaḥ ścatuṣpade iti pūjā || || nāga carmāṃbara dharaṃ nāgavākhya mumāpatim | dhyāye tsamastasiddhyartha muttuṃga vṛṣabhāśrayam || oṃ namaḥ nāgavāyeti pūjā || || namasyāṃ karavai nityaṃ kiṃstūghnākhyāya śūline | bhasmoddhūlita dehaya vedāṃta kṛta sadmane || oṃ namaḥ kiṃstughnayoti pūjā || || pradhānasya nirṛti didbhāge navadurgāḥ pūjayetat vaṃde vāṃchita lābhāya caṃdrārdakṛta śekharam | vṛṣārūḍhāṃ śūladharāṃ śailaputrīṃ yaśasvinīm || oṃ namaśśaiva putryā ityāvāhayanādi || || dadhānā karapadmākhyā makṣamālāṃka maṃḍalam devī prasīdatu mama brahmacāriṇyanuttamā || oṃ namo brahmacāriṇyā iti pūjā || || aṃḍaja pravarārūḍha caṃḍaropārbhaṭīyūtā | prasādaṃ tanutāṃ mahyaṃ caṃḍa khaṃḍeti viśṛtā || oṃ namaścaṃḍa khaṃḍāyā iti pūjā || || saṃhāsana gatā nityaṃ padmāṃcita karadvayā | śubhadāstu sadādevīskaṃda mātā yaśasvinī || oṃ namaskaṃdamātra iti pūjā || || sūrāpūrṇaṃca kalaśaṃ rudhirāplutamevaca | dadhānā hasta padmābhyāṃ kūṣmāṃḍā śubhadāstume || oṃ namaḥ kūṣmāṃḍāyā iti pūjā japaśca || || caṃdra haṃsojjalakarā śārdūla varavāhanā kātyāyanī śubhaṃdadyāddetyādā navaghātinī || m̐ namaḥ kātyāyanyā iti pūjā || || karāla rūpā kālābda samānākṛti vigraha | kālarātri śśubhaṃ dadyāddevī caṃḍāṭṭa hasanī || oṃ namaḥ kālarātryā itipūjā || || śveta hasti varārūḍhā śvetāṃbara dharāśuciḥ | mahā gaurī śubhaṃ dadyāsmahādeva pramodadā || oṃ namo mahāgauryā iti pūjā || || siddha gaṃdharva yakṣādyaira maraira surairapi| sevyamānā sadā bhūyā tsaddhidā siddhidāyinī || oṃ namassiddidāyinyai iti pūjā || jātavedasa iti maṃtreṇa ṣoḍaśopacāra pūjāṃ kuryāt || || atha brahma viṣṇurudra gaṇapatyādidhyānādi prathānasya paścima digbhāge brahmaviṣṇu rudra gaṇapati kṣetrapālā bhayaṃkara vāstu puruṣa rāśidevatā āvāhayet || padmāsanaṃ caturvaktraṃ dvicaturhastamevaca | brahmasūtrojvalaṃ dhyeye dvedāmreḍana tatparam || brahmā devānā mityādavāhanādi || || garutmadvāhanārūḍhaṃ śaṃkha cakra dharaṃ harim | pītāṃbaraṃ hṛdidhyāye tsarvābhīṣṭasya siddhaye || viṣṇornukamitipūjā || || trinetraṃ jaṭilaṃ haste carmāṃbara dharaṃ śivaṃ | śūlahastaṃ vṛṣārūḍhaṃ dyāyāmi girijāpatim || kadrudrāyeti pūjā japaśca || || ekadaṃtaṃ gajamukhaṃ śuṃḍālaṃ modakapriyam | śūrpakarṇaṃ namasyāmi śirasākhu varasthitam|| gaṇānāṃtveti pūjā || || uttuṃga vṛṣabhārūḍhaṃ padma patrāya tekṣaṇaṃ | kṣetrapāla mahaṃ vaṃdesarvāriṣṭasya śāṃtaye || kṣetrasya patineti pūjā || || anamrajana saṃdohā bhītivrāta vināśanaṃ | abhayaṃkaramīḍehaṃ satataṃ saukhyadāyinam || yata iṃdreti pūjā || || mānadaṃḍakarābjena vahaṃtaṃ bhūmi śodakam | vaṃdehaṃ vāstu puruṣaṃ śayānaṃ śayane śūbhe || vāstoṣpati iti pūjā atha rāśi devatā dhyānādi tīkṣṇaśṛṃga yutaṃ dīrgha saṭākūṭa virājitam | raktākṣaṃ kuṃcitapadaṃmeṣaṃ meṣaṃ hṛdi vibhāvaye || oṃ namo meṣāyotyā vāhanādipūjā || || saṃcārya cala saṃkāśaṃ tīkṣṇa śṛṃga dvayānvitaṃ | kakudvirāja mānāṃsaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ hṛdibhāvaye || oṃ namo vṛṣabhāyeti pūjā japaśca || || parasparānu rāgāḍhya manyonya sadṛśākṛti | anyonyā śliṣṭahastābjaṃ hṛdibhāvaye || oṃ namo midunāyeti pūjā japa || || vāri pūrāṃta racaraṃ ṣaḍaṃghrīṃ lohitekṣaṇam | kukṣi vinyastavadanaṃdyāyāmi hṛdi karkaṭam || oṃ namaḥ karkaṭāyetipūjā || || caṃḍāṭṭahāna bhayadaṃ dantimastaka bhedanam | dīrgha lāṃgūlasaṃyuktaṃ siṃhaṃ hṛdi vibhāvaye || oṃ nama siṃhāyoti pūjā || || pati muddiśya sadṛśaṃ tapasyaṃtīṃ mikāśanam | pūrṇa caṃdramukhīṃ kāntāṃ kanyāṃ hṛdi vibhāvaye || oṃ namaḥ kanyāyā iti pūjā || || vadārdamāna siddhyarthaṃ brahmaṇā kalpitāṃ purā | talāvāmeti kathitāṃ saṃkhyārūpāmupāsmahe || oṃ namostulāya iti pūjā || || hālahala samāyuktaṃ nīlatoyada sannibham | ātolyamānapucchagraṃ vṛścikaṃ hṛdi bhāvaye || oṃ namo vṛścikāyeti pūjā || || īṣannamita koṭyagra dṛḍhajyāṃbaṃdha nānvitam | āropitograbāṇāgraṃdhanūrhṛdi vibhāvaye || oṃ namodhanuṣa iti pūjā || || aṃbhodhi ghorajaṭharakṛta bhūyiṣṭakhelanaṃ | jalajaṃtu pratibhayaṃ kamalaṃ hṛdibhāvaye || oṃ namo makarāyeti pūjā || || sauvarṇaṃ ratna khacitaṃ sudhā pūrābhi pūritam | vainateta javānītaṃ kuṃbhaṃ hṛdi vibhavaye || oṃ namaḥ kuṃbhāya iti pojā || || nimeṣa hīna nayanaṃ spuraṃtaṃ vāridehjale | mamābhiṣṭasya siddhyarthaṃ mīnaṃ hṛdi vibhāvaye || oṃ namo mīnāya iti pūjā || || sapta marutpaṃca brahmavāhanādi tīkṣṇaśṛṃga yutaṃ dīrgha saṭākūṭa virājitam | raktākṣaṃ kuṃcitapadaṃ meṣaṃ hṛdi vibhāvaye || oṃ namo meṣāyotyā vāhanādi pūjā || || saṃcārya cala saṃkāśaṃ tīkṣṇa śṛṃga dvayānvitaṃ | kakudvi rājamānāṃsaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ hṛdi bhāvaye || oṃ namo vṛṣabhāyeti pūjājapaśca || || parasparānurāgāḍhya manyonya sadṛśākṛti | anyenyā śliṣṭa hastābjaṃ midhunaṃ hṛdi bhāvaye || oṃ namo mudunāyeti pūjā japa || || vāri pūrāṃta racaraṃ ṣaḍaṃgrīṃ lohitekṣaṇam | kukṣi visyastavadanaṃ dyāyāmi hṛdikarkaṭam || oṃ namaḥ karkaṭāyetipūjā || || caṃḍāṭṭahāsa bhayadaṃdantimastaka bhedanam | dīrgha lāṃgūlasaṃyuktaṃ siṃhaṃ hṛdi vibhāvaye || oṃ namo karkaṭāyetipūjā || || pati muddiśya sadṛśaṃ tapasyaṃtīṃ mitāśanam | pūrṇa caṃdra mukhīṃ kāntāṃ kanyāṃ hṛdi vibhāvaye || oṃ namo kanyāyā iti pūjā || || padārdamāna siddhyarthaṃ brahmaṇā kalpitāṃ purā | tulāvāmeti kathitāṃ saṃkhyārūpā mupāsmahe || oṃ namostulāya iti pūjā || || hālāhala samāyuktaṃ nīlatoyada sannibham | ātolyamānapucchāgraṃ vṛścikaṃ hṛdi bhāvaye || oṃ namo vṛścikāyeti pūjā || || īṣannamita koṭyagra dṛḍhajyābaṃdha nānvitam | āropitogra bāṇāgraṃdhanūrhṛdi vibhāvaye || oṃ namodhanuṣa iti pūjā || || aṃbhodi ghorajaṭharakṛta bhūyiṣṭakhelanaṃ | jalaṃjaṃtu pratibhayaṃ kamalaṃ hṛdi vibhāvaye || oṃ namo makarāyetipūjā || || sauvarṇaṃ ratna khacitaṃ sudhā pūrābhi pūritam | vainateya javānītaṃ kuṃbhaṃ hṛdi vibhāvaye || oṃ namo kuṃbhāya iti pojā || || nimeṣa hīna nayanaṃspuraṃtaṃ vāridherjale | mamābhīṣṭasyasiddhyarthaṃ mīnaṃ hṛdi vibhāge || oṃ namo mīnāya iti pūjā || || sapta marutpaṃca brahmāvāhanādi pradhānasya vāyavya digbhāge sapta maruddevatāḥ paṃca brahmādevatāścā vāhayeti - āsamaṃtātsaṃcariṣṇu ssutīvra garuḍasthitaḥ | avaho marutāṃ śreṣṭha ssukhāyāstu sadā mama || oṃ nama āvāhāyeti pūjā japaśca || || jagatāṃ bhaṃjanaṃ kurvan viparīta pradhāvavaiḥ | nabho madhyagatauvāyurvivaho bhūtidostume || oṃ namo vivahāyeta pūjā japaśca || || pracaṃḍagati nirdūta prapalāyita parvatam | pravahaṃpa vanaśreṣṭha śirapāpraṇamāmyahaṃ || oṃ namaḥ pravahāyeti pūjā japaśca || || udvelayan payorāśīn girīnunmūlayaṃ starūn | jagaṃtikṣobhaya nnitya mudva hassevyate mayā || oṃ namo udvahāya iti pūjā || || jagadānaṃda janako gaṃdhahārīśśa naiśśanaiḥ | śītāṃbūkaṇa saṃvāhāssaṃvahā ssukha dostume || oṃ namossavahāya iti pūjā || || prāṇā pānādi rūpeṇa jagati vyāpya jivayan | sevyatāṃ prāṇi nivahaiḥ marutpari vahābhidaḥ || oṃ namo parivāhāya iti pajā || || prāti kūlyena dhāvaṃtaṃ bhrāmayaṃtaṃ jagatrayaṃ | marutāṃ pravaraṃ nityamāśraye pravahabhidham || oṃ namo pravahāya iti pūjā || || mārutamasīti matreṇa sarveṣāṃ marutāṃ sarvopacāra pūjājapaśca - sadyojātādibhiḥ paṃcabirmaṃtraiḥ paṃca brahmapūjā || tadhāhi akṣamālāvarābhīti hastaṃ tryaṃkṣaṃ caturmukhaṃ | kuṃdeṃdu śaṃkha dhavalaṃ sadyojātaṃ samāmyahaṃ | sadyojātaṃ prapadyāmītyā vāhanādi || || akṣamālābhaya varaṭaṃka hastaṃ trilocanam | kiṃḍalkābhaṃ caturvaktraṃ vāmadeva mahaṃbhaje | vāmadevāya namo jyeṣṭhā yotyā vāhanādi || || kuṭhārāṃku pāśākṣa sūtra ḍhakkā kapālavān | tryakṣa ścaturmukho'ghoraḥ pātumāṃ nīla vigrahaḥ || aghorebhyo'tha ghorebhyaitityāvāhya || || prajīpta vidyutkanakavarṇaṃtryakṣaṃ caturmukhaṃ | vidayāvarakutārādihastaṃ tatpuruṣaṃbhaje || tatpuruṣāya vidmahe ityāvāhanādi || || ṭaṃka pāśāṃkuśābhīti veda ḍhakkākṣa śūlavān | sitadyutiḥ paṃcamukha īśāno'smān sadāvatu || īśāna ssarvavidyānāmityāvāhanādi || || prāṇā pānādi rūpeṇa jagati vyāpya jīvayana| nevyatāṃ prāṇinivahaiḥ marutpari vahābhidaḥ|| oṃ namaḥ sarvopacāra pūjājapaścasadyojātādibhiḥ paṃcabi rmaṃttauḥpaṃca brahma pūjā|| tadhāhi akṣamālāvarābhīti hastaṃ tryikṣaṃ caturmukhaṃ| kuṃdeṃdu śaṃkha dhavalaṃ sadyojātaṃ prapadyāmītyā vāhanādi |||| ścaturmukho' ghoraḥ pātumāṃ nīla vigrahaḥ || agherebhyo'tha ghorebhyaitityāvāhya |||| pradī pta vidyutkanaka varṇaṃtyrakṣaṃ caturmukhaṃ | vidyāvara kuṭhārādi ha staṃ tatpuruṣāyavidmaheityāvāhanādi |||| ṭaṃka pāśāṃkuśābhīti veda ḍhakkākṣa śūlavāna | sitadyutiḥ paṃcamukha īśāno'smāna sadāvatu || īśāna ssarvavidyānāmityavāhanādi |||| ādityādi navagraha pūjā pradhānasyottara digbhāge navagraha devatāḥ graha yaj‍ñokta prakāreṇa pūjayeta | tatprakāraḥ pradarśyate || godhūmā staṃḍulāśau vaetāni navadhānyāni - madhye godhūma dhānyo parivartulākāra maṃḍale sāṃgaṃ sāyudhaṃ savānaṃ saśakti putra mitra patnū parivāra madi devatā pratyadhi devatā sahikaṃ bhagavaṃtaṃ sūrya graha māvāhāyāmi || evamādgneyyāṃ taṃḍulo paricaturaśākāra maṃḍale aṃgārakagrahama | dakṣiṇasyāṃ aḍhakadhālyoparitri koṇākāra maṃḍale aṃgārakagraham | aiśānyāṃ mudgadhyopari bāṇākāra maṃḍale budhagraha | uttarasyāṃcaṇaka dhānyopari dhīrgha caturaśra maṃḍale bṛhaspati graham | prācyāṃ niṣpāvadhānyopari paṃcakoṇākāra maṃḍale śukra graham | prātīcyāṃ tiladhānyoparidhanurākāra maṃḍale śanaiścara graham | nairṛtyāṃ māṣadānyopari śūrpākāra maṃḍalaṃ rūhugrahām | vāyuvyāṃkusuttha dhānyoparithvajākāra maṃḍale ketu graham || ityādi - sarvatra sāṃgaṃ sāyudha mityādi paṭhanīyaṃ iti grahayajñe atra taddhyānādikaṃ grāhyam | | dadhāhi - padyāsanaḥ padmakarodvibāhuḥ padmadyuti ssapta turaṃgavāhaḥ | divākaro loka guruḥ kirīṭī prasīdatānno bhagavān dineśaḥ || ākṛṣṇeneti asatyenetivā oṃ maḥ ādityāya iti sūryā vāhanādi || - sūryādhi devatāgni dhyānaṃ | piṃgabhrūśmaśrukeśākṣi tritayaṃ sūkṣma sūtrakaṃ | dhyāyāmagniṃ śaktidharaṃ chāgasthaṃ rakta vigrahaṃ | agniṃ dūtamiti | oṃ nama adityādi devatāyai agnaya iti pūjā | sūrya pratyadhi devatā rudradhyānam | pināka khaṭvāṃgakapāla śūladharaṃ triṇetraṃ sitadeha kāṃtiṃ | vṛṣādi rūḍhaṃ varadaṃ prasannaṃ dyāyāmi rudraṃ mṛgalāṃchanāṃkam | kadrudrāyeti | oṃ nama āditya pratyadhi devatāyai rudrāya iti pūjādi || || śvetāṃbara śveta vibhūṣaṇāḍhyo gadādhara śśveta rucirdvi bāhuḥ | caṃdra ssudhātmā varadaḥ kirīṭi śreyāṃ simahyaṃ pradadātu devaḥ || apyāya sveti maṃtreṇa oṃ namascaṃdramasa iti candrā vāhanādi | caṃdrādhi devatā'brevatā dhyānam | strīrūpa dāriṇī śvetā āpamakara vāhanāḥ | dadānāḥ pāśa kalaśaumuktābhūṣā bhajāmyaham | apsume somo | oṃ namassomādhi devatābhyo'dbhya iti pūjādi | caṃdra pratyadhi devatā gaurī dhyānaṃ | dhyāyāmi gaurī mādarśa yakṣa sūtraṃ kamaṃḍaluṃ | bibhrāṇāṃ paṃkajaṃ hastairhemā bhāma marārcitāṃ | gaurīrmimāya gaurī mimāyotivā | oṃ namaścaṃdra pratyadhi devatāyai gauryai iti pūjādhi || || raktāṃbaro raktavapuḥ kirīṭi caturbujo meṣa gamogadā bhṛt darāsutaśśaktadharastriśūlī sadāmamasyā dvaradaḥ praśāṃtaḥ | agnirmūrdhā | oṃ namoṃgārakāya iti kuḍāvahanādi | aṃgārakādhi devatābhūmi dhyānaṃ | abjaṃkarai roṣadhi pātra sasyapātreva haṃtīṃ vararatnapātraṃ | dhyāyāmi caṃḍhāṃśu nibhāṃbarāḍhyāṃ śuklāṃ mahīṃ diggajapṛṣṭha saṃsthāṃ || syonāpṛthivībhava - oṃ namoṃgārakāda devatāyai pṛdhivyai iti pūjā | aṃgāraka pratyadi devatāskaṃda dhyānam || patākikā śakti ghaṃṭā kukkuṭāḍhyaṃ mayūragaṃraktāṃbaradharaṃ piṃcha bhūvaṃ dhyāyāmi ṣaṇmukhaṃkumāraṃ mātā | oṃ namoṃgāraka pratyadi daivatāyai kumārāya iti pūjā || || pītāṃbaraḥ pītavapuḥ kirīṭi caturbhuja śśuddamatirgadābhṛt | carmāsidhṛtsoma ssuta ssadāme siṃvādhirūḍho varado buthassyāt | udbudhyadhvaṃ - udbudhyasvāgne itivā | oṃ namo budhāyoti saumya vāhanādi | budhādi devatā viṣṇuṃ dhyānaṃ | pradakṣiṇaṃ dakṣiṇādhaḥ karādārabhya bhibhrataṃ | gadābja śaṃkha cakrāṇi kramādviṣṇuṃ sitaṃ bhaje | idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame oṃ namo budhagrahadhi devatāyai viṣṇave iti pūjādhi | budha pratyadhi devatā puruṣa dhyānaṃ | śaṃkha catra gadā padma rājamāna karāṃbujaṃ suvarṇa varṇaṃ puruṣa mūrtiṃ hṛdivi bhāvaye | sahasra śīrṣā | oṃ namo budhagrahādhi devatāyai puruṣāya iti pūjā || || pītāṃbaraḥpīta vapuḥ kirīṭi caturbhujo deva guruḥ praśāṃtaḥ | dadhacca daṃḍaṃca kamaṃḍaluṃca tadhākṣa sūtraṃ varadostu mahyaṃ || bṛhaspate ati - oṃ namo bṛhaspatayaiti bṛhaspatyā vāhanādi || bṛhaspatyadhideva teṃdra dhyānam | caturdaṃta gajārūḍhaṃ vajrāṃkuśalasatkaram | prācī patiṃ svarṇavarṇaṃ dhyāyā mīṃdra surādhipaṃ | iṃdraśreṣṭhāni | idraṃvo viśvata itivā | oṃ namo bṛhaspatyadhi devatāyai iṃdrāya iti pūjādi | bṛhaspati pratyadhi devatā brahma dhyānam || kamaṃḍaluṃ pustaka makṣamālāṃ sṛpaṃ dadhānaṃ jaṭilaṃ caturmukhaṃ | padmāsanasthaṃ mṛga carmavastraṃ sārśvastha haṃsaṃ praṇamāmi pāṭalaṃ || brahmaṇāte brahmajijñāna mitivā || oṃ namo bṛhaspati pratyadhi devatāyai bhrahmaṇe iti pūjā || || śvetāṃbara śśveta vapuḥ kirīṭi caturbhujodaṃḍa dharaśca śukraḥ | tathākṣa sūtraṃca kamaṃḍaluṃcajaṭāśca bibhra dvaradostu mahyaṃ | śukraṃte anyate - oṃ namaśśukrāya iti bhārgavā vāhanādi | śśukrādhi devateṃdrāṇī dhyānaṃ | iṃdrāṇīṃ bibhraṃtīṃ vāme haste saṃtāna maṃjarīḥ | abhayaṃ dakṣiṇe svarṇa varṇāṃ dhyāyāmyahaṃ śacīṃ | iṃdrāṇī māsunārīṣu | oṃ nama śśukrādhi devatāyai iṃdrāṇyai iti pūjādi | śukra pratyadhi devateṃdra dhyānaṃ | śvetahasti samārūḍhaṃ vajrāṃkuśala satkaraṃ | sahasra netraṃ svarṇābha miṃdraṃ hṛdi vibhānaye || idraṃvoviśvata - || oṃ namaśśukra pratyadi devatāyai iṃdrāya iti pūjādi || || sūryātmaja śśyāmavapuḥ kirīṭi vareṣu bāṇāsana khaḍgapāṇiḥ | gṛdgṛdgrāsanaḥ krūratanaḥ krūratanuḥ kṛpāvān prasīdatānno bhagavān sarauriḥ | śamagniragnibhiḥ oṃ namaśśanaya iti | śśanaiścharādhi devatā prajāpitadhyānaṃ | hastābjai ssruva pustakeca vipūlāmakṣasrajaṃ kuṃḍikāṃba bhrāṇaṃ sitayajña nītra vilasadvistīrṇa vakṣasthalaṃ | naikāsyaṃ varaha maniśaṃ padmaprabhā bhāsuraṃ sāvitrī sahitaṃ prajāpati mahaṃ dhyāyāmi lokeśvaraṃ | prajāpate natvede - || oṃ namaśśanaiścarādhi devatāyai dṛṣṭaṃ pāśahastaṃ yamaṃ mahiṣa vāhanaṃ | kālaṃ karāla vadanaṃ nīlāṃgaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ bhaje || yamāya somaṃ - || oṃ namaśśanaiścara pratyadhi devatāyai yamāyeti pūjādi || || kṛṣṇāṃbaraḥ kṛṣṇa vapuḥ kirīṭi karāla vaktraṃ karavālamālī | caturbhujaścharmadharaśca nīla siṃhadhi rūḍho varadostu rāhuḥ | kayānaścitra - || oṃ namo rāhugrahayeti āvāhanādi | rāhvādhi devatā sarpadhyānaṃ | raktavarṇaṃ karābjābhyāmakṣamālāṃ kamaṃḍaluṃ | bibrāṇaṃ bhavāye sarsaṃ tribogaṃ sarpabhūṣaṇam | ayaṃgauḥ pṛści || oṃ namorāhvadhi devatāyai sarpāyeti pūjādi || rāhu pratyadhi devatā mṛtyu dhnānaṃ | kālaṃ karāla vadanaṃ bhaje nīlāṃga bhīṣaṇaṃ | pāśa daṃḍadharaṃ mṛtyuṃ sarpavṛścikaro makaṃ || paraṃ vṛtyo - || rāhu pratyadhi devatāyai mṛtyava iti pājā || || dhrūmo dvibāhurvarado gadā bhṛtkapauta saṃstho vikṛtānanaśca kirīṭa keyūra vibhūṣitāṃgassacāstume ketu rayaṃ praśāṃtaḥ || ketuṃ kṛṇvān - || oṃ namaḥ ketu grahayetyāvāhanādi || ketvadhi devatābrahma dhyānaṃ || viriṃciṃ vākpatiṃ śvetapadmasthaṃ padma sannibhaṃ | akṣasrakkuṃḍikā bhīti dānahastaṃ vibhāvaye || brahma jijñānaṃ | oṃ namaḥ ketvadhi devatāyai brahmaṇe iti pūjādi | ketu pratyadhi devatā citraguptadhyānaṃ | piṃgalaśmaśruke śākṣaṃ svarṇābhaṃ citra guptakaṃ | vāme patraṃ karedakṣe lekhinīṃ dadhataṃ bhaje || sacitra citraṃ || oṃ namaḥ ketu pratyadhi devatāyai citra guptāyeti pūjā japaśca || || dvā da śā di tya pū jā pradhānanyaiśāna digbhāge dvādaśāditya devatāḥ mṛtyuṃ jayadevatāṃ cāvāhayet || taddhyānaṃ - dhātā śubhasyamedātā bhūyā dbhūyopi bhūyasaḥ | raśmijālasamāvītastamastoma vināśakṛt || oṃ namo dhātra iti pūjā japaśca || || meru śṛṃgāṃtara caraḥ kamalākara bāṃdhavaḥ | aryamāstu sadā bhūtyai bhūyasyai praṇatasyame || oṃ namo'ryamṇa iti pūjā || || niśā nivāraṇa paṭu rudrayādri kṛtāśrayaḥ | mitrostu mamamodāya tamastoma nināśanaḥ || oṃ namo mitrāyoti pūjā || || sūryassyandanamārūḍho hyarcirmālī pratāpavān | kālabhūtaḥ kāmarūpohyaruṇassevyatemayā || oṃ namo'ruṇāyeti pūjā || || niśāvidrā vaṇarato jaganmaṃṭapadīkaḥ | munīṃdra nivahastutyobhūtidoṃśurbhavenmama || oṃ namo'śave iti pūjā || || tidhimāsa ṛtūnāṃca vatsarāya nayorapi | ghaṭikānāṃcayaḥ kartābhago bhāgya prado'stume || oṃ namo bhagāyeti pūja || || sahaśra raśmi saṃvītamiṃdraṃ varada marcatāṃ | śirasā praṇamāmyadya śreyo vṛddhi pradāyakaṃ || oṃ nama iṃdrādayoti pūjā || || jagannirmāma kartāraṃ sarvadigvyāptatejasaṃ | nabhogṛha mahādīpaṃ vivasvaṃtaṃ samāmyahaṃ || oṃ namo vivasvata iti pūjā || || pūṣotoṣāyame bhūyā tsarva pāpāpanuttaye | sahasra karasaṃvītaḥ samastā śāṃtarāṃtaraḥ || oṃ namaḥ pūṣṇa iti pūjā || || prapaṃcaṃ pratapan bhūyo vṛṣṭibhirhladayan punaḥ | jagadānaṃda janakaḥ parjanyaḥ pūjyaremayā || oṃ namaḥ parjanyāyoti pūjā || || tṛṣṭā śubhāyame bhūyācciṣṭāvali niṣevitaḥ || nānāśilpakaronānādātu rūpaḥ prabhākaraḥ || oṃ namastvaṣṭa iti pūjā || || khānu maṃḍala madhyasthaṃ vedatraya niṣevitam | gāyatrī pratipādyaṃtaṃ viṣṇuṃ bhūtyaina māmyahaṃ || oṃ namo viṣṇava iti pūjā || || dvādaśādityānāmudyannadyeti pūjā japaśca || atha mṛtyuṃjaya dhyānaṃ - vadasaṃtāḍita yamaṃ bhakta rakṣaṇa tatparaṃ | mṛtyuṃ jayaṃ sadādhyāye tsarvāpadvi nivṛttaye || triyaṃbakaṃ - oṃ namo mṛtyaṃ jayāyeti pūjā || eteṣāṃ paritoṣṇadikṣu tattatthsāneṣu dikpālakā nāvāhayet || tattadhyānaṃ - śvetahasti samārūḍhaṃ vajrahastaṃ puraṃdharaṃ ṣa sahaśra netraṃ pītābha miṃdraṃ hṛdi bhāvaye || iṃdraṃvo viśvataḥ - oṃ nama iṃdrāyeti pūjā japaśca || || saptārcirvitava puṣaṃ svāhādevī niṣevitaṃ | āja vāhasamārūḍha magniṃ svarṇatanuṃ śraye || agniṃ dūtaṃ - oṃ namo agnaya iti pūjā japaśca || || karāla mahiṣārūḍhaṃ kāladaṃḍadharaṃ punaḥ | śyāmavarṇaṃ pāśahastaṃ kṛtāṃtaṃ praṇamāmyahaṃ || yāmāya somaṃ - oṃ namo yamāya iti pūjā japaśca || || stumo niraṛtiṃgaṃtuṃ turaṃgamakṛtāśrayaṃ | śyāmarūpaṃ śūlahastaṃ vṛtta netraṃ bhayaṃkaraṃ || yattedeveti - oṃ namo virṛtaya iti pūjā japaśca || || nakravāhanamārūḍhaṃ sūdhā kalaśa dhāriṇaṃ | pāśahastaṃ dhūsarābhaṃ varuṇaṃ śirasā mamaḥ || imaṃme varuṇa - oṃ namo varuṇāya itipūjā japasca || || mārutaṃ marutāṃ sevyaṃ sāraṃgavaravāhanaṃ | sarva prāṇyaṃ taragataṃ dhūmravarṇa mahaṃ bhaje || tavavāyo - oṃ namo vāyava iti pūjā japaśca || || kuberaṃ puṣpaka gataṃ nidhibhirna vabhirvṛtaṃ | suvarṇaṃ varṇaṃ pigākṣaṃ manasā bhāva yāmyahaṃ|| some dhenuṃ - oṃ namaḥ kuberāya iti pūjā || || caṃdramauliṃ trinayanaṃ tuṃgapu puṃgava vāhanaṃ | carmāṃbara dharaṃ śaṃbhuṃ raktarūpaṃ samāmyaham || tamīśānam - oṃ namo īśāyeti pūjā japasca|| || kvaciddikpāla pūrvabhāge adholokapālordhva loka pālāvāhanaṃ dṛśyate || tathāhi - padmāsanaṃ caturvaktraṃ bhāratīśaṃ caturbhujaṃ | brahmasūtrojjvalaṃ dhyāye dvedāmreḍana tatparam || adaḥ paśva || oṃ namodho lokapālāya bhrahmaṇe iti pūjā || eteṣāṃ pūrvabhāge ākāśa devatā māvāhayet || sarvavyāpaka mākāśaṃ śabdamātra samākṣayam | namāmi śirasā nitya mārogyā vyāptaye sadā || asmairudhrā mohanā - oṃ nama ākāśāyeti pūjā japaśca || eteṣāṃ paścimabhāge mahī devatā māvāhayat || samasta jagadā dhārāṃ gaṃthamātra kṛtā śrayāṃ | adyāṃ padmabhūva spṛṣṭhermahīmīḍe muhurmuhuḥ || mahīṃ devīṃ - oṃ namo mahyai iti pūjā japaśca || oteṣāṃ catuṣkoṇeṣu - nakra vāhana mūrāḍhān sudhākalaśa dhāriṇaḥ | pāśa hastān dhūsarābhān varuṇāṃ ścaturo bhaje itidhyātvā || imaṃme varuṇa tatvāyāmi tvaṃnno agnesatvanno agne iticatasro varuṇa devatā āvāhayet || tairaiva maṃtrai rupacāro japaśca|| sarveṣāṃ purastāccha taccidra samanvitaṃ bṛhatkalaśaṃ pūjāyet | atra brahma jijñāna mityādi maṃtreṇa brāhmaṇaṃ āvate heśovaruma ityādi mantreṇa varuṇaṃvā pūjayediti kecit || tattatkalaśa niveśitānāṃ dhyānyā vāhanādikaṃ kṛtvā dhūpa dīpanaivedya bhakṣya bhojyalehya cūṣyapeyakhādya carvaṇādikaṃ nānāvidhaphala sahitaṃ tāmbūlaṃca nivedya nīrājanādikaṃ kṛtvā maṃtrapuṣpapradakṣiṇa namaskārādika kuryāt || trairrbahmaṇaistattanmaṃtra japa maṣṭottara sahasra saṃkhyayāṣṭottara śata saṃkhyayāvā kārayet || tataḥ vedapārāyaṇa dvārā japa sūrya namaskārāśvattha pradakṣiṇa rudrābhiṣeka namaka camara puruṣasūkta śrīsūkta bhūsūktāyuṣyasūkta mahāśāṃti ghoṣaśāṃti mahā saurāpohiṣṭhā muṃcāmityā evāpitre pāvamānīśaṃvatī svastimatī iṃdrādīśānāṃtasūk navagrahasūktaviṣṇukavaca śivakavaca nāmatrayādi japārthaṃ bhrāhmaṇānvṛṇuyāt || maṃṭapātsaścimebhāge śāṃti homārthaṃ navagraha homārdaṃ āyutatilahomārdhaṃca kuṃḍatrayaṃ kuryāt | samāna tatreṇa trayāṇāmekaṃvā kuṃḍaṃ kuryāt | ayuta tila homa pakṣe pṛthagevakuṃḍaṃ kuryāt || kuṃḍa pramāṇam - muṣṭimānaṃ śatārdhetu śatecā ratnimātakam | sahasretvathahotavyekuryā tkuṃḍaṃ karātmakam | dvihastamayute home lakṣahome catuṣkaraṃ | aṣṭa hastātmakaṃ kuṃḍala keṭi home tatodhikamiti vacanāt homa tāratāmyānu sāreṇa caturaśaṃ kuṃḍaṃ yathoktaṃ kṛtvā svagṛhyokta mārgeṇollokha nādyājya bhāgāṃtaṃ kṛtvā navagrahahomaṃ śānti homaṃ tilahomaṃca kuryāt | ekasmin kuṃḍe sthaṃḍile vāgraha yajñokta prakāreṇa graha yajñaṃ kṛtvā pradhāna devatā maṃtreṇa samiccarvājyai raṣṭottara sahasra maṣṭottara śataṃvā juhuyāt || adidevatā pratyadhi devatābhyāme taddravyaiḥ tanmaṃtrābhyāṃ tadarthaṃ juhuyāt | mācṛdomṛtyo iti yadhā śakti tilahomaṃ kuryāt | taḍgāyatryā yadhāśakti madhusikta dūrvā homaṃ pṛṣadājya homaṃ kuryāt || ete sahaśramiti maṃtreṇa yadhāśakti gulūcī homaṃ kuryāt | syāsa pūrvakaṃ tryiṃbaka maṃtreṇa pṛthakkuṃḍa pakṣe āyuta tilahomaṃ eka kuṃḍa pakṣe yadhāśakti tilahoṃ kuryāt || janma saṃtsarāyanartu māsapakṣa tidhivāra nakṣatrayoga karaṇarāśi devatānāṃ samiccarvājyai raṣṭā viṃśati saṃkhyayāṣṭa saṃkhyayāvāhomaḥ | itareṣā mekaikāhatuḥ || ullekhanādyagni pratiṣṭhāpanānaṃtara manvādhānavatā manyādhāna kramaḥ asminnanvāhitegnā vityādicakṣuṣī ajyenetyaṃta muktvāsarvoto bhadramaṃḍala devatā ekaika saṃkhyayā samiccarvājya dravyaiḥ | ādityādi navagraha pradhānadevatāḥ yadhā saṃbhavaṃ vivakṣita saṃkhyayātastatsamiccarvājyaiḥ | āgnyaidina nādhi devatāḥ rudrādi navapratyadhi devatāśca vivakṣita saṃkhyayā samiccarvājyaiḥ | ugraradha pradhāna devatāṃ mṛtyuṃ | varaṃ mṛtyo itimaṃtreṇāṣṭottara sahasrādi vivakṣita saṃkhyayā śamīsamcicarvājyaiḥ | ugraradhādhi
