samudra jyeṣṭhāḥ || āpa idvāsu iṃdraṃvo viśvata sparītyādi dikpāla maṃtrāḥ | varuṇa maṃtrāḥ | paraṃ mṛtyo | havig haraṃtamanu | depasyatyā | muṃcāmitvā | sarveṣuvā eṣu lokeṣu | hiraṇya varṇāṃ | trmiyaṃbakaṃ | ṛtaṃca | taccaṃ yorārityā dayo vaidika maṃtrāḥ || surāstvā mabhiṣaṃcaṃtu brahma viṣṇu maheśvārāḥ | vāsudevo jagannādhastadhā saṃkarṣaṇo vibhuḥ || pradyumnaścā niruddaśca bhavaṃtu vijayāyate | akhaṃḍa lognirbhagavānyamolai nirṛti stadā || varuṇaḥ pavanaścaiva dhanādhyakṣa stadāśivaḥ | brahmaṇā sahitā devā ssadā tvāṃpālayaṃtute | kīrtirlakṣmī rdṛtirmedhā tuṣṭi śraddākṣamāgatiḥ | buddirlajjāvapuḥ śśāṃtiḥ puṣṭiḥ kāṃtiśca mātaraḥ || etāstvā mabhiṣiṃcaṃtu dharma patnayssamāgatāḥ | ādityaścaṃdramā bhaumo budho jīvassito'rkajaḥ || grahāstvā mabhiṣiṃcaṃtu ruhu ketu saminvitāḥ | deva dānava gaṃdharva yakṣa rākṣasa pasnagāḥ || ṛṣayo munayo gāvo deva mātara evaca | deva patnyo drumānāgā daityāścāssara sāṃgaṇāḥ || astraṇi sarva śastraṇi rājāno vāhanānica | auṣadhānica ratnāni kālasyā vayavāstadhāḥ || sarita ssāgarāśsailā stīrdhāni japa dānadāḥ | etānitvābhi ṣaṃcaṃtu darmakāmārtha siddaye || vighneśaḥ kṣetrepo durgā lokapālā navagrahoḥ | sarvākāma pradā nityaṃ yacchaṃtu tava maṃgalaṃ || ityādayaṛ paurāṇika mantrāḥ - ataḥ paraṃ kāṃsyādi pātrastha dipaiḥ paritaḥ prādakṣiṇya krameṇa nīrājanaṃ kuryāditi kecit | yānīha bhūtāni vasaṃtitāni baliṃ gṛhītvā vidhi patpradattam | anyatravāsaṃ palikalpayaṃtu namostutebhya ssakalagrahebhyaḥ || iti maṃṭapasya caturdikṣu citrānna baliṃ nyaset | tato yajamāno vastra puṃḍrātikaṃ dṛtvā gaṃdha puṣpādi bhiralaṃ kṛtyābhiṣekāplutā vastrāṇyācāryāya datvā bṛhatsāmeti rakṣāṃ dhṛtvā alakṣmī parihārārthaṃ nirīkṣitājya dānaṃ kariṣye iti saṃkalpya rūpaṃ rūpaṃ prati rūpobabhūveti kāṃsyapātra sthājye svamukhaṃ nirīkṣya | yā'lakṣmīryaccame dhausthyaṃ sarvāṃgeṣu vyavasthitam | tatyaryaṃ śamayādyatyaṃ śriyaṃ puṣṭiṃca varthayā | iti maṃtreṇājyaṃ saṃprārthya | kāmadhenossamudbhūtaṃ viṣṇuṃ pratikaraṃ śubhaṃ || devānā mājyamāhāra mataśśaṃtiṃ prayacchame || iti maṃtreṇāsmai bhrahmaṇāya saṃpradade namama nama metyājyaṃ nadakṣiṇaṃ tāmbūlaṃ sakāṃsya pātraṃ dadyāt || evamayaḥ piṃḍakārpāsa lavaṇa tila kambalādīni durdānāni kuryāt | yasmāda śeṣakarmāṇitva dadhīnāni sarvādā | ayaḥ piṃḍa namastubhyaṃ duṣṭāriṣṭaṃ nivāraya || iti catvāriṃśa tphalādika mayaḥ khaṃḍaṃ sadakṣiṇaṃ brāhmaṇāya dadyāt || kārpāsaṃ caṃcraṃdaivatyaṃ narāṇā mupakārakaṃ | tvamevā varaṇaṃ yasmādata śśaṃtiṃ prayacchame || iti kārpāsaṃ sadakṣiṇākaṃ dadyāt || yasmādanna rasāssarve notkṛṣṭā pavaṇaṃ vinā | priyaṃca śivayornityaṃ tasmā ccāṃtiṃ prayaccame iti | rasānāmagrajaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ lavaṇaṃ bala vardhanaṃ | tasmo devatpradānsāyami tataśśāṃtiṃ prayuccame || iti lavaṇaṃ droṇa tarimitaṃ dadyāt || yasmānmadhuriporviṣṇordehasvedasa mudbhavāḥ | havya kaveṣyu śastāśca tasmācchaṃno bhavitvihā || iti tilaṃ saṃprarthyā - tilāḥ kāśyapa sambhūtā nityaṃ pāpa harā śubhāḥ | tiladānāda sahyaṃ me pāpaṃ nāśaya keśava || iti maṃtreṇa droṇa parimita tila dānaṃ || meṣa loma samutsanana śśītavāta bhayāpahaḥ | tuṣāra bhayahārī yatta smācchāṃtiṃ prayaccame || iti mantreṇa kaṃbala dānam || amāṃgalya parihārārthaṃdailaghaṭadānaṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpya | tatra svamukhaṃ nirīkṣya || amaṃgalaṃme yatvrāptaṃ dausthyaṃ yacca mamāṃgake | sarvaṃ tadadyaśamayataila puṣṭiṃca vardaya || iti saṃprarthyā || tailaṃ puṣṭikaraṃ nitya māyuṣyaṃ pāpa nāśanaṃ | amāṃgalya haraṃ puṇya mataśśāṃtiṃ prayaccame || iti maṃtreṇa taila ghaṭaṃ dadyāt || yato rasānāṃ pravarassā dviṣṭo madhurorasaḥ | tasmādguḍaṃ pradāsyāmi tata śśāṃtiṃ prayaccame || iti guṃḍaṃ sadakṣiṇākaṃ satāmbūlaṃ dadyāt || durdānānaṃtaraṃ snātvā vastraṃ parivartyā vācamyāvā śucirbhavet | āthācāryaṃ bhadra pīṭhe uveśyagaṃdha puṣpa vastradi bhiralaṃkṛtya | sālajkāraṃ sadakṣiṇākaṃ vṛṣabaṃ | dharmatvaṃ vṛṣa saukhyaṃ śāṃtiṃca kurume prabho || iti maṃtreṇa saṃprarthyā dadyādati kecit | yajña sādhana bhūtāyā viśvasyāgha praṇāśanī | viśvarūpa darodevaḥ prīyatāna yāgavā | gavā maṃgeṣu tiṣṭhaṃti bhuvanāni caturdaśa | tasmādenā mahaṃ dadyā mataśśāṃtiṃ prayacchame || iti maṃtreṇa sālaṃkārāṃ savatsāṃ sadohana kāṃsyāṃ sadakṣimāṃcagāṃ dadyāt || atha kalaśa dānam - tatrādau pradhāna pratimādānam | yama daṃḍojjvala karāṃ mahiṣa pravarasthitāṃ | dadāmi mṛtyu pratimāṃ sarvadoṣa nivṛttaye || iti - pāśa hastāṃ rakta dṛśaṃ ghorāṃ mahiṣamāśritām | dadāmi mṛtyu pratimāṃ sarvāpadvi nivṛttaye || itivā maṃtreṇa navastra kalaśa dakṣiṇāṃ mṛtyu pratimāṃ dadyāt || ādi devatogra pratimā dānam - karālāsyāṃ virūpākṣīṃ vyāghra pravara saṃsthitāṃ | dadāmicogra pratimāṃ sarva mṛtyu nivṛttaye || iti - ugrāṃ bhayapradatrīṃ tāṃsīṃha pravara vāhanaṃ | dadāmi pratimāṃ tubhyaṃ sarvābhiti nivṛttaye || itivā matreṇa pūrva vaddadyāt || pratyadhi devatā mṛtyuṃ jaya pratimāṃ dānam || mṛtyuṃjaya namastestu vṛṣavāhana śaṃkara | tavamūrti mahaṃ dadyā mataśātiṃ prayaccame || iti - sudhā pūrṇa ghaṭaṃ haste bibhrāṇāṃ jayanāmikāṃ | dadāmi pratimātubhya sarvasaṃpadvi vṛddhaye || itivā maṃtreṇa pūrvavaddadyāt || pratimāṃ vastra saṃyuktāṃ praptāriṣṭha nivṛttaye | tubhyaṃ dāsyāmi vipeṃdra yadhokta paladabhava | iti maṃtreṇe tarāṃ tsarvān kalaśān savastra pratimā dakṣiṇān dadyāt || tataḥ - go bhū tila hiraṇyājya vāpo dhānya guḍānicarūpyaṃ lavaṇa mityāhurdala dānānyasukramādityākta daśa dānāni kuryāt | tatra godāna pūrvavat | sarva sasyāśrayā bhūmirvarāheṇa samuddṛtā | tasmā dasyāḥ pradānena viśvātmā priyatāṃ hariḥ | iti būdānam | tilāḥ kāśyapa saṃbhūtā nityaṃ pāpa harā sśubhāḥ | tila dānā dasahyaṃ me pāpaṃ nāśayakeśava | iti tiladānam || hiraṇya garbha garbhasthaṃ hema bījaṃ vibhāvasoḥ | anaṃta puṇyaphalada mitaśśāṃtiṃ prayacchame || iti - janmāṃtara sahasreṣu yatkṛtaṃ duritaṃ mayā | hiraṇyasya pradānena śāṃtirastu sadā mama || iti hiraṇyadānaṃ || kāmadhenu samudbhūtaṃ sarvakratuma saṃsthitaṃ | devānāmājaṃ māhāra matasśāṃtiṃ prayacchame | atra dadyāmiti seṣaḥ ityājya dānam || śīta vātoṣṇa saṃtrāṇāṃ lajjāyā lakṣaṇaṃ param | devā laṃkaraṇaṃ vastramata śśāṃtiṃ prayaccame || iti vastra dānaṃ || dhanyaṃ karoti dhātāraṃ dhānya matra paratraca | tasmādeta tpradāsyāmi tataśśāṃtiṃ prayaccame || iti dhānya dānaṃ || gūḍa dānaṃ pūrvavat || rudra netra samutpannaṃ rajitaṃ pitṛ vallabhaṃ tasmāde tatprādāsyāmi tataśśāṃtiṃ prayacchame || iti rūpya dānaṃ || lavaṇa dānaṃ pūrvavat || tato viśiṣya bhūdānaṃ gajāśva radhacchatra cāmara navadhānya navaratna gṛha vastra kanyā brahma sthāpanakratu dānāni manasoddiṣṭa sarva dānāni phala puṣpa tāṃbūlādi dānānica yadhāśakti kuryāt | bhūri dānaṃca kuryāt | tatra gajadāna maṃtraḥ airāvata ścaturthaṃto gajānāṃ nāyaka svayaṃdigdaṃtināṃ pūjyatama śāṃtiṃ kuryātsadā mama || athāśvadānaṃ maṃtraḥ | aśvohi vāhanaṃ bhānordāraṇaṃ hiśata kratoḥ | saṃpradānena caitanya śāṃtirastu sadā mama || atha ratha dāna maṃtraḥ - rathāya ratha nādhāya namaste niśvakarmaṇe | viśva bhūtāya nādhāya namo loka hitāyaca || ityādayo mantrā stattaddāneṣu draṣṭavyāḥ | tato'yutaṃvā sahaśraṃvā śataṃvā brahmaṇān bhojayitvā śiṣovācayitvā brahmārpaṇaṃ kṛtvā svayaṃ baṃdhubbhissaha bhuktvā hariṃ smaran sukhamāsīta | evaṃ kurvata ssarvādiṣṭa śāṃtirbhavati sarva saubhāgya vṛddin bhavati || tathā coktaṃ - jaya sviṣṭa kṛtaṃ hutvā homa śeṣaṃ samāpayet | pratimānāṃ punaḥ pūjāṃ kṛtvā codvānaye ttataḥ || aganeruttara digbhāge caiśānevā vicakṣiṇaḥ | prāṃgaṇecābhiṣekārthaṃ gomayonāma lepanam | raṃga valyādi kaṃkuryādbhadra pīṭhaṃ vinikṣipet | putra pautrādi ssahita ssarvālaṃkāra bhūṣitaḥ || bhadra pīṭhaṃ samāsādya pūrvābhimukha māśritaḥ | yajamānaḥ prahṛṣṭātmā kārayenmārjanaṃ dvijaiḥ || utkṣipyaca bṛhatkumbhamācārya ssudṛḍhaṃ navam | samāhita manābhūtvā tanmūrdho paridhārayet || ādāya taruraḥ kumbhān catvāro veda pāragāḥ | ṛtvija ssarva kalaśa tīrthaṃ sampūryateṣuca || bṛhatkumbhe nikṣipeyurmaṃtrairvāruṇa pūrvakaiḥ | śataccida ghaṭasthena maṃtrapūte savāriṇā || ācāryo yajasūnaṃtaṃ snāpayenmaṃtra pūrvakam | maṃtraissamudra jyeṣṭhā dyairāpo hiṣṭhā dibhistribhiḥ | maṃtraiścha pāvamānībhi rvaṣṇusūktaiśca vāruṇaiḥ | navagrahokta maṃtraiśca tathā dikpāla maṃtraikaiḥ | akṣībhyāmiti sūktena devasyetveti maṃtrataḥ | trātāra mindra maṃtreṇa tatvāyāmīti maṃtrataḥ | tvanno agneca satvanno agnecetyapi maṃtrataḥ | hiraṇya garbha maṃtreṇa sahasrākṣādi maṃtrataḥ | śāṃti maṃtraisthā saurairabhiṣekaṃ samācaret | surāstvā mabhiṣiṃcaṃtu mukhaiḥ paurāṇikairapi | ghṛtā maṃtalārdhāya dīpairnīrājayeccatam | citrodana baliṃpaścā caturdakṣu vinikṣipet | yajamānastva laṃkṛtya vastra puṇḍra vibhūṣaṇaiḥ | bṛhatsāmeti rakṣāṃca dhārayediti kecana | abhiṣekāplutaṃ vastra mācāryāya nivedayet | svarmayakte kāṃsya pātre go ghṛtena samanvite | mukhamālokya tatpātraṃ brahmaṇāya pradāpayet || mṛtyośca prīṇanārdāya dadyādgaṃḍa praśāṃtaye | catvāriṃśa tpalādūrdhva mayaṃ piṃḍaṃca kambalaṃ | kārpāsaḥ lavaṇaṃ caivatilaṃtaila ghaṭaṃ guḍam | evaṃ datvā cadurdānaṃ snātnā vācamyavā śuciḥ || athācāryaṃ bhadra pīṭhe upaveśyaprapūjayet | gaṃdha puṣpakṣa tairmalyai rvastrai rābharaṇairapi || ācāryāya vṛṣaṃ dadyātsā laṃkāraṃ sadakṣiṇam | sarvālaṃkāra saṃyuktāṃ savatsāṃgāṃ pradāpayet | pradhāna pratimāṃ dadyātkumbha vastrādi saṃyutām || ānyāstu pratimādadyā dṛtvigādi davijanmanāṃ || daśadānāni kurvīta bhūdānaṃca viśeṣataḥ | gajāśva ratha vāsāṃsi taiṃbūlaṃ chatra cāmare || gṛhaṃ dhānyāni ratnāni phalaṃ puṣpādi kanyakāḥ | manasodiṣṭa manyacca brahmasthāpana madhvaraṃ | etāni dadyādviprebhyo yathā nibhava mādarāt | dīnebhyo thaviśiṣṭhebhyo bhūridānaṃ prakalpayet | āyutaṃ bojaye dvipran sahasraṃvā śataṃtuvā | āśiṣaḥ pratigṛhyatha kṛtvā brahmārpaṇaṃ tataḥ | baṃdhubhissaha bhuṃjīta hariṃ smṛtvā sukhī bhavet | evaṃ yaḥ kurute śāṃtiṃ bhakti śraddā samanvitaḥ || saṃsarvāriṣṭa nirmukto jīvedvarṣa śataṃ sukhī || iti śrī śaivāga moktograrathaśānti prayoga ssamāptaḥ yaṃtra vithini rūpaṇa saṃgrahaḥ tatrādau sarva sādhāraṇa yaṃtra vidhirnirūpyate - yaṃtra prayoga kuśala ssadācārasaṃpanna ssatyavāgjiteṃdriyaḥ parameśvarārādhako brāhmaṇaḥ tatrāntare susnāta ssuvastra caṃdanādibhirbhūṣito yathoktadravyai śśuddha deśe yaṃtraṃ likhet | tatrādau ṣaṣṭntaṃ sādhaka padaṃ madhye bījaṃ tadadhoviyadyuktaṃ sargabījaṃ likhet - yaṃtra gāyatriḥ || yaṃtra rājāya vidmahemahāyaṃtrāya dhīmahi || tannoyantraḥ pracodayāt - iti yaṃtra gāyatryā prāṇapratiṣṭhā maṃtra varṇenaca yaṃtraṃ sarvato veṣṭacayet - evaṃ yaṃtraṃ likhitvā sāvadhānatayā suvarṇādi nāveṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā yaṃtra pratiṣṭhāṃ kuryāt - sāyadhā - sarvato bhadramaṃḍale'ṣṭadalevā karṇikāyāṃkalaśasthāpana vidhinā kalaśaṃ saṃsthāpya tadupari yaṃtraṃ sthāpayet - maṃḍala koṇa catuṣṭaye catuḥ kalaśāssaṃsthāpya prati kalaśaṃ āṃ hrīṃ kromiti tryakṣirī vidāyakūrca bījayutāṃ sahasraṃ japet - tatastadyaṃtraṃ catuḥ kalaśodakai rabhiṣeka yaṃtra devatā prāṇān pratiṣṭhāpya yaṃtra gāyatryā yaṃtraṃ ṣoḍaśopacārai ssaṃpūjya brāhmaṇā suvāsinīḥ kumārīścā saṃbojya dakṣiṇāṃ datvā teṣāmāśiṣo gṛhītvā yathoktāṃgeyaṃ traṃbadhnīyāt - anukta lekhanasthalebhūrjapatraṃ - anuktalekhana dravye kesara gorocana karsūra kastūrī gajamada caṃdanāgaru dravyāṇi - anukta lekhanikāyāṃ suvarṇaśalākā, anukta vaṣṭane suvarṇaṃ - anuktadhāraṇāṃge dakṣiṇabāhuḥ - iti sarvasādāraṇa yaṃtravidhānaṃ uktaṃhi pārvātī paramesvara saṃvādātmake yaṃtraciṃtāmaṇi graṃthe || ekadā devadeveśaṃ dṛṣṭādevī śucismitā | upagmay śanairvākyaṃ provāca jagadaṃbikā || pārvatyuvāca - devadava jagannātha karuṇākara śaṃkara | varṇāśramāśca dharmāśca saṃdehāśca mahāprakṣo || kautukāni svakalpāni purāṇādīvinavai prabho | śrutaṃ sarvaṃ mayātvatta ssarvajño siyataḥ svayaṃ || maṃtrāṇāṃ viniyogastu yaṃtrāṇāṃ nirlayastathā | ācārabhedāyoloke yogabhyāsa ssudurbabhaḥ || sudurla bhataraṃ jñānaṃ yajñakāṃḍa ssudurlabhaḥ | aneka maṃtrayogovai vedokto pihidṛśyate || tathaivāgama bhodeṣu uditohina saṃśayaḥ || evaṃ dvijāśca maṃtrajñā dṛśyaṃte kleśabhāginaḥ | pākhaṃḍibhiḥ parābhūtā nāsti kairveda niṃdakaiḥ | vināmaṃtrairjapairvomai ralpakleśenaca prabho || tat kṣaṇājjāyate siddastu siddhā sarvakāmadā | māraṇoccāṭanākṛṣṇe vidveṣestaṃbhanetathā || abhicāreṣu sarveṣu kāmyārtheṣu casarvadā | vivādeca vivāheca raṇevairijayotathā || etatsarva yathādeva sidyate sādhakasyahi | nicārya devadeveśa rahasyaṃ paramaṃpada || śrī parameśvara uvāca - vedācāro mayāprokto ṛṣīṇāṃtu mahātmanāṃ | śivadharmastu muktānāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃtu vaiṣṇavaḥ || sauryaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ mayāproktaṃ bahūnāṃ siddhimicchatāṃ || śāktaṃca bahudhāproktaṃ bhairavaṃ bahudhā priye || dharmakāmārtha mokṣāṇāṃ jñānaṃcaiva prakāśitaṃ | rahasyaṃ gopitaṃbhadre sarvatrāpina saṃśayaḥ || rahasyahīno maṃtrastu dhyānenāpi viśeṣataḥ | sasiddhyati varārohekalpakeṭi śatairapi || śrī pārvatyuvāca - prasādaṃ kurudeveśa sukhopāyaṃ vadasvame | surahasyaṃ subodhaṃca sadyaḥ pratyayakāraṇaṃ || vināhomena jāpyena puraścaraṇa sevayā | kalautu siddhyatedeva tathopāyaṃ vadasvame || śrī parameśvara uvāca - sādhusādhu mahā prājñe lokānā hitakārake | idamitthaṃnakenāpipṛṣṭhohaṃ padmalecane || śruṇuṣvaikāgra cittātvāṃ rahasyaṃ kṣaṇa siddhidaṃ | talpaṃ ciṃtāmaṇiṃnāma guhvadguhya taraṃ mahat || sarvāgamasma sāraṃca maṃtrāṇāṃ sāramuttamaṃ | atharvaṇasya sedasya sārātpara taraṃparaṃ || asminkāle bhaviṣyaṃti ciṃtāmaṇimaye śubhe | yaṃtrāṇi bahudhādevi kāmyakarma karāṇica|| etatkalbaṃ sadāyasya likhitaṃ viṃdyate gṛhe | saṃpūjyate prati dinaṃ prabhāvaṃtasya vaiśruṇu || alpamṛtyu bhayaṃnāsti nāsticaura bhayaṃ tathā | bhūtapreta piśācānāṃ prabhāvonaiva jāyate || anyasya kapaṭaṃ nūsaṃsa siddhyatikadācana | aviśvāsonakartavyaḥ sādhakena varānane || abhicāro bhavetkalpe hyaviśvāsānna saṃśayaḥ | saṃśayena kṛtaṃ yaṃtraṃ viparītaṃ prajāyate || snāsaṃkṛtvā śicirbhūtvā pūjayetkula devatāṃ | lekhanīyaṃ prayatnena ekāṃte yaṃtramuttamaṃ || yasyakasya prayogasya vidhireṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | dinatrayaṃ prakurvīta pūjāṃ bhogavidhānataḥ || trirātraṃ bhūmiśāyīsyāt brahmacarya rataśśiciḥ | tridinājjāya tesvapnaṃ sādhakasya varānane || siddhaṃsādhya mariṃcaiva susiddha mathavādhruvaṃ | avaśyaṃ vadatisvapne maṃtrādhiṣṭhena devatā || yadā najāyate svapnaṃ tadasādhyaṃ vinirdiśet | nocedyathāśrutaṃsvapne tattathaiva nivirdiśet || śrutvādevamukhāt svapne phalasiddhiṃ vidhānataḥ | yadānivāritaḥ svapnetadātadyaṃtramuttamaṃ || evaṃ vilikhyayaḥ kuryātsiddhireva prakīrtitā | ata evamayoktāni yaṃtrāṇi subahūnyapi || yonamaṃtrema saṃsiddhi ryoṣāṃteṣāṃ pajāyate | tenatenahitadgrahyaṃ niṣiddhaṃtu parityajet || vidhireṣaḥ prasiddhosti yaṃtrāṇāṃ bhūtalekalau | maṃtrakoṣṭhetupaśyaṃti siddhasādhyādisādhakāḥ || nateṣāṃjāyate siddhiḥ kalidoṣātkadācana | nacaikassādhakoloke naikaprakṛtikojanaḥ || nacaikarāśinakṣatraṃ nacaikākuladevatā | yaṃtrabījaṃ tathāmaṃtraṃ caturthābhavati priye || navaikapaṃcamesiddha ssādhyaṣṣaḍdaśayugamake | trisaptarudresusiddho vedāṣṭadvādaśeripuḥ || siddhasādhyāvariśceti susiddhastutathāparaḥ | siddhassiddhyatikālena sādhyassiddhyativānavā || arirnikṛṃta temūlaṃ susiddhastat kṣaṇārthadaḥ | tasmāddaivavaśādrāśiṃkālaṃ svapnaṃ mahodayaṃ || sādhakasya manobhāvaṃ samyak jñātvā samācaret | etadrahasyaṃ paramaṃproktaṃ yaṃtrasyalakṣaṇaṃ || iti || mahāmohanayaṃtraṃ - rājavaśyaṃ mahāyaṃtraṃ śruṇudevisutrobhitaṃ | kāṃsyabhājanamānīya śuddhaṃ bhasmādibhiḥ kṛtaṃ || jātīkāṣṭhenavilikhedrocanācaṃdanenaca | sādhyanāmalikhenmadhyevartulaṃ veṣṭayettataḥ | tasyoparidalānyaṣṭauvakārāṃ statravinyaset | tatastadveṣṭayotsamyagvartulaṃ pūrvavatrpiye || tasyopariprakurvīta padmaṃṣoḍaśapatrakaṃ | akārādi svarālekhyādale pratyekataḥ kramāt || tatastadveṣṭaye tsamyagrekhābhistisṛbhistataḥ | mallikājātikusumaissitāṃbhojaiḥ prapūjayet || anyaiśca śvetakusumaiḥ sugaṃdhaiḥ śvetakarpaṭaiḥ | saṃpūjyayaṃtrarājaṃtaṃ mahāmehanasaṃjñakaṃ || evaṃ saptadinaṃ kṛtvātrilohairveṣṭayettataḥ | yodhārayettaṃ śirasibāhumulegalethavā || yoṣidvāpuruṣovāpi kṛtaniścayasaṃyutaḥ | kiṃkarā ivatesarve vaśībhūtāssadaivahi || vivāda vijayaṃtraṃ - athātassaṃ pravakṣyāmi vivāde vijayaṃnṛṇāṃ | yaṃtraṃ kurayātrpayatnena sarvalokamanoharaṃ|| madhvenāma likhitvātu vartulaṃ veṣṭayettataḥ | caturdhalaṃ tataḥ kuryādbījayuktaṃ tu mānavaḥ || hrīṃ yaṃ hrīṃ yaṃ pratidalerocanā kuṃkumenaca | bhūrjapatre sasūvikhya pūjayedbhaktimānniraḥ || dhūpairdīpaissunaivedyaiḥ puṣpairnānāvidhaiśśubhaiḥ | trilohaveṣṭitaṃ yaṃtraṃ dugdhamadhyekṣipettataḥ || tatogacche dvivādārthaṃ jayonnāstyatrasaṃśayaḥ | vivādavijayaṃ nāmayaṃtraṃ devaiḥ prapūjitaṃ || dhanikotta mavarmavaśyakara yaṃtraṃ - yadātudai vasūtreṇa dravyanāśaḥ prajāyate | dhanikoyācate dravyaṃ nirbaṃdhenādhamarṇikaṃ || tasyadātunacecchaktirdravyābhāvekathaṃcana | tadātanmohanārthāyayaṃtraṃ māyāmayaṃmahat || tasyadātuṃnacecchaktirdravyākhyābhāvekathaṃcana | tadātanmohanārthāyayaṃtraṃ māyāmayaṃmahat || rocanākuṃkumenaiva bhūrjapatre suvistṛte | ṣaṭkoṇaṃkārayedyatnā tsādhyanāma samanvitaṃ || koṇāṃtare bahirlekhyāṃ klīṃkāra dvādaśaṃ tathā | tatastadveṣṭaye tsamyagvartulaṃ yaṃtramuktamaṃ || paṃcaviṃśati hrīṃkairaiśca kravatpariveṣṭayet | tatastadveṣṭaye tsamyagvartulenaiva pūrvavat || evaṃ saptadinaṃ yaṃtraṃ pūjaye dvidhinātataḥ | pratyahaṃ pūjāyeddevīṃ mahāmāyāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || mārkaṃḍeya pūrāṇoktaṃ devīmāhātmayamukattamaṃ | japetsapatdinaṃ yāvattatohomaṃ tu kārayet || aṃte pūrṇāhutiṃ hutvābhojayetkanyakātrayaṃ | pratiślokaṃ ca juhuyā tpāyasaṃ madhusarpiṣā || trilohaveṣṭaye tsamyagvartulaṃ yaṃtramuttamaṃ || paṃcaviṃśati hrīṃkāraiśca kravatpariveṣcayet | tatastadveṣaṭaye tsamyagvartulenaiva pūrvavat || evaṃ saptadinaṃ yaṃtraṃ pūjaye dvidhinātataḥ | pratyahaṃ pūjayeddevīṃ mahāmāyāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || mārkaṃḍeya pūrāṇoktaṃ devīmāhātmyamuttamaṃ | japetsaptadinaṃ yāvastatohomaṃ tu kārayet || aṃte pūrṇāhutiṃ hutvābhojayetkanyākātrayaṃ | pratiślokaṃ juhuyātpāyasaṃ madhusarpiṣā || trilohaveṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā bāhuyulegalethavā | tainaivadhṛtamātreṇa dhanikovaśyatāmiyāt || nayācate cataddravyaṃ vāṇijyārthaṃ dadātica || duṣṭāvaśyakaraṃ mṛtyuṃjaya yaṃtraṃ - yadākruddhaḥ prabhūrnīnaṃ ghātaṃ kartuṃ hinavāṃchati | tadāsvajīvarakṣārthaṃ yaṃtraṃ mṛtyuṃjayaṃ likhet || ānīya bhūrjapatrāṇi likhetpatradvayopari | madhyenāmalikhitvātu catuṣkomaṃ turekhayā || evaṃ saptacatuḥ koṇaṃ likhollohaśalākayā | tasyoparidalāṃsrīsca caturdikṣuvilikhyaca || īśānādaulikhyellalā lilīlulūca dakṣiṇe | lelailolau paścimeca laṃlaḥ syādathacottare || evaṃ dvādaśadaleṣu pratyekaṃ bijamekakaṃ | triśūlaṃca catuṣkoṇe sabiṃduṃvilikhennaraḥ || evaṃ yaṃtradvayaṃ lekhyaṃ saṃpuṭaṃkārayettataḥ | nikṣipyabhūmautadyaṃtraṃ sādhakaścottarāmukhaḥ || tasyoparikṣipennūnaṃ mahatīcasilāṃdṛḍhā | paścāttatsanmukhegacchetkopastasyapraśāmyati | mṛtyuṃjayaṃ mahāyaṃtraṃ prāṇarakṣākaraṃparaṃ || yadākasyoparikruddhaḥ kālo'pihidurāsadaḥ | tadāpi yaṃtrarājoyaṃ rakṣatye vanasaṃśayaḥ || vyavahāravivādajayaṃyaṃtraṃ - athātassaṃ pravakṣyāmi vivādejayavarthanaṃ | vyavahārebhayahara midaṃyanthraṃpraśasyate || pūrvapaṃṅkau namālekhyaṃ hrīṃmāṃhrīṃ catathaivaca | tasyādhassādyanāmaṃta ccatuḥkoṇenaveṣṭayet || koṇekoṇedalaṃ kuryānmadhyadeśethathaivaca | dakṣiṇerodhabījaṃtu nairutekṣaṃtathaivaca || pūrvecamohabījaṃtu āgneyāṃkṣaṃtathaivaca | evaṃ cāṣṭadalanyasya bījānidvādaśaivatu || śarāvasaṃpuṭekṣistvā yaṃtrarājaṃ jayāvahaṃ | abhyarcyagaṃdhapuṣpādyairdīpaiścāṣṭabhirevaca || lokapālāstusaṃpūjya bhojayitvākumārikāṃ | balidīpaiḥ prapūjyatha aṣṭadikṣukrameṇatu || tāvatlūjyaṃ prayatnetha aṣṭadikṣutrakrameṇatu || tāvatpūjyaṃ prayatnena yāvatkāryaṃcasiddhyati | vyavahārajayaṃnāma vivādavijayaṃ tathā || rājñāṃkule vivādeca jayennāstyatrasaṃśayaḥ | mānonnatirbhavettasya yaṃtrarājaprasādataḥ || strīsaibhāgyakaraṃ lalitākhyaṃ mahāyaṃtraṃ - ataḥ paraṃdevitavabravīmi dairbhāgyahaṃtrīṇicakāminīnāṃ | yaṃtrāṇī saibhāgyaninardhanānisaṃmehanānipriyakāmukīnāṃ || ekapaṃjtkaitusaṃlekhyaṃ hrīṃkāratratayaṃ śabhaṃ | tasyādhastātsamālekhyaṃ nāmavauramaṇasyaca || tataḥpaṃktaitṛtīyetu hrīṃkāratratayaṃpunaḥ | tatastadveṣṭayetsamyakcatuḥ koṇaṃturekhayā || tatastaṣṭadalaṃka tvā bījanyāsaṃ prakalpayeta | hrīṃkāratratayaṃ lekhyaṃ caturdikṣu varānane || koṇekoṇedalenyasya hrīṃkāraṃtu vicakṣaṇaḥ | rocanākuṃkumenauva mṛganābhistucaṃdanaṃ || ekīkṛtyalikhedyaṃtraṃ bhūrjapatresuvistṛte | trayodaśyāṃsitepakṣe sādhakaścottarāmukhaḥ || tadyaṃtraṃ pūjāyennityaṃ rātraurātrauvarānane | bhogairnānāvidhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ || evaṃ saptadinaṃ kṛtvā tadaṃtetavatuṣṭaye | strīyassaubhāgya saṃyuktābhojaye ttaptasaṃkhyayā || śaṃkarasyapriyedevi lalitepriyatāmiti | rūpaṃdehiyaśodehi saubhāgyaṃdehimeśriyaṃ || bhagavativāṃchitaṃ devahi priyamāyuṣyavardhanaṃ | evaṃmaṃtraṃ samuccārya tataścāyaṃ visarjayet || tadyaṃtraṃ dhātunāveṣṭya sadākaṃṭhetudhārayet | subhagārūpasaṃpannā patipriyatamābhavet | lalitākhyaṃ mahāyaṃtraṃ strīṇāṃ saubhāgyakārakaṃ || strīṇāṃ saubhāgyakara yaṃtraṃ - śṛṇudevi prasannena yaṃtraṃ bhartṛ prasādanaṃ | saṃ likhyatha priyaṃnāma sāṃkāra puṭitaṃ śubhaṃ || athopari tathā lekhyaṃ sāṃkāra dvitayaṃ śubhaṃ | tatastadveṣṭayetsamya gvartulaṃ rekhayaikayā || tasyopari dalānyaṣṭau hrīṃkāra sahitān likhet || rocanā kuṃtumenaiva bhūrjapate likhennaraḥ || tridinaṃ pūjāyennityaṃ rātrau rātrautu pūrvavat | tataḥ snātvā caturdhehni pūjaye tsubhagātrayaṃ || anaṃga vallabhaṃ devi tvaṃcame prīyatāmiti | evaṃ priyaṃ mahavaśyaṃ kurutvaṃ smaravallabe || etasmaṃtraṃ samuccārya pūjayitvātutāḥ sriyaḥ | tadyaṃtraṃ thātunāveṣṭya kṛtvāṃkaṃṭhe pradārayet || patirdāso bhasettasyā jyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || nasapatnīṃ gaṇayati saubhāgya madadarpitāṃ | ekāsuvāsinī bhojyā catardaśyāṃ sitetare || pakṣepakṣe pati prītyai pūjyaṃ yaṃtraṃtu nityaśaḥ | yāsāṃ tāsāṃ nadā tavyaṃ yaṃtraṃ saubhāgya vardhanaṃ || || strī paśyakaraṃ kāmarājakhya yaṃtraṃ - yoṣi dṛśyaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇudevi suśobhanaṃ | rocanā kuṃkumenaiva śrīkhaṃḍa mṛga nābhinā || bhūrjapatretu saṃlekyaṃ jātī kāṣṭhena yaṃtrakaṃ | aiṃ hrīṃ klīṃ catatonāma aiṃ hrīṃca punastathā || evaṃ saṃpuṭitaṃ kṛtvā catuḥ koṇaṃtu veṣṭayet || uparyadopiviliketpaṃcabījāni yatnataḥ | aiṃ hrīṃ klīṃ ca tathā kṣīṃ ca aiṃ cāṃteca punastathā || koṇeṣu vinyasedbījān aiṃ hrīṃ klīṃ ca tathaivaca | talākṛtīstukartavyā bījānā mupari kramāt | evaṃ caturdalaṃ kṛtvā bījayuktaṃ manoharaṃ || rājatīṃ pratimāṃ kṛtvā madanasyatu kāṣṭhake | tasyā hṛditu saṃsthāpya padyaṃtraṃ pūjayettataḥ || bhogaiśca vividhairgaṃdhai rdhūpai rdīpaiḥ phalai śśubhaiḥ | rātrau rātrau prakartavyādi nāṃte pratyahaṃ śubhe || evaṃ kṛtecasānārī dāsī nūnaṃ prajāyate | yaṃtraṃ śrīrāma rājākhyaṃ yoṣidvaśyakaraṃ paraṃ || saṃpūjyau madanaścātra rājikā pratimodare | kāmonaṃgaḥ puṣpaśaraḥ kaṃdarpo mīna ketanaḥ || śrī viṣṇu tanayo devaḥ prasanno bhavame prabho || evaṃ nityaṃ prakartavyaṃ yāvatsāvaśyātāmiyāt || krodhaśamanaṃ jāmadagnya yaṃtraṃ - suhṛdo baṃdhuvargonāśatrurvā krudhyate yadi | tadātatkopaśāṃtyarthaṃ kuryādyaṃtraṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || madhyenāmalikhitvātu vartulaṃ veṣṭayettataḥ | uparyadhaścottareca dakṣiṇeca tathaivaca || biṃduvaryaṃ caturdikṣu veṣṭayitvābhittadā | huṃkāraṃtulikhedgarbhe biṃdumadhye uparyadhaḥ || dakṣiṇecottarecaiva sādhyanāmaca pūrvavat | aṃtehuṃkārasaṃyuktamadhaḥ paṅkaiprasādaya || etadyaṃtraṃ susaṃlekhyaṃ tālapatre suvistṛte | kaṃṭakenāyasenaiva vilikhetsomavāsare || kulālamṛttikā madhyeyaṃtraṃ kṣiptvātugolakaṃ | kṛtvāpūjāpramutne yasmātkopaḥ praśāmyati || jāmadagnyaṃ mahāyaṃtraṃ sadyaḥ kopaharaṃparaṃ | akrodhanassatyāvādī jamadagniḥ dṛḍhavrataḥ || rāmasyajanakassākṣātsatvamūrte namostute | evaṃ maṃtraṃ samuccārya pūjayitvā prayatnaḥ || evaṃ saptadinaṃ kāryaṃ krodhāpaharaṇaṃparaṃ | naptamehnipūjanīyobrāhmaṇo vedapāragaḥ || noceddadyodanaṃ deyaṃ manuṣyāhārapūritaṃ | krodhastu hṛdayādyāti prasannojāyatekṣaṇān || saubhāgyajananaṃ kamalākhyaṃ yaṃtraṃ - ataḥ raṃprapakṣyāmiyaṃtraṃ saubhāgyadāyakaṃ | strīṇāmevasamuddiṣṭaṃ yaṃtraṃ kamalasaṃjñikaṃ || tasyasaṃdhāraṇaiddevi vaṃdhyāgarbhavatībhavet | mṛtavatsātuyānārīsālabhetputramuttamaṃ || dhṛtvātujāyatedevi jīvatpu tānasaṃśayaḥ | rocanākuṃkumenaiva bhūrjapatre likhennaraḥ || praṇavaṃtulikhetpūryaṃ hrīṃkārastadanaṃtaraṃ | tatoramaṇanāmaṃca hrīṃkārāṃtaṃ pratiṣṭitaṃ || uparyathopivilikhe trkoṃkāra mekakaṃtathā | tatastadveṣṭayetsarvaṃ vartulaṃ rekhayaikayā || tasyoparidalānyaṣṭau bījākṣarayutānica | jūṃkāraṃca caturdikṣu dalamadhyetu vinyaset || orakāraṃca tathāhrīṃca juṃkāraṃca tathaivaca | hrīṃkāraṃca punarekhyamevaṃ bījacatuṣṭayaṃ || koṇekodalelekhyaṃ pūjayettu dinatrayaṃ || bhoṇayenmithunaṃcaikaṃ lokeśaḥ prīyatāmiti | paścāttaṃtaṃtunāveṣṭya triloke naviśeṣataḥ || vartulaṃ maṇivatkṛtvā hāramadhyetu dhārayet | dhāraṇaijjāyate devi saubhāgyamatulaṃ mahat || putraṃcalabhate nūnaṃ vaṃdhyātvaṃca praśāmyati | kamalākhyaṃ mahāyaṃtraṃ sṛṣṭaṃtu brahmaṇāpūrā || nadeyaṃyasyakasyāpi sādhakena varānane || sarvavyāghracorabhayanāśana yaṃtraṃ - śruṇudevipravakṣyāmi yaṃtramarinivāraṇaṃ | sarvavyāghra bhayaṃnāstiyaṃtraṃ karatalesthitaṃ || lekhanevidhipūrvoktodravyaṃ pūrvoktamevaca | sarvatraśāṃtikedevi vidhiranyonavidyate || pūjanaṃcāpipūrvoktaṃ niyamaścāpitādṛśaḥ | bhūrjapatretu saṃlekhyaṃ dvitīyaṃ yaṃtramuttamaṃ || hrīṃkāragarbhamadhyetu sādhyanāma likhennaraḥ | tattatpādetu saṃyojyaṃ makāraṃ tadanaṃtaraṃ || lakāraṃca vakāraṃca yakārāṃtaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ | ūkāra svasaṃyuktaṃ śātibījaṃ manoharaṃ || tatastadveṣṭayotsamyakcatuḥ koṇaṃ dvirekhayā | trilohaveṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā bāhumūlegalethavā || sarpavyāghra bhayaṃhaṃti haṃticaura bhacaṃtathā | vividhopadravaṃhaṃtinābhakārya vicāraṇā || bālarakṣā yaṃtraṃ - athatassaṃpravakṣyāmi bālānāṃ śāṃtikārakaṃ | yaṃtraṃ rakṣākaraṃ śreṣṭaṃ sarvopa dravanāśanaṃ || pūrvoktavidhinālekhyaṃ dravyaiḥ pūrvoditaiḥ kramāt | bhūrjapatroparidevi pūrvoktavidhinārcanaṃ || madhyenāmalikhitvātu vartulaṃ veṣṭayettataḥ | tataścāṣṭadalaṃ kuryādbījayuktaṃ manoharaṃ || sakārān savisargāṃtān dale pratyeka śonyaset | saṃbūjya vidhivatpaścā dbāhumulegalethavā || dhārayodyaṃtrarājaṃtu lohatritaya veṣṭitaṃ | śākinyo vātha ḍākinyobālagrahā stathāpare || gacchaṃtibālakaṃmuktvā yaṃtrarājasya dhāraṇāt || bhūtajvara nāśana yaṃtraṃ - athātassaṃpravakṣyāmi jvaranirnāśanaṃ paraṃ | bhūtajaṃtujvaraṃ haṃtividyate vaidyakoditaṃ || balānāṃtu sadākāryaṃ yaṃtraṃ vaijvaraśāṃtaye || unmattasyarasairlebhyaṃ karpaṭe vaiśmaśānake || kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ saṃpūjya nikhanettataḥ | śmaśānetu divaivasyānni rāhāreṇa mānavaḥ || catuḥkoṇoparicaturbha vedaṣṭadalaṃ tathā | madhyenāma likhitvātu rakārasyatusaṃpuṭe || dalamadhyeṃtarāletu rakāraṃ saṃpratiṣṭikaṃ | evaṃ viṃśatirephāḥ syūḥ sarvaṃtra krameṇatu || saṃpūryabhūmau saṃpūjyabalipuṣpai rmanoharaiḥ | tatkṣaṇādvāti bhūtaṃtu jvarapūpaṃtu dāruṇaṃ || sarvastaṃbhana yaṃtraṃ - athātaspaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvātsaṃrakṣaṇaṃ paraṃ | tasvādiryathā bālaḥ pretovāpi viśeṣataḥ || sadṛśyate yathādevi pramādādvahni śāntayaḥ | pūrvoktavidhinālekhyaṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ || madhyenāma likhitvātu vartuṃlatu dvirekhayā | saṃveṣṭyaca dalānyaṣṭau haṃsabījān pṛthak pṛthak || trilohaveṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā bāhuyūletu dhārayat | nasyaṃtidarśanā tasyadaṃdaśūkāścaturdiśaṃ || pramādātpatitepāde tiṣṭaṃti staṃbhitāddhruvaṃ | athadaṣṭaḥ pramādeva viṣaṃnaivādhirohati | sarpāṇāṃ staṃbhanārthāya yaṃtraṃ garuḍabhāṣitaṃ || bhūtatrāpana yaṃtraṃ - athā tassaṃ pravakṣyāmi ḍākinī trāsanaṃ paraṃ | būtapreta piśācādyaiḥ ḍākinī brahmarākṣasaiḥ || yadā grasto naraḥ ko nārīpīvā bālakopivā | tadā yaṃtraṃ prakurvīta nārīpīvā bālakopivā | tadā yaṃtraṃ prakurvīta trāsārdhaṃ bhūta rakṣasāṃ || khaḍikayā likhitvātu kharpare nūtane śubhe | catasrastiryagā rekhā ūrvastāḥ paṃcarekhakāḥ | evaṃ bhavaṃti koṣṭhānāṃ dvādaśaiva varānane | hrīṃkāraṃ pratikoṣṭhotu vilikhyātha prapūjayet || bali puṣpova haraiśca tato dūlyā prapūrayet | saṃsthāpya jādgeru parijvālayetkhadirānalaiḥ || rudaṃtaṃca mahābhūtaṃ vepamānaṃ palāyet | tat kṣaṇādbālakaṃtyakatvā deśatyāgena gacchati || garbha rakṣākara yaṃtraṃ - adhā tassaṃ pravakṣyāmi garbha rakṣākaraṃ paraṃ | hāstimadena saṃlekhyaṃ bhūrja pratretu śobhane || madhyenāma likhitvātu catuḥ koṇaṃ dvirekhayā | saṃveṣṭya likhitvātu catuḥ koṇaṃ dvirekhayā | saṃveṣṭya karṇikākāryā vartulātu caturdiśaṃ || yakāṃraṃca rakāraṃca visargāṃtaṃ pṛthak pṛthak | karṇikā madhyato lekhyāḥ pūrvavatpūjayet kramāt || lohai kenatu saṃveṣṭya garbhiṇaḥ kaṃṭhatonyaset | sukhātprahitirbhavati chala chridraca naśyati || garbhiṇi karakṣaṇaṃ sukha prasīti karaṇaṃ yaṃtraṃ - athāssaṃpravakṣyāmi aṃtarvātvī surakṣaṇaṃ | yaṃtraṃ yoni vyathāṃyāti dāruṇaṃ bhūta nāśanaṃ || pūrvokta vidhinā lekhyaṃ dravyaiḥ pūrvoditaiḥ kramāt | bhūrjapatre vidhānena madhyadeśe vicakṣaṇaḥ || praṇavaṃca tathā hrīṃda ādyaṃtaṃ nāmatolikhet | paṭavacca catuḥ koṇaṃ dīrghaṃ saṃveṣṭ rekhayā | uparyodho'pi tridalānkoṇekaikaṃ pratiṣṭata || hrīṃ kṣaṃca tathā hrīṃca koṇedala gataṃ likhet | kroṃ krīṃ raṃ ca tathā hrīṃ ca dala śeṣeṣu vailikhet || evaṃ saṃ likhya saṃpūjyaṃ loha tritaya veṣṭitaṃ || garbhiṇyaḥ kaṃṭha deśetu ḍāryaṃ yatnānna saṃśayaḥ | yeni śūlaṃ śiraśśūlaṃ bhūta doṣaḥ praṇaśyati || sukha prasūti rbhavatipyathā nāśana saṃśayaḥ | rahasyoyaṃ samākhyāto yaṃtra rājo mahādbhutaṃ || sarvasaubhāgyavardhanaṃ sarvatobhadrākhyaṃ yaṃtraṃ - athatassaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvarakṣākaraṃparaṃ | chalachidraharaṃ nāma sarvatobhadra saṃtrikaṃ || ūrdhvarekhāḥ paṃcapaṃca tiryagrekhāstu saṃlikhet | evaṃkṛte bhavaṃtyete koṣṭhāṣṣoḍaśa saṃjñakāḥ || akārapūrvāḥ kramaśovilikhya sarvatrakoṣṭhe niśibhūtaje'hni | bhūrjasyapatre mṛganābhicadanaihi menasaṃvīlyalikhe trkameṇatu || saṃpūjyapuṣpairvividhaiścagaṃdhairdhūpairmanojñairvividhopacāraiḥ | saṃpūjyaviprānvasanairdhanaiścayaṃtraṃca tadbhaktiyuta ssamarcayet || saveṣṭyalohatritayena paścātsaṃha ṣṭacetāvidhivanmanuṣyaḥ | saṃdhārayeddakṣiṇabāhumūle nārīgale yaṃtravaraṃ prayatnāt || taddhāraṇātrpā varaprasādaṃ sarvapriyobhāgyayutassaṃtūrṇaṃ | saṃjāyate sarvabhayena hīnoloke yathāprāpta mahāṣṭasiddhiḥ || baṃdhamokṣaṇa yaṃtraṃ - athātassaṃ pravakṣyāmi baṃdhamokṣaṃ manoharaṃ | baddhoruddhaḥ kṣaṇenaiva mucyate yatrpasādataḥ || yadākenāpi saṃhṛddhonaviṃde nmuktimātmanaḥ | tadāyaṃtraṃ prakurvītatat kṣaṇānmuktidāyakaṃ || karpūrakuṃkumenaiva bhūrjapatre suvistṛte | lekhinīyaṃ prayatnena ekāṃte yaṃtramugattamaṃ || madhyenāma likhitvātu hṛllekhāttadanaṃtaraṃ | tatastadveṣṭaye tsamyagvartulaṃ tudvirekhayā || māṃ moca yetisarvatra caturdikṣu praveṣṭayet | catuḥ koṇaṃtu saṃveṣṭya rakhādvitaya kenatu || pūjanīyaṃ prayatnena gaṃdhapuṣpaiḥ phalaiśśubhaiḥ || trilohaveṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā bāhumūlegalethavādhāraṇāt | tatkṣaṇānmuktaḥ saṃsāra iva nirmamaḥ || svasthatādhāraṇā nitya mavarodhaḥ kadācana | jāyatenaiva saṃdehaḥ svapnepihi kadācana || dyūtavijayakaraṇa yaṃtraṃ - athatassaṃ pravakṣyāmi yaṃtraṃ dyūta jayāvahaṃ | sarvadyātehi paramaṃ jayaṃ syādyaṃtradhāraṇāt || vājinaḥ kramamākhyātaṃ catuṣṭaṣṭastu koṣṭakaṃ | taddhāraṇājjayaṃdevi dyūte sarvatraniścitaṃ || eraṃjapajñe saṃlekhyaṃ lekhinyākā kapiccayā | kajjalasya maṣīkṛtvā likhedrātrau śicismite || tiryagūrdhvāstu saṃlekhyā navarekhāstu vistṛtāḥ | evaṃ bhavitikoṣṭhāśca catuṣṣaṣṭhirvārānane || madhyebījāssu saṃlekhyā'nulema pratilomataḥ | teevahi punarlekhyā śśeṣakoṣṭheṣu cakramāt || maikhkairaktaṃda yorupāka jijataṃdanīcanaḥ || chadāvīṃyamaṃtrateṣa heṣṭivāmokṣiṇapātraṃ | etā evatubājānidvātriṃśa dvilekhe trkamāt || sveccayūnīyate yena catuṣṭaṣṭi padaṃjanaiḥ | prasannaṃtu yayāproktaṃ yaṃtraṃ citraṃ manoharaṃ || sarvadyute jayaṃ proktaṃ dhāraṇājjāyatepriye || nigaḍabaṃdhamokṣakara yaṃtraṃ - athātassaṃ pravakṣyāmi yaṃtraṃ nigaḍayocanaṃ | hastapādatalebaddho mucyate yatrpasādataḥ || kāṃsyapātro parilekhyaṃ rocanācaṃdanenaca | karpūrakuṃkumākhyāṃca mṛganābhiyutenaca|| hrīkāraṃ madhyadeśethu vartulaṃ veṣṭayettataḥ | tatastu ṣoḍaśadala makārādi svarānvitaṃ || tasyopariprakartavyaṃ dvātriṃ śraddhalasaṃyutaṃ | kakārādi sakārāṃtaṃ vyajaṃnāni likhetrkamāt || pratiṣṭhāpya mahāpūjāṃ gaṃdhapuṣpakṣataiśśubhaiḥ | naivedyairbali homaiśadrīpadānai rmanoharaiḥ || oṃ namaścaṃḍikāyai svāhetima treṇāṣṭottara śataṃ juhuyāt | pāyasairmadhukhādyaiśca guglulena viśeṣataḥ || pratyahaṃtu prakartavyaṃ saptamehanipūrvate | uddṛtyapraṇataḥ pūrvaṃ bhojanāgaṃdharocanaṃ || pānārthamarthaṃ dātavyaṃ ghaṭikārdena kalpayet | taddhāraṇātrpamucyeta ciraṃbaddhopi mānavaḥ || bālānāṃ jvarādistaṃbhanaṃ daṃtarogādi kṛtrimopadraśamanaṃ yaṃtraṃ - athātassaṃ pravakṣyāmi bālānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ sadā | yaṃtraṃ jvalanarakṣākhya māyurvṛddhikaraṃparaṃ || pūrvoktavidhinālekhyaṃ dravyaṃ pūrvoditaiśśubhaiḥ | bhūrjapatretu saṃlekhyaṃ sāthyanāmatu madhyataḥ || tatastadveṣṭaye tsamyakcatuḥ koṇaṃturekhayā | tasyoparicatuḥ koṇaṃ triśūlaṃ koṇato likhet || koṇāṃtare likhedjījaṃ cakāraṃ bidubhūṣitaṃ | uparyadhoṃtarāletu hrīṃkāraṃ vilikhedbudaḥ || evaṃ saṃlikhya tadyaṃtraṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ | trilohaveṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā baddhniyātkaṃṭha madhyataḥ || yocopasargatāḥ kecidrogā śśārīramānasāḥ | īṣyākopastathā doṣodaṃtānāṃ saṃbhavaḥ punaḥ || nabādhate bālakanya stanyadoṣaḥ kadācana || prativādi mukhastaṃbhana yaṃtraṃ - athatassaṃ pravakṣyāmi vācāstaṃbhaṃcasuṃdari | prativādi mukhastaṃbhaṃ yaṃtraṃ khyātaṃtubhātale || pītadhavyeṇa saṃlekhyaṃ śilāsaṃpuṭa madhyataḥ | rocanā haritālaṃca haridrāṃca manasśilāṃ || kuṃkumena samāyuktaṃ pītadravyaṃ pracakṣate | madhyenāma likhitvātu trikoṇaṃ veṣṭayettataḥ || tatastadveṣṭaye tsamyagvartulaṃ rekhayaikayā | tasyoparidalānyaṣṭhau prakurvīta tataḥ paraṃ || dalamadhye likhedbhījaṃ lakāraṃ biṃduṅabhūṣitaṃ | evaṃ cāṣṭadale lekhyaṃ pūjayetkusumai śubhaiḥ || pītavarṇaistadhādhūpairdīpairṇaivaidyaktaiśśubhaiḥ | brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayeccaikaṃ pāyasevaguḍenaca || tatonikhanyabhūmautusthāpaye tpūrvavattataḥ | vivāde vyavahāreca śāstracarcā sucaprīye || prativādi mukhastaṃbho jāyatenātra saṃśayaḥ | etadyaṃtraṃ mahadevi sugopyaṃ kathitaṃ tava || śāntikaṃpauṣṭikaṃ nāma yaṃtraṃ - śṛṇudevi paraṃguhyaṃ yaṃtraṃ rakṣau karaṃparaṃ | bālastrīpuruṣāṇāṃca mahārakṣākaraṃ smṛtaṃ || kāṃsyapātretu saṃlekhyaṃ sutithau śobhanedine | raucanāṃ kuṃkumainaiva karpūreṇa viśeṣataḥ || mṛganābhi samāyuktaṃ jātīkāṣṭhena saṃlikhet | ūrthvāmaṣṭābhirekhābhistiryagrekhātathaivaca || evamekonapaṃcāśatkoṣṭhāścaprabhavaṃtihi | īśānādikrameṇai vasarvāḥ koṣṭhena saṃlikhet || tainevakramato lekhyā śeṣakoṣṭheṣu vyaṃjanāḥ | evaṃ saṃlikhyabījāni trīśūlāni likhettataḥ | pratirekhoparinūnaṃ caturdikṣu kramāllikhet || kroṃkārāssaptasaṃlekhyāḥ tu pūrvāpaṃktautu paścime | evaṃ saṃlikhya tadyaṃtraṃ pūjaye dbhaktibhāvataḥ || puṃḍarīkaissitāṃbhojaiḥ śatapatrairmanoharaiḥ | mālatīyūdhikābhiśca ketakairmallikaistadhā || vakulaiśca yathālābaṃ phalaiḥ kālodbhavaiḥ śubhaiḥ | nirgaṃdhaṃ raktavarṇaṃca puṣpaṃ yatnena varjayet || nakarrupaiḥ ścatāṃbūlaiḥ dhūpaiḥ dīpaiḥ sitāṃbaraiḥ || dinatrayaṃtu saṃpūjya naivaidhyaiḥ vividhaiḥ priye | japetsaptaśatīnityaṃ bhrāhmaṇāṃstu dinatrayaṃ || naṃpūjyapāyasenaiva yadheṣṭhena ghṛtenatu | tridinaṃ bhūmiśā yīsyodbhojanādgaṃdharocanāṃ || uddṛtyaghuṭikāṃ kuryātrilohairveṣṭayettataḥ | tacceṣaṃ caivapātavyaṃ pānīyena varānane || parasyajāyate kṣobho vidyayā vainiyojitaḥ | ghuṭikāṃdhārayoddevi bāhumulegalethavā || dhāraṇāttasya yaṃtrasya upasargaḥ praśāmyati | alakṣmīḥ kalahaścaiva daurbhāgyaṃca viśeṣataḥ || yatpareṇakṛtaṃ kiṃcittatsaṃrvaṃca praṇasyati | śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ nāmadevānāmapi durlabhaṃ || pradamaṃ yaṃtrarājākhyaṃ sadyaḥ pratyakārakaṃ || itthameva sarvāṇi yaṃtrāṇi sādhyānītisādhakānāṃdik iti śāṃtikamalākara graṃdhe viśeṣa viṣaya sahite uttara pīṭhikāyāṃ yaṃtra vidhinirūpama saṃgrahaḥ samāptaḥ <13> śrī kāśī viśveśvarāya namaḥ śānti kamalākara graṃthe uttara pīṭhikāyāṃ śrī parāśarokta vaidikāgama sūtraṃ omathātaśśivaliṃga vigraha pratiṣṭhāpanaṃ vyākhyāsyāmo pāṃca rātraṃ paṃcaśaivaṃ kevalaṃtātrikaṃ paramahaṃsaṃceti paṃcadhāvibhajya paṃcarātro brāhmaṇastasya karma pāṃcarātraṃ krīyā ligaṃ vigraheṣu mudrā baṃdha prasiddhaṃ śruti maṃtra varjaṃ darśasevādi sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ paṃcaśaivo brāhmaṇaśca paṃcaśaivaṃ karmatena jīvati tathā svayaṃbhūte kriyābhūteṣu svayaṃ bhūtaṃ nārmadaṃ svayaṃ vyaktaṃca yaṃtraṃ mudrā kriyā maṃtramāgama prasiddhaṃ svayaṃ vyaktaṃca yaṃtraṃ mudrā kriyā maṃtra māgama prasiddhaṃ tatkarma siddhaṃ paṃcaśaiva mityāhurdarśana sevā prasādeṣu sarvepi manyaṃte tatra niveditaṃ nagrāhyame tacca śiva nirmālyaṃ tripathagāvarja maṃbhasye tyārabhya sarva liṃgagg sthāpayatiti vijjāyatetanmadya vartivaidika mācakṣate tadeva kevalaṃ sarvatra kāryaṃ nārmadeṣu viśeṣastadhā vigraheṣu tatra niveditaṃ grāhyameva vaidikācāra siddhatvāt - ttaiṃtrikaṃ taṃtra mātrama maṃtraka kriyā bahulaṃ dārumṛṇmaya pāṣāṇeṣu śudrājāti prasiddhaṃ brāhṇāḥ kecidicchaṃti tatra bhaktirgarīyasī jīvahiṃsāḥ prakurvaṃti karmabhraṣṭāḥ prakathyaṃte kailāsa divya kṣetreṣu dhyānārūḍhaṃ parama haṃsaṃ yadābhaktiḥ prajāyate tadā pūjanīyaṃ mānasa mityeva kriyāliṃga vigraheṣu maṇiyaṃtra dāruṣudhyāna gamyaṃ sthāpayaṃti tasyākarṣaṇa balādbāhulakīsthiti statra sarvaṃ varigrahya matrāgamonāsti viśeṣo brāhmaṇā dīnā maicchikī bhaktiṭhyathā jāti prasiddhaṃ tadhā kartavyaṃ || || yadāṃrudā śipaliṃga pratiṣṭhā puṇya karma kariṣyamāṇo vaidike nāgamena dīkṣāṃ dhārayamāṇotha sśyā brāhmacārana striyopetaḥ kṣāra lavaṇa varjanaṃca śivadhyāna sarobhūtvā satataṃ maṃḍubhāṣī satyavādī sātvikaśca jiteṃdriyaḥ prakurvīta śivasāyujyayeti nārmadaṃvā kriyāliṃgaṃ saparivāraṃ saṃpādya - vṛṣabhaṃca gaṇādyakṣaṃ liṃgaṃcedvaidi kaṃbhavat | athavā bali pīṭhaṃca dhavajarājaṃca śāṃbhavī miti - śivakāla nakṣatreṣu vileṣoda gayaneṣu divya kṣetra tīrtheṣu śivaliṃga vigrahapratiṣṭhāṃ kartavyamiti vitrāyate tatrāye nirmikeyadbhūmerityādi śivag śivamityaṃtaṃ yathoktamālaya siddhiṃ kṛtvā yadhāśki karaṇaṃ paṃcapalva paṃcatvakphalāni paṃcagavya paṃcāmṛtāni madhuparka ityeva paṃcavastra sūtrāṇi paṃca kaṣāya paṃcagaṃdha dhāthu pṛṣṇāṇi paṃcadhūpatailāni paṃcabīja dhānyāni caturdaśa ityeva liṃga yaṃtra vastra netra suvarṇa kajjalānidhenu triśūla nārikela ityeva liṃga yaṃtra vastra netra suvarṇa kajjalānidhenu triśūla nārikela kūṣmāṃḍāni paṃcaratna yaṃtrāṇi balidīpa darpaṇāni samicchatvājya kuśatṛṇāni sṛksṛveṃdhavā dīni saṃpādya paṃcaśarāva pūrṇakuṃbhāni caturveda maṃtrāgama brāhmaṇāgśca saṃpādya vyāghra jana rudrākṣa sarvapārka kṣīrabilvapatrāṇi bhasmagolakānica saṃpādyāṣṭa baṃdhanāṣṭa pīṭhā yaśśaṃku ketanāni tatrokta devatā kalaśa vastra pratimādīni maṃgalatūrya vādyāni vāhanāṃdolikā cchatra cāmarāṇi divya dukūla vsatrābharaṇānica saṃpādya yadokta dakṣiṇāṃ dvatvā pūjā saṃbhāravānupa viśvabrāhmaṇān prārthayet || || tataḥ śvobhūte mahāpagāpsu yadhānidi snātvāsvakīya śivālaye maṃtrasidde brāhmaṇaissahā puṇyāhaṃvāca yitvā | pavitraprāṇaiḥ prāṇānāyamyadeśakālau saṃkīrtya śrīparameśaavara prītyarthaṃ saparivāraṃ saṃsthāpayāmīti saṃkalpaya ṛtvijaḥ prayaṃjāno brahmaṇamācāryaṃ pṛṇuyādrbahaṇān japakarmasuca bṛhatsāmeti kaṃkaṇaṃ dhṛtvā dvihastamātre catuṣkoṇakuṃḍe vidhivadagniṃ pratiṣṭhāpyaparistaraṇāṃtamagni malaṃkṛtayāpassaṃpūjya paṃcaśarāveṣu caturdaśabījānyāvāpya brahmaṇa miṃdraṃ dharma mapāṃpatica somamityetāḥ paṃcadevatā avāhya nityaṃ saṃpūjaye dyāpatkarma paryaṃtaṃ triśūlamāśusśuśānetyanuvākaṃ paṭhitvā dhvajamūlenidhāyārka kṣīrajalāni rudramaṃtrerabhiṣicya sacetanaṃ saṃpūjya kūṣmāṃḍe nidhāya yāvatkarmaparyaṃtaṃ cakratuṃḍāyeti dvārapālakau saṃsthāpya nacetanau samau kuryāddiklālakāṃtsaṃbhodya digbaṃdhanaṃ kuryāccivālaya syāyaśśaṃkūni sarvatassaṃkalya paṃyasūtre rāveṣṭayet || || tataḥ paraṃ dhānyarāśiṃ parikalsya liṃgayaṃtraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya tanmadhye brahmakalaśe bhrahmāṇamāvāhayetta mīśāna mīśāno namaśśaṃbhaveca namo hiraṇyavāhave tatpuruṣāyeti paṃcabharmaṃtrai rumāpiṃ vaśvanādha māvāhaye tsadyojātāyeti śśephastri śaṃkurghaṭotkaca ityādyā devakīgarbhotthā bahurūpiṇi durgāca śaktiḥ pūtanādyābālaghūtinyo bhūtapreta piśācāścakūṣmāṃjaśānakinī betālādyākṣāḥ kirātadevī śabaro rudraśca śatakoṭi rūpāṇi raudrāṇi mātaṃgī śyāmalocchiṣṭa gaṇapati rucciṣṭacāṃḍālī surabhāṃḍeśvaro mohinī rākṣasī tripurālaṃkhiṇī saubhadevī sāmudrikā vanagurgā durgā ātmahaṃtāra śśikṣitāḥ prati vratāśca dravyadevyo guṇadevyo kriyādevya ityādyā grāmadevatā ssamavāyena pūjyate sīdhumāṃsabali birdīpairutsavaiśca tatraghātukā vīrānuyāyino bairavānu yāyinaśca bhairava mahākālavīrabhadrā vṛṣabho gaṇapati hanūmāṃśca tatraśāstā viśeṣeṇa bairavorcyate śūlinī pratyaṃgi rāśmaśāna vāsinīkṛtyaca || || rūpāṇveṣāṃ tattatpurāṇoktāni deva kapavīra raktakaravīra śvetārkanīlonmaṃttajapā picumaṃda snuhyādi patrapuṣpa nirvāsakṣīrādyai rarca yitvāgnikuṃjasya prādakṣiṇyena prācyāmagārasya dhvajastaṃbhe vaśuṃnnahya kṛṣṇachāṃgabastaṃ ṣahiṣaṃ vāvīrāveśīkhaḍgenetkṛtyatasya pādaṃ tanmukhe saṃkīlyatacchirasi devatābhimukhaṃ tailaśarāvaṃ nikṣipya nītanavāsasādīpaṃ prajvālyavādyaghoṣema mahānṛttena caṃjālā devīṃstuvaṃtigrāmīṇā aśvecadarśana prasādamātraṃ śirasāvahaṃti prasannāyadi grāmadevatā grame tasmin mārikāroga paśuroga durbhikṣarogādayaḥ śāmyaṃti nāgnigehātipradahenna nadījala māplāvayedapamṛtyarnaśyatinaiva sarpavṛścikādayo viṣavīryābādhaṃte nabhinodaṃṣṭriṇaścāraṇyagāḥ kiṭibhallūkavyāghrā siṃhādayohiṃ saṃti yogakṣemaḥ kalpate rāṣṭrecaprajākṣemo bhavatīti vikṣāyate || || pratiṣṭhāyāmādaudīkṣitaḥ viśitenaparisrūtāca madhunāmadyenaghṛte nakṣīreṇācamānavīyena śirasā tatrpatinidhi nārikelaphalena prāṇapratiṣṭhādibhiḥ kukkuṭādi bhiralaṃkṛte maṃṭape pratimā alaṃkṛtyalohitānnādi balibhirārādhyakecidupāsakā ssvasvāṃgā nichitvā prayacchaṃti nātrodbaṃdhanaṃ naiva mapakurvaṃti sāhasovā viṣavīrāṇāṃkalau pratyakṣībhavati phalaṃ pratyakṣībhavati phalame tadevakalau śūdrāṇā mucitamityāha bhagavāsparāśaraḥ || || smṛtipūrāṇa samuccaye - pallipakkaṇakheṭānā mābhīra śibirasyaca | kirātapālikāyāśca pugaśreṇavaṇikpathāṃ | śadrāṇāṃ karṣakāṇāṃca nagaryāṃ pattanasyaca | grāmasyacopa grāmasyatvāṣṭrāvāsasya paddhateḥ | grāmaṃcaḍālavācyāśca vilomāvāsakasyaca | tathā pulkanavācyāśca kuviṃdā vāsakasyaca | devyoyāścābhimānīyāḥ kathyaṃte grāmadevatāḥ iti || || āgamasmṛti sāragraṃdhe - bhrāhmaṇānāṃ śivedevaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃtu mādhuvaḥ | vaiśyānāṃtu bhavedbrāhmaśudrāṇāṃ grāmadevatāḥ | tasyedaṃ vyākhyānaṃ - śivognirvedaśca mādhavo dharmoyajñaśca brahmatu bhrāhmaṇā eva grama devatāḥ parāśaroktāścaturvaryena yathākrama marcyaṃtu iti || || devīyāmale ghramadevatā uktāḥ - kālakarma vaśājñātāḥ kalpitā buddhiyogataḥ | svadeśabhāṣānāmādyairarcyaṃte grāmadevatā iti | teṣāmarcanaṃca brāhmaṇā apiśag saṃtītyeke - bhagavaṃtaṃ sarvātmakaṃ tajjalānitiśāṃta upāsītetyādi śrutivacanaiḥ brāhmaṇasyasarvaṃbrahma mayābhavaṃtīti nirduṣṭaṃ | etadvaikāminamuktamākāmānāṃ nakiṃcana | grāmīṇo grāmarakṣārdī pūjaye dgrāmadevatāḥ | iṃdrākṣīpramukhādevya sarvatevāṃśa saṃbhavāḥ | śaktayastatra pūjyaṃte nānārūpāḥ kalauyuge - iti || || tatragrāmadevatā āhabappadeva - śivaśakta ssuvarṇāṃbāreṇukaścāṇimā tathā | vīrāmabā mārikā gaṃgā phasa gairīca nagnikā | arkikā vīrabhadraśca vīraśvapatirevaca | bhillaḥ kirāto laddaśca draipadīcāgrajā tathā | garvāṃbācāryanādhaśca bhavanī saddhapūruṣaḥ | raidrīrudrā mahārāṣṭrī mānikārudra saṃdhikā | mūkāṃbāvalla vāssarve kṛṣṇabhaktāśca yādavāḥ | lakṣmīstārā brahmarakṣastṛṇāṃbā pulla locanā | pharmaīśo mahādevi rudrāṇi caṃḍikeśvaraḥ | vināyakaścauka mātāciṃtyesīvaraṇā tathā | valmīki nīcabheruṃḍā durgāṃdācārgalāṃbikā | jyotirmaheśo yegīnī bakalātathā | śukahastā śṛṃkhalākā māyūrī siṃhāvāhinī | vāruṇīśa ṣkulīkṛtyā rākṣasī caṃdraśekharā | virguṃḍikārkavṛkṣasthā prasthā paryaṃkavāsinī | aṃjanābhūśca niryāsa staṭākesyoṣadhīśvarī | vyāghreśaśca dhanuṣkoṭī stulākoṭi sta theṃdirā | upalā nāgarūpāca jaṭīśāstāca bhauravaḥ | ṛṣyaśṛṃgo jāmadagnyaḥ pārṣataśśakunasśamī | dṛṣadvānkīṭa nāthāca nahādaṃḍāca kuṃḍikā | śreṇikā cāṇakhelāca kūṣtāṃḍaśca vināyakaḥ| masūrikā hipenāca tulasī paśuratsapā | retasśirā mahāviṣṇuḥ kāṃcyāṃ siddena pūjitaḥ | prātītika stamālaśca gaṃgābhṛccha dukūlikā | nīlaśca mihira svāmī spoṭāṃbāca munīśvaraḥ | cālinī śūrpikā cau vagrabayedhaka yūdhapāḥ | malinī yakṣarūpāca mārkaṭo lūkhalātmikāḥ | hauyaṃdavīnā musalī kamārī bāḍharūpiṇī | jalamūrtiścāgnimūrti ścakravākādi nāyakāḥ | laṃbhinī pūjanetyādyāḥ pūjyaṃte grāmadevatā - iti || || iti grāmadevatā pratiṣṭhādi vicāraḥ śrīrastu hrīṃ namaśśivāyau śrī bhuvanesvarī kacchapuṭī taṃtra graṃdhaḥ srīmahāgaṇapatay namaḥ - namaskṛtma mahadevaṃ sṛṣṭisthityaṃta kāriṇaṃ | yaṃtraṃ kacchapuṭī saṃjñaṃ sarahasyaṃ nirūpyate || bhuvaneśvarī kaccha yaṃtrāraṃbhaḥ || - purālokopa kārāyaśivena paribhāṣitaṃ | saṃkhyāyega phalaṃ cakraṃ varṇayegau rabhīṣṭadaṃ || ūrdhvarekhā likhetpaṃca tiryakpaṃca tathā likheta | koṣṭa ṣoḍaśakaṃ cakraṃ jñātaṃ kaṭapayādibhiḥ || rājyaṃ vīro bali rajva yegī gāvo vaye ruruḥ | ekādyaṣṭāṃtikaṃ tatrasthāneṣveteṣu saṃ likheta | ādyena lakṣyate vīdhiru ttareṇa tathā gṛhaṃ | dhruvāṣṭaka midaṃ cakraṃ samaṃ sarveṣu karmasu || ārdī kṛtya yadiṣṭhaṃ tadekona kramaśo likheta | bhogī raghu paṭu rgairī laṃkā putraḥ khago bhuḥ | ukta makṣara saṃkhyābhi rathavā pāribhāṣikauḥ || sūnyaṃ śūnyaṃ karai sa ptaṛtavo pahnaya stadhā | khaṃ khaṃ khaṃ khaṃ gajāścaṃdro vedā bāṇāścakhaṃ cakhaṃ || itdhaṃvā dhruva saṃsthānaṃ gaṇite sāṃka pūraṇaṃ | ekādi ṣoḍaśāṃtānāṃ saṃkhyānāṃ sanniveśane || yayā kayāpi vidhayā samakoṣṭaṃcatuṣṭaye | catustriṃśati revasyātsa maṣṭirnauva hīyate || nyūnodde śe tatojñeyaṃ likhitasyaca lekhanaṃ | nādhike punarāvṛtti ssaṃkhyānāṃ tatra vidyate || evaṃ nama samaṣṭināṃ samacakre niveśanaṃ | nama keṣṭheṣu viṣamā samaṣṭiryadi kāṃkṣyate || ekasya punarāvṛtti rekaṃvā nyūna maṃkakaṃ | icchāvikalbā duddeśonāṃka viccheda lakṣaṇaṃ || daṃjaḥ pāśvvaṃca koṇaṃca cakraṃ vyastamiti kramāt | nāmāni paṃca vedhānāṃ nirvedhaṃ cakramucyate || saṃkhyā yogaphalaṃ cakraṃ paṃcavedhava varjitaṃ | bījaṃ hi sarvasirdhīnāṃ mayāyabrūhi pārvatī || iti śrī umāmaheśvara saṃvāde mayāsuropadeśe kakṣaluṭīvidhāva taṃtre bhavaneśvarī saṃkhyāyogavidhi rnāma pradhamodhyāyaḥ || || oṃ yaṃtretu bhuvaneśvaryā madhyemāyāṃca tṛṣvipi | pārśvadvayelikheddevyau vāgbhījaṃ kāmamevaca || sādhya nāmaca tatraiva karma saṃdhāna lakṣaṇaṃ | druveṣūditamārgeṣu sarvān prasvān likhetsaha || adruveṣuca tatraiva sarvān dīrghān likhetsa | karmacodita maṃtrāṃśca māyayā sahā saṃlikhet || kādighāṃtān druvelikyaṭādi dhāṃtāsparelikhet | kṣādilāṃtān dhruvelikhya nādirāṃtān parelikhet || ṅañaṇai rujhghitairvarṇaiḥ pratilomānulemataḥ | rekhāgrevilikheccūlān prīṃkāraṃ madhyaśūlake || tatpārśvaśūlayorlekhyebīje pāsāṃkuśāhvaye | dikpālakākṣaraṃ dikṣumātṛṇāmakṣarāṇyapi || kṣatrādīśān likhedaṣṭau diggajāṣṭakamevaca | mahānāgāṣṭakaṃ caiva vainateyāṣṭakaṃ tadhā || tato grahāṇāṃ navakaṃrāśidvādaśakaṃnyaset | marutāṃ saptakaṃ caiva paṃcabāṇāṃ stathālikhet || pakṣīṇāṃ paṃcakaṃ caiva gaṇānādha catuṣṭayaṃ | uparyuparivinyasya hrīṃkāreṇaca veṣṭayet || raṃghaṃjhaṃ yaṃtrabājāni pratikoṣṭheṣu vinyaset | yugmaitarāyā ssaṃkhyāyāḥ pūrvāṃśātyetu yatkṛtaṃ || saṃkhyāyāma parāṃśādau likhecceṣaṃtupūrvavat | upāṃtye cāṣṭamecādye daśamenavamedvaye || saptameṃtye prayokcavya mūnaikārdhaṃ samālikhet | yaṃtraṃ kaccapūṭī saṃjñaṃ saṃkhyābīja samanvitaṃ || prasādādbhūvaneśvaryāḥ sirvasiddhi pradaṃbhavet | atrabīja vivekāya pṛthaguddṛtyakadhyate || - sarvāṣṭoḍaśa vijñeyā ākārādyaśca mātrikaiḥ || || iti kaccapūṭī taṃtre umāmaheśvara prokte bījākṣara vinyāsa vidirnāmadvitī yodhyāyaḥ | oṃ yaṃtra prayoga vijñānaṃ vakṣyāmi saha maṃtrakaṃ | vaśya mohana vidveṣoccāṭa nākarṣaṇānica || staṃbhanaṃ māraṇaṃ bedaḥ prayogā āṣṭadhā matāḥ | aicchikā ātmayogena phalavai citrya darśakāḥ || huṃ vidveṣe ghaṭa uṭṭāṭe khekhe caivatu māraṇe | namastaṃbeva ṣaḍvaśye voṣaḍā karṣaṇe tadhā || klīṃ mohaneca kaḍbhede pallavāḥ parikīrtitāḥ | akārādi svara dvaṃdvaṃ pratyekaṃ cāṣṭa karmasu || atha vaśya maṃtraḥ - laṃ hrīṃ paṃ khaṃ vaṣaṭ sarvajanaṃme vaśamānaya svāhā || || atha mohana maṃtraḥ - laṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ laṃ līṃ klīṃ klīṃ klūṃ klaiṃ kṣlauṃ klaḥ haṃ sakala mohaya sarveṃdriyāṇi preraya prasīda mahāmāye sarvamehinyai namaḥ || || vidveṣaṇa maṃtraḥ - oṃ hrīṃ raṃ hrīṃ huṃ bhuvaneśvaryai namaḥ || || atha uccāṭana maṃtraḥ - oṃ hrīṃ raṃ raṃ laṃ harihara devi pratipaṃthi muccāṭaya phaṭaṃ śrīghraṃ gaccha gaccha svāhā || || atha ākarṣaṇa maṃtraḥ - oṃ hrīṃ oṃ vauṣaṭ namaste bhagavati sarveṃdriyāṇi samākarṣa yākarṣaya svāhā || || atha staṃbhana maṃtraḥ - oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ haṃ ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ jhāṃ namassvāhā namonamaḥ || || atha māraṇa maṃtraḥ - hrīṃ raṃ raṃ raṃ kheṃ kheṃ bhairavi bhūvaneśvari mahā mārikemāraya māraya ripuṃ svāhā || || atha bhedana maṃtraḥ - oṃ hrīṃ ṅīṃ klīṃ kaṭ bhavanādhi pataye namo nama ssakaladurita haṃtryai duritaṃ kaṭ chiṃdhi tayormamatāṃ mitrabhedaṃ kuru kuru oṃ hrīṃ huṃ pṛthak pravartaya hrāṃ hrīṃ klīṃ jagatprasūtaye namaḥ || || iti prayogāṣṭaka maṃtrā bhavaṃti - iti śrī bhuvaneśvarī kakṣapuṭī taṃtre umā maheśvara saṃvāde prayoga maṃtravidhi rnāma tṛtīyodhyāyaḥ || oṃ || || oṃ yaṃtretu bhavaneśvaryāḥ pūjāvidhi mathabṛve | gaṇeśa durgāsenā nikṣetreśān dikṣu vinyaset || bhuvaneśvarī bhomātā rehyehi jagadhīśvarī | sarvajñānakriyāśakte maṃtrayaṃtra maheśvarī || iti prārthyavāhya yathau vibhavaṃvai prapūjyet | prayoga kriyānusāreṇa tattanmaṃtrān yojayediti saṃkṣepaḥ || svarāṣṣoḍaśa vijñeyā vyaṃjanādyaṃta yogataḥ | amulema vilomābhyāṃ jñaṇatraya varjatāḥ || ityakṣara ratrayaṃ jñeyaṃ pratyeka mupacārake | tadrūpiṇyai namassvāhā sarvatra samametat || vaśyamohanayoḥ karmavasaṃte parikīrtitaṃ | grīṣmetūccāṭanaṃ śastaṃ varṣāsvevahimāraṇaṃ || staṃbhanaṃca śatatkāle haimaṃte dveṣabhedane | ākarṣaṇaṃ ca śiśiredinemāya kramastathā || vaśyamohākarṣaṇāni staṃbhanaṃ sitapakṣake | anyadapyasite sādhyaṃ saumyakrūrāśca vāsarāḥ || kramātkarmāṇi carvāti pratipanmukhataḥ kramāt | śitoṣṇakaṃṭakakṣīri phalivaṃdhayadrumakramaḥ || śuklaṃ nīlaṃca dūmraṃca pītaṃcaharitaṃ tadhā | raktaṃca kapiśaṃ citraṃ prayoge ṣvaṣṭakarmasu || balyannākṣata puṣpādi rūpamevaṃ vicaṃtiyatām | vaśyetvākarṣaṇestaṃbhekuṃḍaṃtu caturaśrakaṃ || mohoccāṭana bedheṣuvartulaṃ kuṃḍamucyate | vidveṣe māraṇevāpi trikoṇaṃ parikīrtitaṃ || ekadvitri vitastīnāṃ ghātayāma viśālavat | koraṃṭa tulasīgujāmallikāvaśyakarmaṇi || kuṭajau duṃdubarīśigru śikhi somāśca mohane | duttūparakhadirau śṛṃgi bera vṛscikapucchake || veśyā jaṭājaṭāmāṃsī markaṭyaṃ gāravallikī | babhrupādaśca dhūmākhyā muṣaka śrutirevaca || nnuhirvi dveṣataṃtre tutreyā dvādaśamūlikāḥ | saumyasnuhi rbahmadaṃḍīśamya śvattha kusāmṛtāḥ || gāṃdhārī sahadevīca bhūtalī balarākṣasī | laśunaṃ gaṃdhakaṃ lomalākṣāsarjara sovacā || lavaṇaṃ kaṭphalaṃ vahni durgaṃdhaśca durālabhā | kṣāra ityevamādīni sarvoccāṭana karmasu || śvetārkarakta dūttūra nīlonmattakuśā api | pāribhadraka karpūra sudhūpa bhasitānica || raktakārpāsa nepāla niśābhaya punarnavāḥ | kadaṃba kuṃkumādīni sarvākarṣaṇa karmasu || śvetārka śvetaguṃjaina jātī śvetapalāśakau | suvarṇavallī vārāhī vajravallīca pāradaḥ || raktonmattaṃ pītamallī gairikaṃca manasśilā | ketakīceti vijñeyaṃ sarvastaṃbhana karmasu || abhrakaṃ tālakaṃ sīsaṃ varāhasyaca kaṃṭakaṃ | śavasya kaṃḍarā vyāghrāśmaśrūṇica tiladrumaḥ || eraṃḍa rasavyāvartauca droṇomaricavallarī | atasī padmarudrākṣanīlikā apimāraṇe || viruddajaṃtu kaṃkāla ghākanetra śaśaśrutī | nakulasya śiraḥ kāka kukkuṭāṃḍa jabarhakaṃ || jyotiṣmatīca bheruṃḍī muṃḍī drurapibhedane | aṃjane nīlakārpāsaṃ matsyākṣī bhṛṃgarājakaḥ || varāhasya ghṛtaṃ mūla mīśvaryāśca viśiṣyate | mūlikā badnikā yaṃtra rakṣādhāraṇa karmasu || tilakecāṃjanelepe yathāyogaṃ prayojayet | dhūpādiṣvahi nirmokaḥ kvacidatra prayujyate || vidveṣoccāṭana bhodo māraṇaṃcapurādbahiḥ | naivaraktabaliṃ dadyānmāraṇetara karmami || vidveṣo mohanaṃbhedo māraṇaṃca catuṣṭayaṃ | śreyaskāmairna kartavyamarātiṣvapi dhārmikaiḥ || kaṃṭhadaghnajale snātvā sthitvāvātatra tatparaḥ | araṇye giridurge vātulyaśvattha saṃnidhau || gopucchaṃ śivaliṃgaṃ vā nārikela mupaspṛśan | japādakṣara lakṣasyamaṃtra siddhirbhavetkalau || nopadeśo naviyamo nāṃganyā sotravidyate | siddhayotra bhaviṣyaṃti māsādarvāgitisphuṭaṃ || iti kaccapuṭītaṃtre prayogasādhanaṃ caturthodhyāyaḥ || || oṃ sarvayaṃtra prayogeṣu pariśiṣṭamidaṃśṛṇu | japataṃtrādirāhityai bāvanaiva garīyasī || vyāpakaṃ hyātma caitanyamavyaktamiva māyayā | aṃtaḥ karaṇa tādātmyā dadhyastai ssarvavastubhiḥ || sarvāvanthaṃ vibhātyekaṃ sarvajñaṃ sarvaśaktimat | sarvabīja suvicchinnaṃ svābhinnaṃ nityamātmanā || jñātvā tadbalato yogī yaṃtrasiddhi mavāpnuyāt | yaṃtrakoṣṭhākṣarāṇāṃca rekhārjava samatvataḥ || phalotpādakatā śaktirjāyate nānyathā kvacit | adṛṣṭaviṣaye yaṃtramaphalāyaivakalpate || kāryakāraṇasāhitya mātmarakṣama maveca | sādhyasādhana saṃbaṃdhaḥ kathaṃcitparikalyatāṃ || svabhogyaviṣaye saumyesukhevā sukhasādhane | nyāyedharmyepivā yaṃtraṃ śarīredhāryamevatat || gṛhādyāvaraṇasyā tarupayogāya yadbhavet | pratighāta nivṛttāca tatra dvārādimastake || badhnīyānmohanā dautu tatkāledarśaye tkvacit | tatraiva pratighātā dau lekhanīyaṃ manīṣibhiḥ || vidveṣe bhedanevāpi bhūmau khanasamucyate | ākarṣaṇetu vikṣopo būmāvāstaraṇaṃ tadhā || bhiṃdyādvāmāraṇe yaṃtraṃ dāhaye dvānyamūlataḥ | sukhaṃ duḥkha nivṛttiśca phaladvaya mudīratiṃ || aṃtarmātṛka yābhāvyaṃ bhūtvātatparamānasaḥ | bahuvidbhahudā yaṃtraṃ bahirmātṛka yālikhet || saṃkhyākṣara kriyā maṃtrayoga dravya prabhāvataḥ | aiccikaṃ hi camaktāraṃ mayāya brūhipārvati || iti kacchapuṭa bhūvaneśvarī taṃtre pariśiṣṭa vidhirnāma paṃcamo dhyāyaḥ || || oṃ || oṃ abhisaṃdhi prabedhena saṃkhyai vodarkakāraṇaṃ | samaṣṭuddeśa lābhāddi cakrabheda ihocyate || cakrasyatoyakoṣṭeṣu sahā viccinnasaṃkhyayā | nirvedacaturaṃkāpta samaṣṭi ssamavartanī || taṃtradaivādibhedena phalabhedāyakalpate | pārimāṃḍilyamātrā ddirekhā vaiṣamyato phalaṃ || puruṣārdhagaṇaissarva puruṣārdhāpirucyate | saṃtānāptī rasaguṇaistathā dairtvidviruttaraiḥ || ārogyaṃ vijayaṃ pīḍā nivṛtti śamamevaca | viṣasyanigrahaṃ śatṛkṣayaṃ svāttābhirakṣaṇaṃ || kuṭuṃbarakṣaṇaṃ vādivāksaṃbhaṃ śilpabhaṃjanaṃ | āyudhastaṃbhavaṃ kṣudramṛgāṇāṃ mukhabaṃdhanaṃ || iṣṭamoṣidvaśyamarthaṃ mohanaṃ mitrabhedhanaṃ | saṃkocanaṃ vikāsaśca śatṛvarga phalāyanaṃ || dhānyavṛddhiṃ paśorviddhiṃ taṭākādi nibaṃdhanaṃ | sthāpanaṃ gopurādhīnāṃ jīrnoddhāraṃ kṛṣikriyaṃ || nidhisaṃsthāpanaṃ graṃdhiyocanaṃ kāryabhaṃjanaṃ | kāryasiddhiṃ ca saṃdhānaṃ gūha saṃcāṣṭabhūtikaṃ || yaṃtra mityādikāryeṣu māyābīja prabhāvataḥ | yaujyaṃ govyaṃca yatnena kriyā sunipuṇairnaraiḥ || tāṃtrīkī bhuvaneśvaryā siddireṣā prakīrtitā | śuddhadravya janasaṃghāta yogavai citya śaktibhṛt || etatkaccapūṭī taṃtrasāroddhārasamīritaṃ | rahasyaṃ maṃtraśāstetu satyaṃ kaliyugebhavet || iti kaccapuṭītaṃtre phalakadhanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭhodhyāyaḥ || iti kaccapuṭītaṃtrasāroddhāra ssaṃgraha samāptaḥ eva sarvāṇisaṃkhyā vinyasayoga kacchapuṭīyaṃtraṇī taṃtroktavidhinā parikalpyāni diṅmatramatrodā hṛtānyetā nītiśivaṃ śrīgurubhyonamaḥ atha śaivāgayokta bhīmaratha śānti prāraṃbhaḥ athāta ssaṃpravakṣyāmi śāntiti bhīma rathābhidhām | saptatyāṃ jāyate mṛtyuḥ nṛṇāṃ bhīma ruthābhidaḥ || dāra nāśaḥ putra nāśo dhananāśo rujastadhā | ṣaṇmāsānmṛtyu māpnoti vivattirmahatī bhavet || taddoṣa śamanārthāya śāntiṃ kuryādyadhāvidhi | saptatyaṃ vatsare pāpte janrkṣe janmamāsake || janmavāre janmatidhau caṃdra tārā balānvite | abdapūrtidinevāpi śāṃtiṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ || gṛhastyaiśāna digbhāge maṃḍapaṃ kārayocchubham | vitāna mālikā yuktaṃ patākādyupaśobhitam || tatravediṃ vrakurvita caturaśrāṃ samaṃ tataḥ | tatra vrīhī nvinikṣipya triṃśaddroṇa pramāṇakān || tadardaṃ taṃḍūlānnyasya tasyopari tilānnyaset | kuṃbhaṃ tatra pratiṣṭhāpya sudṛḍhaṃcā vraṇaṃ navam || mṛtyuṃjayasya pratimāṃ triṃśanniṣka pramāṇikāṃ | sauvarṇīṃ tatra saṃsthāpya brahma viṣṇu ca pūjayate || adhi pratyadhi devautau tadarda svarṇa mānataḥ || iṃdrādyaṣṭa digīśān tathaiva cirajīvisaḥ | sādgūṇya devatā ssarvāḥ ādityādi navagrahān || caturo maruṇāṃścaiva palaika parimāṇataḥ | kṛtavā samyag‌vidhānena kuṃbheṣu sthāpayedbudhaḥ || puṇyāhavācanaṃ kṛtvā mātṛkā pūjanaṃ tataḥ | nāṃdī śraddhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā karma saṃkalpa mācaret || mṛtyuṃjaya vidhānena adau mṛtyuṃ jayaṃ yajet | brahmāṇaṃca yajetsaścāt brahma jijñāna maṃtrataḥ || viṣṇuṃ samarcayodbhaktyā tadviṣṇoriti maṃtrataḥ | ānyāstu devatāssarvāḥ svasvamatraiḥ pṛthak pṛthak || karudraṃ puruṣe sūktaṃca sauraṃgāma pataṃ tathā || mahāśāṃtiṃca vidivate paṭheyuśca yadhā kramaḥ || rudrābiṣecanaṃ kuryānmārtāṃḍasya namaskriyāḥ || pradakṣiṇānica tathā kuryādaśvattha śākhinaḥ || tatohomaṃ prakurvītagraha yajñapurassaram | mukhāṃtaṃ karmakurvīta sva sūtrokta vidhānataḥ || hunedamṛtavallī bhiḥ ghṛtāktābhi ssahasrakam | mṛtyuṃjaya vidānoktamaṃtreṇa nyāsapūrvakam || tadviṣṭo ritamaṃtreṇa pālāśa samidhāhunet | brahmaji jñānamaṃtreṇa pālāśyairjuhuyādatha || anyāsāṃ devatānāṃ tu svasvamaṃtrairhunetrkamāt | treyaṃbakeṇa maṃtreṇa nyāsa dhyānapurassaram || sahasramayutaṃ vāpi tilahomaṃ samācaret | tataḥ sviṣṇa kṛtaṃ hutvā homaṃśeṣaṃ samāpayet || āvāhitānāṃ devānāṃ puṣpaṃjali yathārpayet | abhliṃgaiḥ pāvamānībhiḥ akṣibhyāmiti sūktataḥ || navagrahokta maṃtraiścha surāstvāmin maṃtrataḥ | yajamānaṃ bhadrapīṭhe susthitaṃ tvabhiṣecayet | nirīkṣitājya dānādi krūra dānāni kārayet | abhiṣekā plutaṃ vastraṃ mācāryāya nivedayet || ācārya mādau saṃpūjya vastrālaṃkaraṇādibhiḥ || mṛtyuṃjayasya pratimāṃ savastraṃ prati pādayet | anyāśca pratamāssarvāḥ ṛtvigbhya ssaṃpradāpayet || ācāryāyaca gāṃdadyā tsavatsāṃca payasvinīṃ || śrīmūrti dānaṃ bhūdānaṃ kanyādānaṃdā tathaivaca | brahmapratiṣṭhā rānaṃcadaśadānāni kārayet || dīnānātha viśiṣṭebhyo bhūridānaṃ samācaret | tri sahasraṃ sahasraṃvā brāhmaṇān bhojayettataḥ || evaṃ yaḥ kurute śāṃtiṃ nidhivacchaddhayānvitaḥ | sasarvaroga nirmuktaḥ sarvapīma vivarjitaḥ || śatavatsara paryaṃtaṃ bhūktābhogāna sanekaśaḥ | aṃte śivapadaṃ prapya tatraiva parimodate || iti śaivāga mokta mārkaṃḍeya bhīmaratha śāṃti ssamārpā atha śaunakokta bhīmartha śāṃti kramaḥ śaunakohaṃ pravakṣyāmi śāṃtiṃ bhīmaradhābhidām | jananātpaptatau varṣe mṛtyurbhīma radhobhavet || ṣaṇmāsānmṛtyu māppoti dhanahānistadhaivaca | putra dārādi nāśaśca dravyadhānya paśujñayaḥ || taddoṣa śamanārthāya śāntiṃ kuryā dvidhānataḥ | janmamāse janmadine janmarkṣevā balānvite || devālaye nadītīre svagṛhevā śubhasthale | puṇyāhaṃvāca yitvādau kuryānnāṃdī mukhaṃ tataḥ | ācāryaṃ varayitvādāvṛtvijo valayodadha || gṛhasyaiśāna digbhāge maṃḍapaṃkārayedatha || vrīhibhāraṃ vinikṣipya taṃjulaṃtu tadardakaṃ | tadardaṃ tilabāraṃcapadmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhet | tasyoparinyasetkuṃbhān taṃtu vastrādi veṣṭitān || hrīṃkāro parivinyasya bhīmaṃ mṛtyuṃ jayaṃ yajet | valamātra suvarṇena tadarthārthenavā punaḥ || ādhipratyadi devau ca tadarthena prakalpayet | iṃdrādi lokapālāṃśca durgāssūryādikān grahān || abhyarcanaṃ yadhāśakti tattanmaṃtraiḥ prakalpayet | upacārai ṣṣoḍaśabhiḥ pradhānaṃ deva marcayet || stuhiśṛtena mantreṇa adhi pratyadhi devate | brahma jijñāna maṃtreṇa tadviṣṇoriti maṃtrataḥ || yadhokta pūjāṃ kṛtvātha tattanmaṃtrān japetkramāt | veda pārāyaṇaṃ kuryāttathā dvāra japaṃcaret || namakaṃ ca makaṃcaiva śrīsūktaṃ bhūmi sūktakam || maṃḍapātpaścimebhāge kuṃḍaṃ syāccaturaśrakaṃ | svasūtroktena mārgeṇa hyājya bhāgāṃta mācaret || navagrahokta maṃtraiśca tattaddomaṃ samācaret | pradhāna maṃtrakaiḥ kuryātsamiccarvājya homakaṃ || aṣṭottara sahasraṃvā aṣṭottara śataṃtuvā | pradhāna homaḥ kartavya stilahoma stadhaivaca|| ādi pratyādhi devauca darda saṃkhyayā | traiyaṃbakeṇa maṃtreṇa dūrvāhomaṃca kārayet || iṃdrādi loka pālāṃśca hutvā sādguṇya devatāḥ | tatassviṣṭa kṛtaṃ hutvā homa śeṣaṃ samāpayet || yajamānābhiṣekaṃtu kuryārācāryakā dayaḥ | yajamānastvakṛtya hyojyāvekṣaṇa mācaret || kuṃbhaḍānaṃ tataḥ kuryāddaśadānānikārayet | dīnāṃdhaka daridrebhyo bhūridānaṃtu kārayet || brāhmaṇān bhojaye tpaścādā śiṣovācayedatha | sarvaduḥkha nivṛtti ssyātsarvadā sukhamaśnite || śatravopi vinaśyaṃtiputrapautrādi vardhate | harimeva smarennityaṃ karmādyaṃte viśeṣataḥ || iti śrī bṛhaccaunakīye bhīmaratha śānti samāptāḥ atha śaunakokta śatābhiṣeka vidhiḥ śatābhiṣekaṃ vakṣyāmi śaunakohaṃ dvijanmanām | aśītyekābdamāsesyā dadhimāsai ssamanvite || sahasrasomadarśa ssyādūrḍhvaṃ syātpuṇya kṛddhvijaḥ | adottarāyaṇe puṇye pūrvapakṣe śubhidine || siddhayoge sulagnesyācchukre vyomni prakāśite | devālaye nadītīre svāṃgaṇevā śubhasthale || brāhmān samanujñāpya prāyaścittaṃ samācaret | svaibdaissamāna saṃkhyāka kṛcchrācaraṇa mācaret || kūṣmāṃḍaṃ juhuyātpaścādgaṇaṃca savanatraye | vṛddhi śrāddhaṃtupūrvaṃ syātkautukaṃ cāṃkurārpaṇaṃ || ācāryaṃ varayetpūryaṃ daivabhakti parāyaṇaṃ | ṛtvijo varayetpaścā nmadhuparkeṇa pūjayet || maṃḍapaṃkārayetpaścā ddehalī toraṇānvitam | phalapuṣpairalaṃkṛcatya homasthānaṃ prakalpayet || bāhumātra pramāṇaṃtu gomaye nopalepayet | vinyanerdvihibhāraṃtu tadardhaṃ tuṃḍulanyaset | tadardaṃtu tilaṃnyasya padma maṣṭadalaṃ likhet || tasyaparinyastekumbhaṃ pūrayottīrthavāriṇā | nānābhījaṃ paṃcaratnaṃ paṃcagavyaṃ ninikṣipet || niṣkamātra suvarṇena viṣṇurūpaṃ prakalpayet | dhātṛrūpaṃ tadarthena lokapālān tadardhakaiḥ || āvāhyakuṃbha madhyeṣuttanmaṃtraiḥ pṛthak pṛthak | idaṃ viṣṇubrahmaṇāte idaṃte pratramityapi | tatogniṃ dūta miticaya māyetica yoṣuṇaḥ || prasamrāṅe bṛhaditi tavavāya vṛtaspate || saumedhenuṃ tamīśāna mābhirṛgbharyadhrākramaṃ | abhyarcya gaṃdhapuṣpādyairnaivedyaṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak || kuṃbhasya paścimedeśe homaṃsthānaṃ prakalpayet | upalepādikaṃ kṛtvā svasūtrokta vidhānataḥ || vidhināgniṃ pratiṣṭhāpya ājyabhāgāṃta mācaret | samidbhirājya carubhiśacata maṣṭottaraṃ huvet || paramānnaṃtu dadhyānnaṃ ghṛtānnaṃ kṛsaraṃguḍam | saktūṃśca mākṣika madhukṣīra go dhūmaśarkarāḥ || aśvatthaṃ cai vapālāśaṃkhādiraṃ ca śamīṃvaṭam | auduṃbaraṃ plākṣabairve samiḍhaścayadhākramam || ghṛsūktaṃ puruṣasākta māyussūktaṃ vihavyakam || ṅīsūktaṃ bhūmisūkatṃ ca dadhilājājyasaktubhiḥ | tatasviṣṭakṛtaṃ hutavā homaṃśeṣaṃ samāpayet | ājyavekṣaṇa dānaṃcaśrotriyāya pradāyaca | tāmraṃ vāmṛnmayaṃ vāpipātraṃ kṛtvā prayatnataḥ | padmākṛti śatacchidraṃ pauruṣeṇā bhiṣecayet | abhiṣekaṃ tataḥ kuryā dṛgyajussāma ssaṃbhavaiḥ || snātvā'hatānivāsāṃ si paridhāya subhūṣitaḥ | upasthānaṃ diśāṃkṛtvā udutyaṃ jātavedasaṃ || citraṃ devānā mitacanamomitreti sūktataṃ || sūryona iti sūktaṃca vibrāḍbṛhatisūktakaṃ | yamāya dharmarājeti varuṇaṃ vori śādanaṃ || tvaṃ somapracikite ityāmuṣyamitisūktataṃ | śrīsūktaṃ bhūmisūktaṃ ca būmiṃ spṛṣṭvā japedvijaiḥ | mahaśāntiṃ japetvaścā tpuṇyāhaṃ vācayedatha || ācāryaṃ pūjaye tpaścādatvastra go bhūhiraṇyakaiḥ | ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāddaśa dāna mataḥ paraṃ | brāhmaṇān bhojayetpaścā dāśiṣo vācayetadatha | radhaṃ vā kuṃjaraṃ vāpi śibhikā maśvamevavā | āruhyanagarādīni dvijaiḥ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ | svasti duṃdubhi śabdeśca nṛttigītai ssahaivatu | gṛhaṃca praviśetpaścā dāśīrvacana mevaca || aikāhikaṃ dvyāhikaṃ vā evaṃ karmasamācaret | daśapūrvān daśāparānātmānaṃ cai kaviṃśatiṃ | punāti putrimitrā dyaiṣṣaṣṭi varṣasahasrakaṃ | svargabhoga matikramya viṣṇuloke mahiyate || iti bṛhaccaunakīye śatābhiṣekavidhiḥ sahasra caṃdradarśana prapautrajanana śāṃtiḥ bhagavan sarvolokeśa bhaktānugrahakāraka | kenopāyena lokesmin jaṃturmucye tabaṃdhanāt || karmakartu maśaktānāṃ mahāpuṇya phalaiṣiṇām | martyanāṃ śreyase kiṃcidvidhānaṃ saṃpracakṣvame || mahadeva uvāca - śṛṇubhadre pravakṣyāmi kiṃcitkarmaśubhāvam | guhyadguhyataraṃ loke martyānāṃ puṇyavardhanaṃ || caṃdrāṇāṃ tu sahasrasya darśanādbhūvimānavaḥ | prapautradarśanā dvāpi sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || mahatpuṇya mavāpnoti devairapi durāsadaṃ | sahasraṃ śaśināṃ dṛṣṭvā prapautraṃ vāpimānavaḥ || pitṛṇāṃca ṛṇālloke mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | śathābhiṣecanaṃ kāryaṃ śāstrokta vidhanātataḥ || śatābhiṣecanālloke pūjyate sarvamānavaiḥ | śriyaṃ prāpnoti vipulaṃ svargaṃ samadhigacchati || gaṃgāsnānācca yatpuṇyaṃ setubaṃdhana darśanāt | puṇyatīrtheṣu ca snānātkṛcchra cāṃdrāyaṇāditaḥ || laghapāyena tatsarvaṃ phrapnoti bhavimānavaḥ | svarṇabhiṣecanaṃ kuryācchataniṣka pramāṇataḥ || tadardhārdhenavā kurayādvittaśāṭ nakārayet | ratnairapi yadāśakti hyabhiṣekaṃ cakārayet || pūrvatyuvāca - vidhinākena kartavyaṃ vistarādvadhameprabho || mahadevaḥ || namyakpṛṣṭaṃ tvayādevi māryānāṃ hitakāmyayā | tadvidhānaṃ pravakṣyamāmi sarvakarma hitakāmyayā | tadvidhānaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvakarma phalapradaṃ || śubhidine sunakṣatre caṃdratārā balānvite | patnyā sahasamāyuktaḥ putrapautrāda bhissaha || kṛtvātu maṃgasasnānaṃ nityakarma samāpyaca | puṇyāhavācanaṃ kuryā nāṃdīśrāddhaṃ tataḥ param || ācāryaṃ varayoccāṃtaṃ śrotriyaṃ vedapāragam | maṃtra taṃtrakalāpajñaṃ kulīnaṃca kuṭuṃbinam || brāhmāṇaṃ tādṛśaṃ kṛtvā ṛtvijaśca tataḥ paraṃ || pamaṃḍapaṃkāraye dramyaṃ vitānādyairalaṃkṛtam || hemastaṃbaiśca saṃvītaṃ ratnaharai rvibhūṣitam | dhānyarāśiṃ prakalpyātha paṃcadroṇa mitaṃ tadhā | pradānakalaśaṃ devaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ prabhūm || sūryāṃcadra masaucaiva pārśvayorubhayostataḥ | tuṃtubhiḥ pariveṣṭyātha vastrairāccaidyamaṃtrataḥ || sauvarṇa pratimāṃkṛtvā palāṣṭaka samanvitam | adhipratyadidevau ca tadartha palasaṃmitau || brāhmaṇaḥ pratimāṃcaiva prathanārda mitādaṃthā | tatassānādhirūḍheṣu kuṃbeṣvetāḥ pravinyaśet || pratyekaṃ pūjayedetān tattanmaṃtra vidhānataḥ | evaṃ saṃpūjyavithivatkuṃḍaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi || maṃḍapātpaścimebhāge tatrahomaṃ samācaret | mukhāṃtaṃ vidivatkṛtvā tattatkarma samācaret || grahahomaṃ prakurvāta taṃtaṃ devaṃ hunettataḥ | pradhānamaṃtraiḥ pūrvoktairaṣṭottara sahasrakam || juhuyādviṣṇu gāyatryā bahmavṛkṣa samudbhavaiḥ | tatasviṣṭa kṛtaṃhurvā pūrṇāhuti mataḥparaṃ || homaśeṣaṃ samāpyātha abhiṣekaṃ samācaret | yajamānaṃ bhadrapīṭhe upaveśya dvijottamāḥ || navagrahokta maṃtraiśca śaturudrīya maṃtrataḥ || svārṇābhiṣecanaṃ lakṣmīsūktenaca samācaret || surāstvādi pūrāṇoktai rabhiṣicya baliṃkṣipet | yajamānastvalaṃkṛtya ācārayādīn prapūjayet || suvarṇa pratimāṃvasatra mācāryāya nivedayet | ṛtvigbyaśśiṣṭakalaśān brāhmaṇebhyaśca dāpayet || daśadānaṃ tataḥ kuryāt bhūdānaṃca viśeṣataḥ || godānaṃca tataḥ kuryā dbharidānaṃ samācaret || dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇebhyaśca brāhmaṇān bhojayettataḥ | evaṃ yaḥkurute martyastadvidhāṃna maheśvari || dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ mahāpātaka nāśanam | loka priyakaraṃ puṇyamṛṇa dāridryanāśam || ekaviṃśatkulānyevaṃ punātye vanaṃsaṃśayaḥ | sarvedāneṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu yatphalam || tatasarvaṃ samavāpnoti kīrtiṃ sadyaḥ kṣaṇenatu || svargaloke sukhaṃ bhūktvā viṣṇuloke mahīyate || tatassaṃ prapya mallokaṃ matsāyujyaṃ samaśnute || || iti śrīśaivāgame uttarakhaṃḍe umāmaheśvara maṃvāde śatābhiṣeka kanakābhiṣeka vidhānaṃ saṃpūrṇam || atha śatasaṃvatsara jīvinassahasra caṃdradarśinaśca śatābhiṣekavidhiḥ athātaśśatābhiṣikavidhiṃ vyākhyā syāma śśatasaṃvatsara jīvina sahasra caṃdradarśina ścodagayana āpūrvamāṇapakṣe puṇyanakṣatre brāhmaṇānannenaparitoṣya puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā deva yajanollekhana prabhṛtyā praṇītapātrāṃtaṃ kṛtvācotthāya vrīhi bhiryavairvācaturaśraṃ sthaḍilaṃ kṛtvā tatra pradhāna kalaśaṃ nidhāyapradhānaṃ gaṃdhapuṣpaphalairavakīrya iṃdrādi krameṇa dakṣiṇottarān kalaśān sthāpayitvā tiraḥ pavitraṃ vidhāya śuddodakena pūrvayitvā madye pradhānakalaśaṃ ratnairavakīryā hatavāsa sāccādya gaṃdhapuṣpai raliṃkṛtya madhyepradhānakalaśe brahmāṇa māvāhayediṃdrādīṃśca krameṇa prajāpati māvāhayāmi | parimeṣṭinamāvāhayāmi || caturmukha māvāhayāmi | hiraṇya garbha māvāhayāmi | ityāvāhya paridhāna prabhu tyagnimukhāṃtaṃ kṛtvā devatā marcayityā pohiṣṭhāmayo bhuva iti tisṛbhirhiraṇyagarbha iti catasṛbhiḥ pavamānassuvarjna ityanuvākenaca mārjayitvādaitān gaṃdhapuṣpa dhūpadīpaira muṣmai namomuṣyai nama ityannenāmuṣmaisvāhetyatha pakvājjuhotyāyuṣṭe viśvatodadha viśvatodadha ditipuronuvākyā manūcyāyūrdhā agneha viṣa iti yājyayājuhoti | brahmajijñānamiti brahmasūktena agnirāyiṣmāniti paṃcabhiḥ parvāyaiḥ sviṣṭakṛtrpabhṛti siddhamādhenu varapradānā tathāgreṇāgniṃ darbhastaṃbheṣu hutaśeṣaṃ nidathātyāmuṣṭa, āyurdhā agne itidvābhyāmatrai tadabhiṣekaṃ karoti yā sugaṃdhārasauvarṇā iti catasṛbhiḥ pratyarcaṃ pradhānakalaśe nābhiṣiṃ ca tīṃdrādikrameṇa yā prācīritica tasṛbhiranuccaṃda samabhiṣekaṃ karoti | yā ūrdhvā iti pradhānakalaśa śeṣeṇābhiṣiṃcati | ahatā nivāsāṃsi paridhāyā ca myāṃlakṛtyā dityamidvikṣya udvayaṃ tama saspadi | udutyaṃ | citraṃ | taccakṣurdevahitaṃ | udagādaya māditya ityadaite naivapathā pratyetyaiṇakāṃ vaiyāghrīṃ vā samāstīrya tasayāṃ prāṅmakha upaviśya sauvarṇe rājatetāmre kāṃsyevā pātre ājyamānīya hiraṇyaṃ nidhāya nimīlyonmīlyā vekṣya brāhmaṇāya prayacchati | adharathamāruhya grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇī kṛtya duṃdubhiśabdena svasti sūktena gurave varaṃdatvā brāhmaṇān saṃpūjya śiṣovācayitvādaśa pūrvān daśāparānātmānaṃ caika viṃśatiṃ punātiputra pautraiśca ṣaṣṭivarṣa sahasrāṇi svargaloke sthitvāta matikramya brāhmaṇa ssāyujyaṃ sālokyaṃca prāpnotī tyāha bhagavān bodhāyanaḥ || || iti bodāyanoktaḥ sahasra caṃdradarśina śatasaṃvatsara jīvinaśca śatābhiṣeka vidhānaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ atha siddhāricakrarītyā maṃtra maitrī darśanādi vicāraḥ akathaha ujapa ākhadala ūcapa ojapa aighama auḍhaśa auñaya īghana ṛjabha igadakṣa ṛchabha aḥtasa aiṭhala am̐ṇaṣa eṭara a i u ṛ la e ai o au aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha ṅa ca cha ja jha ña ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa ta tha da dha na pa pha ba bha ma ya ra la va śa ṣa sa ha iṃdrarkṣanetra ravi paṃcadaśartu vedavahnyā yudhāṣṭa navabhirguṇi tāṃśca sādhyān | digbhūgiriśruti gajāgnimunīṣu vedaṣavahnibhiśca guṇitā nadhasādhakārṇān || nāmajhalādakaṭhabhādgaja chakraśeṣaṃ jñātvobhayo radhika śeṣayutaṃ ṛṇīsyāt || sādhyārṇāṣu yojayet | vasubhircaktaśeṣaṃ yaddhanamityucyate budhaiḥ || sāthakārṇāndviguṇitān sādhyarṇeṣvapiyojayet || vanubhirbhaktaśeṣaṃ ya dṛmamityucyate budhaiḥ || iti rāmārcanacaṃ drakākhya graṃdhe maṃtraratna mahodadhāvapi || sarvatrārisaṃbaṃdho grahyaḥ || sādhyomadhyamaḥ || susiddhi siddhihotu || siddhassaṃbaṃdhamātreṇa phaladaḥ || miśromiśra iti || praṇavādima maṃtrāṇāṃ siddhārirnaiva śodhayet | sapiṃkākṣara maṃtrāṇāṃ tadvatkoṣṭhena śodhanaṃ | kulakramāgatānāṃ tunaikuryā tparīkṣaṇaṃ | svapnalabdhaṃ gurorlabdhama parīkṣyaiva sādhayet || kvicitkāmyeṣu tatkāle prajapopi nadūṣyati | karmasvakhila maṃtrāṇāṃ janena syādvāśodhanaṃ || anyatra sarvamaṃtrāṇāṃ dṛṣṭvā siddhāri marthayediti || maṃtrasārāvaliḥ - maṃtrarkṣā tsādhakarkṣāṃtaṃ gaṇaye nnapasaṃkhyayā | trīṇikṣīṇi praśaśyaṃte trighakhaṃḍeṣu siddhaye | śiraḥ prathamakhaṃḍetu nābhyaṃtaṃ madhyamaḥ srmutaḥ | tṛtīyaṃ pādaparyaṃtaṃ triṣvapyayaṃ vicaṃtayet || || itirahasyatilake || devaghaṭanaṃ - devatākanyakājñeyā yajamānovaraḥ smṛtaḥ | gṛhamaitraṃ gaṇorajjuḥ varṇonāḍi vicāryatāṃ | abhāve paṃcakūṭānāṃ ghaṭatenaivadevatā || || iti pūjādarpaṇe || diṅnirṇaḥ - sahajākālikīdikca sahasūryabhaveccubhā | sahacā śubhakāryeṣu savyāvākālikī kvacit | athavābhimukhī pūrvā sādhakasya kvacinmateti || arthavalakṣaṇa - karbhādāna - pauṣṭikavidhāna - māsakrameṇa garbhasrāva bhaiṣajyakarmādi garbhiṇīrakṣā vidhānam uktaṃca sarvaśāstre - athavakṣye mahādevi śārīraṃ saṃgraheṇate | yad trātvāsyu rnarāloke sukhina ssatrpajāstathā || śuddhaśoṇita śukraucet strīpuṃsau tu parasparaṃ | satrpojotpādane tauhi samarthau bhavatassadā || śuddhaśukrārtavalakṣaṇaṃ - śukraṃ śuklaṃ gurusnigdhaṃ madhuraṃ jahulaṃ bahu | ghṛtamākṣika tailābhaṃ sadgarbhā yūrtavaṃ punaḥ | lākṣārasa śaśāsrābhaṃ dhautaṃ yaccavirajyate || duṣṭaśūkrārtava lakṣaṇaṃ - vātapittaśleṣmaduṣṭaṃ kuṇapagraṃdhipūtikaṃ | pūyakṣīṇa mūtraviṣṭhāretāṃ syutsādane'hitāḥ || raktena catribhirdoṣaiḥ pṛdhagdvaṃ dvaiśca sarvataḥ | duṣṭaṃ tadārthavaṃ caivamabījaṃ bhavatidhruvaṃ || duṣṭaśukra cikitsā - pāyayottaṃ naraṃ sarpirbhiṣakkuṇaparetasi | dhātakī puṣpakhidira dāḍimārju nasādhitaṃ || pāyaye tathavāsarpissālasārādisādhitaṃ | graṃdhibhūte śaṭhīsiddhaṃ pālāśe vāpi bhasmani || parūṣaka vaṭādibhyāṃ pūyaprakhyeca sādhitaṃ | viṭprabhepāyaye tsiddhaṃ citrakośīrahiṃgubhiḥ || duṣṭārthava cikitsā - gradhibhūtepi betpāṭhāṃ tryūṣaṇaṃ vṛkṣakānica | durgaṃdhe pūyasaṃkāśe majjatulye tathārthave | pibedbhadra śriyaḥ kvāthaṃ caṃdana kāthvamevaca || śuddhe śukrārthave satva ssvakarmakleśa coditaḥ | garbhansaṃpadyate yuktivaśādagni rivāraṇau || srīyasuklādhikānnārīpuṃsa śśuklādikātpumān | ubhayośca samānetuklī baśśukrārthave punaḥ || vāyunā bahulobhinne yathāsvaṃbahva patyatā | tasmācchukla viśuddhyarthaṃ vṛṣyaṃ snigdhaṃcabhakṣayet || srīpuṃsayossu ssaṃyoge yadyādau visṛjetpumān | śukraṃ tataḥ pumān vīrojāyate balavān dṛḍhaḥ || athace dvanitāpūrvaṃ visṛjedrakta saṃyutaṃ | tatorūpānvitā kanyājāyate dṛḍhasaṃhatā || puruṣapravartanakramaḥ - snātassraggaṃdhadṛkprīto nādmātaḥ kṣuditopivā | sakāmāṃsānurāgaśca vyavāyaṃ puruṣovrajet | ṛtukālābhigamanaṃ kuryātparvāṇi varjayet || pudārānnagaccheta manasāpi kadācana | paragāragatiḥ puṃsā mubhayatrāpi bhūtidā || itimatvā svadāreṣu ṛtumatsubudho prajeta | atṛptassana yathādāre pumāna kāmayateparāṃ || tadhābhartaricātṛptā paramiccatikāminī | ityātmanopamāṃ kṛtvā svadāraviratobhaveta || atistrī saṃprayegāccara kṣedātmanamātmavāna | śūlakā sadvaraśvāsakārśyapāṃḍvāmaya kṣayāḥ | ativyavāyājjāyaṃte rogāśca kṣāpakādayaḥ | āyuṣmaṃto maṃdajarāva purvarṇa balānvitāḥ | sthiropacita māṃsāśca bhavāti straṣusaṃyutāḥ || tribhistribhirahobhirhi samīyātrpama dāṃ naraḥ | sarveṣvṛtuṣupakṣā tpakṣādvaradedbhudhaḥ|| rajasvalāmakāmāṃ ca malināma priyāṃ tathā | varṇavṛddhāṃ tadhāvyādhi prapīḍitāṃ || hīnāṃgīṃ garbhaṇīṃ dveṣyāṃ yenidoṣa samavvitāṃ | sagotrāṃ gurupatnīṃ ca tathāpra vrajitāmapi || saṃdhyāparvasvagamyāṃ ca tathā madhyaṃ dineṣuca | lajñāsamāvahe deśe vivṛtte śuddha evaca || kṣuditovyāditaścau nakṣubdhacittaśca mānavaḥ | vātaviṇmūtravegīca pipāsurati durbalaḥ || tiryagyo nā vayenaica prāpta śukravidhāraṇaṃ | duṣṭayenai visargaṃtu balavānapi varjayeta || retasaścātimātraṃtu mūrdāvaraṇa mevavā | sthatauttasaśayane viśeṣeṇauva garhitaṃ | krīḍāyāvapi medhāvī hitārthī parivarjayeta || rajasvalāṃ prāptavato narasyāni yatātmanaḥ | dṛṣyṭāyuntejasāṃ hāniradarmaśca tatobhaveta || liṃginīṃ gurupatlīṃ ca sagotrā mathaparvasu | vṛgdhāṃca saṃdyayeścāpigaccato jīvitakṣayaḥ || garbhiṇyāṃ garbhapīḍāsyādvyādhitāyāṃ balakṣayaḥ | hīnāṃgīṃ malināṃ dveṣyāṃ kāmaṃ vaṃdhyāmasaṃvṛte || deśeśuddeca śukrasya manasaścakṣayebhaveta | kṣuditaḥ kṣubdacittaśca madhyāhne tṛṣitobalaḥ || sthita syahāniṃ śukrasyanāyeḥ kopaṃcaviṃdati | atiprasaṃgādabhavati śoṣaśśukra kṣayāvahaḥ || vyāditasyarujāplīhā mṛtyurmūrbhācajāyate | pratyuṣa syardharātreca vātapitte prakupyataḥ || tiryagyonā vayenaica duṣṭayenai tathau vaca || uccārite mūtriteca retasaśca vidhāraṇe | uttānena bhaveccīghraṃ śukraśmapyāstu saṃbhavaḥ | sarvaṃ parihare ttasmā devalloka dvayehitama || duṣṭānyācarateyātunābhinaṃ dititatkathāṃ | aikyaṃ dviṣadbhirrvajati garvaṃvahaticoddhatā || cuṃbitāmārṣṭivadanaṃ dattaṃ na bahumanyate | svapityādai prasuptāpi tathā paścādvibudhyate || spṛṣṭādhunoti gātrāṇagātraṃca viruṇaddhayā | īṣacchṛṇoti vākyāni priyāṇyapi parājmukhī || naṣaśyatyagrada ttaṃtu jaghasaṃcavigūhati | dṛṣṭevivarṇa vadanā mitreṣvathaparājmukhī || tatkāmitāsucastrīṣu madhyasthevaca lakṣyate | jñātimaṃḍana kālāpi nakarotica maṃḍanaṃ || yāsāviraktātāṃtyaktyāsānurāgāṃ strīyaṃbhaveta || rajasvalā lakṣaṇaṃ - kṣāmaprasannavadanāṃ sphuraccroṇiyodharāṃ | srastākṣikukṣiṃ puṃskāmāṃ vidyāyadṛtumatīṃ striyaṃ || padmaṃ saṃkocamāyātidinetīte yadhātadhā | ṛtāvatīteyonissā śukraṃnātaḥ pratīcchati || māsenopacitaṃ kāle dhamanībyāṃta dārtavaṃ | īṣatkṛṣṇaṃ vigaṃdhaṃcavāyuryoni mukhānnudet || māsimāsi rajasrīṇāṃ rasajaṃsravatitryaṃhaṃ | vatsarāddvādaśā dūrthvaṃ yātipaṃcāśataḥ kṣayaṃ || ṛtumatīdharmaḥ - tataḥ puṣpekṣaṇā deva kalyāṇadhyāyinītryahaṃ | mṛjālaṃkārarahitādarbha saṃstāraśāyinī || kṣaireyaṃ yāvakaṃ stokaṃkoṣṭhaśodhanakarṣaṇaṃ | varṇeśarāvehastevā bhūṃjīta bhrahmacāriṇī || divāsvāpātsvāpaśīlohyaṃ janādaṃdhakobhavet | rodanaidyai vikṛtadṛk snānādduḥkhyanulepanāt || tailābhyaṃgā tkuṣṭharogī kunakhīnakha kartanāt | pradhāvanāccaṃcala ssyāddhasanā cchyāvarṇatā || daṃtoṣṭhatālu jihveṣu pralāsī bahubhāṣaṇāt | śravaṇādatiśabdasya badhirohyava lekhanāt || khalatirmārutāyā sasevanādunmadībhavet | tasmādrajasvalaitāni tridineṣu vivarjayet || caturdhehnita tasnātvā śukla mālyāṃbarā śiciḥ | icchaṃtībhartṛsadṛśaṃ putraṃ paśyetpuraḥ patiṃ || pūrvaṃpaśye dṛtusnātā yādṛśaṃ naramaṃganā | tādṛśaṃ janaye tputraṃ bhartāraṃ darśayedataḥ || ṛtustudvādaśaniśāḥ pūrvāstisraścaniṃditāḥ | ekādaśīcayugmāsu syā tprutronyāsu kanyakā || upādhyāyotha putrīyaṃ kurvīta vidhivadvidhiṃ | namaskāra parāyāstu śūdrāyā maṃtravarjitaṃ || garbhiṇīstrīṇāma kāryanirūpaṇaṃ - ativyāvāyamāyā saṃbhāraṃ prāvaraṇaṃ guru | akāla jāgara svapnakarino tkaṭakāsanaṃ || śokakrodha bhayodvega vegaśraddhā vidhāraṇaṃ | upavāsādhvatīkṣṇoṣṇa guruviṣṭaṃbhibhojanaṃ || raktavivasanaṃ śvabhrakūpekṣāṃ madyamāmiṣaṃ | uttānaśayanaṃ yaccastrīyonecchaṃti tattyajet || tathāraktasrutiṃ śuddhiṃ vastimāmāsatoṣṭamāt | ebhirgarbhassravedāmaḥ kukṣau śuṣyenmrayotavā || iṃdriyārthāṃ stuyān yānsobhoktu miccatigarbhiṇī | garbhabādhā bhayāttaṃptān bhiṣagāhṛtyadāpayet || sraprāptadauhṛdā putraṃjanaye dagumānvitaṃ |
