prasūtepārṣadopamaṃ || darśanevyālajātīnāṃ hiṃsāśīlaṃ prasūyate | godhāmāṃsāśane putraṃ suṣupsuṃ dhāraṇātmakaṃ || darśanevyālajātīnāṃ hiṃsāśīlaṃ prasūyate | godhāmāṃsāśane putraṃ suṣupsuṃ dhāraṇātmakaṃ || gavāṃmāṃseca malinaṃ sarvakleśa sahāṃtathā | mahīṣedauhṛdācchūraṃ raktākṣaṃ lomasaṃyutaṃ || varāhamāṃsātsvapnāpnāśuṃ śūraṃ saṃjanayetsutaṃ | mārdāgvikrāṃtajaṃghūlaṃ sadā navacaraṃ sutaṃ || sṛmarādvignamanasaṃ nityabhītaṃca taittirāt | atosukteṣu yānārī samabhidhyādi dauhṛdaṃ | śarīrācāraśīlai ssāsamānaṃ janayiṣyati || garbhiṇīstrī pravartana kramaḥ - śuddhāṃ śuddhāṃbarānityatuṣṭālaṃkārasaṃyutā | śubhakṛtyeṣunaktāca gururaktā parāṅmukhī || bhayakṛdarśanecaiva durgaṃdhāghrāṇane tathā | śṛṇvitīpuṇyacaritaṃ bojyo,ṭaṃ bhuṃjatīlaghu || aklinnamannaṃcā śuṣkamaparyuṣitamevaca | puṇyasthaleṣucaratī bahirgamana varjitā || ākurvatyasakṛttai lābhyaṃgādīni niṣevatī | dravaṃca madhuraṃ snigdhaṃ satkṛtaṃ dīpanesahitam || mṛdvāstaraṇaparyaṃkādiṣṭhātā garbhiṇīsadā | bhavedā pranavādeva manyadhā karba pīḍanaṃ || āharaṃ garbiṇīnāṃca pradame madhuraṃ tathā | dvitīye śītalaṃcaiva tṛtīye dravasaṃyutaṃ || śrīreṇa ṣaṣṭikānnaṃca caturthe dadhisaṃyutaṃ | paṃcame kṣīra yuktaṃca ṣaṣṭhevai sarpiṣāyutaṃ || pṛthakparṇādi saṃsiddhaṃ saptametu pibedghṛtaṃ | praśastāśchāṣṭame koli kaṣāyetu balādvayaṃ || śata puṣpīpayo māṃsaṃ dadhitaila ghṛtaṃ tathā | lavaṇaṃ madanaṃcaiva madhu miśraṃ nirūhayet || śastaśca navamemāse snigdamāṃ sarasodanaṃ | bahusnigdha yavāṃguvā pūrvoktaṃcā upāsanaṃ || tata evapicuṃcāpyā yonau nityaṃ nivāpayet | garbhiṇīṃ navamemāse sūtikāgāra māviśet || garbhasrāva cikitsā - madhukaṃ śāka bījaṃca payasyā suradāruca | āśmaṃtakaḥ kṛṣṇa tīlā stāmravallī śatāvarī || vṛkṣādanī payasyācalatā cotpalaśāribā | anaṃtāśāri bārāsnā padmā madhuka mevaca || bṛhatīdvaya kāśmaryaḥ kṣīriśuṃgāstvaco ghṛtaṃ | pṛśniparṇī balāśigruśva daṃṣṭrā madhuparṇakā || śṛgāṃcakaṃbi saṃdrākṣākaśeru madukaṃ sitā || saptaitānpayasāyogā nradha śloka samā savān | kramātsaptasumāseṣu garbhe sravatiyo jayet || kapittha bṛhatī bilva paṭolekṣu nidigdhijaiḥ | mūlaiśśṛtaṃ prayuṃ jīta kṣīraṃ māse tadhāṣṭame || navameśāri bānaṃtāpa yasyā madhu yaṣṭibhiḥ | yojaye ddaśame māse siddhiṃ kṣīraṃ payasvinā | adhavā yaṣṭi madukaṃ nāgarāma radārubhaḥ || jātasya śiro rupacārādikaṃ - śiśo rjātasya vaktreca saiṃdavena sasarpiṣā | suviśodya ghṛtāktaṃca picuṃ mūrdhnyava dhārayet || ākṛṣyanākhinālaṃca hyagulāṣṭa pramāṇataḥ | badhvā sūtreṇa saṃchedya badhniyāśca śiśorgale | sūtra śeṣaṃ kumārāṃgaṃ suviśudya jalenatu || sauvarṇaṃ madhusarpiścānaṃtā brāhmirasenatu | āgreṇānāmi kāṃgulyā lohāye dbalakaṃ tataḥ || vāṭyālakena cābhyaktaṃ kvādhena kṣīra śākhināṃ | kapittha patrasiddena sukhoṣṇena hivāriṇā | snāpayitvā yathā kālaṃ mṛdumaṃcetu śāyayet || bhartsanādbālakastra stassahasā pratibodhanāt | vātādināṃ vighātasyācchīghrā praharaṇāttathā || uttrepaṇādvai bālakaśca kubjasyādupaveśanāt | tasmādevatā nivarjāni nityaṃ bālahitārthinā || ityādi biṣaksāhyana samyaganu saṃdheyaṃ|| vaśīkaraṇa mūlikā vicāraḥ athavakṣye mahādevi vaśīkaraṇa mūlikāḥ | subhagā manaśśilātālaṃ lākṣārasa samanvitaṃ || taruṇīkṣīra saṃyukto lalāṭetilakovaśe | viṣṇukraṃtācasarpākṣī sahādevaṃ carocanā || ajādugdhe nasaṃpiṣṭaṃ tilakovaśyakārakaḥ | priyaṃgu kuṃkumaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ mohinītagaraṃ ghṛtaṃ || tilakovaśya kṛttaccarocanāraka caṃdanaṃ | viśāmanaśśilā tālaṃ priyaṃgu sarṣapāstathā || yohinī hiratākrāṃtā sahadevī śikātathā | mātuluṃgarasaiḥ piṣṭaṃ lalāṭe tilakovaśe || sedrāsurāvaśaṃ yāṃtikiṃ punaḥ kṣudramāniṣāḥ | maṃjiṣṭhācaṃdanaṃ raktaṃ kaṭukaṃdāvilāsinī || punarnavā samāyukto lepoyaṃ bhāskarovaśe | caṃdanaṃ nāgapuṣpaṃ ca majiṣṭhā tagaraṃvacā || lodhrapriyaṃgu gurajanīmāṃsī tailaṃ vaśaṃkaraṃ | evaṃ saṃti prayogāstu sādhakastatradurlabhaḥ || iti vaśīkaraṇamūlikāvidhiḥ atha jyotirmuhurtādi guṇadoṣa vicāraḥ uktaṃ hi vidyāmādhavīye doṣa nirūpaṇaṃ - athādi śāstreṣu maharṣigītaṃ tsaṃgṛhya daivajña hitāya kāṃścit | ihābhidāsyāmi mūhurtadoṣān kātsnyan natattatkatha nāyaśaktaḥ || || duṣṭāṃ stithyarkṣavārā tatha viṣaghaṭikāḥ kṛṣṇapakṣā parāhṇau | dūmādīn paṃcasaurāgulika dinagadau sagrahardha paharau | viṣṭiṃṣadduṣṭayogānuḍu tithikuhare kālacakrārthapātau sthūṇādīṃ strīṃśca mṛtyīnvidṛga himaśikho kaṃṭake dvaucaṃgaṃḍaṃ || || nakṣatraṃ bhavanaṃ ca karturaśubhaṃ vaināśikaikārgalau śūnyādigrahayukta gamyagatabhaṃ jvalādi yogāṃścaṣaṭ | māsābdavasatīranojadivasaṃ śukrāryayo mūrḍhatāṃ saṃdṛṣṭiṃ ca savedhaśūlamadikānmasāṃśca ketūḍayaṃ || || udvāhetu viśeṣataḥ pariharervedhaṃ śalākāhvayaṃ tattatkarmasugarhitāṃ grahagatiṃ māsarturāśyādikaṃ | doṣān karmavināśakān vidurimānanyānaśeṣā napitrātvātānparihṛtya sukṣmamatayaḥ kurvaṃtu sarvāḥ kriyāḥ || || agnyaṃtaka dvirasana tridaśeśa rudrāḥ pūrvātrayaṃ ca bahulaṃ pitṛmūla śūrpāḥ | chidrāśca pāpadivasāspada kālahorāstyājyo gaṇoya makhilāsu śubhakriyāsu || || agnyaṃtaka dvirasana tridaśeśa rudrāḥ pūrvātrayaṃ ca bahulaṃ pitṛmūla śūrpāḥ | chidrāśca pāpadivasāspada kālahorāstyājyo gaṇoya makhilāsu śubhakriyāsu || || triṃ śaddviguṇi takṛtima nusa midhastriṃ śatkṛ tidvi jāstriṃ śat | kṛ kadhṛṃ tisami daḥkṛ tima numa nudi jmanu kṛti janākṛtika kubhaḥ || || daśavai dyānṛpati janāḥ triṃśatpaṃcā śato janāsaibyaḥ | paratoghaṭī catuṣkaṃ viṣasaṃjñākṛkādiṣujñeyaṃ || || dhūme vedagṛhau srtayedaśabhirapyaṃśaussamete ravai syāttasminvyatipātako vigalite cakrāthethāsminyute | ṣaḍbharbhauḥ pariveṣa iṃdradhanurityasmi ścyatemaṃḍalā datyaṣṭyaṃśayutetu keturatha tattraukarkṣayuktoraviḥ || || bhūkaṃpoṃ śauraśītvānvita ina uḍuya tsarvadoskānipātoniśyatrārdo nayāsminbhavati kṛti kalāviśvabhāgonayāca | pūrvāhṇebrahmadaṃḍodhvaja itica tathā tatraviṃdyoparāhṇeteṣūrthvaṃ prāptanāḍyastapanagiriharittarka nāḍhyoti viṃdyāḥ || || grahavāranāthā dayvāsarasya pramāṇāṣṭrabhāgādhinādāḥkrameṇatathā yāmavatyoścatatpaṃcamādyoya ādyaṃśanādhaḥ sa evāṣṭa manya || || uktakramātkulika marka sutasyabhāgaṃ jīvāṃśakaṃ tu yamakaṃṭaka mā manaṃti | ardhaprahara maraṇādi dineṣu vedaśailākṣibāṇava suvahni guhānanāṃśān || || bhavatyādye budnya dvirasana bhayormūla maghayordvitīya sminnaṃśe guṇaparimite viṣṇu bhagayoḥ | śaśisvānyeraṃtye śubha phala virodhī dinakarastṛtīyaṃśeta smādu paridina mṛtyuśca balavān || || bhūpādbhayaṃ ripubhayaṃ vyasanaṃ pravāsaṃvittakṣayaṃvi śaraṇaṃca śubhakriyāsu | kartuḥ karoti śaśabhṛtkrama śorkapūrvai rekāṃgrahaissahaviśasnuḍu mekarāśau || || śuklevāridi nāgarudra tathi saṃkhyā tāsupakṣe site tatpūrvā svapisaktamahni tithiṣu prodyāti viṣṭi || kramāt | digyāmeṣu śarākṣi śailayugaṣaṭtryiṣṭeṃḍu saṃkhyeṣvado yāmeṣvārya jagaccarāṃtya dahaneṣvaṃtyārya nāḍīṣuca || || nityāvipamkaṃ bhādaye vāritidhyo vārarkṣāṇāṃ vāratārātithināṃ | tārā tidhyorāśi tidhyoritī yogākṣeyāḥ ṣaṭ śubhāścāśśubhāśca || || niṃdyaṃte nityayoge ṣvihanavaparighaḥ savyatīpātavajro vyāghāto vaidhṛtiśca pradhama parivṛtāḥ śūlagaṃḍātigaṃḍāḥ | lokatriṃśannavoṣarbhudhativiśikha dvīpatarkāṃga saṃkhyānāḍyaḥ prāṃteṣuteṣā mapikhaluniyamāt najjanairvarjanīyāḥ || || arkasyāhastarka kūladryarka caturdhyaḥ praleyāṃśo śūladharodvīdharaṣaṣṭhyaḥ | kṣoṇisūnorbhūtabhujaṃgādridaśamyonetrakṣoṇīnāganamamyaḥ śaśisūnoḥ || || vāgīśassyāhaskarasaṃ dadvipaṣṭhakhyaḥ kāvyasyāhisthāṇugaṃkāhi tṛtīyāḥ | saurasyorvīśātajagatyaḥ sanavamyaḥ vyājyāyuktāssaṃtatametetithivārāḥ || || jagajalapati rohiṇyagni mitreṃdra sudhrairmaruda jayamaśūrpārdhrakṣapuṣyāhi pitryaiḥ | ravigurubhaga mātṛtvāṣṭhrato yatrayāṃtryai śśubhakṛtiṣu viniṃdyāvārayogāḥ krameṇa || || tidayaḥ krameṇākāṣṭhā trayodaśa mahīravīṣu vasusaṃkhyāḥ | vidhijalabhaga bhujagānala bhādragānala bhrādrayutā ntyṛkṣaluṃchināmānaḥ || || śubheṣu citrādvaya muttarātrayaṃ maitraṃ makhāvaida samarkanaiṛtaḥ | trayodaśāgni dviśarāṣṭra saptamī samanvitini kramaśo vivarjayet || || makaravaṇi jauleyoṇau strīyamau hayakarkaṭāvali mṛgapatīcā pāṃtyau go jhakṣāviṣamāsvamī | tathiṣutu samāsvete dagdhābhavaṃti jhaṣovṛṣaḥ śaśibhamabalākiṭo nakraḥ kramāddaśamānvitāḥ || || dviguṇita manumu nitidhayaḥ kvatihaya tidhihara manudavitayaṃ | dviguṇita śakvaryaṃ kadvīpātyaṣṭīśa kṛtiśaradvīpāḥ || || atyaṣṭigiri haritsvaragiri tathayo manuyugeṃdra yugabāṇāḥ | etatsaṃkhyā svaṃ tyānāḍyoda srādikeṣu nimnākhyāḥ || || dvābhyāṃyukta ssapta vargaḥ satatvā bāṇāśśailā ākṛtiśca dvijāśca | eteṣvaṃtyānāḍikāḥ kupa saṃjñānaṃ niṃdanīyā stithīnāṃ || || tithi tāraka kūpa nimnanāḍī mabhito dveghaṭike vivarjanīye | avamatya narasta daṃtarāle vicaran kūpa ivānapātayet || || śanaiścarātsaptama mṛkṣamāhu kālaṃ budhāstaṃ katha yaṃtyathānye | arkādi vāreṣvadhi bhāsureṃdu netrāṃ burāśīkṣaṇa saṃkhyamaṃśaṃ || || cakrārdovyati pāta māhuri hatacciṣṭaṃ yadṛkṣaṃ ravāvardonāṃ | śakatoṃ śakārdha sahitātyaktetrayo viṃśatiḥ | anye yāvadi nādbhavatyaditibhaṃ tāvatta tastaṃ viduḥ sarvetaṃ samaye svakīya samaya prāptoviniścinvate || || yatra cakrordha yoge bhavetmaddinaṃ dānayogyaṃ śubheghūtsṛje tkarmasu || tacca tasmādadhaścottaraṃcā śubhaṃ vāsarāṇāṃ trayaṃkecidā cakṣete || || arkakṣoṇi sutābhyāṃ bhavati gaṇanayānaiṛtaṃ yāvadasmāttāvatyau tārake dvekramaśa ihamate kaṃṭake sthūṇasaṃjñe | tābhyāmāmūla saṃkhyādvaya iti gaṇitaḥ kaṃṭaka sthūṇa nāma rakta sthūṇo vasiṣṭaḥ kṣiti rahite saṃhadhṛtyaṃ kakesyāt || || vyayorko rāhurvāripi nidhanayo śśītakiraṇaḥ surejyovā dharme dharaṇi tanayaḥ kheśaśisutaḥ | kavirya nyadyune vasatitanayo sūryatanayogṛhaṃ tanmṛtvyākhyāṃ nikhilarubhakāryeṣu visṛjet || || dadyuścitrā śūrpaśakrāṃbu viṣṇukṣīrādhīśā budhnyadasrāṃtakāśca | dhātārudro devasūra pyajādyairmāsai ryuktāvatsarārthena mṛtyuṃ || || guru rāhu bhāskarādīn vārāṃ strighnānviśodhaye dbhagaṇāt | doṣā navara vira samita tārāḥ kāṇa dvilocanāṃ dhāsyāḥ || || arkārūḍhabha nāḍikāmubhayato rāmāgni ṣaṭtarakā | nāḍyoṃdhaika dṛgakṣi mugmakalitāḥ kāṇāstuti sraḥparā | vārānbhānica taddināṃta mabhimuṃjyāṃ kāptaśiṣṭā ssakkāṇāṃ dhāyuga lokarocana mitāstārāḥ pradiṣṭhāḥ paraiḥ || || aśvinyādiṣu bheṣvajāli makara prāptaṃśa kāṃte kramā daṃśārthasmara bāṇa raṃdhra ghaṭikāstadviśākhādiṣu | meṣāṃśasya mukheṣṭakaurpi mṛgayo raṃśā vasāneṣṭa diṅnaḍīruṣṇa śikhāhvayāḥ pariharetsarveṣu kāryeṣvapi || || rukṣātpūryātmajā krāṃtā dviṃśaṃ gaṃḍaṃ pracakṣate | dvicatvā riṃśa dityuktvā doṣāsyājyāḥ śubheṣvamī || || kartṛ janmādi kāstārakāḥ kīrtitāḥ janma saṃpadvipatkṣema kṛtpratyagāḥ | sādhako dhovadho maitra manyatparā maitra mityeva manyāḥ punaścakramāt || || janma vipatpratyagavadha janmāṣṭamarāśi tārakāstyājyāḥ | sāṣṭāmagṛhā śśubheṣatyajaṃti ṣaṣṭha vyayaucānye || || aṣṭāśīti tamoṃśoyasmin janmādi gaṇa nayābhavati | vaināśikaṃ tadṛkṣaṃ tyajaṃtike citta mevāṃśaṃ || || saṃprapte parighādiyoganavake maitrāhi puṣyā dititvāṣṭrebhyo śśibharassuṣārikiraṇā nmūlācca maitrādapi | prākpaścācca yathākramaṃ nigaṇite tārāgaṇe saṃkhyayā caṃdrārkākṣita tārakeyadi samodoṣāya mekārgaśaḥ || || kuṃbhaṃtya vṛṣavīṇājastrī kīṭavaṇigaśvinaḥ | karkīmṛgamṛgeṃ drauca caitrādau śūnyarāśayaḥ || || kīdyeviśvārya citrānilabha mamarasaubhāgya viśvarkakevā viśvarṣakaṃ vāruṇāṃtye śarakṛtimitabhe somacitrāgni pūṣṇaḥ | ṣaḍviṃśedrāgni mitrāsravituraga śivānviṣṇumūleyameṃdrau śūnyāsārākrameṇa tyajatu parimitāmāsyu caitrādikeṣu || || ṣaḍabāṇārka kulādriravyudadhi digdhātrīmaheśācala kṣoṇilocana pāvakāṣṭa navasaṃkhyāteṣu māseṣvasi | śūnyākhyāḥ prathamādhikāścati bhayaḥ pakṣesite kīrtitāḥ tyājyāḥ paṃcadaśakrameṇa khalutāḥ kṛṣṇe dvitīyādayaḥ || || pauṣomāsa śunya iti kaiściddeśeṣu keṣucit | varjate śubhakāryeṣu vivāheṣu viśeṣataḥ || || grahaira niṃdvaṃduja bhārgavairya nmuktaṃca yuktaṃcayuyāsitaṃ ca | krameṇa dagdhaṃ jvalitaṃ tadṛkṣaṃ dūmāyamānaṃ ca śubheṣu jahyat || || bhaumādbhūpanagābdhi tatvamanavo jvālā guroraṃgabhaṃ vyādhiṃsomajatoṣṭa saṃkṛti dhṛkīrāhurduhākaṃṭakaṃ | pātātpaṃcama mīśvaraṃca parighaḥ śukrāccatithyādayo dveṣassūrya sutāddaśartu kṛtayaḥ khaṃḍaḥ smṛtaḥ paṃḍitaiḥ || || saurorāśiṣu sūryasaṃkramaṇa taścāṃdrastu darśāṃtako vijñeyaḥ pitapakṣapakṣati mukhastriṃśaddina ssāvanaḥ |nākṣatra śaśimaṃḍalāditi mātāmāsāścaturthā kramādaṃte hasrayamādyayoścaramayordikpaṃcanāḍīstyajet || || sauroraverdvādaśa bhistumāsaiścāṃdrastutaiḥ prākṛtasaṃjñitonyaḥ caivastu sūryāddhiṣaṇodayādirbhudhaistridhetthaṃ parikalpitobdaḥ || || arkesthirānviśati viṣṇupadābhidhā nāstebhyaḥ parāstuṣaḍaśītimukhāścatasraḥ | saṃkrāṃta yastvaja mṛgānana taulikarkojñeyāḥ kramā dudagavāgviṣu vāyanākhyāḥ || || tyajiṃti pūrvaṃca paraṃca saṃkramāt dināvita dviṣṇupadāstathā yanāt | śubhakriyāyāṃ viṣuvātparaṃdinaṃ paraṃparebhyaśca dinārdhamutsṛjet || || saptāṃte ravivatsarasya divasāṃstānpaṃca paṃcānyayoḥ prāraṃbhe dinasatrayaṃ pariharettaiṣāṃ trayāṇāmapi | prāṃtebdatritayasyapakṣa maparetyāṃ jyaṃ vidussūrayaḥ saptāhanyuparāgatotha nṛpati prāṇa prayāṇāddaśa || || saptāṃte ravivatsarasya divasāṃstānpaṃca paṃcānyoḥ prāraṃbhe divasatrayaṃ parihāreteṣāṃ trayāṇāmapi | prāṃtebdatritayasyapakṣamaparetyāṃ jyaṃ vidussūrayaḥ saptāhanyuparāgatotha nṛpati prāṇa prayāṇāddaśa || || kramaśaḥ sitapakṣa pakṣati pramukhā locana saṃyutā tidhiḥ | acalai para hṛtya śiṣyate yadidaṃ śrī divasādi saptakaṃ || || sapta divasānmu tāḥ śrī kali naṃdana kālakarṇinā mānaḥ | jaya vardhanārṇavākhyāteṣuca viṣamāḥ śubhā ssamāni śubhāḥ || || dṛśyau yadā hanijanairvrajato yadāstāmanyonyataḥ smaragatauca yadārya śukrau | karmāṇi tatra samayona śubhāni kuryānnaivārabeta śaśijaistagateca vidyāṃ || || prākpaścā duditaraṃ rave rbhṛgu sutaṃ bālaṃ vadaṃ tikramādbāṇa dvīpa dināni vṛddhamanayorasantedina vyatyayāt | udvāhe krama śogaṃnā puruṣayorvaṃtāsa evaṃguru ssarveṣāṃcatayo śiśusthiviratā vidveṣiṇī karmaṇāṃ || || hariṇānanasya daśamāṃ śakasya jatugrahan sphuṭatamānakhilān | avaśiṣṭamatra śubha karmaṇi tadgraha vedha duṣṭamiti visṛjet || || dhātṛ śrīnātha rudra nila ravi varuṇāḥ kāla mitrārya māṃbhobudhnyāryāḥ śukra pūṣāśvahi nirṛti makhā stvāṣṭra vasvaiṃdavāni | bhādraiṃdrāgnyarkṣa viśvāditi dahana bhagāḥ paṃcavargā ssyureṣāṃ vargaṃtaṃ vedha duṣṭaṃ tyaja tugraha kṛtau sagrahāyatra tārāḥ || || rekhā ssaptalikherṛ jūrabhi mukhaṃ tiryakca tāstāvatī rekhāgreśvabhi jidyutāḥ parilikhe dagnyāditārāḥ kramāt | yatraikā madhitiṣṭhataḥ prati mukhaṃ sākaṃ śalāṃkāṃgrahaḥ śītāṃ śuśca śubhaistu śūla muditaṃ tatpāpasaṃjñairmahat || || saṃ sarpo ravimāsi darśayugalaṃ pūrṇādvayaṃvāsti caittasmi npauṣṇayugaṃ bhavedyadi vidustaṃke cidaṃ haspatiṃ | arkeṃdvoryadi madhyoga yugalaṃ madhyerka madhyottayo ssaṃkrātyoradhimāsa eṣaitite māsāstrayo niṃditāḥ || || yasmin nnasta yayaṃti vakra gamanaṃ yatrāraṃbhategrahā | yasmin deva nṛpotsavāśca vivido tpātāśpataṃ vāsaraṃ | nirgātena vadūta katu janane saulkānipāte diśāṃ | dāhe bhūcalane grahapraharaṇe cāhnatrayaṃ varjayet || || dvedve rekhe dvikeṇa pari likhitu puraḥ paṃca paṃcādha tiryigreṣā stāstvīśa koṇa prabhṛtiṣu vilikhedbhānivahvyadikāni | yasminniṃdu rgraśca prati mukha mayutaḥ pākamekāṃ śalākaṃ nakṣatra vedha duṣṭaṃ pariṇayana vidhau tadvipattiṃ vidhatte || || pādaścaturdaḥkili viśvabhasya nāḍyaśca viṣṇoḥ prathamāścatasraḥ | uktābhi chidbhuktiritīya masyāṃ sthitograhau vidhyati dātṛtārāṃ || || icchaṃtya grahatāṃ smarādiṣu padeghādhvāha vipra krīyā caulaprāśana mauli baṃdhana graha prāraṃbhaṇeṣu kramāt | lagnisthāssmarasaṃsthitāśca niyamātpāpāḥ phalaṃ karmaṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ kṣapayaṃti jīva śaśi bhṛgutpāpāśca raṃdra stithāḥ || || sarvāraṃbheṣvayana mavada nnuttaraṃ śreṣṭha māryāścaulādīnā mitara śubhadaṃ karmaṇāṃ vārṣikāṇāṃ | brāhmyedvāpetya jatu caturaścaitra yuktāṃ ścamasānāṣāḍhādhī ssamapi śubhadaṃ māsamūce vasiṣṭhaḥ || || kṛṣiṃ bījavāpaṃ nareṃdrābhiṣekaṃ savidyāgṛhāraṃbhadevapratiṣṭhāḥ | kriyāssapta caulādhikā nāmadheyaṃ kriyāṃcakṣapāyāṃ na kurvaṃti saṃtaḥ || || kṛṣvādikānyatra caturdaśaivaṃ karmāṇyanuktāni niśāsuyāni | sakarṣavedheṣu gṛhaphraveśayukteṣute ṣvaṣṭamaśuddhimāhaṃ || || carādikeṣu triṣumaṃdireṣubhāgān kramācchailaśarāṃka saṃkhyān | ravau prapannaisati duṣprādharśanaṃ doṣaṃ catuṣaṣṭimukhaṃ vadaṃti || || rāśitithi tārākāṇāṃ gaṃḍhāṃtaṃ jaladhi viṣayanavamāṃte | tatro bhayatonāḍyāḥ rāśau śarasaṃmitāstyājyāḥ || || lagnasyadoṣāṃ styajapāpadṛṣṭiṃ pāpodayaṃ corabhaya pāpatāṃca | apāpalābhārisahotthatāṃca śubhagrahānāśrita kaṃdratāṃca || || ripphāvāsaṃ pāpavargapraveśaṃ velāvasthākarmaṇāṃ cā śubhatvaṃ | proktāśceṃdo ssarvakāryeṣu jahyadjñātaṃ cāsya durnimittaṃ kṣutādyaṃ || || iṃdorliptākhākhā śaibha hṛntvāśiṣṭā stithyagnaṃ kaiḥ | hatvābābhraśro trairlabdāḥ karmāvasthāveśajñeyāḥ || || sthānabhraṣṭa stapasvīparayuvati ratastaskirohasti mukhyāhūḍhaḥ siṃhasanastho narapati rarihadaṃḍanetāguṇīca | niṣprāṇacchinna mūrdhākṣata kara caraṇo baṃdhanastho vinaṣṭārājāvedānadhītesvati sucaritaṃ saṃsmaran dharmakartā || || sadvaṃśnonidhi saṃgata śritatulo vyākhyāparaḥ śatṛhorogīśa śathṛjitaḥ | svadeśacalito bhṛtyonivāśārdhakaḥ | āsthānīca samaṃtrataḥ paramahīhartā sabhāryogajatrasta ssaṃyugabhīti mānati bhayolīno nadātāgnidaḥ || || kṣudbādhāsahitonnamatti vicaranmāṃ sāśanotra kṣataḥ saudvāho dhṛtakaṃtuko vihari dyutairṇṛpo duḥkhitaḥ | śayyāsthopusevitāścasa suhṛdhyāyāca bhāryānvito mṛṣṭālica payaḥ pibaṃtsukṛtakṛtsvasthastadhāste sukhaṃ || || etāścaṃdra kriyāḥ paṃcapaṃcā jādiṣurāśiṣu prakalpya tatphalaṃ brūyātsarvakārreṣu tatphalaṃ || || ātmastānātrpavāso mahita nṛpapadāsaktatā prāṇahanirbhūpā latvaṃ svavaṃśocita guṇaniratīroga āsthānagatvaṃ | bhīteḥ kṣudbhāditatvaṃ yupati pariṇayomyaśayyāsu śakti rumuṣṭāśitvaṃca gītā iti bhavana vaśātsadbhiriṃdo ravasthāḥ || || mūrdhāmayo muditatāya janaṃ sukhasthānetrāmayaḥ sukhatatā vinitānihāraḥ | ugrajvaraḥ kanakabhūṣaṇa maśrumokṣaḥ kṣvelāśanaṃ vidhuvanaṃ jaṭharasyarogaḥ || || krīḍāpalehasanarukkalaprayāṇa munmattatātha salilāplavavanaṃ virodhaḥ || || svecchāsthānaṃ kṣudbhayaṃ śāstralābhaḥ sveraṃgoṣṭhiyodhanaṃ puṇyakarma | pāpācāraḥ krūrakarma praharṣaḥ prājñeretāścaṃdravelā pradiṣṭāḥ || || atha daddhoṣāpavāda nirūpaṇaṃ tatraiva doṣairamibhirakhilai rahitaṃ mūhūrtaṃ lokaḥ kalau nalabhalekhalu maṃdabhāgyaḥ | teyāṃti nāśamapavāda gaṇaairyatosmātteṣāṃ kramādabhidadheha mihāvādāt || || śubhakarmaṇi balinādau chidrastithayaḥ kramāccaturthādhyāḥ | navanava manutatvadiśā śara ghaṭikābhyaḥ paraṃ śubhājñeyāḥ || || devārādhana maṃtrabheṣa javidhauvājidvitārohaṇe būpānāmabiṣecanevrata vidhau vidyā kṛṣi prakrame || gārgyorkasya śubhaṃ jagāda divasaṃ dṛṣṭasya saumyaiḥ pare sarveṣvaṃbara dāraṇāccha bhavanā raṃbhādhṛte kecana || || namasta kāryeṣu valakṣapakṣe nilāṃkarasyodaya vāravargāḥ | śubhāḥ pradiṣṭā buhaletva niṣṭā ssadāhya viṣṭyobhyudayo vivāhe || || pāpasya vārepijanasya kārya mavaśya kāryaṃ yadi tatra tasmāt | śubhāṃśayuktā śubhakāla horā grahyai vanīcānmahatina vidyā || || ātmopa labdhā vivayāva matyā mupāgatāyāṃ grahavāsareṣu | sarveṣu śubha svabhāvaṃ | jñeyāni madhyama phalāni tataḥ śubheṣu grāhyaṇyṛte dharaṇi naṃdana maṃdirābhyāṃ || || triṃśatprārabhya śuklaprati padamihayāssaṃtivā sāṃti dhīnāṃ | kṣoṇivahnyaṃ gabāṇa smaraviśikhaśara brahma saṃkhyā krameṇa | vijñeyāḥ kaṣṭa madhyottama mahitatamaśreṣṭha madhyāti kaṣṭāḥ | kṛṣṇapakṣe prayośyāpi balinividhā puttamākaiściduktāḥ || || ṣaḍbhi ssūryasyodayānnāḍikābhiḥ prātaḥ kāla saṃgamaścāpi ṣaḍbhiḥ | madyāhnakhyāstadvadahne parāhṇaḥ sāyaṃkālaścātraviṃdyā paraudvau || || dinakara vāra sametaṃ na śubhavārayogaṃvā | uvacaya saṃstho vārko doṣā sapaharati paṃcadūmādīn || || bharadvājaḥ procevapuṣi śaśi śukre kṣitiyute kramātsaure kṣvādyau praśamama yatonyau guruyute | krameṇādryaṃ korvīvasu tidhiṣu sarvāsvatha punaḥ || svavagan syoccasthaina śubhadṛśi bhānālivitiguruḥ || || artha praharakasya prathame yamaṃkaṃṭasya madhyagate | aṃte gulikasya dvenāḍyā niyamāt parityājyā || || vāreśo gulikaṃ nihaṃtibalavān mūrtausthitaḥ sadgraho | vikṣestā yamakaṃṭasyaca śubhaḥ keṃdratrikoṇasthita | pīyākṣatvikṣi satriyākṛti śūbhai dṛnṣṭe śubhāṃśasthite | lagneṃśeca śubhānvite sati patāṃnāthan prahārādbhayamaṃ || || kṣapāyāṃ kṣīmasādhyaun dimṛtyudi nāmayau | nataudoṣakṣāya kalpetedivāpīdau balānvite || || viṣṭiyradāhanitithe raparādhrajāt pūrvārtha jāniśitadāśubhadāca pucchai | tatkālabhūrapinijodaya yāmabāhyagrahya śubhebalinilagna patau niṃjāṃśe || || pātaḥkāle vārayoge barīyānā dhyevādeśānti etetikecit madhyāhnaṃtaṃ yogamāhustrayaṇāmanye yogāstadviyogā vasānāḥ || || gokanyakarki mīnastha śubhadṛṣṭaḥ śubhāṃśakaḥ uddartādagdadoṣasyabalī kumudabāṃdhavāḥ || || apūryamāṇo balavān himāṃśuḥ svocchāṃśake svocchagṛhaiḥ sthithovā | vargottamevātithi tārayatyevahi nimnanāḍīḥ || || vinihaṃti kālaghorā śubhasyakālāhva yaṃdoṣaṃ | kālaiṃśakastṛtī yoviniṃdito gaṃḍasaṃjñike pradhamaḥ || || svocche svavargeca yadhāpraviṣṭā dṛṣṭau śśubhairbhāskarabhūmi putrau | tau kaṃṭakasthūla samāhvayānā mekotthamoko harati dvajeṃdvā || || yodagdābhyārā śayomṛtyu sajñāyecaproktā svāmidṛṣṭā śśubhāste | vāgīśenaspītavaryama dṛṣṭāḥ saṃyuktāvā sarvakāryoṣva niṃdayāḥ || || haṃtiśubho balavāṃchiśi keṃdre vīkṣaṇa tābhyuditoṃdhajadoṣaṃ | saumyanavāṃśakagaḥ sukhadaṃdustatra sulocanabhābhyuditovā || || ādyejanmaninavyabhūkti vasanālaṃkāraṇyairvinā sarvaṃkarma śubhāśubhaṃ pariharedbhuktiṃ nāvāṃcārbhokīṃ | hitvābhyaṃgavidhiṃ nikṣekasahitaṃ kṣāraṃcaśiṣṭaṃ śubhaṃ | kāryaṃ kāryamuśaṃtike cadṛṣayo janmarkayoranyayoḥ || || sarvānevavipatti paṃcamavadheṣvādyeṣu bheṣvaṃ śakānmadhyeṣyādya turīyapāvaka mitānaṃtyeṣuvā varjayet | satkarmā balavāṃchubhāṃśakagato dṛṣṭaśca saumyagrahaiḥ janmapratya rajānvipadvida bhavāndoṣānvidhūrbādhate || || svakīya janmāṣṭama rāśi patyormaitryānna janmāṣṭama rāśi śeṣṭaḥ | janmeśakarmeśvara mitrabhāvaḥ kṣiṇotivai nāśikadoṣamugraṃ || || yadiśaśiravī tārāyugme dvitīya tṛtīyagau pradhama caramaucāpāṃśātau kramādbala vāṃstadā | praśithila jalaḥprājñaiḥ rekārgalaḥ kathithonyathā katicidathataṃ doṣaṃ śaṃsaṃtyavaṃtiṣu kevalaṃ || || balinau śubhavargagatau svavargagau vā śubhagrahaidṛṣṭau | ekārgala doṣa harau ravi śaśivā vitivadaṃtyanye || || svasvāmi jīvaśaśijaissahitaṃ vilagnaṃ dṛṣṭaṃtuvā harati śūnyaviṣādidoṣān | keṃdra trikoṇa grahagobalavān śubhaśca māsarkṣarāśitidhi śūnya bhayāpaharī || || bhāsvanmaṃdācāryaphau maurgrahaṃ yaddagdaṃ bhū yastatprayāti svabhāvaṃ | māsādābdā dvatsarābdāttadardā dāhutpātā dāhavādyaiśca duṣṭaṃ || || dagdaṃ yadṛkṣaṃkha careṇa bhūyaḥ śuklāṃśa yogādupabṛṃhate tat | tapāvasāne | vanamuṣṭabāsātaptaṃ yathādyāṃbu nipātayogāt || || ṛkṣasya dagdhasyaca dāhakasya grahasya madhyevicaravhimāṃśuḥ vyapohyapīḍā mabhirakṣatīdaṃ balīvahīnaṃ balinovaruddhaṃ || || yaḥ kuruteyaṃ doṣaṃ grahaspva tuṃge sthitassvargevā | saumyagraheṇa dṛṣṭaḥ sa evataṃ doṣa mapaharati || || dvayorastamekasya vā kāvyagurvoḥ divādarśanīyatva manyonyadṛṣṭaṃ | na saṃsarpamaṃ hapṛtiṃ cādhimāsaṃ namāsoktakāryoṣu ṣaḍvarjayaṃti || || pūrvaṃ ṣaghacikāprabhāta mudayādbhānoḥ pradoṣastadhā paścādasta mayā dghaṭitraya mihatyājyāṃ sa evavāthavā | yatkarmā vihitaṃ niśāsutadhṛte kṣaurātsamāvartanā tkartavyaṃ nikhilaṃ prabhātasamaye śaṃsaṃtigārgyādayaḥ || || balinau caṃdralagneśau lagnaṃ mūrdhodayaṃ yadi | asaptamasthapāpānāṃ dṛṣṭrilagnena doṣadāḥ || || svocca svakṣetragataḥ kalirgurvābalīyadālagne | natadāduṣyati dṛṣṭiḥ madanagatasyārkajasyarāhorvā || || uparāga duparigate varṣārdhetvanugate śubhebalini | udayopitamo grahayo śubhadaśubhakarmasu grāhyaḥ || || lagna syapāpadvaya madhyagatvaṃ doṣaṃguruḥ keṃdragatobalāḍhyaḥ keṃdratrikoṇopa ca yoṣumūrteḥ sthituśubhonā balavān nihaṃti || || krūrāśubāvāvapuṣo grahaye sthānānyaniṣṭāni yadāpraviṣṭāḥ | tadāsvaṃtugebalini svabhevāyadi sthitāste śubhadābhavaṃti || || kavaugurau vā balinisthitenauśubhe nadṛṣṭaḥ śubhanargagaḥ śaśī | vivardhamānaḥ śubhakṛcchanā śubhaṃ karotitiṣṭhrannapiṣaṣṭaripṛyoḥ || || saumyadvāta śabhāgagaḥ śubhapadedṛṣṭodhāva sadgrahai raṃgāṃgāṃśaka keṃdraga ssacaguroḥ keṃdrecapakṣesthitaḥ | satkarmaivaca turvidopi balavāniṃduḥ kṣiṇotyātmano doṣaṃ pāpanavāṃśa kāśrayabhavaṃ svāṃśā śrayotthaṃ tathā || || asaumyavargāśrayajān sukarmādṛṣṭo baliṣṭhe śubhenacaṃdraḥ | duṣkarmavelādi samudbhavāṃśca bhinattidoṣāṃ chu bhagavan saṃsthaḥ || || yadā svavargetanu keṃdrasaṃstho guraḥ śaśinātha śubhāṃśakasthaḥ śubhesadṛṣṭaḥ sukṛtatadānīṃ sa pāpayoge kṣaṇadoṣa iṃdoḥ || || gurussudīptasmanu keṃdrasaṃsthito balādhikolagnagato viśeṣataḥ | vihaṃti doṣā nakhilāṃstathāvithiḥ svavargasaṃstho bhṛgujo būdhothavā || || mūrtestrikoṇā yamaṃkaṭakeṣu ravīṃdu jīvārka navāṃśakasthaḥ | makarmakṛnnitya maśeṣadoṣān muṣṇātivardiṣṇuraṣṇanuraśmiḥ || || lagnāṃśā dviṣamāṃśake yadi śubhāstatkaṃṭakāṃ śepivā jīvajñāgurubhārgakābudhasitā vanyonya keṃdrasthitau | lagneśasya śubhasyavātibahavo yuktaṣṭavargākṣatāḥ teṣvekaika samāśritāṃśaka grahallābhāṃśa kāsthāḥ śubhāḥ || || lagnāṃśarkṣa trikoṇāṃśaka sadanagatāḥ sadgrahaḥ keṃdragāvājīvāṃśa kṣetra keṃdresitabudhaśaśinaścaṃdra keṃdresurejyaḥ | caṃdraprāptāṃśarāśe ssuta navamagatāḥ keṃdrasaṃsthāśca saumyāḥ saumyeṃdvātmeśalagnopa cayagrahagatā vīryavaṃta śubhāśca || || rājaṃdra ssahamaṃtriko gajavaraṃ siṃhāsanaṃ vāśritaḥ śītāṃśurbhalavāṃchubhāṃ śakagatolagneṣṭa gehasthitaḥ | horāvatsamāsavāsarapatiḥ laganebalī sadgaho lagnādvairi sahodarā gamagatāḥ pāpāścavīryotkaṭāḥ || || prādhānyena vyāhṛtāḥ kecideteyogā ssarveghnaṃti doṣānaśeṣān | atrānuktāssaṃti cānye sahasraṃ naivoktāste graṃdhabāhulyābhītyā || || atroktāye vīryavaṃto pi doṣādeśācārā rdurbhalāste bhavaṃti | yenye deśācāra siddhāśca doṣāsteṣāṃ deśevaivatatrāpavādaḥ || || anāpadyuttamaḥ kālo madhyamāpadi madhyamaḥ | satyāmatyāpadi grāhyoduṣṭopi svāpavādataḥ || || atha sadguṇa nirūpaṇaṃ tatraiva niśśeṣadoṣa viharasyasu durlabhatvātkā leguṇāgha bahuśeni balālpadośe | karmārabheta śubhamityṛṣi bhiryaduktaṃ tatkāṃścidatrasumuhurta guṇānpravakṣye || || alpadurlabha doṣatvaṃ kālasya prathayoguṇaḥ | abhāvassarvadoṣāṇāṃ dvitīya ssumahanguṇaḥ || || viśiṣṭa viprabhāṣitaṃ śubhagrahasya codayaḥ | tanoścasaumyavargatā trayo mahāguṇāḥ smṛtāḥ || || abādhyamāno vihitakriyā supaṃcāṃgayogo guṇanāyakākyaḥ ṣaḍaṃgayogo guṇarāja uktaḥ saptāṃgayogo gaṇarājarājaḥ || || prasannadaivajña vidhipradiṣṭaṃ sukhapradaṃ durlabha malpapuṇyaiḥ | saptāṃgasaṃpatti samotamo tanmuhurtarājyaṃ sukṛtolabhaṃte || || saumyāḥ keṃdratrikoṇaeṣupāpāḥ kṣatassahotthayoḥ | ekādaśasthetā ssarve śubhadāśśubhakarmasu || || śaśāṃkanakṣatra jalābhivṛddhiḥ ghaṭopyariktaḥ sthitayaścapūrṇāḥ | syātpaṃca pūrṇāhvaya eṣayogo guṇādirājaḥ śubhakarmaṇīṣṭaḥ || || diktārāṇāṃ madhyamāstaṃbha saṃjñāpti srastisraḥ pārśvasaṃjñāghaṭākhyāḥ | tiṣṭatyarko yatrariktassakuṃbha ssaṃpūrṇonyastaṃbha saṃjñopi tadvat || || ahnaḥ paṃcadaśobhāgo muhūrtastārakāhvayaḥ | divāpaṃca daśoktāste niśāyāṃca tathāsmṛtāḥ || || ārdroragamitra makhānasujala viśvābhijidviriṃceṃdrāḥ aim̐drāgnimūlavaruṇāryamabhagatārā divāmuhūrtāsyuḥ || || kramaśoniśamuhūrtā rudrobhādrādoṣṭa tārāsyuḥ | aditiguru viṣṇuhastatvāṣṭra samīrāśca kīrtitāmunibhiḥ || || dinarātrijāmuhūrtāye kathitāstyājya tārakārūpāḥ | ekādaśā śubhāste śubhakarma supūjitāścānye || || utpātaviṣṭivyatipātapūrvaṃ nihaṃtidoṣānabhi jinmuhūrtaḥ | karotiyāmyā mapahayakāṣṭāṃ digaṃtarāṇi vrajatordha siddhiṃ || || bānoraryamadaivatohi marucerbrāhmyastadhā naiṛto bhū putrasyatu pitravanhyadhipatī caṃdrātma jasyābhijit | pitra brāhmya samāhvayā uśanaso brahmaṃbudaivauguroḥ sārpaścāhniśaneramītu niyamātyājyā muhurtābudhaiḥ || || saṃjñāḥ purāṇakathitā raudraśvetastadhā maitraḥ | ārabhaṭassāvitrovairājaścadha gāṃdharvaḥ || || ābhijicca rauhiṇi balau vijayākhyo naiṛtaśśākraḥ | vāruṇabhagadaipatyā viti vijñeyādivā muhurtānāṃ || || ajijidvairājaśca śvetassāvitra maitra balivijayāḥ | śubhakarma siddhijanakā ssaptaproktā || purāṇajñeḥ || || śreṣṭhātārāsattithi ssanmurtassa tithyarthaṃ sannimittaṃcajātaṃ | yogeṃdroyaṃ paṃcakalyāṇa nāmā gārgyeṇokta ssarvakalyāṇadāyī || || sārkādivārā guru mūlahastāścitrā dinārtha śravaṇeṃdutārāḥ | budhnyāśvīnī viśvabhagaprajeśā niśvāgni citrā śaraśaila tidhyoḥ || || trayodaśī mātṛlāṃtyabhāni bhagapraceto marutassanaṃdāḥ | bhadrāssametā vasudātṛtārā krameṇa yogāḥ amṛtābhidānāḥ || || uttarāsalila poṣṇa viṣṇavo mātru māruta vasupracetasaḥ mitradaṃḍadhara pauṣṇatārakaḥ saumitra bhagaviśvaledhanaḥ || || maitrāśvinī marutā mātrṛtikṣyā bhagatrayī nairṛta pauṣṇadasrāḥ| dhātragni vāyutrayavārinādhāḥ sārkādi vāra śubhasiddhayogāḥ || || citrāgnīśvara vāruṇā dinapate vāresanaṃdātadhā bhaumasyāṃbu bhujaṃga pauṣṇamaruto yogaparākhya śśubhāḥ | naṃdā bhārgava bhaumaśīta mahasāṃ bhadhrākavidorjayā cāṃdrīkṣmā sitayoḥ śanerapi varā pūrṇā guro ssiddhidāḥ || || tithi vāra nakṣatra yogāye prektāste śubhakarmaṇi | tattadvārarkṣa yogeṣu viśeṣātsiddhidāyinaḥ || || saṃkṛtyā kṛti nāgasāyaka janairiṃdūtkṛtibhyāṃ śinai rmanṛkaiḥ sthita śakra nāgavasubhirvedāśṭa śakraiḥ kramāt| vidyeṃdrādbhi yugārka gigdṛtijanairaraiḥ purāṇairyutā nāḍī striṃśa datītya bheṣu parato nāḍyaśca tasromṛtam || || amṛta ghaṭikā ssamastā śśubha karmaṇyamṛtā yogavadgrāhyaḥ | viśarogādi cikitsā vidau śubhadā iti navācya midaṃ || || śaśi tadāruḍhāgrahādhipatiśca lagnādi nāthaśca yadātrayomī balādi kāssadgraha dṛśṭi yuktā guṇāghikaṃtaṃ kathayaṃti kālaṃ || || kartu sajanma samayā vasati grahāṇāṃ kṛtvāśṭavarga kathitārka vidhānamatra bahvarkṣa yogavaśataḥ śubharāśi māsa bhāva grahāḥ sthitiṣu karmasubhaṃ vidāryāt || || iyaṃta yevātra guṇāḥ pratiśṭhā doṣāpavādāṃśca tathā huranye | yeṣāṃ vibedhābahavoti sukṣmāḥ prakīrtitā vistarato munīṃdraiḥ || || vyasomanobhirati mahāguṇaṃ pradhānaṃ vāyūdayaṃca kapilaḥ śukanāni jivaḥ | gārgyaḥ prabhāta mṛṣira trirupaśrutiṃca viṣṇu ssamasta śubhakarmasu vipravākyaṃ || || upasyarājānamivadhikārī bhaktyāprasādyevaguruṃ sumaṃtraḥ abhyarcyadaivajña manenadattaḥ śubhomuhurto naśubhainyathāsyāt || || devārcanāsu niratojipa siddamaṃtraḥ saptāṃgayuktā guṇadoṣa balābalajñaḥ |
